const taskSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  order: z.number(),
  userId: z.string(),
  taskType: z.enum(['APPROVAL', 'SIGNATURE', 'REVIEW', 'ACTION']),
  description: z.string(),
  deadline: z.object({
    type: z.enum(['FIXED', 'RELATIVE']),
    value: z.number()
  }),
  dependencies: z.array(z.string()).optional()
});

const stageSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  uuid: z.string(),
  name: z.string(),
  order: z.number(),
  type: z.enum(['SEQUENTIAL', 'PARALLEL', 'QUORUM']),
  tasks: z.array(taskSchema),
  settings: z
    .object({
      quorumThreshold: z.number().optional()
    })
    .optional()
});

const workflowSettingsSchema = z.object({
  parallelExecution: z.boolean().optional(),
  quorumThreshold: z.number().optional(),
  timeoutBehavior: z.enum(['FAIL', 'CONTINUE', 'ESCALATE']),
  escalation: z
    .object({
      enabled: z.boolean(),
      to: z.array(z.string()),
      after: z.number()
    })
    .optional()
});

const baseWorkflowSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().optional(),
  settings: workflowSettingsSchema
});

const hybridWorkflowSchema = baseWorkflowSchema.extend({
  type: z.literal('HYBRID'),
  stages: z.array(stageSchema),
  tasks: z.never().optional()
});

const standardWorkflowSchema = baseWorkflowSchema.extend({
  type: z.enum(['SEQUENTIAL', 'PARALLEL', 'QUORUM']),
  tasks: z.array(taskSchema),
  stages: z.never().optional()
});

const workflowSchema = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [
  hybridWorkflowSchema,
  standardWorkflowSchema
]);

const taskTypes = [

    requiresApprovals: true

  {
    value: 'SIGNATURE',
    label: 'Signature',

type Task = {
  id: string;
  uuid: string;
  order: number;
  userId: string;
  taskType: TaskType;
  description: string;
  deadline: TaskDeadline;
  dependencies: string[];
};

export default function CreateTeamForm({
  organizationId,
  users,
  cookieString,
  user,
  userOrganizations
}: Readonly<CreateTeamFormProps>) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(0);

  const sensors = useSensors(
    useSensor(PointerSensor),
    useSensor(KeyboardSensor, {
      coordinateGetter: sortableKeyboardCoordinates
    })
  );

  const handleDragEnd = (event: DragEndEvent, field: any) => {
    const { active, over } = event;
    if (active.id !== over?.id) {
      const oldIndex = field.value.findIndex(
        (item: any) => item.id === active.id
      );
      const newIndex = field.value.findIndex(
        (item: any) => item.id === over?.id
      );
      field.onChange(arrayMove(field.value, oldIndex, newIndex));
    }
  };

  const SortableTask = ({
    task,
    index,
    field,
    memberOptions
  }: SortableTaskProps) => {
    const {
      attributes,
      listeners,
      setNodeRef,
      transform,
      transition,
      isDragging
    } = useSortable({ id: task.id });

    const style = {
      transform: CSS.Transform.toString(transform),
      transition,
      zIndex: isDragging ? 1 : 0
    };

    return (
      <div
        ref={setNodeRef}
        style={style}
        className={cn(
          'space-y-4 rounded-lg border bg-background p-4',
          isDragging && 'shadow-lg'
        )}
      >
        <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
          <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
            <button
              type='button'
              {...attributes}
              {...listeners}
              className='cursor-grab rounded p-1 hover:bg-muted'
            >
              <GripVertical className='h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground' />
            </button>
            <span className='font-medium'>Task {index + 1}</span>
          </div>
          <Button
            type='button'
            variant='ghost'
            size='sm'
            className='text-destructive'
            onClick={() => {
              const newTasks = [...field.value];
              newTasks.splice(index, 1);
              field.onChange(newTasks);
            }}
          >
            Remove
          </Button>
        </div>
        {renderTaskFields(task, index, field, memberOptions)}
      </div>
    );
  };

  const SortableStage = ({ stage, index, field }: SortableStageProps) => {
    const {
      attributes,
      listeners,
      setNodeRef,
      transform,
      transition,
      isDragging
    } = useSortable({ id: stage.id });

    const style = {
      transform: CSS.Transform.toString(transform),
      transition,
      zIndex: isDragging ? 1 : 0
    };

    const selectedMembers = form.watch('members') || [];
    const memberOptions = userOptions.filter((option) =>
      selectedMembers.includes(option.value)
    );

    return (
      <div
        ref={setNodeRef}
        style={style}
        className={cn(
          'space-y-4 rounded-lg border bg-background p-4',
          isDragging && 'shadow-lg'
        )}
      >
        <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
          <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
            <button
              type='button'
              {...attributes}
              {...listeners}
              className='cursor-grab rounded p-1 hover:bg-muted'
            >
              <GripVertical className='h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground' />
            </button>
            <span className='font-medium'>Stage {index + 1}</span>
          </div>
          <Button
            type='button'
            variant='ghost'
            size='sm'
            className='text-destructive'
            onClick={() => {
              const newStages = [...field.value];
              newStages.splice(index, 1);
              field.onChange(newStages);
            }}
          >
            Remove
          </Button>
        </div>
        <div className='space-y-4'>
          <div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'>
            <div>
              <FormLabel>Stage Name</FormLabel>
              <Input
                value={stage.name}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const newStages = [...field.value];
                  newStages[index] = {
                    ...stage,
                    name: e.target.value
                  };
                  field.onChange(newStages);
                }}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <FormLabel>Stage Type</FormLabel>
              <Select
                value={stage.type}
                onValueChange={(value) => {
                  const newStages = [...field.value];
                  newStages[index] = {
                    ...stage,
                    type: value,
                    settings: value === 'QUORUM' ? { quorumThreshold: 1 } : {}
                  };
                  field.onChange(newStages);
                }}
              >
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder='Select stage type' />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value='SEQUENTIAL'>Sequential</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value='PARALLEL'>Parallel</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value='QUORUM'>Quorum</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {stage.type === 'QUORUM' && (
            <div>
              <FormLabel>Quorum Threshold</FormLabel>
              <Input
                type='number'
                value={stage.settings?.quorumThreshold || ''}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const newStages = [...field.value];
                  newStages[index] = {
                    ...stage,
                    settings: {
                      ...stage.settings,
                      quorumThreshold: parseInt(e.target.value) || 1
                    }
                  };
                  field.onChange(newStages);
                }}
                min={1}
                placeholder='Enter minimum required approvals'
              />
              <FormDescription>
                Minimum number of approvals required to complete this stage
              </FormDescription>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className='space-y-4'>
            <FormLabel>Stage Tasks</FormLabel>
            <div className='space-y-4'>
              <DndContext
                sensors={sensors}
                collisionDetection={closestCenter}
                onDragEnd={(event) => {
                  const { active, over } = event;
                  if (active.id !== over?.id) {
                    const oldIndex = stage.tasks.findIndex(
                      (task: any) => task.id === active.id
                    );
                    const newIndex = stage.tasks.findIndex(
                      (task: any) => task.id === over?.id
                    );
                    const newStages = [...field.value];
                    newStages[index] = {
                      ...stage,
                      tasks: arrayMove(stage.tasks, oldIndex, newIndex)
                    };
                    field.onChange(newStages);
                  }
                }}
              >
                <SortableContext
                  items={stage.tasks?.map((task: any) => task.id) || []}
                  strategy={verticalListSortingStrategy}
                >
                  {stage.tasks?.map((task: any, taskIndex: number) => (
                    <SortableTask
                      key={task.id}
                      task={task}
                      index={taskIndex}
                      field={{
                        value: stage.tasks,
                        onChange: (newTasks: any) => {
                          const newStages = [...field.value];
                          newStages[index] = {
                            ...stage,
                            tasks: newTasks
                          };
                          field.onChange(newStages);
                        }
                      }}
                      memberOptions={memberOptions}
                    />
                  ))}
                </SortableContext>
              </DndContext>
              <Button
                type='button'
                variant='outline'
                onClick={() => {
                  const newStages = [...field.value];
                  newStages[index] = {
                    ...stage,
                    tasks: [
                      ...(stage.tasks || []),
                      createNewTask(
                        form.getValues('workflows.0.tasks')?.length + 1 || 0
                      )
                    ]
                  };
                  field.onChange(newStages);
                }}
              >
                Add Task
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const renderTaskDependencies = (
    task: Task,
    index: number,
    field: any  ) => {
    if (index === 0) {
      return null;
    }
    return (
      <FormField
        control={form.control}
        name={`workflows.0.tasks.${index}.dependencies`}
        render={({ field: dependencyField }) => (
          <FormItem>
            <FormLabel>Dependencies</FormLabel>
            <FormControl>
              <MultiSelect
                options={field.value
                  .filter((t: Task) => t.id !== task.id)
                  .map((t: Task) => ({
                    value: t.id,
                    label: `${t.description} - Task ${t.order}`
                  }))}
                value={dependencyField.value}
                onValueChange={dependencyField.onChange}
                placeholder='Select dependencies'
                modalPopover={true}
              />
            </FormControl>
            <FormMessage />
          </FormItem>
        )}
      />
    );
  };

  const renderTaskFields = (
    task: any,
    index: number,
    field: any,
    memberOptions: { value: string; label: string }[]
  ) => (
    <div className='space-y-6'>
      <div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'>
        <div>
          <FormLabel>Assigned To</FormLabel>
          <Select
            value={task.userId}
            onValueChange={(value) => {
              const newTasks = [...field.value];
              newTasks[index] = {
                ...task,
                userId: value
              };
              field.onChange(newTasks);
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger>
              <SelectValue placeholder='Select team member' />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {memberOptions.map((option) => (
                <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                  {option.label}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <FormLabel>Task Type</FormLabel>
          <Select
            value={task.taskType}
            onValueChange={(value) => {
              const newTasks = [...field.value];
              newTasks[index] = {
                ...task,
                taskType: value as TaskType
              };
              field.onChange(newTasks);
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger>
              <SelectValue placeholder='Select task type' />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {taskTypes.map((type) => (
                <SelectItem key={type.value} value={type.value}>
                  {type.label}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <FormLabel>Task Description</FormLabel>
          <Input
            value={task.description}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const newTasks = [...field.value];
              newTasks[index] = {
                ...task,
                description: e.target.value
              };
              field.onChange(newTasks);
            }}
            placeholder='Enter task description'
          />
        </div>
        <div>
          <FormLabel>Deadline Type</FormLabel>
          <Select
            value={task.deadline ? task.deadline.type : 'FIXED'}
            onValueChange={(value) => {
              const newTasks = [...field.value];
              newTasks[index] = {
                ...task,
                deadline: {
                  ...task.deadline,
                  type: value as 'FIXED' | 'RELATIVE',
                  // Reset value when switching types
                  value: value === 'FIXED' ? new Date().getTime() : 24
                }
              };
              field.onChange(newTasks);
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger>
              <SelectValue placeholder='Select deadline type' />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value='RELATIVE'>Relative (hours)</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value='FIXED'>Fixed Date</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <FormLabel>Deadline Value</FormLabel>
          {task.deadline.type === 'FIXED' ? (
            <DateTimePicker
              value={
                task.deadline.value ? new Date(task.deadline.value) : undefined
              }
              onChange={(date) => {
                const newTasks = [...field.value];
                newTasks[index] = {
                  ...task,
                  deadline: {
                    ...task.deadline,
                    value: date ? date.getTime() : new Date().getTime()
                  }
                };
                field.onChange(newTasks);
              }}
            />
          ) : (
            <Input
              type='number'
              value={task.deadline.value || ''}
              placeholder='Enter deadline value (in hours)'
              onChange={(e) => {
                const newTasks = [...field.value];
                newTasks[index] = {
                  ...task,
                  deadline: {
                    ...task.deadline,
                    value: e.target.value ? parseInt(e.target.value) : 24
                  }
                };
                field.onChange(newTasks);
              }}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      {renderTaskDependencies(task, index, field)}
    </div>
  );

  const defaultWorkflowSettings = {
    timeoutBehavior: 'FAIL',
    parallelExecution: false,
    quorumThreshold: undefined,
    escalation: {
      enabled: false,
      to: [],
      after: 24
    }
  };

  const createNewTask = (order: number, type: TaskType = 'APPROVAL'): Task => {
    const { shortId, uuid } = ShortIdMapper.generatePair();

    return {
      id: shortId,
      uuid,
      order,
      userId: '',
      taskType: type,
      description: '',
      deadline: {
        type: 'RELATIVE',
        value: 24
      },
      dependencies: []
    };
  };

  const createNewStage = (order: number) => {
    const { shortId, uuid } = ShortIdMapper.generatePair();
    return {
      id: shortId,
      uuid,
      name: '',
      order,
      type: 'SEQUENTIAL' as 'SEQUENTIAL' | 'PARALLEL' | 'QUORUM',
      tasks: [],
      settings: {}
    };
  };

  const defaultTask = createNewTask(1);

  const form = useForm<FormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(formSchema),
    mode: 'onChange',
    reValidateMode: 'onChange',
    defaultValues: {
      name: '',
      description: '',
      type: '',
      members: [],
      maxMembers: 2,
      visibility: Visibility.PRIVATE,
      notifications: {
        beforeDeadline: ['24'],
        onComplete: true,
        onStart: true
      },
      configuration: {
        isActive: true,
        autoJoin: {
          enabled: false
        },
        security: {
          mfaRequired: false,
          dataClassification: 'INTERNAL',
          sessionTimeout: 3600
        }
      },
      workflows: [
        {
          type: 'SEQUENTIAL',
          tasks: [defaultTask as any],
          settings: defaultWorkflowSettings as any
        }
      ],
      security: {
        accessControl: {
          mfaRequired: false,
          sessionTimeout: 3600
        }
      }
    }
  });

  const onSubmit = async (data: z.infer<typeof formSchema>) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Add token to all team creation requests
      const headers = {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      };

      // 1. Create team
      // This creates the team record in the database and also adds the owner as a member of the team
      // In all the teams, regardless if the owner is a member or not, the owner is always a member of the team
      const teamResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          headers,
          body: JSON.stringify({
            organizationId,
            name: data.name,
            description: data.description,
            type: data.type,
            maxMembers: data.maxMembers,
            visibility: data.visibility,
            configuration: {
              isActive: true,
              sourceSystemId: SOURCE_SYSTEM_IDS.TEAM_CREATION,
              visibility: data.visibility,
              autoJoin: data.configuration?.autoJoin || {
                enabled: false
              }
            },
            notificationsPreferences: {
              ...data.notifications
            },
            metadata: {
              createdBy: user.sub,
              lastModifiedBy: user.sub,
              version: '1.0.0',
              tags: [],
              customFields: {}
            },
            workflows: data.workflows,
            settings: {
              notifications: {
                enabled: true,
                channels: ['email'],
                events: ['member_added', 'member_removed', 'team_updated']
              },
              collaboration: {
                enabled: true,
                tools: ['chat', 'documents']
              }
            },
            createdBy: user.sub,
            lastModifiedBy: user.sub,
            creatorUserId: user.sub
          })
        }
      );

      const teamResult: CreateCustomTeamResponse = await teamResponse.json();

      if (teamResult.message !== 'Custom team created successfully') {
        console.error('Failed to create team:', teamResult);
        return toast.error(teamResult.message || 'Failed to create team');
      }

      // 2. Create workflow records
      for (const workflow of data.workflows) {
        // Create workflow provenance
        const workflowProvenanceData = {
          entityType: 'WORKFLOW',
          entityId: 'TO_BE_UPDATED',
          sourceSystemId: SOURCE_SYSTEM_IDS.TEAM_CREATION,
          provenanceData: {
            source_system_id: SOURCE_SYSTEM_IDS.TEAM_CREATION,
            provenance: {
              timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
              user_id: user.sub,
              title: `Workflow Creation - ${workflow.name || 'Unnamed Workflow'}`,
              source_system: 'team',
              entity_type: 'WORKFLOW'
            }
          },
          actionType: 'WORKFLOW_CREATED'
        };

        const workflowProvenanceResponse = await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/data-provenances?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            headers,
            body: JSON.stringify(workflowProvenanceData)
          }
        );

        const workflowProvenanceResult: CreateDataProvenanceResponse =
          await workflowProvenanceResponse.json();

        if (
          workflowProvenanceResult.message !==
          'Data provenance created successfully'
        ) {
          console.error(
            'Failed to create workflow data provenance:',
            workflowProvenanceResult
          );
          return toast.error(
            workflowProvenanceResult.message ||
              'Failed to create workflow data provenance'
          );
        }

        // Create workflow security context
        const workflowSecurityContext: CreateSecurityContextResponse =
          await fetch(
            `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/security-contexts?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
            {
              method: 'POST',
              headers,
              body: JSON.stringify({
                name: `Workflow Security Context - ${workflow.name || 'Unnamed Workflow'}`,
                description: `Security context for workflow ${workflow.name || 'Unnamed Workflow'}`,
                contextType: SecurityContextType.WORKFLOW,
                organizationId: organizationId,
                contextData: {
                  sourceSystemId: SOURCE_SYSTEM_IDS.TEAM_CREATION,
                  accessControls: {
                    mfaRequired: false,
                    ipRestrictions: [],
                    geoRestrictions: [],
                    deviceRestrictions: [],
                    temporalRestrictions: []
                  }
                }
              })
            }
          ).then((res) => res.json());

        if (
          workflowSecurityContext.message !==
          'Security context created successfully'
        ) {
          console.error(
            'Failed to create workflow security context:',
            workflowSecurityContext
          );
          return toast.error(
            workflowSecurityContext.message ||
              'Failed to create workflow security context'
          );
        }

        // Create workflow
        const workflowResponse = await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/workflows?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            headers,
            body: JSON.stringify({
              ...workflow,
              name: workflow.name || 'Default Workflow',
              configuration: { ...workflow },
              status: 'ACTIVE',
              steps: workflow.stages || workflow.tasks,
              teamId: teamResult.team.id,
              organizationId,
              creatorUserId: user.sub,
              securityContextId:
                workflowSecurityContext.securityContext.database.id,
              provenanceId: workflowProvenanceResult.dataProvenance.database.id
            })
          }
        );

        const workflowResult: CreateWorkflowResponse =
          await workflowResponse.json();

        if (workflowResult.message !== 'Workflow created successfully') {
          console.error('Failed to create workflow:', workflowResult);
          return toast.error(
            workflowResult.message || 'Failed to create workflow'
          );
        }

        // Update workflow provenance with actual workflow ID
        await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/data-provenances/${workflowProvenanceResult.dataProvenance.database.id}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'PATCH',
            headers,
            body: JSON.stringify({
              entityId: workflowResult.workflow.database.id
            })
          }
        );
      }

      // 3. Create team members
      // Filter out the owner from the list of members because the owner is already a member of the team
      const allMembers = data.members.filter((member) => member !== user.sub);
      for (const memberId of [...new Set(allMembers)]) {
        const member =
          users.database.find((user) => user.id === memberId) ??
          users.logto.find((user) => user.id === memberId);
        if (!member) continue;

        // Create member provenance
        const memberProvenanceData = {
          entityType: 'TEAM_MEMBER',
          entityId: memberId,
          sourceSystemId: SOURCE_SYSTEM_IDS.TEAM_CREATION,
          provenanceData: {
            source_system_id: SOURCE_SYSTEM_IDS.TEAM_CREATION,
            provenance: {
              timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
              user_id: user.sub,
              title: `Team Member Addition - ${memberId}`,
              source_system: 'team',
              entity_type: 'TEAM_MEMBER'
            }
          },
          actionType: 'TEAM_MEMBER_ADDED'
        };

        const memberProvenanceResponse = await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/data-provenances?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            headers,
            body: JSON.stringify(memberProvenanceData)
          }
        );

        const memberProvenanceResult: CreateDataProvenanceResponse =
          await memberProvenanceResponse.json();

        if (
          memberProvenanceResult.message !==
          'Data provenance created successfully'
        ) {
          console.error(
            'Failed to create member data provenance:',
            memberProvenanceResult
          );
          return toast.error(
            memberProvenanceResult.message ||
              'Failed to create member data provenance'
          );
        }

        // Create member security context
        const memberSecurityContext: CreateSecurityContextResponse =
          await fetch(
            `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/security-contexts?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
            {
              method: 'POST',
              headers,
              body: JSON.stringify({
                name: `Team Member Security Context - ${memberId}`,
                description: `Security context for team member ${memberId}`,
                contextType: SecurityContextType.TEAM,
                organizationId: organizationId,
                contextData: {
                  sourceSystemId: SOURCE_SYSTEM_IDS.TEAM_CREATION,
                  accessControls: {
                    mfaRequired: false,
                    ipRestrictions: [],
                    geoRestrictions: [],
                    deviceRestrictions: [],
                    temporalRestrictions: []
                  }
                }
              })
            }
          ).then((res) => res.json());

        if (
          memberSecurityContext.message !==
          'Security context created successfully'
        ) {
          console.error(
            'Failed to create member security context:',
            memberSecurityContext
          );
          return toast.error(
            memberSecurityContext.message ||
              'Failed to create member security context'
          );
        }

        // Create team member
        const memberResponse = await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${teamResult.team.id}/members?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            headers,
            body: JSON.stringify({
              teamId: teamResult.team.id,
              userId: memberId,
              organizationId,
              role:
                memberId === user.sub
                  ? TeamMemberRole.OWNER
                  : TeamMemberRole.MEMBER,
              status: TeamMemberStatus.ACTIVE,
              attributes: {
                permissions: memberId === user.sub ? ['*'] : [],
                level: memberId === user.sub ? 'OWNER' : 'MEMBER',
                function: memberId === user.sub ? 'TEAM_ADMIN' : 'TEAM_MEMBER',
                specializations: []
              },
              invitedBy: user.sub,
              securityContextId:
                memberSecurityContext.securityContext.database.id,
              provenanceId: memberProvenanceResult.dataProvenance.database.id
            })
          }
        );

        const memberResult: AddTeamMemberResponse = await memberResponse.json();

        if (memberResult.message !== 'Team member added successfully') {
          console.error('Failed to add team member:', memberResult);
          return toast.error(
            memberResult.message || 'Failed to add team member'
          );
        }

        // Update member provenance with actual member ID
        await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/data-provenances/${memberProvenanceResult.dataProvenance.database.id}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'PATCH',
            headers,
            body: JSON.stringify({
              entityId: memberResult.member.id
            })
          }
        );

        // Create activity log for member addition
        const activityLogResponse = await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-member-activity-logs?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            headers,
            body: JSON.stringify({
              teamId: teamResult.team.id,
              userId: memberId,
              activityType: TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_ADDED,
              details: {
                changedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                changedBy: user.sub,
                message: `Team member ${member.name} added by ${user.name} on ${formatDate(new Date(), 'PPPPpppp')}.`,
                oldValues: {},
                newValues: {}
              } as TeamMemberActivityLogDetails,
              metadata: {
                teamId: teamResult.team.id,
                usersInvolved: [user.sub, memberId],
                performedBy: user.sub,
                version: '1.0.0'
              } as TeamMemberActivityLogMetadata,
              performedBy: user.sub
            } as Omit<TeamMemberActivityLogInsert, 'id' | 'uid'>)
          }
        );

        const activityLogResult: CreateTeamMemberActivityLogResponse =
          await activityLogResponse.json();

        if (
          activityLogResult.message !==
          'Team member activity log created successfully'
        ) {
          console.error('Failed to create activity log:', activityLogResult);
          return toast.error(
            activityLogResult.message || 'Failed to create activity log'
          );
        }
      }

      toast.success(`Team ${data.name} created successfully!`);
      router.push(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamResult.team.id}`
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating team:', error);
      toast.error(
        'Failed to create team: ' +
          (error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error')
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const userOptions =
    users.database.map((user) => ({
      label: user.name,
      value: user.id
    })) ??
    users.logto.map((user) => ({
      label: user.name,
      value: user.id
    }));

  const isStepValid = (step: number) => {
    const values = form.getValues();
    switch (step) {
      case 0:
        return (
          values.name.length >= 3 &&
          values.description.length >= 10 &&
          values.type.length > 0 &&
          values.maxMembers >= 2
        );
      case 1:
        return values.members.length >= 2;
      case 2: {
        const workflow = values.workflows[0];
        const notificationsValid =
          values.notifications &&
          values.notifications.beforeDeadline?.length > 0;
        if (workflow.type === 'HYBRID') {
          const hybridWorkflow = workflow;
          const hasStages =
            !!hybridWorkflow.stages && hybridWorkflow.stages.length > 0;
          const stagesValid = hasStages
            ? hybridWorkflow.stages.every((stage) => {
                return (
                  stage.name &&
                  stage.type &&
                  !!stage.tasks?.length &&
                  stage.tasks.every(
                    (task) =>
                      task.userId &&
                      task.taskType &&
                      task.description &&
                      task.deadline?.type &&
                      task.deadline?.value > 0
                  ) &&
                  (stage.type !== 'QUORUM' ||
                    (stage.settings?.quorumThreshold &&
                      stage.settings.quorumThreshold > 0))
                );
              })
            : false;
          return hasStages && stagesValid && notificationsValid;
        } else {
          const standardWorkflow = workflow;
          const hasValidTasks =
            standardWorkflow.tasks.length > 0 &&
            standardWorkflow.tasks.every(
              (task) =>
                task.userId &&
                task.taskType &&
                task.description &&
                task.deadline?.type &&
                task.deadline?.value > 0
            );
          return hasValidTasks && notificationsValid;
        }
      }
      default:
        return true;
    }
  };

  const handleStepChangeScroll = () => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      setTimeout(() => {
        const formElement = document.getElementById('create-team-form');
        if (formElement) {
          formElement.scrollIntoView({
            behavior: 'smooth',
            block: 'start'
          });
        } else {
          window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      }, 0);
    }
  };

  const renderWorkflowConfig = (type: WorkflowType) => {
    const selectedMembers = form.watch('members') || [];
    const memberOptions = userOptions.filter((option) =>
      selectedMembers.includes(option.value)
    );

    const renderTimeoutBehavior = () => (
      <FormField
        control={form.control}
        name={`workflows.0.settings.timeoutBehavior`}
        render={({ field }) => (
          <FormItem>
            <FormLabel>Timeout Behavior</FormLabel>
            <Select onValueChange={field.onChange} defaultValue={field.value}>
              <FormControl>
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder='Select timeout behavior' />
                </SelectTrigger>
              </FormControl>
              <SelectContent>
                {timeoutBehaviors.map((behavior) => (
                  <SelectItem key={behavior.value} value={behavior.value}>
                    {behavior.label}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
            <FormDescription>
              Choose what happens when a task times out
            </FormDescription>
            <FormMessage />
          </FormItem>
        )}
      />
    );

    const renderEscalationSettings = () => {
      const timeoutBehavior = form.watch(
        'workflows.0.settings.timeoutBehavior'
      );
      if (timeoutBehavior !== 'ESCALATE') return null;

      return (
        <div className='space-y-4'>
          <FormField
            control={form.control}
            name={`workflows.0.settings.escalation.enabled`}
            render={({ field }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>Enable Escalation</FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Checkbox
                    checked={field.value}
                    onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                  />
                </FormControl>
                <FormDescription>
                  Enable escalation to administrators after timeout
                </FormDescription>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
          {form.watch('workflows.0.settings.escalation.enabled') && (
            <>
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name={`workflows.0.settings.escalation.after`}
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Escalate After (hours)</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input
                        type='number'
                        placeholder='Enter hours before escalation'
                        {...field}
                        value={field.value || ''}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          field.onChange(
                            e.target.value ? parseInt(e.target.value) : 24
                          )
                        }
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormDescription>
                      Number of hours before escalating to administrators
                    </FormDescription>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name={`workflows.0.settings.escalation.to`}
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Escalate To</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <MultiSelect
                        onValueChange={field.onChange}
                        defaultValue={field.value}
                        modalPopover={true}
                        options={userOrganizations.database
                          .filter(
                            (u) =>
                              u.role === UserOrganizationRole.ADMIN ||
                              u.role === UserOrganizationRole.SUPER_ADMIN ||
                              u.role === UserOrganizationRole.OWNER
                          )
                          .map((u) => ({
                            label: u.user.name,
                            value: u.user.id
                          }))}
                        placeholder='Select administrators'
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormDescription>
                      Select administrators to escalate to
                    </FormDescription>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    };

    switch (type) {
      case 'SEQUENTIAL':
        return (
          <div className='space-y-4'>
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='notifications.beforeDeadline'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Remind Before Deadline (hours)</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <MultiSelect
                      onValueChange={field.onChange}
                      defaultValue={field.value.map(String)}
                      modalPopover={true}
                      options={[
                        { value: '1', label: '1 hour' },
                        { value: '2', label: '2 hours' },
                        { value: '6', label: '6 hours' },
                        { value: '12', label: '12 hours' },
                        { value: '24', label: '24 hours' },
                        { value: '48', label: '48 hours' }
                      ]}
                      placeholder='Select reminder times'
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormDescription>
                    Select when to send reminders before the deadline
                  </FormDescription>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            <div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'>
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='notifications.onStart'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-start space-x-3 space-y-0 rounded-md border p-4'>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Checkbox
                        checked={field.value}
                        onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <div className='space-y-1 leading-none'>
                      <FormLabel>Notify on Start</FormLabel>
                      <FormDescription>
                        Send a notification when the workflow starts
                      </FormDescription>
                    </div>
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='notifications.onComplete'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-start space-x-3 space-y-0 rounded-md border p-4'>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Checkbox
                        checked={field.value}
                        onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <div className='space-y-1 leading-none'>
                      <FormLabel>Notify on Complete</FormLabel>
                      <FormDescription>
                        Send a notification when the workflow is completed
                      </FormDescription>
                    </div>
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            </div>
            {renderTimeoutBehavior()}
            {renderEscalationSettings()}
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='workflows.0.tasks'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Sequential Tasks</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <div className='space-y-4'>
                      <DndContext
                        sensors={sensors}
                        collisionDetection={closestCenter}
                        onDragEnd={(event) => handleDragEnd(event, field)}
                      >
                        <SortableContext
                          items={field.value?.map((task: any) => task.id) || []}
                          strategy={verticalListSortingStrategy}
                        >
                          {field.value?.map((task: any, index: number) => (
                            <SortableTask
                              key={task.id}
                              task={task}
                              index={index}
                              field={field}
                              memberOptions={memberOptions}
                            />
                          ))}
                        </SortableContext>
                      </DndContext>
                      <Button
                        type='button'
                        variant='outline'
                        onClick={() => {
                          field.onChange([
                            ...(field.value || []),
                            createNewTask(
                              form.getValues('workflows.0.tasks')?.length + 1 ||
                                0
                            )
                          ]);
                        }}
                      >
                        Add Task
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormDescription>
                    Define the sequence of tasks and assign them to team members
                  </FormDescription>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
          </div>
        );

      case 'PARALLEL':
        return (
          <div className='space-y-4'>
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='notifications.beforeDeadline'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Remind Before Deadline (hours)</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <MultiSelect
                      onValueChange={field.onChange}
                      defaultValue={field.value.map(String)}
                      modalPopover={true}
                      options={[
                        { value: '1', label: '1 hour' },
                        { value: '2', label: '2 hours' },
                        { value: '6', label: '6 hours' },
                        { value: '12', label: '12 hours' },
                        { value: '24', label: '24 hours' },
                        { value: '48', label: '48 hours' }
                      ]}
                      placeholder='Select reminder times'
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormDescription>
                    Select when to send reminders before the deadline
                  </FormDescription>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            <div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'>
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='notifications.onStart'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-start space-x-3 space-y-0 rounded-md border p-4'>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Checkbox
                        checked={field.value}
                        onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <div className='space-y-1 leading-none'>
                      <FormLabel>Notify on Start</FormLabel>
                      <FormDescription>
                        Send a notification when the workflow starts
                      </FormDescription>
                    </div>
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='notifications.onComplete'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-start space-x-3 space-y-0 rounded-md border p-4'>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Checkbox
                        checked={field.value}
                        onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <div className='space-y-1 leading-none'>
                      <FormLabel>Notify on Complete</FormLabel>
                      <FormDescription>
                        Send a notification when the workflow is completed
                      </FormDescription>
                    </div>
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            </div>
            {renderTimeoutBehavior()}
            {renderEscalationSettings()}
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='workflows.0.tasks'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Parallel Tasks</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <div className='space-y-4'>
                      <DndContext
                        sensors={sensors}
                        collisionDetection={closestCenter}
                        onDragEnd={(event) => handleDragEnd(event, field)}
                      >
                        <SortableContext
                          items={field.value?.map((task: any) => task.id) || []}
                          strategy={verticalListSortingStrategy}
                        >
                          {field.value?.map((task: any, index: number) => (
                            <SortableTask
                              key={task.id}
                              task={task}
                              index={index}
                              field={field}
                              memberOptions={memberOptions}
                            />
                          ))}
                        </SortableContext>
                      </DndContext>
                      <Button
                        type='button'
                        variant='outline'
                        onClick={() => {
                          field.onChange([
                            ...(field.value || []),
                            {
                              id: crypto.randomUUID(),
                              userId: '',
                              taskType: 'PARALLEL',
                              description: '',
                              deadline: {
                                type: 'RELATIVE',
                                value: 24
                              },
                              dependencies: [],
                              notifications: {
                                beforeDeadline: [24],
                                onComplete: true,
                                onStart: true
                              },
                              completion: {
                                autoComplete: false
                              }
                            }
                          ]);
                        }}
                      >
                        Add Task
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormDescription>
                    Define parallel tasks that can be executed simultaneously
                  </FormDescription>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='workflows.0.settings.quorumThreshold'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Completion Threshold</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Input
                      type='number'
                      placeholder='Enter minimum number of completions required'
                      {...field}
                      value={field.value || ''}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        field.onChange(
                          e.target.value ? parseInt(e.target.value) : 1
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormDescription>
                    Minimum number of tasks that must be completed
                  </FormDescription>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
          </div>
        );

      case 'QUORUM':
        return (
          <div className='space-y-4'>
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='notifications.beforeDeadline'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Remind Before Deadline (hours)</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <MultiSelect
                      onValueChange={field.onChange}
                      defaultValue={field.value.map(String)}
                      modalPopover={true}
                      options={[
                        { value: '1', label: '1 hour' },

              </h2>
              {renderFormFields()}
            </div>

            <div className='mt-8 flex justify-between'>
              {currentStep > 0 && (
                <Button
                  type='button'
                  variant='outline'
                  onClick={() => {
                    setCurrentStep((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1));
                    handleStepChangeScroll();
                  }}
                  disabled={currentStep === 0}
                >
                  Previous
                </Button>
              )}
              <div className='ml-auto'>
                {currentStep < steps.length - 1 ? (
                  <Button
                    type='button'
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      setCurrentStep((prev) =>
                        Math.min(steps.length - 1, prev + 1)
                      );
                      handleStepChangeScroll();
                    }}
                    disabled={!isStepValid(currentStep)}
                  >
                    Next Step
                    <ChevronRight className='ml-2 h-4 w-4' />
                  </Button>
                ) : (
                  <Button
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      onSubmit(form.getValues());
                    }}
                    disabled={loading}
                  >
                    {loading ? (
                      <>
                        <Loader2 className='mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin' />
                        Creating...
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      'Create Team'
                    )}
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Form>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

type SortableTaskProps = {
  task: any;
  index: number;
  field: any;
  memberOptions: { value: string; label: string }[];
};

const createNewTask = (order: number) => {
  const { shortId: id, uuid } = ShortIdMapper.generatePair();
  return {
    id,
    uuid,
    order,
    userId: '',
    taskType: 'APPROVAL' as 'APPROVAL' | 'SIGNATURE' | 'REVIEW' | 'ACTION',
    description: '',
    deadline: {
      type: 'RELATIVE' as 'RELATIVE' | 'FIXED',
      value: 24
    },
    dependencies: []
  };
};

const SortableTask = ({
  task,
  index,
  field,
  memberOptions
}: SortableTaskProps) => {
  const {
    attributes,
    listeners,
    setNodeRef,
    transform,
    transition,
    isDragging
  } = useSortable({ id: task.id });

  const style = {
    transform: CSS.Transform.toString(transform),
    transition,
    zIndex: isDragging ? 1 : 0
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={setNodeRef}
      style={style}
      className={cn(
        'space-y-4 rounded-lg border bg-background p-4',
        isDragging && 'shadow-lg'
      )}
    >
      <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
        <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
          <button
            type='button'
            {...attributes}
            {...listeners}
            className='cursor-grab rounded p-1 hover:bg-muted'
          >
            <GripVertical className='h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground' />
          </button>
          <span className='font-medium'>Task {index + 1}</span>
        </div>
        <Button
          type='button'
          variant='ghost'
          size='sm'
          className='text-destructive'
          onClick={() => {
            const newTasks = [...field.value];
            newTasks.splice(index, 1);
            field.onChange(newTasks);
          }}
        >
          Remove
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'>
        <div>
          <FormLabel>Assigned To</FormLabel>
          <Select
            value={task.userId}
            onValueChange={(value) => {
              const newTasks = [...field.value];
              newTasks[index] = {
                ...task,
                userId: value
              };
              field.onChange(newTasks);
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger>
              <SelectValue placeholder='Select team member' />
            </SelectTrigger>

          </Select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <FormLabel>Task Type</FormLabel>

                taskType: value
