              field.onChange(newTasks);
            }}
            placeholder='Enter hours'
          />
        )}
      </div>
      {index > 0 && (
        <FormItem>
          <FormLabel>Dependencies</FormLabel>
          <FormControl>
            <MultiSelect
              value={task.dependencies || []}
              defaultValue={task.dependencies || []}
              options={field.value
                .filter((t) => t.id !== task.id)
                .map((t) => ({
                  value: t.id,
                  label: `${t.description} - Task ${t.order}`
                }))}
              onValueChange={(value) => {
                const newTasks = [...field.value];
                newTasks[index] = {
                  ...task,
                  dependencies: value
                };
                field.onChange(newTasks);
              }}
              placeholder='Select dependencies'
            />
          </FormControl>
          <FormDescription>
            Select tasks that must be completed first
          </FormDescription>
          <FormMessage />
        </FormItem>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export function EditTeamSheet({
  team,
  organizationId,
  cookieString,
  user,
  onTeamUpdated,
  allUsers
}: Readonly<EditTeamSheetProps>) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const sensors = useSensors(
    useSensor(PointerSensor),
    useSensor(KeyboardSensor, {
      coordinateGetter: sortableKeyboardCoordinates
    })
  );
  const form = useForm<FormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(formSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      name: team.name,
      description: team.description,
      type: team.type,
      maxMembers: team.maxMembers,
      visibility: team.visibility,
      members: team.members?.map((m) => m.userId) || [],
      notifications: team.notificationsPreferences || {
        beforeDeadline: ['24'],
        onComplete: true,
        onStart: true
      },
      configuration: {
        isActive: (team.configuration as TeamConfiguration)?.isActive ?? true,
        autoJoin: {
          enabled:
            (team.configuration as TeamConfiguration)?.autoJoin?.enabled ??
            false
        },
        security: {
          mfaRequired:
            (team.configuration as TeamConfiguration)?.security?.mfaRequired ??
            false,
          dataClassification:
            (team.configuration as TeamConfiguration)?.security
              ?.dataClassification ?? 'INTERNAL',
          sessionTimeout:
            (team.configuration as TeamConfiguration)?.security
              ?.sessionTimeout ?? 3600
        }
      },
      workflows: (team.workflows as any) || [defaultWorkflow]
    }
  });

  const updateTeamMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (values: FormValues) => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const headers = {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'cookie': cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString
        };

        // Update team
        const teamResponse = await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${team.id}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'PATCH',
            headers,
            body: JSON.stringify({
              name: values.name,
              description: values.description,
              type: values.type,
              maxMembers: values.maxMembers,
              visibility: values.visibility,
              notificationsPreferences: values.notifications,
              configuration: {
                isActive: (values.configuration as TeamConfiguration).isActive,
                autoJoin: (values.configuration as TeamConfiguration).autoJoin,
                security: (values.configuration as TeamConfiguration).security,
                sourceSystemId: SOURCE_SYSTEM_IDS.TEAM_CREATION
              },
              workflows: values.workflows,
              settings: values.settings,
              metadata: {
                ...((team.metadata as any) ?? {}),
                lastModifiedBy: user.sub,
                version: (
                  parseFloat((team.metadata as any)?.version || '1.0.0') + 0.1
                ).toFixed(1)
              }
            })
          }
        );

        const teamResult: UpdateCustomTeamResponse = await teamResponse.json();

        if (teamResult.message !== 'Custom team updated successfully') {
          clientLogger.error('[EditTeamSheet] Error updating team', {
            error: teamResult.message || 'Failed to update team',
            teamId: team.id,
            organizationId
          });
          toast.error('Failed to update team: ' + teamResult.message);
        }

        return teamResult.team;
      } catch (error) {
        clientLogger.error('[EditTeamSheet] Error updating team', {
          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
          teamId: team.id,
          organizationId
        });
        toast.error(
          'Failed to update team: ' +
            (error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error')
        );
      }
    },
    onSuccess: (updatedTeam) => {
      toast.success('Team updated successfully');
      onTeamUpdated(updatedTeam as CustomTeamWithMembers);
      setOpen(false);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['teams', organizationId]
      });
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to update team'
      );
    },
    onSettled: () => {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  });

  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <SheetTrigger asChild>
        <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
          <Pencil className='mr-2 h-4 w-4' />
          Edit Team
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </SheetTrigger>
      <SheetContent className='w-[800px] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-[800px]'>
        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle>Edit Team</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription>
            Make changes to your team. Click save when you're done.
          </SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>
        <Form {...form}>
          <form
            onSubmit={form.handleSubmit((data) =>
              updateTeamMutation.mutate(data)
            )}
            className='space-y-6 py-6'
          >
            <div className='space-y-6'>
              <h3 className='text-lg font-medium'>Basic Details</h3>
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='name'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Name</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input placeholder='Enter team name' {...field} />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='description'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Textarea
                        placeholder='Enter team description'
                        className='resize-none'
                        {...field}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='type'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Team Type</FormLabel>
                    <Select
                      onValueChange={field.onChange}
                      defaultValue={field.value}
                    >
                      <FormControl>
                        <SelectTrigger>
                          <SelectValue placeholder='Select team type' />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                      </FormControl>
                      <SelectContent>
                        {teamTypes.map((type) => (
                          <SelectItem key={type.value} value={type.value}>
                            {type.label}
                          </SelectItem>
                        ))}
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='maxMembers'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Maximum Members</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input
                        type='number'
                        {...field}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          field.onChange(parseInt(e.target.value))
                        }
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='visibility'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Visibility</FormLabel>
                    <Select
                      onValueChange={field.onChange}
                      defaultValue={field.value}
                    >
                      <FormControl>
                        <SelectTrigger>
                          <SelectValue placeholder='Select visibility' />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                      </FormControl>
                      <SelectContent>
                        {Object.values(Visibility).map((value) => (
                          <SelectItem key={value} value={value}>
                            {toTitleCase(value)}
                          </SelectItem>
                        ))}
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            </div>

            <div className='space-y-6'>
              <h3 className='text-lg font-medium'>Configuration</h3>
              <div className='flex flex-col gap-4'>
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name='configuration.isActive'
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-start space-x-3 space-y-0'>
                      <FormControl>
                        <Checkbox
                          checked={field.value}
                          onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                        />
                      </FormControl>
                      <div className='space-y-1 leading-none'>
                        <FormLabel>Active</FormLabel>
                        <FormDescription>
                          Team is active and can be used
                        </FormDescription>
                      </div>
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />

                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name='configuration.autoJoin.enabled'
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-start space-x-3 space-y-0'>
                      <FormControl>
                        <Checkbox
                          checked={field.value}
                          onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                        />
                      </FormControl>
                      <div className='space-y-1 leading-none'>
                        <FormLabel>Auto Join</FormLabel>
                        <FormDescription>
                          Allow members to join automatically
                        </FormDescription>
                      </div>
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className='space-y-6'>
              <h3 className='text-lg font-medium'>Security Settings</h3>
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='configuration.security.mfaRequired'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-start space-x-3 space-y-0'>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Checkbox
                        checked={field.value}
                        onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <div className='space-y-1 leading-none'>
                      <FormLabel>Require MFA</FormLabel>
                      <FormDescription>
                        Require multi-factor authentication
                      </FormDescription>
                    </div>
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='configuration.security.dataClassification'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Data Classification</FormLabel>
                    <Select
                      onValueChange={field.onChange}
                      defaultValue={field.value}
                    >
                      <FormControl>
                        <SelectTrigger>
                          <SelectValue placeholder='Select data classification' />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                      </FormControl>
                      <SelectContent>
                        <SelectItem value='PUBLIC'>Public</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value='INTERNAL'>Internal</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value='CONFIDENTIAL'>
                          Confidential
                        </SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value='RESTRICTED'>Restricted</SelectItem>
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='configuration.security.sessionTimeout'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Session Timeout (seconds)</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input
                        type='number'
                        {...field}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          field.onChange(parseInt(e.target.value))
                        }
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            </div>

            <div className='space-y-6'>
              <h3 className='text-lg font-medium'>Notifications</h3>
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='notifications.beforeDeadline'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Notification Deadlines (hours)</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <MultiSelect
                        value={field.value}
                        defaultValue={
                          team.notificationsPreferences?.beforeDeadline || []
                        }
                        options={[
                          { value: '1', label: '1 hour' },
                          { value: '2', label: '2 hours' },
                          { value: '6', label: '6 hours' },
                          {
                            value: '12',
                            label: '12 hours'
                          },
                          {
                            value: '24',
                            label: '24 hours'
                          },
                          { value: '48', label: '48 hours' }
                        ]}
                        onValueChange={field.onChange}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <div className='flex flex-col gap-4'>
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name='notifications.onStart'
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-start space-x-3 space-y-0'>
                      <FormControl>
                        <Checkbox
                          checked={field.value}
                          onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                        />
                      </FormControl>
                      <div className='space-y-1 leading-none'>
                        <FormLabel>Notify on Start</FormLabel>
                        <FormDescription>
                          Receive notifications when tasks start
                        </FormDescription>
                      </div>
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />

                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name='notifications.onComplete'
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-start space-x-3 space-y-0'>
                      <FormControl>
                        <Checkbox
                          checked={field.value}
                          onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                        />
                      </FormControl>
                      <div className='space-y-1 leading-none'>
                        <FormLabel>Notify on Complete</FormLabel>
                        <FormDescription>
                          Receive notifications when tasks complete
                        </FormDescription>
                      </div>
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className='space-y-6'>
              <h3 className='text-lg font-medium'>Workflow Configuration</h3>
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='workflows.0.type'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Workflow Type</FormLabel>
                    <Select
                      onValueChange={field.onChange}
                      defaultValue={field.value}
                    >
                      <FormControl>
                        <SelectTrigger>
                          <SelectValue placeholder='Select workflow type' />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                      </FormControl>
                      <SelectContent>
                        {workflowTypes.map((type) => (
                          <SelectItem key={type.value} value={type.value}>
                            {type.label}
                          </SelectItem>
                        ))}
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                    <FormDescription>
                      Choose how team members will collaborate
                    </FormDescription>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='workflows.0.settings.timeoutBehavior'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Timeout Behavior</FormLabel>
                    <Select
                      onValueChange={field.onChange}
                      defaultValue={field.value}
                    >
                      <FormControl>
                        <SelectTrigger>
                          <SelectValue placeholder='Select timeout behavior' />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                      </FormControl>
                      <SelectContent>
                        {timeoutBehaviors.map((behavior) => (
                          <SelectItem
                            key={behavior.value}
                            value={behavior.value}
                          >
                            {behavior.label}
                          </SelectItem>
                        ))}
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                    <FormDescription>
                      What happens when a task times out
                    </FormDescription>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              {form.watch('workflows.0.settings.timeoutBehavior') ===
                'ESCALATE' && (
                <>
                  <FormField
                    control={form.control}
                    name='workflows.0.settings.escalation.enabled'
                    render={({ field }) => (
                      <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-start space-x-3 space-y-0'>
                        <FormControl>
                          <Checkbox
                            checked={field.value}
                            onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                          />
                        </FormControl>
                        <div className='space-y-1 leading-none'>
                          <FormLabel>Enable Escalation</FormLabel>
                          <FormDescription>
                            Enable escalation to administrators after timeout
                          </FormDescription>
                        </div>
                      </FormItem>
                    )}
                  />

                  {form.watch('workflows.0.settings.escalation.enabled') && (
                    <>
                      <FormField
                        control={form.control}
                        name='workflows.0.settings.escalation.after'
                        render={({ field }) => (
                          <FormItem>
                            <FormLabel>Escalate After (hours)</FormLabel>
                            <FormControl>
                              <Input
                                type='number'
                                {...field}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                  field.onChange(parseInt(e.target.value))
                                }
                              />
                            </FormControl>
                            <FormDescription>
                              Number of hours before escalating
                            </FormDescription>
                            <FormMessage />
                          </FormItem>
                        )}
                      />

                      <FormField
                        control={form.control}
                        name='workflows.0.settings.escalation.to'
                        render={({ field }) => (
                          <FormItem>
                            <FormLabel>Escalate To</FormLabel>
                            <FormControl>
                              <MultiSelect
                                value={field.value}
                                defaultValue={
                                  team.members
                                    ?.filter(
                                      (member) => member.role === 'ADMIN'
                                    )
                                    ?.map((member) => member.userId) || []
                                }
                                options={
                                  allUsers?.database?.map((user) => ({
                                    value: user.id,
                                    label: user.name || user.id
                                  })) || []
                                }
                                onValueChange={field.onChange}
                              />
                            </FormControl>
                            <FormDescription>
                              Select administrators to escalate to
                            </FormDescription>
                            <FormMessage />
                          </FormItem>
                        )}
                      />
                    </>
                  )}
                </>
              )}

              {/* Workflow Type Specific Settings */}
              {form.watch('workflows.0.type') === 'PARALLEL' && (
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name='workflows.0.settings.parallelExecution'
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-start space-x-3 space-y-0'>
                      <FormControl>
                        <Checkbox
                          checked={field.value}
                          onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                        />
                      </FormControl>
                      <div className='space-y-1 leading-none'>
                        <FormLabel>Allow Parallel Execution</FormLabel>
                        <FormDescription>
                          Tasks can be completed in any order
                        </FormDescription>
                      </div>
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />
              )}

              {(form.watch('workflows.0.type') === 'QUORUM' ||
                form.watch('workflows.0.type') === 'PARALLEL') && (
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name='workflows.0.settings.quorumThreshold'
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem>
                      <FormLabel>
                        {form.watch('workflows.0.type') === 'QUORUM'
                          ? 'Quorum Threshold'
                          : 'Completion Threshold'}
                      </FormLabel>
                      <FormControl>
                        <Input
                          type='number'
                          {...field}
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            field.onChange(parseInt(e.target.value))
                          }
                        />
                      </FormControl>
                      <FormDescription>
                        {form.watch('workflows.0.type') === 'QUORUM'
                          ? 'Minimum number of approvals required'
                          : 'Minimum number of tasks that must be completed'}
                      </FormDescription>
                      <FormMessage />
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />
              )}

              {form.watch('workflows.0.type') === 'HYBRID' && (
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name='workflows.0.stages'
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem>
                      <FormLabel>Hybrid Workflow Stages</FormLabel>
                      <FormControl>
                        <div className='space-y-4'>
                          <DndContext
                            sensors={sensors}
                            collisionDetection={closestCenter}
                            onDragEnd={(event) => {
                              const { active, over } = event;
                              if (active.id !== over?.id) {
                                const oldIndex = field.value.findIndex(
                                  (stage) => stage.id === active.id
                                );
                                const newIndex = field.value.findIndex(
                                  (stage) => stage.id === over?.id
                                );
                                field.onChange(
                                  arrayMove(field.value, oldIndex, newIndex)
                                );
                              }
                            }}
                          >
                            <SortableContext
                              items={
                                field.value?.map((stage) => stage.id) || []
                              }
                              strategy={verticalListSortingStrategy}
                            >
                              {field.value?.map((stage, index) => (
                                <div
                                  key={stage.id}
                                  className='space-y-4 rounded-lg border bg-background p-4'
                                >
                                  <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
                                    <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                                      <span className='font-medium'>
                                        Stage {index + 1}
                                      </span>
                                    </div>
                                    <Button
                                      type='button'
                                      variant='ghost'
                                      size='sm'
                                      className='text-destructive'
                                      onClick={() => {
                                        const newStages = [...field.value];
                                        newStages.splice(index, 1);
                                        field.onChange(newStages);
                                      }}
                                    >
                                      Remove Stage
                                    </Button>
                                  </div>
                                  <div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'>
                                    <FormItem>
                                      <FormLabel>Stage Name</FormLabel>
                                      <Input
                                        value={stage.name}
                                        onChange={(e) => {
                                          const newStages = [...field.value];
                                          newStages[index] = {
                                            ...stage,
                                            name: e.target.value
                                          };
                                          field.onChange(newStages);
                                        }}
                                      />
                                    </FormItem>
                                    <FormItem>
                                      <FormLabel>Stage Type</FormLabel>
                                      <Select
                                        value={stage.type}
                                        onValueChange={(value) => {
                                          const newStages = [...field.value];
                                          newStages[index] = {
                                            ...stage,
                                            type: value as
                                              | 'SEQUENTIAL'
                                              | 'PARALLEL'
                                              | 'QUORUM',
                                            settings:
                                              value === 'QUORUM'
                                                ? {
                                                    quorumThreshold: 1
                                                  }
                                                : {}
                                          };
                                          field.onChange(newStages);
                                        }}
                                      >
                                        <SelectTrigger>
                                          <SelectValue placeholder='Select stage type' />
                                        </SelectTrigger>
                                        <SelectContent>
                                          <SelectItem value='SEQUENTIAL'>
                                            Sequential
                                          </SelectItem>
                                          <SelectItem value='PARALLEL'>
                                            Parallel
                                          </SelectItem>
                                          <SelectItem value='QUORUM'>
                                            Quorum
                                          </SelectItem>
                                        </SelectContent>
                                      </Select>
                                    </FormItem>
                                  </div>

                                  {stage.type === 'QUORUM' && (
                                    <FormItem>
                                      <FormLabel>Quorum Threshold</FormLabel>
                                      <Input
                                        type='number'
                                        value={
                                          stage.settings?.quorumThreshold || ''
                                        }
                                        onChange={(e) => {
                                          const newStages = [...field.value];
                                          newStages[index] = {
                                            ...stage,
                                            settings: {
                                              ...stage.settings,
                                              quorumThreshold:
                                                parseInt(e.target.value) || 1
                                            }
                                          };
                                          field.onChange(newStages);
                                        }}
                                        min={1}
                                      />
                                      <FormDescription>
                                        Minimum number of approvals required for
                                        this stage
                                      </FormDescription>
                                    </FormItem>
                                  )}

                                  <FormField
                                    control={form.control}
                                    name={`workflows.0.stages.${index}.tasks`}
                                    render={({ field: tasksField }) => (
                                      <FormItem>
                                        <FormLabel>Stage Tasks</FormLabel>
                                        <FormControl>
                                          <div className='space-y-4'>
                                            {tasksField.value?.map(
                                              (task, taskIndex: number) => (
                                                <SortableTask
                                                  key={task.id}
                                                  task={task}
                                                  index={taskIndex}
                                                  field={tasksField}
                                                  memberOptions={
                                                    team.members?.map(
                                                      (member) => ({
                                                        value: member.userId,
                                                        label:
                                                          member.user?.name ||
                                                          member.userId
                                                      })
                                                    ) || []
                                                  }
                                                />
                                              )
                                            )}
                                            <Button
                                              type='button'
                                              variant='outline'
                                              onClick={() => {
                                                const newTasks = [
                                                  ...(tasksField.value || [])
                                                ];
                                                newTasks.push(
                                                  createNewTask(
                                                    newTasks.length + 1
                                                  )
                                                );
                                                tasksField.onChange(newTasks);
                                              }}
                                            >
                                              Add Task
                                            </Button>
                                          </div>
                                        </FormControl>
                                      </FormItem>
                                    )}
                                  />
                                </div>
                              ))}
                            </SortableContext>
                          </DndContext>
                          <Button
                            type='button'
                            variant='outline'
                            onClick={() => {
                              const newStages = [...(field.value || [])];
                              const { shortId: id, uuid } =
                                ShortIdMapper.generatePair();
                              newStages.push({
                                id,
                                uuid,
                                name: '',
                                order: newStages.length + 1,
                                type: 'SEQUENTIAL',
                                tasks: [],
                                settings: {}
                              });
                              field.onChange(newStages);
                            }}
                          >
                            Add Stage
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </FormControl>
                      <FormDescription>
                        Define stages that combine sequential and parallel
                        workflows
                      </FormDescription>
                      <FormMessage />
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />
              )}

              {form.watch('workflows.0.type') === 'SEQUENTIAL' && (
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name='workflows.0.tasks'
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem>
                      <FormLabel>Sequential Tasks</FormLabel>
                      <FormControl>
                        <div className='space-y-4'>
                          <DndContext
                            sensors={sensors}
                            collisionDetection={closestCenter}
                            onDragEnd={(event) => {
                              const { active, over } = event;
                              if (active.id !== over?.id) {
                                const oldIndex = field.value.findIndex(
                                  (task) => task.id === active.id
                                );
                                const newIndex = field.value.findIndex(
                                  (task) => task.id === over?.id
                                );
                                field.onChange(
                                  arrayMove(field.value, oldIndex, newIndex)
                                );
                              }
                            }}
                          >
                            <SortableContext
                              items={field.value?.map((task) => task.id) || []}
                              strategy={verticalListSortingStrategy}
                            >
                              {field.value?.map((task, index) => (
                                <SortableTask
                                  key={task.id}
                                  task={task}
                                  index={index}
                                  field={field}
                                  memberOptions={
                                    team.members?.map((member) => ({
                                      value: member.userId,
                                      label: member.user?.name || member.userId
                                    })) || []
                                  }
                                />
                              ))}
                            </SortableContext>
                          </DndContext>
                          <Button
                            type='button'
                            variant='outline'
                            onClick={() => {
                              field.onChange([
                                ...(field.value || []),
                                createNewTask(field.value?.length + 1 || 0)
                              ]);
                            }}
                          >
                            Add Task
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </FormControl>
                      <FormDescription>
                        Define the sequence of tasks and assign them to team
                        members
                      </FormDescription>
                      <FormMessage />
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />
              )}

              {form.watch('workflows.0.type') === 'PARALLEL' && (
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name='workflows.0.tasks'
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem>
                      <FormLabel>Parallel Tasks</FormLabel>
                      <FormControl>
                        <div className='space-y-4'>
                          <DndContext
                            sensors={sensors}
                            collisionDetection={closestCenter}
                            onDragEnd={(event) => {
                              const { active, over } = event;
                              if (active.id !== over?.id) {
                                const oldIndex = field.value.findIndex(
                                  (task) => task.id === active.id
                                );
                                const newIndex = field.value.findIndex(
                                  (task) => task.id === over?.id
                                );
                                field.onChange(
                                  arrayMove(field.value, oldIndex, newIndex)
                                );
                              }
                            }}
                          >
                            <SortableContext
                              items={field.value?.map((task) => task.id) || []}
                              strategy={verticalListSortingStrategy}
                            >
                              {field.value?.map((task, index) => (
                                <SortableTask
                                  key={task.id}
                                  task={task}
                                  index={index}
                                  field={field}
                                  memberOptions={
                                    team.members?.map((member) => ({
                                      value: member.userId,
                                      label: member.user?.name || member.userId
                                    })) || []
                                  }
                                />
                              ))}
                            </SortableContext>
                          </DndContext>
                          <Button
                            type='button'
                            variant='outline'
                            onClick={() => {
                              field.onChange([
                                ...(field.value || []),
                                createNewTask(field.value?.length + 1 || 0)
                              ]);
                            }}
                          >
                            Add Task
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </FormControl>
                      <FormDescription>
                        Define parallel tasks that can be executed
                        simultaneously
                      </FormDescription>
                      <FormMessage />
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />
              )}
            </div>

            <Button
              type='submit'
              disabled={loading || updateTeamMutation.isPending}
              onClick={() => {
                updateTeamMutation.mutate(form.getValues());
              }}
              className='w-full'
            >
              {loading || updateTeamMutation.isPending ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className='mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin' />
                  Updating Team...
                </>
              ) : (
                'Update Team'
              )}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </Form>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

          sessionTimeout:
            (team.configuration as TeamConfiguration)?.security

        {

                              <FormControl>
                                <Input
                                  type='number'
                                  {...field}
                                  onChange={(e) =>
                                    field.onChange(parseInt(e.target.value))
                                  }
                                />
                              </FormControl>
                              <FormMessage />
                            </FormItem>
                          )}
                        />

                        <FormField
                          control={form.control}
                          name={`workflows.${index}.settings.escalation.to`}
                          render={({ field }) => (
                            <FormItem>
                              <FormLabel>Escalate To</FormLabel>
                              <FormControl>
                                <MultiSelect
                                  options={team.members
                                    .filter(
                                      (member) =>
                                        member.role === TeamMemberRole.ADMIN
                                    )
                                    .map((member) => ({
                                      label: member.user?.name || '',
                                      value: member.user?.id || ''
                                    }))}
                                  onValueChange={field.onChange}
                                  defaultValue={field.value}
                                  placeholder='Select administrators'
                                  modalPopover={true}
                                  minItems={0}
                                />
                              </FormControl>
                              <FormDescription>
                                Select administrators to escalate to
                              </FormDescription>
                              <FormMessage />
                            </FormItem>
                          )}
                        />
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className='flex justify-end gap-4'>
                <Button
                  variant='outline'
                  type='button'
                  onClick={() => {
                    const sheet = document.querySelector('[data-state="open"]');
                    if (sheet) {
                      const closeButton = sheet.querySelector(
                        'button[aria-label="Close"]'
                      );
                      if (closeButton) {
                        (closeButton as HTMLButtonElement).click();
                      }
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  Cancel
                </Button>
                <Button type='submit' disabled={loading}>
                  {loading ? (
                    <>
                      <Loader2 className='mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin' />
                      Updating...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    'Update Team'
                  )}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </Form>
        </div>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

type TeamsContentProps = {
  teams: CustomTeamWithMembers[];
  organizationId: string;
  cookieString: string;
  user: IdTokenClaims;
  allUsers: GetOrganizationUsersResponse['users'];
};

type ManageTeamMembersSheetProps = {
  team: CustomTeamWithMembers;
  organizationId: string;
  cookieString: string;
  user: IdTokenClaims;
  allUsers: GetOrganizationUsersResponse['users'];
  onTeamUpdated: (updatedTeam: CustomTeamWithMembers) => void;
};

export function TeamsContent({
  teams,
  organizationId,
  cookieString,
  user,
  allUsers
}: Readonly<TeamsContentProps>) {
  const [allTeams, setAllTeams] = useState(teams);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [deletingTeam, setDeletingTeam] =
    useState<CustomTeamWithMembers | null>(null);

  const filteredTeams = teams.filter((team) =>
    team.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  const handleTeamUpdated = (updatedTeam: CustomTeamWithMembers) => {
    setAllTeams((prevTeams) =>
      prevTeams.map((team) => (team.id === updatedTeam.id ? updatedTeam : team))
    );
  };

  const handleDeleteTeam = async () => {
    if (!deletingTeam) return;

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${deletingTeam.id}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          }
        }
      );

      if (response.ok) {
        setAllTeams(allTeams.filter((team) => team.id !== deletingTeam.id));
        toast.success('Team deleted successfully');
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to delete team');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error('[TeamsContent] Error deleting team', {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
        teamId: deletingTeam.id,
        organizationId
      });
      toast.error('Failed to delete team');
    }
    setDeletingTeam(null);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className='mb-8 flex items-center justify-between'>
        <h1 className='font-signvault text-3xl font-bold'>Teams</h1>
        <Link href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/create`}>
          <Button className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'>
            <Plus className='h-4 w-4' />
            Create Team
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </div>

      <div className='mb-6'>
        <SearchInput
          label='Search teams...'
          showLabel={false}
          placeholder='Search teams...'
          value={searchTerm}
          onChange={(value) => setSearchTerm(value)}
        />
      </div>

      <div className='overflow-x-auto'>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Team Name</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Members</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Created On</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Actions</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {filteredTeams.length === 0 && (
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell colSpan={4} className='text-center'>
                  No teams found
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            )}
            {filteredTeams.map((team) => (
              <TableRow key={team.id}>
                <TableCell className='font-medium'>
                  <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                    {team.icon ? (
                      <img
                        src={team.icon}
                        alt={team.name}
                        className='h-4 w-4 rounded'
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <Users className='h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground' />
                    )}
                    {team.name}
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                    <span>{team.members?.length || 0} members</span>
                    <ManageTeamMembersSheet
                      team={team}
                      organizationId={organizationId}
                      cookieString={cookieString}
                      user={user}
                      allUsers={allUsers}
                      onTeamUpdated={handleTeamUpdated}
                    />
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {formatDate(new Date(team.createdAt), 'PPP')}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <DropdownMenu>
                    <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                      <Button variant='ghost' className='h-8 w-8 p-0'>
                        <MoreHorizontal className='h-4 w-4' />
                      </Button>
                    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                    <DropdownMenuContent align='end'>
                      <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
                        <Link
                          href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${team.id}`}
                          className='flex items-center'
                        >
                          <Eye className='mr-2 h-4 w-4' />
                          View Team Details
                        </Link>
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <EditTeamSheet
                        team={team}
                        organizationId={organizationId}
                        cookieString={cookieString}
                        user={user}
                        onTeamUpdated={handleTeamUpdated}
                      />
                      <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
                        <Link
                          href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${team.id}/calendar`}
                          className='flex items-center'
                        >
                          <Calendar className='mr-2 h-4 w-4' />
                          View Team Calendar
                        </Link>
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
                        <Link
                          href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${team.id}/documents`}
                          className='flex items-center'
                        >
                          <File className='mr-2 h-4 w-4' />
                          View Team Documents
                        </Link>
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem
                        className='flex items-center text-destructive'
                        onClick={() => setDeletingTeam(team)}
                      >
                        <Trash className='mr-2 h-4 w-4' />
                        Delete Team
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                    </DropdownMenuContent>
                  </DropdownMenu>
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>

      <AlertDialog
        open={!!deletingTeam}
        onOpenChange={() => setDeletingTeam(null)}
      >
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>Delete Team</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              Are you sure you want to delete this team? This action cannot be
              undone.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction
              onClick={handleDeleteTeam}
              className='bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90'
            >
              Delete
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </>
  );
}

export function ManageTeamMembersSheet({
  team,
  organizationId,
  cookieString,
  user,
  allUsers,
  onTeamUpdated
}: Readonly<ManageTeamMembersSheetProps>) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [selectedUsers, setSelectedUsers] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const availableUsers = allUsers.database
    .filter((user) => !team.members.some((member) => member.userId === user.id))
    .map((user) => ({
      label: user?.name || '',
      value: user?.id || ''
    }));

  const allUsersAlreadyInTeam = availableUsers.length === 0;

  const handleValueChange = (values: string[]) => {
    setSelectedUsers(values);
  };

  const getRoleBadgeVariant = (role: TeamMemberRole) => {
    switch (role) {
      case TeamMemberRole.OWNER:
        return 'default';
      case TeamMemberRole.ADMIN:
        return 'destructive';
      case TeamMemberRole.MEMBER:
        return 'secondary';
      case TeamMemberRole.GUEST:
        return 'outline';
      default:
        return 'secondary';
    }
  };

  const handleAddMembers = async () => {
    if (!selectedUsers.length) return;
    let addedMembers: string[] = [];
    let failedMembers: string[] = [];
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      for (const userId of selectedUsers) {
        const response = await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${team.id}/members?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'cookie': cookieString,
              'cookie-string': cookieString
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              userId: userId,
              teamId: team.id,
              status: TeamMemberStatus.ACTIVE,
              invitedBy: user.sub,
              organizationId,
              role: TeamMemberRole.MEMBER,
              attributes: {},
              metadata: {}
            })
          }
        );

        if (!response.ok) {
          failedMembers.push(userId);
          continue;
        }

        addedMembers.push(userId);
      }
      if (failedMembers.length > 0) {
        toast.error(
          `Failed to add ${failedMembers.length} members: ${allUsers.database
            .filter((user) => failedMembers.includes(user.id))
            .map((user) => user.name)
            .join(', ')}`
        );
      }
      if (addedMembers.length === selectedUsers.length) {
        toast.success(
          selectedUsers.length > 1
            ? `All ${selectedUsers.length} members added successfully`
            : `1 member added successfully`
        );
      }
      setSelectedUsers([]);
      const updatedTeamData = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${team.id}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          }
        }
      ).then((res) => res.json());
      onTeamUpdated(updatedTeamData.team);
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error('[ManageTeamMembersSheet] Error adding members', {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
        teamId: team.id,
        organizationId,
        selectedUsers
      });
      toast.error('Failed to add members');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveMember = async (memberId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/members/${memberId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          }
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Failed to remove team member');
      }

      // Fetch updated team data
      const teamResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${team.id}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          }
        }
      );

      if (!teamResponse.ok) {
        clientLogger.error(
          '[ManageTeamMembersSheet] Error removing team member',
          {
            error: 'Failed to fetch updated team data',
            teamId: team.id,
            organizationId,
            memberId: memberId
          }
        );
      }

      const teamData: GetCustomTeamResponse = await teamResponse.json();
      onTeamUpdated(teamData.team as CustomTeamWithMembers);
      toast.success('Team member removed successfully');
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error(
        '[ManageTeamMembersSheet] Error removing team member',
        {
          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
          teamId: team.id,
          organizationId,
          memberId: memberId
        }
      );
      toast.error('Failed to remove team member');
    }
  };

  return (
    <Sheet>
      <SheetTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant='ghost' size='icon' className='h-8 w-8'>
          <UserPlus className='h-4 w-4' />
        </Button>
      </SheetTrigger>
      <SheetContent>
        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle>Team Members</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription>
            View and manage team members for {team.name}
          </SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>
        <div className='mt-6'>
          <div className='space-y-4'>
            <div className='flex flex-col gap-4'>
              <div>
                <h3 className='mb-2 text-sm font-medium'>Add Members</h3>
                <div className='flex gap-2'>
                  <div className='flex-1'>
                    {allUsersAlreadyInTeam ? (
                      <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                        All organization members are already in the team.
                      </p>
                    ) : (
                      <MultiSelect
                        options={availableUsers}
                        onValueChange={handleValueChange}
                        defaultValue={[]}
                        placeholder='Select users to add...'
                        modalPopover={true}
                        minItems={0}
                      />
                    )}
                  </div>
                  {!allUsersAlreadyInTeam && (
                    <Button
                      onClick={handleAddMembers}
                      disabled={loading || !selectedUsers.length}
                    >
                      {loading ? (
                        <Loader2 className='h-4 w-4 animate-spin' />
                      ) : (
                        'Add'
                      )}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p className='mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                  {team.members.length} of {team.maxMembers} members
                </p>
              </div>

              <div>
                <h3 className='mb-2 text-sm font-medium'>Current Members</h3>
                <div className='space-y-2'>
                  {team.members.map((member) => (
                    <div
                      key={member.id}
                      className='flex items-center justify-between rounded-md border p-2'
                    >
                      <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                        <Avatar className='h-6 w-6'>
                          <AvatarImage
                            src={member.user?.avatar}
                            alt={member.user?.name}
                          />
                          <AvatarFallback>
                            {member.user?.name?.charAt(0)}
                          </AvatarFallback>
                        </Avatar>
                        <span className='text-sm font-medium'>
                          {member.user.name}
                        </span>
                        <Badge
                          variant={getRoleBadgeVariant(member.role)}
                          className='capitalize'
                        >
                          {toTitleCase(member.role)}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      {member.userId !== user.sub &&
                        member.role !== TeamMemberRole.OWNER && (
                          <AlertDialog>
                            <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
                              <Button
                                variant='ghost'
                                size='icon'
                                className='h-8 w-8'
                              >
                                <Trash className='h-4 w-4' />
                              </Button>
                            </AlertDialogTrigger>
                            <AlertDialogContent>
                              <AlertDialogTitle>
                                Remove Team Member
                              </AlertDialogTitle>
                              <AlertDialogDescription>
                                Are you sure you want to remove{' '}
                                {member.user?.name} from the team?
                              </AlertDialogDescription>
                              <AlertDialogFooter>
                                <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
                                <AlertDialogAction
                                  className='bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90'
                                  onClick={() => handleRemoveMember(member.id)}
                                >
                                  Remove {member.user?.name}
                                </AlertDialogAction>
                              </AlertDialogFooter>
                            </AlertDialogContent>
                          </AlertDialog>
                        )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

          <h2>The Legal Framework for Digital Signatures</h2>
          <p>Digital signatures are legally recognized and enforceable in many countries around the world. Understanding the legal framework surrounding digital signatures is essential for businesses and individuals who rely on this technology for their transactions.</p>
          
          <h3>Key Legislation</h3>
          <p>Several key pieces of legislation govern the use of digital signatures:</p>
          <ul>
            <li>ESIGN Act (USA): The Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act provides legal recognition for electronic signatures and records in the United States.</li>
            <li>UETA (USA): The Uniform Electronic Transactions Act establishes the legal validity of electronic signatures and records at the state level in the United States.</li>
            <li>eIDAS Regulation (EU): The Electronic Identification, Authentication, and Trust Services Regulation provides a standardized framework for electronic signatures across the European Union.</li>
            <li>PIPEDA (Canada): The Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act recognizes the legal validity of electronic signatures in Canada.</li>
          </ul>
          
          <h3>Requirements for Legal Validity</h3>
          <p>To be legally valid, digital signatures must meet certain requirements:</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Intent: The signer must have the intent to sign the document electronically.</li>
            <li>Consent: The parties involved must consent to conduct the transaction electronically.</li>
            <li>Authentication: The identity of the signer must be verified.</li>
            <li>Integrity: The signed document must be tamper-evident and protected from alteration.</li>
          </ul>
          
          <h3>Enforcement and Dispute Resolution</h3>
          <p>Digital signatures are enforceable in court, provided they meet the legal requirements. In the event of a dispute, the following factors may be considered:</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Audit Trail: A detailed record of the signing process, including timestamps and IP addresses.</li>
            <li>Certificate of Completion: A document that verifies the authenticity of the digital signature.</li>
            <li>Compliance: Adherence to relevant laws and regulations governing electronic signatures.</li>
          </ul>
          
          <h3>Global Recognition</h3>
          <p>Digital signatures are recognized in many countries around the world, including:</p>
          <ul>
            <li>United States: Governed by the ESIGN Act and UETA.</li>
            <li>European Union: Governed by the eIDAS Regulation.</li>
            <li>Canada: Governed by PIPEDA.</li>
            <li>Australia: Governed by the Electronic Transactions Act.</li>
            <li>India: Governed by the Information Technology Act.</li>
          </ul>
          
          <h3>Conclusion</h3>
          <p>Understanding the legal framework surrounding digital signatures is crucial for ensuring their validity and enforceability. By complying with relevant laws and regulations, businesses and individuals can confidently use digital signatures for their transactions, knowing that they are legally recognized and protected.</p>

/**
 * Upload multiple documents to S3.
 * @param files Array of File objects to upload.
 * @returns Array of upload results including storage location, hash, and file metadata.
 */
export async function uploadDocumentsToS3(
  files: File[],
  organizationId: string
): Promise<
  Array<{
    filename: string;
    mimeType: string;
    fileSize: bigint;
    key: string;
    storageLocation: string;
    lastModifiedAt: Date;
    hash: string;
  }>
> {
  const results: Array<{
    filename: string;
    mimeType: string;
    fileSize: bigint;
    key: string;
    storageLocation: string;
    lastModifiedAt: Date;
    hash: string;
  }> = [];

  for (const file of files) {
    const presignRes = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/s3/upload`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          filename: file.name,
          contentType: file.type,
          organizationId
        })
      }
    );

    if (!presignRes.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to get S3 presigned URL for ${file.name}`);
    }

    const { url, fields, key } = await presignRes.json();

    // 2. Upload file to S3 using FormData
    const formData = new FormData();
    Object.entries(fields).forEach(([k, v]) => formData.append(k, v as string));
    formData.append('file', file);

    const uploadRes = await fetch(url, {
      method: 'POST',
      body: formData
    });

    if (!uploadRes.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to upload file ${file.name} to S3`);
    }

    // 3. Calculate hash of file
    const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const buffer = Buffer.from(arrayBuffer);
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(buffer).digest('hex');

    // 4. Compose result
    results.push({
      key,
      hash,
      filename: file.name,
      mimeType: file.type,
      fileSize: BigInt(file.size),
      storageLocation: `${url}/${key}`,
      lastModifiedAt: new Date(file.lastModified)
    });
  }

  revalidatePath('/account/documents/my-documents');

  return results;
}

/**
 * Create document records in the database.
 * @param docs Array of document metadata to insert.
 * @returns Array of created DocumentCS records.
 */
export async function createDocumentRecords(
  docs: Array<{
    filename: string;
    title: string;
    mimeType: string;
    fileSize: bigint;
    hash: string;
    storageLocation: string;
    lastModifiedAt: Date;
    organizationId: bigint;
    ownerId: bigint;
    isPublic?: boolean;
    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
    status?: DocumentStatus;
    description?: string;
    s3Key?: string;
  }>
): Promise<DocumentCS[]> {
  const createdDocuments: DocumentCS[] = [];
  const idGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();

  for (const doc of docs) {
    const documentId = await idGenerator.generateDocumentId();
    const [created] = await db
      .insert(documentsCS)
      .values({
        id: documentId,
        organizationId: doc.organizationId,
        ownerId: doc.ownerId,
        filename: doc.filename,
        title: doc.title,
        mimeType: doc.mimeType as MimeTypePSType,
        fileSize: doc.fileSize,
        hash: doc.hash,
        s3Key: doc.s3Key,
        storageLocation: doc.storageLocation,
        isPublic: doc.isPublic ?? false,
        metadata: doc.metadata ?? {},
        status: (doc.status as DocumentStatus) ?? 'ACTIVE',
        lastModifiedAt: doc.lastModifiedAt,
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
        description: doc.description ?? ''
      } as DocumentCS)
      .returning();
    createdDocuments.push(created);
    // Provenance: enqueue document upload event
    await execute(print(EnqueueDocumentUpload as unknown as ASTNode), {
      userId: String(created.ownerId),
      input: {
        correlationId: undefined,
        documentId: created.id.toString(),
        filename: created.filename,
        description: created.description,
        fileSize: Number(created.fileSize),
        hash: created.hash,
        lastModifiedAt: created.lastModifiedAt.toISOString(),
        metadata: created.metadata,
        mimeType: created.mimeType,
        organizationId: created.organizationId.toString(),
        ownerId: created.ownerId.toString(),
        s3Key: created.s3Key || '',
        storageLocation: created.storageLocation || '',
        tags: created.tags || [],
        title: created.title,
        triggeredBy: created.ownerId.toString()
      }
    } as MutationRootEnqueueDocumentUploadArgs).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log create document event');
    });

    // Audit log: document upload
    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.DOCUMENT_CREATED,
      category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
      metadata: {
        documentId: created.id.toString(),
        filename: created.filename,
        title: created.title,
        mimeType: created.mimeType,
        fileSize: Number(created.fileSize),
        hash: created.hash
      },
      entityId: created.id.toString(),
      entityType: 'DOCUMENT',
      description: `Document ${created.title} created by ${created.ownerId}`,
      entityName: created.title,
      documentId: created.id.toString(),
      targetUserId: String(created.ownerId),
      success: true
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log('[AUDIT] Failed to log document upload audit entry');
    });
  }
  revalidatePath('/account/documents');
  return createdDocuments;
}
