export async function getDocumentsForUser(
  userId: bigint,
  organizationId: bigint
): Promise<DocumentCS[]> {
  // get all docuemts where:
  // doc.ownerId == userId
  // doc.organizationId == user.organizationId (if user is an organization member), this one is a little dicey, in the future make this also check for the user's role, team and permissions in the organization.

  const conditions = [eq(documentsCS.ownerId, userId)];

  if (organizationId) {
    conditions.push(eq(documentsCS.organizationId, organizationId));
  }

  const documents = await db.query.documentsCS.findMany({
    where: and(...conditions)
  });

  return documents;
}

export async function softDeleteDocument(
  documentId: bigint,
  deletionReason: string = 'Document deleted by user'
): Promise<void> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  const document = await db.query.documentsCS.findFirst({
    where: eq(documentsCS.id, documentId)
  });
  if (!document) {
    throw new Error('Document not found');
  }
  await db
    .update(documentsCS)
    .set({
      status: 'INACTIVE' as DocumentStatus,
      updatedAt: new Date(),
      lastModifiedAt: new Date()
    } as Partial<DocumentCS>)
    .where(eq(documentsCS.id, documentId));
  // Provenance: enqueue document delete event
  await execute(print(EnqueueDocumentDelete as unknown as ASTNode), {
    userId: String(dbUser.id),
    input: {
      correlationId: undefined,
      documentId: documentId.toString(),
      documentTitle: document.title,
      metadata: document.metadata,
      organizationId: document.organizationId.toString(),
      userId: String(dbUser.id),
      deletionReason: deletionReason
    }
  } as MutationRootEnqueueDocumentDeleteArgs).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log delete document event');
  });

  // Audit log: document deletion
  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.DOCUMENT_DELETED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
    metadata: {
      documentId: documentId.toString(),
      documentTitle: document.title,
      previousStatus: document.status,
      newStatus: 'INACTIVE',
      deletionReason: deletionReason
    },
    entityId: documentId.toString(),
    entityType: 'DOCUMENT',
    description: `Document ${document.title} deleted by ${dbUser.name}`,
    entityName: document.title,
    documentId: documentId.toString(),
    targetUserId: String(dbUser.id),
    success: true
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[AUDIT] Failed to log document deletion audit entry');
  });
  revalidatePath('/account/documents/my-documents');
}

export async function getSecureDocumentDownloadUrl(
  s3Key: string,
  action: 'download' | 'preview'
): Promise<string> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  const document = await db.query.documentsCS.findFirst({
    where: eq(documentsCS.s3Key, s3Key)
  });
  if (!document) {
    throw new Error('Document not found');
  }
  const s3Client = new S3Client({
    region: String(process.env.S3_REGION),
    credentials: {
      accessKeyId: String(process.env.S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID),
      secretAccessKey: String(process.env.S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY)
    }
  });
  const bucketName = String(process.env.S3_BUCKET);
  const expiresIn = 3600;

  const command = new GetObjectCommand({
    Bucket: bucketName,
    Key: s3Key
  });

  // Provenance: enqueue document download event
  if (action === 'download') {
    await execute(print(EnqueueDocumentDownload as unknown as ASTNode), {
      userId: String(dbUser.id),
      input: {
        correlationId: undefined,
        documentId: document.id.toString(),
        documentTitle: document.title,
        metadata: document.metadata,
        organizationId: document.organizationId.toString(),
        s3Key,
        userId: String(dbUser.id)
      }
    } as MutationRootEnqueueDocumentDownloadArgs).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log download document event');
      throw error;
    });
  } else if (action === 'preview') {
    await execute(print(EnqueueDocumentPreview as unknown as ASTNode), {
      input: {
        documentId: document.id.toString(),
        documentTitle: document.title,
        organizationId: document.organizationId.toString(),
        s3Key,
        userId: String(dbUser.id)
      }
    } as MutationRootEnqueueDocumentPreviewArgs).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log preview document event');
      throw error;
    });
  }

  // Audit log: document download

  if (action === 'download') {
    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.DOCUMENT_DOWNLOADED,
      category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
      metadata: {
        documentId: document.id.toString(),
        documentTitle: document.title,
        s3Key,
        expiresIn
      },
      entityId: document.id.toString(),
      entityType: 'DOCUMENT',
      description: `Document ${document.title} downloaded by ${dbUser.name}`,
      entityName: document.title,
      documentId: document.id.toString(),
      targetUserId: String(dbUser.id),
      success: true
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log('[AUDIT] Failed to log document download audit entry');
    });
  } else if (action === 'preview') {
    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.DOCUMENT_PREVIEWED,
      category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
      metadata: {
        documentId: document.id.toString(),
        documentTitle: document.title,
        s3Key,
        expiresIn
      },
      entityId: document.id.toString(),
      entityType: 'DOCUMENT',
      description: `Document ${document.title} previewed by ${dbUser.name}`,
      entityName: document.title,
      documentId: document.id.toString(),
      targetUserId: String(dbUser.id),
      success: true
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log('[AUDIT] Failed to log document preview audit entry');
    });
  }

  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment
  // @ts-ignore - getSignedUrl is not typed correctly
  const presignedUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3Client, command, { expiresIn });
  return presignedUrl;
}

export async function getTemporaryDocumentUrl(s3Key: string): Promise<string> {

  const document = await db.query.documentsCS.findFirst({

  });

  const command = new GetObjectCommand({
    Bucket: bucketName,

      metadata: document.metadata ?? {},
      organizationId: document.organizationId.toString(),

  // @ts-ignore - getSignedUrl is not typed correctly
  const presignedUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3Client, command, { expiresIn });
  return presignedUrl;
}

/**
 * Generate a temporary document URL for a given document with a custom expiry
 */
export async function getTemporaryDocumentUrlForDocument(
  documentId: bigint | string,
  expiresInSeconds: number
): Promise<string> {
  // const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  // const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  const document = await db.query.documentsCS.findFirst({
    where: eq(documentsCS.id, BigInt(documentId))
  });
  if (!document) {
    throw new Error('Document not found');
  }
  if (!document.s3Key) {
    throw new Error('Document does not have a valid storage key');
  }

  const s3Client = new S3Client({
    region: process.env.S3_REGION,
    credentials: {
      accessKeyId: process.env.S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID!,
      secretAccessKey: process.env.S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY!
    }
  });

  const command = new GetObjectCommand({
    Bucket: String(process.env.S3_BUCKET),
    Key: document.s3Key
  });

  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment
  // @ts-ignore - getSignedUrl typing
  const presignedUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3Client, command, {
    expiresIn: Math.max(60, Math.min(expiresInSeconds, 60 * 60 * 24 * 7))
  });
  return presignedUrl;
}

export type ComputedVersionEntry = {
  version: string; // e.g. v1.0, v2.0
  versionNumber: number; // integer major version
  timestamp: Date;
  description?: string | null;
  changes?: string | null;
  createdByUserId?: bigint | null;
  storageLocation?: string | null;
};

/**
 * Get version history for a document from provenance_schema.document_versions
 * If none found, compute based on audit logs: v1.0 at creation, +1 for each DOCUMENT_UPDATED
 */
export async function getDocumentVersionHistory(
  documentId: bigint | string
): Promise<ComputedVersionEntry[]> {
  const docId = BigInt(documentId);

  // First try provenance captured versions
  const versions = await db
    .select({
      versionNumber: documentVersionsPS.versionNumber,
      timestamp: documentVersionsPS.timestamp,
      changes: documentVersionsPS.changes,
      createdByUserId: documentVersionsPS.createdBy,
      storageLocation: documentVersionsPS.storageLocation
    })
    .from(documentVersionsPS)
    .where(eq(documentVersionsPS.documentId, docId))
    .orderBy(asc(documentVersionsPS.versionNumber));

  if (versions.length > 0) {
    return versions.map((v) => ({
      versionNumber: Number(v.versionNumber),
      version: `v${Number(v.versionNumber)}.0`,
      timestamp: new Date(v.timestamp),
      description: null,
      changes: v.changes ?? null,
      createdByUserId: (v.createdByUserId as unknown as bigint) || null,
      storageLocation: v.storageLocation ?? null
    }));
  }

  // Fallback: compute from audit logs
  const auditRes = await getAuditLogsForDocument(docId);
  if (!auditRes.success) return [];
  const logs = (auditRes.data as unknown as AuditLogCS[])
    .slice()
    .sort(
      (a, b) =>
        new Date(a.createdAt as unknown as Date).getTime() -
        new Date(b.createdAt as unknown as Date).getTime()
    );

  let majorVersion = 0;
  const computed: ComputedVersionEntry[] = [];
  for (const log of logs) {
    if (log.action === ('DOCUMENT_CREATED' as AuditLogAction)) {
      majorVersion = 1;
      computed.push({
        versionNumber: majorVersion,
        version: `v${majorVersion}.0`,
        timestamp: new Date(log.createdAt as unknown as Date),
        description: log.description,
        changes: 'Document created',
        createdByUserId: (log.userId as unknown as bigint) || null
      });
    }
    if (log.action === ('DOCUMENT_UPDATED' as AuditLogAction)) {
      majorVersion += 1;
      computed.push({
        versionNumber: majorVersion,
        version: `v${majorVersion}.0`,
        timestamp: new Date(log.createdAt as unknown as Date),
        description: log.description,
        changes: 'Document updated',
        createdByUserId: (log.userId as unknown as bigint) || null
      });
    }
  }

  // Ensure at least v1.0 exists if document exists
  if (computed.length === 0) {
    const doc = await db.query.documentsCS.findFirst({
      where: eq(documentsCS.id, docId)
    });
    if (doc) {
      return [
        {
          versionNumber: 1,
          version: 'v1.0',
          timestamp: new Date(doc.createdAt),
          description: `Document ${doc.title} created`,
          changes: 'Document created',
          createdByUserId: doc.ownerId
        }
      ];
    }
  }

  return computed;
}

/**
 * Get a single document by its ID.
 * @param documentId The ID of the document to fetch.
 * @returns The DocumentCS record or null if not found.
 */
export async function getDocumentById(
  documentId: bigint
): Promise<DocumentCS | null> {
  if (!documentId) return null;

  const document = await db.query.documentsCS.findFirst({
    where: eq(documentsCS.id, documentId)
  });

  return document ? (document as DocumentCS) : null;
}

/**
 * Updates the metadata of a document.
 * @param documentId The ID of the document to update.
 * @param metadata The metadata fields to update (e.g., filename, description).
 * @returns The updated DocumentCS record.
 * @throws Error if update fails or document not found.
 */
export async function updateDocumentMetadata(
  documentId: bigint,
  metadata: {
    title?: string;
    filename?: string;
    description?: string;
    tags?: string[];
    mimeType?: string;
    fileSize?: bigint;
    hash?: string;
    storageLocation?: string;
    s3Key?: string;
    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  }
): Promise<DocumentCS> {
  if (!documentId) {
    throw new Error('Document ID is required for update.');
  }

  const updateData: Partial<DocumentCS> = {};
  if (metadata.title !== undefined) {
    updateData.title = metadata.title;
  }
  if (metadata.filename !== undefined) {
    updateData.filename = metadata.filename;
  }
  if (metadata.description !== undefined) {
    updateData.description = metadata.description;
  }
  if (metadata.tags !== undefined) {
    updateData.tags = metadata.tags;
  }
  if (metadata.mimeType !== undefined) {
    updateData.mimeType = metadata.mimeType as MimeTypePSType;
  }
  if (metadata.fileSize !== undefined) {
    updateData.fileSize = metadata.fileSize;
  }
  if (metadata.hash !== undefined) {
    updateData.hash = metadata.hash;
  }
  if (metadata.storageLocation !== undefined) {
    updateData.storageLocation = metadata.storageLocation;
  }
  if (metadata.s3Key !== undefined) {
    updateData.s3Key = metadata.s3Key;
  }
  if (metadata.metadata !== undefined) {
    updateData.metadata = metadata.metadata;
  }

  if (Object.keys(updateData).length === 0) {
    // Nothing to update, fetch and return current document to avoid unnecessary DB call
    const currentDoc = await getDocumentById(documentId);
    if (!currentDoc) throw new Error('Document not found for update.');
    return currentDoc;
  }

  updateData.updatedAt = new Date(); // Always update the updatedAt timestamp

  const [updatedDocument] = await db
    .update(documentsCS)
    .set(updateData)
    .where(eq(documentsCS.id, documentId))
    .returning();

  if (!updatedDocument) {
    throw new Error('Failed to update document or document not found.');
  }

  return updatedDocument as DocumentCS;
}

export async function updateDocumentStatus(
  documentId: bigint,
  newStatus: DocumentStatus
): Promise<DocumentCS> {
  // Provenance: enqueue document status update event
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
  const existing = await db.query.documentsCS.findFirst({
    where: eq(documentsCS.id, documentId)
  });
  if (!existing) throw new Error('Document not found');
  const updatedDocs = await db
    .update(documentsCS)
    .set({
      status: newStatus,
      updatedAt: new Date()
    } as Partial<DocumentCS>)
    .where(eq(documentsCS.id, documentId))
    .returning();

  if (updatedDocs.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Document not found or failed to update');
  }
  await execute(print(EnqueueDocumentStatusUpdate as unknown as ASTNode), {
    userId: String(dbUser.id),
    input: {
      correlationId: undefined,
      documentId: documentId.toString(),
      previousStatus: existing.status,
      newStatus: newStatus,
      metadata: {},
      organizationId: existing.organizationId.toString(),
      userId: String(dbUser.id)
    }
  } as MutationRootEnqueueDocumentStatusUpdateArgs).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log update document status event');
    throw error;
  });

  // Audit log: document status update
  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.DOCUMENT_UPDATED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
    metadata: {
      documentId: documentId.toString(),
      previousStatus: existing.status,
      newStatus: newStatus
    },
    entityId: documentId.toString(),
    entityType: 'DOCUMENT',
    description: `Document ${existing.title} status updated to ${newStatus} by ${dbUser.name}`,
    entityName: existing.title,
    documentId: documentId.toString(),
    targetUserId: String(dbUser.id),
    success: true
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[AUDIT] Failed to log document status update audit entry');
  });

  return updatedDocs[0] as DocumentCS;
}

export async function uploadPDFBlobToS3(
  pdfBlob: Blob,
  filename: string,
  organizationId: string
): Promise<{
  filename: string;
  mimeType: string;
  fileSize: bigint;
  key: string;
  storageLocation: string;
  lastModifiedAt: Date;
  hash: string;
}> {
  // Convert blob to file for upload
  const file = new File([pdfBlob], filename, { type: 'application/pdf' });

  const presignRes = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/s3/upload`,
    {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        filename: file.name,
        contentType: file.type,
        organizationId
      })
    }
  );

  if (!presignRes.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to get S3 presigned URL for ${file.name}`);
  }

  const { url, fields, key } = await presignRes.json();

  // Upload file to S3 using FormData
  const formData = new FormData();
  Object.entries(fields).forEach(([k, v]) => formData.append(k, v as string));
  formData.append('file', file);

  const uploadRes = await fetch(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: formData
  });

  if (!uploadRes.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to upload file ${file.name} to S3`);
  }

  // Calculate hash of file
  const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
  const buffer = Buffer.from(arrayBuffer);
  const hash = createHash('sha256').update(buffer).digest('hex');

  return {
    key,
    hash,
    filename: file.name,
    mimeType: file.type,
    fileSize: BigInt(file.size),
    storageLocation: `${url}/${key}`,
    lastModifiedAt: new Date(file.lastModified)
  };
}

export async function submitDocumentFromTemplate({
  templateId,
  organizationId,
  ownerId,
  customFields,
  templateData
}: {
  templateId: bigint;
  organizationId: bigint;
  ownerId: bigint;
  customFields: Record<string, string | number | boolean | string[] | null>;
  templateData?: {
    name: string;
    description?: string;
    fields: DocumentTemplateField[];
    organizationName?: string;
    submittedBy?: string;
  };
}): Promise<DocumentCS> {
  const s3Client = new S3Client({
    region: process.env.S3_REGION,
    credentials: {
      accessKeyId: process.env.S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID,
      secretAccessKey: process.env.S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
    }
  });

  const BUCKET_NAME =
    process.env.S3_BUCKET_TEMPLATES ||
    process.env.S3_BUCKET ||
    'your-default-bucket';
  const ORG_BUCKET_NAME =
    process.env.S3_BUCKET_ORG_DATA ||
    process.env.S3_BUCKET ||
    'your-default-org-bucket';

  // Find the template (could be global or custom)
  let sourceTemplate: DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS | null = null;

  try {
    // First try global templates
    sourceTemplate = await db.query.documentTemplates.findFirst({
      where: and(
        eq(documentTemplates.id, templateId),
        eq(documentTemplates.status, 'ACTIVE')
      )
    });

    // If not found, try custom templates
    if (!sourceTemplate) {
      sourceTemplate = await db.query.customDocumentTemplatesCS.findFirst({
        where: and(
          eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.id, templateId),
          eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.status, 'ACTIVE')
        )
      });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error finding template:', error);
    throw new Error('Template not found');
  }

  if (!sourceTemplate) {
    throw new Error('Active document template not found.');
  }

  const isCustomTemplate = isCustomDocumentTemplate(sourceTemplate);
  const idGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();
  const newDocumentId = await idGenerator.generateDocumentId();

  let newS3Key: string | undefined;
  let newStorageLocation: string | undefined;
  let newFileSize: bigint = sourceTemplate.fileSize;
  let newHash: string | undefined = sourceTemplate.hash;
  let newMimeType: MimeTypePSType = 'application/pdf';

  // Generate PDF from form data if template data is provided
  if (templateData) {
    try {
      // Dynamic import to avoid SSR issues with react-pdf
      const { generateFormPDF } = await import(
        '@/app/(user)/account/form-templates/pdf-generator'
      );

      // Generate PDF from form data
      const pdfBlob = await generateFormPDF({
        templateName: templateData.name,
        templateDescription: templateData.description,
        fields: templateData.fields,
        formData: customFields,
        organizationName: templateData.organizationName,
        submittedBy: templateData.submittedBy,
        submittedAt: new Date()
      });

      // Upload generated PDF to S3
      const filename = `${sourceTemplate.name}_filled_${Date.now()}.pdf`;
      const uploadResult = await uploadPDFBlobToS3(
        pdfBlob,
        filename,
        organizationId.toString()
      );

      newStorageLocation = uploadResult.storageLocation;
      newS3Key = uploadResult.key;
      newFileSize = uploadResult.fileSize;
      newHash = uploadResult.hash;
      newMimeType = uploadResult.mimeType as MimeTypePSType;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to generate PDF:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to generate document from template');
    }
  } else if (sourceTemplate.storageLocation && ORG_BUCKET_NAME && BUCKET_NAME) {
    // Fallback: copy template file to new location for the document
    const url = new URL(sourceTemplate.storageLocation);
    const originalS3Key = url.pathname.startsWith('/')
      ? url.pathname.substring(1)
      : url.pathname;

    const originalFilename = sourceTemplate.name;
    newS3Key = `org_${organizationId}/documents/${newDocumentId}/${originalFilename}`;

    const copySource = `${BUCKET_NAME}/${originalS3Key}`;

    try {
      const copyCommand = new CopyObjectCommand({
        Bucket: ORG_BUCKET_NAME,
        CopySource: encodeURIComponent(copySource),
        Key: newS3Key,
        MetadataDirective: 'COPY',
        TaggingDirective: 'COPY'
      });
      await s3Client.send(copyCommand);
      newStorageLocation = `https://${ORG_BUCKET_NAME}.s3.${process.env.S3_REGION}.amazonaws.com/${newS3Key}`;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        'S3 copy error during template submission processing:',
        error
      );
      throw new Error('Failed to copy template file to organization storage.');
    }
  }

  const inheritedDocData: Omit<DocumentCS, 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'> = {
    id: newDocumentId,
    organizationId,
    ownerId,
    title: `${sourceTemplate.name} - Filled Form`,
    filename: `${sourceTemplate.name}_filled.pdf`,
    mimeType: newMimeType,
    fileSize: newFileSize,
    hash: newHash,
    storageLocation: newStorageLocation,
    s3Key: newS3Key,
    isPublic: sourceTemplate.isPublic || false,
    metadata: {
      ...sourceTemplate.metadata,
      filledFromTemplate: templateId,
      customFields,
      submittedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      generatedFromForm: !!templateData
    },
    tags: sourceTemplate.tags || [],
    entityStatus: 'ACTIVE',
    status: 'ACTIVE' as DocumentStatus,
    lastModifiedAt: new Date(),
    description: sourceTemplate.description || '',
    templateId: getTemplateId(sourceTemplate),
    globalTemplateId: isCustomTemplate ? null : sourceTemplate.id,
    customTemplateId: isCustomTemplate ? sourceTemplate.id : null,
    customFields: customFields || null
  };

  const [createdDocument] = await db
    .insert(documentsCS)
    .values(inheritedDocData)
    .returning();

  if (!createdDocument) {
    throw new Error('Failed to create document record from template.');
  }

  // Provenance: enqueue document upload event for template submission
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
  await execute(print(EnqueueDocumentUpload as unknown as ASTNode), {
    userId: String(dbUser.id),
    input: {
      correlationId: undefined,
      documentId: createdDocument.id.toString(),
      filename: createdDocument.filename,
      description: createdDocument.description,
      fileSize: Number(createdDocument.fileSize),
      hash: createdDocument.hash,
      lastModifiedAt: createdDocument.lastModifiedAt.toISOString(),
      metadata: createdDocument.metadata || {},
      mimeType: createdDocument.mimeType,
      organizationId: createdDocument.organizationId.toString(),
      ownerId: createdDocument.ownerId.toString(),
      s3Key: createdDocument.s3Key || '',
      storageLocation: createdDocument.storageLocation || '',
      tags: createdDocument.tags || [],
      title: createdDocument.title,
      triggeredBy: createdDocument.ownerId.toString(),
      deletionReason: 'Document created from template - no deletion applicable',
      userId: String(dbUser.id)
    }
  } as MutationRootEnqueueDocumentDeleteArgs).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log upload document event');
  });

  // Audit log: document created from template
  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.DOCUMENT_CREATED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
    metadata: {
      documentId: createdDocument.id.toString(),
      templateId: templateId.toString(),
      filename: createdDocument.filename,
      title: createdDocument.title,
      mimeType: createdDocument.mimeType,
      fileSize: Number(createdDocument.fileSize),
      hash: createdDocument.hash,
      generatedFromForm: !!templateData,
      templateName: sourceTemplate.name,
      templateDescription: sourceTemplate.description,
      s3Key: createdDocument.s3Key,
      storageLocation: createdDocument.storageLocation
    },
    entityId: createdDocument.id.toString(),
    entityType: 'DOCUMENT',
    description: `Document ${createdDocument.title} created from template ${sourceTemplate.name} by ${dbUser.name}`,
    entityName: createdDocument.title,
    documentId: createdDocument.id.toString(),
    targetUserId: String(dbUser.id),
    success: true
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log(
      '[AUDIT] Failed to log document creation from template audit entry'
    );
  });

  // Create form response record
  try {
    await createFormResponse({
      templateId,
      organizationId,
      documentId: createdDocument.id,
      submittedByUserId: ownerId,
      submittedByName: templateData?.submittedBy,
      formData: customFields,
      metadata: {
        generatedFromForm: !!templateData,
        templateName: sourceTemplate.name,
        templateDescription: sourceTemplate.description
      }
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to create form response record:', error);
    // Don't fail the document creation if form response creation fails
  }

  return createdDocument as DocumentCS;
}

/**
 * Check if a user has access to a document.
 *
 * @param documentId The ID of the document to check access for.
 * @param userId The ID of the user to check access for.
 * @param organizationId The ID of the organization to check access for.
 * @returns True if the user has access to the document, false otherwise.
 */
export async function canAccessDocument(
  documentId: bigint | string,
  userId: bigint | string,
  organizationId: bigint | string
): Promise<boolean> {
  // Normalize IDs to string for comparison where needed, and BigInt for database queries
  const docId = documentId.toString();
  const uId = userId.toString();
  const orgId = organizationId.toString();

  // Fetch user, document, and organization concurrently for efficiency
  const [dbUser, document, organization] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select()
      .from(usersCS)
      .where(eq(usersCS.id, BigInt(uId)))
      .limit(1)
      .then((rows) => rows[0]),
    db
      .select()
      .from(documentsCS)
      .where(eq(documentsCS.id, BigInt(docId)))
      .limit(1)
      .then((rows) => rows[0]),
    db
      .select()
      .from(organizationsCS)
      .where(eq(organizationsCS.id, BigInt(orgId)))
      .limit(1)
      .then((rows) => rows[0])
  ]);

  // If any required entity is not found, access is denied
  if (!dbUser || !document || !organization) {
    return false;
  }

  // 1. Check general access roles (these roles grant full access, temporal restrictions do not apply to them)

  // a - Super admin
  if (
    AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS.includes(
      dbUser.id.toString() as (typeof AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS)[number]
    )
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // b - Organization creator
  if (
    organization.createdByUserId &&
    organization.createdByUserId.toString() === dbUser.id.toString()
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // c - Organization admin (L5_USER role within the specified organization)
  if (
    dbUser.organizationRoleId &&
    dbUser.organizationRoleId.toString() === ROLES.L5_USER.id.toString() &&
    dbUser.organizationId &&
    dbUser.organizationId.toString() === orgId
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // d - Organization member (can access documents within their own organization)
  if (
    dbUser.organizationId &&
    dbUser.organizationId.toString() === document.organizationId.toString()
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // 2. Check specific permissions like DOCUMENT_SIGN, which might have temporal restrictions

  const attributes: UserAttributes | null = dbUser.attributes || null;
  const permissions: PermissionType[] = dbUser.permissions || [];

  const hasDocumentSignPermission =
    permissions.includes(PermissionType.DOCUMENT_SIGN) ||
    (attributes && attributes.function?.primary === 'SIGNER'); // Use optional chaining for safety

  if (hasDocumentSignPermission) {
    // If user has temporal access schedule, check if access is currently allowed
    if (attributes?.temporalAccess) {
      const now = new Date();
      const schedule = attributes.temporalAccess.schedule;

      // Convert current day (0-6) to Weekday enum string
      const currentDay = now.getDay();
      const weekdays = [
        'SUNDAY',
        'MONDAY',
        'TUESDAY',
        'WEDNESDAY',
        'THURSDAY',
        'FRIDAY',
        'SATURDAY'
      ];
      const currentDayWeekday = weekdays[currentDay] as Weekday;

      // a. Check if the current day is in the schedule
      if (!schedule.days.includes(currentDayWeekday)) {
        return false; // Access denied: not allowed on this day
      }

      // b. Check if the current time is within the time range of the schedule (if specified)
      if (schedule.timeRange) {
        const [startTimeStr, endTimeStr] = schedule.timeRange.split('-');
        const [startHour, startMinute] = startTimeStr.split(':').map(Number);
        const [endHour, endMinute] = endTimeStr.split(':').map(Number);

        const currentHour = now.getHours();
        const currentMinute = now.getMinutes();
        const currentSecond = now.getSeconds();

        const currentTimeInSeconds =
          currentHour * 3600 + currentMinute * 60 + currentSecond;
        const startTimeInSeconds = startHour * 3600 + startMinute * 60;
        const endTimeInSeconds = endHour * 3600 + endMinute * 60;

        let isWithinTimeRange = false;
        if (startTimeInSeconds <= endTimeInSeconds) {
          // Normal time range (e.g., 09:00-17:00)
          isWithinTimeRange =
            currentTimeInSeconds >= startTimeInSeconds &&
            currentTimeInSeconds <= endTimeInSeconds;
        } else {
          // Overnight time range (e.g., 22:00-06:00)
          isWithinTimeRange =
            currentTimeInSeconds >= startTimeInSeconds ||
            currentTimeInSeconds <= endTimeInSeconds;
        }

        if (!isWithinTimeRange) {
          return false; // Access denied: not allowed at this time
        }
      }
      // If temporalAccess exists and all checks (day and optional time range) pass, access is granted.
      return true;
    } else {
      // User has DOCUMENT_SIGN permission but no temporal access restrictions, so allow.
      return true;
    }
  }

  // 3. Default: If no conditions above granted access, deny.
  return false;
}

              className='flex size-16 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-primary/20 bg-primary/10'
              variants={fastItemVariants}
              viewport={{ once: true }}
              whileInView='visible'
              transition={{ delay: 0.3 }}
            >
              <Building2 className='size-8 text-primary' />
            </motion.div>
            <motion.div
              variants={fastItemVariants}
              viewport={{ once: true }}
              whileInView='visible'
              transition={{ delay: 0.4 }}
            >
              <CardTitle className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                {organization.name}
                {organization.isVerified && (
                  <Badge
                    variant='secondary'
                    className='gap-1 dark:border-green-700 dark:text-green-400'
                  >
                    <CheckCircle2 className='size-3' />
                    Verified
                  </Badge>
                )}
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                {organization.description || 'No description available'}
              </CardDescription>
            </motion.div>
          </motion.div>
          <motion.div
            variants={fastItemVariants}
            viewport={{ once: true }}
            whileInView='visible'
            transition={{ delay: 0.5 }}
          >
            <Link href='/account/organization/settings'>
              <Button
                size='sm'
                variant='light'
                className='group w-full items-center gap-2 border border-primary/20'
              >
                <Settings className='size-4' />
                Organization Settings
              </Button>
            </Link>
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <motion.div
          className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:grid-cols-4'
          variants={containerVariants}
          initial='hidden'
          animate='visible'
          viewport={{ once: true }}
          whileInView='visible'
          transition={{ delay: 0.6 }}
        >
          {[
            {
              icon: Users,
              label: 'Members',
              value: organizationMembers?.length || 0
            },
            {
              icon: Shield,
              label: 'Security',
              value: organization.isMfaRequired ? 'High' : 'Standard'
            },
            {
              icon: Briefcase,
              label: 'Industry',
              value: organization.industryType
                ? toTitleCase(organization.industryType.replaceAll('_', ' '))
                : 'N/A'
            },
            {
              icon: Globe2,
              label: 'Size',
              value: organization.sizeCategory
                ? toTitleCase(organization.sizeCategory.replaceAll('_', ' '))
                : 'N/A'
            }
          ].map((item, index) => {
            const Icon = item.icon;
            return (
              <motion.div
                key={item.label}
                className='flex flex-col gap-1'
                variants={fastItemVariants}
                viewport={{ once: true }}
                whileInView='visible'
              >
                <div className='flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground dark:text-muted-foreground'>
                  <Icon className='size-4' />
                  {item.label}
                </div>
                <div
                  className={cn(
                    typeof item.value === 'number'
                      ? 'text-2xl font-bold'
                      : 'text-sm font-medium',
                    'dark:text-foreground'
                  )}
                >
                  {item.value}
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            );
          })}
        </motion.div>
      </CardContent>
    </MotionCard>
  );
};

const DocumentsOverview = ({
  documents,
  drafts,
  templates
}: {
  documents: DocumentCS[];
  drafts: DocumentCS[];
  templates: DocumentTemplate[];
}) => {
  const totalDocuments = (documents || []).length;
  const totalDrafts = (drafts || []).length;
  const totalTemplates = (templates || []).length;

  const recentDocuments = [...(documents || [])]
    .sort(
      (a, b) =>
        new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime()
    )
    .slice(0, 5);

  const stats = [
    {
      value: totalDocuments,
      label: 'Documents',
      color: 'text-primary'
    },
    {
      value: totalDrafts,
      label: 'Drafts',
      color: 'text-blue-500'
    },
    {
      value: totalTemplates,
      label: 'Templates',
      color: 'text-green-500'
    }
  ];

  return (
    <MotionCard
      className='zyflo-transition bg-muted/20 hover:bg-muted/30 dark:border-border dark:bg-card dark:hover:bg-muted/10'
      variants={cardVariants}
      initial='hidden'
      animate='visible'
      viewport={{ once: true }}
      whileInView='visible'
    >
      <CardHeader>
        <motion.div variants={fastItemVariants} transition={{ delay: 0.1 }}>
          <CardTitle className='flex items-center gap-2'>
            <FileText className='size-5 text-primary' />
            Documents Overview
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Your document workspace at a glance</CardDescription>
        </motion.div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <motion.div
          className='mb-4 flex flex-row flex-wrap items-center gap-6'
          variants={containerVariants}
          initial='hidden'
          animate='visible'
          viewport={{ once: true }}
          whileInView='visible'
          transition={{ delay: 0.2 }}
        >
          {stats.map((stat, index) => (
            <motion.div
              key={stat.label}
              className='flex flex-1 flex-col items-center rounded-lg border bg-secondary px-3 py-6 dark:border-border dark:bg-secondary'
              variants={fastItemVariants}
              viewport={{ once: true }}
              whileInView='visible'
            >
              <div
                className={cn(
                  'line-clamp-1 text-ellipsis text-2xl font-bold',
                  stat.color,
                  'dark:text-foreground'
                )}
              >
                {stat.value}
              </div>
              <div className='text-sm text-muted-foreground dark:text-muted-foreground'>
                {stat.label}
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          ))}
        </motion.div>
        <motion.div
          variants={fastItemVariants}
          initial='hidden'
          animate='visible'
          viewport={{ once: true }}
          whileInView='visible'
          transition={{ delay: 0.4 }}
        >
          <div className='mb-2 flex items-center justify-between'>
            <span className='text-base font-medium dark:text-foreground'>
              Recent Documents
            </span>
          </div>
          {recentDocuments.length > 0 ? (
            <motion.div
              className='space-y-3'
              variants={containerVariants}
              initial='hidden'
              animate='visible'
              transition={{ delay: 0.5 }}
            >
              {recentDocuments.map((doc, index) => (
                <motion.div
                  key={doc.id.toString()}
                  variants={fastItemVariants}
                  viewport={{ once: true }}
                  whileInView='visible'
                >
                  <Link
                    href={`/account/documents/${doc.id.toString()}`}
                    className='zyflo-transition flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border bg-muted/80 p-2 hover:bg-muted dark:border-border dark:bg-muted/60 dark:hover:bg-muted'
                  >
                    <div className='flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-primary/10 dark:bg-secondary'>
                      <FileText className='size-4 text-primary' />
                    </div>
                    <div className='min-w-0 flex-1'>
                      <p className='truncate text-sm font-medium dark:text-foreground'>
                        {doc.title}
                      </p>
                      <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground dark:text-muted-foreground'>
                        Created{' '}
                        {formatDistanceToNow(new Date(doc.createdAt), {
                          addSuffix: true
                        })}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <DocumentStatusHighlight status={doc.status} />
                  </Link>
                </motion.div>
              ))}
              <motion.div
                variants={fastItemVariants}
                initial='hidden'
                animate='visible'
                viewport={{ once: true }}
                whileInView='visible'
                transition={{ delay: 0.7 }}
              >
                <Link href='/account/documents'>
                  <Button
                    variant='light'
                    size='sm'
                    className='group mt-4 w-full gap-2 border border-primary/20 pl-[18px] dark:border-primary/20 dark:bg-primary/10 dark:hover:border-primary/60'
                  >
                    <FileText className='size-4' />
                    View All
                    <ArrowRight className='zyflo-transition ml-auto size-4 -translate-x-2 opacity-0 group-hover:translate-x-0 group-hover:-rotate-45 group-hover:opacity-100' />
                  </Button>
                </Link>
              </motion.div>
            </motion.div>
          ) : (
            <motion.div
              className='py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground dark:text-muted-foreground'
              variants={fastItemVariants}
              initial='hidden'
              animate='visible'
              viewport={{ once: true }}
              whileInView='visible'
              transition={{ delay: 0.6 }}
            >
              <FileText className='mx-auto mb-2 size-8 opacity-50' />
              <p>No documents yet</p>
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </motion.div>
      </CardContent>
    </MotionCard>
  );
};

const TeamActivity = ({ teams }: { teams: ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS[] }) => {
  const { organizationMembers } = useUserData();

  const teamStats = teams
    .map((team) => ({
      ...team,
      memberCount: (team.members || []).length
    }))
    .slice(0, 5);

  const stats = [
    {
      value: teams.length,
      label: 'Active Teams',
      color: 'text-primary'
    },
    {
      value: organizationMembers?.length || 0,
      label: 'Total Members',
      color: 'text-green-500'
    }
  ];

  return (
    <MotionCard
      className='zyflo-transition bg-muted/20 hover:bg-muted/30 dark:border-border dark:bg-card dark:hover:bg-muted/10'
      variants={cardVariants}
      initial='hidden'
      animate='visible'
      viewport={{ once: true }}
      whileInView='visible'
    >
      <CardHeader>
        <motion.div variants={fastItemVariants} transition={{ delay: 0.1 }}>
          <CardTitle className='flex items-center gap-2'>
            <Users className='size-5 text-primary' />
            Team Activity
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Collaboration across your organization
          </CardDescription>
        </motion.div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <motion.div
          className='mb-4 flex flex-row flex-wrap items-center gap-6'
          variants={containerVariants}
          initial='hidden'
          animate='visible'
          viewport={{ once: true }}
          whileInView='visible'
          transition={{ delay: 0.2 }}
        >
          {stats.map((stat, index) => (
            <motion.div
              key={stat.label}
              className='flex flex-1 flex-col items-center rounded-lg border bg-secondary px-3 py-6 dark:border-border dark:bg-secondary'
              variants={fastItemVariants}

              whileInView='visible'

                {stat.label}
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          ))}
        </motion.div>
        <motion.div
          variants={fastItemVariants}
          initial='hidden'
          animate='visible'

          whileInView='visible'
          transition={{ delay: 0.4 }}
        >
          <div className='mb-2 flex items-center justify-between'>

            </span>

              className='space-y-3'

              initial='hidden'
              animate='visible'
              transition={{ delay: 0.5 }}
            >
              {teamStats.map((team, index) => (

                  key={team.id}
                  className='zyflo-transition flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border bg-muted/80 p-2 hover:bg-muted dark:border-border dark:bg-muted/60 dark:hover:bg-muted'

                  viewport={{ once: true }}
                  whileInView='visible'
                >
                  <div className='flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-primary/10 dark:bg-secondary'>
                    <Users className='size-4 text-primary' />
                  </div>
                  <div className='min-w-0 flex-1'>
                    <p className='truncate text-sm font-medium dark:text-foreground'>
                      {team.name}
                    </p>
                    <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground dark:text-muted-foreground'>
                      {team.memberCount}{' '}
                      {team.memberCount === 1 ? 'member' : 'members'}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </motion.div>
              ))}
            </motion.div>
          ) : (
            <motion.div
              className='py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground dark:text-muted-foreground'
              variants={fastItemVariants}

              animate='visible'

              <Users className='mx-auto mb-2 size-8 opacity-50' />

            </motion.div>
          )}
          <motion.div

            animate='visible'
            viewport={{ once: true }}
            whileInView='visible'
            transition={{ delay: 0.7 }}
          >
            <Link href='/account/organization/teams'>
              <Button
                variant='light'
                size='sm'
                className='group mt-4 w-full gap-2 border border-primary/20 pl-[18px] dark:border-primary/20 dark:bg-primary/10 dark:hover:border-primary/60'
              >
                <UserCog className='size-4' />
                Manage Teams
                <ArrowRight className='zyflo-transition ml-auto size-4 -translate-x-2 opacity-0 group-hover:translate-x-0 group-hover:-rotate-45 group-hover:opacity-100' />
              </Button>
            </Link>
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      </CardContent>
    </MotionCard>

export function CategoryDistributionChart({
  categoryStats
}: {
  categoryStats: { category: string; count: number }[];
}) {
  const id = 'category-distribution-pie';
  const chartData = React.useMemo(() => {
    return categoryStats.map((stat, index) => ({
      category: toTitleCase(stat.category.replace(/_/gu, ' ')),
      count: stat.count,
      fill: `var(--chart-${(index % 5) + 1})`
    }));
  }, [categoryStats]);

  const categories = React.useMemo(
    () => chartData.map((item) => item.category),
    [chartData]
  );
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = React.useState(
    categories[0] ?? ''
  );

  const activeIndex = React.useMemo(
    () => chartData.findIndex((item) => item.category === activeCategory),
    [activeCategory, chartData]
  );

  const chartConfig: ChartConfig = {
    count: { label: 'Count' },
    ...chartData.reduce((acc, { category, fill }) => {
      acc[category] = { label: category, color: fill };
      return acc;
    }, {} as ChartConfig)
  };

  return (
    <Card
      data-chart={id}
      className='dark:border-1 flex flex-col border bg-muted dark:border-solid dark:border-border dark:bg-card'
    >
      <ChartStyle id={id} config={chartConfig} />
      <CardHeader className='flex-row items-start space-y-0 pb-0'>
        <div className='grid gap-1'>
          <CardTitle>Category Distribution</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Breakdown of audit logs by category</CardDescription>
        </div>
        <Select value={activeCategory} onValueChange={setActiveCategory}>
          <SelectTrigger
            className='ml-auto h-8 w-[130px] rounded-lg pl-2.5 font-suisse-intl text-xs'
            aria-label='Select a category'
          >
            <SelectValue placeholder='Select category' />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent
            align='end'
            className='rounded-xl font-suisse-intl text-xs'
          >
            {categories.map((key, idx) => {
              const config = chartConfig[key as keyof typeof chartConfig];
              if (!config) return null;
              return (
                <SelectItem
                  key={key}
                  value={key}
                  className='rounded-lg [&_span]:flex'
                >
                  <div className='flex items-center gap-2 text-xs'>
                    <span
                      className='rounded-xs flex size-3 shrink-0'
                      style={{
                        backgroundColor: chartData[idx]?.fill
                      }}
                    />
                    {config?.label}
                  </div>
                </SelectItem>
              );
            })}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className='flex flex-1 justify-center pb-0'>
        <ChartContainer
          id={id}
          config={chartConfig}
          className='mx-auto aspect-square w-full max-w-[300px]'
        >
          <PieChart>
            <ChartTooltip
              cursor={false}
              content={<ChartTooltipContent hideLabel />}
            />
            <Pie
              data={chartData}
              dataKey='count'
              nameKey='category'
              innerRadius={60}
              strokeWidth={5}
              // activeIndex={activeIndex}
              activeShape={({
                outerRadius = 0,
                ...props
              }: PieSectorDataItem) => (
                <g>
                  <Sector {...props} outerRadius={outerRadius + 10} />
                  <Sector
                    {...props}
                    outerRadius={outerRadius + 25}
                    innerRadius={outerRadius + 12}
                  />
                </g>
              )}
            >
              <Label
                content={({ viewBox }) => {
                  if (
                    viewBox &&
                    'cx' in viewBox &&
                    'cy' in viewBox &&
                    chartData[activeIndex]
                  ) {
                    return (
                      <text
                        x={viewBox.cx}
                        y={viewBox.cy}
                        textAnchor='middle'
                        dominantBaseline='middle'
                      >
                        <tspan
                          x={viewBox.cx}
                          y={viewBox.cy}
                          className='fill-foreground text-3xl font-bold'
                        >
                          {chartData[activeIndex].count.toLocaleString()}
                        </tspan>
                        <tspan
                          x={viewBox.cx}
                          y={(viewBox.cy || 0) + 24}
                          className='fill-muted-foreground'
                        >
                          {chartData[activeIndex].category}
                        </tspan>
                      </text>
                    );
                  }
                  return null;
                }}
              />
            </Pie>
            <ChartLegend
              content={
                <ChartLegendContent nameKey='category' payload={chartData} />
              }
              className='-translate-y-2 flex-wrap gap-2 *:basis-1/4 *:justify-center'
            />
          </PieChart>
        </ChartContainer>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

// Severity Distribution Chart (Horizontal Bar)
const SeverityDistributionChart = ({
  severityStats
}: {
  severityStats: { severity: string; count: number }[];
}) => {
  const chartData = useMemo(() => {
    return severityStats.map((stat, index) => ({
      severity: toTitleCase(stat.severity),
      count: stat.count,
      fill:
        stat.severity === 'ERROR' || stat.severity === 'CRITICAL'
          ? 'var(--destructive)'
          : stat.severity === 'INFO'
            ? 'var(--primary)'
            : '#FCD866'
    }));
  }, [severityStats]);

  const chartConfig: ChartConfig = {
    count: { label: 'Count', color: 'var(--chart-1)' }
  };

  return (
    <ChartContainer config={chartConfig} className='max-h-[250px]'>
      <BarChart accessibilityLayer data={chartData} layout='vertical'>
        <CartesianGrid horizontal={false} />
        <XAxis type='number' hide />
        <YAxis
          type='category'
          dataKey='severity'
          tickLine={false}
          axisLine={false}
          className='text-xs'
        />
        <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
        <Bar dataKey='count' radius={4} fill='var(--color-count)' />
      </BarChart>
    </ChartContainer>
  );
};

export function AuditLogsClient({

  specificLog
}: {
  dbUser: UserCS;
  specificLog?: AuditLogWithUser | null;
}) {
  const {
    data: auditLogsData,
    stats,
    isLoading,
    isStatsLoading,
    error,
    currentPage,
    pageSize,
    filters,
    sort,
    updatePage,
    updatePageSize,
    updateFilters,
    updateSort,
    clearFilters,
    refetch
  } = useAuditLogs();

  const exportMutation = useExportAuditLogs();

  // State
  const [rowSelection, setRowSelection] = useState<RowSelectionState>({});
  const [selectedAuditLog, setSelectedAuditLog] =
    useState<AuditLogWithUser | null>(null);
  const [isDetailsSheetOpen, setIsDetailsSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const [globalFilter, setGlobalFilter] = useState('');

  // Quick Actions: show/hide stats and charts
  const [showStats, setShowStats] = useState(false);
  const [showCharts, setShowCharts] = useState(false);

  // Column visibility and ordering state
  const [columnVisibility, setColumnVisibility] = useState(() => {
    return getLocalStorageItem('audit-logs-column-visibility');
  });
  const [columnOrder, setColumnOrder] = useState<string[]>(() => {
    return getLocalStorageItem('audit-logs-column-order');
  });

  // Save column preferences to localStorage
  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalStorageItem('audit-logs-column-visibility', columnVisibility);
  }, [columnVisibility]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalStorageItem('audit-logs-column-order', columnOrder);
  }, [columnOrder]);

  const debouncedGlobalFilter = useDebounce(globalFilter, 500);

  // Handle global filter changes
  useEffect(() => {
    updateFilters({ ...filters, search: debouncedGlobalFilter || undefined });
  }, [debouncedGlobalFilter]);

  // Handle deep-linking to specific log
  useEffect(() => {
    if (specificLog) {
      setSelectedAuditLog(specificLog);
      setIsDetailsSheetOpen(true);
    }
  }, [specificLog]);

  // Responsive columns definition
  const columns = useMemo<ColumnDef<AuditLogWithUser>[]>(
    () => [
      // Select column (hidden on xs, shown on md+)
      {
        id: 'select',
        header: ({ table }) => (
          <div className='hidden md:block'>
            <Checkbox
              checked={table.getIsAllPageRowsSelected()}
              onCheckedChange={(value) =>
                table.toggleAllPageRowsSelected(!!value)
              }
              className='size-4'
              aria-label='Select all'
            />

              )}

        <div className='flex flex-col-reverse items-center justify-between gap-4 sm:flex-row'>
          <div className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
            {auditLogsData && (
              <>
                Showing {(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + 1} to{' '}
                {Math.min(currentPage * pageSize, auditLogsData.total)} of{' '}
                {auditLogsData.total} results
              </>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
            <Button
              variant='outline'
              size='sm'
              onClick={() => updatePage(currentPage - 1)}
              disabled={currentPage <= 1 || isLoading}
            >
              Previous
            </Button>
            <div className='flex items-center gap-1'>
              <span className='text-sm'>Page</span>
              <span className='text-sm font-medium'>
                {currentPage} of {auditLogsData?.totalPages || 1}
              </span>
            </div>
            <Button
              variant='outline'
              size='sm'
              onClick={() => updatePage(currentPage + 1)}
              disabled={
                currentPage >= (auditLogsData?.totalPages || 1) || isLoading
              }
            >
              Next
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Selection Toolbar */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {selectedAuditLogs.length > 0 && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ y: 100, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ y: 100, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
            className='fixed bottom-6 left-6 z-50 md:bottom-8 md:left-1/2 md:-translate-x-1/2'
          >
            <div className='flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-background px-4 py-2 shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-border sm:gap-4 sm:px-6 sm:py-3'>
              <p className='text-xs font-medium sm:text-sm'>
                {selectedAuditLogs.length} log
                {selectedAuditLogs.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} selected
              </p>
              <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                <Tooltip>
                  <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                    <Button
                      variant='outline'
                      size='sm'
                      onClick={handleClearSelection}
                      className='hover:border-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive'
                    >
                      <X className='mr-1 size-4' />
                      Clear
                    </Button>
                  </TooltipTrigger>
                  <TooltipContent>Clear selection</TooltipContent>
                </Tooltip>

                <Tooltip>
                  <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                    <Button
                      variant='default'
                      size='sm'
                      onClick={handleExportSelected}
                      disabled={exportMutation.isPending}
                    >
                      <Download className='mr-1 size-4' />
                      Export
                    </Button>
                  </TooltipTrigger>
                  <TooltipContent>Export selected logs</TooltipContent>
                </Tooltip>
              </div>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Audit Log Details Sheet */}
      <AuditLogDetailsSheet
        isOpen={isDetailsSheetOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsDetailsSheetOpen}
        auditLog={selectedAuditLog}
      />
    </TooltipProvider>
  );
}

const getLocalStorageItem = (key: string) => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return {};
  const saved = localStorage.getItem(key);
  try {
    return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : {};
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to parse saved item:', error);
    return {};
  }
};

const setLocalStorageItem = (key: string, value: unknown) => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
};

const slugify = (text: string) =>
  text
    .toString()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\s+/gu, '-') // Replace spaces with -
    .replace(/[^\w-]+/gu, '') // Remove all non-word chars
    .replace(/--+/gu, '-') // Replace multiple - with single -
    .replace(/^-+/u, '') // Trim - from start of text
    // eslint-disable-next-line
    .replace(/-+$/u, ''); // Trim - from end of text

// Schema for a single field in the form
const formFieldSchema = z.object({
  name: z
    .string()
    .min(1, 'Field name is required')
    .regex(
      /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/u,
      'Field name must be a valid slug (e.g., first-name)'

  label: z.string().min(1, 'Label is required'),
  type: z.enum([
    'string',

    'image',
    'file',
    'signature'
  ]),
  required: z.boolean().default(false),

});

          isPublic: true,
          tags: '',
          language: 'en',
          file: undefined
        });
        setExistingFileName(null);
        setCurrentFile(null);
      }
    }
  }, [template, isOpen, form]);

  const onDrop = useCallback(
    (acceptedFiles: File[]) => {
      if (acceptedFiles.length > 0) {
        const file = acceptedFiles[0];
        setCurrentFile(file);
        form.setValue('file', file, { shouldValidate: true });
        setExistingFileName(null);
      }
    },
    [form]
  );

  const { getRootProps, getInputProps, isDragActive } = useDropzone({
    onDrop,
    multiple: false,
    accept: { 'application/pdf': ['.pdf'] }
  });

  const handleRemoveFile = () => {
    setCurrentFile(null);
    form.setValue('file', undefined, { shouldValidate: true });
    setExistingFileName(null);
  };

  const onSubmit = async (values: TemplateFormValues) => {
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      let s3File: File | null | undefined = undefined;
      if (currentFile) {
        s3File = currentFile;
      } else if (values.file) {
        s3File = values.file;
      } else if (template && !existingFileName) {
        // File was removed
        s3File = null;
      }

      const derivedMimeType =
        currentFile?.type || template?.mimeType || MimeTypePSEnums[0];

      if (!template && !s3File) {
        form.setError('file', {
          type: 'manual',
          message: 'Template file is required for creation.'
        });
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      // When cloning a global template, require a new file
      if (template && !('organizationId' in template) && !s3File) {
        form.setError('file', {
          type: 'manual',
          message:
            'A template file is required when cloning a global template. Please upload a new file.'
        });
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      const commonData = {
        name: values.name,
        description: values.description,
        category: values.category,
        version: values.version,
        mimeType: derivedMimeType as (typeof MimeTypePSEnums)[number],
        fields:
          values.fields?.map((f) => ({
            name: f.name,
            label: f.label,
            type: f.type,
            required: f.required,
            description: f.description,
            options: f.options ? f.options.split(',').map((o) => o.trim()) : []
          })) ?? [],
        isPublic: values.isPublic,
        tags: values.tags
          ? values.tags
              .split(',')
              .map((tag) => tag.trim())
              .filter(Boolean)
          : [],
        language: values.language
      };

      if (template) {
        // Check if this is a custom template (has organizationId)
        const isCustomTemplate = 'organizationId' in template;

        if (isCustomTemplate) {
          // Update custom template
          if (!currentUserDbId) {
            throw new Error(
              'User ID is required for updating custom templates.'
            );
          }

          const updateData: UpdateCustomDocumentTemplateData = {
            ...commonData,
            updatedBy: BigInt(currentUserDbId),
            file: s3File
          };

          const updatedTemplate = await updateCustomDocumentTemplate(
            template.id,
            updateData
          );

          if (updatedTemplate) {
            toast.success('Template updated successfully!');
            await createAuditLogEntry({
              action: AuditLogAction.TEMPLATE_UPDATED,
              category: AuditLogCategory.TEMPLATE_MANAGEMENT,
              entityId: updatedTemplate.id,
              entityType: 'custom_document_template',
              entityName: updatedTemplate.name,
              description: `User updated custom template: "${updatedTemplate.name}"`,
              beforeState: { template },
              afterState: { template: updatedTemplate }
            }).catch(console.error);
            onSuccess(updatedTemplate);
          }
        } else {
          // This is a global template - we should clone it to create a custom template
          if (!organizationId || !currentUserDbId) {
            throw new Error(
              'Organization ID and User ID are required for cloning global templates.'
            );
          }

          // Clone the global template to create a custom template
          const cloneData: CreateCustomDocumentTemplateData = {
            ...commonData,
            organizationId: BigInt(organizationId),
            createdBy: BigInt(currentUserDbId),
            updatedBy: BigInt(currentUserDbId),
            file: s3File || undefined, // Use new file if provided, otherwise keep original
            // Reference the original global template
            templateId: template.id
          };

          // If no new file is provided, we need to copy the existing file
          if (!s3File && template.storageLocation) {
            // For now, we'll require a file to be provided when cloning
            // In the future, we could implement file copying logic here
            throw new Error(
              'A template file is required when cloning a global template. Please upload a new file.'
            );
          }

          const newCustomTemplate =
            await createCustomDocumentTemplate(cloneData);
          toast.success(
            'Global template cloned successfully as custom template!'
          );
          await createAuditLogEntry({
            action: AuditLogAction.TEMPLATE_CREATED,
            category: AuditLogCategory.TEMPLATE_MANAGEMENT,
            entityId: newCustomTemplate.id,
            entityType: 'custom_document_template',
            entityName: newCustomTemplate.name,
            description: `User cloned global template "${template.name}" to create custom template: "${newCustomTemplate.name}"`,
            afterState: { template: newCustomTemplate },
            metadata: { clonedFromGlobalTemplateId: template.id.toString() }
          }).catch(console.error);
          onSuccess(newCustomTemplate);
        }
      } else {
        // Creating new template
        if (!organizationId || !currentUserDbId) {
          throw new Error(
            'Organization ID and User ID are required for creating custom templates.'
          );
        }

        const createData: CreateCustomDocumentTemplateData = {
          ...commonData,
          organizationId: BigInt(organizationId),
          createdBy: BigInt(currentUserDbId),
          updatedBy: BigInt(currentUserDbId),
          file: s3File as File
        };

        const newTemplate = await createCustomDocumentTemplate(createData);
        toast.success('Template created successfully!');
        await createAuditLogEntry({
          action: AuditLogAction.TEMPLATE_CREATED,
          category: AuditLogCategory.TEMPLATE_MANAGEMENT,
          entityId: newTemplate.id,
          entityType: 'custom_document_template',
          entityName: newTemplate.name,
          description: `User created custom template: "${newTemplate.name}"`,
          afterState: { template: newTemplate }
        }).catch(console.error);
        onSuccess(newTemplate);
      }
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to save template:', error);
      toast.error(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to save template'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Sheet open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <SheetContent className='flex w-full max-w-2xl flex-col p-0 font-suisse-intl'>
        <div className='flex h-full flex-col'>
          <SheetHeader className='flex flex-row items-center gap-4 border-b px-4 pb-2 pt-4 text-left'>
            <div className='zyflo-transition flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-solid border-primary/30 bg-primary/10 p-2 hover:border-primary/40 hover:bg-primary/20'>
              <Pencil className='size-5 text-primary' />
            </div>
            <div>
              <SheetTitle className='font-britanica text-2xl font-semibold'>
                {template
                  ? 'organizationId' in template
                    ? `Edit ${template.name}`
                    : `Clone ${template.name}`
                  : 'Create Custom Template'}
              </SheetTitle>
              <SheetDescription className='text-muted-foreground'>
                {template
                  ? 'organizationId' in template
                    ? 'Update the details of this custom template for your organization.'
                    : 'Clone this global template to create a custom version for your organization. You can modify the fields and settings as needed.'
                  : 'Define a new custom document template for your organization.'}
              </SheetDescription>
            </div>
          </SheetHeader>
          <div className='flex-1'>
            <Form {...form}>
              <form
                onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
                className='flex max-h-[80dvh] flex-col gap-4 overflow-y-auto p-4'
                style={{ minHeight: 0 }}
              >
                <div className='flex flex-col gap-4'>
                  <FormField
                    control={form.control}
                    name='name'
                    render={({ field }) => (
                      <FormItem>
                        <FormLabel className='font-medium'>
                          Template Name/Title
                        </FormLabel>
                        <FormControl>
                          <Input
                            placeholder='E.g., Standard NDA Agreement'
                            {...field}
                            className='h-10'
                          />
                        </FormControl>
                        <FormMessage />
                      </FormItem>
                    )}
                  />
                  <FormField
                    control={form.control}
                    name='description'
                    render={({ field }) => (
                      <FormItem>
                        <FormLabel className='font-medium'>
                          Description (Optional)
                        </FormLabel>
                        <FormControl>
                          <Textarea
                            placeholder='A brief description of the template'
                            {...field}
                            className='min-h-[80px]'
                          />
                        </FormControl>
                        <FormMessage />
                      </FormItem>
                    )}
                  />
                  <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2'>
                    <FormField
                      control={form.control}
                      name='category'
                      render={({ field }) => (
                        <FormItem>
                          <FormLabel className='font-medium'>
                            Category
                          </FormLabel>
                          <FormControl>
                            <Select
                              onValueChange={field.onChange}
                              defaultValue={field.value}
                            >
                              <FormControl>
                                <SelectTrigger className='h-10'>
                                  <SelectValue placeholder='Select a category' />
                                </SelectTrigger>
                              </FormControl>
                              <SelectContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
                                {Object.values(IndustryType)
                                  .filter(
                                    (type) =>
                                      type !== IndustryType.NOT_APPLICABLE
                                  )
                                  .map((type) => (
                                    <SelectItem key={type} value={type}>
                                      {type

                                        .replace(/_/gu, ' ')
                                        .replace(/\b\w/gu, (l) =>
                                          l.toUpperCase()

                                    </SelectItem>

                            />
                            <FormField

                                  <FormControl>

                                      value={field.value ?? ''}
                                      onChange={field.onChange}
                                    />
                                  </FormControl>
                                  <FormMessage />
                                </FormItem>
                              )}
                            />
                          )}
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Footer with Submit Button */}
                <SheetFooter className='absolute bottom-0 flex w-full flex-row gap-2 bg-background p-4'>
                  <SheetClose asChild>
                    <Button
                      type='button'
                      variant='outline'
                      className='min-w-[100px]'

                  >
                    {isSubmitting && (

                    )}
                    {template ? 'Clone Template' : 'Create Template'}
                  </Button>
                </SheetFooter>
              </form>
            </Form>
          </div>
        </div>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}
