  CreateTeamMemberActivityLogResponse,
  GetTeamMemberActivityLogsResponse
} from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/team-member-activity-logs';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import { ActivityLogIcon } from '../components/activity-log-icon';
import { ActivityLogDetailsCard } from '../components/activity-log-details-card';
import { ActivityLogFullView } from '../components/activity-log-full-view';
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverTrigger,
  PopoverContent
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/popover';

const formSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(1, 'Team name is required'),
  description: z.string().min(10, {
    message: 'Description is required and must be at least 10 characters long'
  }),
  type: z.string().min(1, 'Type is required'),
  maxMembers: z.number().min(2, 'Maximum members must be at least 2'),
  visibility: z.nativeEnum(Visibility),
  notifications: z.object({
    beforeDeadline: z.array(z.string()),
    onComplete: z.boolean(),
    onStart: z.boolean()
  }),
  configuration: z.object({
    isActive: z.boolean(),
    autoJoin: z.object({
      enabled: z.boolean()
    }),
    security: z
      .object({
        mfaRequired: z.boolean().optional(),
        dataClassification: z.string().optional(),
        sessionTimeout: z.number().optional()
      })
      .optional()
  })
});

type TeamDetailsProps = {
  organizationId: string;
  teamId: string;
  team: CustomTeam & {
    notifications?: {
      beforeDeadline: string[];
      onComplete: boolean;
      onStart: boolean;
    };
    configuration?: {
      isActive: boolean;
      autoJoin: {
        enabled: boolean;
      };
      security?: {
        mfaRequired?: boolean;
        dataClassification?: string;
        sessionTimeout?: number;
      };
    };
  };
  members: (TeamMember & { user: User })[];
  users: User[];
  activityLogs: GetTeamMemberActivityLogsResponse['teamMemberActivityLogs']['database'];
  documents: GetTeamDocumentsResponse['documents']['database'];
  calendarEvents: GetTeamCalendarEventsResponse['events']['database'];
  cookieString: string;
  user: IdTokenClaims;
}

export function getActivityLogMessage(activityType: TeamMemberActivityLogType) {
  switch (activityType) {
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_ADDED:
      return 'Team member added';
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_INVITED:
      return 'Team member invited';
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_JOINED:
      return 'Team member joined';
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_EXPIRED:
      return 'Team member expired';
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_REMOVED:
      return 'Team member removed';
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_ROLE_UPDATED:
      return 'Team member role updated';
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_CREATED:
      return 'Team created';
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_UPDATED:
      return 'Team updated';
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_DELETED:
      return 'Team deleted';
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_BLOCKED:
      return 'Team blocked';
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_SUSPENDED:
      return 'Team suspended';
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_REACTIVATED:
      return 'Team reactivated';
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_ARCHIVED:
      return 'Team archived';
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_UNARCHIVED:
      return 'Team unarchived';
    default:
      return 'Unknown activity';
  }
}

export default function TeamDetails({
  organizationId,
  teamId,
  team,
  members,
  users,
  activityLogs,
  documents,
  calendarEvents,
  cookieString,
  user
}: Readonly<TeamDetailsProps>) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('overview');

  const form = useForm<z.infer<typeof formSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(formSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      name: team.name,
      description: team.description ?? undefined,
      type: team.type,
      maxMembers: team.maxMembers,
      visibility: team.visibility,
      notifications: team.notifications || {
        beforeDeadline: ['24'],
        onComplete: true,
        onStart: true
      },
      configuration: {
        isActive: team.configuration?.isActive ?? true,
        autoJoin: {
          enabled: team.configuration?.autoJoin?.enabled ?? false
        },
        security: {
          mfaRequired: team.configuration?.security?.mfaRequired ?? false,
          dataClassification:
            team.configuration?.security?.dataClassification ?? 'INTERNAL',
          sessionTimeout: team.configuration?.security?.sessionTimeout ?? 3600
        }
      }
    }
  });

  const onSubmit = async (values: z.infer<typeof formSchema>) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${teamId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'PATCH',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(values)
        }
      );

      if (response.ok) {
        toast.success('Team updated successfully');
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        const error = await response.json();
        toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to update team');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to update team');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteTeam = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${teamId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          }
        }
      );

      if (response.ok) {
        toast.success('Team deleted successfully');
        router.push(`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams`);
      } else {
        const error = await response.json();
        toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to delete team');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to delete team');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateMemberRole = async (
    memberId: string,
    role: TeamMemberRole
  ) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    const updatedUser = members.find((member) => member.id === memberId);
    const adminUser = user;
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/members/${memberId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'PATCH',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ role })
        }
      );
      const oldRole = toTitleCase(updatedUser?.role);
      const newRole = toTitleCase(role);
      const teamMemberActivityLog: CreateTeamMemberActivityLogResponse =
        await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-member-activity-logs?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'cookie': cookieString,
              'cookie-string': cookieString,
              'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              activityType: TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_ROLE_UPDATED,
              details: {
                message: `Team member ${updatedUser?.user?.name}'s role was updated by ${adminUser?.name}.`,
                changedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                changedBy: adminUser?.sub,
                oldValues: {
                  role: oldRole
                },
                newValues: {
                  role: newRole
                },
                metadata: {
                  oldRole,
                  newRole
                }
              } as TeamMemberActivityLogDetails,
              metadata: {
                teamId: team.id,
                performedBy: adminUser?.sub,
                usersInvolved: [updatedUser?.userId, adminUser?.sub],
                version: '1.0.0'
              } as TeamMemberActivityLogMetadata,
              performedBy: adminUser?.sub,
              teamId: team.id,
              userId: updatedUser?.userId
            } as Omit<TeamMemberActivityLogInsert, 'id' | 'uid' | 'createdAt'>)
          }
        ).then((res) => res.json());

      if (
        teamMemberActivityLog.message !==
        'Team member activity log created successfully'
      ) {
        clientLogger.warn('Failed to create team member activity log', {
          teamMemberActivityLog
        });
      }

      if (response.ok) {
        toast.success('Member role updated successfully');
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        const error = await response.json();
        toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to update member role');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to update member role');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveMember = async (memberId: string) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    const removedUser = members.find((member) => member.id === memberId);
    const adminUser = user;
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/members/${memberId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          }
        }
      );

      const teamMemberActivityLog: CreateTeamMemberActivityLogResponse =
        await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-member-activity-logs?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'cookie': cookieString,
              'cookie-string': cookieString,
              'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              activityType: TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_REMOVED,
              details: {
                message: `Team member ${removedUser?.user?.name} was removed by ${adminUser?.name} on ${formatDate(new Date(), 'PPPPpppp')}`,
                changedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                changedBy: adminUser?.sub,
                oldValues: {},
                newValues: {},
                metadata: undefined
              } as TeamMemberActivityLogDetails,
              metadata: {
                metadata: {},
                teamId: team.id,
                performedBy: adminUser?.sub,
                usersInvolved: [removedUser?.userId, adminUser?.sub],
                version: '1.0.0'
              } as TeamMemberActivityLogMetadata,
              performedBy: adminUser?.sub,
              teamId: team.id,
              userId: removedUser?.userId
            } as Omit<TeamMemberActivityLogInsert, 'id' | 'uid' | 'createdAt'>)
          }
        ).then((res) => res.json());

      if (
        teamMemberActivityLog.message !==
        'Team member activity log created successfully'
      ) {
        clientLogger.warn('Failed to create team member activity log', {
          teamMemberActivityLog
        });
      }

      if (response.ok) {
        toast.success(`${removedUser?.user?.name} removed successfully`);
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        const error = await response.json();
        toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to remove member');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to remove member');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const getRoleBadgeVariant = (role: TeamMemberRole) => {
    switch (role) {
      case TeamMemberRole.OWNER:
        return 'default';
      case TeamMemberRole.ADMIN:
        return 'destructive';
      case TeamMemberRole.MEMBER:
        return 'secondary';
      case TeamMemberRole.GUEST:
        return 'outline';
      default:
        return 'secondary';
    }
  };

  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <div className='mb-8 flex items-center justify-between'>
        <Link href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams`}>
          <Button variant='outline' className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'>
            <ChevronLeft className='h-4 w-4' />
            Back to Teams
          </Button>
        </Link>

        <AlertDialog>
          <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
            <Button
              variant='destructive'
              className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
            >
              <Trash className='h-4 w-4' />
              Delete Team
            </Button>
          </AlertDialogTrigger>
          <AlertDialogContent>
            <AlertDialogHeader>
              <AlertDialogTitle>Are you sure?</AlertDialogTitle>
              <AlertDialogDescription>
                This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete the
                team and remove all team memberships.
              </AlertDialogDescription>
            </AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogFooter>
              <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
              <AlertDialogAction
                className='inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-destructive hover:bg-destructive/90'
                onClick={handleDeleteTeam}
              >
                {isLoading ? (
                  <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
                ) : (
                  <Trash2 className='size-4' />
                )}
                {isLoading ? 'Deleting...' : 'Delete Team'}
              </AlertDialogAction>
            </AlertDialogFooter>
          </AlertDialogContent>
        </AlertDialog>
      </div>

      <div className='space-y-8'>
        <div>
          <h1 className='font-signvault text-3xl font-bold'>{team.name}</h1>
          <p className='mt-2 text-muted-foreground'>{team.description}</p>
        </div>

        <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab}>
          <TabsList>
            <TabsTrigger value='overview' className='flex items-center gap-2'>
              <Users className='h-4 w-4' />
              Overview
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value='activity' className='flex items-center gap-2'>
              <Activity className='h-4 w-4' />
              Activity
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value='documents' className='flex items-center gap-2'>
              <File className='h-4 w-4' />
              Documents
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value='calendar' className='flex items-center gap-2'>
              <Calendar className='h-4 w-4' />
              Calendar
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value='settings' className='flex items-center gap-2'>
              <Settings className='h-4 w-4' />
              Settings
            </TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>

          <TabsContent value='overview' className='space-y-6'>
            <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2'>
              <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle>Members</CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription>
                    {members.length} of {team.maxMembers} members
                  </CardDescription>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <ScrollArea className='h-[400px]'>
                    <div className='space-y-4'>
                      {members.map((member) => (
                        <div
                          key={member.id}
                          className='flex items-center justify-between rounded-md border p-2'
                        >
                          <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                            <Avatar className='h-8 w-8'>
                              <AvatarImage
                                src={member.user?.avatar}
                                alt={member.user?.name}
                              />
                              <AvatarFallback>
                                {member.user?.name?.charAt(0)}
                              </AvatarFallback>
                            </Avatar>
                            <div>
                              <p className='text-sm font-medium'>
                                {member.user.name}
                              </p>
                              <Badge
                                variant={getRoleBadgeVariant(member.role)}
                                className='mt-1'
                              >
                                {toTitleCase(member.role)}
                              </Badge>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                            {member.role !== TeamMemberRole.OWNER && (
                              <>
                                <Select
                                  value={member.role}
                                  onValueChange={(value) =>
                                    handleUpdateMemberRole(
                                      member.id,
                                      value as TeamMemberRole
                                    )
                                  }
                                >
                                  <SelectTrigger className='w-[120px]'>
                                    <SelectValue placeholder='Select role' />
                                  </SelectTrigger>
                                  <SelectContent>
                                    {Object.values(TeamMemberRole)
                                      .filter(
                                        (role) => role !== TeamMemberRole.OWNER
                                      )
                                      .map((role) => (
                                        <SelectItem key={role} value={role}>
                                          {toTitleCase(role)}
                                        </SelectItem>
                                      ))}
                                  </SelectContent>
                                </Select>
                                <AlertDialog>
                                  <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
                                    <Button variant='ghost' size='icon'>
                                      <Trash className='h-4 w-4' />
                                    </Button>
                                  </AlertDialogTrigger>
                                  <AlertDialogContent>
                                    <AlertDialogHeader>
                                      <AlertDialogTitle>
                                        Are you sure?
                                      </AlertDialogTitle>
                                      <AlertDialogDescription>
                                        This action cannot be undone. This will
                                        remove{' '}
                                        <strong>{member.user.name}</strong> from
                                        the team. You can add them back later.
                                      </AlertDialogDescription>
                                    </AlertDialogHeader>
                                    <AlertDialogFooter>
                                      <AlertDialogCancel>
                                        Cancel
                                      </AlertDialogCancel>
                                      <AlertDialogAction
                                        className='inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-destructive hover:bg-destructive/90'
                                        onClick={() =>
                                          handleRemoveMember(member.id)
                                        }
                                      >
                                        {isLoading ? (
                                          <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
                                        ) : (
                                          <Trash2 className='size-4' />
                                        )}
                                        {isLoading
                                          ? `Removing ${member.user.name}...`
                                          : `Remove ${member.user.name}`}
                                      </AlertDialogAction>
                                    </AlertDialogFooter>
                                  </AlertDialogContent>
                                </AlertDialog>
                              </>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </ScrollArea>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>

              <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle>Recent Activity</CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription>
                    Last {activityLogs.length} activities
                  </CardDescription>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <ScrollArea className='h-[400px]'>
                    <div className='space-y-4'>
                      {activityLogs
                        .toSorted(
                          (a, b) =>
                            new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() -
                            new Date(a.createdAt).getTime()
                        )
                        .map((log) => (
                          <div
                            key={log.id}
                            className='flex items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-md border p-2'
                          >
                            <div className='flex items-center gap-4'>
                              <div className='flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-border bg-foreground/2 p-2 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:bg-foreground/4'>
                                <ActivityLogIcon
                                  type={log.activityType}
                                  className='size-6 min-h-6 min-w-6'
                                  strokeWidth={1.4}
                                />
                              </div>
                              <div>
                                <p className='text-sm'>
                                  {getActivityLogMessage(log.activityType)}
                                </p>
                                <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                                  {formatDistanceToNow(
                                    new Date(log.createdAt),
                                    {
                                      addSuffix: true
                                    }
                                  )}
                                </p>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <Popover>
                              <PopoverTrigger asChild>
                                <Button
                                  variant='outline'
                                  className='inline-flex items-center justify-center'
                                  size='icon'
                                >
                                  <MoreVertical className='h-4 w-4' />
                                </Button>
                              </PopoverTrigger>
                              <PopoverContent className='h-auto max-h-[500px] w-[400px] overflow-y-auto'>
                                <ActivityLogDetailsCard
                                  log={log}
                                  users={users}
                                />
                              </PopoverContent>
                            </Popover>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                  </ScrollArea>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>

              <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle>Quick Actions</CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription>Common team actions</CardDescription>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent className='flex flex-col gap-4'>
                  <Link
                    href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}/documents`}
                  >
                    <div className='flex items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-md border p-2'>
                      <div className='flex items-center gap-4'>
                        <div className='flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-border bg-foreground/2 p-2 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:bg-foreground/4'>
                          <File className='size-6 min-h-6 min-w-6' />
                        </div>
                        <p className='text-foreground/90'>View Documents</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Link>
                  <Link
                    href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}/calendar`}
                  >
                    <div className='flex items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-md border p-2'>
                      <div className='flex items-center gap-4'>
                        <div className='flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-border bg-foreground/2 p-2 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:bg-foreground/4'>
                          <Calendar className='size-6 min-h-6 min-w-6' />
                        </div>
                        <p className='text-foreground/90'>View Calendar</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Link>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            </div>
          </TabsContent>

          <TabsContent value='activity' className='space-y-6'>
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle>Activity Log</CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>
                  Track all team activities and changes
                </CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <ScrollArea className='h-[600px]'>
                  <div className='space-y-6'>
                    {activityLogs
                      .toSorted(
                        (a, b) =>
                          new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() -
                          new Date(a.createdAt).getTime()
                      )
                      .map((log) => (
                        <ActivityLogFullView
                          key={log.id}
                          log={log}
                          users={users}
                        />
                      ))}
                  </div>
                </ScrollArea>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </TabsContent>

          <TabsContent value='documents' className='space-y-6'>
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle>Team Documents</CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>
                  Manage and access team documents
                </CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <ScrollArea className='h-[600px]'>
                  <div className='space-y-4'>
                    {documents.map((doc) => (
                      <div
                        key={doc.id}
                        className='flex items-start gap-4 rounded-md border p-4'
                      >
                        <File className='mt-1 h-4 w-4' />
                        <div>
                          <p className='font-medium'>{doc.name}</p>
                          <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                            {doc.description}
                          </p>
                          <p className='mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                            Last updated{' '}
                            {formatDistanceToNow(new Date(doc.updatedAt), {
                              addSuffix: true
                            })}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </ScrollArea>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </TabsContent>

          <TabsContent value='calendar' className='space-y-6'>
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle>Team Calendar</CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>View and manage team events</CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <ScrollArea className='h-[600px]'>
                  <div className='space-y-4'>
                    {calendarEvents.map((event) => (
                      <div
                        key={event.id}
                        className='flex items-start gap-4 rounded-md border p-4'
                      >
                        <Calendar className='mt-1 h-4 w-4' />
                        <div>
                          <p className='font-medium'>{event.title}</p>
                          <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                            {event.description}
                          </p>
                          <p className='mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                            {new Date(event.startDate).toLocaleString()} -{' '}
                            {new Date(event.endDate).toLocaleString()}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </ScrollArea>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </TabsContent>

          <TabsContent value='settings' className='space-y-6'>
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle>Team Settings</CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>
                  Manage team configuration and preferences
                </CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <Form {...form}>
                  <form
                    onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
                    className='space-y-8'
                  >
                    <FormField
                      control={form.control}
                      name='name'
                      render={({ field }) => (
                        <FormItem>
                          <FormLabel>Team Name</FormLabel>
                          <FormControl>
                            <Input {...field} />
                          </FormControl>
                          <FormMessage />
                        </FormItem>
                      )}
                    />

                    <FormField
                      control={form.control}
                      name='description'
                      render={({ field }) => (
                        <FormItem>
                          <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
                          <FormControl>
                            <Textarea {...field} />
                          </FormControl>
                          <FormMessage />
                        </FormItem>
                      )}
                    />

                    <FormField
                      control={form.control}
                      name='maxMembers'
                      render={({ field }) => (
                        <FormItem>
                          <FormLabel>Maximum Members</FormLabel>
                          <FormControl>
                            <Input
                              type='number'
                              {...field}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                field.onChange(parseInt(e.target.value))
                              }
                            />
                          </FormControl>
                          <FormMessage />
                        </FormItem>
                      )}
                    />

                                  <SelectItem

                                    value={visibility}

                                    {toTitleCase(visibility)}
                                  </SelectItem>
                                ))}
                              </SelectContent>
                            </Select>
                          </FormControl>
                          <FormMessage />
                        </FormItem>
                      )}

                              checked={field.value}
                              onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                            />
                          </FormControl>
                          <FormLabel>Team is active</FormLabel>
                          <FormMessage />
                        </FormItem>
                      )}
                    />

                    <FormField
                      control={form.control}
                      name='configuration.autoJoin.enabled'
                      render={({ field }) => (
                        <FormItem className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                          <FormControl>
                            <Checkbox

                              onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                            />
                          </FormControl>
                          <FormLabel>Allow auto-join</FormLabel>
                          <FormMessage />
                        </FormItem>
                      )}
                    />

                      {isLoading ? (
                        <>
                          <Loader2 className='mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
                          Saving...
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        'Save Changes'
                      )}
                    </Button>
                  </form>
                </Form>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      </div>
    </React.Fragment>
  );
}

type UsersTableHeaderProps = {
  isAdmin: boolean;
  organizationId: string;
};

// Function to get the initial state for Formity
function getInitialState(): State | undefined {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window?.localStorage) return undefined;
  const state = localStorage.getItem('invite-users-form-state');
  if (state) return JSON.parse(state);
  return undefined;
}

export const UsersTableHeader: React.FC<UsersTableHeaderProps> = ({
  isAdmin,
  organizationId
}) => {
  const [isInviteUsersSheetOpen, setIsInviteUsersSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isInviteUsersLoading, setIsInviteUsersLoading] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  // Add query to fetch active teams
  const { data: activeTeams, isLoading: activeTeamsLoading } =
    useActiveTeams(organizationId);

  const onReturn = useCallback<OnReturn<InviteUsersValues>>(
    async (formValues) => {
      setIsInviteUsersLoading(true);
      // Verify member configuration before proceeding
      const result = await verifyMemberConfiguration(
        formValues.invites.map((invite) => ({
          ...invite,
          team: activeTeams
            ?.find((team) => team.name === invite.activeTeamId)
            ?.id.toString()
        })),
        undefined,
        organizationId
      );

      if (!result.success) {
        toast.error('Please fix member configuration issues before proceeding');
        return;
      }

      try {
        // Call the invite-users endpoint
        const data = await inviteUsers(
          formValues.invites.map((invite) => ({
            ...invite,
            activeTeamId: activeTeams
              ?.find((team) => team.name === invite.activeTeamId)
              ?.id.toString()
          })),
          organizationId
        );

        if (data.message !== 'Users invited successfully') {
          toast.error(`Failed to invite users: ${data.message}`);
          return;
        }

        toast.success(
          `Successfully invited ${data.invites.database.length} user${data.invites.database.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
        );
        setIsInviteUsersSheetOpen(false);
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({
          queryKey: ['organizationPendingUsers']
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error inviting users:', error);
        toast.error('Failed to invite users');
      } finally {
        setIsInviteUsersLoading(false);
        localStorage.removeItem('invite-users-form-state');
      }
    },
    [router, organizationId, activeTeams]
  );

  const hasActiveTeams =
    !activeTeamsLoading && activeTeams && activeTeams.length > 0;

  return (
    <Sheet
      onOpenChange={setIsInviteUsersSheetOpen}
      open={isInviteUsersSheetOpen}
    >
      <SheetTitle hidden>Invite Users</SheetTitle>
      <SheetDescription hidden>
        Invite users to your organization
      </SheetDescription>
      <SheetContent className='w-full overflow-y-auto font-suisse-intl xs:w-[480px] sm:w-[540px]'>
        <Formity<InviteUsersValues>
          initialState={getInitialState()}
          onReturn={onReturn}
          params={{
            isLoading: isInviteUsersLoading,
            activeTeams: activeTeams || [] // Pass active teams to the form
          }}
          schema={getSchema(organizationId, true)}
        />
      </SheetContent>
      <PageHeader
        heading='Users'
        rightElement={
          isAdmin ? (
            <TooltipProvider>
              <Tooltip>
                <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                  <div>
                    <Button
                      asChild
                      className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
                      disabled={!hasActiveTeams}
                      size='sm'
                      variant='default'
                    >
                      <SheetTrigger disabled={!hasActiveTeams}>
                        <Plus className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
                        Invite Users
                      </SheetTrigger>
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </TooltipTrigger>
                {!hasActiveTeams && (
                  <TooltipContent>
                    <p>
                      No active teams found. Please create an active team before
                      inviting users
                    </p>
                  </TooltipContent>
                )}
              </Tooltip>
            </TooltipProvider>
          ) : null
        }
        subheading={`View ${isAdmin ? 'and manage' : ''} all users in your organization`}
      />
    </Sheet>
  );
};

/**
 * Sanitizes HTML.
 * @param html - The HTML to sanitize.
 * @returns The sanitized HTML.
 */
export function htmlSanitize(html: string) {
  return sanitizeHtml(html, {
    allowedTags: sanitizeHtml.defaults.allowedTags
      .filter((elem) => elem !== 'br')
      .concat(['img', 'a']),
    allowedAttributes: {
      'a': ['href', 'name', 'target'],
      'img': ['src', 'srcset', 'alt', 'title', 'width', 'height', 'loading'],
      '*': ['src']
    },
    allowedSchemes: ['data', 'http', 'https'],
    allowedClasses: {},
    allowedStyles: {},
    disallowedTagsMode: 'discard',
    parseStyleAttributes: false,
    allowProtocolRelative: false
  });
}

/**
 * Gets the URL with query parameters.
 * @param baseUrl - The base URL.
 * @param params - The query parameters.
 * @returns The URL with query parameters.
 */
export const getURLWithQueryParams = (
  baseUrl: string,
  params: Record<string, unknown>
) => {
  const query = Object.entries(params)
    .map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${encodeURIComponent(String(value))}`)
    .join('&');

  return `${baseUrl}?${query}`;
};

/**
 * The toast key map.
 */
const toastKeyMap: { [key: string]: string[] } = {
  status: ['status', 'status_description'],
  error: ['error', 'error_description']
};

/**
 * Gets the toast redirect.
 * @param path - The path.
 * @param toastType - The toast type.
 * @param toastName - The toast name.
 * @param toastDescription - The toast description.
 * @param disableButton - Whether the button is disabled.
 * @param arbitraryParams - The arbitrary parameters.
 * @returns The toast redirect.
 */
export const getToastRedirect = (
  path: string,
  toastType: string,
  toastName: string,
  toastDescription: string = '',
  disableButton: boolean = false,
  arbitraryParams: string = ''
): string => {
  const [nameKey, descriptionKey] = toastKeyMap[toastType] ?? ['', ''];

  let redirectPath = `${path}?${nameKey}=${encodeURIComponent(toastName)}`;

  if (toastDescription) {
    redirectPath += `&${descriptionKey}=${encodeURIComponent(toastDescription)}`;
  }

  if (disableButton) {
    redirectPath += `&disable_button=true`;
  }

  if (arbitraryParams) {
    redirectPath += `&${arbitraryParams}`;
  }

  return redirectPath;
};

 * Gets the status redirect.

 * @param statusName - The status name.

 * @returns The status redirect.
 */
export const getStatusRedirect = (
  path: string,
  statusName: string,
  statusDescription: string = '',
  disableButton: boolean = false,
  arbitraryParams: string = ''
): string =>

    statusName,

    disableButton,
    arbitraryParams
  );

  );

/**
 * Extracts the error message from the HTML.
 * @param html - The HTML.
 * @returns The error message.
 */
export function extractErrorMessage(html: string): string | null {
  // Create a regex to match the content between the <pre> and the first <br> tag
  const preTagContentRegex = /<pre>(.*?)<br>/u;

  // Apply the regex on the HTML string
  const match = preTagContentRegex.exec(html);

  // If we find a match, return the error message (without extra whitespaces)
  if (match[1]) {
    return match[1].trim();
  }

  // If no match, return null
  return null;
}

/**
 * Checks if a user has permission to remove an organization user.
 * @param currentUser - The current user.
 * @param targetUser - The target user.
 * @returns Whether the user has permission to remove the organization user.
 */
export function hasPermissionToRemoveOrganizationUser(
  currentUser: {
    id: string;
    organizationRoles: { id: string; name: string }[];
  },
  targetUser: {
    id: string;
    organizationRoles: { id: string; name: string }[];
  }
): boolean {
  // Cannot remove self
  if (currentUser.id === targetUser.id) {
    return false;
  }

  const currentUserRole = currentUser.organizationRoles[0]?.id;
  const targetUserRole = targetUser.organizationRoles[0]?.id;

  // Get role definitions from ROLES
  const currentUserRoleInfo = Object.values(ROLES).find(
    (role) => role.id === currentUserRole
  );
  const targetUserRoleInfo = Object.values(ROLES).find(
    (role) => role.id === targetUserRole
  );

  if (!currentUserRoleInfo || !targetUserRoleInfo) {
    return false;
  }

  // Super admin rules
  if (currentUserRoleInfo.id === ROLES.SUPER_ADMIN.id) {
    // Super admin can remove anyone except other super admins
    return targetUserRoleInfo.id !== ROLES.SUPER_ADMIN.id;
  }

  // L5 user rules
  if (currentUserRoleInfo.id === ROLES.L5_USER.id) {
    // L5 users cannot remove super admins or other L5 users
    return !(
      [
        ROLES.SUPER_ADMIN.id,
        ROLES.L5_USER.id,
        ROLES.L6_USER.id
      ] as OrganizationRoleId[]
    ).includes(targetUserRoleInfo.id);
  }

  // All other roles cannot remove users
  return false;
}

/**
 * Converts a string to title case.
 * @param value - The string to convert.
 * @returns The title cased string.
 */
export const toTitleCase = (value: string) => {
  return value
    .split(' ')
    .map((word) => {
      // Keep HR as uppercase
      if (word.toLowerCase() === 'hr') {
        return 'HR';
      }
      return word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1).toLowerCase();
    })
    .join(' ');
};

/**
 * Converts a camelCase string to title case.
 * @param value - The camelCase string to convert.
 * @returns The title cased string.
 */
export const camelCaseToTitleCase = (value: string) => {
  return (
    value
      // Insert a space before any capital letter that follows a lowercase letter
      .replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/gu, '$1 $2')
      // Split into words and capitalize first letter of each
      .split(' ')
      .map((word) => {
        if (word.toLowerCase() === 'hr') {
          return 'HR';
        }
        if (word.toLowerCase() === 'id') {
          return 'ID';
        }
        return word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1).toLowerCase();
      })
      .join(' ')
  );
};

/**
 * Gets the source system config.
 * @param config - The config.
 * @returns The source system config.
 */
export const getSourceSystemConfig = (config: unknown) => {
  if (typeof config !== 'object' || config === null) {
    throw new Error('Invalid config: config must be a non-null object');
  }

  const requiredProperties = [
    'source_system_name',
    'source_system_type',
    'source_system_description'
  ];

  const configData = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(config));

  if (
    !requiredProperties.every(
      (property) => typeof configData[property] === 'string'
    )
  ) {
    const missingProperties = requiredProperties.filter(
      (property) => !(property in configData)
    );
    // create null properties
    missingProperties.forEach((property) => {
      configData[property] = null;
    });
  }

  return {
    ...configData,
    name: configData.source_system_name,
    type: configData.source_system_type,
    description: configData.source_system_description
  };
};

/**
 * Gets the organization source system config.
 * @param config - The config.
 * @returns The organization source system config.
 */
export const getOrganizationSourceSystemConfig = (config: unknown) => {
  if (typeof config !== 'object' || config === null) {
    throw new Error('Invalid config: config must be a non-null object');
  }

  const requiredProperties = [
    'source_system_id',
    'organization_id',
    'visibility',
    'data_provenance_id',
    'source_system_name',
    'source_system_type',
    'source_system_description',
    'name',
    'type',
    'description'
  ];

  const configData = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(config));

  if (
    !requiredProperties.every(
      (property) => typeof configData[property] === 'string'
    )
  ) {
    // calculate missing properties
    const missingProperties = requiredProperties.filter(
      (property) => !(property in configData)
    );
    // create null properties
    missingProperties.forEach((property) => {
      configData[property] = null;
    });
  }
  return {
    ...configData,
    name: configData.name,
    type: configData.type,
    description: configData.description,
    sourceSystemId: configData.source_system_id,
    organizationId: configData.organization_id,
    visibility: configData.visibility,
    dataProvenanceId: configData.data_provenance_id,
    sourceSystemDescription: configData.source_system_description,
    sourceSystemName: configData.source_system_name,
    sourceSystemType: configData.source_system_type
  };
};

/**
 * Gets the metadata from the content.
 * @param metadata - The metadata.
 * @returns The metadata.
 */
export const getMetadataFromContent = (metadata: unknown) => {
  if (typeof metadata !== 'object' || metadata === null) {
    throw new Error('Invalid metadata: metadata must be a non-null object');
  }
  const metadataData = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(metadata));
  if (
    typeof metadataData.source_system_name !== 'string' ||
    typeof metadataData.source_system_type !== 'string' ||
    typeof metadataData.source_system_description !== 'string'
  ) {
    throw new Error('Invalid metadata: missing required properties');
  }
  return {
    ...metadataData,
    sourceSystemName: metadataData.source_system_name,
    sourceSystemType: metadataData.source_system_type,
    sourceSystemDescription: metadataData.source_system_description
  };
};

export class NanoIdConverter {
  /**
   * Converts a NanoID to a UUID v4
   * Maintains randomness by using the NanoID as a seed for deterministic UUID generation
   * @param nanoId - The NanoID to convert
   * @returns The UUID v4 string
   */
  static toUUID(nanoId: string): string {
    if (!nanoId || typeof nanoId !== 'string' || nanoId.length !== 21) {
      throw new Error('Invalid NanoID format');
    }

    // Create a deterministic hash using crypto-js
    const hash = SHA256(nanoId).toString(Hex);

    // Take first 32 characters (16 bytes) of hash
    const hexString = hash.slice(0, 32);

    // Convert to byte array simulation
    const bytes: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 32; i += 2) {
      bytes.push(parseInt(hexString.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
    }

    // Set version bits for UUID v4
    bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40; // Version 4
    bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80; // Variant 1

    // Convert back to hex strings
    const byteHex = bytes.map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'));

    // Format as UUID
    return [
      byteHex.slice(0, 4).join(''),
      byteHex.slice(4, 6).join(''),
      byteHex.slice(6, 8).join(''),
      byteHex.slice(8, 10).join(''),
      byteHex.slice(10, 16).join('')
    ].join('-');
  }

  /**
   * Validates if a given string is a valid UUID v4
   * @param uuid The UUID to validate
   * @returns boolean indicating if this is a valid UUID v4
   */
  static isValidUUID(uuid: string): boolean {
    try {
      return validateUUID(uuid);
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Generate a lookup key for storing the mapping
   * @param id Either a NanoID or UUID
   * @returns A consistent hash key
   */
  static generateLookupKey(id: string): string {
    return SHA256(id).toString(Hex);
  }
}

/**
 * Optional: Cache manager for ID mappings
 * Useful if you need to store/retrieve mappings frequently
 */
export class IdMappingCache {
  private static readonly cache = new Map<string, string>();
  private static readonly MAX_CACHE_SIZE = 10000;

  static set(nanoId: string, uuid: string): void {
    if (this.cache.size >= this.MAX_CACHE_SIZE) {
      // Clear half of the cache when it gets too large
      const entries = Array.from(this.cache.entries());
      entries.slice(0, this.MAX_CACHE_SIZE / 2).forEach(([key]) => {
        this.cache.delete(key);
      });
    }

    const key = NanoIdConverter.generateLookupKey(nanoId);
    this.cache.set(key, uuid);
  }

  static get(nanoId: string): string | undefined {
    const key = NanoIdConverter.generateLookupKey(nanoId);
    return this.cache.get(key);
  }
}

/**
 * The short ID converter.
 */
export class ShortIdConverter {
  /**
   * Converts a short NanoID (12 chars) to a UUID v4
   * Maintains randomness by using the NanoID as a seed for deterministic UUID generation
   * @param shortId The short NanoID to convert (12 characters)
   * @returns UUID v4 string
   */
  static toUUID(shortId: string): string {
    if (!shortId || typeof shortId !== 'string' || shortId.length !== 12) {
      throw new Error('Invalid short ID format - must be 12 characters');
    }

    // Pad the short ID with a consistent suffix to maintain uniqueness
    const paddedId = shortId + '123456789'; // Padding to reach similar entropy

    // Create a deterministic hash using crypto-js
    const hash = SHA256(paddedId).toString(Hex);

    // Take first 32 characters (16 bytes) of hash
    const hexString = hash.slice(0, 32);

    // Convert to byte array simulation
    const bytes: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 32; i += 2) {
      bytes.push(parseInt(hexString.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
    }

    // Set version bits for UUID v4
    bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40; // Version 4
    bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80; // Variant 1

    // Convert back to hex strings
    const byteHex = bytes.map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'));

    // Format as UUID
    return [
      byteHex.slice(0, 4).join(''),
      byteHex.slice(4, 6).join(''),
      byteHex.slice(6, 8).join(''),
      byteHex.slice(8, 10).join(''),
      byteHex.slice(10, 16).join('')
    ].join('-');
  }

  /**
   * Validates if a given string is a valid short ID
   * @param shortId The short ID to validate
   * @returns boolean indicating if this is a valid short ID
   */
  static isValidShortId(shortId: string): boolean {
    return Boolean(
      shortId &&
        typeof shortId === 'string' &&
        shortId.length === 12 &&
        /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/u.test(shortId) // Validates against standard NanoID alphabet
    );
  }

  /**
   * Generate a lookup key for storing the mapping
   * @param id Either a short ID or UUID
   * @returns A consistent hash key
   */
  static generateLookupKey(id: string): string {
    return SHA256(id).toString(Hex);
  }
}

/**
 * Optional: Cache manager for short ID mappings
 * Useful if you need to store/retrieve mappings frequently
 */
export class ShortIdMappingCache {
  private static readonly cache = new Map<string, string>();
  private static readonly MAX_CACHE_SIZE = 10000;

  static set(shortId: string, uuid: string): void {
    if (this.cache.size >= this.MAX_CACHE_SIZE) {
      // Clear half of the cache when it gets too large
      const entries = Array.from(this.cache.entries());
      entries.slice(0, this.MAX_CACHE_SIZE / 2).forEach(([key]) => {
        this.cache.delete(key);
      });
    }

    const key = ShortIdConverter.generateLookupKey(shortId);
    this.cache.set(key, uuid);
  }

  static get(shortId: string): string | undefined {
    const key = ShortIdConverter.generateLookupKey(shortId);
    return this.cache.get(key);
  }
}

 * Gets a random UUID.
 * @returns The random UUID.

export function getRandomUUID() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return cryptoServer.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
  }
  return crypto.randomUUID();
}

/**
 * Calculates the Levenshtein distance between two strings.
 * @param str1 - The first string.
 * @param str2 - The second string.
 * @returns The Levenshtein distance.
 */
export function levenshteinDistance(str1: string, str2: string): number {
  const track = Array(str2.length + 1)
    .fill(null)
    .map(() => Array(str1.length + 1).fill(null));

  for (let i = 0; i <= str1.length; i += 1) {
    track[0][i] = i;
  }
  for (let j = 0; j <= str2.length; j += 1) {
    track[j][0] = j;
  }

  for (let j = 1; j <= str2.length; j += 1) {
    for (let i = 1; i <= str1.length; i += 1) {
      const indicator = str1[i - 1] === str2[j - 1] ? 0 : 1;
      track[j][i] = Math.min(
        track[j][i - 1] + 1, // deletion
        track[j - 1][i] + 1, // insertion
        track[j - 1][i - 1] + indicator // substitution
      );
    }
  }

  return track[str2.length][str1.length];
}

/**
 * Converts an object array to a cookie string.
 * @param data - The data to convert.
 * @returns The cookie string.
 */
export function objectArrayToCookieString(data: unknown): string {
  if (data instanceof Map) {
    return Array.from(data.values())
      .map((value) => {
        return `${value.name}=${encodeURIComponent(value.value)}`;
      })
      .join('; ');
  } else if (Array.isArray(data)) {
    return data
      .map((value) => {
        if (
          Array.isArray(value) &&
          value.length === 2 &&
          typeof value[1] === 'object'
        ) {
          return `${value[1].name}=${encodeURIComponent(value[1].value)}`;
        }
        return `${value.name}=${encodeURIComponent(value.value)}`;
      })
      .join('; ');
  } else {
    return (data as { name: string; value: unknown }[])
      .map(({ name, value }) => {
        return `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(String(value))}`;
      })
      .join('; ');
  }
}

/**
 * Replaces empty paragraphs with <br/> tags in the given HTML string.
 * @param htmlString - The HTML string to replace empty paragraphs with <br/> tags.
 * @returns The HTML string with empty paragraphs replaced with <br/> tags.

export function replaceEmptyParagraphsWithBr(htmlString: string) {
  return htmlString
    .replace(/<p>\s*<\/p>/gu, '<br/>')
    .replace(/<br>/gu, '<br/>');
}

/**
 * Converts a cookie store or a cookie store parsed to a Map or an Array with name and value properties to a cookie string
 * @param cookieStore - The cookie store to convert (ReadonlyRequestCookies or Map or Array with name and value properties)
 * @returns The cookie string
 */
export const getCookieStringFromCookieStore = (
  cookieStore:
    | ReadonlyRequestCookies
    | Map<string, { name: string; value: string }>
    | { name: string; value: string }[]
) => {
  // case when cookieStore['_parsed'] is passed as a Map
  if (cookieStore instanceof Map || Array.isArray(cookieStore)) {
    return objectArrayToCookieString(cookieStore);
  }
  // case when cookieStore is a ReadonlyRequestCookies object
  let cookieString = cookieStore.toString();
  if (cookieString.includes('[object Object]')) {
    cookieString = objectArrayToCookieString(cookieStore);
  }
  return cookieString;
};

/**
 * Type for the cookies store
 */
export type CookiesStore =
  | ReadonlyRequestCookies
  | Map<string, { name: string; value: string }>
  | { name: string; value: string }[];

export async function checkIfUserHasAccessToOrganization(
  userId: string,
  organizationId: string,
  cookieString: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  const userOrganizationsResponse: GetUserOrganizationsResponse_O = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/user/${userId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (
    userOrganizationsResponse.message !== 'Organizations retrieved successfully'
  ) {
    redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}`,
        'Organization Access Check Failed',
        'Failed to verify organization access. Please try again later.'
      )
    );
  }

  const inLogto = userOrganizationsResponse.organizations.logto.some(
    (org) => org.id === organizationId
  );
  const inDatabase = userOrganizationsResponse.organizations.database.some(
    (org) => org.id === organizationId
  );

  return inLogto || inDatabase;
}

}

/**
 * Merges users by their common ID.
 * @param users - The users to merge.
 * @returns The merged users.
 */
export function mergeUsersByCommonId<T extends { id: string }>(
  users: T[]
): T[] {
  const mergedMap = users.reduce((acc, user) => {
    if (!acc.has(user.id)) {
      acc.set(user.id, {} as T);
    }
    acc.set(user.id, { ...acc.get(user.id), ...user });
    return acc;
  }, new Map<string, T>());

  return Array.from(mergedMap.values());
}

/**
 * Validates if a user is the creator of a calendar event.
 * @param userId - The user's ID
 * @param eventId - The event ID
 * @param organizationId - The organization ID
 * @param cookieString - The cookie string for authentication
 * @returns A redirect response if validation fails, undefined if successful
 */
export async function validateCalendarEventCreator(
  userId: string,
  eventId: string,
  organizationId: string,
  teamId: string,
  cookieString: string
) {
  // 1. Fetch the event details to check creator and attendees
  const eventResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-calendar-events/event/${eventId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (eventResponse.message !== 'Team calendar event retrieved successfully') {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}/events`,
        'Event Not Found',
        'The requested event could not be found.'
      )
    );
  }

  const event = eventResponse.event.database;

  // 2. Check if user is the creator
  const isCreator = event.createdBy === userId;

  // 3. If not creator, check if user is an attendee
  const isAttendee = event.attendees?.some(
    (attendee) => attendee.userId === userId
  );

  if (!isCreator && !isAttendee) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${event.organizationId}/teams/${event.teamId}`,
        'Not Authorized',
        'You are not authorized to access this event.'
      )
    );
  }

  // 4. If not creator, check if user has admin role in organization
  if (!isCreator) {
    const userRolesResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-roles/${event.organizationId}/users/${userId}/roles`,
      {
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString
        }
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());

    if (
      userRolesResponse.message !== 'Organization roles retrieved successfully'
    ) {
      return redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          `/account/organizations/${event.organizationId}/teams/${event.teamId}`,
          'Role Check Failed',
          'Failed to verify user roles. Please try again later.'
        )
      );
    }

    const isAdmin = userRolesResponse.roles.some(
      (role) =>
        role.id === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
        role.id === ROLES.L6_USER.id ||
        role.id === ROLES.SUPER_ADMIN.id
    );

    if (!isAdmin) {
      return redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          `/account/organizations/${event.organizationId}/teams/${event.teamId}/events/${eventId}`,
          'Not Authorized',
          'You are not authorized to manage this event.'
        )
      );
    }
  }

  return undefined;
}

/**
 * Validates if a user has access to an organization and has the required role
 * @param userId - The user's ID
 * @param organizationId - The organization ID to validate against
 * @param requiredRoleId - The role ID required for access
 * @param cookieString - The cookie string for authentication
 * @param redirectPath - The path to redirect to on error
 * @returns A redirect response if validation fails, undefined if successful
 */
export async function validateOrganizationAccess(
  userId: string,
  organizationId: string,
  requiredRoleId: string,
  cookieString: string,
  redirectPath: string
) {
  // 1. Check if user belongs to organization
  const userOrganizationsResponse: GetUserOrganizationsResponse_U = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/users/${userId}/organizations`,
    {
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (
    userOrganizationsResponse.message !==
    'User organizations retrieved successfully'
  ) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        redirectPath,
        'User Organizations Retrieval Failed',
        'Failed to retrieve user organizations. Please try again later.'
      )
    );
  }

  if (userOrganizationsResponse.organizations.logto.length === 0) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        redirectPath,
        'No Organizations Found',
        'You are not a member of any organization.'
      )
    );
  }

  const logtoUserOrganizations = userOrganizationsResponse.organizations.logto;
  const databaseUserOrganizations =
    userOrganizationsResponse.organizations.database;

  if (
    !logtoUserOrganizations.some((org) => org.id === organizationId) &&
    !databaseUserOrganizations.some(
      (org) => org.organizationId === organizationId
    )
  ) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        redirectPath,
        'Not Authorized',
        'You are not authorized to access this page.'
      )
    );
  }

  // 2. Check if user has required role
  const userRolesResponse: GetOrganizationRolesForAUserResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-roles/${organizationId}/users/${userId}/roles`,
    {
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (
    userRolesResponse.message !== 'Organization roles retrieved successfully'
  ) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        redirectPath,
        'User Roles Retrieval Failed',
        'Failed to retrieve user roles. Please try again later.'
      )
    );
  }

  if (userRolesResponse.roles.length === 0) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        redirectPath,
        'No Roles Found',
        'You are not a member of any organization.'
      )
    );
  }

  const rolesAtAndAboveRequiredRole = getRolesAtAndAbove(requiredRoleId);

  if (
    !userRolesResponse.roles.some((role) =>
      rolesAtAndAboveRequiredRole.includes(
        role.id as '6db8yoxt9adxvv8f3txya' | '1b1tp27zmov7aal1edwez'
      )
    )
  ) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        redirectPath,
        'Not Authorized',
        'You are not authorized to access this page.'
      )
    );
  }

  return undefined;
}

/**
 * Extracts the name of a user object.
 * @param user - The user object.
 * @returns The name of the user.
 */
export function extractNameFromUser(user: UserCS): string {
  // a. firstName + lastName (only if both are present)
  if (
    user.firstName &&
    user.lastName &&
    user.firstName !== '' &&
    user.lastName !== ''
  ) {
    return `${user.firstName} ${user.lastName}`;
  }
  // b. name
  if (user.name && user.name !== '') {
    return user.name;
  }
  // c. firstName (only if lastName is not present)
  if (user.firstName && user.firstName !== '' && !user.lastName) {
    return user.firstName;
  }
  // d. username (with @)
  if (user.username && user.username !== '') {
    return `@${user.username}`;
  }

  return 'Unknown User';
}

/**
 * Masks sensitive information by showing only the last N characters.
 * @param value - The value to mask.
 * @param visibleChars - Number of characters to show at the end (default: 4).
 * @param maskChar - Character to use for masking (default: '*').
 * @returns The masked value.
 */
export function maskSensitiveInfo(
  value: string | null | undefined,
  visibleChars: number = 4,
  maskChar: string = '*'
): string {
  if (!value || value.length <= visibleChars) {
    return value || '';
  }

  const maskedLength = value.length - visibleChars;
  const maskedPart = maskChar.repeat(maskedLength);
  const visiblePart = value.slice(-visibleChars);

  return `${maskedPart}${visiblePart}`;
}

/**
 * Masks all sensitive information.
 * @param value - The value to mask.
 * @param type - The type of value to mask.
 * @returns The masked value.
 */
export function maskAllSensitiveInfo(
  value: string | null | undefined,
  type:
    | 'email'
    | 'phone'
    | 'name'
    | 'address'
    | 'id'
    | 'website'
    | 'other' = 'other'
) {
  if (!value) return '';
  switch (type) {
    case 'email':
      // Mask all but first and last char before @, and domain
      const [user, domain] = value.split('@');
      if (!domain) return '••••••••';
      if (user.length <= 2) return `••••@${domain}`;
      return `${user[0]}••••${user[user.length - 1]}@${domain}`;
    case 'phone':
      // Mask all but last 2 digits
      return value.replace(/\d(?=\d{2})/gu, '•');
    case 'name':
      // Mask all but first letter
      return value[0] + '••••••';
    case 'address':
      // Mask all but first 3 chars
      return value.length > 3 ? value.slice(0, 3) + '••••••' : '••••••';
    case 'id':
      // Mask all but last 4
      return value.length > 4 ? '••••••' + value.slice(-4) : '••••••';
    case 'website':
      // Mask domain, show protocol
      try {
        const url = new URL(value);
        return url.protocol + '//••••••••';
      } catch {
        return '••••••••';
      }
    default:
      // General mask
      return '••••••••';
  }
}
