    endDate: z.date(),
    eventType: z.nativeEnum(CalendarEventType),
    color: z.string(),
    attendees: z.array(
      z.custom<{ user: User | null | undefined } & TeamMember>()
    )
  })
  .refine(
    (data) => {
      const diffInHours =
        (data.endDate.getTime() - data.startDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      return diffInHours >= 24 && diffInHours <= 72;
    },
    {
      message: 'Full day events must be between 24 and 72 hours',
      path: ['endDate']
    }
  )
  .refine(
    (data) => {
      return (
        data.startDate.getHours() === 0 &&
        data.startDate.getMinutes() === 0 &&
        data.endDate.getHours() === 0 &&
        data.endDate.getMinutes() === 0
      );
    },
    {
      message: 'Full day events must start and end at midnight (00:00)',
      path: ['endDate']
    }
  );

export default function CalendarManageEventDialog() {
  const {
    manageEventDialogOpen,
    setManageEventDialogOpen,
    selectedEvent,
    setSelectedEvent,
    events,
    setEvents,
    onEventUpdate,
    onEventDelete,
    teamMembers
  } = useCalendarContext();
  const [updating, setUpdating] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [eventUpdated, setEventUpdated] = useState(false);
  const [isDaily, setIsDaily] = useState(true);
  const [isFullDay, setIsFullDay] = useState(false);

  const dailyForm = useForm<z.infer<typeof dailyFormSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(dailyFormSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      title: '',
      description: '',
      location: '',
      day: new Date(),
      fromTime: format(
        roundToNearestMinutes(new Date(), {
          nearestTo: 15
        }),
        'HH:mm'
      ),
      toTime: format(
        roundToNearestMinutes(addMinutes(new Date(), 60), {
          nearestTo: 15
        }),
        'HH:mm'
      ),
      eventType: CalendarEventType.MEETING,
      color: 'blue',
      attendees: []
    }
  });

  const weekForm = useForm<z.infer<typeof weekFormSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(weekFormSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      title: '',
      description: '',
      location: '',
      startDate: new Date(),
      endDate: new Date(),
      startTime: '00:00',
      endTime: '00:00',
      eventType: CalendarEventType.MEETING,
      color: 'blue',
      attendees: []
    }
  });

  const fullDayForm = useForm<z.infer<typeof fullDayFormSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(fullDayFormSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      title: '',
      description: '',
      location: '',
      startDate: startOfDay(new Date()),
      endDate: startOfDay(addDays(new Date(), 1)),
      eventType: CalendarEventType.MEETING,
      color: 'blue',
      attendees: []
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedEvent) {
      const diffInHours =
        (selectedEvent.endDate.getTime() - selectedEvent.startDate.getTime()) /
        (1000 * 60 * 60);
      const isFullDay =
        diffInHours >= 24 &&
        diffInHours <= 72 &&
        selectedEvent.startDate.getHours() === 0 &&
        selectedEvent.startDate.getMinutes() === 0 &&
        selectedEvent.endDate.getHours() === 0 &&
        selectedEvent.endDate.getMinutes() === 0;

      const isDailyEvent = isSameDay(
        selectedEvent.startDate,
        selectedEvent.endDate
      );

      setIsDaily(isDailyEvent && !isFullDay);
      setIsFullDay(isFullDay);

      if (isFullDay) {
        fullDayForm.reset({
          title: selectedEvent.title,
          description: selectedEvent.description || '',
          location: selectedEvent.location || '',
          startDate: selectedEvent.startDate,
          endDate: selectedEvent.endDate,
          eventType: selectedEvent.eventType,
          color: selectedEvent.color,
          attendees: selectedEvent.attendees as TeamMember[]
        });
      } else if (isDailyEvent) {
        dailyForm.reset({
          title: selectedEvent.title,
          description: selectedEvent.description || '',
          location: selectedEvent.location || '',
          day: selectedEvent.startDate,
          fromTime: format(selectedEvent.startDate, 'HH:mm'),
          toTime: format(selectedEvent.endDate, 'HH:mm'),
          eventType: selectedEvent.eventType,
          color: selectedEvent.color,
          attendees: selectedEvent.attendees as TeamMember[]
        });
      } else {
        weekForm.reset({
          title: selectedEvent.title,
          description: selectedEvent.description || '',
          location: selectedEvent.location || '',
          startDate: selectedEvent.startDate,
          endDate: selectedEvent.endDate,
          startTime: format(selectedEvent.startDate, 'HH:mm'),
          endTime: format(selectedEvent.endDate, 'HH:mm'),
          eventType: selectedEvent.eventType,
          color: selectedEvent.color,
          attendees: selectedEvent.attendees as TeamMember[]
        });
      }
    }
  }, [selectedEvent, dailyForm, weekForm, fullDayForm]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDaily) {
      if (dailyForm.formState.isDirty) {
        setEventUpdated(true);
      }
    } else if (isFullDay) {
      if (fullDayForm.formState.isDirty) {
        setEventUpdated(true);
      }
    } else if (weekForm.formState.isDirty) {
      setEventUpdated(true);
    }
  }, [
    dailyForm.formState.isDirty,
    weekForm.formState.isDirty,
    fullDayForm.formState.isDirty,
    isDaily,
    isFullDay
  ]);

  async function onDailySubmit(values: z.infer<typeof dailyFormSchema>) {
    if (!selectedEvent) return;
    setUpdating(true);

    const [fromHour, fromMinute] = values.fromTime.split(':').map(Number);
    const [toHour, toMinute] = values.toTime.split(':').map(Number);

    const startDate = set(values.day, {
      hours: fromHour,
      minutes: fromMinute,
      seconds: 0,
      milliseconds: 0
    });

    const endDate = set(values.day, {
      hours: toHour,
      minutes: toMinute,
      seconds: 0,
      milliseconds: 0
    });

    const updatedEvent = {
      ...selectedEvent,
      title: values.title,
      description: values.description,
      location: values.location,
      startDate,
      endDate,
      color: values.color,
      eventType: values.eventType,
      attendees: values.attendees
    };

    try {
      if (onEventUpdate) {
        await onEventUpdate(updatedEvent);
      }

      setEvents(
        events.map((event) => {
          let eventId = event.id;
          if (eventId.includes('_processed_')) {
            eventId = eventId.split('_processed_')[0];
          }
          if (eventId === selectedEvent.id) {
            return updatedEvent;
          }
          return event;
        })
      );
      handleClose();
      toast.success('Event updated successfully');
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to update event');
      console.error('Error updating event:', error);
    } finally {
      setUpdating(false);
    }
  }

  async function onWeekSubmit(values: z.infer<typeof weekFormSchema>) {
    if (!selectedEvent) return;
    setUpdating(true);

    const [startHour, startMinute] = [0, 0];
    const [endHour, endMinute] = [0, 0];

    const startDate = set(values.startDate, {
      hours: startHour,
      minutes: startMinute,
      seconds: 0,
      milliseconds: 0
    });

    const endDate = set(values.endDate, {
      hours: endHour,
      minutes: endMinute,
      seconds: 0,
      milliseconds: 0
    });

    const updatedEvent = {
      ...selectedEvent,
      title: values.title,
      description: values.description,
      location: values.location,
      startDate,
      endDate,
      color: values.color,
      eventType: values.eventType,
      attendees: values.attendees
    };

    try {
      if (onEventUpdate) {
        await onEventUpdate(updatedEvent);
      }

      setEvents(
        events.map((event) => {
          let eventId = event.id;
          if (eventId.includes('_processed_')) {
            eventId = eventId.split('_processed_')[0];
          }
          if (eventId === selectedEvent.id) {
            return updatedEvent;
          }
          return event;
        })
      );
      handleClose();
      toast.success('Event updated successfully');
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to update event');
      console.error('Error updating event:', error);
    } finally {
      setUpdating(false);
    }
  }

  async function onFullDaySubmit(values: z.infer<typeof fullDayFormSchema>) {
    if (!selectedEvent) return;
    setUpdating(true);

    const updatedEvent = {
      ...selectedEvent,
      title: values.title,
      description: values.description,
      location: values.location,
      startDate: values.startDate,
      endDate: values.endDate,
      color: values.color,
      eventType: values.eventType,
      attendees: values.attendees
    };

    try {
      if (onEventUpdate) {
        await onEventUpdate(updatedEvent);
      }

      setEvents(
        events.map((event) => {
          let eventId = event.id;
          if (eventId.includes('_processed_')) {
            eventId = eventId.split('_processed_')[0];
          }
          if (eventId === selectedEvent.id) {
            return updatedEvent;
          }
          return event;
        })
      );
      handleClose();
      toast.success('Event updated successfully');
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to update event');
      console.error('Error updating event:', error);
    } finally {
      setUpdating(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleDelete() {
    if (!selectedEvent) return;
    setDeleting(true);

    try {
      if (onEventDelete) {
        await onEventDelete(
          selectedEvent.id.includes('_processed_')
            ? selectedEvent.id.split('_processed_')[0]
            : selectedEvent.id
        );
      }

      setEvents(
        events.filter(
          (event) =>
            event.id !==
            (selectedEvent.id.includes('_processed_')
              ? selectedEvent.id.split('_processed_')[0]
              : selectedEvent.id)
        )
      );
      handleClose();
      toast.success('Event deleted successfully');
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to delete event');
      console.error('Error deleting event:', error);
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
    }
  }

  function handleClose() {
    setManageEventDialogOpen(false);
    setSelectedEvent(null);
    dailyForm.reset();
    weekForm.reset();
    fullDayForm.reset();
  }

  const renderCommonFields = (
    form: UseFormReturn<z.infer<typeof dailyFormSchema>>
  ) => (
    <>
      <FormField
        control={form.control}
        name='title'
        render={({ field }) => (
          <FormItem>
            <FormLabel className='font-bold'>Title</FormLabel>
            <FormControl>
              <Input placeholder='Event title' {...field} />
            </FormControl>
            <FormDescription>The title of the event.</FormDescription>
            <FormMessage />
          </FormItem>
        )}
      />

      <FormField
        control={form.control}
        name='description'
        render={({ field }) => (
          <FormItem>
            <FormLabel className='font-bold'>Description</FormLabel>
            <FormControl>
              <Textarea placeholder='Event description' {...field} />
            </FormControl>
            <FormDescription>The description of the event.</FormDescription>
            <FormMessage />
          </FormItem>
        )}
      />

      <FormField
        control={form.control}
        name='location'
        render={({ field }) => (
          <FormItem>
            <FormLabel className='font-bold'>Location</FormLabel>
            <FormControl>
              <Input placeholder='Event location' {...field} />
            </FormControl>
            <FormDescription>The location of the event.</FormDescription>
            <FormMessage />
          </FormItem>
        )}
      />

      <FormField
        control={form.control}
        name='eventType'
        render={({ field }) => (
          <FormItem>
            <FormLabel className='font-bold'>Event Type</FormLabel>
            <FormControl>
              <Select onValueChange={field.onChange} value={field.value}>
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder='Select event type' />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {CalendarEventTypeEnums.map((type) => (
                    <SelectItem key={type} value={type}>
                      {type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() +
                        type.slice(1).toLowerCase().replaceAll('_', ' ')}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </FormControl>
            <FormDescription>The type of event.</FormDescription>
            <FormMessage />
          </FormItem>
        )}
      />

      <FormField
        control={form.control}
        name='color'
        render={({ field }) => (
          <FormItem>
            <FormLabel className='font-bold'>Color</FormLabel>
            <FormControl>
              <ColorPicker
                disableLabel={true}
                onChange={field.onChange}
                value={field.value}
              />
            </FormControl>
            <FormDescription>The color of the event.</FormDescription>
            <FormMessage />
          </FormItem>
        )}
      />

      <FormField
        control={form.control}
        name='attendees'
        render={({ field }) => (
          <FormItem>
            <FormLabel className='font-bold'>Attendees</FormLabel>
            <FormControl>
              <MultiSelect
                defaultValue={
                  selectedEvent?.attendees.map((a) => a.user?.id) || []
                }
                modalPopover={true}
                onValueChange={(value) => {
                  field.onChange(
                    teamMembers.filter((m) => value.includes(m.user?.id))
                  );
                }}
                options={teamMembers.map((member) => ({
                  label: member.user?.name || 'Unknown User',
                  value: member.user?.id
                }))}
                placeholder='Select attendees'
              />
            </FormControl>
            <FormDescription>
              Team members who will attend this event.
            </FormDescription>
            <FormMessage />
          </FormItem>
        )}
      />
    </>
  );

  const renderDailyFields = () => (
    <>
      <FormField
        control={dailyForm.control}
        name='day'
        render={({ field }) => (
          <FormItem>
            <FormLabel className='font-bold'>Select Day</FormLabel>
            <FormControl>
              <DatePicker date={field.value} setDate={field.onChange} />
            </FormControl>
            <FormDescription>The day of the event.</FormDescription>
            <FormMessage />
          </FormItem>
        )}
      />

      <div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'>
        <FormField
          control={dailyForm.control}
          name='fromTime'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel className='font-bold'>From Time</FormLabel>
              <Select
                defaultValue={format(
                  roundToNearestMinutes(new Date(), {
                    nearestTo: 15
                  }),
                  'HH:mm'
                )}
                onValueChange={field.onChange}
                value={field.value}
              >
                <FormControl>
                  <SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectValue placeholder='Select start time' />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                </FormControl>
                <SelectContent>
                  {timeOptions.map((time) => (
                    <SelectItem key={time.value} value={time.value}>
                      {time.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />

        <FormField
          control={dailyForm.control}
          name='toTime'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel className='font-bold'>To Time</FormLabel>
              <Select
                defaultValue={format(
                  roundToNearestMinutes(new Date(), {
                    nearestTo: 15
                  }),
                  'HH:mm'
                )}
                onValueChange={field.onChange}
                value={field.value}
              >
                <FormControl>
                  <SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectValue placeholder='Select end time' />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                </FormControl>
                <SelectContent>
                  {timeOptions.map((time) => (
                    <SelectItem key={time.value} value={time.value}>
                      {time.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );

  const renderWeekFields = () => (
    <>
      <div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'>
        <FormField
          control={weekForm.control}
          name='startDate'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel className='font-bold'>Start Date</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <DatePicker date={field.value} setDate={field.onChange} />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>Start date of the event.</FormDescription>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />

        <FormField
          control={weekForm.control}
          name='endDate'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel className='font-bold'>End Date</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <DatePicker date={field.value} setDate={field.onChange} />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>End date of the event.</FormDescription>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
      </div>

      <div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'>
        <FormField
          control={weekForm.control}
          name='startTime'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel className='font-bold'>Start Time</FormLabel>
              <Select
                defaultValue={format(
                  roundToNearestMinutes(new Date(), {
                    nearestTo: 15
                  }),
                  'HH:mm'
                )}
                onValueChange={field.onChange}
                value={field.value}
              >
                <FormControl>
                  <SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectValue placeholder='Select start time' />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                </FormControl>
                <SelectContent>
                  {timeOptions.map((time) => (
                    <SelectItem key={time.value} value={time.value}>
                      {time.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />

        <FormField
          control={weekForm.control}
          name='endTime'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel className='font-bold'>End Time</FormLabel>
              <Select
                defaultValue={format(
                  roundToNearestMinutes(new Date(), {
                    nearestTo: 15
                  }),
                  'HH:mm'
                )}
                onValueChange={field.onChange}
                value={field.value}
              >
                <FormControl>
                  <SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectValue placeholder='Select end time' />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                </FormControl>
                <SelectContent>
                  {timeOptions.map((time) => (
                    <SelectItem key={time.value} value={time.value}>
                      {time.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );

  const renderFullDayFields = () => (
    <div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'>
      <FormField
        control={fullDayForm.control}
        name='startDate'
        render={({ field }) => (
          <FormItem>
            <FormLabel className='font-bold'>Start Date</FormLabel>
            <FormControl>
              <DatePicker
                date={field.value}
                setDate={(date) => {
                  const midnightDate = startOfDay(date);
                  field.onChange(midnightDate);

                  const nextMidnight = startOfDay(addDays(midnightDate, 1));
                  fullDayForm.setValue('endDate', nextMidnight);
                }}
              />
            </FormControl>
            <FormDescription>Start date of the event (00:00).</FormDescription>
            <FormMessage />
          </FormItem>
        )}
      />

      <FormField
        control={fullDayForm.control}
        name='endDate'
        render={({ field }) => (
          <FormItem>
            <FormLabel className='font-bold'>End Date</FormLabel>
            <FormControl>
              <DatePicker
                date={field.value}
                setDate={(date) => {
                  const midnightDate = startOfDay(date);
                  field.onChange(midnightDate);
                }}
              />
            </FormControl>
            <FormDescription>End date of the event (00:00).</FormDescription>
            <FormMessage />
          </FormItem>
        )}
      />
    </div>
  );

  const renderEventForm = () => {
    if (isDaily) {
      return (
        <Form {...dailyForm}>
          <form
            className='space-y-4'
            onSubmit={dailyForm.handleSubmit(onDailySubmit)}
          >
            {renderCommonFields(dailyForm)}
            {renderDailyFields()}
            <SheetFooter className='flex justify-between gap-2 pt-4 sm:justify-start'>
              <AlertDialog>
                <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
                  <Button
                    className='flex items-center gap-2'
                    disabled={deleting}
                    type='button'
                    variant='destructive'
                  >
                    <TrashIcon className='size-4' />
                    Delete
                  </Button>
                </AlertDialogTrigger>
                <AlertDialogContent>
                  <AlertDialogHeader>
                    <AlertDialogTitle>Delete event</AlertDialogTitle>
                    <AlertDialogDescription>
                      Are you sure you want to delete this event? This action
                      cannot be undone.
                    </AlertDialogDescription>
                  </AlertDialogHeader>
                  <AlertDialogFooter>
                    <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
                    <AlertDialogAction
                      disabled={deleting}
                      onClick={handleDelete}
                    >
                      Delete
                    </AlertDialogAction>
                  </AlertDialogFooter>
                </AlertDialogContent>
              </AlertDialog>
              <Button
                className='flex items-center gap-2'
                disabled={
                  !dailyForm.formState.isDirty || !dailyForm.formState.isValid
                }
                type='submit'
              >
                Update event
                {updating ? (
                  <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin' />
                ) : (
                  <ChevronRightCircle className='size-4' />
                )}
              </Button>
            </SheetFooter>
          </form>
        </Form>
      );
    }

    if (isFullDay) {
      return (
        <Form {...fullDayForm}>
          <form
            className='space-y-4'
            onSubmit={fullDayForm.handleSubmit(onFullDaySubmit)}
          >
            {renderCommonFields(fullDayForm)}
            {renderFullDayFields()}
            <SheetFooter className='flex justify-between gap-2 pt-4 sm:justify-start'>
              <AlertDialog>
                <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
                  <Button
                    className='flex items-center gap-2'
                    disabled={deleting}
                    type='button'
                    variant='destructive'
                  >
                    <TrashIcon className='size-4' />
                    Delete
                  </Button>
                </AlertDialogTrigger>
                <AlertDialogContent>
                  <AlertDialogHeader>
                    <AlertDialogTitle>Delete event</AlertDialogTitle>
                    <AlertDialogDescription>
                      Are you sure you want to delete this event? This action
                      cannot be undone.
                    </AlertDialogDescription>
                  </AlertDialogHeader>
                  <AlertDialogFooter>
                    <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
                    <AlertDialogAction
                      disabled={deleting}
                      onClick={handleDelete}
                    >
                      Delete
                    </AlertDialogAction>
                  </AlertDialogFooter>
                </AlertDialogContent>
              </AlertDialog>
              <Button
                className='flex items-center gap-2'
                disabled={
                  !fullDayForm.formState.isDirty ||
                  !fullDayForm.formState.isValid
                }
                type='submit'
              >
                Update event
                {updating ? (
                  <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin' />
                ) : (
                  <ChevronRightCircle className='size-4' />
                )}
              </Button>
            </SheetFooter>
          </form>
        </Form>
      );
    }

    return (
      <Form {...weekForm}>
        <form
          className='space-y-4'
          onSubmit={weekForm.handleSubmit(onWeekSubmit)}
        >
          {renderCommonFields(weekForm)}
          {renderWeekFields()}
          <SheetFooter className='flex justify-between gap-2 pt-4 sm:justify-start'>
            <AlertDialog>
              <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button
                  className='flex items-center gap-2'
                  disabled={deleting}
                  type='button'
                  variant='destructive'
                >
                  <TrashIcon className='size-4' />
                  Delete
                </Button>
              </AlertDialogTrigger>
              <AlertDialogContent>
                <AlertDialogHeader>
                  <AlertDialogTitle>Delete event</AlertDialogTitle>
                  <AlertDialogDescription>
                    Are you sure you want to delete this event? This action
                    cannot be undone.
                  </AlertDialogDescription>
                </AlertDialogHeader>
                <AlertDialogFooter>
                  <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
                  <AlertDialogAction disabled={deleting} onClick={handleDelete}>
                    Delete
                  </AlertDialogAction>
                </AlertDialogFooter>
              </AlertDialogContent>
            </AlertDialog>
            <Button
              className='flex items-center gap-2'
              disabled={
                !weekForm.formState.isDirty || !weekForm.formState.isValid
              }
              type='submit'
            >
              Update event
              {updating ? (
                <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin' />
              ) : (
                <ChevronRightCircle className='size-4' />
              )}
            </Button>
          </SheetFooter>
        </form>
      </Form>
    );
  };

  return (
    <Sheet onOpenChange={handleClose} open={manageEventDialogOpen}>
      <SheetContent className='w-[400px] overflow-y-auto sm:w-[540px]'>
        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle>
            Manage {getEventModeTitle(isDaily, isFullDay)} Event
          </SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription>
            Update or delete this calendar event
          </SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>
        <div className='mt-6'>{renderEventForm()}</div>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

/**
 * Returns the display title for the event type based on its mode
 * @param isDaily - Whether the event occurs within a single day
 * @param isFullDay - Whether the event is a full-day event
 * @returns The formatted display title for the event type
 */
function getEventModeTitle(isDaily: boolean, isFullDay: boolean) {
  if (isDaily) return 'Daily';
  if (isFullDay) return 'Full-Day';
  return 'Full-Week';
}

// Helper function to deep compare objects and extract changes
const getObjectChanges = (
  oldObj: Record<string, unknown>,
  newObj: Record<string, unknown>
) => {
  const changes: Array<{
    key: string;
    oldValue: unknown;
    newValue: unknown;
    type: 'modified' | 'added' | 'removed';
  }> = [];

  // Get all unique keys from both objects
  const allKeys = new Set([
    ...Object.keys(oldObj || {}),
    ...Object.keys(newObj || {})
  ]);

  allKeys.forEach((key) => {
    const oldValue = oldObj?.[key];
    const newValue = newObj?.[key];

    if (oldValue === undefined && newValue !== undefined) {
      changes.push({ key, oldValue, newValue, type: 'added' });
    } else if (oldValue !== undefined && newValue === undefined) {
      changes.push({ key, oldValue, newValue, type: 'removed' });
    } else if (JSON.stringify(oldValue) !== JSON.stringify(newValue)) {
      changes.push({ key, oldValue, newValue, type: 'modified' });
    }
  });

  return changes;
};

// Helper function to render values using EventData component
const ValueRenderer = ({ value }: { value: unknown }) => {
  return <EventData data={value} />;
};

// Helper function to get user initials
const getUserInitials = (
  name?: string | null,
  username?: string,
  email?: string
): string => {
  if (name) {
    const parts = name.trim().split(' ');
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      return `${parts[0][0]}${parts[parts.length - 1][0]}`.toUpperCase();
    }
    return name.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  }
  if (username) {
    return username.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  }
  if (email) {
    return email.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  }
  return 'SY';
};

                </TabsContent>
              </motion.div>
            </Tabs>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );

'use client';

const templateFormSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(1, 'Template name is required').max(255),
  description: z.string().max(1000).optional(),
  category: z.nativeEnum(IndustryType),
  version: z.string().min(1, 'Version is required').max(50),
  file: z.instanceof(File).optional(),
  isPublic: z.boolean().default(true),
  isPublicLink: z.boolean().default(false),
  tags: z.string().optional(),
  language: z.string().max(10).optional()
});

type TemplateFormValues = z.infer<typeof templateFormSchema>;

const steps = [
  {
    step: 1,
    title: 'Basic Details',
    description: 'Provide a name and description for your template.'
  },
  {
    step: 2,
    title: 'Build Form',
    description: 'Drag and drop elements to build your form.'
  },
  {
    step: 3,
    title: 'Success',
    description: 'Your template has been saved.'
  }
];

type FormTemplateBuilderProps = {
  currentUserLogtoId: string | null;
  currentUserDbId: string | null;
  currentOrganizationId: string | null;
  isSuperAdmin: boolean;
  template?: DocumentTemplate;
};

export default function FormTemplateBuilder({
  isSuperAdmin,
  template,
  currentUserDbId,
  currentOrganizationId
}: FormTemplateBuilderProps) {
  const { elements, setElements, addElement } = useFormBuilderStore();
  const [activeElement, setActiveElement] =
    useState<FormElementInstance | null>(null);
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1);
  const [createdTemplate, setCreatedTemplate] =
    useState<DocumentTemplate | null>(null);
  const [isPublishDialogOpen, setIsPublishDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 768px)');

  const _router = useRouter();

  const form = useForm<TemplateFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(templateFormSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      name: template?.name ?? '',
      description: template?.description ?? '',
      category: (template?.category as IndustryType) ?? IndustryType.OTHER,
      version: template?.version ?? '1.0',
      isPublic: template?.isPublic ?? (isSuperAdmin ? true : false),
      isPublicLink: false,
      tags: template?.tags?.join(', ') ?? '',
      language: template?.language ?? 'en',
      file: undefined
    }
  });

  const handleSave = async (values: TemplateFormValues) => {
    // Check permissions: Super admins can create both global and custom templates
    // Organization admins can only create custom templates (isPublic = false)
    const isGlobalTemplate = values.isPublic;

    if (isGlobalTemplate && !isSuperAdmin) {
      toast.error(
        'You need super admin privileges to create global templates. Uncheck "Global Template" to create a custom template for your organization.'
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!isSuperAdmin && !currentOrganizationId) {
      toast.error(
        'Organization context is required to create custom templates.'
      );
      return;
    }

    if (currentStep === 1) {
      nextStep();
      return;
    }

    const templateFields = elements
      .map((el) => {
        const type = formBuilderTypesToDbTypes[el.type];
        if (!type) return null;
        return {
          name: el.id,
          label: el.label,
          type,
          required: el.required || false,
          options: el.options || [],
          description: el.description || ''
        };
      })
      .filter(Boolean);

    let mimeType = 'application/json' as MimeTypePS;
    if (values.file) {
      mimeType = values.file.type as MimeTypePS;
    } else if (template?.mimeType) {
      mimeType = template.mimeType as MimeTypePS;
    }

    try {
      let result;
      const dbUserId = currentUserDbId ? BigInt(currentUserDbId) : undefined;
      const isGlobalTemplate = values.isPublic; // Global templates are public, custom templates are organization-specific

      if (template) {
        // Updating existing template
        const isTemplateGlobal =
          !('organizationId' in template) || template.organizationId === null;

        if (isTemplateGlobal) {
          // Update global template
          const data: UpdateDocumentTemplateData = {
            name: values.name,
            description: values.description,
            fields: templateFields,
            isPublic: values.isPublic,
            category: values.category,
            version: values.version,
            mimeType,
            language: values.language,
            tags: values.tags
              ? values.tags
                  .split(',')
                  .map((tag) => tag.trim())
                  .filter(Boolean)
              : [],
            file: values.file
          };
          result = await updateGlobalDocumentTemplate(
            BigInt(template.id),
            data
          );
        } else {
          // Update custom template
          const data: UpdateCustomDocumentTemplateData = {
            updatedBy: dbUserId,
            name: values.name,
            description: values.description,
            fields: templateFields,
            isPublic: values.isPublic,
            category: values.category,
            version: values.version,
            mimeType,
            language: values.language,
            tags: values.tags
              ? values.tags
                  .split(',')
                  .map((tag) => tag.trim())
                  .filter(Boolean)
              : [],
            file: values.file
          };
          result = await updateCustomDocumentTemplate(
            BigInt(template.id),
            data
          );
        }
      } else {
        // Creating new template
        if (!values.file) {
          toast.error('A file is required for a new template.');
          return;
        }

        const tags = values.tags
          ? values.tags
              .split(',')
              .map((tag) => tag.trim())
              .filter(Boolean)
          : [];

        if (isGlobalTemplate) {
          // Create global template
          const data: CreateDocumentTemplateData = {
            name: values.name,
            description: values.description,
            fields: templateFields,
            isPublic: values.isPublic,
            category: values.category,
            version: values.version,
            mimeType,
            language: values.language,
            tags,
            file: values.file
          };
          result = await createGlobalDocumentTemplate(data, dbUserId);
        } else {
          // Create custom template
          const data: CreateCustomDocumentTemplateData = {
            organizationId: BigInt(currentOrganizationId),
            createdBy: dbUserId,
            updatedBy: dbUserId,
            name: values.name,
            description: values.description,
            fields: templateFields,
            isPublic: values.isPublic,
            category: values.category,
            version: values.version,
            mimeType,
            language: values.language,
            tags,
            file: values.file
          };
          result = await createCustomDocumentTemplate(data);
        }
      }

      if (result) {
        const templateType = isGlobalTemplate ? 'global' : 'custom';
        toast.success(
          `${templateType.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + templateType.slice(1)} template ${template ? 'updated' : 'created'} successfully!`
        );
        setCreatedTemplate(result);
        setCurrentStep(3);
      } else {
        throw new Error('An unknown error occurred.');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(
        `Failed to ${template ? 'update' : 'create'} template: ${
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
        }`
      );
    }
  };

  const handleDragStart = (event: DragStartEvent) => {

    if (!active) return;
    const isToolboxElement = active.data.current?.isToolboxElement as boolean;
    if (isToolboxElement) {

      const newElement = FormElements[type].construct();
      setActiveElement({

      });
    } else {
      const element = elements.find((el) => el.id === active.id);
      if (element) {
        setActiveElement(element);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleDragEnd = (event: DragEndEvent) => {
    setActiveElement(null);
    const { active, over } = event;
    if (!active || !over) return;

    const isToolboxElement = active.data.current?.isToolboxElement;
    const isDroppingOverCanvas = over.id === 'canvas-drop-area';

    // 1. Dragging from toolbox to canvas
    if (isToolboxElement) {
      const type = active.id as keyof typeof FormElements;
      const newElement = FormElements[type].construct();

      if (isDroppingOverCanvas) {
        // Dropped on canvas drop area
        addElement({ id: uuid(), ...newElement });
      } else {
        // Dropped on another element
        const overId = over.id;
        const overElementIndex = elements.findIndex((el) => el.id === overId);
        if (overElementIndex === -1) {
          console.error('Could not find over element');

        }

        const newElements = [...elements];
        newElements.splice(overElementIndex, 0, { id: uuid(), ...newElement });
        setElements(newElements);
      }

    const isSortingElement = active.data.current?.isCanvasElement;
    if (isSortingElement && !isDroppingOverCanvas) {

      const overId = over.id as string;

      if (activeId === overId) return;

      const activeIndex = elements.findIndex((el) => el.id === activeId);
      const overIndex = elements.findIndex((el) => el.id === overId);

      setElements(arrayMove(elements, activeIndex, overIndex));
    }
  };

  const nextStep = () => setCurrentStep((prev) => Math.min(prev + 1, 3));
  const prevStep = () => setCurrentStep((prev) => Math.max(prev - 1, 1));

  const renderStepContent = () => {

      case 1:
        return (
          <div className='dark:border-1 rounded-lg border border-border bg-white p-4 dark:border-solid dark:border-border dark:bg-card lg:p-6'>

              <div className='flex flex-row flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4'>
                <div className='relative size-12 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-primary/10 xs:size-16'>
                  <FileText

                    strokeWidth={1.5}

                  </h2>
                  <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>

            <Form {...form}>

                  form.handleSubmit(() => nextStep())();
                }}
                className='mt-4'
              >
                <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2'>
                  <FormField
                    control={form.control}
                    name='name'
                    render={({ field }) => (
                      <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
                        <FormLabel>Template Name</FormLabel>
                        <FormControl>
                          <Input
                            {...field}
                            placeholder='e.g., New Client Onboarding'
                            className='bg-background'
                          />
                        </FormControl>
                        <FormMessage />
                      </FormItem>
                    )}
                  />
                  <FormField
                    control={form.control}
                    name='description'
                    render={({ field }) => (
                      <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
                        <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
                        <FormControl>
                          <Textarea
                            {...field}
                            placeholder='A brief description of the template (optional)'
                            className='max-h-14 resize-none bg-background'
                          />
                        </FormControl>
                        <FormMessage />
                      </FormItem>
                    )}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 pt-4 md:grid-cols-2'>
                  <FormField
                    control={form.control}
                    name='category'
                    render={({ field }) => (
                      <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
                        <FormLabel>Category</FormLabel>
                        <FormControl>
                          <Select
                            onValueChange={field.onChange}
                            defaultValue={field.value}
                          >
                            <FormControl>
                              <SelectTrigger className='bg-background'>
                                <SelectValue placeholder='Select a category' />
                              </SelectTrigger>

                            <SelectContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
                              {Object.values(IndustryType)
                                .filter(
                                  (type) => type !== IndustryType.NOT_APPLICABLE
                                )
                                .map((type) => (
                                  <SelectItem key={type} value={type}>
                                    {type
                                      .toLowerCase()
                                      .replace(/_/gu, ' ')

        <div className='mt-4'>{renderStepContent()}</div>

        <div className='mt-4 flex justify-end gap-4'>
          {currentStep > 1 && currentStep < 3 && (
            <Button variant='outline' onClick={prevStep}>
              <ChevronLeft className='mr-2 size-4' />
              Back
            </Button>
          )}
          {currentStep === 1 && (
            <Button
              onClick={() => {
                form.trigger(['name', 'version', 'category']);
                if (form.formState.isValid) {
                  nextStep();
                }
              }}
            >
              Next
              <ChevronRight className='ml-2 size-4' />
            </Button>
          )}
          {currentStep === 2 && (
            <Button
              onClick={form.handleSubmit(handleSave)}
              disabled={form.formState.isSubmitting}
            >
              {form.formState.isSubmitting ? (
                <Loader2 className='mr-2 size-4 animate-spin' />
              ) : (
                <Save className='mr-2 size-4' />
              )}
              {template ? 'Update Template' : 'Save Template'}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
        <DragOverlay modifiers={[restrictToWindowEdges]} dropAnimation={null}>
          {activeElement && (
            <ToolboxElementOverlay
              formElement={FormElements[activeElement.type]}
            />
          )}
        </DragOverlay>
        <PublishTemplateDialog
          isOpen={isPublishDialogOpen}
          onOpenChange={setIsPublishDialogOpen}
          template={createdTemplate}
          organizationId={currentOrganizationId}
          isPublicLink={form.watch('isPublicLink')}
        />
      </DndContext>
    </FormBuilderStoreProvider>
  );
}

                                  <span className='truncate text-sm font-medium'>

                                      ac,
                                      organizationMembers,
                                      teams
                                    )}
                                  </span>
                                  <Badge
                                    variant='secondary'
                                    className={cn(
                                      'text-xs px-2 py-0.5 flex items-center gap-1',
                                      getAccessLevelColor(
                                        ac.accessLevel as AccessLevelEnumPS
                                      )
                                    )}
                                  >
                                    <AccessIcon className='size-3' />
                                    {
                                      ACCESS_LEVEL_LABELS[
                                        ac.accessLevel as AccessLevelEnumPS
                                      ]
                                    }
                                  </Badge>
                                </div>
                                <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                                  {isUser
                                    ? 'Individual user access'
                                    : 'Team access'}{' '}
                                  • Granted{' '}
                                  {formatDistanceToNow(new Date(ac.createdAt), {
                                    addSuffix: true
                                  })}
                                </p>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })()}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </motion.div>

      <AccessControlsSheet
        isOpen={shareOpen}
        onOpenChange={setShareOpen}
        document={document}
        initialAccessControls={accessControls}
        teams={teams}
        isLoadingTeams={isLoadingTeams}
        organizationMembers={organizationMembers}
      />
    </motion.div>
  );
}

import { db } from '@signvault/db';

const s3Client = new S3Client({
  region: process.env.S3_REGION,
  credentials: {
    accessKeyId: process.env.S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID,
    secretAccessKey: process.env.S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  }

  process.env.S3_BUCKET_TEMPLATES ||
  process.env.S3_BUCKET ||
  'your-default-bucket';

  process.env.S3_BUCKET_ORG_DATA ||

async function streamToBuffer(stream: Readable): Promise<Buffer> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
    stream.on('data', (chunk) => chunks.push(chunk));
    stream.on('error', reject);
    stream.on('end', () => resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks)));
  });
}

async function getDbUserFromLogtoId(logtoId: string): Promise<UserCS | null> {
  if (!logtoId) return null;
  const userRecord = await db.query.usersCS.findFirst({
    where: eq(usersCS.logtoId, logtoId)
  });
  return userRecord || null;
}

/**
 * (Super Admin) Creates a new global document template.
 */
export async function createGlobalDocumentTemplate(
  data: CreateDocumentTemplateData,
  superAdminDbId?: bigint
): Promise<DocumentTemplate> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  if (!claims || !authorizedUsers.includes(claims.sub)) {
    throw new Error('Unauthorized: Super admin access required.');
  }

  const superAdminUser = await getDbUserFromLogtoId(claims.sub);
  const creatorId =
    superAdminUser?.id || ORGANIZATION_POOL_IDS.SYSTEM_RUNNER_POOL;

  const idGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();
  const templateId = await idGenerator.generateDocumentId();

  let storageLocation: string | undefined;
  let fileSize: bigint | undefined;
  let fileHash: string | undefined;

  const fileToUpload = data.file;

  const fileBuffer = Buffer.from(await fileToUpload.arrayBuffer());
  const s3Key = `templates/${templateId}/${fileToUpload.name}`;

  try {
    await s3Client.send(
      new PutObjectCommand({
        Bucket: BUCKET_NAME,
        Key: s3Key,
        Body: fileBuffer,
        ContentType: data.mimeType,
        ACL: data.isPublic ? 'public-read' : 'private'
      })
    );
    storageLocation = s3Key;
    fileSize = BigInt(fileToUpload.size);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to upload template file to S3:', error);
    throw new Error('Failed to upload template file.');
  }

  const newTemplateData = {
    id: templateId,
    name: data.name,
    description: data.description,
    content: {},
    fields: data.fields || [],
    category: data.category,
    version: data.version,
    status: 'ACTIVE' as EntityStatusPSType,
    metadata: undefined,
    mimeType: data.mimeType,
    fileSize,
    hash: fileHash,
    storageLocation: `https://${BUCKET_NAME}.s3.${process.env.S3_REGION}.amazonaws.com/${s3Key}`,
    isPublic: data.isPublic === undefined ? true : data.isPublic,
    createdBy: creatorId as bigint,
    updatedBy: creatorId as bigint,
    tags: data.tags || [],
    language: data.language || 'en',
    createdAt: new Date(),
    updatedAt: new Date()
  };

  try {
    const [result] = await db
      .insert(documentTemplates)
      .values(newTemplateData as DocumentTemplateInsert)
      .returning();
    if (!result) {
      throw new Error(
        'Failed to create document template, no result returned.'
      );
    }
    // Provenance: enqueue template creation event
    await execute(print(EnqueueFormTemplateCreate), {
      input: {
        name: result.name,
        description: result.description || '',
        category: result.category,
        version: result.version,
        fields: (data.fields as FormFieldInput[]) || [],
        fileInfo: {
          filename: data.file.name,
          fileSize: Number(data.file.size),
          mimeType: data.mimeType
        },
        isPublic: result.isPublic,
        language: result.language,
        tags: result.tags,
        creatorId: creatorId.toString()
      }
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log(
        '[PROVENANCE] Failed to log create global document template event'
      );
    });

    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.TEMPLATE_CREATED,
      category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
      description: `Global document template ${result.name} created by ${creatorId}`,
      entityId: result.id.toString(),
      entityType: 'TEMPLATE',
      entityName: result.name,
      targetUserId: creatorId.toString(),
      success: true,
      metadata: {
        name: result.name,
        description: result.description,
        category: result.category,
        version: result.version,
        mimeType: result.mimeType,
        isPublic: result.isPublic,
        tags: result.tags,
        language: result.language
      }
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log(
        '[AUDIT LOGS] Failed to log create global document template event'
      );
    });

    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to create document template in DB:', error);
    if (storageLocation) {
      try {
        await s3Client.send(
          new DeleteObjectCommand({ Bucket: BUCKET_NAME, Key: storageLocation })
        );
      } catch (s3DeleteError) {
        console.error(
          'Failed to delete S3 object after DB insert failure:',
          s3DeleteError
        );
      }
    }
    throw new Error('Failed to create document template.');
  }
}

/**
 * (Super Admin) Updates an existing global document template.
 */
export async function updateGlobalDocumentTemplate(
  templateId: bigint,
  data: UpdateDocumentTemplateData,
  superAdminDbId?: bigint
): Promise<DocumentTemplate | null> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  if (!claims || !authorizedUsers.includes(claims.sub)) {
    throw new Error('Unauthorized: Super admin access required.');
  }
  const superAdminUser = await getDbUserFromLogtoId(claims.sub);
  const updaterId =
    superAdminUser?.id || ORGANIZATION_POOL_IDS.SYSTEM_RUNNER_POOL;

  const existingTemplate = await db.query.documentTemplates.findFirst({
    where: eq(documentTemplates.id, templateId)
  });

  if (!existingTemplate) {
    throw new Error(`Template with ID ${templateId} not found.`);
  }

  const updatePayload: Partial<DocumentTemplate> = {
    updatedAt: new Date(),
    updatedBy:
      superAdminDbId ||
      (ORGANIZATION_POOL_IDS.SYSTEM_RUNNER_POOL as unknown as bigint)
  };

  if (data.name !== undefined) updatePayload.name = data.name;
  if (data.description !== undefined)
    updatePayload.description = data.description;
  if (data.category !== undefined) updatePayload.category = data.category;
  if (data.version !== undefined) updatePayload.version = data.version;
  if (data.fields !== undefined) updatePayload.fields = data.fields;
  if (data.isPublic !== undefined) updatePayload.isPublic = data.isPublic;
  if (data.tags !== undefined) updatePayload.tags = data.tags;
  if (data.language !== undefined) updatePayload.language = data.language;

  let newS3Key: string | undefined =
    existingTemplate.storageLocation ?? undefined;
  let newFileSize: bigint | undefined = existingTemplate.fileSize ?? undefined;
  let newMimeType: string | undefined = existingTemplate.mimeType;

  if (data.file === null) {
    if (existingTemplate.storageLocation) {
      try {
        await s3Client.send(
          new DeleteObjectCommand({
            Bucket: BUCKET_NAME,
            Key: existingTemplate.storageLocation
          })
        );
        console.info(
          `Deleted existing S3 object: ${existingTemplate.storageLocation}`
        );
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          `Failed to delete S3 object ${existingTemplate.storageLocation}:`,
          error
        );
        throw new Error('Failed to remove existing template file.');
      }
    }
    updatePayload.storageLocation = null;
    updatePayload.fileSize = null;
    updatePayload.mimeType = null;
    updatePayload.hash = null;
    newS3Key = undefined;
    newFileSize = undefined;
  } else if (data.file) {
    if (existingTemplate.storageLocation) {
      try {
        await s3Client.send(
          new DeleteObjectCommand({
            Bucket: BUCKET_NAME,
            Key: existingTemplate.storageLocation
          })
        );
        console.info(
          `Deleted old S3 object: ${existingTemplate.storageLocation} before update`
        );
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(
          `Could not delete old S3 object ${existingTemplate.storageLocation} during update:`,
          error
        );
      }
    }

    const fileToUpload = data.file;
    const fileBuffer = Buffer.from(await fileToUpload.arrayBuffer());
    const s3Key = `templates/${templateId}/${fileToUpload.name}`;

    try {
      await s3Client.send(
        new PutObjectCommand({
          Bucket: BUCKET_NAME,
          Key: s3Key,
          Body: fileBuffer,
          ContentType: data.mimeType || fileToUpload.type,
          ACL: (
            data.isPublic !== undefined
              ? data.isPublic
              : existingTemplate.isPublic
          )
            ? 'public-read'
            : 'private'
        })
      );
      updatePayload.storageLocation = s3Key;
      updatePayload.fileSize = BigInt(fileToUpload.size);
      updatePayload.mimeType =
        data.mimeType || (fileToUpload.type as MimeTypePSType);
      newS3Key = s3Key;
      newFileSize = BigInt(fileToUpload.size);
      newMimeType = data.mimeType || fileToUpload.type;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to upload updated template file to S3:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to upload updated template file.');
    }
  }

  const significantChanges = Object.keys(updatePayload).filter(
    (key) => key !== 'updatedAt' && key !== 'updatedBy'
  );
  if (significantChanges.length > 0) {
    const [result] = await db
      .update(documentTemplates)
      .set(updatePayload)
      .where(eq(documentTemplates.id, templateId))
      .returning();
    if (!result) {
      throw new Error(
        'Failed to update document template, no result returned.'
      );
    }
    // Provenance: enqueue template edit event
    await execute(print(EnqueueFormTemplateEdit), {
      input: {
        templateId: templateId.toString(),
        updaterId: updaterId.toString(),
        changes: {
          description: updatePayload.description || '',
          fields: (data.fields as FormFieldInput[]) || [],
          version: data.version || existingTemplate.version
        }
      }
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log(
        '[PROVENANCE] Failed to log update global document template event'
      );
    });

    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.TEMPLATE_UPDATED,
      category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
      description: `Global document template ${result.name} updated by ${updaterId}`,
      entityId: templateId.toString(),
      entityType: 'TEMPLATE',
      entityName: result.name,
      targetUserId: updaterId.toString(),
      success: true,
      metadata: {
        changes: updatePayload,
        previous: {
          name: existingTemplate.name,
          description: existingTemplate.description,
          category: existingTemplate.category,
          version: existingTemplate.version,
          mimeType: existingTemplate.mimeType,
          isPublic: existingTemplate.isPublic,
          tags: existingTemplate.tags,
          language: existingTemplate.language
        }
      }
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log(
        '[AUDIT LOGS] Failed to log update global document template event'
      );
    });

    return result;
  }

  return existingTemplate;
}

/**
 * (Super Admin) Soft-deletes a global document template.
 */
export async function deleteGlobalDocumentTemplate(
  templateId: bigint
): Promise<DocumentTemplate> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  if (!claims || !authorizedUsers.includes(claims.sub)) {
    throw new Error('Unauthorized: Super admin access required.');
  }
  const superAdminUser = await getDbUserFromLogtoId(claims.sub);
  const updaterId =
    superAdminUser?.id || ORGANIZATION_POOL_IDS.SYSTEM_RUNNER_POOL;

  const [deletedTemplate] = await db
    .update(documentTemplates)
    .set({
      status: 'INACTIVE' as EntityStatusPSType,
      updatedBy: updaterId as bigint,
      updatedAt: new Date()
    } as Partial<DocumentTemplate>)
    .where(eq(documentTemplates.id, templateId))
    .returning();

  if (!deletedTemplate) {
    throw new Error(
      'Failed to delete document template or template not found.'
    );
  }
  // Provenance: enqueue template delete event
  await execute(print(EnqueueFormTemplateDelete), {
    input: {
      templateId: templateId.toString(),
      deleterId: updaterId.toString(),
      organizationId: superAdminUser?.organizationId?.toString()
    }
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log(
      '[PROVENANCE] Failed to log delete global document template event'
    );
  });

  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.TEMPLATE_DELETED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
    description: `Global document template ${deletedTemplate.name} deleted by ${updaterId}`,
    entityId: templateId.toString(),
    entityType: 'TEMPLATE',
    entityName: deletedTemplate.name,
    targetUserId: updaterId.toString(),
    success: true,
    metadata: {
      name: deletedTemplate.name,
      description: deletedTemplate.description,
      category: deletedTemplate.category,
      version: deletedTemplate.version,
      mimeType: deletedTemplate.mimeType,
      isPublic: deletedTemplate.isPublic,
      tags: deletedTemplate.tags,
      language: deletedTemplate.language
    }
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log(
      '[AUDIT LOGS] Failed to log delete global document template event'
    );
  });

  return deletedTemplate as DocumentTemplate;
}

/**
 * (Org Admin/Creator) Inherits a document template into an organization.
 */
export async function inheritDocumentTemplate(
  templateId: bigint,
  organizationId: bigint,
  inheritingUserId: bigint,
  customFields?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | string[] | null>
): Promise<DocumentCS> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const orgUser = await getDbUser({ claims }); // Assuming user is logged in and has claims

  if (
    !orgUser ||
    orgUser.id !== inheritingUserId ||
    orgUser.organizationId !== organizationId
  ) {
    // Basic check, more robust permission check might be needed (e.g., isCreator, isAdmin role)
    throw new Error('Unauthorized or mismatched user/organization.');
  }
  // Add a proper role check here based on ROLES.L5_USER, ROLES.L6_USER, or isCreator flag from user data
  // For now, proceeding if user ID and org ID match the ones passed.

  const sourceTemplate = await Promise.any([
    db.query.documentTemplates.findFirst({
      where: and(
        eq(documentTemplates.id, templateId),
        eq(documentTemplates.status, 'ACTIVE')
      )
    }),
    db.query.customDocumentTemplatesCS.findFirst({
      where: and(
        eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.id, templateId),
        eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.status, 'ACTIVE')
      )
    })
  ]);

  if (!sourceTemplate) {
    throw new Error('Active document template not found.');
  }

  const isCustomTemplate = isCustomDocumentTemplate(sourceTemplate);

  const idGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();
  const newDocumentId = await idGenerator.generateDocumentId();

  let newS3Key: string | undefined;
  let newStorageLocation: string | undefined;
  let newFileHash: string | undefined = sourceTemplate.hash || undefined;
  let newFileSize: bigint = sourceTemplate.fileSize;
  let newMimeType: MimeTypePSType = sourceTemplate.mimeType;

  if (sourceTemplate.storageLocation && ORG_BUCKET_NAME && BUCKET_NAME) {
    // Assuming storageLocation is the full URL, extract original key
    // Example: https://bucket.s3.region.amazonaws.com/templates/templateId/filename.pdf
    // Key: templates/templateId/filename.pdf
    const url = new URL(sourceTemplate.storageLocation);
    const originalS3Key = url.pathname.startsWith('/')
      ? url.pathname.substring(1)
      : url.pathname;

    const originalFilename = sourceTemplate.name; // Use template name for new filename base
    newS3Key = `org_${organizationId}/documents/${newDocumentId}/${originalFilename}`;

    const copySource = `${BUCKET_NAME}/${originalS3Key}`;

    try {
      const copyCommand = new CopyObjectCommand({
        Bucket: ORG_BUCKET_NAME,
        CopySource: encodeURIComponent(copySource),
        Key: newS3Key,
        MetadataDirective: 'COPY', // Copies metadata from source
        TaggingDirective: 'COPY' // Copies tags from source
      });
      await s3Client.send(copyCommand);
      newStorageLocation = `https://${ORG_BUCKET_NAME}.s3.${process.env.S3_REGION}.amazonaws.com/${newS3Key}`;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('S3 copy error during template inheritance:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to copy template file to organization storage.');
    }
  } else if (sourceTemplate.content && !sourceTemplate.storageLocation) {
    // If template is pure JSON content and has no file, this logic needs to handle it.
    // For now, this path assumes a file-less document is not what documentsCS expects due to notNull constraints.
    // This might mean creating a PDF from sourceTemplate.content, uploading it, then proceeding.
    // This is complex and out of scope for initial pass.
    console.warn(
      `Template ${templateId} has no storageLocation. Inheriting as a metadata-only document or requires content-to-file conversion.`
    );
    // We will proceed assuming documentsCS can handle null storageLocation if mimeType allows, though schema says notNull for fileSize.
    // This case needs more definition based on how non-file templates are handled.
    // For now, we will allow it to proceed and rely on DB constraints or later adjustments.
  }

  const inheritedDocData: Omit<DocumentCS, 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'> = {
    id: newDocumentId,
    organizationId: organizationId,
    ownerId: inheritingUserId,
    title: sourceTemplate.name,
    filename: sourceTemplate.name,
    mimeType: newMimeType,
    fileSize: newFileSize,
    hash: newFileHash,
    storageLocation: newStorageLocation,
    s3Key: newS3Key,
    isPublic: sourceTemplate.isPublic || false,
    metadata: sourceTemplate.metadata || {
      copiedFromTemplate: templateId,
      templateContent: sourceTemplate.content
    },
    tags: sourceTemplate.tags || [],
    entityStatus: 'ACTIVE' as EntityStatusPSType,
    status: 'ACTIVE' as DocumentStatus,
    lastModifiedAt: new Date(),
    description: sourceTemplate.description || '',
    templateId: getTemplateId(sourceTemplate),
    globalTemplateId: isCustomTemplate ? null : sourceTemplate.id,
    customTemplateId: isCustomTemplate ? sourceTemplate.id : null,
    customFields: customFields || null
  };

  const [createdDocument] = await db
    .insert(documentsCS)
    .values(inheritedDocData)
    .returning();

  if (!createdDocument) {
    throw new Error('Failed to create inherited document record.');
  }
  // Provenance: enqueue template inherit event
  await execute(print(EnqueueFormTemplateInherit), {
    input: {
      templateId: templateId.toString(),
      organizationId: organizationId.toString(),
      ownerId: inheritingUserId.toString(),
      customFields: customFields || {}
    }
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log inherit document template event');
  });

  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.TEMPLATE_USED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
    description: `Global document template ${sourceTemplate.name} used by ${inheritingUserId}`,
    entityId: createdDocument.id.toString(),
    entityType: 'DOCUMENT',
    entityName: createdDocument.title || '',
    success: true,
    metadata: {
      templateId,
      inheritedFrom: isCustomTemplate ? 'custom' : 'global',
      customFields: customFields || {},
      title: createdDocument.title,
      filename: createdDocument.filename
    }
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[AUDIT LOGS] Failed to log inherit document template event');
  });

  return createdDocument as DocumentCS;
}

/**
 * (Org Admin) Creates a shareable link for a document template.
 * @param templateId Template ID
 * @param organizationId Organization ID
 * @param expiresInDays Number of days until link expires (default: 1)
 */
export async function publishTemplateLink(
  templateId: bigint, // this is the templateId of the global template or the custom template (it can be either one of them)
  organizationId: bigint,
  expiresInDays: number = 1,
  isPublicLink: boolean = false
): Promise<{ shortId: string }> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const orgUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  if (!orgUser || orgUser.organizationId !== organizationId) {
    throw new Error(
      'Unauthorized: User is not part of the specified organization.'
    );
  }

  const isOrgAdmin =
    orgUser.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L6_USER.id ||
    orgUser.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id;

  if (!isOrgAdmin) {
    throw new Error(
      'Permission denied: Only organization admins can publish template links.'
    );
  }

  // Try to find the template in customDocumentTemplatesCS first, then in documentTemplates
  const customTemplate = await db.query.customDocumentTemplatesCS.findFirst({
    where: and(
      eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.id, templateId),
      eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.status, 'ACTIVE')
    )
  });

  let sourceTemplate: DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS | null = null;
  let isCustomTemplate = false;
  let isGlobalTemplate = false;

  if (customTemplate) {
    sourceTemplate = customTemplate;
    isCustomTemplate = true;
  } else {
    const globalTemplate = await db.query.documentTemplates.findFirst({
      where: and(
        eq(documentTemplates.id, templateId),
        eq(documentTemplates.status, 'ACTIVE')
      )
    });
    if (globalTemplate) {
      sourceTemplate = globalTemplate;
      isGlobalTemplate = true;
    }
  }

  if (!sourceTemplate) {
    throw new Error('Active document template not found.');
  }

  const shortId = nanoid(12);
  const idGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();
  const id = await idGenerator.generateDocumentRelationshipId();

  // compute dynamic expiry
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + expiresInDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  await db.insert(templatePublishLinksCS).values({
    id,
    shortId,
    organizationId,
    templateId,
    globalTemplateId: isCustomTemplate ? null : sourceTemplate.id,
    customTemplateId: isCustomTemplate ? sourceTemplate.id : null,
    createdBy: orgUser.id,
    createdAt: new Date(),
    expiresAt,
    isPublic: isPublicLink
  } as TemplatePublishLinkCSInsert);

  // Provenance: enqueue template publish event
  await execute(print(EnqueueFormTemplatePublish), {
    input: {
      templateId: templateId.toString(),
      publisherId: orgUser.id.toString(),
      organizationId: organizationId.toString(),
      expiresInDays
    }
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log publish template link event');
  });

  // Provenance: create audit log entry
  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.DOCUMENT_SHARED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
    description: `${isCustomTemplate ? 'Custom' : 'Global'} document template ${sourceTemplate.name} published by ${orgUser.id}`,
    entityId: templateId.toString(),
    entityType: 'TEMPLATE',
    entityName: sourceTemplate.name,
    globalDocumentTemplateId: isGlobalTemplate ? templateId : null,
    customDocumentTemplateId: isCustomTemplate ? templateId : null,
    targetUserId: orgUser.id.toString(),
    success: true,
    metadata: {
      shortId,
      expiresAt,
      templateId,
      organizationId,
      publisherId: orgUser.id
    }
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[AUDIT LOGS] Failed to log publish template link event');
  });

  return { shortId };
}

/**
 * Retrieves the details of a published template link.
 * @param shortId The short ID of the template link.
 * @returns An object containing the link details and the full template, or null if not found/expired.
 */
export async function getPublishedTemplateDetails(shortId: string) {
  if (!shortId) return null;

  const linkDetails = await db
    .select()
    .from(templatePublishLinksCS)
    .where(eq(templatePublishLinksCS.shortId, shortId))
    .limit(1)
    .then(([result]) => result);

  if (!linkDetails) {
    return { error: 'INVALID_LINK' };
  }

  if (linkDetails.expiresAt && new Date(linkDetails.expiresAt) < new Date()) {
    return { error: 'EXPIRED_LINK' };
  }

  // get the template from the templateId
  let sourceTemplate: DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS | null = null;
  // check if the template is a global template or a custom template
  const isCustomTemplate =
    linkDetails.customTemplateId !== null &&
    linkDetails.templateId === linkDetails.customTemplateId;
  const isGlobalTemplate =
    linkDetails.globalTemplateId !== null &&
    linkDetails.templateId === linkDetails.globalTemplateId;
  if (isCustomTemplate) {
    sourceTemplate = await db.query.customDocumentTemplatesCS.findFirst({
      where: eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.id, linkDetails.templateId)
    });
  } else if (isGlobalTemplate) {
    sourceTemplate = await db.query.documentTemplates.findFirst({
      where: eq(documentTemplates.id, linkDetails.templateId)
    });
  } else {
    // throw new Error('Invalid template ID');
  }

  return {
    link: linkDetails,
    template: sourceTemplate
  };
}

/**
 * Get form responses for a global template
 * @param templateId The ID of the global template
 * @param organizationId The organization ID (optional - super admin can view all)
 * @returns Array of documents created from this template
 */
export async function getGlobalTemplateResponses(
  templateId: bigint,
  organizationId?: bigint
): Promise<(DocumentCS & { user?: { name: string; primaryEmail: string } })[]> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

  // Check if user is super admin
  const isSuperAdmin = claims?.sub
    ? authorizedUsers.includes(claims.sub)
    : false;

  if (!isSuperAdmin && !organizationId) {
    throw new Error('Organization ID is required for non-super admin users.');
  }

  if (!isSuperAdmin) {
    // For non-super admin users, verify they're org admin
    const orgUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
    if (
      !orgUser ||
      (organizationId && orgUser.organizationId !== organizationId)
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        'Unauthorized: User is not part of the specified organization.'
      );
    }

    const isOrgAdmin =
      orgUser.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L6_USER.id ||
      orgUser.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
      orgUser.isCreator;

    if (!isOrgAdmin) {
      throw new Error(
        'Permission denied: Only organization admins can view template responses.'
      );
    }
  }

  // Build query conditions
  const conditions = [
    eq(documentsCS.templateId, templateId),
    eq(documentsCS.entityStatus, 'ACTIVE')
  ];

  if (organizationId) {
    conditions.push(eq(documentsCS.organizationId, organizationId));
  }

  // Get all documents created from this template
  const responses = await db
    .select({
      document: documentsCS,
      user: {
        id: usersCS.id,
        name: usersCS.name,
        primaryEmail: usersCS.primaryEmail
      }
    })
    .from(documentsCS)
    .leftJoin(usersCS, eq(documentsCS.ownerId, usersCS.id))
    .where(and(...conditions))
    .orderBy(documentsCS.createdAt);

  return responses.map((r) => ({
    ...r.document,
    user: r.user
      ? {
          name: r.user.name || 'Unknown User',
          primaryEmail: r.user.primaryEmail || 'No email'
        }
      : undefined
  }));
}

      toast.error("Failed to update selected pending user's team");
    }
  });

  const handleSaveUserTeam = async ({
    activeTeamId
  }: {
    activeTeamId: string;
  }) => {
    if (addingUserToTeam) {
      const result = await updateUserTeamMutation.mutateAsync({
        userId: addingUserToTeam.id.toString(),
        activeTeamId
      });

      await sendUserConfigUpdatedNotification({
        organizationId: organizationData?.organization?.id.toString(),
        userId: addingUserToTeam.id.toString(),

          old: addingUserToTeam,
          new: result.user
        },
        adminId: organizationData?.user?.id.toString(),
        configType: 'team'
      });
    }
  };

  const handleSavePendingUserTeam = async ({
    activeTeamId
  }: {
    activeTeamId: string;
  }) => {

      await updatePendingUserTeamMutation.mutateAsync({
        email: addingPendingUserToTeam.email,
        activeTeamId
      });

          <Skeleton className='h-10 w-[200px]' />

        <div className='space-y-2'>
          {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
            <Skeleton className='h-16 w-full' key={i} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (organizationMembersError) {
    return <div>Error loading organization members</div>;
  }

  const handleSaveUser = async (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {

          userId: selectedUser.id.toString(),
          data: {
            ...formValues,
            permissions: allowedPermissions
          }
        });

          organizationId: organizationData?.organization?.id.toString(),
          userId: selectedUser.id.toString(),
          details: {
            activeTeamId: formValues.activeTeamId,
            role: formValues.role,
            attributes: formValues.attributes
          },
          adminId: organizationData?.user?.id.toString(),
          configType: 'info'
        });
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['organizationMembers'] });
        router.refresh();
      } catch (error) {
        toast.error(`Failed to update user: ${error}`);
      } finally {

    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!selectedPendingUser) return;
    if (
      pendingUserForm.formState.isValid &&
      pendingUserForm.formState.isDirty

        email: selectedPendingUser.email,
        data: {
          ...pendingUserForm.getValues(),
          permissions: pendingUserAllowedPermissions
        }

              });
              setTab('pending');

              queryClient.invalidateQueries({

                    setSelectedUser(null);

                    setSelectedUser(user);

                organizationMembersLoading ||
                isActiveTeamsLoading
