                  setSelectedUser(null);
                } else {
                  setSelectedUser(user);
                }
              }
            }}
            onViewUserDetails={handleViewUserDetails}
            organizationData={organizationData}
            users={filteredUsers}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {isAdmin &&
        selectedUser &&
        selectedUser.id !== organizationData?.user?.id && (
          <EditSheet
            activeTeams={activeTeams}
            form={form}
            isOpen={!!selectedUser}
            isUpdating={isUpdating}
            onClose={() => setSelectedUser(null)}
            onSave={(e) => handleSaveUser(e)}
            permissionsSection={
              <PermissionsSection
                filteredCategories={filteredCategories}
                isAdmin={Array.from(permissionResults.entries()).some(
                  ([_, result]) => result.isAdminResult

                permissionResults={permissionResults}

            user={selectedUser}
          />

      {isAdmin &&
        selectedPendingUser &&

                isAdmin={Array.from(
                  pendingUserPermissionResults.entries()
                ).some(([_, result]) => result.isAdminResult)}
                permissionResults={pendingUserPermissionResults}
              />
            }
            title='Edit Invitee'
            user={selectedPendingUser}
          />
        )}
      <Sheet
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) setViewingUser(null);
        }}
        open={!!viewingUser}
      >
        <UserDetailsSheetContent
          activeTeams={activeTeams}
          isAdmin={isAdmin}
          isOpen={!!viewingUser}
          onClose={() => setViewingUser(null)}
          user={viewingUser}
        />
      </Sheet>
      <Sheet
        open={!!viewingPendingUser}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) setViewingPendingUser(null);
        }}
      >
        <UserDetailsSheetContent
          activeTeams={activeTeams}
          isAdmin={isAdmin}
          isOpen={!!viewingPendingUser}
          onClose={() => setViewingPendingUser(null)}
          user={viewingPendingUser}
        />
      </Sheet>

      <AddUserToTeamDialog
        activeTeams={activeTeams}
        isOpen={!!addingUserToTeam}
        onClose={() => setAddingUserToTeam(null)}
        onSave={handleSaveUserTeam}
        user={addingUserToTeam}
      />

      <AddUserToTeamDialog
        activeTeams={activeTeams}
        isOpen={!!addingPendingUserToTeam}
        onClose={() => setAddingPendingUserToTeam(null)}
        onSave={handleSavePendingUserTeam}
        user={addingPendingUserToTeam}
      />

      <ConfirmationDialog
        className='font-suisse-intl'
        cancelText='Cancel'
        confirmText='Revoke Invite'
        description='This will revoke the invitation and remove the invited user. This action cannot be undone.'
        isLoading={isRevoking}
        isOpen={!!revokeTarget}
        onCancel={() => setRevokeTarget(null)}
        onConfirm={handleConfirmRevoke}
        title='Revoke Invitation?'
        variant='destructive'
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function isTemplateTeam(
  team: ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS | undefined
): team is ActiveTeamInheritedFromTemplateCS {
  return !!team?.teamTemplateId;
}

  reason: z.string().min(1, 'Reason is required.'),
  pageNumber: z.number().min(1, 'Page number must be at least 1.'),

  const [isRightSidebarCollapsed, setRightSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);

    'height'

    width: number;
    height: number;
  } | null>(null);

  const [pageMargins, setPageMargins] = useState<

      pageNumber: number;
      leftMargin: number;

  const [isZoomOutDisabled, setIsZoomOutDisabled] = useState(false);

  } = useForm<SignDocumentFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(signDocumentSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      reason: ''
    }
  });

  const calculateScale = useCallback(() => {
    if (
      fitMode === 'custom' ||
      !mainContentRef.current ||
      !pageDimensions?.width
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const container = mainContentRef.current;
    // p-4 on pdfContainerRef -> 1rem padding on each side (16px * 4 = 64px total for flex container)
    // However, this is for the inner div. The main container gives the scroll dimensions. Let's use a smaller padding value for safety.
    const padding = 16;
    const containerWidth = container.clientWidth - padding;
    const containerHeight = container.clientHeight - padding;

    if (fitMode === 'width') {
      const newScale = containerWidth / pageDimensions.width;
      setScale(newScale);
    } else if (fitMode === 'height') {
      const newScale = containerHeight / pageDimensions.height;
      setScale(newScale);
    }
  }, [fitMode, pageDimensions]);

      const containerWidth = container.clientWidth - padding;

      setIsZoomInDisabled(scale >= scaleToFitWidth * 2 || scale >= 3);
      setIsZoomOutDisabled(pageDimensions.width * scale < containerWidth * 0.2);
    }
  }, [scale, pageDimensions]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      calculateScale();
    };

    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, [calculateScale]);

    calculateScale();
  }, [calculateScale]);

        })
        .finally(() => setIsLoadingUrl(false));
    }
  }, [document, open, state, toggleSidebar]);

  // Called for each page when loaded, to calculate and store its margins
  const onPageLoadSuccess = (page: {

    pageNumber: number;

      width: number;
      height: number;
    };
  }) => {

    // We'll use getViewport({ scale: 1 }) for actual PDF units
    let width = 0;
    let height = 0;
    if (page.width && page.height) {
      width = page.width;
      height = page.height;
    } else if (page.getViewport) {
      const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
      width = viewport.width;
      height = viewport.height;
    }
    // Example: 20px padding on each side (content area is width-20, height-20)
    const contentWidth = width - 20;
    const contentHeight = height - 20;
    const leftMargin = (width - contentWidth) / 2;
    const topMargin = (height - contentHeight) / 2;

    const newMargin = {
      pageNumber: page.pageNumber,
      leftMargin,
      topMargin,
      width,
      height
    };

    setPageMargins((prevState) => {
      // Avoid duplicate entries for the same page
      if (prevState.some((m) => m.pageNumber === page.pageNumber))
        return prevState;
      return [...prevState, newMargin];
    });
  };

  // Called when the document loads, to set numPages and pageDimensions
  const onDocumentLoadSuccess = async (pdf: {
    numPages: number;
    getPage: (pageNumber: number) => Promise<{
      getViewport: ({ scale }: { scale: number }) => {
        width: number;
        height: number;

  }) => {

      onPageLoadSuccess({

        pageNumber: 1,
        width: viewport.width,
        height: viewport.height
      });

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement, MouseEvent>) => {
    if (tool === 'pan') {
      setIsPanning(true);
      setPanStart({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });

    }

    if (!pdfContainerRef.current) return;
    const rect = pdfContainerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const start = { x, y };
    setStartPos(start);
    setSignatureBox({ x, y, width: 0, height: 0, page: currentPage });

        const dy = e.clientY - panStart.y;
        mainContentRef.current.scrollLeft -= dx;

// Progress indicator component
function ProgressIndicator({
  step,
  files,
  overallProgress
}: {
  step: UploadStep;
  files: UploadableFileDetail[];
  overallProgress: number;
}) {
  const steps = [
    { key: 'selectFiles', label: 'Select', icon: Upload },
    { key: 'editDetails', label: 'Details', icon: FileText },
    { key: 'uploading', label: 'Upload', icon: Loader2 },
    { key: 'summary', label: 'Complete', icon: CheckCircleIcon }
  ];

  const currentStepIndex = steps.findIndex((s) => s.key === step);

  return (
    <SheetHeader className='supports-backdrop-filter:bg-background/60 sticky top-0 z-10 border-b bg-background/95 backdrop-blur-sm'>
      <SheetTitle className='sr-only'>Upload Documents</SheetTitle>

      {/* Step indicators */}
      <div className='mb-6 flex items-center justify-center px-4 pt-2'>
        {steps.map((s, index) => {
          const Icon = s.icon;
          const isActive = index === currentStepIndex;
          const isCompleted = index < currentStepIndex;
          const isUploadingStep = s.key === 'uploading' && step === 'uploading';

          return (
            <div key={s.key} className='flex items-center'>
              <div className='flex flex-col items-center gap-2'>
                <div
                  className={cn(
                    'flex items-center justify-center w-8 h-8 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-full border-2 transition-all duration-200',
                    isCompleted
                      ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground'
                      : isActive
                        ? 'border-primary bg-primary/10 text-primary'
                        : 'border-muted-foreground/30 text-muted-foreground'
                  )}
                >
                  <Icon
                    className={cn(
                      'h-3 w-3 sm:h-4 sm:w-4',
                      isUploadingStep && 'animate-spin'
                    )}
                  />
                </div>
                <span
                  className={cn(
                    'text-xs font-medium hidden sm:block -mt-1',
                    isCompleted || isActive
                      ? 'text-primary'
                      : 'text-muted-foreground'
                  )}
                >
                  {s.label}
                </span>
              </div>
              {index < steps.length - 1 && (
                <div
                  className={cn(
                    'w-8 sm:w-12 h-px sm:mb-4 mb-0 transition-colors',
                    index < currentStepIndex
                      ? 'bg-primary'
                      : 'bg-muted-foreground/30'
                  )}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Step title and description */}
      <div className='px-4 py-2 text-left'>
        <h2 className='mb-1 text-lg font-semibold text-foreground sm:text-xl'>
          {step === 'selectFiles' && 'Select Documents'}
          {step === 'editDetails' && 'Document Details'}
          {step === 'uploading' && 'Uploading Documents'}
          {step === 'summary' && 'Upload Complete'}
        </h2>
        <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
          {step === 'selectFiles' && 'Choose the documents you want to upload'}
          {step === 'editDetails' &&
            `Review and edit details for ${files.length} document${files.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`}
          {step === 'uploading' &&
            'Please wait while your documents are being processed'}
          {step === 'summary' && 'View the results of your document upload'}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Progress bar for uploading */}
      {step === 'uploading' && (
        <div className='my-4 rounded-full px-4'>
          <div className='mb-1 flex justify-between text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
            <span>Upload Progress</span>
            <span>{overallProgress}%</span>
          </div>
          <Progress value={overallProgress} className='h-2' />
        </div>
      )}
    </SheetHeader>
  );
}

// Footer component - designed to be fixed at bottom of sheet
function UploadFooter({
  step,
  files,
  canGoBack,
  canProceed,
  isProcessingUpload,
  onBack,
  onContinue,
  onUpload,
  onReset
}: {
  step: UploadStep;
  files: UploadableFileDetail[];
  canGoBack: boolean;
  canProceed: boolean;
  isProcessingUpload: boolean;
  onBack: () => void;
  onContinue: () => void;
  onUpload: () => void;
  onReset: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <SheetFooter className='supports-backdrop-filter:bg-background/60 sticky z-10 mt-auto border-t bg-background/95 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm'>
      <div className='flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3'>
        <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
          {canGoBack && (
            <Button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                onBack();
              }}
              variant='outline'
              disabled={isProcessingUpload}
              size='sm'
            >
              <ArrowLeft className='mr-2 size-4' />
              <span className='hidden sm:inline'>Back to File Selection</span>
              <span className='sm:hidden'>Back</span>
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
          {step === 'selectFiles' && files.length > 0 && (
            <Button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                onContinue();
              }}
              disabled={isProcessingUpload || files.length === 0}
              size='sm'
            >
              <span className='hidden sm:inline'>
                Continue with {files.length} File{files.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
              </span>
              <span className='sm:hidden'>Continue ({files.length})</span>
            </Button>
          )}

          {step === 'editDetails' && (
            <Button onClick={onUpload} disabled={!canProceed} size='sm'>
              {isProcessingUpload ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className='mr-2 size-4 animate-spin' />
                  <span className='hidden sm:inline'>Uploading...</span>
                  <span className='sm:hidden'>Uploading...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <span className='hidden sm:inline'>
                    Upload {files.length} Document
                    {files.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                  </span>
                  <span className='sm:hidden'>Upload ({files.length})</span>
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          )}

          {(step === 'summary' ||
            (step === 'uploading' && !isProcessingUpload)) && (
            <Button onClick={onReset} variant='outline' size='sm'>
              <span className='hidden sm:inline'>Upload More Documents</span>
              <span className='sm:hidden'>Upload More</span>
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </SheetFooter>
  );
}

import {
  saveDraftToStorage,
  getDraftFromStorage,
  clearDraftFromStorage
} from './utils/draft-storage';
import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import { fileDetailToDraftInput } from '@/lib/document-drafts';

export function DocumentUploadSection({
  onUploadSuccess,
  onClose
}: Readonly<DocumentUploadSectionProps>) {
  const { organizationData } = useUserData();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<UploadStep>(() => {
    const savedDraft = getDraftFromStorage();
    return savedDraft?.files.length ? 'editDetails' : 'selectFiles';
  });
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<UploadableFileDetail[]>(() => {
    const savedDraft = getDraftFromStorage();
    return (
      savedDraft?.files.map((f) => ({
        ...f,
        fileSize: BigInt(
          f?.dbRecord?.fileSize ?? f.fileSize ?? (f.file.size as number) ?? 0
        ),
        mimeType: (f.dbRecord?.mimeType ?? f.mimeType) || 'application/pdf'
      })) || []
    );
  });
  const [globalError, setGlobalError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [overallProgress, setOverallProgress] = useState(0);
  const [isProcessingUpload, setIsProcessingUpload] = useState(false);

  // State to track changes for auto-save
  const [pendingChanges, setPendingChanges] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [lastAutoSave, setLastAutoSave] = useState<number>(Date.now());

  // Add state for countdown
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // Ref to store the singular toast id
  const countdownToastId = useRef<string | null>(null);

  // Save draft when component unmounts or when files/step changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (files.length > 0 && step !== 'summary' && !isProcessingUpload) {
      saveDraftToStorage({
        files: files.map((f) => ({
          ...f,
          fileSize: BigInt(f.file.size ?? f.fileSize ?? 0),
          mimeType:
            ((f.mimeType ?? f.file.type) as MimeTypePSType) || 'application/pdf'
        })),
        lastModified: Date.now(),
        organizationId: organizationData?.organization?.id?.toString() || '',
        userId: organizationData?.user?.id?.toString() || ''
      });
    }
  }, [files, step, isProcessingUpload, organizationData]);

  // Clear draft when upload is successful
  useEffect(() => {
    if (step === 'summary') {
      clearDraftFromStorage();
    }
  }, [step]);

  // Add countdown effect when step changes to summary
  useEffect(() => {
    let interval: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
    let timeout: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;

    if (step === 'summary') {
      setCountdown(5);

      // Show the initial toast
      if (countdownToastId.current) {
        toast.dismiss(countdownToastId.current);
      }
      countdownToastId.current = toast(`Closing dialog in 5 seconds...`, {
        id: 'countdown-toast',
        duration: 1000
      });

      interval = setInterval(() => {
        setCountdown((prev) => {
          if (prev === null || prev <= 1) {
            if (interval) clearInterval(interval);
            return 0;
          }
          return prev - 1;
        });
      }, 1000);

      // Actually close the dialog after 5 seconds
      timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        if (onClose) onClose();
        if (countdownToastId.current) {
          toast.dismiss(countdownToastId.current);
        }
      }, 5000);
    } else {
      setCountdown(null);
      if (countdownToastId.current) {
        toast.dismiss(countdownToastId.current);
        countdownToastId.current = null;
      }
    }

    return () => {
      if (interval) clearInterval(interval);
      if (timeout) clearTimeout(timeout);
    };
  }, [step, onClose]);

  // Show countdown toast, always update the same toast
  useEffect(() => {
    if (step !== 'summary') return;
    if (countdown === null) return;

    if (countdown > 0) {
      // Update the toast with the new countdown
      countdownToastId.current = toast(
        `Closing dialog in ${countdown} second${countdown === 1 ? '' : 's'}...`,
        {
          id: 'countdown-toast',
          duration: 1000
        }
      );
    } else if (countdown === 0) {
      // Optionally show a final message before closing
      countdownToastId.current = toast(`Closing dialog...`, {
        id: 'countdown-toast',
        duration: 1000
      });
    }
  }, [countdown, step]);

  const resetWizard = useCallback(() => {
    setStep('selectFiles');
    setFiles([]);
    setGlobalError(null);
    setOverallProgress(0);
    setIsProcessingUpload(false);
    clearDraftFromStorage();
    if (countdownToastId.current) {
      toast.dismiss(countdownToastId.current);
      countdownToastId.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  // Handle beforeunload event to save draft
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforeUnload = () => {
      if (files.length > 0 && step !== 'summary' && !isProcessingUpload) {
        saveDraftToStorage({
          files: files.map((f) => ({
            ...f,
            fileSize: BigInt(f.file.size ?? f.fileSize ?? 0), // Store original file size
            mimeType: f.mimeType || 'application/pdf' // Ensure mimeType is set
          })),
          lastModified: Date.now(),
          organizationId: organizationData?.organization?.id?.toString() || '',
          userId: organizationData?.user?.id?.toString() || ''
        });
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
      handleBeforeUnload();
    };
  }, [files, step, isProcessingUpload, organizationData]);

  // Auto-save drafts every 60 seconds when there are changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (pendingChanges.size === 0 || step !== 'editDetails') {
      return;
    }

    const interval = setInterval(async () => {
      const now = Date.now();
      const timeSinceLastSave = now - lastAutoSave;

      // Only auto-save if it's been at least 60 seconds since the last save
      if (timeSinceLastSave >= 60000 && pendingChanges.size > 0) {
        try {
          // Update drafts that have pending changes
          const updatePromises = Array.from(pendingChanges).map(
            async (fileId) => {
              const file = files.find((f) => f.id === fileId);
              if (file?.draftId) {
                await updateDocumentDraft(file.draftId, {
                  title: file.title,
                  description: file.description,
                  tags: file.tags
                });
                return file;
              }
              return null;
            }
          );

          const updatedFiles = await Promise.all(updatePromises);

          // Update local storage with the latest data
          if (updatedFiles.some((f) => f !== null)) {
            saveDraftToStorage({
              files: files.map((f) => ({
                ...f,
                fileSize: BigInt(f.file.size ?? f.fileSize ?? 0),
                mimeType: f.mimeType || 'application/pdf'
              })),
              lastModified: now,
              organizationId:
                organizationData?.organization?.id?.toString() || '',
              userId: organizationData?.user?.id?.toString() || ''
            });
          }

          // Clear pending changes and update last save time
          setPendingChanges(new Set());
          setLastAutoSave(now);

          toast.success('Draft changes saved automatically');
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Auto-save failed:', error);
          toast.error('Failed to auto-save changes');
        }
      }
    }, 60000); // Check every 60 seconds

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [files, pendingChanges, lastAutoSave, step, organizationData]);

  const handleFilesSelected = useCallback(
    async (selectedNativeFiles: File[]) => {
      const newUploadableFiles: UploadableFileDetail[] =
        selectedNativeFiles.map((file) => ({
          id: getRandomUUID(),
          file,
          title:
            file.name.substring(0, file.name.lastIndexOf('.')) || file.name,
          description: '',
          tags: [],
          status: 'pending',
          progress: 0
        }));
      const toastMessage = `Creating ${newUploadableFiles.length} document draft${newUploadableFiles.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}...`;
      const toastId = toast.loading(toastMessage);
      // Create draft records in the database for each file
      try {
        if (organizationData?.organization?.id && organizationData?.user?.id) {
          const draftInputs = newUploadableFiles.map((file) =>
            fileDetailToDraftInput(
              {
                title: file.title,
                description: file.description,
                tags: file.tags,
                file: file.file
              },
              organizationData.organization.id,
              organizationData.user.id
            )
          );

          const createdDrafts = await createMultipleDocumentDrafts(draftInputs);

          // Update the files with draft IDs
          const filesWithDrafts = newUploadableFiles.map((file, index) => ({
            ...file,
            draftId: createdDrafts[index]?.id
          }));

          setFiles((prevFiles) => [...prevFiles, ...filesWithDrafts]);
          toast.success('Drafts created successfully', { id: toastId });
        } else {
          // Fallback if organization data isn't available
          setFiles((prevFiles) => [...prevFiles, ...newUploadableFiles]);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to create drafts:', error);
        toast.error('Failed to create drafts', { id: toastId });
        // Still add files to the list but without draft IDs
        setFiles((prevFiles) => [...prevFiles, ...newUploadableFiles]);
      }
      toast.dismiss(toastId);
      setStep('editDetails');
      setGlobalError(null);
    },
    [organizationData]
  );

  const handleUpdateFileField = useCallback(
    <K extends keyof UploadableFileDetail>(
      id: string,
      field: K,
      value: UploadableFileDetail[K]
    ) => {
      setFiles((prevFiles) =>
        prevFiles.map((f) => (f.id === id ? { ...f, [field]: value } : f))
      );

      // Track this file as having pending changes for draft metadata fields
      if (field === 'title' || field === 'description' || field === 'tags') {
        setPendingChanges((prev) => new Set(prev).add(id));
      }
    },
    []
  );

  const handleRemoveFileInDetails = useCallback(
    async (id: string) => {
      const fileToRemove = files.find((f) => f.id === id);

      // If the file has a draft in the database, delete it
      if (fileToRemove?.draftId) {
        try {
          toast.promise(deleteDraft(fileToRemove.draftId), {
            loading: 'Deleting draft...',
            success: 'Draft deleted successfully',
            error: 'Failed to delete draft from database'
          });
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Failed to delete draft:', error);
          toast.error('Failed to delete draft from database');
        }
      }

      // Remove the file from the local state
      const updatedFiles = files.filter((f) => f.id !== id);
      setFiles(updatedFiles);

      // Remove from pending changes if it was there
      setPendingChanges((prev) => {
        const newSet = new Set(prev);
        newSet.delete(id);
        return newSet;
      });

      // Update local storage
      if (updatedFiles.length > 0) {
        saveDraftToStorage({
          files: updatedFiles.map((f) => ({
            ...f,
            fileSize: BigInt(f.file.size ?? f.fileSize ?? 0),
            mimeType:
              ((f.mimeType ?? f.file.type) as MimeTypePSType) ||
              'application/pdf'
          })),
          lastModified: Date.now(),
          organizationId: organizationData?.organization?.id?.toString() || '',
          userId: organizationData?.user?.id?.toString() || ''
        });
      } else {
        // If no files left, clear the draft storage and go back to file selection
        clearDraftFromStorage();
        setStep('selectFiles');
      }
    },
    [files, organizationData]
  );

  const handleProceedToUpload = async () => {
    setIsProcessingUpload(true);
    setStep('uploading');
    setGlobalError(null);
    setOverallProgress(0);

    const totalFiles = files.length;
    let successfullyUploadedDocs: DocumentCS[] = [];
    let filesProcessed = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
      const fileDetail = files[i];
      if (fileDetail.status === 'completed') {
        filesProcessed++;
        setOverallProgress(Math.round((filesProcessed / totalFiles) * 100));
        continue;
      }
      handleUpdateFileField(fileDetail.id, 'status', 'uploading-s3');
      handleUpdateFileField(fileDetail.id, 'progress', 10);

      try {
        handleUpdateFileField(fileDetail.id, 'progress', 30);
        // Pass organizationId here!
        const s3Results = await uploadDocumentsToS3(
          [fileDetail.file],
          String(organizationData?.organization?.id)
        );
        const s3Result = s3Results[0];
        if (!s3Result || !s3Result.key || !s3Result.lastModifiedAt) {
          throw new Error(
            'S3 upload incomplete or missing key/lastModifiedAt.'
          );
        }
        handleUpdateFileField(fileDetail.id, 's3Key', s3Result.key);
        handleUpdateFileField(
          fileDetail.id,
          'storageLocation',
          s3Result.storageLocation
        );
        handleUpdateFileField(fileDetail.id, 'progress', 60);
        handleUpdateFileField(fileDetail.id, 'status', 'creating-record');

        const docToCreate = {
          filename: s3Result.filename,
          title: fileDetail.title,
          description: fileDetail.description,
          tags: fileDetail.tags,
          mimeType: s3Result.mimeType,
          fileSize: s3Result.fileSize,
          hash: s3Result.hash,
          storageLocation: s3Result.storageLocation,
          s3Key: s3Result.key,
          lastModifiedAt: s3Result.lastModifiedAt,
          organizationId: organizationData?.organization?.id,
          ownerId: organizationData?.user?.id
        };

        const createdDocs = await createDocumentRecords([docToCreate]);
        const createdDoc = createdDocs[0];
        if (!createdDoc) {
          throw new Error('Failed to create document record.');
        }

        handleUpdateFileField(fileDetail.id, 'dbRecord', createdDoc);
        handleUpdateFileField(fileDetail.id, 'status', 'completed');
        handleUpdateFileField(fileDetail.id, 'progress', 100);
        successfullyUploadedDocs.push(createdDoc);
        toast.success(`Uploaded: ${fileDetail.title || fileDetail.file.name}`);
        await createAuditLogEntry({
          action: AuditLogAction.DOCUMENT_CREATED,
          category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
          entityId: createdDoc.id,
          entityType: 'document',
          entityName: createdDoc.title,
          description: `User uploaded a new document: "${createdDoc.title}"`,
          afterState: { document: createdDoc } as NestedRecord
        }).catch(console.error);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error uploading file:', fileDetail.file.name, error);
        const errorMessage =
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error';
        handleUpdateFileField(fileDetail.id, 'status', 'error');
        handleUpdateFileField(fileDetail.id, 'error', errorMessage);
        handleUpdateFileField(fileDetail.id, 'progress', 100);
        toast.error(
          `Failed: ${fileDetail.title || fileDetail.file.name} - ${errorMessage}`
        );
      }
      filesProcessed++;
      setOverallProgress(Math.round((filesProcessed / totalFiles) * 100));
    }

    if (successfullyUploadedDocs.length > 0) {
      onUploadSuccess(successfullyUploadedDocs);
    }
    setStep('summary');
    setIsProcessingUpload(false);
    toast.success('Upload complete!');
  };

  const renderStepContent = () => {
    switch (step) {
      case 'selectFiles':
        return (
          <div className='flex min-h-[400px] items-center justify-center p-4'>
            <div className='w-full max-w-2xl'>
              <FileDropzoneStep
                onFilesSelected={handleFilesSelected}
                disabled={isProcessingUpload}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      case 'editDetails':
        return (
          <div className='p-4'>
            <FileDetailsStep
              files={files}
              onUpdateFileField={handleUpdateFileField}
              onRemoveFile={handleRemoveFileInDetails}
              onBack={() => {
                setStep('selectFiles');
                setGlobalError(null);
              }}
              onProceedToUpload={handleProceedToUpload}
              isUploading={isProcessingUpload}
              isDraft={!!getDraftFromStorage()}
            />
          </div>
        );
      case 'uploading':
      case 'summary':
        const completedCount = files.filter(
          (f) => f.status === 'completed'
        ).length;
        const errorCount = files.filter((f) => f.status === 'error').length;

        return (
          <div className='space-y-6 p-4'>
            {step === 'summary' && (
              <div
                className={cn(
                  'border rounded-xl p-6 text-left',
                  errorCount > 0
                    ? 'border-destructive/20 bg-destructive/5 text-destructive'
                    : 'border-green-200 bg-green-50 text-green-800'
                )}
              >
                {errorCount > 0 ? (
                  <XCircleIcon className='mx-auto mb-3 size-12 text-destructive' />
                ) : (
                  <CheckCircleIcon className='mx-auto mb-3 size-12 text-green-600' />
                )}
                <h3 className='mb-2 text-left text-lg font-semibold'>
                  {errorCount > 0
                    ? 'Upload Completed with Errors'
                    : 'Upload Successful!'}
                </h3>
                <p className='text-left text-sm'>
                  {completedCount} of {files.length} document
                  {files.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} processed successfully.
                  {errorCount > 0 && ` ${errorCount} failed to upload.`}
                </p>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className='space-y-3'>
              {files.map((f) => (
                <FileUploadItem
                  key={f.id}
                  fileDetail={f}
                  onUpdateField={() => {}}
                  isEditing={false}
                  isUploadingOrProcessing={
                    f.status === 'uploading-s3' ||
                    f.status === 'creating-record'
                  }
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      default:
        return <div className='p-4 text-left'>Unknown step. Please reset.</div>;
    }
  };

  const canGoBack = step === 'editDetails' && !isProcessingUpload;
  const canProceed =
    step === 'editDetails' &&
    files.every((f) => f.title.trim() !== '') &&
    files.length > 0 &&
    !isProcessingUpload;

  return (
    <div className='flex h-full flex-col'>
      {/* Fixed Header */}
      <ProgressIndicator
        step={step}
        files={files}
        overallProgress={overallProgress}
      />

      {/* Scrollable Content Area */}
      <ScrollArea className='flex min-h-0 w-full flex-1'>
        <div className='min-h-full'>
          {renderStepContent()}

          {/* Global Error Display */}
          {globalError && (
            <div className='mx-4 mb-4 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-destructive/20 bg-destructive/10 p-4 text-sm text-destructive'>
              <AlertCircle className='mt-0.5 size-5 shrink-0' />
              <div>
                <p className='mb-1 font-medium'>Upload Error</p>
                <p>{globalError}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </ScrollArea>

      {/* Fixed Footer */}
      <UploadFooter
        step={step}
        files={files}
        canGoBack={canGoBack}
        canProceed={canProceed}
        isProcessingUpload={isProcessingUpload}
        onBack={() => {
          setStep('selectFiles');
          setGlobalError(null);
        }}
        onContinue={() => {
          setStep('editDetails');
          setGlobalError(null);
        }}
        onUpload={handleProceedToUpload}
        onReset={resetWizard}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

'use server';

import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getDbUser } from './auth';
import { sendOrganizationNotification } from './notifications';
import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import {
  organizationJoinRequestsCS,
  organizationsCS,
  usersCS
} from '@signvault/db/schema';
import { and, desc, eq, ilike, or } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type {
  OrganizationJoinRequestCS,
  OrganizationCS,
  UserCS,
  OrganizationJoinRequestCSInsert,
  RolePermissionsPS,
  UserCSInsert,
  OrganizationCSInsert
} from '@signvault/db/types';

import { createAuditLogEntry } from './audit-logs';

  AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogCategory,
  OrganizationJoinRequestStatus
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';

// Helper function to get organization admins
async function getOrganizationAdmins(
  organizationId: string | bigint
): Promise<UserCS[]> {
  try {
    const admins = await db
      .select()
      .from(usersCS)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(usersCS.organizationId, BigInt(organizationId)),
          eq(usersCS.organizationRoleId, ROLES.L5_USER.id)
        )
      );

    return admins;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching organization admins:', error);
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Creates a new organization join request
 */
export async function createJoinRequest({
  organizationId,
  message
}: {
  organizationId: string | bigint;
  message?: string;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; requestId?: string }> {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const user = await getDbUser({ claims });

    if (!user) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not authenticated' };
    }

    // Check if organization exists and is public
    const organization = await db
      .select()
      .from(organizationsCS)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(organizationsCS.id, BigInt(organizationId)),
          eq(organizationsCS.isPublic, true),
          eq(organizationsCS.isActive, true)
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    if (organization.length === 0) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Organization not found or not accepting join requests'
      };
    }

    // Check if user already has a pending request for this organization
    const existingRequest = await db
      .select()
      .from(organizationJoinRequestsCS)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.requesterId, user.id),
          eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.organizationId, BigInt(organizationId)),
          eq(
            organizationJoinRequestsCS.status,
            OrganizationJoinRequestStatus.PENDING
          )
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    if (existingRequest.length > 0) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'You already have a pending request for this organization'
      };
    }

    // Check if user is already a member of this organization
    const isMember = user.organizationId === BigInt(organizationId);
    if (isMember) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'You are already a member of this organization'
      };
    }

    // Create the join request
    const idGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();
    const requestId = await idGenerator.generateOrganizationJoinRequestId();
    const [joinRequest] = await db
      .insert(organizationJoinRequestsCS)
      .values({
        id: BigInt(requestId),
        requesterId: user.id,
        organizationId: BigInt(organizationId),
        status: 'PENDING',
        message: message || null,
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date()
      } as OrganizationJoinRequestCSInsert)
      .returning();

    // Get organization admins using helper function
    const admins = await getOrganizationAdmins(organizationId);

    // Send notifications to all admins
    const notificationPromises = admins.map(async (admin) => {
      // Send in-app notification
      await sendOrganizationNotification({
        action: 'USER_JOINED',
        receiverId: admin.id,
        organizationId: BigInt(organizationId),
        title: 'New Organization Join Request',
        message: `${user.name} has requested to join your organization`,
        targetEntityId: joinRequest.id,
        targetEntityType: 'JOIN_REQUEST',
        data: {
          requesterId: user.id,
          requesterName: user.name,
          requesterEmail: user.primaryEmail,
          requestMessage: message
        }
      });

      // Send email notification
      await sendEmail({
        to: admin.primaryEmail,
        subject: `New Join Request for ${organization[0].name}`,
        html: `
          <h2>New Organization Join Request</h2>
          <p><strong>${user.name}</strong> (${user.primaryEmail}) has requested to join your organization <strong>${organization[0].name}</strong>.</p>
          ${message ? `<p><strong>Message:</strong> ${message}</p>` : ''}
          <p>Please review this request in your admin dashboard.</p>
        `
      });
    });

    await Promise.all(notificationPromises);

    // Create audit log entry
    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.ORGANIZATION_JOIN_REQUEST_CREATED,
      category: AuditLogCategory.ORGANIZATION,
      metadata: {
        requestId: joinRequest.id,
        organizationId: organizationId,
        organizationName: organization[0].name,
        requesterId: user.id,
        requesterName: user.name,
        requesterEmail: user.primaryEmail,
        message: message
      },
      description: `${user.name} requested to join organization ${organization[0].name}`,
      entityId: String(joinRequest.id),
      entityType: 'JOIN_REQUEST',
      entityName: `Join request for ${organization[0].name}`,
      targetUserId: String(user.id),
      success: true
    });

    return { success: true, requestId: String(joinRequest.id) };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error creating join request:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to create join request' };
  }
}

/**
 * Gets all join requests for a user
 */
export async function getUserJoinRequests(): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  requests?: (OrganizationJoinRequestCS & {
    organization: OrganizationCSInsert;
    user: UserCSInsert;
  })[];
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const user = await getDbUser({ claims });

    if (!user) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not authenticated' };
    }

    const requests = await db
      .select()
      .from(organizationJoinRequestsCS)
      .leftJoin(
        organizationsCS,
        eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.organizationId, organizationsCS.id)
      )
      .leftJoin(usersCS, eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.requesterId, usersCS.id))
      .where(eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.requesterId, user.id))
      .orderBy(desc(organizationJoinRequestsCS.createdAt));

    return {
      success: true,
      requests: requests.map((r) => ({
        ...r.organization_join_requests,
        organization: r.organizations!,
        user: r.users!
      }))
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching user join requests:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to fetch join requests' };
  }
}

/**
 * Gets all join requests for an organization (admin view)
 */
export async function getOrganizationJoinRequests(
  organizationId: string | bigint
): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  requests?: (OrganizationJoinRequestCS & {
    user: UserCSInsert;
  })[];
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const user = await getDbUser({ claims });

    if (!user) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not authenticated' };
    }

    // Check if user belongs to the organization
    if (String(user.organizationId) !== String(organizationId)) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Unauthorized: You can only view requests for your organization'
      };
    }

    // Check if user is admin of the organization
    const isAdmin =
      user.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L6_USER.id ||
      user.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
      user.isCreator;

    if (!isAdmin) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Admin access required' };
    }

    const requests = await db
      .select()
      .from(organizationJoinRequestsCS)
      .leftJoin(usersCS, eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.requesterId, usersCS.id))
      .where(
        eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.organizationId, BigInt(organizationId))
      )
      .orderBy(desc(organizationJoinRequestsCS.createdAt));

    return {
      success: true,
      requests: requests.map((r) => ({
        ...r.organization_join_requests,
        user: r.users!
      }))
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching organization join requests:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to fetch join requests' };
  }
}

/**
 * Revokes a join request (user action)
 */
export async function revokeJoinRequest(requestId: string | bigint): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const user = await getDbUser({ claims });

    if (!user) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not authenticated' };
    }

    // Get the request to verify ownership
    const [request] = await db
      .select()
      .from(organizationJoinRequestsCS)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.id, BigInt(requestId)),
          eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.requesterId, user.id)
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    if (!request) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Request not found or unauthorized' };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'PENDING') {
      return { success: false, error: 'Can only revoke pending requests' };
    }

    // Update request status to revoked
    await db
      .update(organizationJoinRequestsCS)
      .set({
        status: OrganizationJoinRequestStatus.REVOKED,
        updatedAt: new Date()
      } as Partial<OrganizationJoinRequestCS>)
      .where(eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.id, BigInt(requestId)));

    // Create audit log entry
    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.ORGANIZATION_JOIN_REQUEST_REVOKED,
      category: AuditLogCategory.ORGANIZATION,
      metadata: {
        requestId: requestId,
        organizationId: request.organizationId,
        requesterId: user.id,
        requesterName: user.name
      },
      description: `${user.name} revoked their join request`,
      entityId: String(requestId),
      entityType: 'JOIN_REQUEST',
      entityName: 'Revoked join request',
      targetUserId: String(user.id),
      success: true
    });

    return { success: true };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error revoking join request:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to revoke join request' };
  }
}

/**
 * Rejects a join request (admin action)
 */
export async function rejectJoinRequest({
  requestId,
  reviewMessage
}: {
  requestId: string | bigint;
  reviewMessage?: string;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const admin = await getDbUser({ claims });

    if (!admin) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not authenticated' };
    }

    // Get the request and verify admin access
    const [request] = await db
      .select()
      .from(organizationJoinRequestsCS)
      .where(eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.id, BigInt(requestId)))
      .limit(1);

    if (!request) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Request not found' };
    }

    const isAdmin =
      admin.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L6_USER.id ||
      admin.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
      (admin.isCreator &&
        String(admin.organizationId) === String(request.organizationId));

    // Verify admin access
    if (admin.organizationId !== request.organizationId && !isAdmin) {
      console.log('admin:', admin);
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Admin access required' };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'PENDING') {
      return { success: false, error: 'Can only reject pending requests' };
    }

    // Update request status to rejected
    const updatedRequest = await db
      .update(organizationJoinRequestsCS)
      .set({
        status: OrganizationJoinRequestStatus.REJECTED,
        reviewedBy: admin.id,
        reviewedAt: new Date(),
        reviewMessage: reviewMessage || null,
        updatedAt: new Date()
      } as Partial<OrganizationJoinRequestCS>)
      .where(eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.id, BigInt(requestId)))
      .returning();

    // Get requester info for notification
    const [requester] = await db
      .select()
      .from(usersCS)
      .where(eq(usersCS.id, request.requesterId))
      .limit(1);

    if (requester) {
      // Send notification to requester
      await sendOrganizationNotification({
        action: 'USER_LEFT',
        receiverId: requester.id,
        organizationId: request.organizationId,
        title: 'Join Request Rejected',
        message: `Your request to join the organization has been rejected`,
        targetEntityId: request.id,
        targetEntityType: 'JOIN_REQUEST',
        data: {
          reviewMessage: reviewMessage,
          reviewedBy: admin.name
        }
      });

      // Send email notification
      const [organization] = await db
        .select()
        .from(organizationsCS)
        .where(eq(organizationsCS.id, request.organizationId))
        .limit(1);

      if (organization) {
        await sendEmail({
          to: requester.primaryEmail,
          subject: `Join Request Rejected - ${organization.name}`,
          html: `
            <h2>Join Request Update</h2>
            <p>Your request to join <strong>${organization.name}</strong> has been rejected.</p>
            ${reviewMessage ? `<p><strong>Reason:</strong> ${reviewMessage}</p>` : ''}
            <p>You may contact the organization directly if you have questions about this decision.</p>
          `
        });
      }
    }

    // Create audit log entry
    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.ORGANIZATION_JOIN_REQUEST_REJECTED,
      category: AuditLogCategory.ORGANIZATION,
      metadata: {
        requestId: requestId,
        organizationId: request.organizationId,
        requesterId: request.requesterId,
        reviewedBy: admin.id,
        reviewerName: admin.name,
        reviewMessage: reviewMessage
      },
      description: `${admin.name} rejected join request`,
      entityId: String(requestId),
      entityType: 'JOIN_REQUEST',
      entityName: 'Rejected join request',
      targetUserId: String(admin.id),
      success: true
    });

    // Send rejection notification to the user
    try {
      await sendOrganizationNotification({
        action: 'USER_LEFT',
        creatorId: admin.id,
        receiverId: updatedRequest[0].requesterId,
        organizationId: updatedRequest[0].organizationId,
        title: 'Join Request Rejected',
        message: `Your request to join the organization has been rejected.${reviewMessage ? ` Reason: ${reviewMessage}` : ''}`,
        targetEntityId: updatedRequest[0].id,
        targetEntityType: 'JOIN_REQUEST',
        data: {
          requestId: updatedRequest[0].id,
          reviewMessage: reviewMessage || null,
          reviewedBy: admin.id,
          reviewedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        }
      });
    } catch (notificationError) {
      console.error(
        'Failed to send rejection notification:',
        notificationError
      );
      // Don't fail the rejection if notification fails
    }

    return {
      success: true
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error rejecting join request:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Failed to reject join request'
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Approves a join request and adds user to organization (admin action)
 */
export async function approveJoinRequest({
  requestId,
  userAttributes
}: {
  requestId: string | bigint;
  userAttributes: {
    roleId: OrganizationRoleId;
    teamId?: string | bigint;
    attributes: UserAttributes;
    permissions: PermissionType[];
    rolePermissions?: RolePermissionsPS[];
  };
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const admin = await getDbUser({ claims });

    if (!admin) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not authenticated' };
    }

    // Get the request and verify admin access
    const [request] = await db
      .select()
      .from(organizationJoinRequestsCS)
      .where(eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.id, BigInt(requestId)))
      .limit(1);

    if (!request) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Request not found' };
    }

    const isAdmin =
      admin.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L6_USER.id ||
      admin.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
      (admin.isCreator &&
        String(admin.organizationId) === String(request.organizationId));

    // Verify admin access
    if (admin.organizationId !== request.organizationId && !isAdmin) {
      console.log('admin:', admin);
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Admin access required' };
    }

    if (request.status !== 'PENDING') {
      return { success: false, error: 'Can only approve pending requests' };
    }

    // Get requester info
    const [requester] = await db
      .select()
      .from(usersCS)
      .where(eq(usersCS.id, request.requesterId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!requester) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Requester not found' };
    }

    // Check if user is already in an organization
    if (requester.organizationId) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'User is already a member of an organization'
      };
    }

    // Update the user with organization details
    await updateUser(requester.id, {
      organizationId: request.organizationId,
      organizationRoleId: userAttributes.roleId,
      activeTeamId: userAttributes.teamId
        ? BigInt(userAttributes.teamId)
        : null,
      permissions: userAttributes.permissions,
      rolePermissions: userAttributes.rolePermissions || [],
      attributes: userAttributes.attributes
    });

    // Add user to Logto organization
    await logtoApiClient.POST('/api/organizations/{id}/users', {
      params: {
        path: {
          id: String(request.organizationId)
        }
      },
      body: {
        userIds: [requester.logtoId]
      }
    });

    // Assign role in Logto
    await logtoApiClient.POST('/api/organizations/{id}/users/roles', {
      params: {
        path: {
          id: String(request.organizationId)
        }
      },
      body: {
        userIds: [requester.logtoId],
        organizationRoleIds: [userAttributes.roleId]
      }
    });

    // Update request status to approved
    const updatedRequest = await db
      .update(organizationJoinRequestsCS)
      .set({
        status: OrganizationJoinRequestStatus.APPROVED,
        reviewedBy: admin.id,
        reviewedAt: new Date(),
        proposedRoleId: userAttributes.roleId,
        proposedTeamId: userAttributes.teamId
          ? BigInt(userAttributes.teamId)
          : null,
        proposedAttributes: userAttributes.attributes,
        proposedPermissions: userAttributes.permissions,
        proposedRolePermissions: userAttributes.rolePermissions || [],
        updatedAt: new Date()
      } as Partial<OrganizationJoinRequestCS>)
      .where(eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.id, BigInt(requestId)))
      .returning();

    // Send notification to requester
    await sendOrganizationNotification({
      action: 'USER_JOINED',
      receiverId: requester.id,
      organizationId: request.organizationId,
      title: 'Join Request Approved',
      message: `Your request to join the organization has been approved! Welcome aboard!`,
      targetEntityId: request.id,
      targetEntityType: 'JOIN_REQUEST',
      data: {
        reviewedBy: admin.name,
        roleId: userAttributes.roleId,
        teamId: userAttributes.teamId
      }
    });

    // Send email notification
    const [organization] = await db
      .select()
      .from(organizationsCS)
      .where(eq(organizationsCS.id, request.organizationId))
      .limit(1);

    if (organization) {
      await sendEmail({
        to: requester.primaryEmail,
        subject: `Welcome to ${organization.name}!`,
        html: `
          <h2>Join Request Approved</h2>
          <p>Congratulations! Your request to join <strong>${organization.name}</strong> has been approved.</p>
          <p>You can now access your organization dashboard and start collaborating with your team.</p>
          <p>Welcome aboard!</p>
        `
      });
    }

    // Create audit log entry
    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.ORGANIZATION_JOIN_REQUEST_APPROVED,
      category: AuditLogCategory.ORGANIZATION,
      metadata: {
        requestId: requestId,
        organizationId: request.organizationId,
        requesterId: request.requesterId,
        requesterName: requester.name,
        reviewedBy: admin.id,
        reviewerName: admin.name,
        assignedRole: userAttributes.roleId,
        assignedTeam: userAttributes.teamId
      },
      description: `${admin.name} approved join request for ${requester.name}`,
      entityId: String(requestId),
      entityType: 'JOIN_REQUEST',
      entityName: 'Approved join request',
      targetUserId: String(admin.id),
      success: true
    });

    // Send approval notification to the user
    try {
      await sendOrganizationNotification({
        action: 'USER_JOINED',
        creatorId: admin.id,
        receiverId: updatedRequest[0].requesterId,
        organizationId: updatedRequest[0].organizationId,
        title: 'Join Request Approved',
        message: `Your request to join the organization has been approved.${userAttributes.attributes ? ` Welcome to the team!` : ''}`,
        targetEntityId: updatedRequest[0].id,
        targetEntityType: 'JOIN_REQUEST',
        data: {
          requestId: updatedRequest[0].id,
          reviewedBy: admin.id,
          reviewedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          roleId: userAttributes.roleId,
          attributes: userAttributes.attributes
        }
      });
    } catch (notificationError) {
      console.error('Failed to send approval notification:', notificationError);
      // Don't fail the approval if notification fails
    }

    return {
      success: true
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error approving join request:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Failed to approve join request'
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Searches for public organizations
 */
export async function searchPublicOrganizations(query: string): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  organizations?: OrganizationCS[];
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const user = await getDbUser({ claims });

    if (!user) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not authenticated' };
    }

    const organizations = await db
      .select()
      .from(organizationsCS)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(organizationsCS.isPublic, true),
          eq(organizationsCS.isActive, true),
          or(
            ilike(organizationsCS.name, `%${query}%`),
            ilike(organizationsCS.description, `%${query}%`)
          )
        )
      )
      .limit(20);

    return { success: true, organizations };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error searching organizations:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to search organizations' };
  }
}

/**
 * Gets a specific join request by ID
 */
export async function getJoinRequestById(requestId: string | bigint): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  request?: OrganizationJoinRequestCS & {
    requester: UserCS;
    organization: OrganizationCS;
  };
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const user = await getDbUser({ claims });

    if (!user) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not authenticated' };
    }

    const result = await db
      .select()
      .from(organizationJoinRequestsCS)
      .leftJoin(usersCS, eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.requesterId, usersCS.id))
      .leftJoin(
        organizationsCS,
        eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.organizationId, organizationsCS.id)
      )
      .where(eq(organizationJoinRequestsCS.id, BigInt(requestId)))
      .limit(1);

    if (!result || result.length === 0) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Request not found' };
    }

    const request = {
      ...result[0].organization_join_requests,
      requester: result[0].users!,
      organization: result[0].organizations!
    };

    // Check if user has permission to view this request
    const canView =
      request.requesterId === user.id || // User is the requester
      (user.organizationId === request.organizationId &&
        user.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id); // User is admin of the organization

    if (!canView) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized to view this request' };
    }

    return { success: true, request };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching join request:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to fetch join request' };
  }
}
