/**
 * (Org Admin/Creator) Creates a new custom document template.
 */
export async function createCustomDocumentTemplate(
  data: CreateCustomDocumentTemplateData
): Promise<CustomDocumentTemplateCS> {
  const creatorId = data.createdBy;

  const idGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();
  const templateId = await idGenerator.generateDocumentId();

  let storageLocation: string | undefined;
  let fileSize: bigint | undefined;
  let fileHash: string | undefined;

  const fileToUpload = data.file;

  const fileBuffer = Buffer.from(await fileToUpload.arrayBuffer());
  const s3Key = `org_${data.organizationId}/custom_templates/${templateId}/${fileToUpload.name}`;

  try {
    await s3Client.send(
      new PutObjectCommand({
        Bucket: BUCKET_NAME,
        Key: s3Key,
        Body: fileBuffer,
        ContentType: data.mimeType,
        ACL: data.isPublic ? 'public-read' : 'private'
      })
    );
    storageLocation = s3Key;
    fileSize = BigInt(fileToUpload.size);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to upload template file to S3:', error);
    throw new Error('Failed to upload template file.');
  }

  const newTemplateData = {
    id: templateId,
    name: data.name,
    organizationId: BigInt(data.organizationId),
    createdBy: creatorId as bigint,
    updatedBy: creatorId as bigint,
    description: data.description,
    content: {},
    fields: data.fields || [],
    category: data.category,
    version: data.version,
    status: 'ACTIVE' as EntityStatusPSType,
    metadata: undefined,
    mimeType: data.mimeType,
    fileSize,
    hash: fileHash,
    storageLocation: `https://${BUCKET_NAME}.s3.${process.env.S3_REGION}.amazonaws.com/${s3Key}`,
    isPublic: data.isPublic === undefined ? true : data.isPublic,
    tags: data.tags || [],
    language: data.language || 'en',
    templateId: data.templateId, // Include the reference to the global template
    createdAt: new Date(),
    updatedAt: new Date()
  };

  try {
    const [result] = await db
      .insert(customDocumentTemplatesCS)
      .values(newTemplateData as CustomDocumentTemplateCSInsert)
      .returning();
    if (!result) {
      throw new Error(
        'Failed to create document template, no result returned.'
      );
    }
    // Provenance: enqueue template creation event
    await execute(print(EnqueueFormTemplateCreate), {
      input: {
        name: result.name,
        description: result.description || '',
        category: result.category,
        version: result.version,
        fields: (data.fields as FormFieldInput[]) || [],
        fileInfo: {
          filename: data.file.name,
          fileSize: Number(data.file.size),
          mimeType: data.mimeType
        },
        isPublic: result.isPublic,
        language: result.language,
        tags: result.tags,
        creatorId: creatorId.toString()
      }
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log(
        '[PROVENANCE] Failed to log create custom document template event'
      );
    });

    // Provenance: create audit log entry
    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.TEMPLATE_CREATED,
      category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
      description: `Custom document template ${result.name} created by ${creatorId}`,
      targetUserId: creatorId.toString(),
      documentId: result.id.toString(),
      entityId: result.id.toString(),
      entityType: 'CUSTOM_DOCUMENT_TEMPLATE',
      entityName: result.name,
      success: true
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log(
        '[AUDIT LOGS] Failed to log create custom document template event'
      );
    });

    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to create document template in DB:', error);
    if (storageLocation) {
      try {
        await s3Client.send(
          new DeleteObjectCommand({ Bucket: BUCKET_NAME, Key: storageLocation })
        );
      } catch (s3DeleteError) {
        console.error(
          'Failed to delete S3 object after DB insert failure:',
          s3DeleteError
        );
      }
    }
    throw new Error('Failed to create document template.');
  }
}

/**
 * (Org Admin/Creator) Updates an existing custom document template.
 */
export async function updateCustomDocumentTemplate(
  customTemplateId: bigint,
  data: UpdateCustomDocumentTemplateData
): Promise<CustomDocumentTemplateCS | null> {
  const updaterId = data.updatedBy;

  const existingTemplate = await db.query.customDocumentTemplatesCS.findFirst({
    where: eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.id, customTemplateId)
  });

  if (!existingTemplate) {
    throw new Error(`Template with ID ${customTemplateId} not found.`);
  }

  const updatePayload: Partial<CustomDocumentTemplateCS> = {
    updatedAt: new Date(),
    updatedBy: updaterId as bigint
  };

  if (data.name !== undefined) updatePayload.name = data.name;
  if (data.description !== undefined)
    updatePayload.description = data.description;
  if (data.category !== undefined) updatePayload.category = data.category;
  if (data.version !== undefined) updatePayload.version = data.version;
  if (data.fields !== undefined) updatePayload.fields = data.fields;
  if (data.isPublic !== undefined) updatePayload.isPublic = data.isPublic;
  if (data.tags !== undefined) updatePayload.tags = data.tags;
  if (data.language !== undefined) updatePayload.language = data.language;

  let newS3Key: string | undefined =
    existingTemplate.storageLocation ?? undefined;
  let newFileSize: bigint | undefined = existingTemplate.fileSize ?? undefined;
  let newMimeType: string | undefined = existingTemplate.mimeType;

  if (data.file === null) {
    if (existingTemplate.storageLocation) {
      try {
        await s3Client.send(
          new DeleteObjectCommand({
            Bucket: BUCKET_NAME,
            Key: existingTemplate.storageLocation
          })
        );
        console.info(
          `Deleted existing S3 object: ${existingTemplate.storageLocation}`
        );
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          `Failed to delete S3 object ${existingTemplate.storageLocation}:`,
          error
        );
        throw new Error('Failed to remove existing template file.');
      }
    }
    updatePayload.storageLocation = null;
    updatePayload.fileSize = null;
    updatePayload.mimeType = null;
    updatePayload.hash = null;
    newS3Key = undefined;
    newFileSize = undefined;
  } else if (data.file) {
    if (existingTemplate.storageLocation) {
      try {
        await s3Client.send(
          new DeleteObjectCommand({
            Bucket: BUCKET_NAME,
            Key: existingTemplate.storageLocation
          })
        );
        console.info(
          `Deleted old S3 object: ${existingTemplate.storageLocation} before update`
        );
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(
          `Could not delete old S3 object ${existingTemplate.storageLocation} during update:`,
          error
        );
      }
    }

    const fileToUpload = data.file;
    const fileBuffer = Buffer.from(await fileToUpload.arrayBuffer());
    const s3Key = `org_${existingTemplate.organizationId}/custom_templates/${customTemplateId}/${fileToUpload.name}`;

    try {
      await s3Client.send(
        new PutObjectCommand({
          Bucket: BUCKET_NAME,
          Key: s3Key,
          Body: fileBuffer,
          ContentType: data.mimeType || fileToUpload.type,
          ACL: (
            data.isPublic !== undefined
              ? data.isPublic
              : existingTemplate.isPublic
          )
            ? 'public-read'
            : 'private'
        })
      );
      updatePayload.storageLocation = s3Key;
      updatePayload.fileSize = BigInt(fileToUpload.size);
      updatePayload.mimeType =
        data.mimeType || (fileToUpload.type as MimeTypePSType);
      newS3Key = s3Key;
      newFileSize = BigInt(fileToUpload.size);
      newMimeType = data.mimeType || fileToUpload.type;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to upload updated template file to S3:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to upload updated template file.');
    }
  }

  const significantChanges = Object.keys(updatePayload).filter(
    (key) => key !== 'updatedAt' && key !== 'updatedBy'
  );
  if (significantChanges.length > 0) {
    const [result] = await db
      .update(customDocumentTemplatesCS)
      .set(updatePayload)
      .where(eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.id, customTemplateId))
      .returning();
    if (!result) {
      throw new Error(
        'Failed to update document template, no result returned.'
      );
    }
    // Provenance: enqueue template edit event
    await execute(print(EnqueueFormTemplateEdit), {
      input: {
        templateId: customTemplateId.toString(),
        updaterId: updaterId.toString(),
        changes: {
          description: updatePayload.description || '',
          fields: (data.fields as FormFieldInput[]) || [],
          version: data.version || existingTemplate.version
        }
      }
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log(
        '[PROVENANCE] Failed to log update custom document template event'
      );
    });
    // Provenance: create audit log entry
    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.TEMPLATE_UPDATED,
      category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
      description: `Custom document template ${result.name} updated by ${updaterId}`,
      beforeState: existingTemplate as NestedRecord,
      afterState: result as NestedRecord,
      targetUserId: updaterId.toString(),
      documentId: result.id.toString(),
      entityId: result.id.toString(),
      entityType: 'CUSTOM_DOCUMENT_TEMPLATE',
      entityName: result.name,
      success: true
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log(
        '[AUDIT LOGS] Failed to log update custom document template event'
      );
    });
    return result;
  }

  return existingTemplate;
}

/**
 * (Org Admin/Creator) Soft-deletes a custom document template.
 */
export async function deleteCustomDocumentTemplate(
  customTemplateId: bigint,
  updaterId: bigint // user id who is deleting the template
): Promise<CustomDocumentTemplateCS> {
  const [deletedTemplate] = await db
    .update(customDocumentTemplatesCS)
    .set({
      status: 'INACTIVE' as EntityStatusPSType,
      updatedBy: updaterId as bigint,
      updatedAt: new Date(),
      deletedAt: new Date()
    } as Partial<CustomDocumentTemplateCS>)
    .where(eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.id, customTemplateId))
    .returning();

  if (!deletedTemplate) {
    throw new Error(
      'Failed to delete document template or template not found.'
    );
  }
  // Provenance: enqueue template delete event
  await execute(print(EnqueueFormTemplateDelete), {
    input: {
      templateId: customTemplateId.toString(),
      deleterId: updaterId.toString(),
      organizationId: deletedTemplate.organizationId.toString()
    }
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log(
      '[PROVENANCE] Failed to log delete custom document template event'
    );
  });
  // Provenance: create audit log entry
  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.TEMPLATE_DELETED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
    description: `Custom document template ${deletedTemplate.name} deleted by ${updaterId}`,
    targetUserId: updaterId.toString(),
    documentId: deletedTemplate.id.toString(),
    entityId: deletedTemplate.id.toString(),
    entityType: 'CUSTOM_DOCUMENT_TEMPLATE',
    entityName: deletedTemplate.name,
    success: true
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log(
      '[AUDIT LOGS] Failed to log delete custom document template event'
    );
  });
  return deletedTemplate as CustomDocumentTemplateCS;
}

/**
 * (Org Admin/Creator) Inherits a document template into an organization.
 */
export async function inheritCustomDocumentTemplate(
  customTemplateId: bigint,
  organizationId: bigint,
  inheritingUserId: bigint,
  customFields?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | string[] | null>
): Promise<DocumentCS> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const orgUser = await getDbUser({ claims }); // Assuming user is logged in and has claims

  if (
    !orgUser ||
    orgUser.id !== inheritingUserId ||
    orgUser.organizationId !== organizationId
  ) {
    // Basic check, more robust permission check might be needed (e.g., isCreator, isAdmin role)
    throw new Error('Unauthorized or mismatched user/organization.');
  }
  // Add a proper role check here based on ROLES.L5_USER, ROLES.L6_USER, or isCreator flag from user data
  // For now, proceeding if user ID and org ID match the ones passed.

  const sourceTemplate = await db.query.customDocumentTemplatesCS.findFirst({
    where: and(
      eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.id, customTemplateId),
      eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.status, 'ACTIVE')
    )
  });

  if (!sourceTemplate) {
    throw new Error('Active document template not found.');
  }

  const idGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();
  const newDocumentId = await idGenerator.generateDocumentId();

  let newS3Key: string | undefined;
  let newStorageLocation: string | undefined;
  let newFileHash: string | undefined = sourceTemplate.hash || undefined;
  let newFileSize: bigint = sourceTemplate.fileSize;
  let newMimeType: MimeTypePSType = sourceTemplate.mimeType;

  if (sourceTemplate.storageLocation && ORG_BUCKET_NAME && BUCKET_NAME) {
    // Assuming storageLocation is the full URL, extract original key
    // Example: https://bucket.s3.region.amazonaws.com/templates/templateId/filename.pdf
    // Key: templates/templateId/filename.pdf
    const url = new URL(sourceTemplate.storageLocation);
    const originalS3Key = url.pathname.startsWith('/')
      ? url.pathname.substring(1)
      : url.pathname;

    const originalFilename = sourceTemplate.name; // Use template name for new filename base
    newS3Key = `org_${organizationId}/documents/${newDocumentId}/${originalFilename}`;

    const copySource = `${BUCKET_NAME}/${originalS3Key}`;

    try {
      const copyCommand = new CopyObjectCommand({
        Bucket: ORG_BUCKET_NAME,
        CopySource: encodeURIComponent(copySource),
        Key: newS3Key,
        MetadataDirective: 'COPY', // Copies metadata from source
        TaggingDirective: 'COPY' // Copies tags from source
      });
      await s3Client.send(copyCommand);
      newStorageLocation = `https://${ORG_BUCKET_NAME}.s3.${process.env.S3_REGION}.amazonaws.com/${newS3Key}`;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('S3 copy error during template inheritance:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to copy template file to organization storage.');
    }
  } else if (sourceTemplate.content && !sourceTemplate.storageLocation) {
    // If template is pure JSON content and has no file, this logic needs to handle it.
    // For now, this path assumes a file-less document is not what documentsCS expects due to notNull constraints.
    // This might mean creating a PDF from sourceTemplate.content, uploading it, then proceeding.
    // This is complex and out of scope for initial pass.
    console.warn(
      `Template ${customTemplateId} has no storageLocation. Inheriting as a metadata-only document or requires content-to-file conversion.`
    );
    // We will proceed assuming documentsCS can handle null storageLocation if mimeType allows, though schema says notNull for fileSize.
    // This case needs more definition based on how non-file templates are handled.
    // For now, we will allow it to proceed and rely on DB constraints or later adjustments.
  }

  const inheritedDocData: Omit<DocumentCS, 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'> = {
    id: newDocumentId,
    organizationId: organizationId,
    ownerId: inheritingUserId,
    title: sourceTemplate.name,
    filename: sourceTemplate.name,
    mimeType: newMimeType,
    fileSize: newFileSize,
    hash: newFileHash,
    storageLocation: newStorageLocation,
    s3Key: newS3Key,
    isPublic: sourceTemplate.isPublic || false,
    metadata: sourceTemplate.metadata || {
      copiedFromTemplate: customTemplateId,
      templateContent: sourceTemplate.content
    },
    tags: sourceTemplate.tags || [],
    entityStatus: 'ACTIVE' as EntityStatusPSType,
    status: 'ACTIVE' as DocumentStatus,
    lastModifiedAt: new Date(),
    description: sourceTemplate.description || '',
    templateId: sourceTemplate.id,
    globalTemplateId: null,
    customTemplateId: sourceTemplate.id,
    customFields: customFields || null
  };

  const [createdDocument] = await db
    .insert(documentsCS)
    .values(inheritedDocData)
    .returning();

  if (!createdDocument) {
    throw new Error('Failed to create inherited document record.');
  }
  // Provenance: enqueue template inherit event
  await execute(print(EnqueueFormTemplateInherit), {
    input: {
      templateId: customTemplateId.toString(),
      organizationId: organizationId.toString(),
      ownerId: inheritingUserId.toString(),
      customFields: customFields || {}
    }
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log(
      '[PROVENANCE] Failed to log inherit custom document template event'
    );
  });

  // Provenance: create audit log entry
  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.TEMPLATE_USED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
    description: `Custom document template ${sourceTemplate.name} used by ${inheritingUserId}`,
    documentId: createdDocument.id.toString(),
    entityId: createdDocument.id.toString(),
    entityType: 'DOCUMENT',
    entityName: createdDocument.title || '',
    success: true
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log(
      '[AUDIT LOGS] Failed to log inherit custom document template event'
    );
  });

  return createdDocument as DocumentCS;
}

/**
 * (Org Admin) Creates a shareable link for a custom document template.
 * @param customTemplateId Custom Template ID
 * @param organizationId Organization ID
 * @param expiresInDays Number of days until link expires (default: 1)
 */
export async function publishCustomTemplateLink(
  customTemplateId: bigint,
  organizationId: bigint,
  expiresInDays: number = 1,
  isPublicLink: boolean = false
): Promise<{ shortId: string }> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const orgUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  if (!orgUser || orgUser.organizationId !== organizationId) {
    throw new Error(
      'Unauthorized: User is not part of the specified organization.'
    );
  }

  const isOrgAdmin =
    orgUser.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L6_USER.id ||
    orgUser.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id;

  if (!isOrgAdmin) {
    throw new Error(
      'Permission denied: Only organization admins can publish template links.'
    );
  }

  const sourceTemplate = await db.query.customDocumentTemplatesCS.findFirst({
    where: and(
      eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.id, customTemplateId),
      eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.status, 'ACTIVE')
    )
  });

  if (!sourceTemplate) {
    throw new Error('Active document template not found.');
  }

  const shortId = nanoid(12);
  const idGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();
  const id = await idGenerator.generateDocumentRelationshipId();

  // compute dynamic expiry
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + expiresInDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  await db.insert(templatePublishLinksCS).values({
    id,
    shortId,
    organizationId,
    templateId: customTemplateId,
    createdBy: orgUser.id,
    createdAt: new Date(),
    expiresAt,
    isPublic: isPublicLink
  } as TemplatePublishLinkCSInsert);
  // Provenance: enqueue template publish event
  await execute(print(EnqueueFormTemplatePublish), {
    input: {
      templateId: customTemplateId.toString(),
      publisherId: orgUser.id.toString(),
      organizationId: organizationId.toString(),
      expiresInDays
    }
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log(
      '[PROVENANCE] Failed to log publish custom template link event'
    );
  });

  // Provenance: create audit log entry
  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.DOCUMENT_SHARED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
    description: `Custom document template ${sourceTemplate.name} published by ${orgUser.id}`,
    entityId: customTemplateId.toString(),
    entityType: 'CUSTOM_DOCUMENT_TEMPLATE',
    entityName: sourceTemplate.name,
    documentId: customTemplateId.toString(),
    targetUserId: orgUser.id.toString(),
    success: true
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log(
      '[AUDIT LOGS] Failed to log publish custom template link event'
    );
  });

  return { shortId };
}

/**
 * Retrieves the details of a published custom template link.
 * @param shortId The short ID of the custom template link.
 * @returns An object containing the link details and the full template, or null if not found/expired.
 */
export async function getPublishedCustomTemplateDetails(shortId: string) {
  if (!shortId) return null;

  const linkDetails = await db
    .select()
    .from(templatePublishLinksCS)
    .where(eq(templatePublishLinksCS.shortId, shortId))
    .limit(1)
    .then(([result]) => result);

  if (!linkDetails) {
    return { error: 'INVALID_LINK' };
  }

  if (linkDetails.expiresAt && new Date(linkDetails.expiresAt) < new Date()) {
    return { error: 'EXPIRED_LINK' };
  }

  // get the template from the templateId
  const template = await db
    .select()
    .from(customDocumentTemplatesCS)
    .where(eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.id, linkDetails.templateId))
    .limit(1)
    .then(([result]) => result);

  return {
    link: linkDetails,
    template: template
  };
}

/**
 * Get form responses for a custom template
 * @param templateId The ID of the custom template
 * @param organizationId The organization ID
 * @returns Array of documents created from this template
 */
export async function getCustomTemplateResponses(
  templateId: bigint,
  organizationId: bigint
): Promise<(DocumentCS & { user?: { name: string; primaryEmail: string } })[]> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const orgUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  if (!orgUser || orgUser.organizationId !== organizationId) {
    throw new Error(
      'Unauthorized: User is not part of the specified organization.'
    );
  }

  // Check if user is admin or creator
  const isOrgAdmin =
    orgUser.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L6_USER.id ||
    orgUser.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
    orgUser.isCreator;

  if (!isOrgAdmin) {
    throw new Error(
      'Permission denied: Only organization admins can view template responses.'
    );
  }

  // Get all documents created from this template
  const responses = await db
    .select({
      document: documentsCS,
      user: {
        id: usersCS.id,
        name: usersCS.name,
        primaryEmail: usersCS.primaryEmail
      }
    })
    .from(documentsCS)
    .leftJoin(usersCS, eq(documentsCS.ownerId, usersCS.id))
    .where(
      and(
        eq(documentsCS.templateId, templateId),
        eq(documentsCS.organizationId, organizationId),
        eq(documentsCS.entityStatus, 'ACTIVE')
      )
    )
    .orderBy(documentsCS.createdAt);

  return responses.map((r) => ({
    ...r.document,
    user: r.user
      ? {
          name: r.user.name || 'Unknown User',
          primaryEmail: r.user.primaryEmail || 'No email'
        }
      : undefined
  }));
}

const DocumentStatusChart = ({ documents }: { documents: DocumentCS[] }) => {
  const chartData = useMemo(() => {
    // Handle case where documents is undefined, null, or empty
    if (!documents || documents.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    const statusCounts = documents.reduce(
      (acc, doc) => {
        const status = doc.status || 'UNKNOWN';
        acc[status] = (acc[status] || 0) + 1;
        return acc;
      },
      {} as Record<string, number>
    );
    return Object.entries(statusCounts).map(([name, value]) => ({
      name,
      value
    }));
  }, [documents]);

  const chartConfig: ChartConfig = {
    value: { label: 'Documents' },
    ...chartData.reduce((acc, { name }, i) => {
      acc[name] = {
        label: name,
        color: `var(--chart-${i + 1})`
      };
      return acc;
    }, {} as ChartConfig)
  };

  return (
    <ChartContainer config={chartConfig} className='w-full'>
      <BarChart accessibilityLayer data={chartData}>
        <CartesianGrid vertical={false} />
        <XAxis
          dataKey='name'
          tickLine={false}
          tickMargin={10}
          axisLine={false}
        />
        <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
        <Bar dataKey='value' radius={4}>
          {chartData.map((entry, index) => (
            <Cell key={`cell-${index}`} fill={chartConfig[entry.name]?.color} />
          ))}
        </Bar>
      </BarChart>
    </ChartContainer>
  );
};

const DocumentsOverTimeChart = ({ documents }: { documents: DocumentCS[] }) => {
  const chartData = useMemo(() => {
    // Handle case where documents is undefined, null, or empty
    if (!documents || documents.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    const sortedDocs = [...documents].sort(
      (a, b) =>
        new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(b.createdAt).getTime()
    );
    return sortedDocs
      .map((doc) => ({
        date: new Date(doc.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
          month: 'short',
          day: 'numeric'
        }),
        count: 1
      }))
      .reduce(
        (acc, curr) => {
          const last = acc[acc.length - 1];
          if (last && last.date === curr.date) {
            last.count += 1;
          } else {
            acc.push({ date: curr.date, count: (last?.count || 0) + 1 });
          }
          return acc;
        },
        [] as { date: string; count: number }[]
      );
  }, [documents]);

  const chartConfig = {
    count: {
      label: 'Documents',
      color: 'var(--chart-1)'
    }
  } satisfies ChartConfig;

  return (
    <ChartContainer config={chartConfig}>
      <LineChart
        accessibilityLayer
        data={chartData}
        margin={{
          left: 12,
          right: 12
        }}
      >
        <CartesianGrid vertical={false} />
        <XAxis
          dataKey='date'
          tickLine={false}
          axisLine={false}
          tickMargin={8}
        />
        <ChartTooltip
          cursor={false}
          content={<ChartTooltipContent indicator='dot' />}
        />
        <Line
          dataKey='count'
          type='natural'
          stroke='var(--color-count)'
          strokeWidth={2}
          dot={false}
        />
      </LineChart>
    </ChartContainer>
  );
};

const RoleDistributionRadarChart = ({
  roles,
  members
}: {
  roles: RoleCS[];
  members: UserCS[];
}) => {
  const chartData = useMemo(() => {
    // Handle case where members is undefined, null, or empty
    if (!members || members.length === 0) {
      return roles.map((role) => ({
        name: role.name,
        count: 0
      }));
    }

    const roleCounts = members.reduce(
      (acc, member) => {
        const roleId = member?.organizationRoleId;
        if (roleId) {
          acc[roleId.toString()] = (acc[roleId.toString()] || 0) + 1;
        }
        return acc;
      },
      {} as Record<string, number>
    );

    return roles.map((role) => ({
      name: role.name,
      count: roleCounts[role.id.toString()] || 0
    }));
  }, [roles, members]);

  const chartConfig = {
    count: { label: 'User Count' }
  } satisfies ChartConfig;

  return (
    <ChartContainer config={chartConfig} className='mx-auto aspect-square'>
      <RadarChart data={chartData}>
        <ChartTooltip
          cursor={false}
          content={<ChartTooltipContent indicator='dot' />}
        />
        <PolarAngleAxis dataKey='name' />
        <PolarGrid />
        <Radar
          dataKey='count'
          fill='var(--color-count)'
          fillOpacity={0.6}
          stroke='var(--color-count)'
        />
      </RadarChart>
    </ChartContainer>
  );
};

type TemplatesPageClientProps = {
  initialGlobalTemplates: DocumentTemplate[];
  initialCustomTemplates: CustomDocumentTemplateCS[];
  currentUserLogtoId: string | null;
  currentUserDbId: string | null;
  currentOrganizationId: string | null;
  isSuperAdmin: boolean;
  userRole?: OrganizationRoleId | null;
  isCreator?: boolean;
};

function useUserTemplatePermissions({
  isSuperAdmin,
  currentUserLogtoId,
  currentOrganizationId,
  userRole,
  isCreator
}: Omit<
  TemplatesPageClientProps,
  'initialGlobalTemplates' | 'initialCustomTemplates' | 'currentUserDbId'
>) {
  const { organizationData: contextOrgData } = useUserData();

  const canManageGlobalTemplates = isSuperAdmin;

  const effectiveUserRole =
    userRole ?? contextOrgData?.user?.organizationRoleId;
  const _effectiveIsCreator = isCreator ?? contextOrgData?.user?.isCreator;

  const isOrgAdmin =
    effectiveUserRole === ROLES.L6_USER.id ||
    effectiveUserRole === ROLES.L5_USER.id;

  const canCreateOrEditTemplates = isOrgAdmin || isSuperAdmin;

  const canInheritTemplates = !!currentUserLogtoId && !!currentOrganizationId;
  // && (isOrgAdmin || isOrgCreator); For now, allowing all the users to 'inherit' form/document templates

  const canViewTemplates = true;
  const canPublishTemplates = isOrgAdmin;

  return {
    canManageGlobalTemplates,
    canInheritTemplates,
    canViewTemplates,
    canPublishTemplates,
    canCreateOrEditTemplates
  };
}

export default function TemplatesPageClient({

  currentUserLogtoId,
  currentUserDbId,
  currentOrganizationId,
  isSuperAdmin,
  userRole,

    DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS | null

    DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS | null
  >(null);

  });

      queryFn: getGlobalDocumentTemplates,
      initialData: initialGlobalTemplates
    });

  const { data: customTemplates = [], isLoading: isLoadingCustomTemplates } =
    useQuery<CustomDocumentTemplateCS[]>({
      queryKey: ['customDocumentTemplates', currentOrganizationId],
      queryFn: getCustomDocumentTemplates,
      initialData: initialCustomTemplates
    });

  const inheritGlobalMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (templateId: bigint) => {
      if (!currentUserDbId || !currentOrganizationId) {
        throw new Error(
          'User or Organization ID is missing for inheriting template.'
        );
      }
      return inheritDocumentTemplate(
        templateId,
        BigInt(currentOrganizationId),
        BigInt(currentUserDbId)
      );
    },
    onSuccess: (newDocument: DocumentCS) => {
      toast.success(
        `Template "${globalTemplates.find((t) => t.id === newDocument.templateId)?.name || 'Template'}" inherited successfully as "${newDocument.filename}"!`
      );
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['organizationDocuments'] });
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(`Failed to inherit template: ${error.message}`);
    }
  });

  const inheritCustomMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (templateId: bigint) => {
      if (!currentUserDbId || !currentOrganizationId) {
        throw new Error(
          'User or Organization ID is missing for inheriting template.'
        );
      }
      return inheritCustomDocumentTemplate(
        templateId,
        BigInt(currentOrganizationId),
        BigInt(currentUserDbId)
      );
    },
    onSuccess: (newDocument: DocumentCS) => {
      toast.success(
        `Template "${customTemplates.find((t) => t.id === newDocument.templateId)?.name || 'Template'}" inherited successfully as "${newDocument.filename}"!`
      );
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['organizationDocuments'] });
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(`Failed to inherit template: ${error.message}`);
    }
  });

  const deleteGlobalMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: deleteGlobalDocumentTemplate,
    onSuccess: async (deletedTemplate) => {
      toast.success(`Template "${deletedTemplate.name}" deleted successfully.`);
      await createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.TEMPLATE_DELETED,
        category: AuditLogCategory.TEMPLATE_MANAGEMENT,

        description: `User deleted global template: "${deletedTemplate.name}"`
      }).catch(console.error);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['globalDocumentTemplates'] });
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(`Failed to delete template: ${error.message}`);
    }
  });

    }) => deleteCustomDocumentTemplate(templateId, updaterId),
    onSuccess: async (deletedTemplate) => {

  const handleViewResponses = (
    template: DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS
  ) => {
    if (!currentUserPermissions.canPublishTemplates) {
      toast.error('You do not have permission to view template responses.');
      return;
    }
    setViewingResponsesTemplate(template);
    setIsResponsesDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handlePreviewTemplate = (
    template: DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS
  ) => {
    setPreviewingTemplate(template);
  };

  const handleCloneToCustom = (template: DocumentTemplate) => {
    if (!currentUserPermissions.canCreateOrEditTemplates) {
      toast.error('You do not have permission to create custom templates.');
      return;
    }
    setCloningTemplate(template);
    setIsCreateEditSheetOpen(true);
  };

  const filteredAndSortedGlobalTemplates = useMemo(() => {
    return globalTemplates
      .filter((template) => {
        const searchLower = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
        const matchesSearch =
          template.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          (template.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          template.category.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower);
        const matchesCategory =
          !filterCategory || template.category === filterCategory;
        return matchesSearch && matchesCategory;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (sortBy === 'name') return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
        if (sortBy === 'category') return a.category.localeCompare(b.category);
        if (sortBy === 'version') return a.version.localeCompare(b.version);
        if (sortBy === 'createdAt' && a.createdAt && b.createdAt) {
          return (
            new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime()
          );
        }
        return 0;
      });
  }, [globalTemplates, searchTerm, sortBy, filterCategory]);

  const filteredAndSortedCustomTemplates = useMemo(() => {
    return customTemplates
      .filter((template) => {
        const searchLower = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
        const matchesSearch =
          template.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          (template.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          template.category.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower);
        const matchesCategory =
          !filterCategory || template.category === filterCategory;
        return matchesSearch && matchesCategory;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (sortBy === 'name') return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
        if (sortBy === 'category') return a.category.localeCompare(b.category);
        if (sortBy === 'version') return a.version.localeCompare(b.version);
        if (sortBy === 'createdAt' && a.createdAt && b.createdAt) {
          return (
            new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime()
          );
        }
        return 0;
      });
  }, [customTemplates, searchTerm, sortBy, filterCategory]);

  const uniqueCategories = useMemo(() => {
    const allTemplates =
      activeTab === 'global' ? globalTemplates : customTemplates;
    const categories = new Set(allTemplates.map((t) => t.category));
    return Array.from(categories);
  }, [activeTab, globalTemplates, customTemplates]);

  if (!currentUserPermissions.canViewTemplates) {
    return <p>You do not have permission to view templates.</p>;
  }

  return (
    <div className='space-y-6'>
      <PageHeader
        heading='Form Templates'
        subheading='Browse and use form templates. Create custom templates for your organization or use global templates.'
        rightElement={
          currentUserPermissions.canCreateOrEditTemplates && (
            <Link href='/account/form-templates/create'>
              <Button className='gap-2'>
                <Plus className='size-4' />
                Create Template
              </Button>
            </Link>
          )
        }
      />

      <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab}>
        <div className='mb-6 mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between'>
          <TabsList className='w-fit'>
            <TabsTrigger value='global'>Global</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value='custom'>Custom</TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>
          <div className='flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center'>
            <div className='relative sm:w-60'>
              <Search className='absolute left-3 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground' />
              <Input
                type='search'
                placeholder='Search templates...'
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                className='pl-10'
              />
            </div>
            <div className='flex flex-row flex-wrap items-center gap-2'>
              <div className='flex flex-row flex-wrap items-center gap-2'>
                <Button
                  variant={viewMode === 'list' ? 'secondary' : 'ghost'}
                  size='icon'
                  onClick={() => setViewMode('list')}
                  aria-label='List view'
                >
                  <List className='size-5' />
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant={viewMode === 'grid' ? 'secondary' : 'ghost'}
                  size='icon'
                  onClick={() => setViewMode('grid')}
                  aria-label='Grid view'
                >
                  <LayoutGrid className='size-5' />
                </Button>
              </div>
              <div className='flex flex-row flex-wrap items-center gap-2'>
                <Select value={sortBy} onValueChange={setSortBy}>
                  <SelectTrigger className='w-auto gap-1.5'>
                    <ArrowUpDown className='size-4 text-muted-foreground' />
                    <SelectValue placeholder='Sort by' />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
                    <SelectItem value='name'>Name</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value='category'>Category</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value='version'>Version</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value='createdAt'>Date</SelectItem>
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
                <DropdownMenu>
                  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                    <Button
                      variant='outline'
                      className={cn(
                        'gap-1.5',
                        filterCategory && 'border-primary text-primary'
                      )}
                    >
                      <FilterIcon className='size-4' />
                      Filter
                      <ChevronDown
                        className={cn(
                          'size-4 text-muted-foreground transition-transform',
                          'group-data-[state=open]:rotate-180',
                          filterCategory && 'text-primary'
                        )}
                      />
                    </Button>
                  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                  <DropdownMenuContent align='end' className='font-suisse-intl'>
                    <DropdownMenuItem
                      onClick={() => setFilterCategory(null)}
                      className={cn(
                        !filterCategory && 'bg-primary/20 font-medium'
                      )}
                    >
                      All Categories
                    </DropdownMenuItem>
                    {uniqueCategories.map((category) => (
                      <DropdownMenuItem
                        key={category}
                        onClick={() => setFilterCategory(category)}
                        className={cn(
                          filterCategory === category &&
                            'bg-primary/20 font-medium'
                        )}
                      >
                        {toTitleCase(category)}
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                    ))}
                  </DropdownMenuContent>
                </DropdownMenu>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <TabsContent value='global'>
          {isLoadingGlobalTemplates ? (
            <p>Loading global templates...</p>
          ) : (
            <TemplateList
              templates={filteredAndSortedGlobalTemplates}
              permissions={currentUserPermissions}
              onViewTemplate={handleViewTemplate}
              onPreviewTemplate={handlePreviewTemplate}
              onCloneToCustom={handleCloneToCustom}
              onUseTemplate={handleOpenUseTemplateDialog}
              onEditTemplate={handleEditTemplate}
              onDeleteTemplate={(id) => handleDeleteTemplate(id, false)}
              viewMode={viewMode}
              onPublishLink={handlePublishLink}
              onViewResponses={handleViewResponses}
            />
          )}
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value='custom'>
          {isLoadingCustomTemplates ? (
            <p>Loading custom templates...</p>
          ) : (
            <TemplateList
              templates={filteredAndSortedCustomTemplates}
              permissions={currentUserPermissions}
              onViewTemplate={handleViewTemplate}
              onPreviewTemplate={handlePreviewTemplate}
              onCloneToCustom={undefined} // Not applicable for custom templates
              onUseTemplate={handleOpenUseTemplateDialog}
              onEditTemplate={handleEditTemplate}
              onDeleteTemplate={(id) => handleDeleteTemplate(id, true)}
              viewMode={viewMode}
              onPublishLink={handlePublishLink}
              onViewResponses={handleViewResponses}
            />
          )}
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>

      {(currentUserPermissions.canManageGlobalTemplates && editingTemplate) ||
      (currentUserPermissions.canCreateOrEditTemplates && cloningTemplate) ? (
        <CreateEditTemplateSheet
          isOpen={isCreateEditSheetOpen}
          onOpenChange={(isOpen) => {
            setIsCreateEditSheetOpen(isOpen);
            if (!isOpen) {
              setEditingTemplate(null);
              setCloningTemplate(null);
            }
          }}
          template={editingTemplate || cloningTemplate}
          organizationId={currentOrganizationId}
          currentUserDbId={currentUserDbId}
          onSuccess={(newTemplate) => {
            queryClient.invalidateQueries({
              queryKey: ['globalDocumentTemplates']
            });
            queryClient.invalidateQueries({
              queryKey: ['customDocumentTemplates', currentOrganizationId]
            });
            setIsCreateEditSheetOpen(false);
            setEditingTemplate(null);
            setCloningTemplate(null);

            // Check if this was a clone operation
            const wasCloning = !!cloningTemplate;
            if (wasCloning) {
              toast.success(
                `Global template "${cloningTemplate?.name}" cloned successfully as custom template!`
              );
            } else {
              toast.success(
                `Template "${newTemplate.name}" updated successfully!`
              );
            }
          }}
        />
      ) : null}

      {viewingTemplate && (
        <TemplateDetailsSheet
          template={viewingTemplate}
          onClose={() => setViewingTemplate(null)}
        />
      )}

      <UseTemplateDialog
        key={
          selectedTemplateForUse ? selectedTemplateForUse.id.toString() : 'new'
        }
        isOpen={isUseTemplateDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsUseTemplateDialogOpen}
        template={selectedTemplateForUse}
        onSuccess={() => {
          queryClient.invalidateQueries({
            queryKey: ['organizationDocuments']
          });
          setIsUseTemplateDialogOpen(false);
          setSelectedTemplateForUse(null);
        }}
        currentUserDbId={currentUserDbId}
        currentOrganizationId={currentOrganizationId}
        currentOrganizationName={
          organizationLoading
            ? 'Unknown Organization'
            : organizationData?.organization?.name
        }
        currentUserName={
          organizationLoading
            ? 'Unknown User'
            : extractNameFromUser(organizationData?.user)
        }
      />

      <PublishTemplateDialog
        isOpen={isPublishDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={(isOpen) => {
          setIsPublishDialogOpen(isOpen);
          if (!isOpen) {
            setPublishingTemplate(null);
          }
        }}
        template={publishingTemplate}
        organizationId={currentOrganizationId}
        isPublicLink={false}
      />

      <TemplateResponsesDialog
        isOpen={isResponsesDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={(isOpen) => {
          setIsResponsesDialogOpen(isOpen);
          if (!isOpen) {
            setViewingResponsesTemplate(null);
          }
        }}
        template={viewingResponsesTemplate}
        organizationId={currentOrganizationId}
      />

      {previewingTemplate && (
        <TemplatePreviewSheet
          isOpen={!!previewingTemplate}
          onOpenChange={(isOpen) => !isOpen && setPreviewingTemplate(null)}
          template={previewingTemplate}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const dailyFormSchema = z
  .object({
    title: z.string().min(1, 'Title is required'),
    description: z.string().optional(),
    location: z.string().optional(),
    day: z.date(),
    fromTime: z.string(),
    toTime: z.string(),
    eventType: z.nativeEnum(CalendarEventType),
    color: z.string(),
    attendees: z.array(
      z.custom<{ user: User | null | undefined } & TeamMember>()
    )
  })
  .refine(
    (data) => {
      const [fromHour, fromMinute] = data.fromTime.split(':').map(Number);
      const [toHour, toMinute] = data.toTime.split(':').map(Number);
      return (
        toHour > fromHour || (toHour === fromHour && toMinute > fromMinute)
      );
    },
    {
      message: 'End time must be after start time',
      path: ['toTime']
    }
  );

const weekFormSchema = z
  .object({
    title: z.string().min(1, 'Title is required'),
    description: z.string().optional(),
    location: z.string().optional(),
    startDate: z.date(),
    endDate: z.date(),
    startTime: z.string(),
    endTime: z.string(),
    eventType: z.nativeEnum(CalendarEventType),
    color: z.string(),
    attendees: z.array(
      z.custom<{ user: User | null | undefined } & TeamMember>()
    )
  })
  .refine(
    (data) => {
      return data.endDate >= data.startDate;
    },
    {
      message: 'End date must be after or equal to start date',
      path: ['endDate']
    }
  );

const fullDayFormSchema = z
  .object({
    title: z.string().min(1, 'Title is required'),
    description: z.string().optional(),
    location: z.string().optional(),
    startDate: z.date(),
    endDate: z.date(),
    eventType: z.nativeEnum(CalendarEventType),
    color: z.string(),
    attendees: z.array(
      z.custom<{ user: User | null | undefined } & TeamMember>()
    )
  })
  .refine(
    (data) => {
      // Calculate the difference in hours
      const diffInHours =
        (data.endDate.getTime() - data.startDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      return diffInHours >= 24 && diffInHours <= 72;
    },
    {
      message: 'Full day events must be between 24 and 72 hours',
      path: ['endDate']
    }
  )
  .refine(
    (data) => {
      // Ensure both dates start at midnight (00:00)
      return (
        data.startDate.getHours() === 0 &&
        data.startDate.getMinutes() === 0 &&
        data.endDate.getHours() === 0 &&
        data.endDate.getMinutes() === 0
      );
    },
    {
      message: 'Full day events must start and end at midnight (00:00)',
      path: ['endDate']
    }
  );

export default function CalendarNewEventDialog() {
  const {
    newEventDialogOpen,
    setNewEventDialogOpen,
    date,
    onEventAdd,
    teamMembers,
    selectedDate,
    eventFormMode
  } = useCalendarContext();

  const dailyForm = useForm<z.infer<typeof dailyFormSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(dailyFormSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      title: '',
      description: '',
      location: '',
      day: date,
      fromTime: format(
        roundToNearestMinutes(new Date(), {
          nearestTo: 15
        }),
        'HH:mm'
      ),
      toTime: format(
        roundToNearestMinutes(addMinutes(new Date(), 60), {
          nearestTo: 15
        }),
        'HH:mm'
      ),
      eventType: CalendarEventType.MEETING,
      color: 'blue',
      attendees: []
    }
  });

  const weekForm = useForm<z.infer<typeof weekFormSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(weekFormSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      title: '',
      description: '',
      location: '',
      startDate: startOfWeek(date, { weekStartsOn: 1 }),
      endDate: endOfWeek(date, { weekStartsOn: 1 }),
      startTime: '00:00',
      endTime: '00:00',
      eventType: CalendarEventType.MEETING,
      color: 'blue',
      attendees: []
    }
  });

  const fullDayForm = useForm<z.infer<typeof fullDayFormSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(fullDayFormSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      title: '',
      description: '',
      location: '',
      startDate: startOfDay(date),
      endDate: startOfDay(addDays(date, 1)),
      eventType: CalendarEventType.MEETING,
      color: 'blue',
      attendees: []
    }
  });

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  // Handle selectedDate updates
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedDate) {
      const roundedTime = roundToNearestMinutes(selectedDate, {
        nearestTo: 15
      });

      if (eventFormMode === 'full-week') {
        const weekStart = startOfWeek(selectedDate, {
          weekStartsOn: 1
        });
        const weekEnd = endOfWeek(selectedDate, {
          weekStartsOn: 1
        });

        weekForm.setValue('startDate', weekStart);
        weekForm.setValue('endDate', weekEnd);
        weekForm.setValue('startTime', format(roundedTime, 'HH:mm'));
        weekForm.setValue('endTime', format(roundedTime, 'HH:mm'));
      } else if (eventFormMode === 'full-day') {
        const dayStart = startOfDay(selectedDate);
        const dayEnd = startOfDay(addDays(selectedDate, 1));

        fullDayForm.setValue('startDate', dayStart);
        fullDayForm.setValue('endDate', dayEnd);
      } else {
        const endTime = addHours(roundedTime, 2);
        dailyForm.setValue('day', roundedTime);
        dailyForm.setValue('fromTime', format(roundedTime, 'HH:mm'));
        dailyForm.setValue('toTime', format(endTime, 'HH:mm'));
      }
    }
  }, [selectedDate, eventFormMode, dailyForm, weekForm, fullDayForm]);

        name='description'
        render={({ field }) => (
          <FormItem>

                  // Ensure the date is set to midnight
                  const midnightDate = startOfDay(date);
                  field.onChange(midnightDate);

                  // Automatically set end date to next midnight
                  const nextMidnight = startOfDay(addDays(midnightDate, 1));
                  fullDayForm.setValue('endDate', nextMidnight);

      return (
        <Form {...dailyForm}>
          <form
            className='space-y-4'
            onSubmit={dailyForm.handleSubmit(onDailySubmit)}
          >
            {renderCommonFields(dailyForm)}

            </div>
          </form>
        </Form>
      );
    }

    if (eventFormMode === 'full-week') {
      return (
        <Form {...weekForm}>
          <form
            className='space-y-4'
            onSubmit={weekForm.handleSubmit(onWeekSubmit)}
          >
            {renderCommonFields(weekForm)}

                type='submit'

                ) : (
                  <PlusIcon className='mr-2 size-4' />
                )}
                {loading ? 'Creating event...' : 'Create event'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Form>
      );
    }

    return (
      <Form {...fullDayForm}>
        <form
          className='space-y-4'
          onSubmit={fullDayForm.handleSubmit(onFullDaySubmit)}
        >
          {renderCommonFields(fullDayForm)}
          {renderFullDayFields()}
          <div className='flex justify-end pt-4'>
            <Button
              disabled={!fullDayForm.formState.isValid || loading}
              type='submit'
            >
              {loading ? (
                <Loader2 className='mr-2 size-4 animate-spin' />
              ) : (
                <PlusIcon className='mr-2 size-4' />
              )}
              {loading ? 'Creating event...' : 'Create event'}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Form>
    );
  };

  return (
    <Sheet onOpenChange={setNewEventDialogOpen} open={newEventDialogOpen}>
      <SheetContent className='w-[400px] overflow-y-auto sm:w-[540px]'>
        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle>
            Create {EVENT_MODE_TITLES[eventFormMode]} Event
          </SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription>
            Add a new event to your team calendar
          </SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>
        <div className='mt-6'>{renderEventForm()}</div>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

type DocumentListProps = {

  onUpdateDocumentStatus: (

    newStatus: DocumentStatus

  viewMode: 'list' | 'grid';

type DocumentControlsProps = {
  searchTerm: string;
  onSearchChange: (term: string) => void;
  viewMode: 'list' | 'grid';
  onViewModeChange: (mode: 'list' | 'grid') => void;
  sortBy: 'title' | 'updatedAt' | 'status' | 'createdAt';
  onSortChange: (

  ) => void;
  filterStatus: string | null;
  onFilterStatusChange: (status: string | null) => void;
};

const DocumentControls: React.FC<DocumentControlsProps> = ({
  searchTerm,
  onSearchChange,
  viewMode,
  onViewModeChange,
  sortBy,
  onSortChange,
  filterStatus,
  onFilterStatusChange

            aria-label='List view'
          >
            <List className='size-5' />
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={viewMode === 'grid' ? 'secondary' : 'ghost'}
            size='icon'

          >
            <LayoutGrid className='size-5' />
          </Button>
        </div>
        <div className='flex flex-row items-center gap-2'>

              <SelectValue
                placeholder='Sort by'
                className='text-muted-foreground'
              />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
              <SelectItem value='title'>Title</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value='updatedAt'>Updated</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value='createdAt'>Created</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value='status'>Status</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
              <Button
                variant='outline'
                className={cn(
                  'gap-1.5',
                  filterStatus && 'border-primary text-primary'
                )}
              >
                <FilterIcon className='size-4' />
                {filterStatus
                  ? toTitleCase(filterStatus.replace(/_/gu, ' '))
                  : 'Filter'}
                <ChevronDown
                  className={cn(
                    'size-4 text-muted-foreground transition-transform',
                    'group-data-[state=open]:rotate-180',

            <DropdownMenuContent
              align='end'
              className='font-suisse-intl'
              side='bottom'
            >
              <DropdownMenuItem
                onClick={() => onFilterStatusChange(null)}
                className={cn(!filterStatus && 'bg-primary/20 font-medium')}
              >
                All Statuses
              </DropdownMenuItem>
              {DocumentStatusEnums.filter(
                (status) =>

export function DocumentList({
  documents,
  onUpdateDocumentStatus,
  viewMode,
  searchTerm,
  onSearchChange,
  sortBy,
  onSortChange,
  onViewModeChange,
  filterStatus,
  onFilterStatusChange
}: Readonly<DocumentListProps>) {
  const [selectedDocument, setSelectedDocument] = useState<DocumentCS | null>(
    null
  );
  const [isViewOpen, setIsViewOpen] = useState(false);
  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isPreviewLoading, setIsPreviewLoading] = useState(false);
  const { organizationData } = useUserData();
  const { isLoading: documentsLoading, refetch: refetchDocuments } =
    useDocuments();
  const [editingDocument, setEditingDocument] = useState<DocumentCS | null>(
    null
  );
  const [signingDocument, setSigningDocument] = useState<DocumentCS | null>(
    null
  );
  // Pagination for grid view
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const pageSize = 9;
  const router = useRouter();
  const copyLinkMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (documentId: string) => {
      const url = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/documents/${documentId}`;
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
      return url;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success('Link copied to clipboard');
    },
    onError: () => {
      toast.error('Failed to copy link');
    }
  });

  const downloadMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (doc: DocumentCS) => {
      if (doc.s3Key) {
        const downloadUrl = await getSecureDocumentDownloadUrl(
          doc.s3Key,
          'download'
        );
        window.open(downloadUrl, '_blank');
        return downloadUrl;
      } else if (doc.storageLocation) {
        toast('Attempting direct download. Secure link unavailable.');
        window.open(doc.storageLocation, '_blank');
        return doc.storageLocation;
      }
      throw new Error('Document not available for download.');
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success('Document download initiated');
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to get download link for document');
    }
  });

  const handleViewDocument = (document: DocumentCS) => {
    setSelectedDocument(document);
    setIsViewOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenSignSheet = (document: DocumentCS) => {
    setSigningDocument(document);
  };

  const handleSignSuccess = (updatedDocument: DocumentCS) => {
    setSigningDocument(null);
    toast.success(`Document "${updatedDocument.title}" signed successfully.`);
    refetchDocuments();
  };

  const handleRequestAccess = async (document: DocumentCS) => {
    toast.loading('Sending access request...');

    try {
      const result = await sendDocumentAccessRequestNotification({
        documentId: document.id,
        documentName:
          document.title || document.filename || 'Untitled Document',
        ownerId: document.ownerId || '',
        organizationId: organizationData.organization.id,
        requesterId: organizationData.user.id,
        requesterName: organizationData.user.name || 'A user'
      });

      if (result) {
        toast.dismiss();
        toast.success('Access request sent successfully');
        await createAuditLogEntry({
          action: AuditLogAction.DOCUMENT_ACCESS_REQUESTED,
          category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
          entityId: document.id,
          entityType: 'document',
          entityName: document.title || document.filename,
          description: `User requested access to document: "${document.title || document.filename}"`,
          targetUserId: document.ownerId
        }).catch(console.error);
      } else {
        toast.dismiss();
        toast.error('Failed to send access request');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.dismiss();
      toast.error('An error occurred while sending the request');
      console.error('Error requesting document access:', error);
    }
  };

  const handleOpenEditDialog = (doc: DocumentCS) => {
    setEditingDocument(doc);
  };

  const handleEditSuccess = (_updatedDocument: DocumentCS) => {
    setEditingDocument(null);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedDocument && selectedDocument.s3Key && isViewOpen) {
      setIsPreviewLoading(true);
      setPreviewUrl(null);
      getSecureDocumentDownloadUrl(selectedDocument.s3Key, 'preview')
        .then((url) => {
          setPreviewUrl(url);
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          console.error('Failed to get preview URL:', error);
          toast.error('Could not load document preview.');
          setPreviewUrl(null);
        })
        .finally(() => {
          setIsPreviewLoading(false);
        });
    } else if (isViewOpen && selectedDocument && !selectedDocument.s3Key) {
      setPreviewUrl(null);
      setIsPreviewLoading(false);
      toast.error('Preview unavailable: Document key missing or invalid.');
    } else if (!isViewOpen) {
      setSelectedDocument(null);
      setPreviewUrl(null);
      setIsPreviewLoading(false);
    }
  }, [selectedDocument, isViewOpen]);

  // Reset page when filters or source list changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setPage(1);
  }, [documents.length, searchTerm, sortBy, filterStatus]);

  if (documentsLoading) {
    return (
      <div className='flex h-32 items-center justify-center'>
        <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <DocumentControls
        searchTerm={searchTerm}
        onSearchChange={onSearchChange}
        viewMode={viewMode}
        onViewModeChange={onViewModeChange}
        sortBy={sortBy}
        onSortChange={onSortChange}
        filterStatus={filterStatus}
        onFilterStatusChange={onFilterStatusChange}
      />
      {!documentsLoading && documents.length === 0 ? (
        <div className='flex h-40 flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-dashed p-8 text-center'>
          <div>
            <h3 className='font-medium'>No documents found</h3>
            <p className='mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
              Upload documents to get started.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div>
          {viewMode === 'grid' && (
            <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3'>
              {(() => {
                const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;
                const end = page * pageSize;
                const pageDocs = documents.slice(start, end);
                return pageDocs.map((document) => (
                  <DocumentCard
                    key={document.id.toString()}
                    document={document}
                    onView={handleViewDocument}
                    onUpdateDocumentStatus={onUpdateDocumentStatus}
                    className='group relative rounded-lg border bg-secondary/10 p-4 transition-all hover:border-primary'
                  />
                ));
              })()}
            </div>
          )}
          {viewMode === 'grid' && documents.length > pageSize && (
            <div className='mt-4 flex justify-end'>
              <Pagination
                currentPage={page}
                totalPages={Math.max(1, Math.ceil(documents.length / pageSize))}
                paginationItemsToDisplay={3}
                onPageChange={(p) =>
                  setPage(
                    Math.min(
                      Math.max(1, Math.ceil(documents.length / pageSize)),
                      Math.max(1, p)
                    )
                  )
                }
              />
            </div>
          )}
          {viewMode === 'list' && (
            <div className='overflow-hidden rounded-lg border'>
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow className='bg-muted/50'>
                    <TableHead className='w-2/5 px-4 py-3 sm:w-[35%]'>
                      Document
                    </TableHead>
                    <TableHead className='hidden px-4 py-3 sm:table-cell'>
                      Status
                    </TableHead>
                    <TableHead className='hidden px-4 py-3 md:table-cell'>
                      Activity
                    </TableHead>
                    <TableHead className='px-4 py-3 text-right'>
                      Actions
                    </TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {documents.map((document) => (
                    <TableRow
                      key={document.id.toString()}
                      className='hover:bg-muted/50'
                    >
                      <TableCell className='flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 font-medium'>
                        <FileText className='hidden size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 shrink-0 text-primary md:block' />
                        <div className='line-clamp-1 flex flex-col'>
                          <h4 className='font-semibold text-foreground'>
                            {document.title
                              ? document.title.length > 20
                                ? document.title.slice(0, 20) + '...'
                                : document.title
                              : document.filename?.split('.')[0] ||
                                'Untitled Document'}
                          </h4>
                          <p className='text-ellipsis text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                            {(document.description &&
                            document.description.length > 30
                              ? document.description.slice(0, 25) + '...'
                              : document.description) ||
                              'No description provided...'}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className='hidden px-4 py-3 text-sm sm:table-cell'>
                        <DocumentStatusHighlight status={document.status} />
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className='hidden px-4 py-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground md:table-cell'>
                        {document.updatedAt || document.createdAt
                          ? (() => {
                              const d =
                                document.updatedAt ?? document.createdAt;
                              return d
                                ? formatDistanceToNow(new Date(d), {
                                    addSuffix: true
                                  })
                                : '-';
                            })()
                          : '-'}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className='px-4 py-3 text-right'>
                        <DropdownMenu modal={false}>
                          <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                            <Button
                              variant='ghost'
                              size='icon'
                              className='size-8'
                            >
                              <MoreVertical className='size-4' />
                              <span className='sr-only'>Open menu</span>
                            </Button>
                          </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                          <DropdownMenuContent
                            className='font-suisse-intl'
                            align='end'
                          >
                            <DropdownMenuItem
                              onClick={() => handleViewDocument(document)}
                            >
                              <Eye className='mr-2 size-4' />
                              <span>View</span>
                            </DropdownMenuItem>
                            <DropdownMenuItem
                              onClick={() => handleOpenEditDialog(document)}
                            >
                              <Pencil className='mr-2 size-4' />
                              <span>Edit</span>
                            </DropdownMenuItem>
                            <DropdownMenuItem
                              onClick={() => handleOpenSignSheet(document)}
                              disabled={
                                document.status === ('SIGNED' as DocumentStatus)
                              }
                            >
                              <Signature className='mr-2 size-4' />
                              <span>E-Sign</span>
                            </DropdownMenuItem>
                            <DropdownMenuItem
                              onClick={() =>
                                copyLinkMutation.mutate(document.id.toString())
                              }
                            >
                              <CopyIcon className='mr-2 size-4' />
                              <span>Copy link</span>
                            </DropdownMenuItem>
                            {/* Disabled download button for now; We can only provide the download option to paid users; keep it disabled by default */}
                            {/* <DropdownMenuItem
                              onClick={() => downloadMutation.mutate(document)}
                            >
                              <Download className='mr-2 size-4' />
                              <span>Download</span>
                            </DropdownMenuItem> */}
                            {document.status === 'ACTIVE' ? (
                              <DropdownMenuItem
                                onClick={() =>
                                  onUpdateDocumentStatus(
                                    document,
                                    'ARCHIVED' as DocumentStatus
                                  )
                                }
                              >
                                <ArchiveIcon className='mr-2 size-4' />
                                <span>Archive</span>
                              </DropdownMenuItem>
                            ) : document.status === 'ARCHIVED' ? (
                              <DropdownMenuItem
                                onClick={() =>
                                  onUpdateDocumentStatus(
                                    document,
                                    'ACTIVE' as DocumentStatus
                                  )
                                }
                              >
                                <ArchiveRestoreIcon className='mr-2 size-4' />
                                <span>Unarchive</span>
                              </DropdownMenuItem>
                            ) : null}
                            {/* More Details (redirects to the /documents/[documentId] page) */}
                            <DropdownMenuItem
                              onClick={() =>
                                router.push(`/account/documents/${document.id}`)
                              }
                            >
                              <Info className='mr-2 size-4' />
                              <span>More Details</span>
                            </DropdownMenuItem>
                          </DropdownMenuContent>
                        </DropdownMenu>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
              {documents.length === 0 && (
                <div className='p-6 text-center text-muted-foreground'>
                  No documents to display in list view.
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Document Preview Sheet */}
      <DocumentPreviewSheet
        key={selectedDocument?.id || ''}
        selectedDocument={selectedDocument}
        isOpen={isViewOpen}
        previewUrl={previewUrl}
        isPreviewLoading={isPreviewLoading}
        onOpenChange={setIsViewOpen}
        onDownload={() => downloadMutation.mutate(selectedDocument)}
        onRequestAccess={() => handleRequestAccess(selectedDocument)}
        onEdit={() => handleOpenEditDialog(selectedDocument)}
      />

      {/* Edit Document Dialog Instance */}
      {editingDocument && (
        <EditDocumentDialog
          document={editingDocument}
          isOpen={true}
          onOpenChange={(isOpen) => {
            if (!isOpen) setEditingDocument(null);
          }}
          onSuccess={handleEditSuccess}
        />
      )}
      {/* E-Sign Document Sheet Instance */}
      <ESignDocumentSheet
        document={signingDocument}
        isOpen={!!signingDocument}
        onOpenChange={(isOpen) => {
          if (!isOpen) setSigningDocument(null);
        }}
        onSuccess={handleSignSuccess}
      />
    </>
  );
}

'use server';
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-non-null-assertion */

import { EntityIdGenerator } from '@signvault/core-id-ts';
import { auditLogsCS, usersCS } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_';
import type {
  AuditLogCS,
  AuditLogCSInsert,
  NestedRecord
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import { and, desc, eq, gte, ilike, lte, or, count, asc } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { alias } from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core';
import { headers } from 'next/headers';
import { getDbUser } from '@/actions/auth';
import {
  type AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogSeverity,
  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';

export type GetAuditLogsSchema = {

  pageSize?: number;

    actions?: AuditLogAction[];
    categories?: AuditLogCategory[];
    severities?: AuditLogSeverity[];
    entityTypes?: string[];

    dateTo?: Date;
