/**
 * Create a new audit log entry
 */
export async function createAuditLogEntry(input: CreateAuditLogInput) {
  try {
    const validation = input as CreateAuditLogSchema;
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

    if (!dbUser) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not authenticated' };
    }

    const user = dbUser;
    const headersList = await headers();
    const ipAddress =
      headersList.get('x-forwarded-for') ||
      headersList.get('x-real-ip') ||
      'unknown';
    const userAgent = headersList.get('user-agent') || 'unknown';

    const idGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();
    const auditLogId = await idGenerator.generateAuditLogId();
    const requestId = headersList.get('x-request-id') || `req_${auditLogId}`;

    const [auditLog] = await db
      .insert(auditLogsCS)
      .values({
        id: auditLogId,
        organizationId: user.organizationId!,
        userId: user.id,
        action: validation.action,
        category: validation.category,
        severity: validation.severity || 'INFO',
        entityType: validation.entityType,
        entityId: validation.entityId,
        entityName: validation.entityName,
        description: validation.description,
        metadata: validation.metadata || {},
        ipAddress,
        userAgent,
        sessionId: `session_${user.id}_${Date.now()}`,
        sourceSystem: validation.sourceSystem || 'USER_MANAGEMENT',
        requestId,
        targetUserId: validation.targetUserId,
        teamId: validation.teamId,
        documentId: validation.documentId,
        globalDocumentTemplateId: validation.globalDocumentTemplateId,
        customDocumentTemplateId: validation.customDocumentTemplateId,
        beforeState: validation.beforeState,
        afterState: validation.afterState,
        success: validation.success !== undefined ? validation.success : true,
        errorMessage: validation.errorMessage,
        duration: validation.duration
      } as AuditLogCSInsert)
      .returning();

    return { success: true, data: auditLog };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to create audit log entry:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : 'Failed to create audit log entry'
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Get audit logs with pagination, filtering, and sorting
 */
export async function getAuditLogs(input: GetAuditLogsSchema) {
  try {
    const {
      page = 1,
      pageSize = 20,
      filters = {},
      sort = { field: 'createdAt', direction: 'desc' }
    } = input || {};
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

    if (!dbUser) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not authenticated' };
    }

    const user = dbUser;
    const offset = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    // Build WHERE conditions
    const whereConditions = [
      eq(auditLogsCS.organizationId, user.organizationId!)
    ];

    // Apply filters
    if (filters.actions && filters.actions.length > 0) {
      whereConditions.push(
        or(...filters.actions.map((action) => eq(auditLogsCS.action, action)))!
      );
    }

    if (filters.categories && filters.categories.length > 0) {
      whereConditions.push(
        or(
          ...filters.categories.map((category) =>
            eq(auditLogsCS.category, category)
          )
        )!
      );
    }

    if (filters.severities && filters.severities.length > 0) {
      whereConditions.push(
        or(
          ...filters.severities.map((severity) =>
            eq(auditLogsCS.severity, severity)
          )
        )!
      );
    }

    if (filters.entityTypes && filters.entityTypes.length > 0) {
      whereConditions.push(
        or(
          ...filters.entityTypes.map((entityType) =>
            eq(auditLogsCS.entityType, entityType)
          )
        )!
      );
    }

    if (filters.entityNames && filters.entityNames.length > 0) {
      whereConditions.push(
        or(
          ...filters.entityNames.map((entityName) =>
            eq(auditLogsCS.entityName, entityName)
          )
        )!
      );
    }

    if (filters.userIds && filters.userIds.length > 0) {
      whereConditions.push(
        or(...filters.userIds.map((userId) => eq(auditLogsCS.userId, userId)))!
      );
    }

    if (filters.targetUserIds && filters.targetUserIds.length > 0) {
      whereConditions.push(
        or(
          ...filters.targetUserIds.map((targetUserId) =>
            eq(auditLogsCS.targetUserId, targetUserId)
          )
        )!
      );
    }

    if (filters.teamIds && filters.teamIds.length > 0) {
      whereConditions.push(
        or(...filters.teamIds.map((teamId) => eq(auditLogsCS.teamId, teamId)))!
      );
    }

    if (filters.documentIds && filters.documentIds.length > 0) {
      whereConditions.push(
        or(
          ...filters.documentIds.map((documentId) =>
            eq(auditLogsCS.documentId, documentId)
          )
        )!
      );
    }

    if (filters.success !== undefined) {
      whereConditions.push(eq(auditLogsCS.success, filters.success));
    }

    if (filters.dateFrom) {
      whereConditions.push(gte(auditLogsCS.createdAt, filters.dateFrom));
    }

    if (filters.dateTo) {
      whereConditions.push(lte(auditLogsCS.createdAt, filters.dateTo));
    }

    if (filters.search) {
      whereConditions.push(
        or(
          ilike(auditLogsCS.description, `%${filters.search}%`),
          ilike(auditLogsCS.entityName, `%${filters.search}%`)
        )!
      );
    }

    // Build ORDER BY
    const orderByColumn =
      sort.field === 'createdAt'
        ? auditLogsCS.createdAt
        : sort.field === 'action'
          ? auditLogsCS.action
          : sort.field === 'category'
            ? auditLogsCS.category
            : sort.field === 'severity'
              ? auditLogsCS.severity
              : sort.field === 'entityType'
                ? auditLogsCS.entityType
                : auditLogsCS.createdAt;

    const orderBy =
      sort.direction === 'asc' ? asc(orderByColumn) : desc(orderByColumn);

    // Get total count
    const totalCount: number = await db
      .select({ totalCount: count() })
      .from(auditLogsCS)
      .where(and(...whereConditions))
      .then((result) => result[0].totalCount)
      .catch((error) => {
        console.error('Failed to get audit log count:', error);
        return 0;
      });

    // Get paginated data with user joins
    const auditLogs = await db
      .select({
        id: auditLogsCS.id,
        organizationId: auditLogsCS.organizationId,
        userId: auditLogsCS.userId,
        action: auditLogsCS.action,
        category: auditLogsCS.category,
        severity: auditLogsCS.severity,
        entityType: auditLogsCS.entityType,
        entityId: auditLogsCS.entityId,
        entityName: auditLogsCS.entityName,
        description: auditLogsCS.description,
        metadata: auditLogsCS.metadata,
        ipAddress: auditLogsCS.ipAddress,
        userAgent: auditLogsCS.userAgent,
        sessionId: auditLogsCS.sessionId,
        sourceSystem: auditLogsCS.sourceSystem,
        requestId: auditLogsCS.requestId,
        targetUserId: auditLogsCS.targetUserId,
        teamId: auditLogsCS.teamId,
        documentId: auditLogsCS.documentId,
        globalDocumentTemplateId: auditLogsCS.globalDocumentTemplateId,
        customDocumentTemplateId: auditLogsCS.customDocumentTemplateId,
        beforeState: auditLogsCS.beforeState,
        afterState: auditLogsCS.afterState,
        success: auditLogsCS.success,
        errorMessage: auditLogsCS.errorMessage,
        duration: auditLogsCS.duration,
        createdAt: auditLogsCS.createdAt,
        retentionPeriod: auditLogsCS.retentionPeriod,
        expiresAt: auditLogsCS.expiresAt,
        // Join user information
        user: {
          name: usersCS.name,
          primaryEmail: usersCS.primaryEmail,
          username: usersCS.username
        }
      })
      .from(auditLogsCS)
      .leftJoin(usersCS, eq(auditLogsCS.userId, usersCS.id))
      .where(and(...whereConditions))
      .orderBy(orderBy)
      .limit(pageSize)
      .offset(offset);

    const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalCount / pageSize);

    const result: PaginatedAuditLogs = {
      data: auditLogs.map((log) => ({
        ...log,
        user: log.user.name ? log.user : undefined,
        targetUser: undefined // Simplified for now
      })),
      total: totalCount,
      page,
      pageSize,
      totalPages
    };

    return { success: true, data: result };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to get audit logs:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to get audit logs'
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Export audit logs to CSV format
 */
export async function exportAuditLogsToCSV(input: {
  filters?: AuditLogFiltersType;
  selectedIds?: bigint[];
}) {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

    if (!dbUser) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not authenticated' };
    }

    const user = dbUser;

    // Build WHERE conditions
    const whereConditions = [
      eq(auditLogsCS.organizationId, user.organizationId!)
    ];

    // If specific IDs are selected, filter by those
    if (input.selectedIds && input.selectedIds.length > 0) {
      whereConditions.push(
        or(...input.selectedIds.map((id) => eq(auditLogsCS.id, id)))!
      );
    }

    // Get all matching records (limited to 10,000 for safety)
    const auditLogs = await db
      .select({
        id: auditLogsCS.id,
        createdAt: auditLogsCS.createdAt,
        action: auditLogsCS.action,
        category: auditLogsCS.category,
        severity: auditLogsCS.severity,
        entityType: auditLogsCS.entityType,
        entityId: auditLogsCS.entityId,
        entityName: auditLogsCS.entityName,
        description: auditLogsCS.description,
        success: auditLogsCS.success,
        errorMessage: auditLogsCS.errorMessage,
        duration: auditLogsCS.duration,
        ipAddress: auditLogsCS.ipAddress,
        sourceSystem: auditLogsCS.sourceSystem,
        userName: usersCS.name,
        userEmail: usersCS.primaryEmail
      })
      .from(auditLogsCS)
      .leftJoin(usersCS, eq(auditLogsCS.userId, usersCS.id))
      .where(and(...whereConditions))
      .orderBy(desc(auditLogsCS.createdAt))
      .limit(10000);

    // Convert to CSV format
    const csvHeaders = [
      'ID',
      'Date',
      'Action',
      'Category',
      'Severity',
      'Entity Type',
      'Entity ID',
      'Entity Name',
      'Description',
      'Success',
      'Error Message',
      'Duration (ms)',
      'IP Address',
      'Source System',
      'User Name',
      'User Email'
    ];

    const csvRows = auditLogs.map((log) => [
      log.id.toString(),
      log.createdAt.toISOString(),
      log.action,
      log.category,
      log.severity,
      log.entityType || '',
      log.entityId?.toString() || '',
      log.entityName || '',
      `"${log.description.replace(/"/gu, '""')}"`, // Escape quotes
      log.success.toString(),
      log.errorMessage ? `"${log.errorMessage.replace(/"/gu, '""')}"` : '',
      log.duration?.toString() || '',
      log.ipAddress || '',
      log.sourceSystem || '',
      log.userName || '',
      log.userEmail || ''
    ]);

    const csvContent = [
      csvHeaders.join(','),
      ...csvRows.map((row) => row.join(','))
    ].join('\n');

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        csv: csvContent,
        filename: `audit-logs-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`,
        count: auditLogs.length
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to export audit logs:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to export audit logs'
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Helper function to create common audit log entries
 */
export async function logUserAction(
  action: AuditLogAction,
  description: string,
  options?: {
    entityType?: string;
    entityId?: bigint | string;
    entityName?: string;
    targetUserId?: bigint | string;
    teamId?: bigint | string;
    documentId?: bigint | string;
    metadata?: NestedRecord;
    severity?: AuditLogSeverity;
  }
) {
  const category: AuditLogCategory = action.includes('USER_')
    ? AuditLogCategory.USER_MANAGEMENT
    : action.includes('ORGANIZATION_')
      ? AuditLogCategory.ORGANIZATION
      : action.includes('TEAM_')
        ? AuditLogCategory.TEAM_MANAGEMENT
        : action.includes('DOCUMENT_')
          ? AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT
          : action.includes('TEMPLATE_')
            ? AuditLogCategory.TEMPLATE_MANAGEMENT
            : AuditLogCategory.SYSTEM;

  return createAuditLogEntry({
    action,
    category,
    description,
    severity: options?.severity || AuditLogSeverity.INFO,
    entityType: options?.entityType,
    entityId: options?.entityId,
    entityName: options?.entityName,
    targetUserId: options?.targetUserId,
    teamId: options?.teamId,
    documentId: options?.documentId,
    metadata: options?.metadata
  });
}

/**
 * Get audit log statistics for dashboard/overview
 */
export async function getAuditLogStats(input: {
  dateFrom?: Date;
  dateTo?: Date;
}) {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

    if (!dbUser) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not authenticated' };
    }

    const user = dbUser;

    const whereConditions = [
      eq(auditLogsCS.organizationId, user.organizationId!)
    ];

    if (input.dateFrom) {
      whereConditions.push(gte(auditLogsCS.createdAt, input.dateFrom));
    }

    if (input.dateTo) {
      whereConditions.push(lte(auditLogsCS.createdAt, input.dateTo));
    }

    // Get total count
    const [{ total }] = await db
      .select({ total: count() })
      .from(auditLogsCS)
      .where(and(...whereConditions));

    // Get counts by category
    const categoryStats = await db
      .select({
        category: auditLogsCS.category,
        count: count()
      })
      .from(auditLogsCS)
      .where(and(...whereConditions))
      .groupBy(auditLogsCS.category);

    // Get counts by severity
    const severityStats = await db
      .select({
        severity: auditLogsCS.severity,
        count: count()
      })
      .from(auditLogsCS)
      .where(and(...whereConditions))
      .groupBy(auditLogsCS.severity);

    // Get failed actions count
    const [{ failedCount }] = await db
      .select({ failedCount: count() })
      .from(auditLogsCS)
      .where(and(...whereConditions, eq(auditLogsCS.success, false)));

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        total,
        failedCount,
        successRate: total > 0 ? ((total - failedCount) / total) * 100 : 100,
        categoryStats,
        severityStats
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to get audit log stats:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to get audit log stats'
    };
  }
}

        sourceSystem: auditLogsCS.sourceSystem,
        retentionPeriod: auditLogsCS.retentionPeriod,
        expiresAt: auditLogsCS.expiresAt,
        createdAt: auditLogsCS.createdAt,
        user: {
          name: usersCS.name,
          primaryEmail: usersCS.primaryEmail,
          username: usersCS.username
        },
        targetUser: {
          name: targetUsersAlias.name,
          primaryEmail: targetUsersAlias.primaryEmail,
          username: targetUsersAlias.username
        }
      })
      .from(auditLogsCS)
      .leftJoin(usersCS, eq(auditLogsCS.userId, usersCS.id))
      .leftJoin(
        targetUsersAlias,
        eq(auditLogsCS.targetUserId, targetUsersAlias.id)
      )
      .where(
        and(
          eq(auditLogsCS.id, BigInt(logId)),
          eq(auditLogsCS.organizationId, user.organizationId!)
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    if (auditLog.length === 0) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Audit log not found' };
    }

    return { success: true, data: auditLog[0] };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to get audit log by ID:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to get audit log'
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Get audit logs for a specific document
 */
export async function getAuditLogsForDocument(documentId: bigint | string) {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

    if (!dbUser) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not authenticated' } as const;
    }

    const whereConditions = [
      eq(auditLogsCS.organizationId, dbUser.organizationId!),
      eq(auditLogsCS.documentId, BigInt(documentId))
    ];

    const logs = await db
      .select({
        id: auditLogsCS.id,
        organizationId: auditLogsCS.organizationId,
        userId: auditLogsCS.userId,
        action: auditLogsCS.action,
        category: auditLogsCS.category,
        severity: auditLogsCS.severity,
        entityType: auditLogsCS.entityType,
        entityId: auditLogsCS.entityId,
        entityName: auditLogsCS.entityName,
        description: auditLogsCS.description,
        metadata: auditLogsCS.metadata,
        ipAddress: auditLogsCS.ipAddress,
        userAgent: auditLogsCS.userAgent,
        sessionId: auditLogsCS.sessionId,
        sourceSystem: auditLogsCS.sourceSystem,
        requestId: auditLogsCS.requestId,
        targetUserId: auditLogsCS.targetUserId,
        teamId: auditLogsCS.teamId,
        documentId: auditLogsCS.documentId,
        createdAt: auditLogsCS.createdAt,
        success: auditLogsCS.success,
        errorMessage: auditLogsCS.errorMessage,
        duration: auditLogsCS.duration,
        user: {
          name: usersCS.name,
          primaryEmail: usersCS.primaryEmail,
          username: usersCS.username
        }
      })
      .from(auditLogsCS)
      .leftJoin(usersCS, eq(auditLogsCS.userId, usersCS.id))
      .where(and(...whereConditions))
      .orderBy(desc(auditLogsCS.createdAt))
      .limit(200);

    return { success: true, data: logs } as const;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to get audit logs for document:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : 'Failed to get audit logs for document'
    } as const;
  }
}

/**
 * Add users as members to the specified organization with the given user IDs.
 * @param {string} id - The unique identifier of the organization.
 * @param {string[]} userIds - An array of user IDs to be added to the organization.
 * @returns {Promise<any>}
 */
export async function addOrganizationUsers(id: string, userIds: string[]) {
  try {
    const url = `${BASE_URL}/api/organizations/${id}/users?organizationId=${id}`;
    const options: RequestInit = {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ userIds })
    };

    const response = await fetch(url, options);
    const res = await response.json();

    if (!response.ok) {
      console.error('Logto organization API call failed: ', res);
    }

    return res;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error adding organization users: ', error);
    // console.log("error here", error)
  }
}

/**
 * Make an API request to the organization endpoints.
 * @param {string} endpoint - The API endpoint to call.
 * @param {'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE'} [method='GET'] - The HTTP method to use.
 * @param {object} [body] - The request body for POST, PUT, or PATCH requests.
 * @returns {Promise<any>} The JSON response from the API, or undefined for DELETE requests.
 * @throws {Error} If the API call fails.
 */
async function makeApiRequest(
  endpoint: string,
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE' = 'GET',
  body?: object,
  organizationId?: string
) {
  const url = `${BASE_URL}/organizations${endpoint}${endpoint.includes('?') ? '&' : '?'}organizationId=${organizationId ?? ''}`;
  const options: RequestInit = {
    method,
    headers:
      method !== 'GET' ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : undefined,
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined
  };

  const response = await fetch(url, options);

  if (!response.ok) {
    console.error('Logto organization API call failed:', response.statusText);
    throw new Error(
      `Logto organization API call failed: ${response.statusText}`
    );
  }

  if (method === 'DELETE') {
    return undefined;
  }

  try {
    return await response.json();
  } catch (error) {
    if (
      error instanceof TypeError &&
      error.message.includes('Body is unusable')
    ) {
      console.warn('Response body has already been consumed');
      return null;
    }
    console.error('Error parsing API response:', error);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Convert an object of parameters to a query string.
 * @param {Record<string, unknown>} params - The parameters to convert.
 * @returns {string} The query string.
 */
function paramsToQueryString(params: Record<string, unknown>) {
  return new URLSearchParams(params as Record<string, string>).toString();
}

/**
 * StepAccordion component for displaying form steps
 */
function StepAccordion({
  value,
  title,
  children,
  isCompleted,
  isLocked,
  onValueChange,
  stepNumber,
  isSelected
}: Readonly<StepAccordionProps>) {
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSelected && triggerRef.current) {
      triggerRef.current.focus();
    }
  }, [isSelected]);

  return (
    <AccordionItem className='relative border-b border-line' value={value}>
      <AccordionTrigger
        className={cn(
          'group px-0 py-4 hover:no-underline',
          isLocked && 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-50'
        )}
        onClick={() => !isLocked && onValueChange(value)}
        ref={triggerRef}
      >
        <div className='flex w-full flex-1 items-center gap-3'>
          <div
            className={cn(
              'flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-xs font-medium transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out',
              isSelected
                ? 'bg-foreground text-background border-none'
                : 'bg-secondary text-muted-foreground'
            )}
          >
            {stepNumber}
          </div>
          <span className='text-base font-medium'>{title}</span>
          {isCompleted && !isLocked && (
            <span className='ml-auto mr-4 inline-flex items-center rounded-md bg-green-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-green-600 ring-1 ring-inset ring-green-600/20'>
              Complete
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </AccordionTrigger>
      {isLocked && (
        <div className='absolute right-12 top-5'>
          <Lock className='size-4 text-muted-foreground' />
        </div>
      )}
      <AccordionContent asChild className='mt-2'>
        {!isLocked && children}
      </AccordionContent>
    </AccordionItem>
  );
}

  organization,
  documents,
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  selectedUsers,
  handleRemoveUser,
  onSuccess
}: SendTnsDialogProps) {
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const form = useForm<z.infer<typeof formSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(formSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      tab: 'recurring',
      documentId: ''
    }
  });

  const currentTab = form.watch('tab');

  const onSubmit = async (values: z.infer<typeof formSchema>) => {
    if (selectedUsers.length === 0) {
      toast.error('Please select at least one user.');
      return;
    }
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    const payload = {
      userIds: selectedUsers.map((u) => u.id.toString()),
      documentId: values.documentId,
      isRecurring: values.tab === 'recurring',
      customMessage: values.customMessage ?? null,
      frequency: values.frequency as ReminderFrequency,
      startDate: values.startDate,
      organizationId: organization.id.toString(),
      senderId: loggedInUser.id.toString(),
      message:
        values.customMessage ??
        `Signature request sent by ${loggedInUser.name ?? loggedInUser.primaryEmail ?? loggedInUser.username} on ${format(
          new Date(),
          'PPP'
        )}.`
    };

    try {
      const result = await sendTns(payload);
      if (result.success) {
        toast.success('TNS sent successfully!');
        // Filter out the sender from selectedUsers for audit logging
        const recipients = selectedUsers.filter(
          (user) => user.id.toString() !== loggedInUser.id.toString()
        );

        // Create audit log entries only for actual recipients (not the sender)
        for (const user of recipients) {
          await createAuditLogEntry({
            action: AuditLogAction.TNS_SENT,
            category: AuditLogCategory.NOTIFICATIONS,
            documentId: BigInt(values.documentId),
            description: `User sent a TNS for document ID ${values.documentId} to ${recipients.length} user(s).`,
            metadata: {
              isRecurring: payload.isRecurring,
              frequency: payload.frequency,
              startDate: payload.startDate?.toISOString(),
              customMessage: payload.customMessage,
              targetUserIds: recipients.map((u) => u.id.toString())
            },
            targetUserId: user.id
          }).catch(console.error);
        }

        // Create a separate audit log for sender confirmation if multiple recipients
        if (recipients.length > 1) {
          await createAuditLogEntry({
            action: AuditLogAction.TNS_CONFIRMATION_SENT,
            category: AuditLogCategory.NOTIFICATIONS,
            documentId: BigInt(values.documentId),
            description: `User received TNS confirmation for sending to ${recipients.length} recipients.`,
            metadata: {
              isRecurring: payload.isRecurring,
              frequency: payload.frequency,
              startDate: payload.startDate?.toISOString(),
              customMessage: payload.customMessage,
              recipientCount: recipients.length,
              targetUserIds: recipients.map((u) => u.id.toString())
            },
            targetUserId: loggedInUser.id
          }).catch(console.error);
        }
        onSuccess();
        onClose();
      } else {
        toast.error(result.error || 'Failed to send TNS.');
      }
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        toast.error(error.message);
      } else {
        toast.error('An unexpected error occurred.');
      }
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onClose}>
      <DialogContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Track Nudge Sign</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Send a notification to users to sign documents securely.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className='grid max-h-[60dvh] grid-cols-1 gap-4 overflow-y-auto pr-2 sm:grid-cols-1'>
          <div className='flex flex-col gap-2'>
            <h3 className='font-medium'>Users</h3>
            <div className='flex max-h-[200px] flex-col gap-2 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border p-2 pr-3'>
              {selectedUsers.map((user) => (
                <div
                  key={user.id}
                  className='flex items-center justify-between rounded-md p-2 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:bg-muted'
                >
                  <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                    <Avatar className='size-9 rounded-sm'>
                      <AvatarImage
                        className='rounded-sm'
                        src={user.avatar || ''}
                      />
                      <AvatarFallback>{user.name?.[0]}</AvatarFallback>
                    </Avatar>
                    <div>
                      <p className='text-sm font-medium'>{user.name}</p>
                      <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                        {user.primaryEmail}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <Button
                    variant='ghost'
                    size='icon'
                    className='size-6 rounded-md hover:bg-destructive/10 focus:bg-destructive/10'
                    onClick={() => {
                      handleRemoveUser(user.id);
                      // check if there are no users left
                      if (selectedUsers.length === 0) {
                        onClose();
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    <Trash2 className='size-4 text-destructive' />
                  </Button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <Form {...form}>
            <form id='tns-form' onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
              <Tabs
                defaultValue='oneOff'
                className='w-full'
                onValueChange={(value) =>
                  form.setValue('tab', value as 'recurring' | 'oneOff')
                }
              >
                <TabsList className='mb-4 grid w-full grid-cols-2'>
                  <TabsTrigger
                    className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
                    value='oneOff'
                  >
                    <CalendarDays className='size-4' />
                    One Off
                  </TabsTrigger>
                  <TabsTrigger
                    className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
                    value='recurring'
                  >
                    <Repeat2 className='size-4' />
                    Recurring
                  </TabsTrigger>
                </TabsList>
                <TabsContent value='recurring' className='space-y-2'>
                  <FormField
                    control={form.control}
                    name='startDate'
                    render={({ field }) => (
                      <FormItem className='flex flex-col space-y-2'>
                        <FormLabel>Start Date</FormLabel>
                        <Popover modal={true}>
                          <PopoverTrigger asChild>
                            <FormControl>
                              <Button
                                variant='outline'
                                className={cn(
                                  'w-full pl-3 text-left font-normal',
                                  !field.value && 'text-muted-foreground'
                                )}
                              >
                                {field.value ? (
                                  format(field.value, 'PPP')
                                ) : (
                                  <span>Pick a date</span>
                                )}
                                <CalendarIcon className='ml-auto size-4 opacity-50' />
                              </Button>
                            </FormControl>
                          </PopoverTrigger>
                          <PopoverContent
                            className='w-auto p-0 font-suisse-intl'
                            align='start'
                          >
                            <Calendar
                              mode='single'
                              selected={field.value}
                              onSelect={field.onChange}
                              disabled={(date) => date < new Date()}
                              initialFocus
                            />
                          </PopoverContent>
                        </Popover>
                        <div className='mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2'>
                          <Button
                            type='button'
                            size='sm'
                            variant='secondary'
                            className='h-8 text-xs'
                            onClick={() => field.onChange(new Date())}
                          >
                            Now
                          </Button>
                          <Button
                            type='button'
                            size='sm'
                            variant='secondary'
                            className='h-8 text-xs'
                            onClick={() => {
                              const tomorrow = new Date();
                              tomorrow.setDate(tomorrow.getDate() + 1);
                              field.onChange(tomorrow);
                            }}
                          >
                            Tomorrow
                          </Button>
                          <Button
                            type='button'
                            size='sm'

                            }}
                          >
                            Next Month
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                        <FormMessage />
                      </FormItem>
                    )}
                  />
                  <FormField
                    control={form.control}
                    name='documentId'
                    render={({ field }) => (
                      <FormItem className='space-y-2'>
                        <FormLabel className=''>Document</FormLabel>
                        <Select
                          onValueChange={(value) => field.onChange([value])}
                          defaultValue={field.value[0] || ''}
                        >
                          <FormControl>
                            <SelectTrigger>
                              <SelectValue placeholder='Select a document' />
                            </SelectTrigger>
                          </FormControl>
                          <SelectContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
                            {documents.map((doc) => (
                              <SelectItem
                                key={doc.id.toString()}
                                value={doc.id.toString()}
                              >
                                {doc?.title ??
                                  doc?.filename?.split('.')[0] ??
                                  doc?.filename ??
                                  'Untitled Document'}

import {
  sendTeamConfigUpdatedNotification,
  sendUserConfigUpdatedNotification
} from '@/actions/notifications';
import {
  JOB_SCOPE_DESCRIPTIONS,
  JOB_SCOPE_ICONS,
  JOB_SCOPE_TITLES
} from '@/app/(user)/create-organization/components/invite-users-form/constants';
import {
  useAddTeamMember,
  useRemoveTeamMember
} from '@/hooks/use-team-members';
import { useActiveTeams, useDeleteActiveTeam } from '@/hooks/use-teams';
import {
  TeamInheritanceType,
  type TeamMemberCS,
  type UserCS
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { useUserData } from '@signvault/frontend/contexts/user-data-context';
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/avatar';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/sheet';
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/tooltip';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { format } from 'date-fns';
import {
  BriefcaseBusiness,
  Clock2,
  Loader2,
  PenTool,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  UserRoundX,
  Users2
} from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

import { EditActiveTeamDialog } from './edit-active-team-dialog';
import { createAuditLogEntry } from '@/actions/audit-logs';
import {
  AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';

type ActiveTeamSheetProps = {
  admin: UserCS;
  adminIds: (string | bigint)[];
  isAdmin: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  organizationId?: string | bigint;
  teamId: string | bigint;
};

export function ActiveTeamSheet({
  adminIds,
  teamId,
  onClose,
  isAdmin,
  organizationId,
  admin
}: Readonly<ActiveTeamSheetProps>) {
  const { data: teams, isLoading: teamsLoading } = useActiveTeams(
    organizationId ?? ''
  );
  const team = teams?.find((t) => t.id === teamId);
  const jobScopes =
    'template' in team ? team.template?.jobScopes : team.customTeam?.jobScopes;
  const { organizationData, organizationMembers } = useUserData();
  const users = organizationMembers;

  const deleteTeam = useDeleteActiveTeam();
  const addMemberMutation = useAddTeamMember();
  const removeMemberMutation = useRemoveTeamMember();

  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  if (!team || !organizationId || teamsLoading) {
    return (
      <div className='flex size-full items-center justify-center'>
        <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    try {
      await deleteTeam.mutateAsync({
        teamId,
        organizationId,
        customTeamId: team.customTeamId,
        teamTemplateId: team.teamTemplateId
      });

      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['activeTeams']
      });

      try {
        await sendTeamConfigUpdatedNotification({
          organizationId,
          teamId,
          teamName: team.name,
          memberIds: team.members.map((member) => member.userId),
          adminId: admin.id,
          changes: {
            old: { activeTeam: teamId },
            new: { activeTeam: null }
          }
        });
      } catch (notificationError) {
        console.error(
          'Failed to send team deletion notification:',
          notificationError
        );
        toast.error(
          `Team deleted but notification failed: ${notificationError instanceof Error ? notificationError.message : String(notificationError)}`
        );
      }

      toast.success('Team deleted successfully');
      await createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.TEAM_DELETED,
        category: AuditLogCategory.TEAM_MANAGEMENT,
        entityId: team.id,
        entityType: 'team',
        entityName: team.name,
        description: `User deleted team: "${team.name}"`,
        teamId: team.id
      }).catch(console.error);
      onClose();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error(`Failed to delete team: ${error}`);
    }
  };

  const handleAddMember = async (userId: string | bigint) => {
    try {
      await addMemberMutation.mutateAsync({
        userId: typeof userId !== 'string' ? userId : BigInt(userId),
        teamId: typeof teamId !== 'string' ? teamId : BigInt(teamId),
        organizationId:
          typeof organizationId !== 'string'
            ? organizationId
            : BigInt(organizationId),
        invitedBy: organizationData?.user?.id as bigint,
        permissions: [],
        attributes: {},
        jobScopes: []
      } as Omit<TeamMemberCS, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>);

      try {
        await sendUserConfigUpdatedNotification({
          organizationId,
          userId,
          adminId: admin.id,
          configType: 'team',
          details: { activeTeam: teamId }
        });
      } catch (notificationError) {
        console.error(
          'Failed to send member addition notification:',
          notificationError
        );
        toast.error(
          `Member added but notification failed: ${notificationError instanceof Error ? notificationError.message : String(notificationError)}`
        );
      }

      toast.success('Member added successfully');
      await createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.TEAM_MEMBER_ADDED,
        category: AuditLogCategory.TEAM_MANAGEMENT,
        entityId: team.id,
        entityType: 'team',
        entityName: team.name,
        description: `User added a new member to team: "${team.name}"`,
        targetUserId: typeof userId !== 'string' ? userId : BigInt(userId)
      }).catch(console.error);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['activeTeams']
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error(`Failed to add member: ${error}`);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveMember = async (memberId: string | bigint) => {
    try {
      await removeMemberMutation.mutateAsync({
        memberId,
        organizationId
      });
      toast.success('Member removed successfully');
      await createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.TEAM_MEMBER_REMOVED,
        category: AuditLogCategory.TEAM_MANAGEMENT,
        entityId: team.id,
        entityType: 'team',
        entityName: team.name,
        description: `User removed a member from team: "${team.name}"`,
        targetUserId:
          typeof memberId !== 'string' ? memberId : BigInt(memberId),
        teamId: team.id
      }).catch(console.error);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['activeTeams']
      });

      try {
        await sendUserConfigUpdatedNotification({
          organizationId,
          userId: users?.find((user) => user.id === memberId)?.id || '',
          adminId: admin.id,
          configType: 'team',
          details: { activeTeam: null }
        });
      } catch (notificationError) {
        console.error(
          'Failed to send member removal notification:',
          notificationError
        );
        toast.error(
          `Member removed but notification failed: ${notificationError instanceof Error ? notificationError.message : String(notificationError)}`
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error(`Failed to remove member: ${error}`);
    }
  };

  // Filter out users who are already members of the team
  const availableUsers = users?.filter(
    (user) => !team.members.some((member) => member.userId === user.id)
  );

  // Determine if the team is inherited from a template or custom team
  const isFromTemplate =
    team.inheritedFrom === TeamInheritanceType.TEAM_TEMPLATE;
  const sourceTeam = isFromTemplate
    ? 'template' in team
      ? team.template
      : null
    : 'customTeam' in team
      ? team.customTeam
      : null;

  return (
    <Sheet onOpenChange={onClose} open>
      <SheetContent className='w-full max-w-3xl overflow-y-auto pb-16 font-suisse-intl'>
        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle hidden>{team.name}</SheetTitle>
        </SheetHeader>
        <SheetDescription hidden>{team.description}</SheetDescription>
        <div className='mb-6 mt-4 flex items-start justify-between'>
          <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
            <div className='rounded-lg bg-primary/10 p-2.5'>
              <BriefcaseBusiness
                className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 text-primary'
                strokeWidth={2}
              />
            </div>
            <h3 className='font-britanica text-2xl'>{team.name}</h3>
          </div>
          {isAdmin &&
            organizationData?.user?.id &&
            organizationData?.organization?.id && (
              <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                <EditActiveTeamDialog
                  adminIds={adminIds}
                  organizationId={organizationData.organization.id}
                  team={team}
                  userId={organizationData.user.id}
                />
                <AlertDialog>
                  <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
                    <Button
                      className='size-8 bg-destructive/15 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/20'
                      size='icon'
                      variant='destructive'
                    >
                      <Trash2 className='size-4' />
                    </Button>
                  </AlertDialogTrigger>
                  <AlertDialogContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
                    <AlertDialogHeader>
                      <AlertDialogTitle>Delete Team</AlertDialogTitle>
                      <AlertDialogDescription>
                        Are you sure you want to delete the team{' '}
                        <span className='font-semibold'>{team.name}</span>? This
                        action cannot be undone.
                      </AlertDialogDescription>
                    </AlertDialogHeader>
                    <AlertDialogFooter>
                      <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
                      <AlertDialogAction
                        className='bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90'
                        onClick={handleDelete}
                      >
                        Delete
                      </AlertDialogAction>
                    </AlertDialogFooter>
                  </AlertDialogContent>
                </AlertDialog>
              </div>
            )}
        </div>

        <div className='space-y-6'>
          {/* Basic Information */}
          <div className='space-y-2'>
            <h3 className='text-lg'>Basic Information</h3>

                                </Button>

                    key={member.id}

                    <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>

                        <AvatarFallback>
                          {member.user?.name?.[0] || 'U'}
                        </AvatarFallback>

                        </span>

                    </div>

                              <span>?</span>

                          </AlertDialogHeader>
                          <AlertDialogFooter>

                  </p>

            <div className='dark:border-1 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 rounded-lg bg-card p-4 dark:border-solid dark:border-border dark:bg-card xs:grid-cols-2'>
              <div>
                <h4 className='mb-1 text-base font-medium'>Date Created</h4>
                <code className='inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-primary/10 px-3 py-0.5 text-xs text-primary'>

                  <Clock2 className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
                  {format(new Date(team.updatedAt), 'PPP')}
                </code>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

  const [viewingRecordId, setViewingRecordId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const { organizationData, organizationMembers } = useUserData();

  const organizationId = organizationData?.organization?.id?.toString();

  const loggedInUser = organizationMembers?.find(
    (member) => member.id === organizationData?.organization?.id
  );
  const loggedInUserId = loggedInUser?.id;

  const loadAllEvents = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!organizationId) return;

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const { events: allEvents, records: allRecords } =
        await getAllEventsWithRecords({
          organizationId
        });

      // Combine events with their related records
      const eventsWithRecords: EventWithRecord[] = allEvents.map((event) => {
        // Try to find the related record based on event data
        const relatedRecord = allRecords.find((record) => {
          if (
            event.data &&
            typeof event.data === 'object' &&
            'recordId' in event.data
          ) {
            return event.data.recordId === record.id.toString();
          }
          // Fallback: match by user or timestamp proximity
          return event.userId === record.userId;
        });

        return {
          ...event,
          record: relatedRecord
        };
      });

      // Sort by timestamp descending (newest first)
      eventsWithRecords.sort(
        (a, b) =>
          new Date(a.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(b.timestamp).getTime()
      );

      setEvents(eventsWithRecords);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error loading events:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load events');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [organizationId]);

  const loadEventsForRecord = useCallback(
    async (recordId: string) => {
      if (!organizationId) return;

      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const recordEvents = await getEventsByRecordId({
          recordId,
          organizationId
        });

        const selectedRecord = records.find(
          (r) => r.id.toString() === recordId
        );

        const eventsWithRecords: EventWithRecord[] = recordEvents.map(
          (event) => ({
            ...event,
            record: selectedRecord
          })
        );

        // Sort by timestamp descending (newest first)
        eventsWithRecords.sort(
          (a, b) =>
            new Date(a.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(b.timestamp).getTime()
        );

        setEvents(eventsWithRecords);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error loading events for record:', error);
        toast.error('Failed to load events for record');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [organizationId, records]
  );

  const handleRecordIdSearch = async () => {
    if (!recordIdInput.trim() || !organizationId) {
      toast.error('Please enter a valid record ID');
      return;
    }

    setSearchLoading(true);
    try {
      // Validate access first
      const hasAccess = await validateRecordAccess({
        recordId: recordIdInput.trim(),
        organizationId
      });

      if (!hasAccess) {
        toast.error('Record not found or access denied');
        return;
      }

      // Load events for this specific record
      onRecordSelect?.(recordIdInput.trim());
      setRecordIdInput('');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error validating record access:', error);
      toast.error('Error validating record access');
    } finally {
      setSearchLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const _formatEventData = (data: unknown) => {
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return 'No additional data';
    return JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
  };

  const handleViewRecordDetails = (recordId: string) => {
    setViewingRecordId(recordId);
    setIsRecordDetailsOpen(true);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedRecordId && organizationId) {
      loadEventsForRecord(selectedRecordId);
    }
  }, [selectedRecordId, organizationId, loadEventsForRecord]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedRecordId && organizationId) {
      loadAllEvents();
    }
  }, [selectedRecordId, organizationId, loadAllEvents]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className='flex h-64 items-center justify-center'>
        <div className='text-center'>
          <Activity className='mx-auto mb-4 size-8 animate-pulse text-primary' />
          <p className='text-muted-foreground'>Loading provenance trail...</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className='space-y-6'>
      {/* Record ID Search */}
      <div className='flex gap-2'>
        <div className='relative flex-1'>
          <Search className='absolute left-3 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground' />
          <Input
            placeholder='Enter record ID to view its trail...'
            value={recordIdInput}
            inputMode='numeric'
            type='number'
            onChange={(e) => setRecordIdInput(e.target.value)}
            className='pl-10'
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                handleRecordIdSearch();
              }
            }}
          />
        </div>
        <Button
          onClick={handleRecordIdSearch}
          disabled={searchLoading || !recordIdInput.trim()}
          variant='outline'
        >
          {searchLoading ? 'Searching...' : 'Search'}
        </Button>
        {selectedRecordId && (
          <Button
            onClick={() => {
              onRecordSelect?.(null);
              loadAllEvents();
            }}
            variant='ghost'
          >
            Show All
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Trail Header */}
      {selectedRecordId && (
        <div className='rounded-lg border bg-muted p-4'>
          <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
            <RiFingerprintFill className='size-6 text-primary' />
            <h3 className=''>Viewing provenance trail for record</h3>
            <SpanHighlight
              interactive
              size='xs'
              padding='tight'
              className='border border-primary/10'
            >
              {selectedRecordId}
            </SpanHighlight>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Events Trail */}
      {events.length === 0 ? (
        <div className='flex h-64 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-dashed'>
          <div className='text-center'>
            <AlertCircle className='mx-auto mb-4 size-8 text-muted-foreground' />
            <p className='text-muted-foreground'>
              {selectedRecordId
                ? 'No events found for this record'
                : 'No events found'}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <motion.div
          className='relative'
          variants={container}
          initial='hidden'
          animate='show'

                            </h5>

                              variant={

                              }
                            >
                              {policy.legalHold ? 'Active' : 'None'}
                            </Badge>
                          </div>
                          <div>

                              Retention Basis
                            </h5>
                            <span className='text-sm'>
                              {policy.retentionBasis || 'Not specified'}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </motion.div>
            </TabsContent>
            <TabsContent value='versions' className='space-y-4'>
              <motion.div variants={item}>
                <h4 className='mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-semibold'>
                  <History className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5' />
                  Version History ({data.versionHistory.length})
                </h4>
                {data.versionHistory.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className='py-8 text-center'>
                    <History className='mx-auto mb-4 size-8 text-muted-foreground' />
                    <p className='text-muted-foreground'>
                      No version history found
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ) : (

                    {data.versionHistory.map((version) => (

                        key={version.id.toString()}
                        className='rounded-lg border p-4'

                        <div className='mb-4 flex items-start justify-between'>
                          <div>
                            <h5 className='font-medium'>
                              Version {version.majorVersion}.
                              {version.minorVersion}
                            </h5>
                            <div className='flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                              <Clock className='size-3' />
                              {format(new Date(version.timestamp), 'PPPPpppp')}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <Badge variant='outline'>
                            {ENTITY_TYPE_LABELS[version.entityType]}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <div className='space-y-3'>
                          <div>
                            <h6 className='mb-1 text-sm font-medium'>
                              Changes
                            </h6>
                            <p className='rounded bg-muted/50 p-2 text-sm'>

                              <h6 className='mb-1 text-sm font-medium'>

                              </h6>

                                {version.createdBy?.toString() || 'N/A'}
                              </SpanHighlight>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <h6 className='mb-1 text-sm font-medium'>
                                Modified By
                              </h6>
                              <SpanHighlight size='xs' padding='tight'>
                                {version.modifiedBy?.toString() || 'N/A'}
                              </SpanHighlight>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </motion.div>
            </TabsContent>
          </motion.div>
        </Tabs>
      </div>
    );
  };

  if (mode === 'dialog') {
    return (
      <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
        <DialogContent className='max-h-[90vh] max-w-4xl font-suisse-intl'>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className='flex items-center gap-2'>
              {/* <Database className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5' /> */}
              Provenance Record Details
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              Comprehensive view of provenance record data, evidence, retention
              policies, and version history.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <ScrollArea className='h-[75vh]'>
            <RecordContent />
          </ScrollArea>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Sheet open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <SheetContent className='w-full max-w-4xl overflow-y-auto pb-16 font-suisse-intl'>
        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle className='flex items-center gap-2'>
            {/* <Database className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5' /> */}
            Provenance Record Details
          </SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription className='mt-0! text-left'>
            Comprehensive view of provenance record data, evidence, retention
            policies, and version history.
          </SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>
        <div className='mt-6'>
          <RecordContent />
        </div>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

  filters,
  onFiltersChange,
  onClose

  filters: AuditLogFiltersType;
  onFiltersChange: (filters: AuditLogFiltersType) => void;
  onClose?: () => void;

  const [presetName, setPresetName] = useState('');
  const [savedPresets, setSavedPresets] = useState<FilterPreset[]>([]);
  const [showAdvanced, setShowAdvanced] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('audit-log-filter-presets');
    if (saved) {
      try {
        setSavedPresets(JSON.parse(saved));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to parse saved presets:', error);
      }
    }

  const saveFilterPreset = useCallback(() => {
    if (!presetName.trim()) return;

    const newPreset: FilterPreset = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      name: presetName.trim(),
      filters: filters
    };

    const updatedPresets = [...savedPresets, newPreset];
    setSavedPresets(updatedPresets);
    localStorage.setItem(
      'audit-log-filter-presets',
      JSON.stringify(updatedPresets)
    );
    setPresetName('');
  }, [presetName, filters, savedPresets]);

  const loadFilterPreset = useCallback(
    (presetId: string) => {
      const preset = savedPresets.find((p) => p.id === presetId);
      if (preset) {
        onFiltersChange(preset.filters);
      }
    },
    [savedPresets, onFiltersChange]
  );

  const filtersAreActive = Object.values(filters).some((val) =>
    Array.isArray(val) ? val.length > 0 : val !== undefined
  );

  return (
    <Sheet>
      <SheetTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          variant='outline'
          className={cn(
            'gap-2  transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out',

      </SheetTrigger>
      <SheetContent className='overflow-y-auto font-suisse-intl'>

            <label
              htmlFor='action'
              className='mb-0.5 block text-sm font-medium'
            >
              Actions
            </label>
            <Select
              value={filters.actions?.[0] || ''}

                  actions: value ? [value as AuditLogAction] : undefined
                })

                <SelectValue placeholder='Select action type' />
              </SelectTrigger>

                defaultValue='USER_CREATED'
                className='font-suisse-intl'
              >

              <Button

                onClick={saveFilterPreset}
                disabled={!presetName.trim()}
                size='sm'
              >

          </div>

          {savedPresets.length > 0 && (

              </label>

                      {preset.name}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        {/* Clear Filters */}

            className='mt-4 flex w-full items-center gap-2'

export type OrganizationNotificationPayload = {
  action: NotificationAction;
  creatorId?: string | bigint;
  data?: Record<string, unknown>;
  message: string;
  organizationId: string | bigint;
  receiverId: string | bigint;
  targetEntityId?: string | bigint;
  targetEntityType?: string;
  targetId?: string | bigint;
  title: string;
};

export type NotificationAction =
  | 'ACTIVE_TEAM_SETUP'
  | 'CUSTOM_TEAM_SETUP'
  | 'USER_JOINED'
  | 'TEAM_ASSIGNED'
  | 'USER_CONFIG_UPDATED'
  | 'TEAM_CONFIG_UPDATED'
  | 'ROLE_CREATED'
  | 'ROLE_UPDATED'
  | 'ROLE_ASSIGNED'
  | 'ORGANIZATION_INFO_UPDATED'
  | 'USER_ROLE_CHANGED'
  | 'USER_LEFT'
  | 'DOCUMENT_ACCESS_REQUESTED'
  | 'SIGNATURE_REQUEST_SENT'
  | 'TNS_CONFIRMATION_SENT';

/**
 * Sends a notification to all admins of an organization when an active team is set up
 */
export async function sendActiveTeamSetupNotification(payload: {
  adminIds: (string | bigint)[];
  creatorId: string | bigint;
  organizationId: string | bigint;
  teamId: string | bigint;
  teamName: string;
}): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const results = await Promise.all(
      payload.adminIds.map((adminId) =>
        sendOrganizationNotification({
          action: 'ACTIVE_TEAM_SETUP',
          creatorId: payload.creatorId,
          receiverId: adminId,
          organizationId: payload.organizationId,
          title: 'New Active Team Created',
          message: `A new active team "${payload.teamName}" has been created in your organization.`,
          targetEntityId: payload.teamId,
          targetEntityType: 'ACTIVE_TEAM',
          targetId: payload.teamId,
          data: {
            teamId: payload.teamId,
            teamName: payload.teamName
          }
        })
      )
    );

    // Check if all notifications were sent successfully
    return results.every(Boolean);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to send active team setup notification', error);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Sends a notification to an organization - used by other notification functions
 */
export async function sendOrganizationNotification(
  payload: OrganizationNotificationPayload
): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const userId = String(payload.creatorId);

    // Prepare notification data for API
    const notificationData = {
      title: payload.title,
      message: payload.message,
      userId: userId,
      receiverId: payload.receiverId ? String(payload.receiverId) : null,
      organizationId: String(payload.organizationId),
      notificationType: NotificationTypePS.IN_APP,
      status: NotificationStatusPS.SENT,
      content: {
        targetEntityId: payload.targetEntityId
          ? String(payload.targetEntityId)
          : undefined,
        targetEntityType: payload.targetEntityType,
        targetId: payload.targetId ? String(payload.targetId) : undefined
      },
      metadata: {
        action: payload.action,
        data: payload.data || {}
      },
      senderId: payload.creatorId ? String(payload.creatorId) : null
    };

    // Send notification via API
    const response = await api.post<CreateNotificationResponse>(
      `api/v2/notifications/${userId}`,
      notificationData,
      '',
      undefined,
      {
        headers: {
          'x-user-logto-id': userId,
          'x-middleware-bypass-token':
            process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
        }
      }
    );

    // Add provenance tracking for notification sent
    if (response && 'notification' in response) {
      try {
        // Get current user context for sender tracking
        const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
        const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

        await execute(print(EnqueueNotificationSent as ASTNode), {
          input: {
            notificationId: response.notification.id.toString(),
            senderId: payload.creatorId
              ? String(payload.creatorId)
              : dbUser?.id.toString() || '',
            receiverId: payload.receiverId ? String(payload.receiverId) : '',
            organizationId: String(payload.organizationId),
            notificationType: payload.action,
            deliveryChannel: 'IN_APP',
            deliveryStatus: 'SENT'
          }
        }).catch((error) => {
          console.error(error);
          console.log('[AUDIT LOG] Failed to log notification sent event');
        });
        // Create audit log entry
        await createAuditLogEntry({
          action: AuditLogAction.NOTIFICATION_SENT,
          category: AuditLogCategory.NOTIFICATIONS,
          metadata: {
            notificationId: response.notification.id.toString(),
            notificationType: payload.action,
            deliveryChannel: 'IN_APP',
            deliveryStatus: 'SENT'
          },
          description: `Notification ${payload.action} sent to ${payload.receiverId}`,
          entityId: response.notification.id.toString(),
          entityType: 'NOTIFICATION',
          entityName: payload.title,
          targetUserId: payload.receiverId ? String(payload.receiverId) : '',
          success: true
        }).catch((error) => {
          console.error(error);
          console.log('[AUDIT LOG] Failed to log notification sent event');
        });
      } catch (provenanceError) {
        console.error(
          'Failed to track notification sent provenance:',
          provenanceError
        );
      }
    }

    return response && 'notification' in response;
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    console.error('Failed to send organization notification', error);
    return false;
  }
}

 * Sends a notification to a user when they are assigned a role

          action: payload.isNew ? 'ROLE_CREATED' : 'ROLE_UPDATED',
          creatorId: payload.creatorId,

          organizationId: payload.organizationId,
          title: payload.isNew ? 'New Role Created' : 'Role Updated',
          message: payload.isNew
            ? `A new role "${payload.roleName}" has been created.`
            : `The role "${payload.roleName}" has been updated.`,
          targetEntityId: payload.roleId,
          targetEntityType: 'ROLE',
          targetId: payload.roleId,
          data: {
            roleId: payload.roleId,
            roleName: payload.roleName
          }
        })
      )
    );

    // Check if all notifications were sent successfully
    return results.every(Boolean);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to send role change notification', error);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Sends a notification to admins when a user's role is changed
 */
export async function sendUserRoleChangeNotification(payload: {
  adminIds: (string | bigint)[];
  newRole: string;
  oldRole: string;
  organizationId: string | bigint;
  updaterId: string | bigint;
  userId: string | bigint;
  userName: string;
}): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    // Send to admins
    const adminResults = await Promise.all(
      payload.adminIds.map((adminId) =>
        sendOrganizationNotification({
          action: 'USER_ROLE_CHANGED',
          creatorId: payload.updaterId,
          receiverId: adminId,
          organizationId: payload.organizationId,
          title: 'User Role Changed',
          message: `${payload.userName}'s role has been changed from "${payload.oldRole}" to "${payload.newRole}".`,
          targetEntityId: payload.userId,
          targetEntityType: 'USER',
          targetId: payload.userId,
          data: {
            userId: payload.userId,
            userName: payload.userName,
            oldRole: payload.oldRole,
            newRole: payload.newRole
          }
        })
      )
    );

    // Also notify the user about their role change
    const userResult = await sendOrganizationNotification({
      action: 'USER_ROLE_CHANGED',
      creatorId: payload.updaterId,
      receiverId: payload.userId,
      organizationId: payload.organizationId,
      title: 'Your Role Has Changed',
      message: `Your role has been changed from "${payload.oldRole}" to "${payload.newRole}".`,
      targetEntityId: payload.userId,
      targetEntityType: 'USER',
      targetId: payload.userId,
      data: {
        oldRole: payload.oldRole,
        newRole: payload.newRole
      }
    });

    // Check if all notifications were sent successfully
    return adminResults.every(Boolean) && userResult;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to send user role change notification', error);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Sends a notification to document owner when someone requests access to their document
 */
export async function sendDocumentAccessRequestNotification(payload: {
  documentId: string | bigint;
  documentName: string;
  ownerId: string | bigint;
  organizationId: string | bigint;
  requesterId: string | bigint;
  requesterName: string;
}): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const result = await sendOrganizationNotification({
      action: 'DOCUMENT_ACCESS_REQUESTED',
      creatorId: payload.requesterId,
      receiverId: payload.ownerId,
      organizationId: payload.organizationId,
      title: 'Document Access Request',
      message: `${payload.requesterName} has requested access to your document "${payload.documentName}".`,
      targetEntityId: payload.documentId,
      targetEntityType: 'DOCUMENT',
      targetId: payload.documentId,
      data: {
        documentId: payload.documentId,
        documentName: payload.documentName,
        requesterId: payload.requesterId,
        requesterName: payload.requesterName
      }
    });

    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to send document access request notification', error);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Server action to fetch the unread count for the logged in user
 */
export async function fetchUnreadCount(userId: string) {
  const unreadNotifications = await db.query.notificationsANS.findMany({
    where: and(
      eq(notificationsANS.receiverId, BigInt(userId)),
      isNull(notificationsANS.readAt)
    )
  });

  return unreadNotifications.length;
}

/**
 * Server action to fetch notifications for the logged in user
 */
export async function fetchNotifications(userId: string) {
  const notifications = await db.query.notificationsANS.findMany({
    where: eq(notificationsANS.receiverId, BigInt(userId)),
    orderBy: desc(notificationsANS.createdAt)
  });
  return notifications;
}

import type { CalendarEvent as CalendarEventType } from '@/components/calendar/calendar-types';

import { useCalendarContext } from '@/components/calendar/calendar-context';
import { cn, toTitleCase } from '@/lib/utils';
import {
  CalendarEventType as CalendarEventTypeSchema,
  TeamMemberStatus
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import {
  Avatar,
  AvatarFallback,
  AvatarImage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/avatar';
import { Badge } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { ExpandableIconTabs } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/expandable-icon-tabs';
import { ExpandableTabs } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/expandable-tabs';
import {
  differenceInDays,
  differenceInHours,
  format,
  isSameDay
} from 'date-fns';
import { Bell, CalendarIcon, Clock, Info, MapPin, Users } from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import React from 'react';
import { FaUsers } from 'react-icons/fa6';

type EventPosition = {
  height: string;
  left: string;
  top: string;
  width: string;
};

type EventStyles = {
  height: string;
  isOverlapping: boolean;
  left: string;
  overlappingLevel: number;
  top: string;
  width: string;
};

export default function CalendarEvent({
  event,
  type = 'month',
  month = false,
  className
}: Readonly<{
  className?: string;
  event: CalendarEventType;
  month?: boolean;
  type?: 'day' | 'week' | 'month';
}>) {
  const { events, setSelectedEvent, setManageEventDialogOpen } =
    useCalendarContext();
  const dayEvents = events.filter(
    (event) =>
      isSameDay(event.startDate, event.endDate) &&
      differenceInDays(event.endDate, event.startDate) === 0
  );
  const allStyles = React.useMemo(
    () => (month ? {} : getStylesForEveryEvent(dayEvents)),
    [dayEvents, month]
  );
  const {
    isOverlapping = false,
    overlappingLevel = 1,
    ...style
  } = month
    ? { isOverlapping: false, overlappingLevel: 1 }
    : allStyles[event.id] || {};

  const tabs = [
    { title: 'Description', icon: Info },
    { title: 'Attendees', icon: Users },
    { title: 'Location', icon: MapPin }
  ];

  const [selectedTab, setSelectedTab] = React.useState<number>(1);

  const eventLessThanTwoHours =
    differenceInHours(event.endDate, event.startDate) < 2;

  const getOverlappingStyles = (baseSize: string) => {
    if (!isOverlapping) return baseSize;
    if (overlappingLevel === 2)
      return `${baseSize.split('-')[0]}-${Number(baseSize.split('-')[1]) - 0.5}`;
    if (overlappingLevel === 3)
      return `${baseSize.split('-')[0]}-${Number(baseSize.split('-')[1]) - 1}`;
    if (overlappingLevel >= 4)
      return `${baseSize.split('-')[0]}-${Number(baseSize.split('-')[1]) - 1.5}`;
    return baseSize;
  };

  // check if event is full day
  if (
    event.startDate.getHours() === 0 &&
    event.endDate.getHours() === 0 &&
    event.startDate.getMinutes() === 0 &&
    event.endDate.getMinutes() === 0 &&
    differenceInDays(event.endDate, event.startDate) > 0
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        `${month ? 'px-3 py-1.5' : getOverlappingStyles('p-3.5')} overflow-hidden rounded-md border bg-white transition-all duration-300 ${
          type !== 'day' ? `border-${event.color}-500` : 'border-border'
        }`,
        !month && 'absolute',
        className
      )}
      key={event.id}
      style={style}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          `flex w-full flex-col text-foreground`,
          month && 'flex-row items-center justify-between',
          type !== 'day' && `text-${event.color}-700`
        )}
      >
        <div
          className={cn(
            'flex cursor-pointer items-center',
            type !== 'day' ? 'border-none p-0' : 'border p-2',
            'rounded-lg border-border',
            isOverlapping && getOverlappingStyles('gap-2')
          )}
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            setSelectedEvent(event);
            setManageEventDialogOpen(true);
          }}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
              e.stopPropagation();
              setSelectedEvent(event);
              setManageEventDialogOpen(true);
            }
          }}
          role='button'
          tabIndex={0}
        >
          {type === 'day' && (
            <Icon
              className={cn(
                'mr-2',
                isOverlapping && overlappingLevel >= 3 && 'p-2',
                isOverlapping && overlappingLevel >= 4 && 'p-1.5'
              )}
              event={event}
            />
          )}
          <div className='flex flex-col gap-0'>
            <p
              className={cn(
                'line-clamp-1 truncate font-bold',
                month && 'text-xs',
                month && `text-${event.color}-500`,
                isOverlapping && overlappingLevel === 2 && 'text-[14px]',
                isOverlapping && overlappingLevel === 3 && 'text-sm',
                isOverlapping && overlappingLevel >= 4 && 'text-xs'
              )}
            >
              {event.title}
            </p>
            {!month && (
              <p
                className={cn(
                  'whitespace-nowrap',
                  isOverlapping && overlappingLevel === 2 && 'text-[12px]',
                  isOverlapping && overlappingLevel === 3 && 'text-[11px]',
                  isOverlapping && overlappingLevel >= 4 && 'text-[10px]',
                  !isOverlapping && 'text-[13px]'
                )}
              >
                <span>{format(event.startDate, 'h:mm a')}</span>
                <span
                  className={cn(
                    isOverlapping && overlappingLevel >= 3 ? 'mx-0.5' : 'mx-1'
                  )}
                >

                              isOverlapping && overlappingLevel >= 3
                                ? 'size-8'
                                : 'size-10'
                            )}
                          >
                            <AvatarImage
                              alt={attendee.user?.name || 'Unknown'}
                              src={attendee.user?.avatar || ''}
                            />
                            <AvatarFallback>
                              {attendee.user?.name?.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase() ||
                                '??'}
                            </AvatarFallback>
                          </Avatar>
                          <div className='flex flex-col'>
                            <p
                              className={cn(
                                'font-medium',
                                isOverlapping &&
                                  overlappingLevel === 2 &&
                                  'text-[13px]',
