function buildOverlapGroups(
  events: CalendarEventType[]
): CalendarEventType[][] {
  const groups: CalendarEventType[][] = [];
  const processedEvents = new Set<string>();

  function findOverlappingGroup(event: CalendarEventType): CalendarEventType[] {
    const group = new Set<CalendarEventType>([event]);
    let hasNewEvents = true;

    while (hasNewEvents) {
      hasNewEvents = false;
      const currentSize = group.size;

      Array.from(group).forEach((groupEvent) => {
        events.forEach((otherEvent) => {
          if (
            !group.has(otherEvent) &&
            groupEvent.startDate < otherEvent.endDate &&
            groupEvent.endDate > otherEvent.startDate &&
            isSameDay(groupEvent.startDate, otherEvent.startDate)
          ) {
            group.add(otherEvent);
          }
        });
      });

      hasNewEvents = group.size > currentSize;
    }

    return Array.from(group);
  }

  events.forEach((event) => {
    if (!processedEvents.has(event.id)) {
      const group = findOverlappingGroup(event);
      group.forEach((e) => processedEvents.add(e.id));
      groups.push(group);
    }
  });

  return groups;
}

function calculateEventPosition(
  event: CalendarEventType,
  allEvents: CalendarEventType[]
): EventPosition {
  // Find all events that overlap with the current event
  const overlappingEvents = getOverlappingEvents(event, allEvents);

  // Create a group of events that overlap with each other
  const group = [event, ...overlappingEvents];

  // Sort events by start time, then by duration (longer events first)
  group.sort((a, b) => {
    const startDiff = a.startDate.getTime() - b.startDate.getTime();
    if (startDiff !== 0) return startDiff;

    const aDuration = a.endDate.getTime() - a.startDate.getTime();
    const bDuration = b.endDate.getTime() - b.startDate.getTime();
    return bDuration - aDuration;
  });

  // Calculate the total number of events in the group
  const totalEvents = group.length;

  // Find the position of the current event in the sorted group
  const position = group.indexOf(event);

  // Calculate width and position - each event gets equal width
  const width = `${100 / totalEvents}%`;
  const left = `${(position * 100) / totalEvents}%`;

  // Calculate vertical position
  const startHour = event.startDate.getHours();
  const startMinutes = event.startDate.getMinutes();

  let endHour = event.endDate.getHours();
  let endMinutes = event.endDate.getMinutes();

  // If event ends on a different day, cap it at end of current day
  if (!isSameDay(event.startDate, event.endDate)) {
    endHour = 23;
    endMinutes = 59;
  }

  // Calculate top position (each hour is 128px)
  const topPosition = startHour * 128 + (startMinutes / 60) * 128;

  // Calculate duration in minutes
  const duration = endHour * 60 + endMinutes - (startHour * 60 + startMinutes);

  // Convert duration to height (each hour is 128px)
  const height = (duration / 60) * 128;

  return {
    left,
    width,
    top: `${topPosition}px`,
    height: `${height}px`
  };
}

function getClassNameFromStatus(status: TeamMemberStatus) {
  const baseClass = 'border transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out';
  switch (status) {
    case TeamMemberStatus.ACTIVE:
      return `${baseClass} bg-green-500/10 text-green-500 border-green-500/30 hover:bg-green-500/20`;
    case TeamMemberStatus.BLOCKED:
      return `${baseClass} bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 border-red-500/30 hover:bg-red-500/20`;
    case TeamMemberStatus.INACTIVE:
      return `${baseClass} bg-gray-500/10 text-gray-500 border-gray-500/30 hover:bg-gray-500/20`;
    case TeamMemberStatus.PENDING:
      return `${baseClass} bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-500 border-yellow-500/30 hover:bg-yellow-500/20`;
    default:
      return `${baseClass} bg-gray-500/10 text-gray-500 border-gray-500/30 hover:bg-gray-500/20`;
  }
}

function getIcon(event: CalendarEventType) {
  const className = `w-5 h-5 text-${event.color}-500`;
  switch (event.eventType) {
    case CalendarEventTypeSchema.DEADLINE:
      return <Clock className={className} />;
    case CalendarEventTypeSchema.MEETING:
      return <FaUsers className={className} />;
    case CalendarEventTypeSchema.OTHER:
      return <CalendarIcon className={className} />;
    case CalendarEventTypeSchema.REMINDER:
      return <Bell className={className} />;
    default:
      return <CalendarIcon className={className} />;
  }
}

function getOverlappingEvents(
  currentEvent: CalendarEventType,
  events: CalendarEventType[]
): CalendarEventType[] {
  return events.filter((event) => {
    if (event.id === currentEvent.id) return false;
    return (
      currentEvent.startDate < event.endDate &&
      currentEvent.endDate > event.startDate &&
      isSameDay(currentEvent.startDate, event.startDate)
    );
  });
}

function getStylesForEveryEvent(
  events: CalendarEventType[]
): Record<string, EventStyles> {
  const styles: Record<string, EventStyles> = {};
  const groups = buildOverlapGroups(events);

  // First, set default values for all events
  events.forEach((event) => {
    styles[event.id] = {
      left: '0%',
      width: '100%',
      top: '0px',
      height: '0px',
      isOverlapping: false,
      overlappingLevel: 1
    };
  });

  groups.forEach((group) => {
    // Sort events within group by start time and duration
    group.sort((a, b) => {
      const startDiff = a.startDate.getTime() - b.startDate.getTime();
      if (startDiff !== 0) return startDiff;
      return (
        b.endDate.getTime() -
        b.startDate.getTime() -
        (a.endDate.getTime() - a.startDate.getTime())
      );
    });

    const columnWidth = 100 / group.length;
    const isOverlapping = group.length > 1;
    const overlappingLevel = group.length;

    group.forEach((event, index) => {
      const startHour = event.startDate.getHours();
      const startMinutes = event.startDate.getMinutes();
      let endHour = event.endDate.getHours();
      let endMinutes = event.endDate.getMinutes();

      if (!isSameDay(event.startDate, event.endDate)) {
        endHour = 23;
        endMinutes = 59;
      }

      const topPosition = startHour * 128 + (startMinutes / 60) * 128;
      const duration =
        endHour * 60 + endMinutes - (startHour * 60 + startMinutes);
      const height = (duration / 60) * 128;

      styles[event.id] = {
        left: `${index * columnWidth}%`,
        width: `${columnWidth}%`,
        top: `${topPosition}px`,
        height: `${height}px`,
        isOverlapping,
        overlappingLevel
      };
    });
  });

  return styles;
}

function Icon({
  event,
  className
}: Readonly<{
  className?: string;
  event: CalendarEventType;
}>) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        `rounded-lg p-3 bg-${event.color}-500/10 border-${event.color}-500 border border-opacity-30`,
        className
      )}
    >
      {getIcon(event)}
    </div>
  );
}

export function CustomTeamSheet({
  adminIds,
  teamId,
  onClose
}: Readonly<{
  adminIds: (string | bigint)[];
  onClose: () => void;
  teamId: string | bigint;
}>) {
  const {
    organizationData,
    organizationMembers,
    organizationLoading,
    organizationMembersLoading
  } = useUserData();

  const { data: customTeams, isLoading: customTeamsLoading } = useCustomTeams(
    organizationData?.organization?.id ?? ''
  );

  const team = customTeams?.find((t) => t.id === teamId);

  const isAdmin =
    organizationData?.user?.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
    organizationData?.user?.isCreator;

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [selectedUsers, setSelectedUsers] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const maxMembers = team?.maxMembers;
  const teamHasMaxMembers = team?.members?.length === maxMembers;
  const isInheritedFromTemplate = team?.templateType !== 'CUSTOM';

  const availableUsers =
    organizationMembers
      ?.filter(
        (user) =>
          !(team?.members || []).some((member) => member.userId === user.id)
      )
      .map((user) => ({
        label: user?.name || '',
        value: user?.id.toString() || ''
      })) || [];

  const allUsersAlreadyInTeam = availableUsers.length === 0;

  const handleValueChange = (values: string[]) => {
    setSelectedUsers(values);
  };

  const addMemberMutation = useAddTeamMember();
  const removeMemberMutation = useRemoveTeamMember();

  const handleAddMembers = async () => {
    if (!selectedUsers.length || !team) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      for (const userId of selectedUsers) {
        await addMemberMutation.mutateAsync({
          userId: typeof userId !== 'string' ? userId : BigInt(userId),
          teamId: team.id,
          organizationId:
            typeof organizationData?.organization?.id !== 'string'
              ? organizationData?.organization?.id
              : BigInt(organizationData?.organization?.id),
          invitedBy:
            typeof organizationData?.user?.id !== 'string'
              ? organizationData?.user?.id
              : BigInt(organizationData?.user?.id),
          permissions: [],
          attributes: {}
        } as Omit<TeamMemberCS, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>);

        // Add notification for team assignment
        await sendTeamAssignmentNotification({
          organizationId: organizationData?.organization?.id || '',
          teamId: team.id,
          teamName: team.name,
          userId,
          adminId: organizationData?.user?.id || ''
        });
      }
      const selectedUsersNames = organizationMembers
        ?.filter((user) => selectedUsers.includes(user.id.toString()))
        .map((user) => user.name);
      toast.success(
        selectedUsers.length > 1
          ? `${selectedUsers.length} members added successfully: ${selectedUsersNames?.join(', ')}`
          : `Member added successfully: ${selectedUsersNames?.[0]}`
      );
      setSelectedUsers([]);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to add members:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to add members');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveMember = async (
    memberId: string | bigint,
    userId: string | bigint
  ) => {
    try {
      await removeMemberMutation.mutateAsync({
        memberId,
        organizationId: organizationData?.organization?.id || ''
      });

      // Add notification for team config update
      await sendTeamConfigUpdatedNotification({
        organizationId: organizationData?.organization?.id || '',
        teamId: team.id,
        teamName: team.name,
        memberIds: team.members.map((m) => m.userId),
        adminId: organizationData?.user?.id || '',
        changes: {
          old: { memberIds: team.members.map((m) => m.userId) },
          new: {
            memberIds: team.members
              .filter((m) => m.id !== memberId)
              .map((m) => m.userId)
          }
        }
      });

      const removedUser = organizationMembers?.find((u) => u.id === userId);
      toast.success(`Member removed successfully: ${removedUser?.name}`);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to remove member:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to remove member');
    }
  };

  const renderMemberSelection = () => {
    if (allUsersAlreadyInTeam) {
      return (
        <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
          All organization members are already in the team.
        </p>
      );
    }

    if (teamHasMaxMembers) {
      return (
        <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
          The team has reached the maximum number of members.
        </p>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className='flex flex-col gap-2 xs:flex-row'>
        <MultiSelect
          className='max-w-full bg-background font-suisse-intl'
          defaultValue={[]}
          minItems={0}
          modalPopover={true}
          onValueChange={handleValueChange}
          options={availableUsers}
          placeholder='Select users to add...'
        />
        <Button
          disabled={loading || !selectedUsers.length}
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            handleAddMembers();
          }}
        >
          {loading ? <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin' /> : 'Add'}
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  };

  if (
    organizationLoading ||
    organizationMembersLoading ||
    customTeamsLoading ||
    !team
  ) {
    return (
      <div className='flex size-full items-center justify-center'>
        <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin' />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Sheet onOpenChange={onClose} open={true}>
      <SheetContent className='w-full max-w-3xl overflow-y-auto pb-16 font-suisse-intl'>
        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle hidden>{team.name}</SheetTitle>
        </SheetHeader>
        <SheetDescription hidden>{team.description}</SheetDescription>
        <div className='mb-6 mt-4 flex items-start justify-between'>
          <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
            <div className='rounded-lg bg-primary/10 p-2.5'>
              <BriefcaseBusiness
                className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 text-primary'
                strokeWidth={2}
              />
            </div>
            <h3 className='font-britanica text-2xl'>{team.name}</h3>
          </div>
          {isAdmin &&
            organizationData?.user?.id &&
            organizationData?.organization?.id && (
              <EditCustomTeamDialog
                adminIds={adminIds}
                organizationId={organizationData.organization.id}
                team={team}
                userId={organizationData.user.id}
              />
            )}
        </div>

        <div className='space-y-6'>
          {/* Basic Information */}
          <div className='space-y-2'>
            <h3 className='text-lg'>Basic Information</h3>
            <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 rounded-lg bg-secondary p-4 xs:grid-cols-2'>
              <div className='col-span-2'>
                <h4 className='mb-1 text-base font-medium'>Name</h4>
                <code className='inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-primary/10 px-3 py-0.5 text-xs text-primary'>
                  <PenTool className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
                  {team.name}
                </code>
              </div>
              {team.description && (
                <div className='col-span-2'>
                  <h4 className='mb-1 text-base font-medium'>Description</h4>
                  <p className='whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm text-foreground/80'>
                    {team.description}
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}
              <div>
                <h4 className='mb-1 text-base font-medium'>Type</h4>
                <code className='inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-primary/10 px-3 py-0.5 text-xs text-primary'>
                  <BriefcaseBusiness className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
                  {toTitleCase(team.type.replaceAll('_', ' '))}

export function ManageTeamMembersSheet({
  team,
  organizationId,
  cookieString,
  user,
  allUsers,
  onTeamUpdated
}: Readonly<ManageTeamMembersSheetProps>) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [selectedUsers, setSelectedUsers] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const maxMembers = team.maxMembers;

  const teamHasMaxMembers = team.members?.length === maxMembers;

  const availableUsers = allUsers.database
    .filter(
      (user) =>
        !(team.members || []).some((member) => member.userId === user.id)
    )
    .map((user) => ({
      label: user?.name || '',
      value: user?.id || ''
    }));

  const allUsersAlreadyInTeam = availableUsers.length === 0;

  const handleValueChange = (values: string[]) => {
    setSelectedUsers(values);
  };

  const getRoleBadgeVariant = (role: TeamMemberRole) => {
    switch (role) {
      case TeamMemberRole.OWNER:
        return 'default';
      case TeamMemberRole.ADMIN:
        return 'destructive';
      case TeamMemberRole.MEMBER:
        return 'secondary';
      case TeamMemberRole.GUEST:
        return 'outline';
      default:
        return 'secondary';
    }
  };

  const addMembersMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (userId: string) => {
      const addedUser = allUsers.database.find((u) => u.id === userId);
      const adminUser = allUsers.database.find((u) => u.id === user.sub);
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${team.id}/members?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            userId,
            teamId: team.id,
            status: TeamMemberStatus.ACTIVE,
            invitedBy: user.sub,
            organizationId,
            role: TeamMemberRole.MEMBER,
            attributes: {},
            metadata: {}
          })
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Failed to add member');
      }

      const teamMemberActivityLog: CreateTeamMemberActivityLogResponse =
        await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-member-activity-logs?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'cookie': cookieString,
              'cookie-string': cookieString,
              'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              activityType: TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_ADDED,
              details: {
                message: `Team member ${addedUser?.name} was added by ${adminUser?.name}.`,
                changedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                changedBy: adminUser?.id,
                oldValues: {},
                newValues: {},
                metadata: undefined
              } as TeamMemberActivityLogDetails,
              metadata: {
                metadata: {},
                teamId: team.id,
                performedBy: adminUser?.id,
                usersInvolved: [addedUser?.id, adminUser?.id],
                version: '1.0.0'
              } as TeamMemberActivityLogMetadata,
              performedBy: adminUser?.id,
              teamId: team.id,
              userId: addedUser?.id
            } as Omit<TeamMemberActivityLogInsert, 'id' | 'uid' | 'createdAt'>)
          }
        ).then((res) => res.json());

      if (
        teamMemberActivityLog.message !==
        'Team member activity log created successfully'
      ) {
        console.error('Failed to create team member activity log', {
          teamMemberActivityLog
        });
        clientLogger.warn('Failed to create team member activity log', {
          teamMemberActivityLog
        });
      }

      const data: AddTeamMemberResponse = await response.json();
      if (data.message !== 'Team member added successfully') {
        throw new Error('Invalid response from server');
      }
      return data;
    },
    onMutate: async (userId) => {
      await queryClient.cancelQueries({
        queryKey: ['teams', organizationId]
      });

      const newUser = allUsers.database.find((u) => u.id === userId);
      if (!newUser) return;

      // Create an optimistic team update with proper types
      const optimisticTeam = {
        ...team,
        members: [...(team.members || [])]
      } as CustomTeamWithMembers;

      // Update the cache
      queryClient.setQueryData<CustomTeamWithMembers[]>(
        ['teams', organizationId],
        (old) => (old || []).map((t) => (t.id === team.id ? optimisticTeam : t))
      );

      // Update the UI
      onTeamUpdated(optimisticTeam);

      return { optimisticTeam };
    },
    onError: (error, userId, context) => {
      if (context?.optimisticTeam) {
        // Revert the optimistic update
        onTeamUpdated(team);
        queryClient.setQueryData<CustomTeamWithMembers[]>(
          ['teams', organizationId],
          (old) => (old || []).map((t) => (t.id === team.id ? team : t))
        );
      }
      console.error('Error adding member:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to add member');
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      if (data.message !== 'Team member added successfully') return;

      // Update with the actual server response
      const updatedTeam = {
        ...team,
        members: [...(team.members || []), data.member]
      } as CustomTeamWithMembers;
      queryClient.setQueryData<CustomTeamWithMembers[]>(
        ['teams', organizationId],
        (old) => (old || []).map((t) => (t.id === team.id ? updatedTeam : t))
      );
      onTeamUpdated(updatedTeam);
    }
  });

  const removeMemberMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      memberId,
      userId
    }: {
      memberId: string;
      userId: string;
    }) => {
      const removedUser = allUsers.database.find((u) => u.id === userId);
      const adminUser = allUsers.database.find((u) => u.id === user.sub);
      const response = await fetch(

        {

          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          }

      }

        await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-member-activity-logs?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'cookie': cookieString,
              'cookie-string': cookieString,
              'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              activityType: TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_REMOVED,
              details: {
                message: `Team member ${removedUser?.name} was removed by ${adminUser?.name}.`,
                changedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                changedBy: adminUser?.id,
                oldValues: {},
                newValues: {},
                metadata: undefined
              } as TeamMemberActivityLogDetails,
              metadata: {
                metadata: {},
                teamId: team.id,
                performedBy: adminUser?.id,
                usersInvolved: [removedUser?.id, adminUser?.id],
                version: '1.0.0'
              } as TeamMemberActivityLogMetadata,
              performedBy: adminUser?.id,
              teamId: team.id,
              userId: removedUser?.id
            } as Omit<TeamMemberActivityLogInsert, 'id' | 'uid' | 'createdAt'>)
          }
        ).then((res) => res.json());

      if (
        teamMemberActivityLog.message !==
        'Team member activity log created successfully'
      ) {
        console.error('Failed to create team member activity log', {
          teamMemberActivityLog
        });
        clientLogger.warn('Failed to create team member activity log', {
          teamMemberActivityLog
        });
      }

      const data: RemoveTeamMemberResponse = await response.json();
      if (data.message !== 'Team member removed successfully') {
        throw new Error('Invalid response from server');
      }
      return data;
    },
    onMutate: async ({ memberId, userId }) => {
      await queryClient.cancelQueries({
        queryKey: ['teams', organizationId]
      });

      // Create an optimistic team update with proper types
      const optimisticTeam: CustomTeamWithMembers = {
        ...team,
        members: (team.members || []).filter((member) => {
          const { id, userId: memberUserId } = member;
          return id !== memberId && memberUserId !== userId;
        })
      };

      // Update the cache
      queryClient.setQueryData<CustomTeamWithMembers[]>(
        ['teams', organizationId],
        (old) => (old || []).map((t) => (t.id === team.id ? optimisticTeam : t))
      );

      // Update the UI
      onTeamUpdated(optimisticTeam);

      return { optimisticTeam };
    },
    onError: (error, memberId, context) => {
      if (context?.optimisticTeam) {
        // Revert the optimistic update
        onTeamUpdated(team);
        queryClient.setQueryData<CustomTeamWithMembers[]>(
          ['teams', organizationId],
          (old) => (old || []).map((t) => (t.id === team.id ? team : t))
        );
      }
      console.error('Error removing member:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to remove member');
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      if (data.message !== 'Team member removed successfully') return;

      // Update with the actual server response
      const updatedTeam = {
        ...team,
        members: (team.members || []).filter(
          (member) => member.id !== data.member.id
        )
      } as CustomTeamWithMembers;
      queryClient.setQueryData<CustomTeamWithMembers[]>(
        ['teams', organizationId],
        (old) => (old || []).map((t) => (t.id === team.id ? updatedTeam : t))
      );
      onTeamUpdated(updatedTeam);
    }
  });

  const handleAddMembers = async () => {
    if (!selectedUsers.length) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      for (const userId of selectedUsers) {
        await addMembersMutation.mutateAsync(userId);
      }
      const selectedUsersNames = (allUsers.database ?? allUsers.logto)
        .filter((user) => selectedUsers.includes(user.id))
        .map((user) => user.name);
      toast.success(
        selectedUsers.length > 1
          ? `${selectedUsers.length} members added successfully: ${selectedUsersNames.join(', ')}`
          : `Member added successfully: ${selectedUsersNames[0]}`
      );
      setSelectedUsers([]);
      window.location.reload();
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveMember = async (memberId: string, userId: string) => {
    await removeMemberMutation.mutateAsync({
      memberId,
      userId
    });
    const removedUser = allUsers.database.find((u) => u.id === userId);
    toast.success(`Member removed successfully: ${removedUser?.name}`);
    window.location.reload();
  };

  const renderMemberSelection = () => {
    if (allUsersAlreadyInTeam) {
      return (
        <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
          All organization members are already in the team.
        </p>
      );

    if (teamHasMaxMembers) {
      return (
        <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
          The team has reached the maximum number of members.
        </p>
      );
    }

    return (
      <MultiSelect
        options={availableUsers}
        onValueChange={handleValueChange}
        defaultValue={[]}
        placeholder='Select users to add...'
        modalPopover={true}
        minItems={0}
      />
    );
  };

  return (

      <SheetTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant='ghost' size='icon' className='h-8 w-8'>
          <UserPlus className='h-4 w-4' />

        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle>Team Members</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription>
            View and manage team members for {team?.name}.
          </SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>

            <div className='flex flex-col gap-4'>
              <div>
                <h3 className='mb-2 text-sm font-medium'>Add Members</h3>
                <div className='flex gap-2'>
                  <div className='flex-1'>{renderMemberSelection()}</div>
                  {!allUsersAlreadyInTeam && !teamHasMaxMembers && (
                    <Button
                      onClick={handleAddMembers}
                      disabled={loading || !selectedUsers.length}
                    >
                      {loading ? (
                        <Loader2 className='h-4 w-4 animate-spin' />
                      ) : (
                        'Add'
                      )}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p className='mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                  {team?.members?.length} of {team?.maxMembers} members
                </p>
              </div>

              <div>
                <h3 className='mb-2 text-sm font-medium'>Current Members</h3>
                <div className='space-y-2'>

                            alt={member.user?.name}

                          className='capitalize'
                        >
                          {toTitleCase(member.role)}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>

                        member.role !== TeamMemberRole.OWNER && (
                          <AlertDialog>

                                  Remove {member.user?.name}

'use client';

import type { GetNotificationPreferenceResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/v2/notifications';
import type {
  NotificationANS,
  NotificationPreferenceANS
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/notifications_/types';
import type { Socket } from 'socket.io-client';

import { useAuth } from '@/contexts/auth-context';
import { api } from '@/lib/api';

  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,

  useMemo,

// Query keys for better type safety and reusability
const QUERY_KEYS = {
  notifications: ['notifications'] as const,
  unreadCount: ['notifications', 'unreadCount'] as const,
  preferences: ['notifications', 'preferences'] as const,
  archived: ['notifications', 'archived'] as const
} as const;

// API functions
const notificationsApi = {
  /**
   * Fetches notifications for a user.
   * @param cookieString - The cookie string.
   * @param userId - The user ID.
   * @returns The notifications.
   */
  async fetchNotifications(cookieString: string, userId: string) {
    return api.get<{ notifications: NotificationANS[] }>(
      `api/v2/notifications/${userId}`,
      cookieString
    );
  },

  /**
   * Fetches the unread count for a user.
   * @param cookieString - The cookie string.
   * @param userId - The user ID.
   * @returns The unread count.
   */
  async fetchUnreadCount(cookieString: string, userId: string) {
    return api.get<{ count: number }>(
      `api/v2/notifications/unread/count/${userId}`,
      cookieString
    );
  },

  /**
   * Fetches the notification preferences for a user.
   * @param cookieString - The cookie string.
   * @param userId - The user ID.
   * @returns The notification preferences.
   */
  async fetchPreferences(cookieString: string, userId: string) {
    return api.get<GetNotificationPreferenceResponse>(
      `api/v2/notifications/preferences/${userId}`,
      cookieString
    );
  },

  /**
   * Deletes a notification.
   * @param id - The notification ID.
   * @param cookieString - The cookie string.
   * @param userId - The user ID.
   * @returns The deleted notification.
   */
  async deleteNotification(id: string, cookieString: string, userId: string) {
    return api.delete<NotificationANS>(
      `api/v2/notifications/${id}/${userId}`,
      cookieString
    );
  },

  /**
   * Deletes all notifications for a user.
   * @param cookieString - The cookie string.
   * @param userId - The user ID.
   * @returns An object with a message.
   */
  async clearAll(cookieString: string, userId: string) {
    return api.delete<{ message: string }>(
      `api/v2/notifications/all/${userId}`,
      cookieString
    );
  },

  /**
   * Marks a notification as read.
   * @param id - The notification ID.
   * @param cookieString - The cookie string.
   * @param userId - The user ID.
   * @returns The notification.
   */
  async markAsRead(id: string, cookieString: string, userId: string) {
    return api.post<NotificationANS>(
      `api/v2/notifications/${id}/mark-read/${userId}`,
      {},
      cookieString
    );
  },

  /**
   * Marks all notifications as read.
   * @param cookieString - The cookie string.
   * @param userId - The user ID.
   * @returns The notifications.
   */
  async markAllAsRead(cookieString: string, userId: string) {
    return api.post<NotificationANS[]>(
      `api/v2/notifications/mark-all-read/${userId}`,
      {},
      cookieString
    );
  },

  /**
   * Updates the notification preferences for a user.
   * @param prefs - The notification preferences.
   * @param cookieString - The cookie string.
   * @param userId - The user ID.
   * @returns The notification preferences.
   */
  async updatePreferences(
    prefs: Partial<NotificationPreferenceANS>,
    cookieString: string,
    userId: string
  ) {
    return api.patch<NotificationPreferenceANS>(
      `api/v2/notifications/preferences/${userId}`,
      prefs,
      cookieString
    );
  }
};

/**
 * The notification context type.
 */
type NotificationContextType = {
  clearAll: () => Promise<void>;
  deleteNotification: (id: bigint | string) => Promise<void>;
  error: string | null;
  isLoading: boolean;
  markAllAsRead: () => Promise<void>;
  markAsRead: (id: bigint | string) => Promise<void>;
  notifications: NotificationANS[];
  preferences: NotificationPreferenceANS | null;
  refetchData: () => Promise<void>;
  unreadCount: number;
  updatePreferences: (
    prefs: Partial<NotificationPreferenceANS>
  ) => Promise<void>;
};

// Create notification context
const NotificationContext = createContext<NotificationContextType | undefined>(
  undefined
);

/**
 * The notification provider component.
 * @param children - The child elements.
 * @param cookieString - The cookie string.
 * @returns The notification provider component.

export function NotificationProvider({
  children,
  cookieString
}: Readonly<{
  children: React.ReactNode;
  cookieString: string;
}>) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { isAuthenticated, isLoading: authLoading, dbUser } = useAuth();

  const socket: Socket | null = useSocket(dbUser?.id.toString());

  // Add socket connection state
  const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState(false);

  // Queries
  const {
    data: notificationsData,
    error: notificationsError,
    isLoading: isLoadingNotifications
  } = useQuery({
    queryKey: QUERY_KEYS.notifications,
    queryFn: () =>
      notificationsApi.fetchNotifications(cookieString, dbUser?.id.toString()),
    enabled: isAuthenticated && !!dbUser?.id,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: true,
    refetchOnMount: true,
    refetchOnReconnect: true,
    staleTime: 30000
  });

    data: unreadCountData,

  } = useQuery({

    queryFn: () =>
      notificationsApi.fetchUnreadCount(cookieString, dbUser?.id.toString()),

    refetchOnWindowFocus: true,
    refetchOnMount: true,
    refetchOnReconnect: true,
    staleTime: 30000

    data: preferencesData,
    error: preferencesError,
    isLoading: isLoadingPreferences
  } = useQuery({
    queryKey: QUERY_KEYS.preferences,
    queryFn: () =>
      notificationsApi.fetchPreferences(cookieString, dbUser?.id.toString()),
    enabled: isAuthenticated && !!dbUser?.id
  });

  const markAsReadMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: bigint | string) =>
      notificationsApi.markAsRead(
        typeof id === 'bigint' ? id.toString() : id,
        cookieString,
        dbUser?.id.toString()
      ),
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: QUERY_KEYS.notifications
      });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: QUERY_KEYS.unreadCount

    onError: (error) =>

        'Error marking notification as read',

        'frontend-notifications'

    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: QUERY_KEYS.notifications
      });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: QUERY_KEYS.unreadCount
      });
    },
    onError: (error) =>
      clientLogger.error(
        'Error marking all notifications as read',
        { error },
        'frontend-notifications'
      )

    mutationFn: (id: bigint | string) =>
      notificationsApi.deleteNotification(
        typeof id === 'bigint' ? id.toString() : id,
        cookieString,
        dbUser?.id.toString()
      ),
    onSuccess: () => {

      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: QUERY_KEYS.unreadCount
      });
    },
    onError: (error) =>
      clientLogger.error(
        'Error deleting notification',
        { error },
        'frontend-notifications'
      )
  });

      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: QUERY_KEYS.unreadCount
      });
    },

      clientLogger.error(
        'Error clearing all notifications',
        { error },
        'frontend-notifications'
      )
  });

        cookieString,
        dbUser?.id.toString()

        queryKey: QUERY_KEYS.preferences

  });

        clientLogger.info(

    });

    return () => {
      clientLogger.info(
        '[NotificationsContext] Cleaning up socket listeners',
        {},
        'frontend-notifications'
      );
      if (socket) {
        socket.off('notification');
        socket.off('connect');
        socket.off('disconnect');
      }
    };
  }, [
    isAuthenticated,
    dbUser?.id,
    queryClient,
    preferencesData?.preferences?.browserNotificationsEnabled,
    socket,
    authLoading
  ]);

  // Add automatic reconnection
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isConnected && isAuthenticated && dbUser?.id) {
      const reconnectTimer = setInterval(() => {
        socket.connect();
      }, 5000);

      return () => clearInterval(reconnectTimer);
    }
  }, [isConnected, isAuthenticated, dbUser?.id, socket]);

  const error = notificationsError || unreadCountError || preferencesError;
  const isLoading =
    isLoadingNotifications || isLoadingUnreadCount || isLoadingPreferences;

  const refetchData = useCallback(async () => {
    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: QUERY_KEYS.notifications
      }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: QUERY_KEYS.unreadCount
      }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: QUERY_KEYS.preferences
      }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: QUERY_KEYS.archived
      })
    ]);
    clientLogger.info(
      'Refetched notification data',
      {},
      'frontend-notifications'
    );
  }, [queryClient]);

  const markAsRead = useCallback(
    async (id: bigint | string) => {
      await markAsReadMutation.mutateAsync(id);
      await createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.NOTIFICATION_READ,
        category: AuditLogCategory.NOTIFICATIONS,
        entityId: BigInt(id),
        entityType: 'notification',
        description: `User marked notification as read`
      }).catch((err) =>
        clientLogger.error('Failed to log markAsRead', { error: err })
      );
    },
    [markAsReadMutation.mutate]
  );

  const markAllAsRead = useCallback(async () => {
    await markAllAsReadMutation.mutateAsync();
    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.NOTIFICATIONS_READ_ALL,
      category: AuditLogCategory.NOTIFICATIONS,
      description: `User marked all notifications as read`
    }).catch((err) =>
      clientLogger.error('Failed to log markAllAsRead', { error: err })
    );
  }, [markAllAsReadMutation.mutate]);

  const deleteNotification = useCallback(
    async (id: bigint | string) => {
      await deleteNotificationMutation.mutateAsync(id);
      await createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.NOTIFICATION_DELETED,
        category: AuditLogCategory.NOTIFICATIONS,
        entityId: BigInt(id),
        entityType: 'notification',
        description: `User deleted a notification`
      }).catch((err) =>
        clientLogger.error('Failed to log deleteNotification', { error: err })
      );
    },
    [deleteNotificationMutation.mutate]
  );

  const clearAll = useCallback(async () => {
    await clearAllMutation.mutateAsync();
    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.NOTIFICATIONS_CLEARED,
      category: AuditLogCategory.NOTIFICATIONS,
      description: `User cleared all notifications`
    }).catch((err) =>
      clientLogger.error('Failed to log clearAll', { error: err })
    );
  }, [clearAllMutation.mutate]);

  const updatePreferences = useCallback(
    async (prefs: Partial<NotificationPreferenceANS>) => {
      await updatePreferencesMutation.mutateAsync(prefs);
      await createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS_UPDATED,
        category: AuditLogCategory.NOTIFICATIONS,
        description: `User updated notification preferences`,
        afterState: { preferences: prefs }
      }).catch((err) =>
        clientLogger.error('Failed to log updatePreferences', { error: err })
      );
    },
    [updatePreferencesMutation.mutate]
  );

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      notifications: notificationsData?.notifications || [],
      unreadCount: parseInt(String(unreadCountData?.count) || '0'),
      preferences: preferencesData?.preferences || null,
      error: error ? error.message : null,
      isLoading,
      markAsRead,
      markAllAsRead,
      deleteNotification,
      clearAll,
      updatePreferences,
      refetchData: refetchData as () => Promise<void>
    }),
    [
      notificationsData?.notifications,
      unreadCountData?.count,
      preferencesData?.preferences,
      error,
      isLoading,
      markAsRead,
      markAllAsRead,
      deleteNotification,
      clearAll,
      updatePreferences,
      refetchData
    ]
  );

  return (
    <NotificationContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </NotificationContext.Provider>
  );
}

/**
 * Custom hook to use notifications.
 * @returns The notification context.
 */
export function useNotifications() {
  const context = useContext(NotificationContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error(
      'useNotifications must be used within NotificationProvider'
    );
  }
  return context;
}

export const orgDetailsResolver = zodResolver(
  z
    .object({
      name: z.string().min(3, 'Name must be at least 3 characters').max(128),
      description: z
        .string()
        .min(10, 'Description must be at least 10 characters')
        .max(1024),
      legalCorporateName: z.string().max(128),
      taxId: z.string().max(128),
      industryType: z
        .nativeEnum(IndustryType)
        .default(IndustryType.NOT_APPLICABLE),
      sizeCategory: z
        .nativeEnum(SizeCategory)
        .default(SizeCategory.NOT_APPLICABLE),
      naicsCode: z.string().max(128).default('')
    })
    .superRefine((data, ctx) => {
      // Check if any business field is filled
      const anyBusinessFieldFilled =
        !!data.legalCorporateName ||
        !!data.taxId ||
        data.industryType !== IndustryType.NOT_APPLICABLE ||
        data.sizeCategory !== SizeCategory.NOT_APPLICABLE ||
        !!data.naicsCode;

      // If any business field is filled, all business fields become required
      if (anyBusinessFieldFilled) {
        if (!data.legalCorporateName) {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
            message:
              'Legal corporate name is required when any business field is filled',
            path: ['legalCorporateName']
          });
        }
        if (!data.taxId) {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
            message: 'Tax ID is required when any business field is filled',
            path: ['taxId']
          });
        }
        if (data.industryType === IndustryType.NOT_APPLICABLE) {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
            message:
              'Industry type is required when any business field is filled',
            path: ['industryType']
          });
        }
        if (data.sizeCategory === SizeCategory.NOT_APPLICABLE) {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
            message:
              'Size category is required when any business field is filled',
            path: ['sizeCategory']
          });
        }
        if (!data.naicsCode) {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
            message:
              'Industry classification is required when any business field is filled',
            path: ['naicsCode']
          });
        }
      }
    })
);

export const inviteUsersResolver = zodResolver(

      .array(
        z.object({

          email: z.string().email('Invalid email address').max(256),
          role: z.enum(

          ),
          team: z.string().min(1, 'Team is required'),
          attributes: z.object({
            function: z.object({
              primary: z.nativeEnum(FunctionPrimaryRole),
              specialization: z.nativeEnum(FunctionSpecialization)
            }),
            clearance: z.object({
              level: z.nativeEnum(ClearanceSecurityLevel),
              scope: z
                .array(z.nativeEnum(AccessScope))
                .min(1, 'At least one access scope is required')
                .max(5, 'You can only select 5 access scopes')
            }),
            temporalAccess: z.object({
              timezone: z.string().superRefine((data, ctx) => {
                if (!Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone').includes(data)) {
                  ctx.addIssue({
                    code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
                    message: 'Invalid timezone'
                  });
                }
              }),
              schedule: z.object({
                days: z
                  .array(z.nativeEnum(Weekday))
                  .min(1, 'At least one day is required'),
                hours: z
                  .object({
                    start: z.string(),
                    end: z.string()
                  })
                  .superRefine((data, ctx) => {
                    // Use a fixed date to compare times
                    const startTime = new Date(`1970-01-01T${data.start}:00`);
                    const endTime = new Date(`1970-01-01T${data.end}:00`);
                    if (startTime >= endTime) {
                      ctx.addIssue({
                        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
                        message: 'Start time must be before end time'
                      });
                    }
                  }),
                timeRange: z
                  .string()
                  .optional()
                  .superRefine((data, ctx) => {
                    if (data) {
                      const [start, end] = data.split('-');
                      const startTime = new Date(`1970-01-01T${start}:00`);
                      const endTime = new Date(`1970-01-01T${end}:00`);
                      if (startTime >= endTime) {
                        ctx.addIssue({
                          code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
                          message: 'Start time must be before end time'
                        });
                      }
                    }
                  })
              })
            })
          }),
          permissions: z.array(z.nativeEnum(PermissionType))
        })

type TemplateFillingFormProps = {
  template: DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS;
  currentUserDbId: string;
  currentOrganizationId: string;
  dbUser: UserCS;
};

export default function TemplateFillingForm({
  template,
  currentUserDbId,
  currentOrganizationId,
  dbUser
}: TemplateFillingFormProps) {
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [isSuccess, setIsSuccess] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();
  const { organizationData, organizationLoading } = useUserData();

  const createFormSchema = (fields: DocumentTemplateField[] = []) => {
    const schemaObject: Record<string, z.ZodTypeAny> = {};

    fields.forEach((field) => {
      let fieldSchema;

      switch (field.type) {
        case 'string':
          fieldSchema = z.string();
          if (field.required) {
            fieldSchema = fieldSchema.min(1, `${field.label} is required`);
          }
          break;
        case 'number':
          fieldSchema = z.coerce.number();
          if (field.required) {
            fieldSchema = fieldSchema.min(
              0,
              `${field.label} must be a positive number`
            );
          }
          break;
        case 'date':
          fieldSchema = z.string();
          if (field.required) {
            fieldSchema = fieldSchema.min(1, `${field.label} is required`);
          }
          break;
        case 'boolean':
          fieldSchema = z.boolean().default(false);
          break;
        case 'select':
          fieldSchema = z.string();
          if (field.required) {
            fieldSchema = fieldSchema.min(1, `${field.label} is required`);
          }
          break;
        case 'multi-select':
          fieldSchema = z.array(z.string()).optional();
          if (field.required) {
            fieldSchema = z
              .array(z.string())
              .min(1, `${field.label} is required`);
          }
          break;
        case 'image':
        case 'file':
          fieldSchema = z.instanceof(File).optional();
          if (field.required) {
            fieldSchema = z.instanceof(File, {
              message: `${field.label} is required`
            });
          }
          break;
        case 'signature':
          fieldSchema = z
            .object({
              type: z.enum(['typed', 'drawn', 'uploaded']),
              value: z.any()
            })
            .optional();
          if (field.required) {
            fieldSchema = z.object({
              type: z.enum(['typed', 'drawn', 'uploaded']),
              value: z.any().refine((val) => {
                if (val instanceof File) return true;
                if (typeof val === 'string' && val.length > 0) return true;
                return false;
              }, 'Signature is required')
            });
          }
          break;
        default:
          fieldSchema = z.any();
      }
      if (!field.required) {
        fieldSchema = fieldSchema.optional();
      }
      schemaObject[field.name] = fieldSchema;
    });

    return z.object(schemaObject);
  };

  const formSchema = createFormSchema(
    template?.fields as DocumentTemplateField[]
  );
  type FormValues = z.infer<typeof formSchema>;

  const form = useForm<FormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(formSchema),
    defaultValues:
      (template?.fields as DocumentTemplateField[])?.reduce((acc, field) => {
        acc[field.name as keyof FormValues] =
          field.type === 'boolean' ? false : '';
        if (field.type === 'multi-select') {
          acc[field.name as keyof FormValues] = [];
        }
        return acc;
      }, {}) || {}
  });

  const onSubmit = async (values: FormValues) => {
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    const processedValues = { ...values };

    for (const field of template.fields as DocumentTemplateField[]) {
      if (
        (field.type === 'image' || field.type === 'file') &&
        processedValues[field.name] instanceof File
      ) {
        try {
          const file = processedValues[field.name] as File;
          const { url } = await uploadFileToS3(
            file,
            currentOrganizationId.toString()
          );
          processedValues[field.name] = url;
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(`Failed to upload ${field.type}:`, error);
          toast.error(`Failed to upload ${field.label}. Please try again.`);
          setIsSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
      } else if (field.type === 'signature' && processedValues[field.name]) {
        const signature = processedValues[field.name] as {
          type: 'typed' | 'drawn' | 'uploaded';
          value: File | string;
        };
        // If the user typed but also has a saved default image signature, prefer stored URL for better appearance in generated PDF
        if (signature.type === 'typed' && dbUser?.savedSignatures?.length) {
          const saved = dbUser.savedSignatures as UserSavedSignature[];
          const def = saved.find((s) => s.isDefault) ?? saved[0];
          if (def?.image?.url) {
            processedValues[field.name] = def.image.url;
            continue;
          }
        }
        if (signature.type === 'drawn' || signature.type === 'uploaded') {
          if (signature.value instanceof File) {
            try {
              const { url } = await uploadFileToS3(
                signature.value,
                currentOrganizationId.toString()
              );
              processedValues[field.name] = url;
            } catch (error) {
              console.error('Failed to upload signature:', error);
              toast.error('Failed to upload signature. Please try again.');
              setIsSubmitting(false);
              return;
            }
          }
        } else {
          processedValues[field.name] = signature.value;
        }
      }
    }

    try {
      const newDocument = await submitDocumentFromTemplate({
        templateId: template.id,
        organizationId: BigInt(currentOrganizationId),
        ownerId: BigInt(currentUserDbId),
        customFields: processedValues,
        templateData: {
          name: template.name,
          description: template.description,
          fields: template.fields as DocumentTemplateField[],
          organizationName: organizationLoading
            ? 'Unknown Organization'
            : organizationData?.organization?.name,
          submittedBy: extractNameFromUser(dbUser)
        }
      });

      toast.success(
        `Form "${template.name}" submitted successfully! A PDF has been generated and saved to your documents.`
      );
      await createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.TEMPLATE_USED,
        category: AuditLogCategory.TEMPLATE_MANAGEMENT,
        entityId: template.id,
        entityType: 'document_template',
        entityName: template.name,
        description: `User filled and submitted template: "${template.name}"`,
        metadata: { newDocumentId: String(newDocument.id) }
      }).catch(console.error);
      setIsSuccess(true);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to submit form:', error);
      toast.error(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to submit form'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const renderField = (field: DocumentTemplateField) => {
    switch (field.type) {
      case 'string':
        return (
          <FormField
            key={field.name}
            control={form.control}
            name={String(field.name as keyof FormValues)}
            render={({ field: formField }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>
                  {field.label}
                  {field.required && (
                    <span className='text-destructive'>*</span>
                  )}
                </FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Input
                    type='text'
                    placeholder={field.description || field.label}
                    {...formField}
                  />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
        );
      case 'number':
        return (
          <FormField
            key={field.name}
            control={form.control}
            name={String(field.name as keyof FormValues)}
            render={({ field: formField }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>
                  {field.label}
                  {field.required && (
                    <span className='text-destructive'>*</span>
                  )}
                </FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Input
                    type='number'
                    placeholder={field.description || field.label}
                    {...formField}
                  />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
        );
      case 'date':
        return (
          <FormField
            key={field.name}
            control={form.control}
            name={String(field.name as keyof FormValues)}
            render={({ field: formField }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>
                  {field.label}
                  {field.required && (
                    <span className='text-destructive'>*</span>
                  )}
                </FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Input
                    type='date'
                    {...formField}
                    value={formField.value as string | undefined}
                  />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
        );
      case 'select':
        return (
          <FormField
            key={field.name}
            control={form.control}
            name={String(field.name as keyof FormValues)}
            render={({ field: formField }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>
                  {field.label}
                  {field.required && (
                    <span className='text-destructive'>*</span>
                  )}
                </FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Select
                    onValueChange={formField.onChange}
                    defaultValue={formField.value}
                  >
                    <SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectValue
                        placeholder={
                          field.description ||
                          `Select ${field.label.toLowerCase()}`
                        }
                      />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
                      {field.options?.map((option) => (
                        <SelectItem key={option} value={option}>
                          {option}
                        </SelectItem>
                      ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
        );
      case 'multi-select':
        return (
          <FormField
            key={field.name}
            control={form.control}
            name={String(field.name as keyof FormValues)}
            render={({ field: formField }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>
                  {field.label}
                  {field.required && (
                    <span className='text-destructive'>*</span>
                  )}
                </FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <MultiSelect
                    options={
                      field.options?.map((option) => ({

                        label: option
                      })) ?? []
                    }
                    onValueChange={formField.onChange}
                    defaultValue={formField.value}
                    placeholder={
                      field.description || `Select ${field.label.toLowerCase()}`
                    }
                  />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
        );
      case 'boolean':
        return (
          <FormField
            key={field.name}
            control={form.control}
            name={String(field.name as keyof FormValues)}
            render={({ field: formField }) => (
              <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-start space-x-3 space-y-0 rounded-lg border p-4'>
                <FormControl>
                  <Checkbox
                    checked={formField.value}
                    onCheckedChange={formField.onChange}
                  />
                </FormControl>
                <div className='space-y-1 leading-none'>
                  <FormLabel>
                    {field.label}
                    {field.required && (
                      <span className='text-destructive'>*</span>
                    )}
                  </FormLabel>
                  {field.description && (
                    <p className='whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                      {field.description}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
        );
      case 'image':
      case 'file':
        return (
          <FileAttachmentField
            key={field.name}
            field={field}
            form={form}
            isImage={field.type === 'image'}
          />
        );
      case 'signature':
        return <SignatureField key={field.name} field={field} form={form} />;
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  if (isSuccess) {
    return (
      <Card className='w-full max-w-xl'>
        <CardHeader className='items-center text-center'>
          <CheckCircle2 className='size-12 text-green-500' />
          <CardTitle className='font-britanica text-2xl'>
            Form Submitted Successfully
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription className='font-suisse-intl'>
            Your response for the form "
            <span className='font-bold'>{template.name}</span>" has been
            recorded.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className='flex justify-center gap-4'>
          <Button onClick={() => router.push('/account/my-documents')}>
            Go to My Documents
          </Button>
          {/* We can uncomment the below code IF we want to allow users to submit the same form more than once */}
          {/* <Button variant='outline' onClick={() => setIsSuccess(false)}>
            Submit Another
          </Button> */}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  const fields = (template.fields as DocumentTemplateField[]) || [];

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader className='text-center'>
        <CardTitle className='font-britanica text-2xl md:text-3xl'>
          {template.name}
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription className='whitespace-pre-wrap text-left font-suisse-intl'>
          {template.description ||
            'Fill in the required information to create a document from this template.'}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <Form {...form}>
          <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className='space-y-6'>
            {fields.length === 0 ? (
              <div className='py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground'>
                <p>This template has no custom fields to fill.</p>
                <p className='text-sm'>
                  Click "Submit" to create the document directly.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className='space-y-4'>{fields.map(renderField)}</div>
            )}

            <div className='flex justify-end'>
              <Button type='submit' disabled={isSubmitting}>
                {isSubmitting && (
                  <Loader2 className='mr-2 size-4 animate-spin' />
                )}
                Submit Form
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Form>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

  if (id.includes('_processed_')) {
    return id.split('_processed_')[0];
  }
  return id;
}

        'team-calendar'
      );
      toast.error('Failed to update event');
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteEvent = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      clientLogger.info(
        'Deleting team calendar event',
        {
          teamId,
          organizationId,
          eventId: id
        },
        'team-calendar'
      );

      // 1. Delete the event
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-calendar-events/${checkAndReplaceProccessedEventId(id)}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          }
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        const error = await response.json();
        clientLogger.error(
          'Failed to delete team calendar event',
          {
            teamId,
            organizationId,
            eventId: id,
            error
          },
          'team-calendar'
        );
        toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to delete event');
        return;
      }

      clientLogger.info(
        'Team calendar event deleted successfully',
        {
          teamId,
          organizationId,
          eventId: id
        },
        'team-calendar'
      );

      // 2. Delete the attendees
      const attendeesResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-calendar-events/${checkAndReplaceProccessedEventId(id)}/attendees?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          }
        }
      );

      if (!attendeesResponse.ok) {
        const error = await attendeesResponse.json();
        clientLogger.error(
          'Failed to delete attendees',
          {
            teamId,
            organizationId,
            eventId: id,
            error
          },
          'team-calendar'
        );
        toast.error('Failed to delete event attendees: ' + error.message);
        return;
      }

      setEvents((prevEvents) => prevEvents.filter((e) => e.id !== id));
      toast.success('Event deleted successfully');
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error(
        'Error deleting team calendar event',
        {
          teamId,
          organizationId,
          eventId: id,
          error
        },
        'team-calendar'
      );
      toast.error('Failed to delete event');
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className='mb-8 flex items-center justify-between'>
        <div>
          <div className='mb-8 flex items-center gap-4'>
            <Link
              href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}`}
            >
              <Button
                variant='outline'
                className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
              >
                <ChevronLeft className='h-4 w-4' />
                Back to Team
              </Button>
            </Link>
          </div>
          <h1 className='font-signvault text-3xl font-bold'>
            {team.name} - Event Calendar
          </h1>
          <p className='mt-2 text-muted-foreground'>
            Schedule and manage team events
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <CalendarProvider
        events={events}
        setEvents={setEvents}
        mode={mode}
        setMode={setMode}
        date={date}
        selectedDate={selectedDate}
        setDate={setDate}
        setSelectedDate={setSelectedDate}
        topOffset={topOffset}
        setTopOffset={setTopOffset}
        selectedTab={selectedTab}
        setSelectedTab={setSelectedTab}
        viewType={viewType}
        setViewType={setViewType}
        processedEvents={processedEvents}
        setProcessedEvents={setProcessedEvents}
        onEventAdd={handleAddEvent}
        onEventUpdate={handleUpdateEvent}
        onEventDelete={handleDeleteEvent}
        teamMembers={members}
        cookieString={cookieString}
        organizationId={organizationId}
        teamId={teamId}
        userId={user.id}
      >
        <Calendar />
      </CalendarProvider>
    </>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import * as z from 'zod';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';

  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/select';

  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/table';
