import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { X, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  getRoleKeyNameFromGeneralName,
  ROLES
} from '@/lib/logto-roles-and-permissions';
import type { OrganizationSourceSystem } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { Visibility } from '@signvault/db/types';
import type { User as LogtoUser } from '@signvault/logto/types';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getSourceSystemConfig
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { MultiSelect } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/multi-select';

const memberSchema = z.object({
  email: z.string().email('Invalid email address'),
  role: z.string().min(1, 'Role is required'),
  sourceSystems: z
    .array(z.string())
    .min(1, 'At least one source system is required')
});

type FormData = z.infer<typeof memberSchema>;

type Member = {
  email: string;
  role: string;
  sourceSystems: string[];
}

type MemberInviteProps = {
  organizationId: string;
  organizationName: string;
  user: LogtoUser;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
  sourceSystems: OrganizationSourceSystem[];
}

const AVAILABLE_ROLES = {
  REGULAR_USER: 'Regular User',
  VERIFIED_USER: 'Verified User',
  AUTHOR: 'Author',
  EDITOR: 'Editor',
  ADMINISTRATOR: 'Administrator'
};

export default function MemberInvite({
  organizationId,
  organizationName,
  user,
  cookieStore,
  sourceSystems
}: Readonly<MemberInviteProps>) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [members, setMembers] = useState<Member[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const form = useForm<FormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(memberSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      email: '',
      role: '',
      sourceSystems: []
    }
  });

  if (!sourceSystems || sourceSystems.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className='space-y-6'>
        <div className='space-y-4 py-8 text-center'>
          <h2 className='text-xl font-semibold'>No Source Systems Available</h2>
          <p className='mx-auto max-w-md text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
            Before inviting team members, you need to create at least one source
            system. Source systems define what resources and capabilities your
            team members can access.
          </p>
          <Button
            onClick={() =>
              router.push(
                `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/source-systems/create`
              )
            }
            className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
          >
            <Plus className='h-4 w-4' />
            Create Source System
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const handleAddMember = (data: FormData) => {
    if (data.email === user.primaryEmail) {
      form.setError('email', {
        message: 'You cannot invite yourself'
      });
      return;
    }

    const existingMember = members.find(
      (member) => member.email.toLowerCase() === data.email.toLowerCase()
    );
    if (existingMember) {
      form.setError('email', {
        message: 'This email is already added to the invitation list'
      });
      return;
    }

    setMembers([...members, data as Member]);
    form.reset();
  };

  const removeMember = (index: number) => {
    const updatedMembers = [...members];
    updatedMembers.splice(index, 1);
    setMembers(updatedMembers);
  };

  const handleInvite = async () => {
    if (members.length === 0) {
      toast.error('Please add at least one member');
      return;
    }

    setIsLoading(true);
    const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
      cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
        ? cookieStore
        : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
            name: cookie.name,
            value: cookie.value
          }))
    );

    try {
      const expiresAt = new Date();
      const invitationExpiryDays = 3;
      expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + invitationExpiryDays);
      for (const member of members) {
        const invitationLink = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/join-organization/${organizationId}`;
        const organizationRoleId =
          ROLES[
            getRoleKeyNameFromGeneralName(
              member.role as keyof typeof AVAILABLE_ROLES
            )
          ].id;
        // Create invitation
        const invitationRequest = await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-invitations?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            body: JSON.stringify({
              invitee: member.email,
              organizationRoleIds: [organizationRoleId],
              inviterId: user.id,
              organizationId,
              expiresAt: expiresAt.getTime(),
              messagePayload: {
                code: '',
                link: invitationLink,
                key: '',
                organizationName,
                inviterName: user.name,
                expiryDate: expiresAt.toLocaleDateString()
              },
              sourceSystems: member.sourceSystems
            }),
            cache: 'no-store',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
                ? cookieStore.toString()
                : cookieString,
              'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
                ? cookieStore.toString()
                : cookieString
            }
          }
        );

        const invitationResponse = await invitationRequest.json();

        if (
          invitationResponse.message !==
          'Organization invitation created successfully'
        ) {
          toast.error(invitationResponse.message);
          return;
        }

        // Create pending user
        const pendingUserRequest = await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/pending-users?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            cache: 'no-store',
            body: JSON.stringify({
              email: member.email,
              organizationId: organizationId,
              organizationRoleIds: [organizationRoleId]
            }),
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
                ? cookieStore.toString()
                : cookieString,
              'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
                ? cookieStore.toString()
                : cookieString
            }
          }
        );

        const pendingUserResponse = await pendingUserRequest.json();

        if (
          pendingUserResponse.message !== 'Pending user created successfully'
        ) {
          toast.error(pendingUserResponse.message);
          return;
        }
      }

      toast.success('All invitations sent successfully');
      setMembers([]);
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        if (
          error.message.toLowerCase().includes('unprocessable entity') ||
          error.message.includes('422') ||
          error.message.includes('duplicate key value')
        ) {
          toast.error(error.message);
        } else if (error.message.includes('entity does not exist')) {
          toast.error('One or more users do not exist.');
        } else {
          toast.error(error.message);
        }
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to send invitations');
      }
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSourceSystemsChange = (
    index: number,
    newSourceSystems: string[]
  ) => {
    const currentMember = members[index];

    // If trying to deselect when only one system is selected, prevent the change
    if (
      currentMember.sourceSystems.length === 1 &&
      newSourceSystems.length === 0
    ) {
      toast.error('At least one source system is required');
      return;
    }

    const updatedMembers = [...members];
    updatedMembers[index] = {
      ...updatedMembers[index],
      sourceSystems: newSourceSystems
    };
    setMembers(updatedMembers);
  };

  const handleRoleChange = (index: number, newRole: string) => {
    const updatedMembers = [...members];
    updatedMembers[index] = {
      ...updatedMembers[index],
      role: newRole
    };
    setMembers(updatedMembers);
  };

  return (
    <div className='space-y-6'>
      <div className='space-y-4'>
        <h2 className='text-xl font-semibold'>Invite Team Members</h2>
        <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
          Invited members will need to verify their identity and complete
          security onboarding before accessing organization resources.
        </p>

        <Form {...form}>
          <form
            onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(handleAddMember)}
            className='space-y-4'
          >
            <div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'>
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='email'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Email Address</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input
                        type='email'
                        placeholder='Email address'
                        {...field}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          field.onChange(e);
                          // Clear error when user starts typing
                          if (form.formState.errors.email) {
                            form.clearErrors('email');
                          }
                        }}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='role'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Role</FormLabel>
                    <Select onValueChange={field.onChange} value={field.value}>
                      <FormControl>
                        <SelectTrigger>
                          <SelectValue placeholder='Select a role' />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                      </FormControl>
                      <SelectContent>
                        {Object.entries(AVAILABLE_ROLES).map(([key, value]) => (
                          <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>
                            {value}
                          </SelectItem>
                        ))}
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            </div>

            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='sourceSystems'
              render={() => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Source Systems Access</FormLabel>
                  <div className='flex flex-row flex-wrap gap-4'>
                    {sourceSystems &&
                      sourceSystems.length > 0 &&
                      sourceSystems.map((system) => {
                        const config = getSourceSystemConfig(
                          system.configuration
                        );
                        return (
                          <div
                            key={system.id}
                            className='flex flex-row flex-wrap items-center gap-2'
                          >
                            <FormControl>
                              <Checkbox
                                checked={form
                                  .watch('sourceSystems')
                                  .includes(system.id)}
                                onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                                  const current =
                                    form.getValues('sourceSystems');
                                  const updated = checked
                                    ? [...current, system.id]
                                    : current.filter((id) => id !== system.id);
                                  form.setValue('sourceSystems', updated);
                                }}
                                disabled={
                                  system.visibility !== Visibility.PUBLIC
                                }
                              />
                            </FormControl>
                            <label className='text-sm font-medium leading-none peer-disabled:cursor-not-allowed peer-disabled:opacity-70'>
                              {config.source_system_name}
                            </label>
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                  </div>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />

            <Button
              type='submit'
              className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
              disabled={isLoading || !form.formState.isValid}
            >
              <Plus className='h-4 w-4' />
              Add member
            </Button>
          </form>
        </Form>
      </div>

      {members.length > 0 && (
        <div className='space-y-4'>
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>Email</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Role</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Source Systems</TableHead>
                <TableHead className='w-[50px]'></TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {members.map((member, index) => (
                <TableRow key={member.email}>
                  <TableCell>{member.email}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Select
                      value={member.role}
                      onValueChange={(value) => handleRoleChange(index, value)}
                    >
                      <SelectTrigger className='xs:w-[100px] sm:w-[150px] md:w-[200px]'>
                        <SelectValue>
                          {
                            AVAILABLE_ROLES[
                              member.role as keyof typeof AVAILABLE_ROLES
                            ]
                          }
                        </SelectValue>
                      </SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectContent>
                        {Object.entries(AVAILABLE_ROLES).map(([key, value]) => (
                          <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>
                            {value}
                          </SelectItem>
                        ))}
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <MultiSelect
                      options={sourceSystems.map((system) => ({
                        label: getSourceSystemConfig(system.configuration)
                          .source_system_name,
                        value: system.id
                      }))}
                      defaultValue={member.sourceSystems}
                      onValueChange={(values) =>
                        handleSourceSystemsChange(index, values)
                      }
                      placeholder='Select source systems'
                      maxCount={2}
                      className='xs:w-[150px] sm:w-[200px] md:w-[300px]'
                      modalPopover={true}
                    />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Button
                      variant='ghost'
                      size='sm'
                      onClick={() => removeMember(index)}
                    >
                      <X className='h-4 w-4' />
                    </Button>
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>

          <Button
            onClick={handleInvite}
            disabled={isLoading || members.length === 0}
            className='w-full'
          >
            {isLoading
              ? 'Sending Invitations...'
              : `Send ${members.length} Invitation${members.length > 1 && 's'}`}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import type {
  CustomDocumentTemplateCS,
  DocumentTemplate
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import * as z from 'zod';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogClose
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/select';
import { Checkbox } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/checkbox';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { submitDocumentFromTemplate } from '@/actions/documents';
import type { DocumentTemplateField } from '@signvault/db/schemas/template/types';
import { MultiSelect } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/multi-select';
import { uploadFileToS3 } from '@/actions/template-files';
import FileAttachmentField from './file-attachment-field';
import SignatureField from './signature-file-field';
import { useUserData } from '@/contexts/user-data-context';
import { createAuditLogEntry } from '@/actions/audit-logs';
import {
  AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';

type UseTemplateDialogProps = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  template: DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS | null;
  currentUserDbId: string | null;
  currentOrganizationId: string | null;
  currentUserName: string | null;
  currentOrganizationName: string | null;
  onOpenChange: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  onSuccess: (documentId: bigint) => void;
};

export function UseTemplateDialog({
  isOpen,
  onOpenChange,
  template,
  onSuccess,
  currentUserDbId,
  currentOrganizationId,
  currentUserName,
  currentOrganizationName
}: UseTemplateDialogProps) {
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const { organizationData, organizationLoading } = useUserData();

  const createFormSchema = (fields: DocumentTemplateField[] = []) => {
    const schemaObject: Record<string, z.ZodTypeAny> = {};

    fields.forEach((field) => {
      let fieldSchema;

      switch (field.type) {
        case 'string':
          fieldSchema = z.string();
          if (field.required) {
            fieldSchema = fieldSchema.min(1, `${field.label} is required`);
          }
          break;
        case 'number':
          fieldSchema = z.coerce.number();
          if (field.required) {
            fieldSchema = fieldSchema.min(
              0,
              `${field.label} must be a positive number`
            );
          }
          break;
        case 'date':
          fieldSchema = z.string();
          if (field.required) {
            fieldSchema = fieldSchema.min(1, `${field.label} is required`);
          }
          break;
        case 'boolean':
          fieldSchema = z.boolean().default(false);
          break;
        case 'select':
          fieldSchema = z.string();
          if (field.required) {
            fieldSchema = fieldSchema.min(1, `${field.label} is required`);
          }
          break;
        case 'multi-select':
          fieldSchema = z.array(z.string()).optional();
          if (field.required) {
            fieldSchema = z
              .array(z.string())
              .min(1, `${field.label} is required`);
          }
          break;
        case 'image':
        case 'file':
          fieldSchema = z.instanceof(File).optional();
          if (field.required) {
            fieldSchema = z.instanceof(File, {
              message: `${field.label} is required`
            });
          }
          break;
        case 'signature':
          fieldSchema = z
            .object({
              type: z.enum(['typed', 'drawn', 'uploaded']),
              value: z.any()
            })
            .optional();
          if (field.required) {
            fieldSchema = z.object({
              type: z.enum(['typed', 'drawn', 'uploaded']),
              value: z.any().refine((val) => {
                if (val instanceof File) return true;
                if (typeof val === 'string' && val.length > 0) return true;
                return false;
              }, 'Signature is required')
            });
          }
          break;
        default:
          fieldSchema = z.any();
      }
      if (!field.required) {
        fieldSchema = fieldSchema.optional();
      }
      schemaObject[field.name] = fieldSchema;
    });

    return z.object(schemaObject);
  };

  const formSchema = createFormSchema(
    template?.fields as DocumentTemplateField[]
  );
  type FormValues = z.infer<typeof formSchema>;

  const form = useForm<FormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(formSchema),
    defaultValues:
      (template?.fields as DocumentTemplateField[])?.reduce((acc, field) => {
        acc[field.name as keyof FormValues] =
          field.type === 'boolean' ? false : '';
        if (field.type === 'multi-select') {
          acc[field.name as keyof FormValues] = [];
        }
        return acc;
      }, {}) || {}
  });

  const onSubmit = async (values: FormValues) => {
    if (!template || !currentUserDbId || !currentOrganizationId) {
      toast.error('Missing required data to use template');
      return;
    }
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    const processedValues = { ...values };

    for (const field of template.fields as DocumentTemplateField[]) {
      if (
        (field.type === 'image' || field.type === 'file') &&
        processedValues[field.name] instanceof File
      ) {
        try {
          const file = processedValues[field.name] as File;
          const { url } = await uploadFileToS3(file, currentOrganizationId);
          processedValues[field.name] = url;
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(`Failed to upload ${field.type}:`, error);
          toast.error(`Failed to upload ${field.label}. Please try again.`);
          setIsSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
      } else if (field.type === 'signature' && processedValues[field.name]) {
        const signature = processedValues[field.name] as {
          type: 'typed' | 'drawn' | 'uploaded';
          value: File | string;
        };
        if (signature.type === 'typed' && currentUserDbId) {
          // Best-effort: prefer user's default image signature if available via injected props (not available here), so skip
        }
        if (signature.type === 'drawn' || signature.type === 'uploaded') {
          if (signature.value instanceof File) {
            try {
              const { url } = await uploadFileToS3(
                signature.value,
                currentOrganizationId
              );
              processedValues[field.name] = url;
            } catch (error) {
              console.error('Failed to upload signature:', error);
              toast.error('Failed to upload signature. Please try again.');
              setIsSubmitting(false);
              return;
            }
          }
        } else {
          processedValues[field.name] = signature.value;
        }
      }
    }

    try {
      const newDocument = await submitDocumentFromTemplate({
        templateId: template.id,
        organizationId: BigInt(currentOrganizationId),
        ownerId: BigInt(currentUserDbId),
        customFields: processedValues,
        templateData: {
          name: template.name,
          description: template.description,
          fields: template.fields as DocumentTemplateField[],
          organizationName: currentOrganizationName ?? 'Unknown Organization',
          submittedBy: currentUserName ?? 'Unknown User'
        }
      });

      toast.success(
        `Template "${template.name}" used successfully! A PDF has been generated and saved to your documents.`
      );
      await createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.TEMPLATE_USED,
        category: AuditLogCategory.TEMPLATE_MANAGEMENT,
        entityId: template.id,
        entityType: 'document_template',
        entityName: template.name,
        description: `User used template: "${template.name}" to create document "${newDocument.title}"`,
        metadata: { newDocumentId: newDocument.id }
      }).catch(console.error);
      onSuccess(newDocument.id);
      onOpenChange(false);
      form.reset();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to use template:', error);
      toast.error(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to use template'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const renderField = (field: DocumentTemplateField) => {
    switch (field.type) {
      case 'string':
        return (
          <FormField
            key={field.name}
            control={form.control}
            name={String(field.name as keyof FormValues)}
            render={({ field: formField }) => (
              <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
                <FormLabel>
                  {field.label}
                  {field.required && (
                    <span className='text-destructive'>*</span>
                  )}
                </FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Input
                    type='text'
                    placeholder={field.description || field.label}
                    {...formField}
                  />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
        );
      case 'number':
        return (
          <FormField
            key={field.name}
            control={form.control}
            name={String(field.name as keyof FormValues)}
            render={({ field: formField }) => (
              <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
                <FormLabel>
                  {field.label}
                  {field.required && (
                    <span className='text-destructive'>*</span>
                  )}
                </FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Input
                    type='number'
                    placeholder={field.description || field.label}
                    {...formField}
                  />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
        );
      case 'date':
        return (
          <FormField
            key={field.name}
            control={form.control}
            name={String(field.name as keyof FormValues)}
            render={({ field: formField }) => (
              <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
                <FormLabel>
                  {field.label}
                  {field.required && (
                    <span className='text-destructive'>*</span>
                  )}
                </FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Input
                    type='date'
                    {...formField}
                    value={formField.value as string | undefined}
                  />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
        );
      case 'select':
        return (
          <FormField
            key={field.name}
            control={form.control}
            name={String(field.name as keyof FormValues)}
            render={({ field: formField }) => (
              <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
                <FormLabel>
                  {field.label}
                  {field.required && (
                    <span className='text-destructive'>*</span>
                  )}
                </FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Select
                    onValueChange={formField.onChange}
                    defaultValue={formField.value}
                  >
                    <SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectValue
                        placeholder={
                          field.description ||
                          `Select ${field.label.toLowerCase()}`
                        }
                      />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
                      {field.options?.map((option) => (
                        <SelectItem key={option} value={option}>
                          {option}
                        </SelectItem>
                      ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
        );
      case 'multi-select':
        return (
          <FormField
            key={field.name}
            control={form.control}
            name={String(field.name as keyof FormValues)}
            render={({ field: formField }) => (
              <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
                <FormLabel>
                  {field.label}
                  {field.required && (
                    <span className='text-destructive'>*</span>
                  )}
                </FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <MultiSelect
                    modalPopover={true}
                    options={
                      field.options?.map((option) => ({
                        value: option,
                        label: option
                      })) ?? []
                    }
                    onValueChange={formField.onChange}
                    defaultValue={formField.value}
                    placeholder={
                      field.description || `Select ${field.label.toLowerCase()}`
                    }
                  />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
        );
      case 'boolean':
        return (
          <FormField
            key={field.name}
            control={form.control}
            name={String(field.name as keyof FormValues)}
            render={({ field: formField }) => (
              <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-start space-x-3 space-y-0'>
                <FormControl>
                  <Checkbox
                    checked={formField.value}

                  />
                </FormControl>

                  <FormLabel>
                    {field.label}
                    {field.required && (

                    )}
                  </FormLabel>

                <FormMessage />

      case 'image':
      case 'file':

          />
        );
      case 'signature':
        return <SignatureField key={field.name} field={field} form={form} />;
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  if (!template) return null;

  const fields = (template.fields as DocumentTemplateField[]) || [];

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>

const getValueIcon = (value: unknown) => {
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    return <Code className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />;
  }
  if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
    return value ? (
      <CheckCircle className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
    ) : (
      <XCircle className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
    );
  }
  if (Date.parse(value as string)) {
    return <Calendar className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />;
  }
  return <Key className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />;
};

const getDisplayValue = (value: unknown): string => {
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    return JSON.stringify(value);
  }
  if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
    return value ? 'Yes' : 'No';
  }
  if (Date.parse(value as string)) {
    return format(new Date(value as string), 'PP');
  }
  return String(value);
};

'use server';

import type {
  FormResponseCS,
  NestedRecord,
  DocumentTemplateField
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import { EntityIdGenerator } from '@signvault/core-id-ts';
import {
  formResponsesCS,
  organizationsCS,
  usersCS,
  customDocumentTemplatesCS,
  templatePublishLinksCS,
  documentsCS
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_';
import { documentTemplates } from '@signvault/db/schemas/template';
import { eq, and, desc, count } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getDbUser } from './auth';
import { ROLES } from '@signvault/logto/types';
import { AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS } from '@signvault/core-lib/index';

/**
 * Create a new form response record.
 */
export async function createFormResponse({
  templateId,
  organizationId,
  publishLinkId,
  documentId,
  submittedByUserId,
  submittedByName,
  submittedByEmail,
  submittedByPhone,
  ipAddress,
  userAgent,
  formData,
  metadata = {},
  status = 'SUBMITTED'
}: {
  templateId: bigint;
  organizationId: bigint;
  publishLinkId?: bigint;
  documentId?: bigint;
  submittedByUserId?: bigint;
  submittedByName?: string;
  submittedByEmail?: string;
  submittedByPhone?: string;
  ipAddress?: string;
  userAgent?: string;
  formData: Record<string, string | number | boolean | string[] | null>;
  metadata?: NestedRecord;
  status?: string;
}): Promise<FormResponseCS> {
  const idGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();
  const responseId = await idGenerator.generateDocumentId();

  // Determine if this is a global or custom template
  const globalTemplate = await db.query.documentTemplates.findFirst({
    where: eq(documentTemplates.id, templateId)
  });

  const customTemplate = !globalTemplate
    ? await db.query.customDocumentTemplatesCS.findFirst({
        where: eq(customDocumentTemplatesCS.id, templateId)
      })
    : null;

  if (!globalTemplate && !customTemplate) {
    throw new Error('Template not found');
  }

  const [createdResponse] = await db
    .insert(formResponsesCS)
    .values({
      id: responseId,
      organizationId,
      templateId,
      globalTemplateId: globalTemplate?.id || null,
      customTemplateId: customTemplate?.id || null,
      publishLinkId: publishLinkId || null,
      documentId: documentId || null,
      submittedByUserId: submittedByUserId || null,
      submittedByName: submittedByName || null,
      submittedByEmail: submittedByEmail || null,
      submittedByPhone: submittedByPhone || null,
      ipAddress: ipAddress || null,
      userAgent: userAgent || null,
      formData,
      metadata,
      status,
      submittedAt: new Date(),
      createdAt: new Date(),
      updatedAt: new Date()
    } as FormResponseCS)
    .returning();

  if (!createdResponse) {
    throw new Error('Failed to create form response');
  }

  return createdResponse as FormResponseCS;
}

/**
 * Get form responses for a specific template with pagination and filtering.
 */
export async function getFormResponsesForTemplate({
  templateId,
  organizationId,
  page = 1,
  limit = 20,
  status
}: {
  templateId: bigint;
  organizationId: bigint;
  page?: number;
  limit?: number;
  status?: string;
}): Promise<{
  responses: FormResponseCS[];
  total: number;
  totalPages: number;
  currentPage: number;
}> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  // Check if user has permission to view responses
  const canViewResponses = await canUserViewFormResponses(
    dbUser.id,
    organizationId
  );

  if (!canViewResponses) {
    throw new Error('Insufficient permissions to view form responses');
  }

  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

  // Build where conditions
  const whereConditions = [
    eq(formResponsesCS.templateId, templateId),
    eq(formResponsesCS.organizationId, organizationId)
  ];

  if (status) {
    whereConditions.push(eq(formResponsesCS.status, status));
  }

  // Get responses with pagination
  const responses = await db
    .select()
    .from(formResponsesCS)
    .where(and(...whereConditions))
    .orderBy(desc(formResponsesCS.submittedAt))
    .limit(limit)
    .offset(offset);

  // Get total count
  const [{ count: totalCount }] = await db
    .select({ count: count() })
    .from(formResponsesCS)
    .where(and(...whereConditions));

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalCount / limit);

  return {
    responses: responses as FormResponseCS[],
    total: totalCount,
    totalPages,
    currentPage: page
  };
}

/**
 * Get a single form response by ID.
 */
export async function getFormResponseById(
  responseId: bigint,
  organizationId: bigint
): Promise<FormResponseCS | null> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  // Check if user has permission to view responses
  const canViewResponses = await canUserViewFormResponses(
    dbUser.id,
    organizationId
  );

  if (!canViewResponses) {
    throw new Error('Insufficient permissions to view form responses');
  }

  const response = await db.query.formResponsesCS.findFirst({
    where: and(
      eq(formResponsesCS.id, responseId),
      eq(formResponsesCS.organizationId, organizationId)
    )
  });

  return response ? (response as FormResponseCS) : null;
}

/**
 * Update a form response status.
 */
export async function updateFormResponseStatus(
  responseId: bigint,
  organizationId: bigint,
  newStatus: string
): Promise<FormResponseCS> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  // Check if user has permission to manage responses
  const canManageResponses = await canUserManageFormResponses(
    dbUser.id,
    organizationId
  );

  if (!canManageResponses) {
    throw new Error('Insufficient permissions to manage form responses');
  }

  const [updatedResponse] = await db
    .update(formResponsesCS)
    .set({
      status: newStatus,
      updatedAt: new Date()
    } as Partial<FormResponseCS>)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(formResponsesCS.id, responseId),
        eq(formResponsesCS.organizationId, organizationId)
      )
    )
    .returning();

  if (!updatedResponse) {
    throw new Error('Form response not found or failed to update');
  }

  return updatedResponse as FormResponseCS;
}

/**
 * Delete a form response (soft delete by updating status).
 */
export async function deleteFormResponse(
  responseId: bigint,
  organizationId: bigint
): Promise<void> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  // Check if user has permission to manage responses
  const canManageResponses = await canUserManageFormResponses(
    dbUser.id,
    organizationId
  );

  if (!canManageResponses) {
    throw new Error('Insufficient permissions to delete form responses');
  }

  await db
    .update(formResponsesCS)
    .set({
      status: 'DELETED',
      updatedAt: new Date()
    } as Partial<FormResponseCS>)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(formResponsesCS.id, responseId),
        eq(formResponsesCS.organizationId, organizationId)
      )
    );
}

/**
 * Get form response statistics for a template.
 */
export async function getFormResponseStats(
  templateId: bigint,
  organizationId: bigint
): Promise<{
  totalResponses: number;
  submittedResponses: number;
  processingResponses: number;
  completedResponses: number;
  lastSubmittedAt?: Date;
}> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  // Check if user has permission to view responses
  const canViewResponses = await canUserViewFormResponses(
    dbUser.id,
    organizationId
  );

  if (!canViewResponses) {
    throw new Error(
      'Insufficient permissions to view form response statistics'
    );
  }

  const responses = await db
    .select({
      status: formResponsesCS.status,
      submittedAt: formResponsesCS.submittedAt
    })
    .from(formResponsesCS)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(formResponsesCS.templateId, templateId),
        eq(formResponsesCS.organizationId, organizationId)
      )
    );

  const stats = {
    totalResponses: responses.length,
    submittedResponses: responses.filter((r) => r.status === 'SUBMITTED')
      .length,
    processingResponses: responses.filter((r) => r.status === 'PROCESSING')
      .length,
    completedResponses: responses.filter((r) => r.status === 'COMPLETED')
      .length,
    lastSubmittedAt: responses.reduce(
      (latest, r) => {
        return !latest || r.submittedAt > latest ? r.submittedAt : latest;
      },
      undefined as Date | undefined
    )
  };

  return stats;
}

/**
 * Check if a user can view form responses for an organization.
 */
export async function canUserViewFormResponses(
  userId: bigint,
  organizationId: bigint
): Promise<boolean> {
  const dbUser = await db.query.usersCS.findFirst({
    where: eq(usersCS.id, userId)
  });

  if (!dbUser) {
    return false;
  }

  // Super admin
  if (
    AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS.includes(
      dbUser.id.toString() as (typeof AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS)[number]
    )
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // Organization admin (L5_USER role within the specified organization)
  if (
    dbUser.organizationRoleId &&
    dbUser.organizationRoleId.toString() === ROLES.L5_USER.id.toString() &&
    dbUser.organizationId &&
    dbUser.organizationId.toString() === organizationId.toString()
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // Organization creator
  const organization = await db.query.organizationsCS.findFirst({
    where: eq(organizationsCS.id, organizationId)
  });

  if (
    organization?.createdByUserId &&
    organization.createdByUserId.toString() === dbUser.id.toString()
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

/**
 * Check if a user can manage (update/delete) form responses for an organization.
 */
export async function canUserManageFormResponses(
  userId: bigint,
  organizationId: bigint
): Promise<boolean> {
  // For now, use the same permissions as viewing
  // This can be refined to be more restrictive if needed
  return canUserViewFormResponses(userId, organizationId);
}

/**
 * Get form responses with related template and user information.
 */
export async function getFormResponsesWithDetails({
  templateId,
  organizationId,
  page = 1,
  limit = 20,
  status
}: {
  templateId: bigint;
  organizationId: bigint;
  page?: number;
  limit?: number;
  status?: string;
}): Promise<{
  responses: Array<
    FormResponseCS & {
      submittedByUser?: {
        id: bigint;
        name: string;
        primaryEmail: string;
      };
      template?: {
        name: string;
        description?: string;
        fields?: DocumentTemplateField[];
      };
      publishLink?: {
        shortId: string;
      };
      document?: {
        id: bigint;
        title: string;
        filename: string;
        s3Key: string | null;
      };
    }
  >;
  total: number;
  totalPages: number;
  currentPage: number;
}> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  // Check if user has permission to view responses
  const canViewResponses = await canUserViewFormResponses(
    dbUser.id,
    organizationId
  );

  if (!canViewResponses) {
    throw new Error('Insufficient permissions to view form responses');
  }

  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

  // Build where conditions
  const whereConditions = [
    eq(formResponsesCS.templateId, templateId),
    eq(formResponsesCS.organizationId, organizationId)
  ];

  if (status) {
    whereConditions.push(eq(formResponsesCS.status, status));
  }

  // Get responses with related data using nested select for better type safety
  const responses = await db
    .select({
      // Main response data
      id: formResponsesCS.id,
      templateId: formResponsesCS.templateId,
      organizationId: formResponsesCS.organizationId,
      submittedByUserId: formResponsesCS.submittedByUserId,
      globalTemplateId: formResponsesCS.globalTemplateId,
      customTemplateId: formResponsesCS.customTemplateId,
      publishLinkId: formResponsesCS.publishLinkId,
      documentId: formResponsesCS.documentId,
      status: formResponsesCS.status,
      formData: formResponsesCS.formData,
      submittedAt: formResponsesCS.submittedAt,
      createdAt: formResponsesCS.createdAt,
      updatedAt: formResponsesCS.updatedAt,

      // Nested objects for related data
      submittedByUser: {
        id: usersCS.id,
        name: usersCS.name,
        primaryEmail: usersCS.primaryEmail
      },
      globalTemplate: {
        name: documentTemplates.name,
        description: documentTemplates.description,
        fields: documentTemplates.fields
      },
      customTemplate: {
        name: customDocumentTemplatesCS.name,
        description: customDocumentTemplatesCS.description,
        fields: customDocumentTemplatesCS.fields
      },
      publishLink: {
        shortId: templatePublishLinksCS.shortId
      },
      document: {
        id: documentsCS.id,
        title: documentsCS.title,
        filename: documentsCS.filename,
        s3Key: documentsCS.s3Key
      }
    })
    .from(formResponsesCS)
    .leftJoin(usersCS, eq(formResponsesCS.submittedByUserId, usersCS.id))
    .leftJoin(
      documentTemplates,
      eq(formResponsesCS.globalTemplateId, documentTemplates.id)
    )
    .leftJoin(
      customDocumentTemplatesCS,
      eq(formResponsesCS.customTemplateId, customDocumentTemplatesCS.id)
    )
    .leftJoin(
      templatePublishLinksCS,
      eq(formResponsesCS.publishLinkId, templatePublishLinksCS.id)
    )
    .leftJoin(documentsCS, eq(formResponsesCS.documentId, documentsCS.id))
    .where(and(...whereConditions))
    .orderBy(desc(formResponsesCS.submittedAt))
    .limit(limit)
    .offset(offset);

  // Get total count
  const [{ count: totalCount }] = await db
    .select({ count: count() })
    .from(formResponsesCS)
    .where(and(...whereConditions));

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalCount / limit);

  // Transform the results - leveraging Drizzle's nested select type safety
  const transformedResponses = responses.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    templateId: row.templateId,
    organizationId: row.organizationId,
    submittedByUserId: row.submittedByUserId,
    globalTemplateId: row.globalTemplateId,
    customTemplateId: row.customTemplateId,
    publishLinkId: row.publishLinkId,
    documentId: row.documentId,
    status: row.status,
    formData: row.formData,
    submittedAt: row.submittedAt,
    createdAt: row.createdAt,
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt,
    submittedByUser: row.submittedByUser.id ? row.submittedByUser : undefined,
    template:
      row.globalTemplate || row.customTemplate
        ? {
            name: row.globalTemplate?.name || row.customTemplate?.name,
            description:
              row.globalTemplate?.description ||
              row.customTemplate?.description,
            fields: row.globalTemplate?.fields || row.customTemplate?.fields
          }
        : undefined,
    publishLink: row.publishLink?.shortId ? row.publishLink : undefined,
    document: row.document?.id ? row.document : undefined
  }));

  return {
    responses: transformedResponses as Array<
      FormResponseCS & {
        submittedByUser?: {
          id: bigint;
          name: string;
          primaryEmail: string;
        };
        template?: {
          name: string;
          description?: string;
          fields?: DocumentTemplateField[];
        };
        publishLink?: {
          shortId: string;
        };
        document?: {
          id: bigint;
          title: string;
          filename: string;
          s3Key: string | null;
        };
      }
    >,
    total: totalCount,
    totalPages,
    currentPage: page
  };
}

const sourceSystemSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(1, 'Name is required'),
  type: z.enum(
    SourceSystemTypeEnums.map((type) => type.toString()) as [
      string,
      ...string[]
    ]
  ),
  description: z.string().optional(),
  visibility: z.enum(
    VisibilityEnums.map((visibility) => visibility.toString()) as [
      string,
      ...string[]
    ]
  )
});

export function CreateSourceSystemForm({
  organizationId,
  user,
  organization,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<{
  organizationId: string;
  user: DbUser | LogtoUser;
  organization: DbOrganization;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}>) {
  clientLogger.info('Rendering create source system form', {
    organizationId,
    user,
    organization
  });
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );
  const form = useForm<FormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(sourceSystemSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      name: '',
      type: '',
      description: '',
      visibility: 'PUBLIC'
    }
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const onSubmit = async (data: FormData) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const pairGeneratedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      const { shortId: id, uuid: uid } = ShortIdMapper.generatePair();
      const sourceSystemCreationBody = {
        id,
        uid,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        name: data.name,
        type: data.type,
        isActive: true,
        integrationType: 'ASYNC' as SourceSystemIntegrationType,
        complianceProgram: 'STANDARD' as SourceSystemComplianceProgram,
        description: data.description
      } as SourceSystem;
      const metadata = {
        table: `"public"."source_systems"`,
        purpose: 'source_system',
        source: 'frontend_app',
        context: {
          action: 'CREATE_SOURCE_SYSTEM',
          sourceSystemCreationBody
        },
        createdBy: {
          application: 'frontend_app',
          url: window.location.href
        },
        version: '1.0',
        sourceGeneratedAt: pairGeneratedAt
      } as IdMappingMetadata;
      const idMappingResponse = await createIdMapping(
        id,
        uid,
        metadata,
        cookieString
      );

      if (idMappingResponse.message !== 'ID mapping created successfully') {
        toast.error(idMappingResponse.message);
        return;
      }

      // 1. Create source system
      const sourceSystemResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/source-systems?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          },
          cache: 'no-store',
          body: JSON.stringify(sourceSystemCreationBody)
        }
      );
      const sourceSystem: CreateSourceSystemResponse =
        await sourceSystemResponse.json();

      if (sourceSystem.message !== 'Source system created successfully') {
        clientLogger.error('Ran into error while creating source system', {
          sourceSystem,
          organizationId,
          user,
          organization
        });
        return toast.error(sourceSystem.message);
      }

      const sourceSystemId = sourceSystem.sourceSystem.database.id;
      const sourceSystemEntityType = 'source_system';
      const sourceSystemProvenanceRootContextId = `${sourceSystemEntityType}_${organizationId}_${sourceSystemId}_provenance_root`;

      // 2. Create data provenance
      const provenanceData = {
        entityType: sourceSystemEntityType,
        entityId: organizationId,
        actionType: 'SOURCE_SYSTEM_CREATED',
        provenanceData: {
          root_context_id: sourceSystemProvenanceRootContextId,
          is_root: true,
          source_id: sourceSystemId,
          provenance: {
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
            user_id: user.id,
            source_system_name: data.name,
            source_system_type: data.type,
            source_system_description: data.description
          },
          events: [
            {
              type: 'creation',
              timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
              user_id: user.id,
              action: 'create'
            }
          ],
          version_history: [
            {
              version: '1.0',
              timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
              changes: 'Initial creation'
            }
          ]
        },
        sourceSystemId: sourceSystemId
      };

      const provenanceResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/data-provenances?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          },
          cache: 'no-store',
          body: JSON.stringify(provenanceData)
        }
      );
      const provenance: CreateDataProvenanceResponse =
        await provenanceResponse.json();

      if (provenance.message !== 'Data provenance created successfully') {
        clientLogger.error('Ran into error while creating data provenance', {
          provenance,
          organizationId,
          user,
          organization
        });
        return toast.error(provenance.message);
      }

      const organizationSourceSystemEntityType = 'organization_source_system';
      const organizationSourceSystemProvenanceRootContextId = `${organizationSourceSystemEntityType}_${organizationId}_${sourceSystemId}_provenance_root`;

      const orgProvenanceData = {
        entityType: organizationSourceSystemEntityType,
        entityId: organizationId,
        actionType: 'ORGANIZATION_SOURCE_SYSTEM_CREATED',
        provenanceData: {
          root_context_id: organizationSourceSystemProvenanceRootContextId,
          is_root: true,
          source_id: sourceSystemId,
          provenance: {
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
            user_id: user.id,
            source_system_name: data.name,
            source_system_type: data.type,
            source_system_description: data.description
          },
          version_history: [
            {
              version: '1.0',
              timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
              changes: 'Initial creation'
            }
          ],
          events: [
            {
              type: 'creation',
              timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
              user_id: user.id,
              action: 'create'
            }
          ]
        },
        sourceSystemId: sourceSystemId
      };

      const orgProvenanceResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/data-provenances?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')

          body: JSON.stringify(orgProvenanceData)

        clientLogger.error('Ran into error while creating data provenance', {
          orgProvenance,
          organizationId,
          user,
          organization

        return toast.error(orgProvenance.message);
      }

      const organizationSourceSystemDataProvenanceId =

          organization.sizeCategory === 'NOT_APPLICABLE'
            ? ('INDIVIDUAL' as EntityType)

        organizationId,
        sourceSystemId,
        creatorUserId: user.id,
        visibility: data.visibility as Visibility,
        dataProvenanceId: organizationSourceSystemDataProvenanceId,
        configuration: {
          source_system_id: sourceSystemId,
          organization_id: organizationId,
          visibility: data.visibility,
          data_provenance_id: organizationSourceSystemDataProvenanceId,
          source_system_name: data.name,
          source_system_type: data.type,
          source_system_description: data.description
        }
      };

        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-source-systems?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          },
          cache: 'no-store',
          body: JSON.stringify(orgSourceSystemData)
        }
      );
      const orgSourceSystem: CreateOrganizationSourceSystemResponse =
        await orgSourceSystemResponse.json();

      if (
        orgSourceSystem.message !==
        'Organization source system created successfully'
      ) {
        clientLogger.error(
          'Ran into error while creating organization source system',
          {
            orgSourceSystem,
            organizationId,
            user,
            organization
          }
        );
        return toast.error(orgSourceSystem.message);
      }

      form.reset();
      return toast.success('Source system created successfully');
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      clientLogger.error('Ran into error while creating source system', {
        error,
        organizationId,
        user,
        organization

      if (error instanceof Error) {
        toast.error(error.message);
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to create source system');
      }

      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className='space-y-8'>
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='name'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Name</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>

              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='type'
          render={({ field }) => (

              <FormLabel>Type</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Select onValueChange={field.onChange}>

                    <SelectValue placeholder='Select source system type' />

                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>

              </FormControl>

          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='description'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Textarea placeholder='Enter description' {...field} />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='visibility'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Visibility</FormLabel>
              <Select onValueChange={field.onChange}>
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder='Select visibility' />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>

        />
        <Button variant='default' size='sm' type='submit' disabled={loading}>
          {(() => {
            const nameText = form.getValues('name')
              ? `- ${form.getValues('name')}`
              : '';
            return loading
              ? `Creating source system ${nameText}`
              : `Create new source system ${nameText}`;
          })()}
        </Button>
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useMemo, useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogFooter
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/select';

import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import {
  AccessLevelEnumPSEnums,
  type AccessLevelEnumPS,
  type AccessLevelEnumPSType,
  type ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS,
  type DocumentCS,
  type UserCS
} from '@signvault/db/types';

import {
  addAccessControl,
  removeAccessControl
} from '@/actions/document-access-controls';
import {
  Plus,
  Eye,
  User,
  Users,
  AlertCircle,
  Trash2,
  Lock,
  Loader2
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Label, Separator } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui';
import { Badge } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/badge';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns';
import {
  MultipleSelector,
  type Option
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/multiple-selector';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import {
  ACCESS_LEVEL_ICONS,
  ACCESS_LEVEL_LABELS
} from '../../data-provenance/types';
import {
  getAccessLevelColor,
  type AccessControlItem,
  getAccessControlTargetType as getTargetType,
  getAccessControlTargetDisplayName as getTargetDisplayName,
  parseSelectedOption
} from './types';

const itemVariants = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 10 },
  visible: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
  exit: { opacity: 0, x: -10 }
};

export function AccessControlsSheet({
  isOpen,
  onOpenChange,
  document,
  initialAccessControls,
  teams,
  organizationMembers,
  isLoadingTeams
}: {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  document: DocumentCS;
  initialAccessControls: AccessControlItem[];
  teams: ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS[];
  isLoadingTeams: boolean;
  organizationMembers: UserCS[];
}) {
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<AccessControlItem[]>(initialAccessControls);
  const [selectedTargets, setSelectedTargets] = useState<Option[]>([]);
  const [accessLevel, setAccessLevel] =
    useState<AccessLevelEnumPSType>('PUBLIC');

  // Create options for users and teams with enhanced display
  const userOptions: Option[] = useMemo(() => {
    return (organizationMembers || []).map((member) => {
      const displayName =
        member.name ||
        member.primaryEmail ||
        member.username ||
        `User ${member.id}`;
      const secondaryInfo =
        member.primaryEmail && member.name ? ` (${member.primaryEmail})` : '';

      return {
        value: `user-${member.id}`,
        label: `👤 ${displayName}${secondaryInfo}`,
        type: 'Users',
        memberData: member.id.toString(),
        searchTerms: [
          displayName,
          member.primaryEmail || '',
          member.username || ''
        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(' ')
      };
    });
  }, [organizationMembers]);

  const teamOptions: Option[] = useMemo(() => {
    return teams.map((team) => {
      const memberCount = (team.members || []).length;
      const displayName = team.name || `Team ${team.id}`;

      return {
        value: `team-${team.id}`,
        label: `👥 ${displayName} (${memberCount} member${memberCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''})`,
        type: 'Teams',
        memberCount: memberCount.toString(),
        teamData: team.id.toString(),
        searchTerms: [displayName, `${memberCount} members`].join(' ')
      };
    });
  }, [teams]);

  const allOptions = [...userOptions, ...teamOptions];

  const handleAdd = () => {
    if (selectedTargets.length === 0) {
      toast.error('Please select users or teams to grant access');
      return;
    }

    startTransition(async () => {
      const promises = selectedTargets.map(async (target) => {
        const { type, id } = parseSelectedOption(target.value);

        return addAccessControl({
          documentId: document.id,
          userId: type === 'user' ? id : null,
          teamId: type === 'team' ? id : null,
          accessLevel: accessLevel as AccessLevelEnumPS,
          grantedBy: document.ownerId,
          isActive: true
        });
      });

      try {
        const results = await Promise.all(promises);
        const successCount = results.filter((r) => r.success).length;
        const failureCount = results.length - successCount;

        if (successCount > 0) {
          toast.success(
            `Access granted to ${successCount} ${successCount === 1 ? 'target' : 'targets'}`
          );

          // Add successful results to rows
          const newRows = results
            .filter((r) => r.success && r.data)
            .map((r) => r.data as unknown as AccessControlItem);

          setRows((prev) => [...newRows, ...prev]);
          setSelectedTargets([]);
        }

        if (failureCount > 0) {
          toast.error(
            `Failed to grant access to ${failureCount} ${failureCount === 1 ? 'target' : 'targets'}`
          );
        }
      } catch (_error) {
        toast.error('Failed to grant access');
      }
    });
  };

  const handleRemove = (id: bigint) => {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await removeAccessControl(id);
      if (res.success) {
        toast.success('Access revoked');
        setRows((prev) => prev.filter((r) => r.id !== id));
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to revoke access');
      }
    });
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent
        className='flex max-h-[90vh] max-w-2xl flex-col font-suisse-intl'
        aria-describedby={undefined}
      >
        <DialogHeader className='pb-4'>
          <DialogTitle className='flex items-center gap-2'>
            <Lock className='size-5 text-primary' />
            Manage Document Access
          </DialogTitle>
          <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
            Control who can view, edit, or manage this document
          </p>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className='flex-1 space-y-6 overflow-hidden'>
          {/* Add New Access */}
          <div className='space-y-4 rounded-lg border bg-muted/20 p-4'>
            <div className='mb-3 flex items-center gap-2'>
              <Plus className='size-4 text-primary' />
              <Label className='text-sm font-medium'>Grant Access</Label>
            </div>

            <div className='space-y-3'>
              <div>
                <Label className='mb-2 block text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                  Select Users & Teams
                </Label>
                <MultipleSelector
                  value={selectedTargets}
                  onChange={setSelectedTargets}
                  placeholder='Search for users or teams...'
                  options={allOptions}
                  groupBy='type'
                  className='w-full'
                  emptyIndicator={
                    <p className='text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                      No users or teams found
                    </p>
                  }
                  disabled={isPending || isLoadingTeams}
                />
                {selectedTargets.length > 0 && (
                  <p className='mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                    {selectedTargets.length} target
                    {selectedTargets.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} selected
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
                <div className='flex-1'>
                  <Label className='mb-2 block text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                    Access Level
                  </Label>
                  <Select
                    value={accessLevel}
                    onValueChange={(value) =>
                      setAccessLevel(value as AccessLevelEnumPSType)
                    }
                  >
                    <SelectTrigger className='w-full'>
                      <SelectValue />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
                      {AccessLevelEnumPSEnums.map((level) => {
                        const Icon = ACCESS_LEVEL_ICONS[level] ?? Eye;
                        return (
                          <SelectItem key={level} value={level}>
                            <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                              <Icon className='size-4' />
                              <span>{ACCESS_LEVEL_LABELS[level]}</span>
                            </div>
                          </SelectItem>
                        );
                      })}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>

                <Button
                  onClick={handleAdd}
                  disabled={
                    isPending || selectedTargets.length === 0 || isLoadingTeams
                  }
                  className='mt-6 flex items-center gap-2'
                >
                  {isPending ? 'Adding...' : 'Grant Access'}
                  {isPending ? (
                    <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin' />
                  ) : (
                    <Plus className='size-4' />
                  )}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <Separator />

          {/* Current Access Controls */}
          <div className='space-y-3'>
            <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
              <Label className='text-sm font-medium'>Current Access</Label>
              <Badge variant='secondary' className='text-xs'>
                {rows.length} {rows.length === 1 ? 'entry' : 'entries'}
              </Badge>
            </div>

            <div className='h-64 w-full overflow-y-auto pr-3'>
              {rows.length === 0 ? (
                <div className='flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-8 text-center'>
                  <AlertCircle className='mb-2 size-8 text-muted-foreground' />
                  <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                    No access controls configured
                  </p>
                  <p className='mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                    Only the document owner has access
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className='space-y-2'>
                  <AnimatePresence mode='popLayout'>
                    {rows.map((ac) => {
                      const displayType = getTargetType(ac);
                      const TypeIcon = displayType === 'user' ? User : Users;
                      const AccessIcon =
                        ACCESS_LEVEL_ICONS[
                          ac.accessLevel as AccessLevelEnumPS
                        ] ?? Eye;
                      return (

                          variants={itemVariants}

                          animate='visible'

                          layout

                            onClick={() => handleRemove(ac.id)}
                            disabled={isPending || isLoadingTeams}
                            className='zyflo-transition ml-2 border-none bg-destructive/10 hover:bg-destructive/20'
                          >
                            <Trash2 className='size-4' />
                          </Button>
                        </motion.div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </AnimatePresence>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter className='border-t pt-4'>
          <Button
            variant='secondary'
            onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
            disabled={isPending || isLoadingTeams}
          >
            Close
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

    if (!organizationMembers) return [];
    return organizationMembers;
  }, [organizationMembers]);

    data: users,
    columns,
    state: {
      columnFilters,
      rowSelection
    },
    onRowSelectionChange: setRowSelection,
    onColumnFiltersChange: setColumnFilters,

    getFacetedUniqueValues: getFacetedUniqueValues()

  const teamFilter = table.getColumn('activeTeamId');

        <Skeleton className='h-64 w-full' />

                  className='size-10 min-h-10 min-w-10'

                >
                  <RotateCcw className='size-4' />
                </Button>
              </TooltipTrigger>
              <TooltipContent>Reset filters and sorting</TooltipContent>
            </Tooltip>
          </div>
          <div className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'>
            <Tooltip>

                <Popover>
                  <PopoverTrigger asChild>

                        'inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2',
                        // if any of the filters are selected, make the border-primary and text-primary

                          0 && 'border-primary text-primary'
                      )}
                    >
                      <FilterIcon className='-ms-1 opacity-60' size={16} />
                      Team
                    </Button>
                  </PopoverTrigger>
                  <PopoverContent className='flex flex-col gap-2'>
                    {activeTeams?.map((team) => (
