=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/form-templates/template-response-sheet.tsx ===

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetClose,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetFooter,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/sheet';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { ScrollArea } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/scroll-area';
import { Badge } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/badge';
import {
  Download,
  Calendar,
  User,
  FileText,
  Phone,
  Globe,
  Shield,
  Clock2,
  Mail,
  FormInput,
  ExternalLink
} from 'lucide-react';
import { SpanHighlight } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/span-highlight';
import { format } from 'date-fns';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import type {
  DocumentTemplate,
  CustomDocumentTemplateCS,
  FormResponseCS,
  DocumentTemplateField
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { toTitleCase } from '@/lib/utils';
import { getSecureDocumentDownloadUrl } from '@/actions/documents';

type ResponseWithDetails = FormResponseCS & {
  submittedByUser?: {
    id: bigint;
    name: string;
    primaryEmail: string;
  };
  template?: {
    name: string;
    description?: string;
    fields?: DocumentTemplateField[];
  };
  publishLink?: {
    shortId: string;
  };
  document?: {
    id: bigint;
    title: string;
    filename: string;
    s3Key: string | null;
  };
};

type TemplateResponseSheetProps = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  response: ResponseWithDetails | null;
  template: DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS | null;
};

export function TemplateResponseSheet({
  isOpen,
  onOpenChange,
  response,
  template
}: TemplateResponseSheetProps) {
  const [templateFields, setTemplateFields] = useState<DocumentTemplateField[]>(
    []
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    // First try to get fields from the response template data
    if (response?.template?.fields) {
      setTemplateFields(response.template.fields);
    }
    // Fallback to the template prop if available
    else if (template && 'fields' in template && template.fields) {
      setTemplateFields(template.fields);
    }
  }, [template, response]);

  const getFieldLabel = (fieldSlug: string): string => {
    const field = templateFields.find((f) => f.name === fieldSlug);
    return field?.label || fieldSlug;
  };

  const isValidUrl = (string: string): boolean => {
    try {
      new URL(string);
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  };

  const handleExternalLinkClick = (url: string) => {
    try {
      window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to open URL:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to open link');
    }
  };

  const formatFormData = (
    formData: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined
  ) => {
    if (!formData || typeof formData !== 'object') return null;

    return Object.entries(formData).map(([key, value]) => {
      const valueString =
        value === null || value === undefined
          ? 'Not provided'
          : Array.isArray(value)
            ? value.join(', ')
            : String(value);

      const isUrl = valueString !== 'Not provided' && isValidUrl(valueString);

      return (
        <div key={key} className='space-y-1'>
          <h5 className='text-sm font-medium'>{getFieldLabel(key)}</h5>
          <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
            <SpanHighlight
              className={`gap-1.5 ${isUrl ? 'max-w-[200px]' : ''}`}
              display='inline-flex'
              icon={
                <FormInput className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
              }
              padding='tight'
              size='xs'
            >
              <span className={isUrl ? 'line-clamp-1 text-ellipsis' : ''}>
                {valueString}
              </span>
              {isUrl && (
                <Button
                  variant='light'
                  size='icon'
                  className='size-3 shrink-0 rounded-md'
                  onClick={() => handleExternalLinkClick(valueString)}
                >
                  <ExternalLink className='size-3' />
                </Button>
              )}
            </SpanHighlight>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    });
  };

  const handleDownload = async () => {
    if (!response?.document?.s3Key) {
      toast.error('No file available for download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      toast.loading('Preparing download...');
      const downloadUrl = await getSecureDocumentDownloadUrl(
        response.document.s3Key,
        'download'
      );
      window.open(downloadUrl, '_blank');
      toast.dismiss();
      toast.success('Document download initiated.');
    } catch (error) {
      toast.dismiss();
      console.error('Failed to download file:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to get download link.');
    }
  };

  if (!response) return null;

  return (
    <Sheet open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <SheetContent className='w-full max-w-3xl overflow-y-auto pb-16 font-suisse-intl'>
        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle hidden>Response Details</SheetTitle>
        </SheetHeader>
        <SheetDescription hidden>
          Form response submission details
        </SheetDescription>

        <div className='mb-6 flex items-start justify-between'>
          <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
            <div className='rounded-lg bg-primary/10 p-2.5'>
              <FileText
                className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 text-primary'
                strokeWidth={2}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className='font-britanica text-2xl'>Response Details</h3>
              <p className='-mt-0.5 font-britanica text-lg text-muted-foreground'>
                {response.template?.name || 'Unknown Template'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <ScrollArea className='h-[calc(100vh-200px)]'>
          <div className='space-y-6 overflow-y-auto'>
            {/* Response Status */}
            <div className='space-y-2'>
              <h3 className='text-lg'>Response Status</h3>
              <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 rounded-lg bg-secondary p-4 sm:grid-cols-2'>
                <div>
                  <h4 className='mb-1 text-base font-medium'>Status</h4>
                  <Badge
                    variant={
                      response.status === 'SUBMITTED'
                        ? 'default'
                        : response.status === 'COMPLETED'
                          ? 'secondary'
                          : 'outline'
                    }
                  >
                    {toTitleCase(response.status)}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h4 className='mb-1 text-base font-medium'>Submitted On</h4>
                  <SpanHighlight
                    className='gap-1.5'
                    display='inline-flex'
                    icon={
                      <Calendar className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
                    }
                    padding='tight'
                    size='xs'
                  >
                    {response.submittedAt
                      ? format(new Date(response.submittedAt), 'PPP p')
                      : 'Unknown'}
                  </SpanHighlight>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Submitter Information */}
            <div className='space-y-2'>
              <h3 className='text-lg'>Submitter Information</h3>
              <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 rounded-lg bg-secondary p-4 sm:grid-cols-2'>
                <div>
                  <h4 className='mb-1 text-base font-medium'>Name</h4>
                  <SpanHighlight
                    className='gap-1.5'
                    display='inline-flex'
                    icon={
                      <User className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
                    }
                    padding='tight'
                    size='xs'
                  >
                    {response.submittedByUser?.name ||
                      response.submittedByName ||
                      'Anonymous User'}
                  </SpanHighlight>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h4 className='mb-1 text-base font-medium'>Email</h4>
                  <SpanHighlight
                    className='gap-1.5'
                    display='inline-flex'
                    icon={
                      <Mail className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
                    }
                    padding='tight'
                    size='xs'
                  >
                    {response.submittedByUser?.primaryEmail ||
                      response.submittedByEmail ||
                      'Not provided'}
                  </SpanHighlight>
                </div>
                {response.submittedByPhone && (
                  <div>
                    <h4 className='mb-1 text-base font-medium'>Phone</h4>
                    <SpanHighlight
                      className='gap-1.5'
                      display='inline-flex'
                      icon={
                        <Phone className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
                      }
                      padding='tight'
                      size='xs'
                    >
                      {response.submittedByPhone}
                    </SpanHighlight>
                  </div>
                )}
                {response.ipAddress && (
                  <div>
                    <h4 className='mb-1 text-base font-medium'>IP Address</h4>
                    <SpanHighlight
                      className='gap-1.5'
                      display='inline-flex'
                      icon={
                        <Globe className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
                      }
                      padding='tight'
                      size='xs'
                    >
                      {response.ipAddress}
                    </SpanHighlight>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Generated Document */}
            {response.document && (
              <div className='space-y-2'>
                <h3 className='text-lg'>Generated Document</h3>
                <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 rounded-lg bg-secondary p-4 sm:grid-cols-2'>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className='mb-1 text-base font-medium'>Title</h4>
                    <SpanHighlight
                      className='gap-1.5'
                      display='inline-flex'
                      icon={
                        <FileText className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
                      }
                      padding='tight'
                      size='xs'
                    >
                      {response.document.title}
                    </SpanHighlight>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className='mb-1 text-base font-medium'>Filename</h4>
                    <SpanHighlight
                      className='gap-1.5'
                      display='inline-flex'
                      icon={
                        <FileText className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
                      }
                      padding='tight'
                      size='xs'
                    >
                      {response.document.filename}
                    </SpanHighlight>
                  </div>
                  <div className='col-span-2'>
                    <Button
                      onClick={handleDownload}
                      disabled={!response.document.s3Key}
                      className='w-full'
                    >
                      <Download className='mr-2 size-4' />
                      Download Document
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Form Data */}
            {response.formData && (
              <div className='space-y-2'>
                <h3 className='text-lg'>Form Data</h3>
                <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 rounded-lg bg-secondary p-4 sm:grid-cols-2'>
                  {formatFormData(response.formData)}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Publish Link */}

                      }
                      padding='tight'

                    >
                      {response.publishLink.shortId}
                    </SpanHighlight>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {response.metadata && Object.keys(response.metadata).length > 0 && (

              </div>

            <div className='space-y-2'>

'use client';

import { sendCustomTeamSetupNotification } from '@/actions/notifications';

  PermissionType,
  TeamInheritanceType
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer/enums';
import { Visibility } from '@signvault/db/schemas/public/enums';

  JobScopePS,
  JobScopePSEnums,

  type NestedRecord

const formSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(3, 'Name must be at least 3 characters long'),
  description: z
    .string()
    .min(10, 'Description must be at least 10 characters long'),
  type: z.nativeEnum(TeamInheritanceType),
  visibility: z.nativeEnum(Visibility),
  maxMembers: z
    .number()
    .min(2, 'At least 2 members are required')
    .max(100, 'Maximum 100 members allowed'),
  permissions: z
    .array(z.nativeEnum(PermissionType))
    .min(1, 'At least one permission is required')
    .max(8, 'Maximum 8 permissions allowed'),
  jobScopes: z
    .array(z.nativeEnum(JobScopePS))
    .min(1, 'At least one job scope is required')
    .max(3, 'Maximum 3 job scopes allowed'),
  templateType: z.enum(TeamTemplatesPSEnums).default('CUSTOM')
});

export type CreateCustomTeamFormValues = z.infer<typeof formSchema>;

type CreateCustomTeamFormProps = {
  adminIds?: (string | bigint)[];
  defaultValues?: CreateCustomTeamFormValues;
  formOnly?: boolean;
  isEditing?: boolean;
  onCancel: () => void;
  onSuccess?: (values?: CreateCustomTeamFormValues) => void;
  organizationId: string | bigint;
  teamId?: string | bigint;
  userId: string | bigint;
} & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLFormElement>;

export function CreateCustomTeamForm({
  onSuccess,
  onCancel,
  userId,
  organizationId,
  className,
  defaultValues,
  isEditing,
  teamId,
  formOnly = false,
  adminIds
}: Readonly<CreateCustomTeamFormProps>) {
  const form = useForm<CreateCustomTeamFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(formSchema),
    defaultValues: defaultValues || {
      name: '',
      description: '',
      type: TeamInheritanceType.CUSTOM_TEAM,
      visibility: Visibility.PRIVATE,
      maxMembers: 20,
      permissions: [PermissionType.DOCUMENT_VIEW]
    },
    mode: 'onBlur',
    reValidateMode: 'onBlur'
  });

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const createTeamMutation = useCreateCustomTeam();
  const updateTeamMutation = useUpdateCustomTeam();

  const onSubmit = async (values: CreateCustomTeamFormValues) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);

      if (formOnly) {
        // When used in a form-only mode, just pass the values back
        if (onSuccess) {
          onSuccess(values);
        }
        return;
      }

      if (isEditing && teamId) {
        await updateTeamMutation.mutateAsync({
          id: teamId,
          data: {
            name: values.name,
            description: values.description,
            type: values.type,
            visibility: values.visibility,
            maxMembers: values.maxMembers,
            updatedAt: new Date(),
            organizationId:
              typeof organizationId !== 'string'
                ? organizationId
                : BigInt(organizationId),
            permissions: values.permissions,
            jobScopes: values.jobScopes
          },
          actorUserId: userId.toString()
        });

        // Send notification for team configuration update
        await sendCustomTeamSetupNotification({
          organizationId,
          teamId,
          teamName: values.name,
          adminIds,
          creatorId: userId
        });

        toast.success(`Team ${values.name} updated successfully`);
      } else {
        const result = await createTeamMutation.mutateAsync({
          data: {
            name: values.name,
            maxMembers: values.maxMembers,
            organizationId:
              typeof organizationId !== 'string'
                ? organizationId
                : BigInt(organizationId),
            permissions: values.permissions,
            jobScopes: values.jobScopes,
            archivedAt: null,
            description: values.description,
            status: 'ACTIVE',
            icon: null,
            type: TeamInheritanceType.CUSTOM_TEAM,
            visibility: values.visibility,
            templateType: values.templateType
          },
          creatorId: userId.toString()
        });

        // Send notification for new team creation
        await sendCustomTeamSetupNotification({
          organizationId,
          teamId: result.id,
          teamName: values.name,
          adminIds,
          creatorId: typeof userId !== 'string' ? userId : BigInt(userId)
        });

        await createAuditLogEntry({
          action: AuditLogAction.TEAM_CREATED,
          category: AuditLogCategory.TEAM_MANAGEMENT,
          entityId: result.id,
          entityType: 'team',
          entityName: values.name,
          description: `User created a new team: "${values.name}"`,
          afterState: { team: result } as NestedRecord
        }).catch(console.error);

        toast.success(`Team ${values.name} created successfully`);
      }
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['customTeams'] });
      if (onSuccess) {
        onSuccess();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to create team', error);
      toast.error(
        `Failed to ${isEditing ? 'update' : 'create'} team: ${
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
        }`
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form
        className={cn('space-y-4', className)}
        onBlur={() => form.trigger()}
        onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
      >
        {/* Basic Section */}
        <div className='dark:border-1 border-1 space-y-4 rounded-lg border-solid bg-card p-4 dark:border-solid dark:border-border dark:bg-card'>
          <h3 className='flex items-center gap-2 font-britanica text-xl font-medium'>
            <Users2 className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 text-primary' />
            Basic Information
          </h3>
          <div className='space-y-4'>
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='name'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Team Name</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Input
                      className='bg-background'
                      placeholder='Enter team name'
                      {...field}
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />

            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='description'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Textarea
                      className='resize-none bg-background'
                      placeholder='Enter team description'
                      {...field}
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Job Scopes Section */}
        <div className='dark:border-1 border-1 space-y-4 rounded-lg border-solid bg-card p-4 dark:border-solid dark:border-border dark:bg-card'>
          <h3 className='flex items-center gap-2 font-britanica text-xl font-medium'>
            <Shield className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 text-primary' />
            Team Job Scope
          </h3>
          <div className='space-y-4'>
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='jobScopes'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Job Scopes</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <MultipleSelector
                      className='bg-background'
                      defaultOptions={JobScopePSEnums.map((p) => ({
                        value: p,
                        label: JOB_SCOPE_TITLES[p]
                      }))}
                      maxSelected={3}
                      onChange={(options) => {
                        field.onChange(options.map((opt) => opt.value));
                      }}
                      onMaxSelected={() => {
                        toast.error(
                          'You can only select a maximum of 3 job scopes'
                        );
                      }}
                      options={JobScopePSEnums.map((p) => ({
                        value: p,
                        label: JOB_SCOPE_TITLES[p]
                      }))}
                      placeholder='Select job scopes'
                      value={field.value?.map((scope) => ({
                        value: scope,
                        label: JOB_SCOPE_TITLES[scope]
                      }))}
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Configuration Section */}
        <div className='dark:border-1 border-1 space-y-4 rounded-lg border-solid bg-card p-4 dark:border-solid dark:border-border dark:bg-card'>
          <h3 className='flex items-center gap-2 font-britanica text-xl font-medium'>
            <Settings2 className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 text-primary' />
            Team Configuration
          </h3>
          <div className='grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2'>

                    <FormControl>

                        <SelectValue placeholder='Select visibility' />
                      </SelectTrigger>
                    </FormControl>
                    <SelectContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
                      {Object.values(Visibility).map((visibility) => (

                          {toTitleCase(visibility)}
                        </SelectItem>
                      ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                  <FormMessage />

                    <Input

import type { TeamTemplate } from '@signvault/db/types';

export const TeamTableControls: React.FC<TeamTableControlsProps> = ({

const RightElement = ({
  adminIds,
  tab,
  organizationData,
  teamTemplates
}: {
  adminIds: (string | bigint)[];
  organizationData: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getUserAndOrganizationDetails>>;
  tab: TeamsPageTab;
  teamTemplates: TeamTemplate[];
}): React.ReactNode => {
  if (tab === 'active') {
    return (
      <AssignActiveTeamDialog
        adminIds={adminIds}
        organizationId={organizationData?.organization?.id}
        teamTemplates={teamTemplates}
        userId={organizationData?.user?.id}
      />
    );
  }

  if (tab === 'templates') {
    return (
      <AddTemplateDialog
        adminIds={adminIds}
        organizationId={organizationData?.organization?.id}
        teamTemplates={teamTemplates}
        triggerText='Add Template to Active Teams'
        userId={organizationData?.user?.id}
      />
    );
  }

  if (tab === 'custom') {
    return (
      <CreateCustomTeamDialog
        adminIds={adminIds}
        organizationId={organizationData?.organization?.id}
        userId={organizationData?.user?.id}
      />
    );
  }

  return null;
};

export type TeamsPageSortBy = 'name' | 'visibility' | 'createdAt';
export type TeamsPageTab = 'active' | 'templates' | 'custom';

export function TeamsPage({
  teamTemplates
}: Readonly<{
  teamTemplates: TeamTemplate[];
}>) {
  const {
    organizationData,
    organizationLoading,
    organizationMembersLoading,
    organizationMembers
  } = useUserData();
  const isAdmin =
    organizationData?.user?.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
    organizationData?.user?.isCreator;

  const [currentTab, setCurrentTab] = useState<TeamsPageTab>('active');

  // Separate states for default and custom team selection
  const [selectedDefaultTeam, setSelectedDefaultTeam] =
    useState<TeamTemplate | null>(null);
  const [selectedCustomTeamId, setSelectedCustomTeamId] = useState<
    string | bigint | null
  >(null);

  // Store sort state in component
  const [customTeamsSortBy] = useState<TeamsPageSortBy>('name');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  // Add state for active teams
  const [selectedActiveTeamId, setSelectedActiveTeamId] = useState<
    string | bigint | null
  >(null);

  const debouncedSearch = useMemo(
    () =>
      debounce((value: string) => {
        setSearch(value);
        // When filtering, close any open sheet(s)
        setSelectedDefaultTeam(null);
        setSelectedCustomTeamId(null);
      }, 300),
    []
  );

  const { data: customTeams, isLoading: customTeamsLoading } = useCustomTeams(
    organizationData?.organization?.id ?? ''
  );
  const { data: activeTeams, isLoading: activeTeamsLoading } = useActiveTeams(
    organizationData?.organization?.id ?? ''
  );

  // Add filteredActiveTeams
  const filteredActiveTeams = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeTeams) return [];

    let filtered = [...activeTeams];

    if (search) {
      const searchLower = search.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(
        (team) =>
          team.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          team.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)
      );
    }

    filtered
      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
      .filter((team) => team.archivedAt !== null);
    return filtered;
  }, [activeTeams, search]);

  const filteredTeamTemplates = useMemo(() => {
    if (!teamTemplates) return [];

    let filtered = [...teamTemplates];

    if (search) {
      const searchLower = search.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(
        (team) =>
          team.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          team.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)
      );
    }

    // Always sort default teams by name
    filtered.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

    return filtered;
  }, [teamTemplates, search]);

  const filteredCustomTeams = useMemo(() => {
    if (!customTeams) return [];

    let filtered = [...customTeams];

    if (search) {
      const searchLower = search.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(
        (team) =>
          team.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          team.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          team.type.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)
      );
    }

    filtered.sort((a, b) => {
      switch (customTeamsSortBy) {
        case 'createdAt':
          return (
            new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime()
          );
        case 'name':
          return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
        case 'visibility':
          return a.visibility.localeCompare(b.visibility);
        default:
          return 0;
      }
    });

    return filtered;
  }, [customTeams, search, customTeamsSortBy]);

  if (
    organizationLoading ||
    organizationMembersLoading ||
    customTeamsLoading ||
    activeTeamsLoading
  ) {
    return (
      <div className='flex size-full flex-col'>
        <PageHeader
          heading={isAdmin ? 'Team Management' : 'Teams'}
          subheading={`View ${
            isAdmin ? 'and manage' : ''
          } teams ${isAdmin ? 'and their members' : ''} in your organization.`}
        />
        <div className='flex size-full items-center justify-center'>
          <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const adminIds = organizationMembers
    .filter(
      (member) =>
        member.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
        member.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L6_USER.id
    )
    .map((member) => member.id);

  return (
    <div className='flex size-full flex-col pb-24'>
      <PageHeader
        heading={isAdmin ? 'Team Management' : 'Teams'}
        rightElement={
          isAdmin ? (
            <RightElement
              adminIds={adminIds}
              organizationData={organizationData}
              tab={currentTab}
              teamTemplates={teamTemplates}
            />
          ) : null
        }
        subheading={`View ${
          isAdmin ? 'and manage' : ''
        } teams ${isAdmin ? 'and their members' : ''} in your organization.`}
      />
      <Tabs
        defaultValue='active'
        onValueChange={(value) =>
          setCurrentTab(value as 'active' | 'templates' | 'custom')
        }
        value={currentTab}
      >
        <div className='mb-6 mt-2 flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between'>
          <TabsList className='grid size-full grid-cols-2 xs:inline-flex xs:h-auto xs:w-fit'>
            <TabsTrigger value='active'>Active Teams</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value='templates'>Templates</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value='custom'>Custom</TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>
          <TeamTableControls
            onSearch={debouncedSearch}
            showSort={currentTab === 'custom'}
          />
        </div>
        <TabsContent
          className='divide-y divide-line rounded-lg border border-line'
          value='active'
        >
          {organizationLoading ||
          organizationMembersLoading ||
          activeTeamsLoading ? (
            <div className='flex flex-col'>
              {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
                <TeamCardSkeleton key={i} />
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {filteredActiveTeams.map((team) => (
                <div
                  className={cn(
                    'cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-300 ease-in-out',
                    selectedActiveTeamId === team.id ? 'bg-secondary' : ''
                  )}
                  key={team.id}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedActiveTeamId(team.id)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                      setSelectedActiveTeamId(team.id);
                    }
                  }}
                  role='button'
                  tabIndex={0}
                >
                  <ActiveTeamCard className='flex flex-col gap-3' team={team} />
                </div>
              ))}
              {!filteredActiveTeams.length && (
                <div className='flex h-24 items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground'>
                  No active teams found.
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent
          className='divide-y divide-line rounded-lg border border-line'
          value='templates'
        >
          {organizationLoading || organizationMembersLoading ? (
            <div className='flex flex-col'>
              {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
                <TeamCardSkeleton key={i} />
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {filteredTeamTemplates.map((team) => (
                <div
                  className={cn(
                    'cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-300 ease-in-out',
                    selectedDefaultTeam?.id === team.id ? 'bg-secondary' : ''
                  )}
                  key={team.id}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedDefaultTeam(team)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                      setSelectedDefaultTeam(team);
                    }
                  }}
                  role='button'
                  tabIndex={0}
                >
                  <TeamCard className='flex flex-col gap-3 p-6' team={team} />
                </div>
              ))}
              {!filteredTeamTemplates.length && (
                <div className='flex h-24 items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground'>
                  No templates found.
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent
          className='divide-y divide-line rounded-lg border border-line'
          value='custom'
        >
          {filteredCustomTeams.map((team) => (
            <div
              className={cn(
                'cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-300 ease-in-out',
                selectedCustomTeamId === team.id ? 'bg-secondary' : ''
              )}
              key={team.id}
              onClick={() => setSelectedCustomTeamId(team.id)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                  setSelectedCustomTeamId(team.id);
                }
              }}
              role='button'
              tabIndex={0}
            >
              <TeamCard className='flex flex-col gap-3 p-6' team={team} />
            </div>
          ))}
          {!filteredCustomTeams.length && (
            <div className='flex h-24 items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground'>
              No custom teams found.
            </div>
          )}
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>

      {selectedActiveTeamId && (
        <ActiveTeamSheet
          admin={isAdmin ? organizationData?.user : undefined}
          adminIds={adminIds}
          isAdmin={isAdmin}
          onClose={() => setSelectedActiveTeamId(null)}
          organizationId={organizationData?.organization?.id}
          teamId={selectedActiveTeamId}
        />
      )}

      {selectedDefaultTeam && (
        <TeamTemplateSheet
          adminIds={adminIds}
          isAdmin={isAdmin}
          onClose={() => setSelectedDefaultTeam(null)}
          organizationId={organizationData?.organization?.id}
          team={selectedDefaultTeam}
          teamTemplates={teamTemplates}
          userId={organizationData?.user?.id}
        />
      )}

      {selectedCustomTeamId && (
        <CustomTeamSheet
          adminIds={adminIds}
          onClose={() => setSelectedCustomTeamId(null)}
          teamId={selectedCustomTeamId}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/form-templates/signature-file-field.tsx ===

import { useRef, useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useDropzone } from 'react-dropzone';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import {
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormControl,
  FormMessage,
  FormDescription
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import {
  Tabs,
  TabsContent,
  TabsList,
  TabsTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/tabs';
import { SignatureCanvas } from 'react-signature-canvas';
import type { DocumentTemplateField } from '@signvault/db/types';
import type { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { PenTool, Type, Upload, Save, CheckCircle, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/tooltip';
import { useAuth } from '@/contexts/auth-context';
import {
  saveUserSignature,
  deleteUserSignature,
  setDefaultUserSignature
} from '@/actions/signing';
import type { UserSavedSignature } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { uploadFileToS3 } from '@signvault/frontend/actions/template-files';

export default function SignatureField({
  field,
  form
}: {
  field: DocumentTemplateField;
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  form: ReturnType<typeof useForm<any>>;
}) {
  const { dbUser } = useAuth();
  const [signatureType, setSignatureType] = useState<
    'typed' | 'drawn' | 'uploaded'
  >('typed');
  const sigCanvas = useRef<SignatureCanvas>(null);
  const savedSignatures = (dbUser?.savedSignatures ??
    []) as UserSavedSignature[];

  // Find the current default signature id for toggling UI
  const defaultSignatureId = savedSignatures.find((s) => s.isDefault)?.id;

  // For UI feedback on async actions
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const onDrop = (acceptedFiles: File[]) => {
    form.setValue(
      field.name,
      { type: 'uploaded', value: acceptedFiles[0] },
      { shouldValidate: true }
    );
  };

  const { getRootProps, getInputProps, isDragActive } = useDropzone({
    onDrop,
    // only allow jpg, png, jpeg
    accept: { 'image/jpeg': [], 'image/png': [], 'image/jpg': [] },
    maxSize: 1 * 1024 * 1024, // 1MB
    multiple: false,
    onError: (error) => {
      // console.error('File upload error:', error);
      toast.error(error.message || 'File upload failed. Please try again.');
    }
  });

  const signatureValue = form.watch(field.name);

  const handleDrawEnd = () => {
    if (sigCanvas.current) {
      const dataUrl = sigCanvas.current.toDataURL();
      fetch(dataUrl)
        .then((res) => res.blob())
        .then((blob) => {
          const file = new File([blob], 'signature.png', {
            type: 'image/png'
          });
          form.setValue(field.name, { type: 'drawn', value: file });
        });
    }
  };

  return (
    <FormField
      control={form.control}
      name={field.name}
      render={() => (
        <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
          <FormLabel>
            {field.label}
            {field.required && <span className='text-destructive'>*</span>}
          </FormLabel>
          {field.description && (
            <FormDescription className='whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
              {field.description}
            </FormDescription>
          )}
          <FormControl>
            <Tabs
              value={signatureType}
              onValueChange={(value) =>
                setSignatureType(value as 'typed' | 'drawn' | 'uploaded')
              }
            >
              <TabsList className='my-2 grid w-full grid-cols-3'>
                <TabsTrigger value='typed'>
                  <Type className='mr-2 hidden size-4 sm:inline' />
                  Type
                </TabsTrigger>
                <TabsTrigger value='drawn'>
                  <PenTool className='mr-2 hidden size-4 sm:inline' />
                  Draw
                </TabsTrigger>
                <TabsTrigger value='uploaded'>
                  <Upload className='mr-2 hidden size-4 sm:inline' />
                  Upload
                </TabsTrigger>
              </TabsList>
              <TabsContent value='typed'>
                <Input
                  type='text'
                  placeholder='Type your name'
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    form.setValue(field.name, {
                      type: 'typed',
                      value: e.target.value
                    })
                  }
                />
                <div className='mt-2'>
                  <TooltipProvider>
                    <Tooltip delayDuration={200}>
                      <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                        <Button
                          role='button'
                          type='button'
                          size='sm'
                          variant='secondary'
                          onClick={async () => {
                            const value = form.getValues()[field.name]
                              ?.value as string;
                            if (!value)
                              return toast.error('Type your name first');
                            await saveUserSignature({
                              type: 'typed',
                              isDefault: true,
                              text: { value }
                            });
                            toast.success('Saved as default signature');
                            setSignatureType('typed');
                          }}
                        >
                          <Save className='mr-1 size-4' /> Save as default
                        </Button>
                      </TooltipTrigger>
                      <TooltipContent className='border-none bg-foreground text-background'>
                        Saves this signature to your account and sets it as
                        default for future signing.
                      </TooltipContent>
                    </Tooltip>
                  </TooltipProvider>
                </div>
              </TabsContent>
              <TabsContent value='drawn'>
                <div className='space-y-2'>
                  <SignatureCanvas
                    ref={sigCanvas}
                    penColor='black'
                    canvasProps={{
                      className:
                        'border border-line rounded-md w-full h-40 bg-white/90'
                    }}
                    onEnd={handleDrawEnd}
                  />
                  <div className='flex justify-start gap-2'>
                    <Button
                      role='button'
                      type='button'
                      size='sm'
                      variant='outline'
                      onClick={() => sigCanvas.current?.clear()}
                    >
                      Clear
                    </Button>
                    <TooltipProvider>
                      <Tooltip delayDuration={200}>
                        <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                          <Button
                            role='button'
                            type='button'
                            size='sm'
                            onClick={async () => {
                              const v = form.getValues()[field.name];
                              if (!v?.value)
                                return toast.error('Draw your signature first');

                              let imageUrl: string | null = null;
                              const orgId = dbUser?.organizationId
                                ? String(dbUser.organizationId)
                                : 'default';

                              if (v.value instanceof File) {
                                try {
                                  const { url } = await uploadFileToS3(
                                    v.value as File,
                                    orgId
                                  );
                                  imageUrl = url;
                                } catch (err) {
                                  toast.error(
                                    'Failed to upload signature image'
                                  );
                                  return;
                                }
                              } else if (typeof v.value === 'string') {
                                imageUrl = v.value;
                              }

                              if (!imageUrl) {
                                toast.error(
                                  'Could not determine signature image URL'
                                );
                                return;
                              }

                              await saveUserSignature({
                                type: 'drawn',
                                isDefault: true,
                                image: { url: imageUrl }
                              });
                              toast.success('Saved as default signature');
                              setSignatureType('drawn');
                            }}
                          >
                            <Save className='mr-1 size-4' /> Save as default
                          </Button>
                        </TooltipTrigger>
                        <TooltipContent className='border-none bg-foreground text-background'>
                          Stores the drawn image as your default signature.
                        </TooltipContent>
                      </Tooltip>
                    </TooltipProvider>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </TabsContent>
              <TabsContent value='uploaded'>
                <div
                  {...getRootProps()}
                  className={`cursor-pointer rounded-md border-2 border-dashed p-4 text-center ${
                    isDragActive ? 'border-primary' : 'border-gray-300'
                  }`}
                >
                  <input {...getInputProps()} />
                  {signatureValue?.type === 'uploaded' &&
                  signatureValue.value instanceof File ? (
                    <div>
                      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                      <img
                        src={URL.createObjectURL(signatureValue.value)}
                        alt='Signature Preview'
                        className='mx-auto h-16 w-32 object-contain'
                      />
                      <p>{signatureValue.value.name}</p>
                      <Button
                        role='button'
                        type='button'
                        variant='link'
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          form.setValue(field.name, null, {
                            shouldValidate: true
                          });
                          setSignatureType('typed');
                        }}
                      >
                        Remove
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                      {isDragActive
                        ? 'Drop the image here ...'
                        : "Drag 'n' drop signature image, or click to select"}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </TabsContent>
            </Tabs>
          </FormControl>
          <FormMessage />
          {savedSignatures?.length ? (
            <div className='mt-3 rounded-md border p-2'>
              <p className='mb-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground'>
                Saved signatures
              </p>
              <p className='mb-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                Your default signature auto-fills during signing. Use the check
                icon to set default.
              </p>
              <div className='flex flex-wrap gap-2'>
                {savedSignatures.map((s) => (
                  <div
                    key={s.id}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md border p-2 ${
                      defaultSignatureId === s.id
                        ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5'
                        : 'border-gray-200'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {s.type === 'typed' ? (
                      <span className='text-sm'>{s.text?.value}</span>
                    ) : (
                      // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                      <img
                        src={s.image?.url ?? ''}
                        alt='sig'
                        className='h-8 w-auto'
                      />
                    )}
                    {/* Show check icon only if this is the default */}
                    {defaultSignatureId === s.id ? (
                      <CheckCircle
                        className='size-4 text-primary'
                        aria-label='Default signature'
                      />
                    ) : null}
                    {/* Only show the "set as default" button if not already default */}
                    {defaultSignatureId !== s.id && (
                      <Button
                        type='button'
                        size='icon'
                        variant='ghost'
                        role='button'
                        aria-label='Set as default'
                        disabled={isPending}
                        onClick={() => {
                          startTransition(async () => {
                            await setDefaultUserSignature(s.id);
                            toast.success('Set as default signature');
                            setSignatureType('typed');
                          });
                        }}
                      >
                        <CheckCircle className='size-4 text-muted-foreground' />
                      </Button>
                    )}
                    <Button
                      type='button'
                      size='icon'
                      variant='ghost'
                      role='button'
                      aria-label='Delete signature'
                      disabled={isPending}
                      onClick={() => {
                        startTransition(async () => {
                          await deleteUserSignature(s.id);
                          toast.success('Signature deleted');
                          setSignatureType('typed');
                        });
                      }}
                    >
                      <Trash2 className='size-4 text-destructive' />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </FormItem>
      )}
    />
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/table';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import { Badge } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { ScrollArea } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/scroll-area';
import {
  Loader2,
  Download,
  Eye,
  Calendar,
  MoreVertical,
  FileText,
  Mail,
  FileText as FileTextIcon,
  FileJson
} from 'lucide-react';
import { getFormResponsesWithDetails } from '@/actions/form-responses';
import { TemplateResponseSheet } from './template-response-sheet';
import type {
  DocumentTemplate,
  CustomDocumentTemplateCS,
  FormResponseCS,
  DocumentTemplateField
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { format } from 'date-fns';
import { toTitleCase } from '@/lib/utils';
import { getSecureDocumentDownloadUrl } from '@/actions/documents';

type TemplateResponsesDialogProps = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  template: DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS | null;
  organizationId: string | null;
};

type ResponseWithDetails = FormResponseCS & {
  submittedByUser?: {
    id: bigint;
    name: string;
    primaryEmail: string;
  };
  template?: {
    name: string;
    description?: string;
    fields?: DocumentTemplateField[];
  };
  publishLink?: {
    shortId: string;
  };
  document?: {
    id: bigint;
    title: string;
    filename: string;
    s3Key: string | null;
  };
};

export function TemplateResponsesDialog({
  isOpen,
  onOpenChange,
  template,
  organizationId
}: TemplateResponsesDialogProps) {
  const [selectedResponse, setSelectedResponse] =
    useState<ResponseWithDetails | null>(null);
  const [isSheetOpen, setIsSheetOpen] = useState(false);

  const {
    data: responsesData,
    isLoading,
    error
  } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['formResponses', template?.id, organizationId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!template || !organizationId) {
        return { responses: [], total: 0, totalPages: 0, currentPage: 1 };
      }

      return getFormResponsesWithDetails({
        templateId: template.id,
        organizationId: BigInt(organizationId),
        page: 1,
        limit: 100 // Load all responses for now
      });
    },
    enabled: isOpen && !!template && !!organizationId
  });

  const responses = responsesData?.responses || [];

  const handleViewResponse = (response: ResponseWithDetails) => {
    setSelectedResponse(response);
    setIsSheetOpen(true);
  };

  const handleDownload = async (response: ResponseWithDetails) => {
    if (!response.document?.s3Key) {
      toast.error('No file available for download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      toast.loading('Preparing download...');
      const downloadUrl = await getSecureDocumentDownloadUrl(
        response.document.s3Key,
        'download'
      );
      window.open(downloadUrl, '_blank');
      toast.dismiss();
      toast.success('Document download initiated.');
    } catch (error) {
      toast.dismiss();
      console.error('Failed to download file:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to get download link.');
    }
  };

  const handleCloseSheet = () => {
    setIsSheetOpen(false);
    setSelectedResponse(null);
  };

  const exportToCSV = () => {
    if (!responses.length) {
      toast.error('No data to export');
      return;
    }

    try {
      // Create CSV headers
      const headers = [
        'ID',
        'Submitted By',
        'Email',
        'Date',
        'Status',
        'Response Data'
      ];

      // Create CSV rows
      const csvRows = responses.map((response) => [
        response.id.toString(),
        response.submittedByUser?.name ||
          response.submittedByName ||
          'Anonymous',
        response.submittedByUser?.primaryEmail ||
          response.submittedByEmail ||
          '',
        response.submittedAt
          ? new Date(response.submittedAt).toISOString()
          : '',
        response.status,
        JSON.stringify(response.metadata || {})
      ]);

      // Combine headers and rows
      const csvContent = [headers, ...csvRows]
        .map((row) =>
          row
            .map((field) => `"${String(field).replace(/"/gu, '""')}"`)
            .join(',')
        )
        .join('\n');

      // Create and download file
      const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      if (link.download !== undefined) {
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        link.setAttribute('href', url);
        link.setAttribute(
          'download',
          `${template?.name || 'template'}_responses_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`
        );
        link.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        document.body.appendChild(link);
        link.click();
        document.body.removeChild(link);
      }
      toast.success('CSV export completed');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('CSV export failed:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to export CSV');
    }
  };

  const exportToJSON = () => {
    if (!responses.length) {
      toast.error('No data to export');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const exportData = {
        template: {
          id: template?.id.toString(),
          name: template?.name,
          description: template?.description,
          fields: template?.fields
        },
        responses: responses.map((response) => ({
          id: response.id.toString(),
          submittedBy: {
            name: response.submittedByUser?.name || response.submittedByName,
            email:
              response.submittedByUser?.primaryEmail ||
              response.submittedByEmail
          },
          submittedAt: response.submittedAt,
          status: response.status,
          responseData: response.metadata,
          document: response.document
            ? {
                id: response.document.id.toString(),
                title: response.document.title,
                filename: response.document.filename
              }
            : null
        })),
        exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        totalResponses: responses.length
      };

      const jsonContent = JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2);

      // Create and download file
      const blob = new Blob([jsonContent], {
        type: 'application/json;charset=utf-8;'
      });
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      if (link.download !== undefined) {
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        link.setAttribute('href', url);
        link.setAttribute(
          'download',
          `${template?.name || 'template'}_responses_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`
        );
        link.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        document.body.appendChild(link);
        link.click();
        document.body.removeChild(link);
      }
      toast.success('JSON export completed');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('JSON export failed:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to export JSON');
    }
  };

  if (!template) return null;

  return (
    <>
      <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
        <DialogContent className='max-h-[90vh] max-w-4xl font-suisse-intl'>
          <DialogHeader>
            <div className='flex flex-row flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2 md:flex-col md:items-start'>
              <div>
                <DialogTitle className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                  Form Responses - {template.name}
                </DialogTitle>
                <DialogDescription>
                  View all submissions for this template. Click on actions to
                  view details or download files.
                </DialogDescription>
              </div>
              {responses.length > 0 && (
                <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                  <Button
                    variant='outline'
                    size='sm'
                    onClick={exportToCSV}
                    className='gap-2'
                  >
                    <FileTextIcon className='size-4' />
                    Export CSV
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant='outline'
                    size='sm'
                    onClick={exportToJSON}
                    className='gap-2'
                  >
                    <FileJson className='size-4' />
                    Export JSON
                  </Button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </DialogHeader>

          <ScrollArea className='h-[70vh]'>
            {isLoading ? (
              <div className='flex h-32 items-center justify-center'>
                <Loader2 className='size-6 animate-spin' />
                <span className='ml-2'>Loading responses...</span>
              </div>
            ) : error ? (
              <div className='py-8 text-center text-destructive'>
                Failed to load responses. Please try again.
              </div>
            ) : responses.length === 0 ? (
              <div className='py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground'>
                No responses found for this template.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Submitted By</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className='hidden md:table-cell'>Date</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className='hidden lg:table-cell'>
                      Status
                    </TableHead>
                    <TableHead className='w-[70px]'>Actions</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {responses.map((response) => (
                    <TableRow key={response.id.toString()}>
                      <TableCell className='font-medium'>
                        <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
                          <span className='rounded-lg bg-muted p-2'>
                            <FileText size={16} />
                          </span>
                          <div>
                            <p className='font-medium'>
                              {response.submittedByUser?.name ||
                                response.submittedByName ||
                                'Anonymous User'}
                            </p>
                            <div className='flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground md:hidden'>
                              <Mail className='size-3' />
                              {response.submittedByUser?.primaryEmail ||
                                response.submittedByEmail ||
                                'No email'}
                            </div>
                            <div className='flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground md:hidden'>
                              <Calendar className='size-3' />
                              {response.submittedAt
                                ? format(
                                    new Date(response.submittedAt),
                                    'MMM d, yyyy'
                                  )
                                : 'Unknown'}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className='hidden md:table-cell'>
                        <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                          <Calendar className='size-4 text-muted-foreground' />
                          <div className='text-sm'>
                            {response.submittedAt
                              ? format(
                                  new Date(response.submittedAt),
                                  'MMM d, yyyy'
                                )
                              : 'Unknown'}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className='hidden lg:table-cell'>
                        <Badge
                          variant={
                            response.status === 'SUBMITTED'
                              ? 'default'
                              : response.status === 'COMPLETED'
                                ? 'secondary'
                                : 'outline'
                          }
                        >
                          {toTitleCase(response.status)}
                        </Badge>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <DropdownMenu>
                          <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                            <Button
                              variant='ghost'
                              size='icon'
                              className='size-8'
                            >
                              <MoreVertical className='size-4' />
                            </Button>
                          </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                          <DropdownMenuContent
                            align='end'
                            className='w-[160px] font-suisse-intl'
                          >
                            <DropdownMenuItem
                              onSelect={() => handleViewResponse(response)}
                              className='gap-2'
                            >
                              <Eye className='size-4' />
                              View Details
                            </DropdownMenuItem>
                            <DropdownMenuItem
                              onSelect={() => handleDownload(response)}
                              disabled={!response.document?.s3Key}
                              className='gap-2'
                            >
                              <Download className='size-4' />
                              Download
                            </DropdownMenuItem>
                          </DropdownMenuContent>
                        </DropdownMenu>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </ScrollArea>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      <TemplateResponseSheet
        isOpen={isSheetOpen}
        onOpenChange={handleCloseSheet}
        response={selectedResponse}
        template={template}
      />
    </>
  );
}

import { createAuditLogEntry } from '@/actions/audit-logs';
import {

  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';

type OnboardingFormProps = {
  onComplete?: () => void;
  pendingUser?: PendingUserCS;
  socCodes: SocCode[];
  user: UserCS;
};

export default function OnboardingForm({
  user,
  socCodes,
  pendingUser,
  onComplete
}: Readonly<OnboardingFormProps>) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSocCode, setSelectedSocCode] = useState<Option>();
  const router = useRouter();

  clientLogger.info('Initializing onboarding form', {
    userId: user.id,
    socCodesCount: socCodes.length,
    hasPendingUser: !!pendingUser
  });

  // Convert SOC codes to autocomplete options
  const socCodeOptions: Option[] = socCodes.map((code) => ({
    value: code.onetCode,
    label: `${code.onetCode} - ${code.title}`,
    socCode: code.code,
    title: code.title
  }));

  const formSchema = z.object({
    name: z.string().min(2, 'Full name is required'),
    email: z.string().email('Invalid email address'),
    phone: z.string().min(10, 'Valid phone number is required'),
    socCode: z.string().length(10, 'SOC code must be 10 characters'),
    timezone: z.string(),
    linkedinProfileUrl: z
      .string()
      .optional()
      // .url('Invalid LinkedIn profile URL')
      .refine(
        (value) =>
          /^https:\/\/w{3}\.linkedin\.com\/in\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/u.test(value),
        {
          message:
            'Invalid LinkedIn profile URL. It should be in the format https://www.linkedin.com/in/<username>.'
        }
      )
      .superRefine((url, ctx) => {
        // Get the username from the URL
        const urlUsername = url.split('/').pop()?.toLowerCase() || '';

        // Get the form values from the current form state
        const formValues = form.getValues();
        const name = formValues.name.toLowerCase();

        // Calculate similarity score
        let matchScore = 0;

        // Split into words and normalize
        const normalizeWord = (word: string) => {
          // Handle common letter duplications
          return word.replace(/(.)\1+/u, '$1');
        };

        // Split name into words properly
        const nameWords = name
          .split(/(?=[A-Z])|[\s_-]/u)
          .map((w) => normalizeWord(w))
          .filter(Boolean);
        const usernameWords = urlUsername
          .split(/(?=[A-Z])|[\s_-]/u)
          .map((w) => normalizeWord(w))
          .filter(Boolean);

        // Check for partial matches between name parts and username parts
        for (const namePart of nameWords) {
          for (const usernamePart of usernameWords) {
            // Direct match
            if (usernamePart === namePart) {
              matchScore += 100;
              continue;
            }

            // Partial match (one contains the other)
            if (
              usernamePart.includes(namePart) ||
              namePart.includes(usernamePart)
            ) {
              matchScore += 50;
              continue;
            }

            // Fuzzy match (allow for common variations)
            const distance = levenshteinDistance(namePart, usernamePart);
            const maxLength = Math.max(namePart.length, usernamePart.length);
            const similarity = 1 - distance / maxLength;

            if (similarity > 0.5) {
              // 50% similar
              matchScore += 40;
            }
          }
        }

        // Additional check for combined words in username
        const combinedUsername = usernameWords.join('');
        for (const namePart of nameWords) {
          if (combinedUsername.includes(normalizeWord(namePart))) {
            matchScore += 40;
          }
        }

        // Count how many name words are represented in the username (in any form)
        let nameWordsFound = 0;
        for (const namePart of nameWords) {
          const normalizedNamePart = normalizeWord(namePart);
          if (
            usernameWords.some(
              (usernamePart) =>
                normalizeWord(usernamePart).includes(normalizedNamePart) ||
                normalizedNamePart.includes(normalizeWord(usernamePart))
            ) ||
            combinedUsername.includes(normalizedNamePart)
          ) {
            nameWordsFound++;
          }
        }

        // Bonus points if at least 2 name words are found
        if (nameWordsFound >= 2) {
          matchScore += 70;
        }

        // Normalize score to 0-100
        matchScore = Math.min(100, matchScore / Math.max(2, nameWords.length));

        if (matchScore < LINKEDIN_URL_NAME_MATCH_STRICTNESS) {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
            message: 'LinkedIn profile URL should contain parts of your name'
          });
        }
      })
  });

  const form = useForm<z.infer<typeof formSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(formSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      name: user.name || '',
      email: user.primaryEmail || '',
      phone: user.primaryPhone ? `+${user.primaryPhone}` : '',
      socCode: user.onetCode || '',
      timezone: Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone,
      linkedinProfileUrl: ''
    },
    mode: 'onBlur',
    reValidateMode: 'onBlur'
  });

  const onSubmit = async (data: z.infer<typeof formSchema>) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      clientLogger.info('Submitting onboarding form', {
        userId: user.id,
        name: data.name,
        socCode: selectedSocCode?.value,
        hasPendingUser: !!pendingUser
      });

      const updateData = {
        ...data,
        primaryEmail: user.primaryEmail,
        primaryPhone: data.phone.replace('+', ''),
        occupationTitle: selectedSocCode?.title,
        socCode: selectedSocCode?.socCode,
        onboardingCompleted: true,
        onboardingCompletedAt: new Date(),
        customData: {
          linkedin: {
            profile_url: data.linkedinProfileUrl
          }
        },
        firstName: data.name.split(' ')[0],
        lastName: data.name.split(' ').slice(1).join(' '),
        socialProfiles: {
          linkedin: data.linkedinProfileUrl
        },
        organizationId: String(user.organizationId)
      };

      // If there's a pending user, merge their attributes
      if (pendingUser) {
        Object.assign(updateData, {
          attributes: pendingUser.attributes,
          activeTeamId: pendingUser.activeTeamId,
          organizationRoleId: pendingUser.organizationRoleId,
          permissions: pendingUser.permissions
        });
      }

      const { code } = await updateUserSettings(
        String(user.id),
        updateData as Partial<
          Omit<UserCS, 'id' | 'logtoId' | 'organizationId'>
        >,
        `User ${extractNameFromUser(user)} (@${user.username} - ${user.id}) completed their initial user onboarding.`
      );

      console.log(code);

      switch (code) {
        case 'user.updated':
          await createAuditLogEntry({
            action: AuditLogAction.USER_UPDATED,
            category: AuditLogCategory.USER_MANAGEMENT,
            entityId: user.id,
            entityType: 'user',
            entityName: user.name,
            description: `User completed their initial user onboarding on SignVault.`,
            afterState: { user: user } as NestedRecord
          }).catch(console.error);
          break;
        case 'user.not.found':
          break;
        case 'user.email.exists':
          toast.error('This email is already in use');
          break;
        case 'user.username.exists':
          toast.error('This username is already in use');
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }

      // Prepare metadata for Stripe: only include string values from updateData
      const metadataForStripe: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(updateData)) {
        if (typeof value === 'string') {
          metadataForStripe[key] = value;
        }
      }
      metadataForStripe.dbId = String(user.id);
      metadataForStripe.logtoId = user.logtoId;

      // Create user on stripe
      await createStripeCustomer(
        user.primaryEmail,
        `${updateData.firstName} ${updateData.lastName}`,
        metadataForStripe
      );

      // Add the user to the unaffiliated users pool
      await enqueueNewUserUnaffiliatedWithProvenance({
        userId: String(user.id),
        firstName: data.name.split(' ')[0],
        lastName: data.name.split(' ').slice(-1)?.[0] || '',
        email: user.primaryEmail,
        jobTitle: selectedSocCode?.title || ''
      });

      clientLogger.info('Onboarding completed successfully', {
        userId: user.id
      });

      // If onComplete callback is provided, use it
      if (onComplete) {
        onComplete();
      } else {
        // Otherwise, redirect to settings
        return router.push(
          getStatusRedirect(
            '/account/settings/organization',
            'Onboarding Completed',
            'You have successfully completed the onboarding process. You can now create an organization and start using SignVault.'
          )
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error('Error during onboarding submission', {
        userId: user.id,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
      });
      toast.error(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to complete onboarding'
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSocCodeChange = (option: Option | undefined) => {
    clientLogger.info('SOC code selected', {
      userId: user.id,
      socCode: option?.value
    });
    setSelectedSocCode(option);
    form.setValue('socCode', option?.value || '');
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user.onetCode && !selectedSocCode) {
      const socCodeOption = socCodeOptions.find(
        (option) => option.value === user.onetCode
      );
      if (socCodeOption) {
        handleSocCodeChange(socCodeOption);
      }
    }
  }, [user, selectedSocCode, socCodeOptions]);

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form
        className='space-y-8'
        onBlur={() => {
          form.trigger();
        }}
        onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
      >
        <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-2'>
          <FormField
            control={form.control}
            name='name'
            render={({ field }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>Full Name *</FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Input className='bg-background' {...field} />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
          <FormField
            control={form.control}
            name='email'
            render={({ field }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>Email</FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Input className='bg-background' disabled {...field} />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
          <FormField
            control={form.control}
            name='phone'
            render={({ field }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormControl>
                  <PhoneInput
                    className='bg-background'
                    label='Phone *'
                    {...field}
                  />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
          <FormField
            control={form.control}
            name='linkedinProfileUrl'
            render={({ field }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>LinkedIn Profile URL</FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Input className='bg-background' {...field} />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
        </div>

        <div className='space-y-2'>
          <label className='text-sm font-medium' htmlFor='occupation'>
            Occupation (SOC Code) *
          </label>
          <AutoComplete
            className='rounded-lg border border-line bg-background'
            emptyMessage='No matching occupations found.'
            onValueChange={handleSocCodeChange}
            options={socCodeOptions}
            placeholder='Search for your occupation...'
            value={selectedSocCode}
          />
          {form.formState.errors.socCode && (
            <FormMessage>{form.formState.errors.socCode.message}</FormMessage>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className='flex w-full items-end justify-end'>
          <Button
            className='inline-flex w-full items-center gap-2 md:w-auto'
            disabled={loading || !selectedSocCode || !form.formState.isValid}
            onClick={() => {
              clientLogger.info('Onboarding form submit button clicked', {
                userId: user.id,
                isValid: form.formState.isValid
              });
              onSubmit(form.getValues());
            }}
            type='submit'
          >
            {loading ? 'Completing...' : 'Complete Onboarding'}
            {loading ? (
              <Loader2 className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4 animate-spin' />
            ) : (
              <ChevronRightCircle className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
            )}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
}
