'use server';

import { stripe } from '@/lib/stripe'; // Use shared Stripe instance
import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import { organizationsCS } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/schema';
import { eq } from '@signvault/db/drizzle';
import { createAuditLogEntry } from './audit-logs';
import {
  AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';
import { getDbUser } from './auth';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import type { OrganizationCS } from '@signvault/db/types';

export async function createStripeCustomer(
  email: string,
  name: string,
  metadata: Record<string, string>
) {
  const customer = await stripe.customers.create({
    email,
    name,
    metadata
  });

  return {
    id: customer.id,
    email: customer.email,
    name: customer.name,
    metadata: customer.metadata
  };
}

export async function createStripeOrganizationSubscription(
  organization: {
    name: string;
    billingEmail: string;
    billingAddress?: string;
    billingCity?: string;
    billingState?: string;
    billingCountry?: string;
    billingPostalCode?: string;
    phone?: string;
  },
  metadata: Record<string, string>
) {
  await stripe.customers.create({
    name: organization.name,
    email: organization.billingEmail,
    phone: organization.phone,
    metadata,
    address: organization.billingAddress
      ? {
          line1: organization.billingAddress,
          city: organization.billingCity,
          state: organization.billingState,
          country: organization.billingCountry,
          postal_code: organization.billingPostalCode
        }
      : undefined
  });
}

/**
 * Update organization subscription details in the database
 */
export async function updateOrganizationSubscription(
  organizationId: string | bigint,
  subscriptionData: {
    stripeCustomerId?: string;
    stripeSubscriptionId?: string;
    stripeProductId?: string;
    planName?: string;
    subscriptionStatus?: string;
  }
) {
  try {
    const orgId =
      typeof organizationId === 'string'
        ? BigInt(organizationId)
        : organizationId;

    const [updatedOrg] = await db
      .update(organizationsCS)
      .set({
        ...subscriptionData,
        updatedAt: new Date()
      } as Partial<OrganizationCS>)
      .where(eq(organizationsCS.id, orgId))
      .returning();

    if (!updatedOrg) {
      throw new Error('Organization not found');
    }

    return { success: true, organization: updatedOrg };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error updating organization subscription:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Get organization subscription details
 */
export async function getOrganizationSubscription(
  organizationId: string | bigint
): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  subscription: {
    hasSubscription: boolean;
    hasOrganization: boolean;
    currentPlan: string | undefined;
    subscriptionStatus: string | undefined;
    isActive: boolean;
    stripeCustomerId?: string;
    stripeSubscriptionId?: string;
    stripeProductId?: string;
  };
  error?: string | null;
}> {
  try {
    const orgId =
      typeof organizationId === 'string'
        ? BigInt(organizationId)
        : organizationId;

    const organization = await db.query.organizationsCS.findFirst({
      where: eq(organizationsCS.id, orgId)
    });

    if (!organization) {
      return {
        success: false,
        subscription: {
          hasSubscription: false,
          hasOrganization: false,
          currentPlan: undefined,
          subscriptionStatus: undefined,
          isActive: false
        },
        error: 'Organization not found'
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      subscription: {
        hasSubscription: !!organization.stripeSubscriptionId,
        hasOrganization: true,
        currentPlan: organization.planName,
        subscriptionStatus: organization.subscriptionStatus,
        isActive:
          Boolean(organization.subscriptionStatus) &&
          Boolean(organization.stripeSubscriptionId),
        stripeCustomerId: organization.stripeCustomerId,
        stripeSubscriptionId: organization.stripeSubscriptionId,
        stripeProductId: organization.stripeProductId
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error getting organization subscription:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      subscription: {
        hasSubscription: false,
        hasOrganization: false,
        currentPlan: undefined,
        subscriptionStatus: undefined,
        isActive: false
      },
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Handle subscription creation webhook
 */
export async function handleSubscriptionCreatedWebhook(
  subscriptionId: string,
  customerId: string,
  planName: string,
  status: string,
  organizationId?: string
) {
  try {
    console.log('Handling subscription created webhook:', {
      subscriptionId,
      customerId,
      planName,
      status,
      organizationId
    });

    let organization: OrganizationCS | undefined;

    if (organizationId) {
      console.log('Looking for organization by ID:', organizationId);
      // Find organization by ID if provided
      [organization] = await db
        .select()
        .from(organizationsCS)
        .where(eq(organizationsCS.id, BigInt(organizationId)))
        .limit(1);

      if (organization) {
        console.log('Found organization by ID:', organization.name);
      } else {
        console.log('Organization not found by ID:', organizationId);
      }
    }

    // If organization not found by ID, try to find by Stripe customer ID
    if (!organization) {
      console.log(
        'Looking for organization by Stripe customer ID:',
        customerId
      );
      [organization] = await db
        .select()
        .from(organizationsCS)
        .where(eq(organizationsCS.stripeCustomerId, customerId))
        .limit(1);

      if (organization) {
        console.log(
          'Found organization by Stripe customer ID:',
          organization.name
        );
      } else {
        console.log(
          'Organization not found by Stripe customer ID:',
          customerId
        );
      }
    }

    // If still not found, try to find by subscription ID (in case of updates)
    if (!organization) {
      console.log(
        'Looking for organization by subscription ID:',
        subscriptionId
      );
      [organization] = await db
        .select()
        .from(organizationsCS)
        .where(eq(organizationsCS.stripeSubscriptionId, subscriptionId))
        .limit(1);

      if (organization) {
        console.log(
          'Found organization by subscription ID:',
          organization.name
        );
      } else {
        console.log(
          'Organization not found by subscription ID:',
          subscriptionId
        );
      }
    }

    if (!organization) {
      console.error(
        'Organization not found for customer ID:',
        customerId,
        'organization ID:',
        organizationId,
        'subscription ID:',
        subscriptionId
      );
      return {
        success: false,
        organization: undefined,
        error: 'Organization not found'
      };
    }

    console.log(
      'Successfully found organization:',
      organization.name,
      'ID:',
      organization.id
    );

    // Update organization subscription details including the Stripe customer ID
    const updateResult = await updateOrganizationSubscription(organization.id, {
      stripeCustomerId: customerId,
      stripeSubscriptionId: subscriptionId,
      planName,
      subscriptionStatus: status
    });

    if (updateResult.success) {
      // Create audit log entry
      await createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.SUBSCRIPTION_CREATED,
        category: AuditLogCategory.BILLING,
        description: `Subscription ${subscriptionId} created for organization ${organization.name}`,
        entityId: organization.id.toString(),
        entityType: 'ORGANIZATION',
        entityName: organization.name,
        metadata: {
          subscriptionId,
          customerId,
          planName,
          status,
          organizationId: organization.id.toString(),
          organizationName: organization.name
        },
        success: true
      });

      return { success: true, organization: updateResult.organization };
    }

    return updateResult;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error handling subscription creation webhook:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      organization: undefined,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    };
  }
}

    };

          status: 'cancelled',
          organizationId: organization.id.toString(),
          organizationName: organization.name
        },
        success: true
      });

      return { success: true, organization: updateResult.organization };
    }

    return updateResult;
  } catch (error) {

    return {
      success: false,
      organization: undefined,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    };

/**
 * Get subscription status for a user
 */
export async function getUserSubscriptionStatus(userId: string): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  subscription: {
    hasSubscription: boolean;
    hasOrganization: boolean;
    currentPlan: string | undefined;
    subscriptionStatus: string | undefined;
    isActive: boolean;
  };
  error?: string | null;
}> {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

    if (!dbUser || dbUser.id.toString() !== userId) {
      return {
        success: false,
        subscription: {
          hasSubscription: false,
          hasOrganization: false,
          currentPlan: undefined,
          subscriptionStatus: undefined,
          isActive: false
        },
        error: 'Unauthorized'
      };
    }

    if (!dbUser.organizationId) {
      return {
        success: true,
        subscription: {
          hasSubscription: false,
          hasOrganization: false,
          currentPlan: undefined,
          subscriptionStatus: undefined,
          isActive: false
        }
      };
    }

    // Always return a full object with subscription property
    const orgResult = await getOrganizationSubscription(dbUser.organizationId);
    if (!orgResult.success) {
      return {
        success: false,
        subscription: {
          hasSubscription: false,
          hasOrganization: false,
          currentPlan: undefined,
          subscriptionStatus: undefined,
          isActive: false
        },
        error: orgResult.error
      };
    }
    // Only return the relevant fields for user subscription
    const {
      hasSubscription,
      hasOrganization,
      currentPlan,
      subscriptionStatus,
      isActive
    } = orgResult.subscription;
    return {
      success: true,
      subscription: {
        hasSubscription,
        hasOrganization,
        currentPlan,
        subscriptionStatus,
        isActive
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error getting user subscription status:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      subscription: {
        hasSubscription: false,
        hasOrganization: false,
        currentPlan: undefined,
        subscriptionStatus: undefined,
        isActive: false
      },
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    };
  }
}

import { LayoutDashboard, LogOut, Menu, Settings, User } from 'lucide-react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { NotificationBell } from './notifications/notification-bell';
import AnnouncementBanner from './announcement-banner';
import type { IdTokenClaims } from '@logto/next';

type Props = {
  readonly claims: IdTokenClaims | null;
  readonly isAuthenticated: boolean;
  readonly totalUsers: number;
};

export function StickySiteHeader({
  isAuthenticated,
  claims,
  totalUsers: _totalUsers
}: Props) {
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
  const [isSheetOpen, setIsSheetOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const toggleVisibility = () => {
      if (window.pageYOffset > 133) {
        setIsVisible(true);
      } else {
        setIsVisible(false);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('scroll', toggleVisibility);

    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', toggleVisibility);
  }, []);

import { type Metadata } from 'next';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { ROLES } from '@/lib/logto-roles-and-permissions';
import OrganizationAdminDashboard from './organization-admin-dashboard';
import {
  type GetAllOrganizationsResponse,
  type GetOrganizationResponse,
  type GetOrganizationUsersResponse,
  type GetUserOrganizationsResponse
} from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organizations';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getErrorRedirect,
  getRandomUUID
} from '@/lib/utils';
import type { GetUserResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/users';
import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import type { GetOrganizationSourceSystemsResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organization-source-systems';
import { SOURCE_SYSTEM_IDS } from '@signvault/logto';

export const revalidate = 60;
export const dynamicParams = true;

export async function generateStaticParams() {
  const logger = getServerLogger(getRandomUUID(), 'org-admin-dashboard-ssg');
  try {
    logger.info('Generating static params for organization admin dashboard');

    const organizationsRequest = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations?bypassToken=${process.env.BYPASS_TOKEN}`
    );

    const organizationsResponse: GetAllOrganizationsResponse =
      await organizationsRequest.json();
    if (
      !organizationsResponse.organizations.logto ||
      !organizationsResponse.organizations.database
    ) {
      logger.error('No organizations found', {
        organizationsResponse
      });
      return [];
    }
    const organizations =
      organizationsResponse.organizations.logto ??
      organizationsResponse.organizations.database;

    return organizations.map((org) => ({
      organizationId: org.id
    }));
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error(
      'Error generating static params for organization admin dashboard',
      {
        error
      }
    );
    return [];
  }
}

export async function generateMetadata({
  params
}: {
  params: { organizationId: string };
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'org-admin-dashboard-metadata');
  const cookiesStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookiesStore);
  const { organizationId } = await params;

  try {
    logger.info('Generating metadata for organization', {
      organizationId
    });

    const response = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookiesStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookiesStore.toString()
            : cookieString
        }
      }
    );

    const organizationResponse: GetOrganizationResponse = await response.json();

    if (
      organizationResponse.message !== 'Organization retrieved successfully'
    ) {
      logger.warn('Organization not found for metadata', {
        organizationId
      });
      return {
        title: 'Unknown Organization - Admin Dashboard',
        description: `Manage unknown organization, users, and invitations with SignVault's secure admin dashboard.`
      };
    }

    const organizationDetails =
      organizationResponse.organization.logto ??
      organizationResponse.organization.database ??
      null;

    if (!organizationDetails) {
      logger.warn('Invalid organization details for metadata', {
        organizationId
      });
      return {
        title: 'Unknown Organization - Admin Dashboard',
        description: `Manage unknown organization, users, and invitations with SignVault's secure admin dashboard.`
      };
    }

    const title = `${organizationDetails.name} - Admin Dashboard`;
    const description = `Manage ${organizationDetails.name} organization, users, and invitations with SignVault's secure admin dashboard.`;

    logger.info('Generated metadata successfully', {
      organizationId,
      organizationName: organizationDetails.name
    });

    return {
      title,
      description,
      keywords: [
        'SignVault',
        'organization management',
        'admin dashboard',
        'user management',
        'invitations',
        'role-based access control',
        organizationDetails.name
      ],
      openGraph: {
        title: title + ' | SignVault',
        description,
        url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/organizations/${organizationId}/manage`,
        siteName: 'SignVault',
        images: [
          {
            url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`,
            width: 1200,
            height: 630
          }
        ],
        locale: 'en_US',
        type: 'website'
      },
      twitter: {
        card: 'summary_large_image',
        title: title + ' | SignVault',
        description,
        images: [`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`]
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error generating metadata', {
      organizationId,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    });
    throw error;
  }
}

export default async function OrganizationAdminDashboardWrapper({
  params
}: Readonly<{
  params: { organizationId: string };
}>) {
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'org-admin-dashboard');
  const { organizationId } = await params;

  logger.info('Accessing organization admin dashboard', {
    organizationId
  });

  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const cookiesStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookiesStore);

  if (!claims) {
    logger.warn('No claims found, redirecting to home', {
      organizationId
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect('/', 'Not logged in', 'You are not logged in.')
    );
  }

  logger.info('Fetching user organizations', {
    userId: claims.sub
  });

  const userOrganizationsRequest = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/user/${claims.sub}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  );
  const userOrganizationsResponse: GetUserOrganizationsResponse =
    await userOrganizationsRequest.json();

  if (
    userOrganizationsResponse.message !== 'Organizations retrieved successfully'
  ) {
    logger.warn('Failed to retrieve user organizations', {
      userId: claims.sub
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organizations',
        'Failed to retrieve user organizations',
        'Failed to retrieve user organizations.'
      )
    );
  }

  const userOrganizations =
    userOrganizationsResponse.organizations.logto ??
    userOrganizationsResponse.organizations.database ??
    [];

  if (userOrganizations.length === 0) {
    logger.warn('User has no organizations', {
      userId: claims.sub
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organizations',
        'User has no organizations',
        'User has no organizations.'
      )
    );
  }

  logger.info('Fetching user details', {
    userId: claims.sub
  });

  const userResponse: GetUserResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/users/${claims.sub}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  const user = userResponse.user.logto;

  if (!user) {
    logger.error('User not found', { userId: claims.sub });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organizations',
        'User not found',
        'The user was not found in the database.'
      )
    );
  }

  if (
    !userOrganizations ||
    userOrganizations.length === 0 ||
    !Array.isArray(userOrganizations) ||
    !userOrganizations.some((org: any) => org.id === organizationId)
  ) {
    logger.warn('User not authorized for organization', {
      userId: claims.sub,
      organizationId: organizationId
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organizations',
        'User not authorized for organization',
        'User is not authorized for this organization.'
      )
    );
  }

  const userRoles = userOrganizations
    .filter((org: any) => org.id === organizationId)
    .flatMap((org: any) => org.organizationRoles);

  const isAuthorized = userRoles.some(
    (role: any) =>
      role.id === ROLES.SUPER_ADMIN.id || role.id === ROLES.L5_USER.id
  );

  if (!isAuthorized) {
    logger.warn('User not authorized for admin dashboard', {
      userId: claims.sub,
      organizationId: organizationId,
      roles: userRoles.map((r: any) => r.id)
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organizations',
        'Unauthorized',
        'You are not authorized to access this page.'
      )
    );
  }

  logger.info('Fetching organization details', {
    organizationId: organizationId
  });

  const organizationDetailsRequest = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  );
  const organizationDetailsResponse: GetOrganizationResponse =
    await organizationDetailsRequest.json();

  const organizationDetails = organizationDetailsResponse.organization.logto
    ? organizationDetailsResponse.organization.logto
    : null;

  if (!organizationDetails) {
    logger.error('Organization details not found', {
      organizationId: organizationId
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organizations',
        'Organization details not found',
        'The organization details were not found.'
      )
    );
  }

  logger.info('Fetching organization users', {
    organizationId: organizationId
  });

  const organizationUsersRequest = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}/users?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  );
  const organizationUsersResponse: GetOrganizationUsersResponse =
    await organizationUsersRequest.json();

  const organizationUsers =
    organizationUsersResponse.users.logto ??
    organizationUsersResponse.users.database ??
    [];

  if (
    organizationUsersResponse.message !==
      'Organization users retrieved successfully' ||
    !organizationUsers ||
    organizationUsers.length === 0
  ) {
    logger.error('Failed to retrieve organization users', {
      organizationId: organizationId
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organizations',
        'Failed to retrieve organization users',
        'Failed to retrieve organization users.'
      )
    );
  }

  const organizationSourceSystemsRequest = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-source-systems/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  const organizationSourceSystemsResponse: GetOrganizationSourceSystemsResponse =
    await organizationSourceSystemsRequest.json();

  if (
    !organizationSourceSystemsResponse.organizationSourceSystems.database ||
    organizationSourceSystemsResponse.message !==
      'Organization source systems retrieved successfully'
  ) {
    logger.error('Failed to retrieve organization source systems', {
      organizationId: organizationId
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organizations',
        'Failed to retrieve organization source systems',
        'Failed to retrieve organization source systems.'
      )
    );
  }

  const organizationSourceSystems =
    organizationSourceSystemsResponse.organizationSourceSystems.database;

  logger.info('Successfully loaded organization admin dashboard', {
    organizationId: organizationId,
    userCount: organizationUsers.length
  });

  return (
    <OrganizationAdminDashboard
      organizationDetails={organizationDetails}
      organizationUsers={organizationUsers}
      currentUserId={claims.sub}
      user={user}
      cookieStore={cookiesStore}
      organizationSourceSystems={organizationSourceSystems.filter(
        (system) => system.sourceSystemId !== SOURCE_SYSTEM_IDS.ORGANIZATION
      )}
    />
  );
}

type WorkflowConfigProps = {
  type: WorkflowType;
  form: any;
  memberOptions: { value: string; label: string }[];
  userOrganizations: any;
};

function getTaskDescription(type: WorkflowType) {
  switch (type) {
    case 'SEQUENTIAL':
      return 'Define the sequence of tasks and assign them to team members';
    case 'PARALLEL':
      return 'Define parallel tasks that can be executed simultaneously';
    case 'QUORUM':
      return 'Add team members who can participate in the quorum';
    default:
      return '';
  }
}

export function WorkflowConfig({
  type,
  form,
  memberOptions,
  userOrganizations
}: Readonly<WorkflowConfigProps>) {
  const sensors = useSensors(
    useSensor(PointerSensor),
    useSensor(KeyboardSensor, {
      coordinateGetter: sortableKeyboardCoordinates
    })
  );

  const handleDragEnd = (event: any, field: any) => {
    const { active, over } = event;
    if (active.id !== over?.id) {
      const oldIndex = field.value.findIndex(
        (item: any) => item.id === active.id
      );
      const newIndex = field.value.findIndex(
        (item: any) => item.id === over?.id
      );
      const newItems = [...field.value];
      const [movedItem] = newItems.splice(oldIndex, 1);
      newItems.splice(newIndex, 0, movedItem);
      field.onChange(newItems);
    }
  };

  const renderTimeoutBehavior = () => (
    <FormField
      control={form.control}
      name='workflows.0.settings.timeoutBehavior'
      render={({ field }) => (
        <FormItem>
          <FormLabel>Timeout Behavior</FormLabel>
          <Select onValueChange={field.onChange} defaultValue={field.value}>
            <FormControl>
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue placeholder='Select timeout behavior' />
              </SelectTrigger>
            </FormControl>
            <SelectContent>
              {timeoutBehaviors.map((behavior) => (
                <SelectItem key={behavior.value} value={behavior.value}>
                  {behavior.label}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
          <FormDescription>
            Choose what happens when a task times out
          </FormDescription>
          <FormMessage />
        </FormItem>
      )}
    />
  );

  const renderEscalationSettings = () => {
    const timeoutBehavior = form.watch('workflows.0.settings.timeoutBehavior');
    if (timeoutBehavior !== 'ESCALATE') return null;

    return (
      <div className='space-y-4'>
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='workflows.0.settings.escalation.enabled'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Enable Escalation</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Checkbox
                  checked={field.value}
                  onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>
                Enable escalation to administrators after timeout
              </FormDescription>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        {form.watch('workflows.0.settings.escalation.enabled') && (
          <>
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='workflows.0.settings.escalation.after'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Escalate After (hours)</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Input
                      type='number'
                      placeholder='Enter hours before escalation'
                      {...field}
                      value={field.value || ''}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        field.onChange(
                          e.target.value ? parseInt(e.target.value) : 24
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormDescription>
                    Number of hours before escalating to administrators
                  </FormDescription>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            <FormField

                      defaultValue={field.value}

                        )
                        .map((u: any) => ({

                    />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormDescription>
                    Select administrators to escalate to

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import type {
  DocumentTemplate,
  CustomDocumentTemplateCS,
  DocumentTemplateField
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetFooter
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/sheet';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/select';
import { Checkbox } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/checkbox';

import { Label } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/label';
import { FileText, Eye } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@signvault/ui-lib/lib/utils';

type TemplatePreviewSheetProps = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  template: DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS | null;
};

export function TemplatePreviewSheet({
  isOpen,
  onOpenChange,
  template
}: TemplatePreviewSheetProps) {
  const [formValues, setFormValues] = useState<
    Record<string, string | string[] | boolean | number>
  >({});

  if (!template) return null;

  const handleFieldChange = (
    fieldName: string,
    value: string | string[] | boolean | number
  ) => {
    setFormValues((prev) => ({ ...prev, [fieldName]: value }));
  };

  const renderField = (field: DocumentTemplateField) => {
    const fieldValue = formValues[field.name] || '';

    switch (field.type) {
      case 'string':
        return (
          <div key={field.name} className='space-y-2'>
            <Label htmlFor={field.name} className='text-sm font-medium'>
              {field.label}
              {field.required && <span className='ml-1 text-red-500'>*</span>}
            </Label>
            {field.description && (
              <p className='whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                {field.description}
              </p>
            )}
            <Input
              id={field.name}
              placeholder={`Enter ${field.label.toLowerCase()}`}
              value={typeof fieldValue === 'string' ? fieldValue : ''}
              onChange={(e) => handleFieldChange(field.name, e.target.value)}
              className='bg-background'
              disabled // Preview mode - no interaction
            />
          </div>
        );

      case 'number':
        return (
          <div key={field.name} className='space-y-2'>
            <Label htmlFor={field.name} className='text-sm font-medium'>
              {field.label}
              {field.required && <span className='ml-1 text-red-500'>*</span>}
            </Label>
            {field.description && (
              <p className='whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                {field.description}
              </p>
            )}
            <Input
              id={field.name}
              type='number'
              placeholder={`Enter ${field.label.toLowerCase()}`}
              value={
                typeof fieldValue === 'number'
                  ? fieldValue.toString()
                  : typeof fieldValue === 'string'
                    ? fieldValue
                    : ''
              }
              onChange={(e) => handleFieldChange(field.name, e.target.value)}
              className='bg-background'
              disabled // Preview mode - no interaction
            />
          </div>
        );

      case 'select':
        return (
          <div key={field.name} className='space-y-2'>
            <Label htmlFor={field.name} className='text-sm font-medium'>
              {field.label}
              {field.required && <span className='ml-1 text-red-500'>*</span>}
            </Label>
            {field.description && (
              <p className='whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                {field.description}
              </p>
            )}
            <Select
              value={typeof fieldValue === 'string' ? fieldValue : ''}
              onValueChange={(value) => handleFieldChange(field.name, value)}
              disabled
            >
              <SelectTrigger className='bg-background'>
                <SelectValue
                  placeholder={`Select ${field.label.toLowerCase()}`}
                />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
                {field.options?.map((option) => (
                  <SelectItem key={option} value={option}>
                    {option}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        );

      case 'multi-select':
        return (
          <div key={field.name} className='space-y-3'>
            <Label className='text-sm font-medium'>
              {field.label}
              {field.required && <span className='ml-1 text-red-500'>*</span>}
            </Label>
            {field.description && (
              <p className='whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                {field.description}
              </p>
            )}
            <div className='space-y-2'>
              {field.options?.map((option) => (
                <div key={option} className='flex items-center space-x-2'>
                  <Checkbox
                    id={`${field.name}-${option}`}
                    checked={
                      Array.isArray(fieldValue) && fieldValue.includes(option)
                    }
                    onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                      const currentValues = Array.isArray(fieldValue)
                        ? fieldValue
                        : [];
                      if (checked) {
                        handleFieldChange(field.name, [
                          ...currentValues,
                          option
                        ]);
                      } else {
                        handleFieldChange(
                          field.name,
                          currentValues.filter((v: string) => v !== option)
                        );
                      }
                    }}
                    disabled // Preview mode - no interaction
                  />
                  <Label
                    htmlFor={`${field.name}-${option}`}
                    className='cursor-pointer text-sm'
                  >
                    {option}
                  </Label>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        );

      case 'boolean':
        return (
          <div key={field.name} className='space-y-2'>
            <div className='flex items-center space-x-2'>
              <Checkbox
                id={field.name}
                checked={Boolean(fieldValue)}
                onCheckedChange={(checked) =>
                  handleFieldChange(field.name, Boolean(checked))
                }
                disabled // Preview mode - no interaction
              />
              <Label htmlFor={field.name} className='text-sm font-medium'>

            )}

            </Label>

                {field.description}
              </p>
            )}
            <Input
              id={field.name}
              type='date'
              value={typeof fieldValue === 'string' ? fieldValue : ''}
              onChange={(e) => handleFieldChange(field.name, e.target.value)}
              className='bg-background'
              disabled // Preview mode - no interaction
            />
          </div>
        );

              {field.label}

                Image upload field (preview mode)

        </div>
        <SheetFooter className=' w-full  justify-self-auto border-t pt-6'>

  );

import { toTitleCase } from '@/lib/utils';
import {
  AccessScope,
  ClearanceSecurityLevel,
  FunctionPrimaryRole,
  PermissionType
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer/enums';
import { ROLES } from '@signvault/logto';

type EvaluationResult = {
  allowed: boolean;
  isAdminResult?: boolean;
  reason: string;
  requiredBy: EvaluationSource[];
  restrictedBy: EvaluationSource[];
};

type EvaluationSource = {
  type: 'role' | 'team' | 'function' | 'clearance' | 'access';
  value: string;
};

export class PermissionEvaluator {
  public static readonly OWNER_ONLY_PERMISSIONS = [
    PermissionType.SYSTEM_SETTINGS_MANAGE,
    PermissionType.SYSTEM_BACKUP_MANAGE,
    PermissionType.SYSTEM_INTEGRATION_MANAGE,
    PermissionType.SECURITY_SETTINGS_MANAGE,
    PermissionType.PRIVACY_DATA_ACCESS,
    PermissionType.PRIVACY_SETTINGS_MANAGE,
    PermissionType.ALL
  ] as const;

  private static readonly FUNCTION_PERMISSION_MAP: Record<
    FunctionPrimaryRole,
    PermissionType[]
  > = {
    [FunctionPrimaryRole.COMPLIANCE_OFFICER]: [
      PermissionType.COMPLIANCE_SETTINGS_MANAGE,
      PermissionType.COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_ACCESS,
      PermissionType.COMPLIANCE_REPORT_GENERATE,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_VIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD,
      PermissionType.HR_COMPLIANCE_MANAGE
    ],
    [FunctionPrimaryRole.DOCUMENT_MANAGER]: [
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_CREATE,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_EDIT,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_DELETE,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_VIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_REVIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_APPROVE,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_ARCHIVE,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_RESTORE
    ],
    [FunctionPrimaryRole.SIGNER]: [
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_SIGN,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_VIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD
    ],
    [FunctionPrimaryRole.VIEWER]: [
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_VIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD
    ],
    [FunctionPrimaryRole.TEMPLATE_MANAGER]: [
      PermissionType.TEMPLATE_CREATE,
      PermissionType.TEMPLATE_EDIT,
      PermissionType.TEMPLATE_DELETE,
      PermissionType.TEMPLATE_VIEW,
      PermissionType.TEMPLATE_ASSIGN
    ],
    [FunctionPrimaryRole.WORKFLOW_MANAGER]: [
      PermissionType.WORKFLOW_CREATE,
      PermissionType.WORKFLOW_EDIT,
      PermissionType.WORKFLOW_DELETE,
      PermissionType.WORKFLOW_VIEW,
      PermissionType.WORKFLOW_ASSIGN,
      PermissionType.WORKFLOW_EXECUTE
    ],
    [FunctionPrimaryRole.AUDITOR]: [
      PermissionType.AUDIT_LOG_VIEW,
      PermissionType.AUDIT_REPORT_GENERATE,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_VIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_REVIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_APPROVE,
      PermissionType.COMPLIANCE_REPORT_GENERATE,
      PermissionType.COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_ACCESS,
      PermissionType.ANALYTICS_ACCESS
    ],
    [FunctionPrimaryRole.DATA_PRIVACY_OFFICER]: [
      PermissionType.PRIVACY_SETTINGS_MANAGE,
      PermissionType.PRIVACY_DATA_ACCESS,
      PermissionType.PRIVACY_CONSENT_MANAGE,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_VIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_REVIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_APPROVE,
      PermissionType.COMPLIANCE_REPORT_GENERATE,
      PermissionType.COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_ACCESS,
      PermissionType.ANALYTICS_ACCESS
    ],
    [FunctionPrimaryRole.SUPPORT_USER]: [
      PermissionType.SUPPORT_TICKET_MANAGE,
      PermissionType.SUPPORT_USER_ASSIST,
      PermissionType.SUPPORT_LOG_VIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_VIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD
    ],
    [FunctionPrimaryRole.HR_MANAGER]: [
      PermissionType.HR_DOCUMENT_MANAGE,
      PermissionType.HR_EMPLOYEE_MANAGE,
      PermissionType.HR_ONBOARDING_MANAGE,
      PermissionType.HR_OFFBOARDING_MANAGE,
      PermissionType.HR_COMPLIANCE_MANAGE,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_VIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_REVIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_APPROVE,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_SIGN
    ]
  } as const;

  private static readonly CLEARANCE_PERMISSION_MAP: Record<
    ClearanceSecurityLevel,
    PermissionType[]
  > = {
    [ClearanceSecurityLevel.RESTRICTED]: [
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_VIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD
    ],
    [ClearanceSecurityLevel.CONFIDENTIAL]: [
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_VIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_EDIT,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_SIGN
    ],
    [ClearanceSecurityLevel.PUBLIC]: [
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_VIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD
    ],
    [ClearanceSecurityLevel.PRIVATE]: [
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_VIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_EDIT,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_SIGN,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_APPROVE
    ]
  } as const;

  private static readonly ACCESS_SCOPE_PERMISSION_MAP: Record<
    Exclude<AccessScope, AccessScope.ALL>,
    PermissionType[]
  > = {
    [AccessScope.VIEW]: [
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_VIEW,
      PermissionType.REPORT_VIEW,
      PermissionType.TEMPLATE_VIEW,
      PermissionType.WORKFLOW_VIEW,
      PermissionType.AUDIT_LOG_VIEW,
      PermissionType.SUPPORT_LOG_VIEW
    ],
    [AccessScope.DOWNLOAD]: [PermissionType.DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD],
    [AccessScope.EDIT]: [
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_EDIT,
      PermissionType.TEMPLATE_EDIT,
      PermissionType.WORKFLOW_EDIT
    ],
    [AccessScope.AUDIT]: [
      PermissionType.AUDIT_LOG_VIEW,
      PermissionType.AUDIT_REPORT_GENERATE,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_VIEW,
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD
    ],
    [AccessScope.SIGN]: [PermissionType.DOCUMENT_SIGN],
    [AccessScope.APPROVE]: [PermissionType.DOCUMENT_APPROVE],
    [AccessScope.REVIEW]: [
      PermissionType.DOCUMENT_REVIEW,
      PermissionType.COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_ACCESS
    ]
  } as const;

  constructor(
    private readonly role: (typeof ROLES)[keyof typeof ROLES]['id'],
    private readonly teamPermissions: PermissionType[],
    private readonly teamName: string,
    private readonly primaryRole: FunctionPrimaryRole,
    private readonly clearanceLevel: ClearanceSecurityLevel,
    private readonly accessScopes: AccessScope[]
  ) {}

  private isOrganizationAdmin(): boolean {
    return (
      this.role === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
      this.role === ROLES.L6_USER.id ||
      this.role === ROLES.SUPER_ADMIN.id
    );
  }

  public evaluatePermission(permission: PermissionType): EvaluationResult {
    const result: EvaluationResult = {
      allowed: false,
      reason: '',
      requiredBy: [],
      restrictedBy: []
    };

    const isOrganizationAdmin = this.isOrganizationAdmin();

    // Special handling for L5_USER (Organization Admin)
    if (isOrganizationAdmin) {
      if (
        (
          PermissionEvaluator.OWNER_ONLY_PERMISSIONS as unknown as PermissionType[]
        ).includes(permission)
      ) {
        result.allowed = false;
        result.reason = 'Restricted to only the organization owner';
      } else {
        result.allowed = true;
        result.reason =
          'Organization administrators automatically have most of the permissions, regardless of their roles, primary functions or clearance';
      }
      // Set the result to be an admin result
      result.isAdminResult = true;
      // Early return for admin role since we don't need to check other conditions
      return result;
    }

    // For non-admin roles, check team permissions
    if (this.teamPermissions.length > 0) {
      if (this.teamPermissions.includes(permission)) {
        result.allowed = true;
        result.requiredBy.push({
          type: 'team',
          value: this.teamName
        });
      } else {
        result.restrictedBy.push({
          type: 'team',
          value: this.teamName
        });
      }
    }

    // Check function role permissions
    if (this.primaryRole) {
      if (
        PermissionEvaluator.FUNCTION_PERMISSION_MAP[this.primaryRole]?.includes(
          permission
        )
      ) {
        result.allowed = true;
        result.requiredBy.push({
          type: 'function',
          value: toTitleCase(this.primaryRole.replace(/_/gu, ' '))
        });
      } else {
        result.restrictedBy.push({
          type: 'function',
          value: toTitleCase(this.primaryRole.replace(/_/gu, ' '))
        });
      }
    }

    // Check clearance and access scope permissions
    if (this.clearanceLevel) {
      const hasClearancePermission =
        PermissionEvaluator.CLEARANCE_PERMISSION_MAP[
          this.clearanceLevel
        ]?.includes(permission);

      if (hasClearancePermission) {
        // Check if any access scope allows this permission
        const validScopes = this.accessScopes.filter(
          (scope) =>
            scope === AccessScope.ALL ||
            PermissionEvaluator.ACCESS_SCOPE_PERMISSION_MAP[scope]?.includes(
              permission
            )
        );

        if (validScopes.length > 0) {
          result.allowed = true;
          result.requiredBy.push({
            type: 'clearance',
            value: toTitleCase(this.clearanceLevel.replace(/_/gu, ' '))
          });
          validScopes.forEach((scope) => {
            result.requiredBy.push({
              type: 'access',
              value: toTitleCase(scope.replace(/_/gu, ' '))
            });
          });
        } else {
          result.restrictedBy.push({
            type: 'access',
            value: this.accessScopes
              .map((scope) => toTitleCase(scope.replace(/_/gu, ' ')))
              .join(', ')
          });
        }
      } else {
        result.restrictedBy.push({
          type: 'clearance',
          value: toTitleCase(this.clearanceLevel.replace(/_/gu, ' '))
        });
      }
    }

    // Format the final reason message only for non-admin roles
    if (!this.isOrganizationAdmin()) {
      if (result.allowed) {
        // Group sources by type
        const groupedSources = result.requiredBy.reduce(
          (acc, source) => {
            if (!acc[source.type]) {
              acc[source.type] = [];
            }
            acc[source.type].push(source.value);
            return acc;
          },
          {} as Record<EvaluationSource['type'], string[]>
        );

        // Format each type's message
        const requirements = Object.entries(groupedSources).map(
          ([type, values]) => {
            switch (type) {
              case 'access':
                return values.length === 1
                  ? `the '${values[0]}' access scope`
                  : `the ${values
                      .slice(0, -1)
                      .map((v) => `'${v}'`)
                      .join(
                        ', '
                      )}${values.length > 2 ? ',' : ''} and '${values[values.length - 1]}' access scopes`;
              case 'clearance':
                return `the '${values[0]}' security clearance level`;
              case 'function':
                return `'${values[0]}' primary role`;
              case 'team':
                return `the '${values[0]}' team`;
              default:
                return `${type}: ${values.join(', ')}`;
            }
          }
        );

        // Add "and" before the last item if there are multiple items
        if (requirements.length > 1) {
          const lastRequirement = requirements.pop();
          result.reason = `Required by ${requirements.join(', ')}, and ${lastRequirement}`;
        } else {
          result.reason = `Required by ${requirements[0]}`;
        }
      } else {
        // Group sources by type
        const groupedSources = result.restrictedBy.reduce(
          (acc, source) => {
            if (!acc[source.type]) {
              acc[source.type] = [];
            }
            acc[source.type].push(source.value);
            return acc;
          },
          {} as Record<EvaluationSource['type'], string[]>
        );

        // Format each type's message
        const restrictions = Object.entries(groupedSources).map(
          ([type, values]) => {
            switch (type) {
              case 'access':
                return values.length === 1
                  ? `the '${values[0]}' access scope`
                  : `the ${values
                      .slice(0, -1)
                      .map((v) => `'${v}'`)
                      .join(
                        ', '
                      )}${values.length > 2 ? ',' : ''} and '${values[values.length - 1]}' access scopes`;
              case 'clearance':
                return `the '${values[0]}' security clearance level`;
              case 'function':
                return `'${values[0]}' primary role`;
              case 'team':
                return `the '${values[0]}' team`;
              default:
                return `${type}: ${values.join(', ')}`;
            }
          }
        );

        // Add "and" before the last item if there are multiple items
        if (restrictions.length > 1) {
          const lastRestriction = restrictions.pop();
          result.reason = `Restricted by ${restrictions.join(', ')}, and ${lastRestriction}`;
        } else {
          result.reason = `Restricted by ${restrictions[0]}`;
        }
      }
    }

    return result;
  }

  public getAllPermissions(): Map<PermissionType, EvaluationResult> {
    const permissionResults = new Map<PermissionType, EvaluationResult>();

    Object.values(PermissionType).forEach((permission) => {
      permissionResults.set(permission, this.evaluatePermission(permission));
    });

    return permissionResults;
  }
}

                    draggable={false}

                    width={600}
                  />
                  <Image
                    alt='Spot Blur'

                    draggable={false}
                    loading='lazy'
                    fetchPriority='high'
                    height={200}
                    src={`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_S3_BUCKET_URL}/public/spot+blur+pricing.svg`}
                    width={600}
                  />
                </React.Fragment>
              )}

                <h4 className='mb-2 text-xl font-semibold'>{plan.name}</h4>
                <p className='font-sora text-xs text-background/70 dark:text-muted-foreground md:text-sm'>
                  {plan.description}
                </p>
              </div>
              <hr className='border border-dashed border-line/10 dark:border-primary/20' />
              <div className='overflow-hidden p-6'>
                <AnimatePresence mode='wait'>
                  <motion.div
                    animate='animate'
                    className='overflow-hidden'
                    exit='exit'
                    initial='initial'
                    key={plan.price}
                    transition={{
                      duration: 0.3,
                      ease: 'easeInOut'
                    }}
                    variants={{
                      animate: {
                        transform: 'translateY(0)',
                        opacity: 1
                      },
                      initial: {
                        transform: 'translateY(200%)',
                        opacity: 0
                      },
                      exit: {
                        transform: 'translateY(-200%)',
                        opacity: 0
                      }
                    }}

                    <span className='font-sora text-4xl font-bold'>
                      {(() => {

                              <span className='line-through'>$9.99</span>

                        }

                      })()}
                    </span>

                        /{isYearly ? 'year' : 'month'}

                            fillRule='evenodd'
                          />
                        </svg>
                        <span className='text-sm text-white'>{feature}</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
              <div className='z-20 mt-auto p-6 pt-0'>
                <Button
                  onClick={() => handlePlanSelection(plan)}
                  className={`w-full rounded-md py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_hsl(var(--primary)/0.3)] ${
                    plan.isRecommended
                      ? 'bg-[#5D5DFF] text-white shadow-[0_0_28px_hsl(var(--primary)/0.05)]'
                      : 'bg-[#2E2E4B] text-white/90 shadow-[0_0_28px_hsl(240,25%,10%)]'
                  }`}
                >
                  Choose Plan
                </Button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import type { DocumentTemplate, MimeTypePS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import * as z from 'zod';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage,
  FormDescription
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import {
  createGlobalDocumentTemplate,
  updateGlobalDocumentTemplate
} from '@/actions/document-templates';
import { useFormBuilderStore } from '@signvault/frontend/components/form-builder/store-provider';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { FileText, Loader2, Save, UploadCloud } from 'lucide-react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { formBuilderTypesToDbTypes } from './types';
import { IndustryType } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer/enums';
import { Textarea } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/textarea';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/select';
import { Switch } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/switch';
import PageHeader from '@signvault/frontend/components/pages/account/page-header';
import FileAttachmentField from '@/app/(user)/account/form-templates/file-attachment-field';
import { OptionsTagInputField } from '../form/options-tag-input-field';

const templateFormSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(1, 'Template name is required').max(255),
  description: z.string().max(1000).optional(),
  category: z.nativeEnum(IndustryType),
  version: z.string().min(1, 'Version is required').max(50),
  file: z.instanceof(File).optional(),
  isPublic: z.boolean().default(true),
  tags: z.string().optional(),
  language: z.string().max(10).optional()
});

type TemplateFormValues = z.infer<typeof templateFormSchema>;

type FormBuilderHeaderProps = {
  isSuperAdmin: boolean;
  template?: DocumentTemplate;
  currentUserDbId: string | null;
};

export default function FormBuilderHeader({
  isSuperAdmin,
  template,
  currentUserDbId
}: FormBuilderHeaderProps) {
  const { elements } = useFormBuilderStore();
  const router = useRouter();

  const form = useForm<TemplateFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(templateFormSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      name: template?.name ?? '',
      description: template?.description ?? '',
      category: (template?.category as IndustryType) ?? IndustryType.OTHER,
      version: template?.version ?? '1.0',
      isPublic: template?.isPublic ?? true,
      tags: template?.tags?.join(', ') ?? '',
      language: template?.language ?? 'en',
      file: undefined
    }
  });

  const handleSave = async (values: TemplateFormValues) => {
    if (!isSuperAdmin) {
      toast.error('You do not have permission to create/update templates.');
      return;
    }

    const templateFields = elements
      .map((el) => {
        const type = formBuilderTypesToDbTypes[el.type];
        if (!type) return null;
        return {
          name: el.id,
          label: el.label,
          type,
          required: el.required || false,
          options: el.options || [],
          description: el.description || ''
        };
      })
      .filter(Boolean);

    let mimeType = 'application/json' as MimeTypePS;
    if (values.file) {
      mimeType = values.file.type as MimeTypePS;
    } else if (template?.mimeType) {
      mimeType = template.mimeType as MimeTypePS;
    }

    const commonData = {
      name: values.name,
      description: values.description,
      fields: templateFields,
      isPublic: values.isPublic,
      category: values.category,
      version: values.version,
      mimeType,
      language: values.language,
      tags: values.tags
        ? values.tags
            .split(',')
            .map((tag) => tag.trim())
            .filter(Boolean)
        : []
    };

    try {
      if (template) {
        // Update
        const updated = await updateGlobalDocumentTemplate(template.id, {
          ...commonData,
          file: values.file
        });
        toast.success(`Template "${updated.name}" updated successfully.`);
        router.push('/account/form-templates');
      } else {
        // Create
        const created = await createGlobalDocumentTemplate({
          ...commonData,
          file: values.file // Can be undefined for form-only templates
        });
        toast.success(`Template "${created.name}" created successfully.`);
        router.push('/account/form-templates');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to save template.'
      );
      console.error(error);
    }
  };

  const existingFileName = template?.storageLocation
    ? template.storageLocation.split('/').pop()
    : null;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        heading='Create New Form Template'
        subheading='Build a new form template for your organization.'
        classNames={{
          container: 'items-center'
        }}
        rightElement={
          <Button
            type='button'
            onClick={form.handleSubmit(handleSave)}
            disabled={form.formState.isSubmitting}
            className='gap-2'
          >
            {form.formState.isSubmitting ? (
              <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin' />
            ) : (
              <Save className='size-4' />
            )}
            Save Template
          </Button>
        }
      />

      <div className='rounded-lg border border-border bg-white p-4 lg:p-6'>
        <div className='flex flex-row flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4'>
          <div className='flex flex-row flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4'>
            <div className='relative size-12 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-primary/10 xs:size-16'>
              <FileText
                className='size-full p-3.5 text-primary'
                strokeWidth={1.5}
              />
            </div>
            <div className=''>
              <h2 className='font-britanica text-2xl font-semibold'>
                Basic Details
              </h2>
              <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                Fill out the basic details for your new template.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Form {...form}>
          <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(handleSave)} className='mt-4'>
            <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2'>
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='name'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
                    <FormLabel>Template Name</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input
                        {...field}
                        placeholder='e.g., New Client Onboarding'
                        className='bg-background'
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='description'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
                    <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Textarea
                        {...field}
                        placeholder='A brief description of the template (optional)'
                        className='max-h-14 resize-none bg-background'
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            </div>
            <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 pt-4 md:grid-cols-2'>
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='category'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
                    <FormLabel>Category</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Select
                        onValueChange={field.onChange}
                        defaultValue={field.value}
                      >
                        <FormControl>
                          <SelectTrigger className='bg-background'>
                            <SelectValue placeholder='Select a category' />
                          </SelectTrigger>
                        </FormControl>
                        <SelectContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
                          {Object.values(IndustryType)
                            .filter(
                              (type) => type !== IndustryType.NOT_APPLICABLE
                            )
                            .map((type) => (
                              <SelectItem key={type} value={type}>
                                {type
                                  .toLowerCase()
                                  .replace(/_/gu, ' ')
                                  .replace(/\b\w/gu, (l) => l.toUpperCase())}
                              </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                      </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='version'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
                    <FormLabel>Version</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input
                        placeholder='e.g., 1.0, 2.1.0'
                        {...field}
                        className='bg-background'
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='tags'

                  <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>

                            closeButton:
                              'text-background hover:text-background/90'

=== FILE: ./components/global-search.tsx ===

import type {
  ActiveTeamCS,
  CalendarEventCS,
  NotificationANS,
  OrganizationCS
} from '@signvault/db/types';

import { useUserData } from '@/contexts/user-data-context';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Command,
  CommandEmpty,
  CommandGroup,
  CommandInput,
  CommandItem,
  CommandList
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/command';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import { useSidebar } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/sidebar';
import {
  Bell,
  Building2,
  Calendar,
  FileText,
  Plug,
  Search,
  Users
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

type SearchResult = {
  allDetails: OrganizationCS | ActiveTeamCS | CalendarEventCS | NotificationANS;
  description?: string;
  id: string | bigint;
  title: string;
  type: 'event' | 'notification' | 'team' | 'sourceSystem';
  url: string;
};

const typeToIcon = {
  event: Calendar,
  notification: Bell,
  organization: Building2,
  team: Users,
  content: FileText,
  sourceSystem: Plug
};

export function GlobalSearch({
  sidebarAlwaysOpen = false
}: {
  sidebarAlwaysOpen?: boolean;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [results, setResults] = useState<SearchResult[]>([]);
  const router = useRouter();
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const { open: sidebarOpen } = useSidebar();

  const userData = useUserData();

  const { organizationJoined, notifications, isLoading } = userData;

  const handleSearch = (value: string) => {
    setSearch(value);

    if (!organizationJoined) {
      setResults([]);
      return;
    }

    const { teams, events } = userData;

    if (!value || isLoading) {
      setResults([]);
      return;
    }

    const searchTerm = value.toLowerCase();

    let searchResults: SearchResult[] = [
      // Search through events
      ...events
        .filter(
          (event) =>
            event.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm) ||
            event.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)
        )
        .map((event) => ({
          id: event.id,
          title: event.title,
          description: event.description,
          type: 'event' as const,
          url: `/account/organizations/${event.organizationId}/teams/${event.teamId}/events/${event.id}`,
          allDetails: event
        })),
      // Search through notifications
      ...notifications
        .filter(
          (notification) =>
            notification.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm) ||
            notification.message?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)
        )
        .map((notification) => ({
          id: notification.id,
          title: notification.title,
          description: notification.message,
          type: 'notification' as const,
          url: `/account/notifications/${notification.id}`,
          allDetails: notification
        })),
      // Search through teams
      ...teams
        .filter(
          (team) =>
            team.name?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm) ||
            team.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)
        )
        .map((team) => ({
          id: team.id,
          title: team.name || 'Unnamed Team',
          description: team.description,
          type: 'team' as const,
          url: `/account/organizations/${team.organizationId}/teams/${team.id}`,
          allDetails: team
        }))
      // Search through source systems
      // ...sourceSystems
      //   .filter((system) => {
      //     const config = getSourceSystemConfig(system.configuration);
      //     return (
      //       config.name?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm) ||
      //       config.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)
      //     );
      //   })
      //   .map((system) => {
      //     const config = getSourceSystemConfig(system.configuration);
      //     return {
      //       id: system.id,
      //       title: config.name || 'Unnamed System',
      //       description: config.description,
      //       type: 'sourceSystem' as const,
      //       url: `/account/organizations/${system.organizationId}/source-systems/${system.id}`,
      //       allDetails: system
      //     };
      //   })
    ];

    // Remove duplicate results, correctly
    const uniqueResults = searchResults.filter(
      (result, index, self) =>
        index === self.findIndex((t) => t.id === result.id)
    );

    setResults(uniqueResults);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.metaKey && e.key === 'k') || (e.ctrlKey && e.key === 'k')) {
        e.preventDefault();
        setOpen(true);
      }
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setOpen(false);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, []);

  // Auto-focus input when dialog opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        inputRef.current?.focus();
      });
    }
  }, [open]);

  const renderSearchResults = () => {
    if (isLoading) {
      return (
        <div className='flex items-center justify-center py-6'>
          <div className='size-4 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent' />
          <span className='ml-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
            Loading data...
          </span>
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (results.length === 0) {
      return (
        <CommandEmpty className='py-6 text-center text-sm'>
          No results found.
        </CommandEmpty>
      );
    }

    if (!organizationJoined) {
      return (
        <CommandEmpty className='py-6 text-center text-sm'>
          You must join an organization to search.
        </CommandEmpty>
      );
    }

    const eventResults = results.filter((r) => r.type === 'event');
    const notificationResults = results.filter(
      (r) => r.type === 'notification'
    );
    const teamResults = results.filter((r) => r.type === 'team');
    const sourceSystemResults = results.filter(
      (r) => r.type === 'sourceSystem'
    );

    return (
      <>
        {/* Events */}
        {eventResults.length > 0 && (
          <CommandGroup heading='Events'>
            {eventResults.map((result) => {
              const Icon = typeToIcon[result.type];
              return (
                <CommandItem
                  className='flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2'
                  key={result.id}
                  onSelect={() => {
                    setOpen(false);
                    router.push(result.url);
                  }}
                >
                  <div className='flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border bg-secondary'>
                    <Icon className='size-4' />
                  </div>
                  <div className='flex flex-col'>
                    <span className='text-sm font-medium'>{result.title}</span>
                    {result.description && (
                      <span className='line-clamp-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                        {result.description}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </CommandItem>
              );
            })}
          </CommandGroup>
        )}

        {/* Notifications */}
        {notificationResults.length > 0 && (
          <CommandGroup heading='Notifications'>
            {notificationResults.map((result) => {
              const Icon = typeToIcon[result.type];
              return (
                <CommandItem
                  className='flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2'
                  key={result.id}
                  onSelect={() => {
                    setOpen(false);
                    router.push(result.url);
                  }}
                >
                  <div className='flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border bg-secondary'>
                    <Icon className='size-4' />
                  </div>
                  <div className='flex flex-col'>
                    <span className='text-sm font-medium'>{result.title}</span>
                    {result.description && (
                      <span className='line-clamp-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                        {result.description}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </CommandItem>
              );
            })}
          </CommandGroup>
        )}

        {/* Teams */}
        {teamResults.length > 0 && (
          <CommandGroup heading='Teams'>
            {teamResults.map((result) => {
              const Icon = typeToIcon[result.type];
              return (
                <CommandItem
                  className='flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2'
                  key={result.id}
                  onSelect={() => {
                    setOpen(false);
                    router.push(result.url);
                  }}
                >
                  <div className='flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border bg-secondary'>
                    <Icon className='size-4' />
                  </div>
                  <div className='flex flex-col'>
                    <span className='text-sm font-medium'>{result.title}</span>
                    {result.description && (
                      <span className='line-clamp-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                        {result.description}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </CommandItem>
              );
            })}
          </CommandGroup>
        )}

        {/* Source Systems */}
        {sourceSystemResults.length > 0 && (
          <CommandGroup heading='Source Systems'>
            {sourceSystemResults.map((result) => {
              const Icon = typeToIcon[result.type];
              return (
                <CommandItem
                  className='flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2'
                  key={result.id}
                  onSelect={() => {
                    setOpen(false);
                    router.push(result.url);
                  }}
                >
                  <div className='flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border bg-secondary'>
                    <Icon className='size-4' />
                  </div>
                  <div className='flex flex-col'>
                    <span className='text-sm font-medium'>{result.title}</span>
                    {result.description && (
                      <span className='line-clamp-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                        {result.description}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </CommandItem>
              );
            })}
          </CommandGroup>
        )}
      </>
    );
  };

  return (
    <>
      {sidebarAlwaysOpen || sidebarOpen ? (
        <Button
          className='relative min-h-10 w-full justify-start rounded-[0.5rem] px-2 text-sm font-normal text-muted-foreground shadow-none hover:bg-secondary dark:border-line'
          onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
          size='sm'
          variant='outline'
        >
          <Search className='mr-2 size-4' />
          <span className='inline-flex'>Search...</span>
          <kbd className='pointer-events-none ml-auto hidden h-5 select-none items-center gap-1 rounded border border-line px-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-medium opacity-100 sm:flex'>
            <span className='text-xs'>⌘</span>K
          </kbd>
        </Button>
      ) : (
        <Button
          className='size-8 min-h-8 min-w-8 hover:bg-secondary'
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            setOpen(true);
          }}
          size='icon'
          variant='ghost'
        >
          <Search className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
        </Button>
      )}

      <Dialog onOpenChange={setOpen} open={open}>
        <DialogContent
          aria-describedby='search-for-anything'
          aria-description='Search for events, notifications, organizations, teams, content, and source systems'
          className='overflow-hidden p-0 font-suisse-intl'
        >
          <DialogTitle className='sr-only'>Search</DialogTitle>
          <Command className='[&_[cmdk-group-heading]]:px-2 [&_[cmdk-group-heading]]:font-medium [&_[cmdk-group-heading]]:text-muted-foreground [&_[cmdk-group]:not([hidden])_~[cmdk-group]]:pt-0 [&_[cmdk-group]]:px-2 [&_[cmdk-input-wrapper]_svg]:size-5 [&_[cmdk-input]]:h-12 [&_[cmdk-item]]:px-2 [&_[cmdk-item]]:py-3 [&_[cmdk-item]_svg]:size-5'>
            <CommandInput
              className='outline-hidden flex h-11 w-full rounded-md bg-transparent py-3 text-sm placeholder:text-muted-foreground disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50'
              onValueChange={handleSearch}
              placeholder='Type to search...'
              ref={inputRef}
              value={search}
            />
            <CommandList>{renderSearchResults()}</CommandList>
          </Command>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}

export const UserDetailsSheetContent: React.FC<
  UserDetailsSheetContentProps

  const teamId = isPending ? user.activeTeamId : user.activeTeamId;
  const team = activeTeams?.find((t) => t.id === teamId);

        (role) => role.value === user.organizationRoleId.toString()
      )?.label;

        <SheetTitle hidden>User Details</SheetTitle>
