        <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
          <Avatar className='size-16 min-h-16 min-w-16 rounded-xl'>
            {!isPending && 'avatar' in user && (
              <AvatarImage alt={user.name || 'User'} src={user.avatar || ''} />
            )}
            <AvatarFallback className='dark:border-1 rounded-xl border-none bg-secondary text-xl dark:border-solid dark:border-line dark:bg-card'>
              {isPending
                ? `${user.firstName?.charAt(0) || ''}${user.lastName?.charAt(0) || ''}`
                : user.name?.charAt(0) || 'U'}
            </AvatarFallback>
          </Avatar>
          <div>
            <h3 className='font-britanica text-2xl'>
              {isPending
                ? `${user.firstName || ''} ${user.lastName || ''}`
                : user.name || 'Unknown User'}

            <p className='-mt-0.5 font-britanica text-lg text-muted-foreground'>
              {isPending ? user.email : user.primaryEmail}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className='space-y-6'>
        {/* Basic Information */}
        <div className='space-y-2'>
          <h3 className='text-lg'>Basic Information</h3>

'use server';

import type {
  UpdateUserResponse,
  UserExistsResponse
} from '@signvault/backend/routes/v2/users';
import type { GetUserDataResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/v2/user-data';
import type { GetOrganizationMembersResponse } from '@signvault/backend/routes/v2/organizations';
import {
  getOrganizationById,
  getUserById,
  getUserData as getUserDataDb
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud';
import { getOrganizationMembers as getOrganizationMembersDb } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud';
import type {
  NestedRecord,
  OrganizationCS,
  PermissionType,
  UserCS
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import type { EditUserFormValues } from '@/app/(user)/account/organization/users/users-page';
import { updateUser as updateUserDb } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud/users';
import type { OrganizationRoleId } from '@signvault/logto';
import { AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS } from '@signvault/core-lib';

  AccessLevel,
  SourceSystemType,
  UserType,
  VerificationStatus,
  type MutationRootEnqueueUserModifyArgs
} from '@signvault/gql-client/graphql';

import { execute } from '@signvault/gql-client/execute';

import { EnqueueUserModify } from '@signvault/gql-client/mutations/user';

import { EnqueueUserRoleOrPermissionsModified } from '@signvault/gql-client/mutations/team';

  AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';

/**
 * Client side action that checks if a user already exists in the database or Logto
 * @param email - The email of the user to check
 * @returns True if the user already exists, false otherwise
 */
export async function userAlreadyExists(email: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users/exists?email=${encodeURIComponent(
        email
      )}`,
      {
        method: 'GET',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        }
      }
    );

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to check user existence');
    }

    const data: UserExistsResponse = await response.json();
    return data.exists;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error checking user existence:', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
      email
    });
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Server action that gets user and organization data
 * @param userId - The ID of the user
 * @returns User and organization data
 */
export async function getUserAndOrganizationDetails(userId: string) {
  const dbUserResult = await getUserById(userId);
  const user = dbUserResult.user;
  const userHasJoinedAnOrganization = user?.organizationJoined ?? false;

  let dbOrganization = null;
  if (userHasJoinedAnOrganization && user?.organizationId) {
    const orgResult = await getOrganizationById(user.organizationId);
    dbOrganization = orgResult.organization || null;
  }

  return {
    user,
    organizationJoined: userHasJoinedAnOrganization,
    organization: dbOrganization as OrganizationCS | null
  };
}

/**
 * Server action that gets user data
 * @param userId - The ID of the user
 * @returns User data
 */
export async function getUserData(
  userId: string
): Promise<GetUserDataResponse> {
  const data = await getUserDataDb(userId);
  return {
    data,
    message: 'User data retrieved successfully'
  };
}

 * Server action that gets organization members

  };
}

/**
 * Server action that updates a user
 * @param userId - The ID of the user to update
 * @param organizationId - The ID of the organization
 * @param data - The data to update the user with
 * @returns The updated user
 */
export async function updateUser({
  userId,
  data
}: {
  data: { permissions?: PermissionType[] } & EditUserFormValues;
  userId: string;
}) {
  // Get original user record for provenance before update
  const originalUserResult = await getUserById(userId);
  if (originalUserResult.code !== 'user.found' || !originalUserResult.user) {
    throw new Error('User not found');
  }
  const originalUser = originalUserResult.user;

  // Get current user context for admin tracking
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const adminUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
  if (!adminUser) {
    throw new Error('Admin user not found');
  }

  const result = await updateUserDb(userId, {
    permissions: data.permissions,
    organizationRoleId: data.role as OrganizationRoleId,
    activeTeamId:
      typeof data.activeTeamId === 'string'
        ? BigInt(data.activeTeamId)
        : data.activeTeamId,
    attributes: data.attributes
  } as Partial<UserCS>);

  // Track role/permission changes if successful
  if (result.code === 'user.updated' && result.user) {
    const changedFields = [];
    if (data.permissions) changedFields.push('permissions');
    if (data.role) changedFields.push('organizationRoleId');
    if (data.activeTeamId) changedFields.push('activeTeamId');
    if (data.attributes) changedFields.push('attributes');

    // Enqueue user role/permissions modification event
    await execute(print(EnqueueUserRoleOrPermissionsModified as ASTNode), {
      input: {
        actorUserId: String(adminUser.id),
        organizationId: String(originalUser.organizationId),
        targetUserId: userId,
        roleName: data.role ? String(data.role) : 'unknown',
        permissions: data.permissions || []
      }
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log(
        '[PROVENANCE] Failed to log user role/permissions modification event'
      );
    });

    // Also track general user modification for audit purposes
    await execute(print(EnqueueUserModify as ASTNode), {
      input: {
        actorUserId: String(adminUser.id),
        organizationId: String(originalUser.organizationId),
        targetUserId: userId,
        isUnaffiliated: false,
        modificationReason: 'User role/permissions update by admin',
        modifiedFields: changedFields,
        previousValues: originalUser,
        newValues: result.user
      }
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log user modify event');
    });
    // Create audit log entry
    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.USER_UPDATED,
      category: AuditLogCategory.USER_MANAGEMENT,
      metadata: {
        userId: userId,
        username: result.user.username,
        userJobTitle: result.user.jobTitle,
        userType: result.user.userType
      },
      beforeState: originalUser as NestedRecord,
      afterState: result.user as NestedRecord,
      description: `User ${extractNameFromUser(result.user)} updated by ${extractNameFromUser(adminUser)}`,
      entityId: userId,
      entityType: 'USER',
      entityName: extractNameFromUser(result.user),
      targetUserId: String(adminUser.id),
      success: true
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log(
        '[AUDIT LOG] Failed to log user role/permissions updated event'
      );
    });
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Server action that updates a user's settings
 * Mostly used for updating the user's social profiles, custom data, etc.
 * @param userId - The ID of the user to update
 * @param data - The data to update the user with
 * @returns The updated user
 */
export async function updateUserSettings(
  userId: string,
  data: Partial<Omit<UserCS, 'id' | 'logtoId' | 'organizationId'>>,
  modificationReason: string
): Promise<UpdateUserResponse> {
  // Get original user record for provenance and admin user concurrently
  const [originalUserResult, { claims }] = await Promise.all([
    getUserById(userId),
    getLogtoContext(logtoConfig)
  ]);

  if (originalUserResult.code !== 'user.found' || !originalUserResult.user) {
    return {
      code: 'user.not.found',
      user: null
    } as unknown as UpdateUserResponse;
  }
  const originalUser = originalUserResult.user;

  // Fetch admin user from DB (sequential, as logtoContext must be awaited first)
  const adminUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  if (!adminUser || !adminUser.id) {
    throw new Error('Admin user not found');
  }

  // Update user in database
  const updateResult = await updateUserDb(userId, data);

  if (updateResult.code === 'user.updated' && updateResult.user) {
    // Create provenance event

    await execute(print(EnqueueUserModify as ASTNode), {
      input: {
        actorUserId: userId,
        isUnaffiliated: false,
        modificationReason: modificationReason,
        modifiedFields: Object.keys(data),
        newValues: updateResult.user,
        previousValues: originalUser,
        targetUserId: userId,
        organizationId: String(originalUser.organizationId)
      }
    } as MutationRootEnqueueUserModifyArgs).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log user settings updated event');
    });

    // Create audit log entry
    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.USER_UPDATED,
      category: AuditLogCategory.USER_MANAGEMENT,
      metadata: {
        userId: userId,
        username: updateResult.user.username,
        userJobTitle: updateResult.user.jobTitle,
        userType: updateResult.user.userType
      },
      beforeState: originalUser as NestedRecord,
      afterState: updateResult.user as NestedRecord,
      description: `User ${extractNameFromUser(updateResult.user)} updated by ${extractNameFromUser(adminUser)}`,
      entityId: userId,
      entityType: 'USER',
      entityName: extractNameFromUser(updateResult.user),
      targetUserId: String(adminUser.id),
      success: true
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log('[AUDIT LOG] Failed to log user settings updated event');
    });
  }

  return {
    code: updateResult.code,
    user: {
      database: updateResult.user,
      logto: null
    }
  } as UpdateUserResponse;
}

/**
 * Server action that adds a user to the unaffiliated users pool
 * @param data - The data of the user to add to the unaffiliated users pool
 * @returns The updated user
 */
export async function enqueueNewUserUnaffiliatedWithProvenance(data: {
  userId: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  email: string;
  jobTitle: string;
}) {
  // Enqueue the user to be added to the unaffiliated users pool
  const entityGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();

  await execute(
    print(EnqueueNewUserUnaffiliatedWithProvenanceDocument as ASTNode),
    {
      adminId: AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS[0] as string,
      sourceSystems: {
        accessLevel: 'L1',
        sourceSystemType: SourceSystemType.UserManagement,
        id: String(await entityGenerator.generateSourceSystemId()),
        organizationId: '',
        name: 'User Management'
      },
      input: {
        userId: data.userId,
        organizationId: ORGANIZATION_POOL_IDS.UNAFFILIATED_USERS_POOL,
        firstName: data.firstName,
        lastName: data.lastName,
        email: data.email,
        creationMethod: 'API',
        jobTitle: data.jobTitle,
        accessLevel: AccessLevel.L1,
        userType: UserType.SystemDefault,
        verificationStatus: VerificationStatus.Unverified
      }
    }
  ).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log(
      '[PROVENANCE] Failed to log new user unaffiliated with provenance event'
    );
  });
  // Create audit log entry
  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.USER_CREATED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.USER_MANAGEMENT,
    metadata: {
      userId: data.userId,
      userName: `${data.firstName} ${data.lastName}`,
      userEmail: data.email,
      userJobTitle: data.jobTitle,
      userType: 'SYSTEM_DEFAULT',
      userStatus: 'UNVERIFIED'
    },
    description: `User ${data.firstName} ${data.lastName} added to the unaffiliated users pool`,
    entityId: data.userId,
    entityType: 'USER',
    entityName: `${data.firstName} ${data.lastName}`,
    targetUserId: data.userId,
    success: true
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log(
      '[AUDIT LOG] Failed to log user added to unaffiliated users pool event'
    );
  });
}

'use client';

import type { LinkedInData, TwitterData } from '@signvault/db/types';

import { useUserData } from '@/contexts/user-data-context';
import { connectTwitterAccount } from '@/lib/user-actions';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogOverlay,
  DialogPortal,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuPortal,
  DropdownMenuTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/tooltip';
import { CheckCircle, EllipsisVertical, Loader2, XCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { BiLogoLinkedin } from 'react-icons/bi';
import { FaXTwitter } from 'react-icons/fa6';
import { updateUserSettings } from '@/actions/users';
import { extractNameFromUser } from '@/lib/utils';

export function SocialMediaSettingsForm() {
  const { organizationData, organizationLoading } = useUserData();
  const dbUser = organizationData?.user;
  const [isConnectingTwitter, setIsConnectingTwitter] = useState(false);
  const [isConnectingLinkedin, setIsConnectingLinkedin] = useState(false);
  const [isDisconnectingLinkedin, setIsDisconnectingLinkedin] = useState(false);
  const [twitterData, setTwitterData] = useState<TwitterData | null>(
    (dbUser?.customData as Record<string, TwitterData>)?.twitter ?? null
  );
  const [linkedinData, setLinkedinData] = useState<LinkedInData | null>(
    (dbUser?.customData as Record<string, LinkedInData>)?.linkedin ?? null
  );
  const [isDisconnectingTwitter, setIsDisconnectingTwitter] = useState(false);

  const handleConnectTwitter = async () => {
    setIsConnectingTwitter(true);
    try {
      const authUrl = await connectTwitterAccount();
      globalThis.location.assign(authUrl);
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to connect Twitter account');
    } finally {
      setIsConnectingTwitter(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDisconnectTwitter = async () => {
    setIsDisconnectingTwitter(true);
    try {
      await updateUserSettings(
        String(dbUser?.id ?? ''),
        {
          customData: {
            twitter: {
              ...twitterData,
              connected: false
            }
          }
        },
        `User ${extractNameFromUser(dbUser)} (@${dbUser.username} - ${dbUser.id}) disconnected their Twitter account.`
      );
      setTwitterData(null);
      toast.success('Twitter account disconnected successfully');
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to disconnect Twitter account');
    } finally {
      setIsDisconnectingTwitter(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDisconnectLinkedin = async () => {
    setIsDisconnectingLinkedin(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/auth/linkedin/disconnect`,
        {
          method: 'POST'
        }
      );

      if (response.ok) {
        setLinkedinData(null);
        toast.success('LinkedIn account disconnected successfully');
      } else {
        throw new Error('Failed to disconnect LinkedIn account');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to disconnect LinkedIn account');
    } finally {
      setIsDisconnectingLinkedin(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!organizationLoading) {
      setTwitterData(
        (organizationData?.user.customData as Record<string, TwitterData>)
          ?.twitter ??
          (organizationData?.user.customData as Record<string, TwitterData>)
            ?.twitter
      );
      setLinkedinData(
        (organizationData?.user.customData as Record<string, LinkedInData>)
          ?.linkedin
      );
    }
  }, [organizationData, organizationLoading]);

  if (organizationLoading) {
    return (
      <div className='flex size-full items-center justify-center'>
        <Loader2 className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4 animate-spin' />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className='flex flex-col gap-4'>
      {twitterData?.connected ? (
        <div className='inline-flex w-fit flex-row items-center gap-4 rounded-lg border border-line px-4 py-3'>
          <div className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'>
            <FaXTwitter className='size-5 text-primary' />
            <Link
              className='transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:text-primary'
              href={
                twitterData.username
                  ? `https://twitter.com/${twitterData.username}`
                  : '#'
              }
              target='_blank'
            >
              {twitterData.username}
            </Link>
            {twitterData.verified && (
              <TooltipProvider>
                <Tooltip>
                  <TooltipTrigger>
                    <CheckCircle className='size-3 text-green-500' />
                  </TooltipTrigger>
                  <TooltipContent>Verified Twitter Account</TooltipContent>
                </Tooltip>
              </TooltipProvider>
            )}
          </div>
          <Dialog>
            <DropdownMenu>
              <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                <Button
                  className='size-8 p-1 hover:bg-primary/10'
                  size='icon'
                  variant='outline'
                >
                  <EllipsisVertical className='size-4' />
                </Button>
              </DropdownMenuTrigger>
              <DropdownMenuPortal>
                <DropdownMenuContent>
                  <DialogTrigger asChild>
                    <DropdownMenuItem
                      className='inline-flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-destructive hover:text-destructive focus:text-destructive'
                      disabled={isDisconnectingTwitter}
                    >
                      <XCircle className='size-4 text-destructive hover:text-destructive' />
                      {isDisconnectingTwitter
                        ? 'Disconnecting...'
                        : 'Disconnect'}
                    </DropdownMenuItem>
                  </DialogTrigger>
                </DropdownMenuContent>
              </DropdownMenuPortal>
            </DropdownMenu>
            <DialogPortal>
              <DialogOverlay className='DialogOverlay' />
              <DialogContent className='DialogContent'>
                <DialogHeader>
                  <DialogTitle>
                    Are you sure you want to disconnect your Twitter account?
                  </DialogTitle>
                  <DialogDescription>
                    You can re-connect your Twitter account again any time.
                  </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>
                <DialogFooter>
                  <DialogClose asChild>
                    <Button
                      className='hover:bg-primary/10'
                      size='sm'
                      type='button'
                      variant='outline'
                    >
                      Cancel
                    </Button>
                  </DialogClose>
                  <Button
                    className='inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-2'

'use client';

import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetFooter
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/sheet';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Loader2,
  Lock,
  RotateCcw,
  ZoomIn,
  ZoomOut,
  Hand,
  Type
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { DocumentCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Document, Page, pdfjs } from 'react-pdf';
import 'react-pdf/dist/Page/TextLayer.css';
import 'react-pdf/dist/Page/AnnotationLayer.css';
import {
  Pagination,
  PaginationContent,
  PaginationItem,
  PaginationNext,
  PaginationPrevious
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/pagination';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { cn } from '@signvault/ui-lib/lib/utils';
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/tooltip';

pdfjs.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = `//unpkg.com/pdfjs-dist@${pdfjs.version}/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs`;

type DocumentPreviewSheetProps = {
  selectedDocument: DocumentCS;
  isOpen: boolean;
  previewUrl: string | null;
  isPreviewLoading: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  onDownload: () => void;
  onRequestAccess: () => void;
  onEdit: () => void;
};

export default function DocumentPreviewSheet({
  selectedDocument,
  isOpen,
  previewUrl,
  isPreviewLoading,
  onOpenChange,
  onDownload,
  onRequestAccess,
  onEdit
}: DocumentPreviewSheetProps) {
  const [numPages, setNumPages] = useState<number>(0);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [scale, setScale] = useState(1.0);

  const [activeTool, setActiveTool] = useState<'hand' | 'text'>('text');

  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const startCoords = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const scrollStart = useRef({ left: 0, top: 0 });
  const scrollContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const onDocumentLoadSuccess = ({ numPages }: { numPages: number }) => {
    setNumPages(numPages);
    setCurrentPage(1);
  };

  const handlePageChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const page = parseInt(e.target.value, 10);
    if (page >= 1 && page <= numPages) {
      setCurrentPage(page);
    }
  };

  const handleMouseDown = useCallback(
    (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      if (activeTool !== 'hand' || !scrollContainerRef.current) return;

      setIsDragging(true);
      startCoords.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
      scrollStart.current = {
        left: scrollContainerRef.current.scrollLeft,
        top: scrollContainerRef.current.scrollTop
      };

      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
    },
    [activeTool]
  );

  const handleMouseMove = useCallback(
    (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      if (activeTool !== 'hand' || !isDragging || !scrollContainerRef.current)
        return;

      const dx = e.clientX - startCoords.current.x;
      const dy = e.clientY - startCoords.current.y;

      scrollContainerRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollStart.current.left - dx;
      scrollContainerRef.current.scrollTop = scrollStart.current.top - dy;
    },
    [isDragging, activeTool]
  );

  const handleMouseUp = useCallback(() => {
    if (isDragging) {
      setIsDragging(false);
      document.body.style.userSelect = '';
    }
  }, [isDragging]);

  const handleMouseLeave = useCallback(() => {
    if (isDragging) {
      setIsDragging(false);
      document.body.style.userSelect = '';
    }
  }, [isDragging]);

  const handleZoomOut = () => {
    setScale((s) => Math.max(0.5, s - 0.1));
  };

  const handleResetZoom = () => {
    setScale(1.0);
  };

  const handleZoomIn = () => {
    setScale((s) => Math.min(3.0, s + 0.1));
  };

  const renderPagination = () => {
    if (numPages <= 1) return null;

    return (
      <Pagination>
        <PaginationContent>
          <PaginationItem>
            <PaginationPrevious
              size='sm'
              onClick={() => setCurrentPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
              className={cn(
                'cursor-pointer bg-secondary hover:bg-secondary/90',
                currentPage === 1 && 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-50'
              )}
            />
          </PaginationItem>
          <PaginationItem>
            <Input
              type='number'
              className='h-9 w-16 text-center'
              value={currentPage}
              onChange={handlePageChange}
              min={1}
              max={numPages}
            />
          </PaginationItem>
          <PaginationItem>
            <span className='p-2 text-sm'>of {numPages}</span>
          </PaginationItem>
          <PaginationItem>
            <PaginationNext
              size='sm'
              onClick={() => setCurrentPage((p) => Math.min(numPages, p + 1))}
              className={cn(
                'cursor-pointer bg-secondary hover:bg-secondary/90',
                currentPage === numPages && 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-50'
              )}
            />
          </PaginationItem>
        </PaginationContent>
      </Pagination>
    );
  };

  return (
    <Sheet open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <SheetContent className='flex flex-col font-suisse-intl'>
        <SheetHeader>
          <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
            <div>
              <SheetTitle className='font-britanica text-2xl'>
                {selectedDocument?.title ||
                  selectedDocument?.filename?.split('.')[0] ||
                  'Document'}
              </SheetTitle>
              <SheetDescription>
                {selectedDocument?.description || 'No description provided'}
              </SheetDescription>
            </div>
            {/* Disabled download button for now; We can only provide the download option to paid users; keep it disabled by default */}
            {/* <Button
              variant='light'
              size='sm'
              className='gap-2'
              onClick={onDownload}
              disabled={
                isPreviewLoading ||
                !selectedDocument ||
                (!previewUrl && !selectedDocument?.storageLocation)
              }
            >
              <Download className='size-4' />
              Download
            </Button> */}
          </div>
        </SheetHeader>
        {isPreviewLoading ? (
          <div className='my-2 flex items-center gap-2'>
            <div className='size-9 animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted' />
            <div className='size-9 animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted' />
            <div className='size-9 animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted' />
            <div className='size-9 animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted' />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <TooltipProvider>
            <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
              {/* Text Select Tool Button */}
              <Tooltip>
                <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                  <Button
                    variant={activeTool === 'text' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
                    size='icon'
                    onClick={() => setActiveTool('text')}
                  >
                    <Type className='size-4' />
                  </Button>
                </TooltipTrigger>
                <TooltipContent>
                  <p>Toggle Text Select Tool</p>
                </TooltipContent>
              </Tooltip>
              {/* Hand Tool Button */}
              <Tooltip>
                <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                  <Button
                    variant={activeTool === 'hand' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
                    size='icon'
                    onClick={() => setActiveTool('hand')}
                  >
                    <Hand className='size-4' />
                  </Button>
                </TooltipTrigger>
                <TooltipContent>
                  <p>Toggle Hand Tool</p>
                </TooltipContent>
              </Tooltip>
              <Tooltip>
                <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                  <Button
                    variant='outline'
                    size='icon'
                    onClick={handleZoomOut}
                    disabled={scale <= 0.5}
                  >
                    <ZoomOut className='size-4' />
                  </Button>
                </TooltipTrigger>
                <TooltipContent>
                  <p>Zoom Out</p>
                </TooltipContent>
              </Tooltip>
              <Tooltip>
                <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                  <Button
                    variant='outline'
                    size='icon'
                    onClick={handleResetZoom}
                  >
                    <RotateCcw className='size-4' />
                  </Button>
                </TooltipTrigger>
                <TooltipContent>
                  <p>Reset Zoom</p>
                </TooltipContent>
              </Tooltip>
              <Tooltip>
                <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                  <Button
                    variant='outline'
                    size='icon'
                    onClick={handleZoomIn}
                    disabled={scale >= 3.0}
                  >
                    <ZoomIn className='size-4' />
                  </Button>
                </TooltipTrigger>
                <TooltipContent>
                  <p>Zoom In</p>
                </TooltipContent>
              </Tooltip>
            </div>
          </TooltipProvider>
        )}
        <div className='flex-1 overflow-auto'>
          {isPreviewLoading ? (
            <div className='flex h-full animate-pulse flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-dashed bg-muted/50 p-8 text-center'>
              <h3 className='font-medium'>Loading preview...</h3>
            </div>
          ) : previewUrl ? (
            <div className='flex h-full flex-col'>
              <div
                role='button'
                tabIndex={0}
                onKeyDown={() => {}}
                ref={scrollContainerRef}
                className={cn(
                  'size-full overflow-auto rounded-lg border bg-white',
                  activeTool === 'hand' &&
                    (isDragging ? 'cursor-grabbing' : 'cursor-grab'),
                  activeTool === 'text' && 'cursor-text'
                )}
                onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
                onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
                onMouseUp={handleMouseUp}
                onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
              >
                <Document
                  file={previewUrl}
                  onLoadSuccess={onDocumentLoadSuccess}
                >
                  <Page
                    pageNumber={currentPage}
                    scale={scale}
                    renderTextLayer={activeTool === 'text'}
                    renderAnnotationLayer={activeTool === 'text'}
                    className='shadow-md'
                    loading={
                      <div className='flex h-full items-center justify-center'>
                        <Loader2 className='size-8 animate-spin' />
                      </div>
                    }
                  />
                </Document>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className='flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-dashed p-8 text-center'>
              <Lock className='size-8 text-muted-foreground' />
              <h3 className='font-medium'>Document preview not available</h3>
              <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                {selectedDocument?.s3Key
                  ? 'Could not load preview. You can try downloading the document.'
                  : 'This document may not have a valid preview or requires additional permissions.'}
              </p>
              {!selectedDocument?.s3Key && (
                <Button
                  variant='default'
                  className='mt-4'
                  onClick={onRequestAccess}
                >
                  Request Access
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <SheetFooter className='mt-4 w-full'>
          <div className='flex w-full items-center justify-between'>
            {isPreviewLoading ? (
              <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                <div className='h-9 w-24 animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted' />
                <div className='h-9 w-16 animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted' />
                <div className='h-9 w-12 animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted' />
                <div className='h-9 w-24 animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted' />
              </div>
            ) : (
              renderPagination()
            )}
          </div>
        </SheetFooter>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./components/dev/gql-api-tester.tsx ===

'use client';

import { useAuth } from '@/contexts/auth-context';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/textarea';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/select';
import { Minimize2, Play, Copy } from 'lucide-react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { FaCode } from 'react-icons/fa6';
import {
  TbBoxAlignBottomLeft,
  TbBoxAlignBottomRight,
  TbBoxAlignTopLeft,
  TbBoxAlignTopRight
} from 'react-icons/tb';

type Position = 'bottom-right' | 'bottom-left' | 'top-right' | 'top-left';

type GraphQLOperation = {
  name: string;
  type: 'query' | 'mutation';
  operation: string;
  variables?: Record<string, unknown>;
  description?: string;
};

// Predefined operations for quick testing
const PREDEFINED_OPERATIONS: GraphQLOperation[] = [
  {
    name: 'Get Provenance Record',
    type: 'query',
    operation: `query GetProvenanceRecord($id: String!) {
  getProvenanceRecord(id: $id) {
    id
    entityType
    entityId
    organizationId
    provenanceData
    actionType
    sourceSystemId
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}`,
    variables: { id: '124024813698879488' },
    description: 'Fetch a provenance record by ID'
  },
  {
    name: 'Enqueue Document Upload',
    type: 'mutation',
    operation: `mutation EnqueueDocumentUpload($userId: String!, $input: DocumentUploadInput!) {
  enqueueDocumentUpload(userId: $userId, input: $input) {
    success
    message
    correlationId
  }
}`,
    variables: {
      userId: '',
      input: {
        documentId: '',
        filename: 'test-document.pdf',
        title: 'Test Document',
        description: 'A test document upload',
        fileSize: 1024,
        hash: 'sample-hash',
        lastModifiedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        metadata: {},
        mimeType: 'application/pdf',
        organizationId: '',
        ownerId: '',
        s3Key: 'test-key',
        storageLocation: 'https://example.com/test.pdf',
        tags: ['test'],
        triggeredBy: ''
      }
    },
    description: 'Test document upload event'
  },
  {
    name: 'Get User Provenance',
    type: 'query',
    operation: `query GetUserProvenance($userId: String!, $organizationId: String!) {
  getUserProvenance(userId: $userId, organizationId: $organizationId) {
    id
    entityType
    entityId
    provenanceData
    actionType
    createdAt
  }
}`,
    variables: { userId: '', organizationId: '' },
    description: 'Get provenance records for a user'
  }
];

export function GqlApiTester() {
  const [operation, setOperation] = useState('');
  const [variables, setVariables] = useState('{}');
  const [response, setResponse] = useState('');
  const [isMinimized, setIsMinimized] = useState(true);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState<Position>('bottom-right');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [selectedOperation, setSelectedOperation] = useState<string>('');
  const { dbUser } = useAuth();

  const executeGraphQL = async (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    try {
      e.preventDefault();
      setIsLoading(true);
      setResponse('');

      if (!operation.trim()) {
        toast.error('Please enter a GraphQL operation');
        return;
      }

      let parsedVariables = {};
      try {
        parsedVariables = JSON.parse(variables);
      } catch (error) {
        toast.error('Invalid JSON in variables field');
        return;
      }

      // Auto-populate user and organization IDs if they're empty strings
      if (parsedVariables && typeof parsedVariables === 'object') {
        const updatedVariables = { ...parsedVariables };

        // Replace empty userId with current user ID
        if ('userId' in updatedVariables && updatedVariables.userId === '') {
          updatedVariables.userId = dbUser?.id?.toString() || '';
        }

        // Replace empty organizationId with current organization ID
        if (
          'organizationId' in updatedVariables &&
          updatedVariables.organizationId === ''
        ) {
          updatedVariables.organizationId =
            dbUser?.organizationId?.toString() || '';
        }

        // Handle nested input objects
        if (
          'input' in updatedVariables &&
          updatedVariables.input &&
          typeof updatedVariables.input === 'object'
        ) {
          const input = updatedVariables.input;
          if ('organizationId' in input && input.organizationId === '') {
            input.organizationId = dbUser?.organizationId?.toString() || '';
          }
          if ('ownerId' in input && input.ownerId === '') {
            input.ownerId = dbUser?.id?.toString() || '';
          }
          if ('triggeredBy' in input && input.triggeredBy === '') {
            input.triggeredBy = dbUser?.id?.toString() || '';
          }
        }

        parsedVariables = updatedVariables;
      }

      const provenanceCoreUrl =
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PROVENANCE_CORE_URL || 'http://localhost:4501';

      const response = await fetch(`${provenanceCoreUrl}/graphql`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Accept': 'application/graphql-response+json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          query: operation,
          variables: parsedVariables
        })
      });

      const result = await response.json();
      setResponse(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

      if (result.errors) {
        toast.error('GraphQL execution completed with errors');
      } else {
        toast.success('GraphQL operation executed successfully');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      const errorMessage =
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      toast.error(`Error executing GraphQL: ${errorMessage}`);
      setResponse(`Error: ${errorMessage}`);
      clientLogger.error(
        'Error executing GraphQL operation:',
        {
          message: errorMessage,
          operation,
          variables
        },
        'gql-api-tester'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const loadPredefinedOperation = (operationName: string) => {
    const predefined = PREDEFINED_OPERATIONS.find(
      (op) => op.name === operationName
    );
    if (predefined) {
      setOperation(predefined.operation);
      setVariables(JSON.stringify(predefined.variables || {}, null, 2));
      setSelectedOperation(operationName);
    }
  };

  const copyResponse = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(response);
    toast.success('Response copied to clipboard');
  };

  const toggleMinimize = () => {
    setIsMinimized(!isMinimized);
  };

  const changePosition = (newPosition: Position) => {
    setPosition(newPosition);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`fixed ${getPosition(position)} ${isMinimized ? 'w-fit' : 'w-full max-w-4xl'} z-50 ${isMinimized ? 'p-0' : 'p-4'} rounded-md ${isMinimized ? 'border-none' : 'border'} max-h-[80vh] overflow-hidden bg-background transition-all duration-300`}
    >
      {isMinimized ? (
        <Button onClick={toggleMinimize} size='icon' variant='outline'>
          <FaCode className='size-4' />
        </Button>
      ) : (
        <div className='flex size-full flex-col gap-4'>
          <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
            <h3 className='text-lg font-semibold'>GraphQL API Tester</h3>
            <div className='flex gap-2'>
              <Button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  changePosition('bottom-right');
                }}
                size='icon'
                variant='outline'
              >
                <TbBoxAlignBottomRight className='size-4' />
              </Button>
              <Button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  changePosition('bottom-left');
                }}
                size='icon'
                variant='outline'
              >
                <TbBoxAlignBottomLeft className='size-4' />
              </Button>
              <Button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  changePosition('top-right');
                }}
                size='icon'
                variant='outline'
              >
                <TbBoxAlignTopRight className='size-4' />
              </Button>
              <Button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  changePosition('top-left');
                }}
                size='icon'
                variant='outline'
              >
                <TbBoxAlignTopLeft className='size-4' />
              </Button>
              <Button onClick={toggleMinimize} size='icon' variant='outline'>
                <Minimize2 className='size-4' />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className='flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-auto'>
            {/* Predefined Operations */}
            <div className='flex flex-col gap-2'>
              <label
                className='text-sm font-medium'
                htmlFor='predefined-operations'
              >
                Quick Start
              </label>
              <Select
                value={selectedOperation}
                onValueChange={loadPredefinedOperation}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id='predefined-operations'>
                  <SelectValue placeholder='Select a predefined operation' />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {PREDEFINED_OPERATIONS.map((op) => (
                    <SelectItem key={op.name} value={op.name}>
                      <div className='flex flex-col'>
                        <span>{op.name}</span>
                        <span className='whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                          {op.description}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>

            {/* GraphQL Operation */}
            <div className='flex flex-col gap-2'>
              <label
                className='text-sm font-medium'
                htmlFor='graphql-operation'
              >
                GraphQL Operation
              </label>
              <Textarea
                id='graphql-operation'
                className='min-h-32 font-mono text-sm'
                onChange={(e) => setOperation(e.target.value)}
                placeholder='Enter your GraphQL query or mutation here...'
                value={operation}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Variables */}
            <div className='flex flex-col gap-2'>
              <label className='text-sm font-medium' htmlFor='variables'>
                Variables (JSON)
              </label>
              <Textarea
                id='variables'
                className='min-h-24 font-mono text-sm'
                onChange={(e) => setVariables(e.target.value)}
                placeholder='{"id": "123", "input": {...}}'
                value={variables}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Execute Button */}
            <Button
              className='w-full'
              disabled={!operation.trim() || isLoading}
              onClick={executeGraphQL}
              type='button'
            >
              <Play className='mr-2 size-4' />
              {isLoading ? 'Executing...' : 'Execute Operation'}
            </Button>

            {/* Response */}
            {response && (
              <div className='flex flex-col gap-2'>
                <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
                  <label className='text-sm font-medium' htmlFor='response'>
                    Response
                  </label>
                  <Button onClick={copyResponse} size='sm' variant='outline'>
                    <Copy className='mr-2 size-4' />
                    Copy
                  </Button>
                </div>
                <Textarea
                  id='response'
                  className='max-h-64 min-h-32 font-mono text-sm'
                  readOnly
                  value={response}
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function getPosition(position: Position) {
  switch (position) {
    case 'bottom-left':
      return 'bottom-10 left-6';
    case 'bottom-right':
      return 'bottom-10 right-12';
    case 'top-left':
      return 'top-10 left-6';
    case 'top-right':
      return 'top-10 right-6';
  }
}

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/card';
import { Badge } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/badge';
import { Skeleton } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/skeleton';
import { Textarea } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/textarea';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';

import {
  Avatar,
  AvatarFallback,
  AvatarImage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/avatar';
import { Check, X, Users, Calendar, MessageSquare, User } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { rejectJoinRequest } from '@/actions/organization-join-requests';
import { formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns';
import type { UserAttributes } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer/types';
import type { OrganizationRoleId } from '@signvault/logto';
import { UserAttributesDialog } from './components/user-attributes-dialog';
import type {
  OrganizationJoinRequestCS,
  UserCS
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/types';
import { OrganizationJoinRequestStatus } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';
import { extractNameFromUser } from '@/lib/utils';

/**
 * Page for organization admins to view and manage pending join requests
 */
export default function OrganizationPendingRequestsPageClient({
  requests: initialRequests,
  user
}: {
  requests: OrganizationJoinRequestCS[];
  user: UserCS;
}) {
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState(initialRequests);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [processingRequest, setProcessingRequest] = useState<string | null>(
    null
  );
  const [reviewMessage, setReviewMessage] = useState('');
  const [selectedRequest, setSelectedRequest] =
    useState<OrganizationJoinRequestCS | null>(null);
  const [actionType, setActionType] = useState<'approve' | 'reject' | null>(
    null
  );
  const [isDialogOpen, setIsDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [showAttributesDialog, setShowAttributesDialog] = useState(false);

  // Load organization's join requests
  const loadRequests = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      // Filter only pending requests
      const pendingRequests = requests.filter(
        (req) => req.status === OrganizationJoinRequestStatus.PENDING
      );
      setRequests(pendingRequests);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error loading requests:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load join requests');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const refreshRequests = async () => {
    await loadRequests();
  };

  // Handle approve request
  const handleApprove = async (attributes: {
    roleId: OrganizationRoleId;
    teamId?: string;
    attributes: UserAttributes;
    permissions: string[];
    reviewMessage?: string;
  }) => {
    if (!selectedRequest) return;

    try {
      setProcessingRequest(String(selectedRequest.id));
      // TODO: Implement actual approval with attributes and role
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000)); // Simulate API call
      toast.success('Join request approved successfully');
      setSelectedRequest(null);
      setShowAttributesDialog(false);
      setIsDialogOpen(false);
      await refreshRequests();
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to approve join request');
    } finally {
      setProcessingRequest(null);
    }
  };

  // Handle reject request
  const handleReject = async (requestId: string, message?: string) => {
    setProcessingRequest(requestId);
    try {
      const result = await rejectJoinRequest({
        requestId,
        reviewMessage: message
      });
      if (result.success) {
        toast.success('Join request rejected');
        // Remove the request from the list
        setRequests((prev) =>
          prev.filter((req) => String(req.id) !== String(requestId))
        );
        setIsDialogOpen(false);
        setReviewMessage('');
        setSelectedRequest(null);
      } else {
        toast.error(result.error || 'Failed to reject join request');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error rejecting request:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to reject join request');
    } finally {
      setProcessingRequest(null);
    }
  };

  // Open review dialog
  const openReviewDialog = (
    request: OrganizationJoinRequestCS,
    action: 'approve' | 'reject'
  ) => {
    setSelectedRequest(request);
    setActionType(action);
    setReviewMessage('');
    setIsDialogOpen(true);
  };

  // Handle review submission
  const handleReviewSubmit = () => {
    if (!selectedRequest || !actionType) return;

    if (actionType === 'approve') {
      // This will be handled by the UserAttributesDialog
      setShowAttributesDialog(true);
    } else {
      handleReject(String(selectedRequest.id), reviewMessage);
    }
  };

  // Get user initials for avatar fallback
  const getUserInitials = (name?: string, email?: string) => {
    if (name) {
      return name
        .split(' ')
        .map((n) => n[0])
        .join('')
        .toUpperCase()
        .slice(0, 2);
    }
    if (email) {
      return email.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    }
    return 'U';
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadRequests();
  }, []);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className='space-y-6'>
        <div>
          <h1 className='text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight'>
            Pending Join Requests
          </h1>
          <p className='text-muted-foreground'>
            Review and manage requests to join your organization.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className='space-y-4'>
          {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
            <Card key={i}>
              <CardHeader>
                <Skeleton className='h-6 w-1/3' />
                <Skeleton className='h-4 w-2/3' />
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <Skeleton className='h-4 w-full' />
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className='space-y-6'>
      <div>
        <h1 className='text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight'>
          Pending Join Requests
        </h1>
        <p className='text-muted-foreground'>
          Review and manage requests to join your organization.
        </p>
      </div>

      {requests.length === 0 ? (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className='flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12'>
            <Users className='mb-4 size-12 text-muted-foreground' />
            <h3 className='mb-2 text-lg font-semibold'>No Pending Requests</h3>
            <p className='text-center text-muted-foreground'>
              There are no pending join requests for your organization.
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className='space-y-4'>
          {requests.map((request) => (
            <Card key={request.id}>
              <CardHeader>
                <div className='flex items-start justify-between'>
                  <div className='flex items-start gap-4'>
                    <Avatar className='size-12'>
                      <AvatarImage
                        src={user.avatar}
                        alt={extractNameFromUser(user)}
                      />
                      <AvatarFallback>
                        {getUserInitials(user.name, user.primaryEmail)}
                      </AvatarFallback>
                    </Avatar>
                    <div className='space-y-1'>
                      <CardTitle className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                        <User className='size-4' />
                        {user.name || 'Unknown User'}
                      </CardTitle>
                      <CardDescription>{user.primaryEmail}</CardDescription>
                      <div className='flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                        <Calendar className='size-4' />
                        <span>
                          Requested{' '}
                          {formatDistanceToNow(new Date(request.createdAt), {
                            addSuffix: true
                          })}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <Badge variant='secondary'>Pending Review</Badge>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <div className='space-y-4'>
                  {request.message && (
                    <div>
                      <h4 className='mb-2 flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-medium'>
                        <MessageSquare className='size-4' />
                        Message from User:
                      </h4>
                      <p className='rounded-md bg-muted p-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                        {request.message}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                    <Button
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSelectedRequest(request);
                        setIsDialogOpen(true);
                      }}
                      disabled={processingRequest === String(request.id)}
                      className='bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700'
                    >
                      <Check className='mr-2 size-4' />
                      Approve
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      onClick={() => openReviewDialog(request, 'reject')}
                      disabled={processingRequest === String(request.id)}
                      variant='destructive'
                    >
                      <X className='mr-2 size-4' />
                      Reject
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Review Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={isDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setIsDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>
              {actionType === 'approve' ? 'Approve' : 'Reject'} Join Request
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {actionType === 'approve'
                ? `Approve ${selectedRequest?.requesterId}'s request to join your organization.`
                : `Reject ${selectedRequest?.requesterId}'s request to join your organization.`}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className='space-y-4'>
            <div>
              <label className='text-sm font-medium'>
                {actionType === 'approve'
                  ? 'Welcome Message (Optional)'
                  : 'Rejection Reason (Optional)'}
              </label>
              <Textarea
                value={reviewMessage}
                onChange={(e) => setReviewMessage(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={
                  actionType === 'approve'
                    ? "Welcome to the organization! We're excited to have you on board."
                    : 'Please provide a reason for rejection...'
                }
                className='mt-2'
                rows={3}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button
              variant='outline'
              onClick={() => setIsDialogOpen(false)}
              disabled={processingRequest === String(selectedRequest?.id)}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleReviewSubmit}
              disabled={processingRequest === String(selectedRequest?.id)}
              className={
                actionType === 'approve'
                  ? 'bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700'
                  : ''
              }
              variant={actionType === 'reject' ? 'destructive' : 'default'}
            >
              {processingRequest === String(selectedRequest?.id)
                ? 'Processing...'
                : actionType === 'approve'
                  ? 'Approve Request'
                  : 'Reject Request'}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* User Attributes Dialog for Approval */}
      <UserAttributesDialog
        user={user}
        isOpen={showAttributesDialog}
        onClose={() => setShowAttributesDialog(false)}
        request={selectedRequest}
        onApprove={handleApprove}
        isProcessing={processingRequest === String(selectedRequest?.id)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getOrganizationSourceSystemConfig,
  getSourceSystemConfig,
  toTitleCase
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import type { CreateContentResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/content';
import type { CreateDataProvenanceResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/data-provenances';
import BlockNoteEditor from '@/components/blocknote-editor';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';

export default function CreateContentForm({
  organizationId,
  organizationSourceSystems,
  userId,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<{
  organizationId: string;
  organizationSourceSystems: OrganizationSourceSystem[];
  userId: string;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}>) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const organizationSourceSystemsNames = organizationSourceSystems.map(
    (system) => {
      const config = getOrganizationSourceSystemConfig(system.configuration);
      return config.name;
    }
  );
  const contentSchema = z.object({
    title: z.string().min(5, 'Title must be at least 5 characters long'),
    description: z
      .string()
      .min(10, 'Description must be at least 10 characters long')
      .optional(),
    organizationSourceSystemName: z.enum(
      organizationSourceSystemsNames as [string, ...string[]]
    ),
    status: z.enum(ContentStatusEnums as [string, ...string[]]),
    content: z.string().min(50, 'Content must be at least 50 characters long')
  });
  type FormValues = z.infer<typeof contentSchema>;
  const form = useForm<FormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(contentSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      title: '',
      description: '',
      content: '',
      status: 'ACTIVE'
    }
  });
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );
  clientLogger.info('Rendering create content form', {
    organizationId,
    organizationSourceSystems,
    userId
  });

  const onSubmit = async (values: FormValues) => {
    try {
      clientLogger.info('Submitting create content form', {
        values
      });

      const organizationSourceSystem = organizationSourceSystems.find(
        (system) =>
          getOrganizationSourceSystemConfig(system.configuration).name ===
          values.organizationSourceSystemName
      );

      if (!organizationSourceSystem) {
        clientLogger.error('Organization source system not found', { values });
        return toast.error('Organization source system not found');
      }

      const orgSourceConfig = getOrganizationSourceSystemConfig(
        organizationSourceSystem.configuration
      );
      const sourceConfig = getSourceSystemConfig(
        organizationSourceSystem.configuration
      );
      const sourceSystemId = organizationSourceSystem.sourceSystemId;

      const contentEntityType = 'content';
      const contentProvenanceRootContextId = `${contentEntityType}_${organizationId}_${sourceSystemId}_provenance_root`;

      const provenanceData = {
        entityType: contentEntityType,
        entityId: organizationId,
        actionType: 'CONTENT_CREATED' as ProvenanceAction,
        provenanceData: {
          root_context_id: contentProvenanceRootContextId,
          is_root: true,
          source_id: sourceSystemId,
          provenance: {
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
            user_id: userId,
            source_system_name: sourceConfig.name,
            source_system_type: sourceConfig.type,
            source_system_description: sourceConfig.description
          },
          events: [
            {
              type: 'creation',
              timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
              user_id: userId,
              action: 'create'
            }
          ],
          version_history: [
            {
              version: '1.0',
              timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
              changes: 'Initial creation'
            }
          ]
        },
        sourceSystemId: sourceSystemId
      };

      const provenanceResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/data-provenances?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(provenanceData)
        }
      );
      const provenance: CreateDataProvenanceResponse =
        await provenanceResponse.json();

      if (provenance.message !== 'Data provenance created successfully') {
        clientLogger.error('Failed to create data provenance', {
          provenance
        });
        return toast.error(
          provenance.message ?? 'Failed to create data provenance'
        );
      }

      const dbProvenance = provenance.dataProvenance.database;

      const contentResponse: CreateContentResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/content?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            ...values,
            title: values.title,
            content: values.content,
            description: values.description,
            authorId: userId,
            organizationId,
            contentType: orgSourceConfig.type,
            dataProvenanceId: dbProvenance.id,
            organizationSourceSystemId: organizationSourceSystem.id,
            sourceSystemId,
            organizationSourceSystemRef: {
              organization_id: organizationId,
              source_system_id: sourceSystemId,
              id: organizationSourceSystem.id,
              name: orgSourceConfig.name,
              type: orgSourceConfig.type,
              description: orgSourceConfig.description,
              sourceSystemId: organizationSourceSystem.id,
              sourceSystemName: sourceConfig.name,
              sourceSystemType: sourceConfig.type
            }
          })
        }
      ).then((response) => response.json());

      if (contentResponse.message !== 'Content created successfully') {
        clientLogger.error('Failed to create content', {
          contentResponse
        });
        return toast.error(
          contentResponse.message ?? 'Failed to create content'
        );
      }
      clientLogger.info('Content created successfully', {
        contentResponse
      });
      toast.success('Content created successfully');
      router.push(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/content/${contentResponse.content.database.id}`
      );
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error('Error submitting create content form', {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
      });
      toast.error('Failed to create content');
    }
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className='space-y-6'>
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='title'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Title</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input {...field} placeholder='Enter content title' />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />

        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='description'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Textarea
                  {...field}
                  placeholder='Enter content description'
                  rows={3}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />

        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='organizationSourceSystemName'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Source System</FormLabel>
              <Select onValueChange={field.onChange} defaultValue={field.value}>
                <FormControl>
                  <SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectValue placeholder='Select source system' />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                </FormControl>
                <SelectContent>
                  {organizationSourceSystemsNames.map((name) => (
                    <SelectItem key={name} value={name}>
                      {name}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='content'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Content</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <BlockNoteEditor
                  content={field.value}
                  onChange={(html) => field.onChange(html)}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />

        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='status'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Status</FormLabel>
              <Select onValueChange={field.onChange} defaultValue={field.value}>
                <FormControl>
                  <SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectValue placeholder='Select status' />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                </FormControl>
                <SelectContent>
                  {ContentStatusEnums.map((status) => (
                    <SelectItem key={status} value={status}>
                      {toTitleCase(status.toLowerCase().replaceAll('_', ' '))}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />

        <div className='flex justify-end gap-4'>
          <Button type='button' variant='outline' onClick={() => router.back()}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            type='submit'
            disabled={form.formState.isSubmitting}
            className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
          >
            {form.formState.isSubmitting && (
              <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
            )}
            {form.formState.isSubmitting ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Content'}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
