'use client';

import type { UpdateUserResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/v2/users';
import type { LinkedInData, NestedRecord } from '@signvault/db/types';

import { useUserData } from '@/contexts/user-data-context';
import { extractNameFromUser, levenshteinDistance } from '@/lib/utils';
import { LINKEDIN_URL_NAME_MATCH_STRICTNESS } from '@/site';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import PhoneInput from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/phone-input';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import * as z from 'zod';
import { updateUserSettings } from '@/actions/users';
import {
  AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';
import { createAuditLogEntry } from '@/actions/audit-logs';

export function BasicSettingsForm() {
  const [isFormChanged, setIsFormChanged] = useState(false);
  const { organizationData, organizationLoading } = useUserData();
  const dbUser = organizationData?.user;

  const formSchema = z.object({
    name: z.string().min(2, 'Name must be at least 2 characters long'),
    username: z
      .string()
      .min(3, 'Username must be at least 3 characters long')
      .refine((value) => /^\w+$/u.test(value), {
        message: 'Username can only contain letters, numbers, and underscores.'
      }),
    primaryPhone: z.string().optional(),
    primaryEmail: z.string(),
    linkedinProfileUrl: z
      .string()
      .url('Invalid LinkedIn profile URL')
      .refine(
        (value) =>
          /^https:\/\/w{3}\.linkedin\.com\/in\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/u.test(value),
        {
          message:
            'Invalid LinkedIn profile URL. It should be in the format https://www.linkedin.com/in/<username>.'
        }
      )
      .superRefine((url, ctx) => {
        // Get the username from the URL
        const urlUsername = url.split('/').pop()?.toLowerCase() || '';

        // Get the form values from the current form state
        const formValues = form.getValues();
        const name = formValues.name.toLowerCase();

        // Calculate similarity score
        let matchScore = 0;

        // Split into words and normalize
        const normalizeWord = (word: string) => {
          // Handle common letter duplications
          return word.replace(/(.)\1+/gu, '$1');
        };

        // Split name into words properly
        const nameWords = name
          .split(/(?=[A-Z])|[\s_-]/u)
          .map((w) => normalizeWord(w))
          .filter(Boolean);
        const usernameWords = urlUsername
          .split(/(?=[A-Z])|[\s_-]/u)
          .map((w) => normalizeWord(w))
          .filter(Boolean);

        // Check for partial matches between name parts and username parts
        for (const namePart of nameWords) {
          for (const usernamePart of usernameWords) {
            // Direct match
            if (usernamePart === namePart) {
              matchScore += 100;
              continue;
            }

            // Partial match (one contains the other)
            if (
              usernamePart.includes(namePart) ||
              namePart.includes(usernamePart)
            ) {
              matchScore += 50;
              continue;
            }

            // Fuzzy match (allow for common variations)
            const distance = levenshteinDistance(namePart, usernamePart);
            const maxLength = Math.max(namePart.length, usernamePart.length);
            const similarity = 1 - distance / maxLength;

            if (similarity > 0.5) {
              // 50% similar
              matchScore += 40;
            }
          }
        }

        // Additional check for combined words in username
        const combinedUsername = usernameWords.join('');
        for (const namePart of nameWords) {
          if (combinedUsername.includes(normalizeWord(namePart))) {
            matchScore += 40;
          }
        }

        // Count how many name words are represented in the username (in any form)
        let nameWordsFound = 0;
        for (const namePart of nameWords) {
          const normalizedNamePart = normalizeWord(namePart);
          if (
            usernameWords.some(
              (usernamePart) =>
                normalizeWord(usernamePart).includes(normalizedNamePart) ||
                normalizedNamePart.includes(normalizeWord(usernamePart))
            ) ||
            combinedUsername.includes(normalizedNamePart)
          ) {
            nameWordsFound++;
          }
        }

        // Bonus points if at least 2 name words are found
        if (nameWordsFound >= 2) {
          matchScore += 70;
        }

        // Normalize score to 0-100
        matchScore = Math.min(100, matchScore / Math.max(2, nameWords.length));

        if (matchScore < LINKEDIN_URL_NAME_MATCH_STRICTNESS) {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
            message: 'LinkedIn profile URL should contain parts of your name'
          });
        }
      })
  });

  const form = useForm<z.infer<typeof formSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(formSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      name: '',
      username: '',
      primaryPhone: '',
      primaryEmail: '',
      linkedinProfileUrl: ''
    }
  });

  // Set form values after loading is complete
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!organizationLoading && dbUser) {
      form.reset({
        name: dbUser.name || '',
        username: dbUser.username || '',
        primaryPhone: `+${dbUser.primaryPhone || ''}`,
        primaryEmail: dbUser.primaryEmail || '',
        linkedinProfileUrl: dbUser?.socialProfiles?.linkedin || ''
      });
    }
  }, [organizationLoading, dbUser, form]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const subscription = form.watch((formValues) => {
      const defaultValues = {
        name: dbUser?.name || '',
        username: dbUser?.username || '',
        primaryPhone: `+${dbUser?.primaryPhone || ''}`,
        primaryEmail: dbUser?.primaryEmail || '',
        linkedinProfileUrl: dbUser?.socialProfiles?.linkedin || ''
      };

      const hasChanges = Object.keys(defaultValues).some(
        (key) =>
          formValues[key as keyof typeof formValues] !==
          defaultValues[key as keyof typeof defaultValues]
      );

      setIsFormChanged(hasChanges);
    });

    return () => subscription.unsubscribe();
  }, [form, dbUser]);

  const onSubmit = async (data: z.infer<typeof formSchema>) => {
    try {
      const linkedInData =
        ((dbUser?.customData as Record<string, unknown>)
          .linkedin as LinkedInData) ??
        ((dbUser?.customData as Record<string, unknown>)
          .linkedin as LinkedInData);
      const body = {
        ...data,
        primaryEmail: undefined,
        primaryPhone: data.primaryPhone?.replace('+', '') || undefined,
        customData: {
          ...(dbUser?.customData
            ? (dbUser?.customData as Record<string, unknown>)
            : {}),
          linkedin: {
            ...linkedInData,
            profile_url: data.linkedinProfileUrl
          }
        },
        socialProfiles: {
          linkedin: data.linkedinProfileUrl
        },
        organizationId: String(dbUser?.organizationId)
      };

      const updateUserDataResponse: UpdateUserResponse =
        await updateUserSettings(
          String(dbUser?.id ?? ''),
          body,
          `User ${extractNameFromUser(dbUser)} (@${dbUser.username} - ${dbUser.id}) updated their own profile.`
        );

      switch (updateUserDataResponse.code) {
        case 'user.updated':
          toast.success('Profile updated successfully');
          await createAuditLogEntry({
            action: AuditLogAction.USER_UPDATED,
            category: AuditLogCategory.USER_MANAGEMENT,
            entityId: dbUser?.id,
            entityType: 'user',
            entityName: dbUser?.name,
            description: `User updated their own profile.`,
            afterState: { user: dbUser } as NestedRecord
          }).catch(console.error);
          break;
        case 'user.email.exists':
          toast.error('Email already in use');
          break;
        case 'user.not.found':
          toast.error('User not found');
          break;
        case 'user.username.exists':
          toast.error('Username already in use');
          break;
        case 'user.update.failed':
        case 'internal.server.error':
        default:
          toast.error('Failed to update profile');
          break;
      }
      setIsFormChanged(false);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error('Failed to update profile');
    }
  };

  return !organizationLoading ? (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form
        className='mr-auto max-w-lg basis-[calc(50%-1rem)] space-y-4'
        onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
      >
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='primaryEmail'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Email</FormLabel>
              <FormDescription className='text-xs text-foreground/80'>
                This is your primary email address.
              </FormDescription>
              <FormControl>
                <Input disabled {...field} />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='name'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Name</FormLabel>
              <FormDescription className='text-xs text-foreground/80'>
                This is your full name.
              </FormDescription>
              <FormControl>
                <Input {...field} />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='username'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Username</FormLabel>
              <FormDescription className='text-xs text-foreground/80'>
                This is your username. It should be unique and can only contain
                letters, numbers, and underscores.
              </FormDescription>
              <FormControl>
                <Input {...field} />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='primaryPhone'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Phone Number</FormLabel>
              <FormDescription className='text-xs text-foreground/80'>
                This is your primary phone number.
              </FormDescription>
              <FormControl>
                <PhoneInput {...field} disableLabel label='Phone Number' />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='linkedinProfileUrl'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>LinkedIn Profile URL</FormLabel>
              <FormDescription className='text-xs text-foreground/80'>
                This is the URL of your LinkedIn profile.
              </FormDescription>
              <FormControl>
                <Input {...field} />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <Button disabled={!isFormChanged} type='submit'>
          Update Profile
        </Button>
      </form>
    </Form>
  ) : (
    <div className='flex size-full items-center justify-center'>
      <Loader2 className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4 animate-spin' />
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/card';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/textarea';
import {
  ChevronLeft,
  MoreHorizontal,
  Plus,
  File,
  FileText,
  FileImage,
  FileArchive,
  FileCog
} from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import FilledCircle from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/filled-circle';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';
import type { IdTokenClaims } from '@logto/node';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore } from '@/lib/utils';
import SearchInput from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/search-input';

type TeamDocumentsProps = {
  organizationId: string;
  teamId: string;
  team: any;
  documents: any[];
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
  user: IdTokenClaims;
}

export default function TeamDocuments({
  organizationId,
  teamId,
  team,
  documents: initialDocuments,
  cookieStore,
  user
}: Readonly<TeamDocumentsProps>) {
  const [documents, setDocuments] = useState(initialDocuments);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadData, setUploadData] = useState({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    file: null as File | null
  });
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
      name: cookie.name,
      value: cookie.value
    }))
  );

  const filteredDocuments = documents.filter((doc) =>
    doc.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files[0]) {
      setUploadData((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        file: e.target.files[0]
      }));
    }
  };

  const handleUpload = async () => {
    if (!uploadData.file || !uploadData.name) {
      toast.error('Please provide a file and name');
      return;
    }

    setIsUploading(true);
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', uploadData.file);
      formData.append('name', uploadData.name);
      formData.append('description', uploadData.description);

      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}/documents?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          },
          body: formData
        }
      );

      if (response.ok) {
        const newDocument = await response.json();
        setDocuments((prev) => [newDocument, ...prev]);
        setUploadData({
          name: '',
          description: '',
          file: null
        });
        toast.success('Document uploaded successfully');
      } else {
        const error = await response.json();
        toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to upload document');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to upload document');
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteDocument = async (documentId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}/documents/${documentId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          }
        }
      );

      if (response.ok) {
        setDocuments((prev) => prev.filter((doc) => doc.id !== documentId));
        toast.success('Document deleted successfully');
      } else {
        const error = await response.json();
        toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to delete document');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to delete document');
    }
  };

  const getFileIcon = (fileType: string) => {
    if (fileType.startsWith('image/')) return <FileImage className='h-6 w-6' />;
    if (fileType === 'application/pdf') return <FileText className='h-6 w-6' />;
    if (fileType.includes('zip') || fileType.includes('compressed'))
      return <FileArchive className='h-6 w-6' />;
    if (fileType.includes('json') || fileType.includes('xml'))
      return <FileCog className='h-6 w-6' />;
    return <File className='h-6 w-6' />;
  };

  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number) => {
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
    let size = bytes;
    let unitIndex = 0;

    while (size >= 1024 && unitIndex < units.length - 1) {
      size /= 1024;
      unitIndex++;
    }

    return `${size.toFixed(1)} ${units[unitIndex]}`;
  };

  return (
    <div className='w-full border-b border-line bg-transparent'>
      <div className='relative mx-4 max-w-5xl border-x border-line px-4 py-16 sm:px-6 md:mx-auto lg:px-8'>
        <FilledCircle className='absolute bottom-0 left-0 -translate-x-1/2 translate-y-1/2' />
        <FilledCircle className='absolute bottom-0 right-0 block translate-x-1/2 translate-y-1/2 xs:block sm:block md:hidden lg:hidden xl:block' />

        <div className='mb-8 flex items-center justify-between'>
          <div>
            <div className='mb-2 flex items-center gap-4'>
              <Link
                href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}`}
              >
                <Button
                  variant='outline'
                  className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
                >
                  <ChevronLeft className='h-4 w-4' />
                  Back to Team
                </Button>
              </Link>
            </div>
            <h1 className='font-signvault text-3xl font-bold'>
              {team.name} - Documents
            </h1>
            <p className='mt-2 text-muted-foreground'>
              Manage and organize team documents
            </p>
          </div>

          <Dialog>
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
              <Button className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'>
                <Plus className='h-4 w-4' />
                Upload Document
              </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
              <DialogHeader>
                <DialogTitle>Upload Document</DialogTitle>
                <DialogDescription>
                  Upload a document to share with your team
                </DialogDescription>
              </DialogHeader>

              <div className='space-y-4'>
                <div>
                  <Label htmlFor='name'>Document Name</Label>
                  <Input
                    id='name'
                    value={uploadData.name}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setUploadData((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        name: e.target.value
                      }))
                    }
                    placeholder='Enter document name'
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <Label htmlFor='description'>Description (Optional)</Label>
                  <Textarea
                    id='description'
                    value={uploadData.description}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setUploadData((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        description: e.target.value
                      }))
                    }
                    placeholder='Enter document description'
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <Label htmlFor='file'>File</Label>
                  <Input id='file' type='file' onChange={handleFileChange} />
                </div>
              </div>

              <DialogFooter>
                <Button
                  variant='outline'
                  onClick={() =>
                    setUploadData({
                      name: '',
                      description: '',
                      file: null
                    })
                  }
                >
                  Cancel
                </Button>
                <Button
                  onClick={handleUpload}
                  disabled={isUploading || !uploadData.file || !uploadData.name}
                >
                  {isUploading ? 'Uploading...' : 'Upload'}
                </Button>
              </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
          </Dialog>
        </div>

        <div className='mb-6'>
          <SearchInput
            label='Search documents...'
            showLabel={false}
            placeholder='Search documents...'
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(value) => setSearchTerm(value)}
          />
        </div>

        <div className='grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3'>
          {filteredDocuments.map((doc) => (
            <Card key={doc.id} className='relative'>
              <CardHeader className='pb-3'>
                <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
                  <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                    {getFileIcon(doc.fileType)}
                    <CardTitle className='text-lg'>{doc.name}</CardTitle>
                  </div>
                  <DropdownMenu>
                    <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                      <Button variant='ghost' className='h-8 w-8 p-0'>
                        <MoreHorizontal className='h-4 w-4' />
                      </Button>
                    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                    <DropdownMenuContent align='end'>
                      <DropdownMenuItem
                        onClick={() => window.open(doc.fileUrl, '_blank')}
                      >
                        Download
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem
                        className='text-destructive'
                        onClick={() => handleDeleteDocument(doc.id)}
                      >
                        Delete
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                    </DropdownMenuContent>
                  </DropdownMenu>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                {doc.description && (
                  <CardDescription className='mb-2'>
                    {doc.description}
                  </CardDescription>
                )}
                <div className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                  <p>Size: {formatFileSize(doc.fileSize)}</p>
                  <p>Uploaded by: {doc.uploadedBy.name}</p>
                  <p>
                    Last modified:{' '}
                    {new Date(doc.updatedAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>

        {filteredDocuments.length === 0 && (
          <div className='py-8 text-center'>
            <File className='mx-auto mb-4 h-12 w-12 text-muted-foreground' />
            <h3 className='text-lg font-medium'>No documents found</h3>
            <p className='text-muted-foreground'>
              {searchTerm
                ? 'Try adjusting your search term'
                : 'Upload your first document to get started'}
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

                            )}
                          </Avatar>
                          <span>
                            {(claims.name as string) || 'Unknown User'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        {isAuthorizedUser && (
                          <Button
                            className='inline-flex w-full items-center justify-start gap-2 hover:bg-primary/10'
                            onClick={() => handleNavigate('/dashboard')}
                            variant='outline'
                          >
                            <LayoutDashboard className='size-4' />
                            Dashboard
                          </Button>
                        )}
                        <Button
                          className='inline-flex w-full items-center justify-start gap-2 hover:bg-primary/10'
                          onClick={() =>
                            handleNavigate('/account/settings/basic')
                          }
                          variant='outline'
                        >
                          <Settings className='size-4' />
                          Account Settings
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          className='inline-flex w-full items-center justify-start gap-2 hover:bg-primary/10'
                          onClick={handleSignOutClick}
                          variant='outline'
                        >
                          <LogOut className='size-4' />
                          Sign Out
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </SheetContent>
              </Sheet>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>
    </>
  );
}

'use client';

import type {
  BulkUploadState,
  InviteUser,
  TeamData
} from '@signvault/frontend/app/(user)/create-organization/types';

import {
  AccessScope,
  ClearanceSecurityLevel,
  FunctionPrimaryRole,
  FunctionSpecialization,
  Weekday
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { type OrganizationRoleId, ROLES } from '@signvault/logto';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { cn } from '@signvault/ui-lib/lib/utils';
import { AlertCircle, Check, Download, Info } from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useDropzone } from 'react-dropzone';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { read, utils } from 'xlsx';

import { PermissionEvaluator } from '@/lib/permission-evaluator';

// Role mapping for CSV import
const ROLE_MAPPING = {
  VERIFIED_USER: ROLES.L2_USER.id,
  REGULAR_USER: ROLES.L1_USER.id,
  ORG_ADMIN: ROLES.L5_USER.id
} as const;

// Required columns in the CSV file
const REQUIRED_COLUMNS = [
  'firstName',
  'lastName',
  'email',
  'role',
  'team',
  'function.primary',
  'function.specialization',
  'clearance.level',
  'clearance.scope',
  'temporalAccess.timezone',
  'temporalAccess.schedule.days',
  'temporalAccess.schedule.hours.start',
  'temporalAccess.schedule.hours.end'
] as const;

type BulkUploadSectionProps = {
  bulkUploadState: BulkUploadState;
  onTabChange: (tab: string) => void;
  onUploadSuccess: (users: InviteUser[]) => void;
  setBulkUploadState: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<BulkUploadState>>;
  teams: TeamData[];
};

/**
 * Bulk upload section of the invite users form
 * Allows uploading multiple users via CSV file
 */
export function BulkUploadSection({
  onUploadSuccess,
  onTabChange,
  bulkUploadState,
  setBulkUploadState,
  teams
}: Readonly<BulkUploadSectionProps>) {
  const { getRootProps, getInputProps, isDragActive } = useDropzone({
    accept: {
      'text/csv': ['.csv'],
      'application/vnd.ms-excel': ['.csv']
    },
    multiple: false,
    onDrop: async (acceptedFiles) => {
      if (acceptedFiles.length === 0) return;

      const file = acceptedFiles[0];
      const reader = new FileReader();

      reader.onload = async (e) => {
        try {
          setBulkUploadState((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            isUploading: true,
            isSuccess: false,
            isError: false,
            error: null
          }));

          const data = new Uint8Array(e.target?.result as ArrayBuffer);
          const workbook = read(data, { type: 'array' });
          const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[workbook.SheetNames[0]];
          const jsonData = utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet);

          // Validate all required columns are present in the CSV
          const headers = Object.keys(jsonData[0] || {});
          const missingColumns = REQUIRED_COLUMNS.filter(
            (col) => !headers.includes(col)
          );
          if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
            throw new Error(
              `Missing required columns: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}`
            );
          }

          // Validate and transform each row
          const validUsers: InviteUser[] = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
            const user = validateAndTransformRow(
              jsonData[i] as Record<
                string,
                | FunctionPrimaryRole
                | ClearanceSecurityLevel
                | AccessScope
                | Weekday
                | string
              >,
              teams
            );
            if (user) {
              validUsers.push(user);
            } else {
              throw new Error(`Invalid data in row ${i + 1}`);
            }
          }

          if (validUsers.length === 0) {
            throw new Error('No valid users found in the CSV');
          }

          onUploadSuccess(validUsers);
          setBulkUploadState((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            isUploading: false,
            isSuccess: true,
            users: validUsers
          }));
          toast.success(`Successfully imported ${validUsers.length} users`);
          onTabChange('single');
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error processing CSV:', error);
          setBulkUploadState((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            isUploading: false,
            isError: true,
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
          }));
          toast.error(
            error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to import CSV'
          );
        }
      };

      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
    }
  });

  return (
    <div className='space-y-6'>
      <div
        {...getRootProps()}
        className={cn(
          'cursor-pointer rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed border-line p-8 text-center transition-colors',
          isDragActive ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5' : 'hover:bg-secondary/50'
        )}
      >
        <input {...getInputProps()} />
        <div className='flex flex-col items-center gap-4'>
          <div className='rounded-full bg-secondary p-3'>
            <Download className='size-6 text-primary' />
          </div>
          <div className='space-y-1'>
            <h3 className='text-lg font-medium'>
              {isDragActive
                ? 'Drop CSV file here'
                : 'Click to upload or drag CSV file'}
            </h3>
            <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
              CSV file should follow the provided template format
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className='flex flex-col items-center gap-3 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 p-4 text-primary sm:flex-row'>
        <div className='inline-flex items-center gap-3'>
          <Info className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 shrink-0' />
          <p className='text-sm'>
            Download our template file for the correct format of member details
            and team assignments
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button
          asChild
          className='ml-auto gap-2 border-primary hover:bg-primary/10 hover:text-primary'
          size='sm'
          variant='outline'
        >
          <Link
            download
            href='/templates/invite-users-template.csv'
            target='_blank'
          >
            <Download className='size-4' />
            Download .csv template
          </Link>
        </Button>
      </div>

      {bulkUploadState.isSuccess && (
        <div className='flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg bg-green-100/50 p-4 text-green-600'>
          <div className='rounded-full bg-green-600 p-1'>
            <Check className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-background' />
          </div>
          <p className='text-sm'>
            Successfully imported {bulkUploadState.users.length} user
            {bulkUploadState.users.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} from the CSV template.
            <br /> You can now switch over to the &quot;Single User&quot; tab to
            review the imported users.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {bulkUploadState.isError && (
        <div className='flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 p-4 text-destructive'>
          <div className='rounded-full bg-destructive p-1'>
            <AlertCircle className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-background' />
          </div>
          <p className='text-sm'>{bulkUploadState.error}</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Validates and parses a comma-separated string into an array of enum values
 */
function parseArrayValue<T extends string>(
  value: string,
  enumType: Record<string, T>
): T[] {
  return value
    .split(',')
    .map((v) => v.trim())
    .filter((v) => validateEnumValue(v, enumType) !== null) as T[];
}

/**
 * Validates and transforms CSV row data into InviteUser format
 */
function validateAndTransformRow(
  row: Record<
    string,
    | FunctionPrimaryRole
    | ClearanceSecurityLevel
    | AccessScope
    | Weekday
    | string
  >,
  teams: TeamData[]
): InviteUser | null {
  try {
    // Validate required fields
    for (const column of REQUIRED_COLUMNS) {
      if (!row[column]) {
        throw new Error(`Missing required column: ${column}`);
      }
    }

    // Validate role mapping
    const roleId = ROLE_MAPPING[row.role as keyof typeof ROLE_MAPPING];
    if (!roleId) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid role: ${row.role}`);
    }

    // Validate team
    if (!row.team) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid team: ${row.team}`);
    }

    // Validate function primary role
    const primaryRole = validateEnumValue(
      row['function.primary'],
      FunctionPrimaryRole
    );
    if (!primaryRole) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid primary role: ${row['function.primary']}`);
    }

    // Validate function specialization
    const specialization = validateEnumValue(
      row['function.specialization'],
      FunctionSpecialization
    );
    if (!specialization) {
      throw new Error(
        `Invalid specialization: ${row['function.specialization']}`
      );
    }

    // Validate clearance level
    const clearanceLevel = validateEnumValue(
      row['clearance.level'],
      ClearanceSecurityLevel
    );
    if (!clearanceLevel) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid clearance level: ${row['clearance.level']}`);
    }

    // Validate access scopes
    const accessScopes = parseArrayValue(row['clearance.scope'], AccessScope);
    if (accessScopes.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid access scopes: ${row['clearance.scope']}`);
    }

    // Validate schedule days
    const days = parseArrayValue(row['temporalAccess.schedule.days'], Weekday);
    if (days.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(
        `Invalid schedule days: ${row['temporalAccess.schedule.days']}`
      );
    }
    // Create user object
    const user: InviteUser = {
      firstName: row.firstName.trim(),
      lastName: row.lastName.trim(),
      email: row.email.trim(),
      role: roleId.trim() as OrganizationRoleId,
      team: row.team.trim(),
      attributes: {
        function: {
          primary: primaryRole,
          specialization
        },
        clearance: {
          level: clearanceLevel,
          scope: accessScopes
        },
        temporalAccess: {
          timezone: row['temporalAccess.timezone'].trim(),
          schedule: {
            days,
            hours: {
              start: row['temporalAccess.schedule.hours.start'].trim(),
              end: row['temporalAccess.schedule.hours.end'].trim()
            },
            timeRange: `${row['temporalAccess.schedule.hours.start'].trim()}-${row['temporalAccess.schedule.hours.end'].trim()}`
          }
        }
      },
      permissions: []
    };
    const userTeam = teams.find((team) => team.name === user.team);
    // Evaluate permissions
    const evaluator = new PermissionEvaluator(
      user.role,
      userTeam?.permissions || [],
      userTeam?.name || '',
      user.attributes.function.primary,
      user.attributes.clearance.level,
      user.attributes.clearance.scope
    );

    const permissionResults = evaluator.getAllPermissions();
    user.permissions = Array.from(permissionResults.entries())
      .filter(([_, result]) => result.allowed)
      .map(([permission]) => permission);

    return user;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Row validation error:', error);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Validates enum values against their respective types
 */
function validateEnumValue<T extends string>(
  value: string,
  enumType: Record<string, T>
): T | null {
  const enumValues = Object.values(enumType);
  return enumValues.includes(value as T) ? (value as T) : null;
}

type PDFDocumentProps = {
  templateName: string;
  templateDescription?: string;
  fields: DocumentTemplateField[];
  formData: Record<string, any>;
  organizationName?: string;
  submittedBy?: string;
  submittedAt?: Date;
};

const FormPDFDocument: React.FC<PDFDocumentProps> = ({
  templateName,
  templateDescription,
  fields,
  formData,
  organizationName,
  submittedBy,
  submittedAt
}) => {
  const renderFieldValue = (field: DocumentTemplateField, value: any) => {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) {
      return <Text style={styles.fieldValue}>Not provided</Text>;
    }

    switch (field.type) {
      case 'boolean':
        return <Text style={styles.fieldValue}>{value ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</Text>;
      case 'multi-select':
        const multiValue = Array.isArray(value)
          ? value.join(', ')
          : String(value);
        return <Text style={styles.fieldValue}>{multiValue}</Text>;
      case 'date':
        let dateValue = 'Not provided';
        if (value) {
          try {
            dateValue = new Date(value).toLocaleDateString();
          } catch {
            dateValue = String(value);
          }
        }
        return <Text style={styles.fieldValue}>{dateValue}</Text>;
      case 'number':
        return <Text style={styles.fieldValue}>{String(value)}</Text>;
      case 'image':
        if (typeof value === 'string' && value.startsWith('http')) {
          return (
            <View style={styles.imageField}>
              <Image
                src={value}
                style={{ maxWidth: 200, maxHeight: 200, marginBottom: 8 }}
              />
              <Link
                src={value}
                style={{
                  fontSize: 9,
                  color: colors.primary,
                  fontFamily: 'Inter'
                }}
              >
                View full image
              </Link>
            </View>
          );
        }
        return (
          <View style={styles.fileField}>
            <Text style={styles.fieldValue}>
              {value instanceof File
                ? `Image: ${value.name}`
                : 'Image uploaded'}
            </Text>
          </View>
        );
      case 'file':
        if (typeof value === 'string' && value.startsWith('http')) {
          const filename = value.split('/').pop() || 'Download file';
          return (
            <View style={styles.fileField}>
              <Text style={styles.fieldValue}>File attachment:</Text>
              <Link
                src={value}
                style={{
                  fontSize: 10,
                  color: colors.primary,
                  marginTop: 4,
                  fontFamily: 'Inter'
                }}
              >
                📎 {filename}
              </Link>
            </View>
          );
        }
        return (
          <View style={styles.fileField}>
            <Text style={styles.fieldValue}>
              {value instanceof File ? `📎 ${value.name}` : '📎 File uploaded'}
            </Text>
          </View>
        );
      case 'signature':
        if (typeof value === 'string' && value.startsWith('http')) {
          return (
            <View style={styles.signatureField}>
              <Text style={styles.fieldValue}>Digital signature:</Text>
              <Image
                src={value}
                style={{ maxWidth: 150, maxHeight: 75, marginTop: 8 }}
              />
            </View>
          );
        }
        return (
          <View style={styles.signatureField}>
            <Text style={styles.fieldValue}>
              {typeof value === 'string' && !value.startsWith('http')
                ? `✍️ ${value}`
                : '✍️ Signature provided'}
            </Text>
          </View>
        );
      default:
        return <Text style={styles.fieldValue}>{String(value)}</Text>;
    }
  };

  return (
    <Document>
      <Page size='LETTER' style={styles.page}>
        {/* Logo Header - Only on first page */}
        <View style={styles.logoHeader}>
          <View
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              justifyContent: 'flex-start',
              alignItems: 'flex-start',
              marginTop: 6
            }}
          >
            <Text style={styles.title}>{templateName}</Text>
            {templateDescription && (
              <Text style={styles.description}>{templateDescription}</Text>
            )}
          </View>
          <Image
            src={`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/logo-light.png`}
            style={styles.logo}
            cache={false}
          />
          {/* <Text style={styles.brandText}>SignVault</Text> */}
        </View>

        {/* Form Header */}
        <View style={styles.header}>
          <View style={styles.metaInfo}>
            <View style={styles.metaRow}>
              <Text style={{ ...styles.metaLabel, fontSize: 14 }}>
                Form Response Information
              </Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.metaRow}>
              <Text style={styles.metaLabel}>Form name:</Text>
              <Text>{templateName}</Text>
            </View>
            {organizationName && (
              <View style={styles.metaRow}>
                <Text style={styles.metaLabel}>Organization:</Text>
                <Text>{organizationName}</Text>
              </View>
            )}
            {submittedBy && (
              <View style={styles.metaRow}>
                <Text style={styles.metaLabel}>Submitted by:</Text>
                <Text>{submittedBy}</Text>
              </View>
            )}
            {submittedAt && (
              <View style={styles.metaRow}>
                <Text style={styles.metaLabel}>Submitted on:</Text>
                <Text>{format(submittedAt, 'PPPppp')}</Text>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Meta Information */}

        {/* Form Fields */}
        {fields.map((field) => (
          <View key={field.name} style={styles.fieldContainer}>
            <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>
              {field.label}
              {field.required && ' *'}
            </Text>
            {renderFieldValue(field, formData[field.name])}
            {field.description && (
              <Text style={styles.fieldDescription}>{field.description}</Text>
            )}
          </View>
        ))}

        {/* Fixed Footer - Appears on every page */}
        <View style={styles.footer} fixed>
          <View>
            <Text>Generated by SignVault.io</Text>
            <Text>Form filled on {format(new Date(), 'PPPppp')}</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={{ alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
            <Text
              render={({ pageNumber, totalPages }) =>
                `Page ${pageNumber} of ${totalPages}`
              }
            />
            {organizationName && <Text>Organization: {organizationName}</Text>}
          </View>
        </View>
      </Page>
    </Document>
  );
};

export async function generateFormPDF({
  templateName,
  templateDescription,
  fields,
  formData,
  organizationName,
  submittedBy,
  submittedAt = new Date()
}: PDFDocumentProps): Promise<Blob> {
  const doc = (
    <FormPDFDocument
      templateName={templateName}
      templateDescription={templateDescription}
      fields={fields}
      formData={formData}
      organizationName={organizationName}
      submittedBy={submittedBy}
      submittedAt={submittedAt}
    />
  );

  const pdfBlob = await pdf(doc).toBlob();
  return pdfBlob;
}

export type { PDFDocumentProps };

export default function JoinOrganization({
  activeTeam,
  organization,
  user,
  pendingUser,
  invitation,
  joinToken,
  adminIds,
  cookieString
}: Readonly<JoinOrganizationProps>) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const jobScopes = isTemplateTeam(activeTeam)
    ? activeTeam?.template?.jobScopes
    : activeTeam?.customTeam?.jobScopes;

  const handleJoinOrganization = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      clientLogger.info('Attempting to join organization', {
        organizationId: organization.id,
        userId: user.id
      });

      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/organization-join?organizationId=${organization.id}`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'x-organization-join-token': joinToken,
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            organizationId: organization.id,
            invitationId: invitation.id,
            userId: user.id
          })
        }
      );

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.message || 'Failed to join organization');
      }

      await sendUserJoinedNotification({
        organizationId: organization.id,
        userId: user.id,
        userName: user.name,
        adminIds
      });

      // Success! Redirect to organization page
      router.push(
        getStatusRedirect(
          `/account/organization/information`,
          'Organization Joined',
          'You have successfully joined the organization.'
        )
      );
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error('Error joining organization', {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
      });
      toast.error(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to join organization'
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card className='border-none bg-secondary shadow-none'>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Join {organization.name}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription hidden>
          You've been invited to join {organization.name}. Please join to
          proceed.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className='flex flex-col gap-6'>
        <div className='rounded-lg bg-background p-4'>
          <h3 className='mb-2 inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-lg'>
            <CircleAlert className='size-5 min-h-5' strokeWidth={2} />
            Final Step
          </h3>
          <ul className='list-inside list-disc text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
            <li>Please review the information below.</li>
            <li>
              Once reviewed, you can click on the{' '}
              <SpanHighlight padding='tight'>
                Join {organization.name}
              </SpanHighlight>{' '}
              button to complete the process.
            </li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div className='flex flex-col gap-4'>
          <h4 className='text-xl'>Your Access</h4>
          <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 rounded-lg md:grid-cols-2'>
            <div className='flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg bg-background p-4'>
              <div className='flex items-center gap-2 text-base'>
                <UserCircle2 className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
                Role
              </div>

                }

'use client';

import { type DocumentCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import type { DocumentStatus } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';
import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/tooltip';
import { cn } from '@signvault/ui-lib/lib/utils';
import {
  Eye,
  FileText,
  UserCircle,
  MoreVertical,
  Pencil,
  Copy,
  Download,
  Archive as ArchiveIcon,
  ArchiveRestore as ArchiveRestoreIcon,
  Signature,
  Tag,
  Info
} from 'lucide-react';
import { formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { getSecureDocumentDownloadUrl } from '@/actions/documents';
import { EditDocumentDialog } from './edit-document-dialog';
import { useUserData } from '@/contexts/user-data-context';
import dynamic from 'next/dynamic';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Badge } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/badge';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';

// only load the PDF viewer sheet on the client
const ESignDocumentSheet = dynamic(() => import('./e-sign-document-sheet'), {
  ssr: false
});
const DocumentThumbnail = dynamic(() => import('./document-thumbnail'), {
  ssr: false
});

type DocumentCardProps = {
  document: DocumentCS;
  onView?: (document: DocumentCS) => void;
  onUpdateDocumentStatus?: (
    document: DocumentCS,
    newStatus: DocumentStatus
  ) => void;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
} & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>;

export function DocumentCard({
  document,
  onView,
  onUpdateDocumentStatus,
  children,
  ...props
}: Readonly<DocumentCardProps>) {
  const StatusIcon = FileText;
  const [isEditDialogOpen, setIsEditDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isSigningSheetOpen, setIsSigningSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const { organizationData, organizationMembers } = useUserData();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const owner = organizationMembers?.find(
    (member) => member.id === document.ownerId
  );
  const router = useRouter();
  const MAX_VISIBLE_TAGS = 3;
  const visibleTags = document.tags
    ? document.tags.slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE_TAGS)
    : [];
  const extraTagsCount = document.tags
    ? Math.max(0, document.tags.length - MAX_VISIBLE_TAGS)
    : 0;

  const copyLinkMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (url: string) => {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
      return url;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success('Link copied to clipboard');
    },
    onError: () => {
      toast.error('Failed to copy link');
    }
  });

  const downloadMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (s3Key: string) => {
      const downloadUrl = await getSecureDocumentDownloadUrl(s3Key, 'download');
      window.open(downloadUrl, '_blank');
      return downloadUrl;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success('Document download initiated');
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to get download link for document');
    }
  });

  const handleOpenEditDialog = () => {
    setIsEditDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenSignSheet = () => {
    setIsSigningSheetOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSignSuccess = (updatedDocument: DocumentCS) => {
    setIsSigningSheetOpen(false);
    toast.success(`Document "${updatedDocument.title}" signed successfully.`);
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({
      queryKey: ['organizationDocuments', organizationData?.organization?.id]
    });
  };

  const handleEditSuccess = (updatedDocument: DocumentCS) => {
    // The dialog itself invalidates 'organizationDocuments' query.
    // If we need to update a specific document query (e.g., for a single document view page cache),
    // it could be done here or also in the dialog.
    // For now, list invalidation is handled by the dialog.
    // toast.success(`Document "${updatedDocument.filename}" was updated.`); // Toast already in dialog
  };

  const handleCopyLink = () => {
    const url = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/documents/${document.id}`;
    copyLinkMutation.mutate(url);
  };

  const handleDownload = () => {
    if (document.s3Key) {
      downloadMutation.mutate(document.s3Key);
    } else if (document.storageLocation && !document.s3Key) {
      toast('Attempting direct download. Secure link unavailable.');
      window.open(document.storageLocation, '_blank');
      toast.success('Document opened for download (direct link).');
    } else {
      toast.error(
        'Document file not available for download (no key or location).'
      );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn('rounded-lg p-6', props.className)} {...props}>
      <div className='flex-1'>
        {/* Thumbnail (shown nicely in grid layouts) */}
        <div className='mb-3'>
          <DocumentThumbnail doc={document} />
        </div>
        <div className='flex items-start justify-between'>
          <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>

                className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 text-primary'
                strokeWidth={2}
              />
            </div>
            <h3 className='line-clamp-1 font-britanica text-xl sm:text-2xl'>
              {document.title ||
                document.filename?.split('.')[0] ||
                'Untitled Document'}
            </h3>
          </div>
          <div className='flex items-center gap-1'>
            <TooltipProvider>
              <Tooltip delayDuration={400}>
                <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                  <Button
                    onClick={() => onView?.(document)}
                    variant='secondary'
                    size='icon'
                    aria-label='View document'
                    className='size-8 p-0'
                  >
                    <Eye className='size-4' />
                    <span className='sr-only'>View</span>
                  </Button>
                </TooltipTrigger>
                <TooltipContent className='border-none bg-foreground text-background'>
                  View document
                </TooltipContent>
              </Tooltip>
            </TooltipProvider>
            <DropdownMenu modal={false}>
              <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                <Button
                  variant='light'
                  className='size-8 p-0'
                  aria-label='Open menu'
                >
                  <MoreVertical className='size-4' />
                </Button>
              </DropdownMenuTrigger>
              <DropdownMenuContent align='end' className='font-suisse-intl'>
                <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => onView?.(document)}>
                  <Eye className='mr-2 size-4' />
                  <span>View</span>
                </DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem onClick={handleOpenEditDialog}>
                  <Pencil className='mr-2 size-4' />
                  <span>Edit</span>
                </DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem
                  onClick={handleOpenSignSheet}
                  disabled={document.status === ('SIGNED' as DocumentStatus)}
                >
                  <Signature className='mr-2 size-4' />
                  <span>E-Sign</span>
                </DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem onClick={handleCopyLink}>
                  <Copy className='mr-2 size-4' />
                  <span>Copy link</span>
                </DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem onClick={handleDownload}>
                  <Download className='mr-2 size-4' />
                  <span>Download</span>
                </DropdownMenuItem>
                {onUpdateDocumentStatus && document.status === 'ACTIVE' ? (
                  <DropdownMenuItem
                    onClick={() =>
                      onUpdateDocumentStatus(
                        document,
                        'ARCHIVED' as DocumentStatus
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    <ArchiveIcon className='mr-2 size-4' />
                    <span>Archive</span>
                  </DropdownMenuItem>
                ) : onUpdateDocumentStatus && document.status === 'ARCHIVED' ? (
                  <DropdownMenuItem
                    onClick={() =>
                      onUpdateDocumentStatus(
                        document,
                        'ACTIVE' as DocumentStatus
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    <ArchiveRestoreIcon className='mr-2 size-4' />
                    <span>Unarchive</span>
                  </DropdownMenuItem>
                ) : null}
                <DropdownMenuItem
                  onClick={() =>
                    router.push(`/account/documents/${document.id}`)
                  }
                >
                  <Info className='mr-2 size-4' />
                  <span>More Details</span>
                </DropdownMenuItem>
              </DropdownMenuContent>
            </DropdownMenu>
            {children}
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className='mt-2 line-clamp-2 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
          {document?.description || 'No description provided'}
        </p>
        {document?.tags && document?.tags?.length > 0 && (
          <div className='mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2'>
            {visibleTags.map((tag) => (
              <Badge
                key={tag}
                variant='light'
                className='flex items-center gap-1 font-normal'
              >
                <Tag className='size-3' />
                {tag}
              </Badge>
            ))}
            {extraTagsCount > 0 && (
              <Badge variant='light' className='font-normal'>
                +{extraTagsCount} more
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className='flex items-center justify-between pt-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground '>
        <div className='flex items-center gap-1'>
          <UserCircle className='size-3.5' />
          <span>{owner?.name || 'Unknown'}</span>
        </div>
        <span>
          {document.createdAt
            ? formatDistanceToNow(new Date(document.createdAt), {
                addSuffix: true
              })
            : '2h ago'}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Edit Dialog instance */}
      {document && (
        <EditDocumentDialog
          document={document}
          isOpen={isEditDialogOpen}
          onOpenChange={setIsEditDialogOpen}
          onSuccess={handleEditSuccess}
        />
      )}
      <ESignDocumentSheet
        document={document}
        isOpen={isSigningSheetOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsSigningSheetOpen}
        onSuccess={handleSignSuccess}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/documents/my-drafts/drafts-page-client.tsx ===

'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import type { DocumentCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
  getOrganizationDrafts,
  updateDraftMetadata,
  deleteDraft,
  publishDraft
} from '@/actions/document-drafts';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import PageHeader from '@/components/pages/account/page-header';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/select';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  List,
  LayoutGrid,
  Search,
  ArrowUpDown,
  Filter as FilterIcon,
  ChevronDown
} from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@signvault/ui-lib/lib/utils';
import { DraftList } from './draft-list';
import { EditDocumentDialog } from '@/app/(user)/account/documents/edit-document-dialog';
import { DraftDetailsSheet } from './draft-details-sheet';
import { createAuditLogEntry } from '@/actions/audit-logs';
import {
  AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';

type DraftsPageClientProps = {
  initialDrafts: DocumentCS[];
  currentUserDbId: string;
  currentOrganizationId: string;
};

export default function DraftsPageClient({
  initialDrafts,
  currentUserDbId,
  currentOrganizationId
}: DraftsPageClientProps) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState('updatedAt-desc');
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'grid' | 'list'>('grid');
  const [filterTag, setFilterTag] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editingDraft, setEditingDraft] = useState<DocumentCS | null>(null);
  const [viewingDraft, setViewingDraft] = useState<DocumentCS | null>(null);
  const [isEditDialogOpen, setIsEditDialogOpen] = useState(false);

  const { data: drafts = [], isLoading: isLoadingDrafts } = useQuery<
    DocumentCS[]
  >({
    queryKey: ['drafts', currentOrganizationId, currentUserDbId],
    queryFn: () =>
      getOrganizationDrafts(
        BigInt(currentOrganizationId),
        BigInt(currentUserDbId)
      ),
    initialData: initialDrafts
  });

  const updateMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({
      draftId,
      data
    }: {
      draftId: bigint;
      data: { filename?: string; description?: string; tags?: string[] };
    }) => updateDraftMetadata(draftId, data),
    onSuccess: (updatedDraft) => {
      toast.success(
        `Document "${updatedDraft.title || updatedDraft.filename}" updated successfully.`
      );
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['drafts', currentOrganizationId, currentUserDbId]
      });
      setIsEditDialogOpen(false);
      setEditingDraft(null);
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(`Failed to update document: ${error.message}`);
    }
  });

  const deleteMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: deleteDraft,
    onSuccess: async (deletedDraft) => {
      toast.success(
        `Document "${deletedDraft.title || deletedDraft.filename}" deleted successfully.`
      );
      await createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.DOCUMENT_DRAFT_DELETED,
        category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
        entityId: deletedDraft.id,
        entityType: 'document',
        entityName: deletedDraft.title || deletedDraft.filename,
        description: `User deleted uploaded document: "${deletedDraft.title || deletedDraft.filename}"`
      }).catch(console.error);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['drafts', currentOrganizationId, currentUserDbId]
      });
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(`Failed to delete document: ${error.message}`);
    }
  });

  const publishMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: publishDraft,
    onSuccess: async (publishedDocument) => {
      setViewingDraft(null);
      toast.success(
        `Document "${publishedDocument.title || publishedDocument.filename}" published successfully.`
      );
      await createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.DOCUMENT_DRAFT_PUBLISHED,
        category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
        entityId: publishedDocument.id,
        entityType: 'document',
        entityName: publishedDocument.title || publishedDocument.filename,
        description: `User published uploaded document: "${publishedDocument.title || publishedDocument.filename}"`
      }).catch(console.error);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['drafts', currentOrganizationId, currentUserDbId]
      });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['organizationDocuments', currentOrganizationId]
      });
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(`Failed to publish document: ${error.message}`);
    }
  });

  const handleEditDraft = (draft: DocumentCS) => {
    setEditingDraft(draft);
    setIsEditDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handleDeleteDraft = (draftId: bigint) => {
    deleteMutation.mutate(draftId);
  };

  const handlePublishDraft = (draftId: bigint) => {
    publishMutation.mutate(draftId);
  };

  const handleViewDraft = (draft: DocumentCS) => {
    setViewingDraft(draft);
  };

  const uniqueTags = useMemo(() => {
    const tags = new Set(drafts.flatMap((draft) => draft.tags || []));
    return Array.from(tags);
  }, [drafts]);

  const filteredAndSortedDrafts = useMemo(() => {
    return drafts
      .filter((draft) => {
        const searchLower = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
        const matchesSearch =
          (draft.title || draft.filename).toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          (draft.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          (draft.tags || []).some((tag) =>
            tag.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)
          );

        const matchesTag = !filterTag || (draft.tags || []).includes(filterTag);

        return matchesSearch && matchesTag;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        const [key, direction] = sortBy.split('-');
        let result = 0;
        switch (key) {
          case 'filename':
            result = (a.title || a.filename).localeCompare(
              b.title || b.filename
            );
            break;
          case 'updatedAt':
            result =
              new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime();
            break;
          case 'createdAt':
            result =
              new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();
            break;
        }
        return direction === 'asc' ? result : -result;
      });
  }, [drafts, searchTerm, sortBy, filterTag]);

  return (
    <div className='space-y-6'>
      <PageHeader
        heading='Uploaded Documents'
        subheading='Manage your uploaded documents before publishing.'
      />

      <div className='mb-6 flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between'>
        <div className='relative sm:w-72'>
          <Search className='absolute left-3 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground' />
          <Input
            type='search'
            placeholder='Search uploaded documents...'
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            className='pl-10'
          />
        </div>
        <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
          <Button
            variant={viewMode === 'list' ? 'secondary' : 'ghost'}
            size='icon'
            onClick={() => setViewMode('list')}
            aria-label='List view'
          >
            <List className='size-5' />
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={viewMode === 'grid' ? 'secondary' : 'ghost'}
            size='icon'
            onClick={() => setViewMode('grid')}
            aria-label='Grid view'
          >
            <LayoutGrid className='size-5' />
          </Button>
          <Select value={sortBy} onValueChange={setSortBy}>
            <SelectTrigger className='w-auto gap-1.5'>
              <ArrowUpDown className='size-4 text-muted-foreground' />
              <SelectValue placeholder='Sort by' />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
              <SelectItem value='updatedAt-desc'>Last Updated</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value='createdAt-desc'>Date Created</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value='filename-asc'>Name (A-Z)</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value='filename-desc'>Name (Z-A)</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
              <Button
                variant='outline'
                className={cn(
                  'gap-1.5',
                  filterTag && 'border-primary text-primary'
                )}
              >
                <FilterIcon className='size-4' />
                Filter
                <ChevronDown
                  className={cn(
                    'size-4 text-muted-foreground transition-transform',
                    'group-data-[state=open]:rotate-180',
                    filterTag && 'text-primary'
                  )}
                />
              </Button>
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent align='end' className='font-suisse-intl'>
              <DropdownMenuItem
                onClick={() => setFilterTag(null)}
                className={cn(!filterTag && 'bg-primary/20 font-medium')}
              >
                All Tags
              </DropdownMenuItem>
              {uniqueTags.map((tag) => (
                <DropdownMenuItem
                  key={tag}
                  onClick={() => setFilterTag(tag)}
                  className={cn(
                    filterTag === tag && 'bg-primary/20 font-medium'
                  )}
                >
                  {tag}
                </DropdownMenuItem>
              ))}
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>
        </div>
      </div>

      <DraftList
        drafts={filteredAndSortedDrafts}
        viewMode={viewMode}
        onEdit={handleEditDraft}
        onDelete={handleDeleteDraft}
        onPublish={handlePublishDraft}
        onView={handleViewDraft}
        isLoading={isLoadingDrafts}
      />

      {editingDraft && (
        <EditDocumentDialog
          isOpen={isEditDialogOpen}
          onOpenChange={setIsEditDialogOpen}
          document={editingDraft}
          onSuccess={(data) =>
            updateMutation.mutate({
              draftId: editingDraft.id,
              data
            })
          }
        />
      )}

      {viewingDraft && (
        <DraftDetailsSheet
          draft={viewingDraft}
          onClose={() => setViewingDraft(null)}
          onPublish={handlePublishDraft}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import type {
  UpdateUserCustomDataResponse,
  UpdateUserSocialProfilesResponse
} from '@signvault/backend/routes/users';

const TWITTER_CLIENT_ID = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_TWITTER_CLIENT_ID;
const TWITTER_REDIRECT_URI = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/auth/twitter/callback`;
const TWITTER_STATE = 'twitter-state';
const TWITTER_CODE_CHALLENGE = 'challenge';
const TWITTER_AUTH_URL = 'https://twitter.com/i/oauth2/authorize';
const TWITTER_SCOPE = ['tweet.read', 'users.read', 'offline.access'].join(' ');

/**
 * Add a personal access token for a user.
 * @param {string} userId - The unique identifier of the user.
 * @param {string} name - The name of the token.
 * @param {number} [expiresAt] - The expiration time of the token.
 * @returns {Promise<any>} The created personal access token.
 */
export async function addUserPersonalAccessToken(
  userId: string,
  name: string,
  expiresAt?: number
) {
  return makeApiRequest(`/users/${userId}/personal-access-tokens`, 'POST', {
    name,
    expiresAt
  });
}

/**
 * Assign roles to a user.
 * @param {string} userId - The unique identifier of the user.
 * @param {string[]} roleIds - The IDs of the roles to assign.
 * @returns {Promise<any>} The result of the assignment.
 */
export async function assignRolesToUser(userId: string, roleIds: string[]) {
  return makeApiRequest(`/users/${userId}/roles`, 'POST', {
    roleIds
  });
}

/**
 * Connect Twitter account.
 * @returns {Promise<string>} The Twitter authorization URL.
 */
export async function connectTwitterAccount() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    response_type: 'code',
    client_id: TWITTER_CLIENT_ID,
    redirect_uri: TWITTER_REDIRECT_URI,
    scope: TWITTER_SCOPE,
    state: TWITTER_STATE,
    code_challenge: TWITTER_CODE_CHALLENGE,
    code_challenge_method: 'plain'
  });

  return `${TWITTER_AUTH_URL}?${params.toString()}`;
}

/**
 * Create an MFA verification for a user.
 * @param {string} userId - The unique identifier of the user.
 * @param {'Totp' | 'BackupCode'} type - The type of MFA verification.
 * @returns {Promise<any>} The created MFA verification.
 */
export async function createUserMfaVerification(

) {
  return makeApiRequest(`/users/${userId}/mfa-verifications`, 'POST', { type });

/**
 * Disconnect Twitter account for a user.
 * @param {string} userId - The unique identifier of the user.
 * @param {string} cookieString - The cookie string.
 * @returns {Promise<boolean>} The result of the disconnection.
 */
export async function disconnectTwitterAccount(
  userId: string | bigint,
  cookieString: string,
  existingTwitterData: object
): Promise<boolean> {
  const customDataResponse: UpdateUserCustomDataResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users/${userId}/custom-data`,
    {
      method: 'PATCH',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        customData: {
          twitter: {
            ...existingTwitterData,
            connected: false
          }
        }
      }),
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (customDataResponse.message !== 'User custom data updated successfully') {
    return false;
  }

  const updateSocialProfilesResponse: UpdateUserSocialProfilesResponse =
    await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users/${userId}/social-profiles?overwrite=false`,
      {
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: JSON.stringify({ socialProfiles: { twitter: null } }),
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'cookie': cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString
        }
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (
    updateSocialProfilesResponse.message !==
    'User social profiles updated successfully'
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  return true;
}

/**
 * Make an API request to the Logto user API.
 * @param {string} endpoint - The API endpoint.
 * @param {'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE'} [method='GET'] - The HTTP method.
 * @param {object} [body] - The request body.
 * @returns {Promise<any>} The API response.
 * @throws {Error} If the API request fails.
 */
async function makeApiRequest<T>(
  endpoint: string,
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE' = 'GET',
  body?: object
): Promise<T> {
  const url = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/logto/management/${endpoint}`;
  const options: RequestInit = {
    method,
    headers:
      method !== 'GET' ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : undefined,
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined
  };

  const response = await fetch(url, options);

  if (!response.ok) {
    console.error('API request failed:', response.statusText);
    console.error('API request failed:', response);
  }

  if (method === 'DELETE') {
    return undefined;
  }

  try {
    return (await response.json()) as T;
  } catch (error) {
    if (
      error instanceof TypeError &&
      error.message.includes('Body is unusable')
    ) {
      console.warn('Response body has already been consumed');
      return null;
    }
    console.error('Error parsing API response:', error);
    throw error;
  }
}

import { addToWaitlist } from '@/actions/waitlist';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { ArrowRight, InfoIcon, Loader2, User, Building } from 'lucide-react'; // Added User and Building icons

const MotionButton = motion.create(Button);

export function WaitlistDialog({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const { totalUsers, fetchTotalUsers } = useWaitlist();
  const { isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [formState, setFormState] = useState({
    name: '',
    email: '',
    type: 'INDIVIDUAL' as 'INDIVIDUAL' | 'BUSINESS'
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTotalUsers();
  }, [fetchTotalUsers]);

  const handleChange = (
    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement> // Removed HTMLSelectElement as Select is no longer used
  ) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormState((prev) => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
  };

  const handleTypeChange = (value: 'INDIVIDUAL' | 'BUSINESS') => {
    // Renamed for clarity
    setFormState((prev) => ({ ...prev, type: value }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await addToWaitlist(formState);
      if (result.success) {
        toast.success(
          'You have been added to the public waitlist! You will receive an email with more information shortly.'
        );
        setOpen(false);
        setFormState({ name: '', email: '', type: 'INDIVIDUAL' });
      } else {
        toast.error(result.error || 'An error occurred.');
      }
    } catch (_error) {
      toast.error('Failed to join the waitlist.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild disabled={isAuthenticated}>
        {children}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent className='p-0 font-suisse-intl'>
        <MagicCard
          gradientFrom='var(--line)'
          gradientTo='var(--primary)'
          gradientColor='var(--line)'
          gradientOpacity={0.3}
          gradientSize={264}
        >
          <div className='p-6'>
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle className='text-xl'>
                Join the Beta Waitlist
              </DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className='mt-1!'>
                Get early access to SignVault and help shape its future.
                <br />
                {totalUsers > 0 && (
                  <>
                    {totalUsers}+ people have already joined SignVault from the
                    waitlist.
                  </>
                )}
              </DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
