import { type Metadata } from 'next';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import OrganizationUserPage from './organization-user-page';
import type {
  GetAllOrganizationsResponse,
  GetOrganizationResponse,
  GetOrganizationUsersResponse
} from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organizations';
import type { GetUserResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/users';
import type { GetOrganizationRolesForAUserResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organization-roles';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getErrorRedirect,
  getRandomUUID
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';

export const revalidate = 60;
export const dynamicParams = true;

export async function generateStaticParams() {
  const logger = getServerLogger(getRandomUUID(), 'organization-user-ssg');
  try {
    logger.info('Generating static params for organization user');

    const organizationsResponse: GetAllOrganizationsResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations?bypassToken=${process.env.BYPASS_TOKEN}`,
      {
        method: 'GET'
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());

    if (
      organizationsResponse.message !== 'Organizations retrieved successfully'
    ) {
      logger.error('Error fetching organizations', {
        organizationsResponse
      });
      return [];
    }

    const organizations =
      organizationsResponse.organizations.logto ??
      organizationsResponse.organizations.database ??
      [];

    const params = [];

    for (const org of organizations) {
      const usersResponse: GetOrganizationUsersResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${org.id}/users?bypassToken=${process.env.BYPASS_TOKEN}`,
        {
          method: 'GET'
        }
      ).then((res) => res.json());

      if (
        usersResponse.message !== 'Organization users retrieved successfully'
      ) {
        logger.error('Error fetching organization users', {
          usersResponse
        });
        continue;
      }

      const users =
        usersResponse.users.logto ?? usersResponse.users.database ?? [];

      for (const user of users) {
        params.push({
          organizationId: org.id,
          userId: user.id
        });
      }
    }

    logger.info('Generated static params for organization user', {
      totalOrganizations: organizations.length,
      totalUsers: params.length
    });

    return params;
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error generating static params for organization user', {
      error
    });
    return [];
  }
}

export async function generateMetadata(props: {
  params: Promise<{
    organizationId: string;
    userId: string;
  }>;
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const params = await props.params;
  const cookiesStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookiesStore);
  const { organizationId, userId } = params;
  const logger = getServerLogger(getRandomUUID(), 'organization-user-metadata');

  logger.info('Generating metadata for organization user', {
    organizationId,
    userId
  });

  const organizationDetailsResponse: GetOrganizationResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}?bypassToken=${process.env.BYPASS_TOKEN}&organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (
    organizationDetailsResponse.message !==
    'Organization retrieved successfully'
  ) {
    logger.error('Error fetching organization details', {
      organizationDetailsResponse
    });
    return {};
  }

  const organizationDetails =
    organizationDetailsResponse.organization.logto ??
    organizationDetailsResponse.organization.database ??
    null;

  if (!organizationDetails) {
    logger.error('Organization details not found', {
      organizationDetailsResponse
    });
    return {
      title: 'Organization not found',
      description: 'Organization not found'
    };
  }

  const userResponse: GetUserResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/users/${userId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (userResponse.message !== 'User retrieved successfully') {
    logger.error('Error fetching user details', {
      userResponse
    });
    return {};
  }

  const user = userResponse.user.database ?? userResponse.user.logto ?? null;

  if (!user) {
    logger.error('User details not found', {
      userResponse
    });
    return {
      title: 'User not found',
      description: 'User not found'
    };
  }

  const title = `${user.name} - User Details in ${organizationDetails.name}`;
  const description = `Manage user details and roles for ${user.name} in ${organizationDetails.name} organization. Secure and efficient user management with SignVault.`;

  return {
    title,
    description,
    keywords: [
      'SignVault',
      'user management',
      'user roles',
      'user permissions',
      'organization member',
      'identity access management',
      'enterprise security',
      organizationDetails.name,
      user.name
    ],
    openGraph: {
      title,
      description,
      url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/organizations/${organizationId}/users/${userId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
      siteName: 'SignVault',
      images: [
        {
          url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`,
          width: 1200,
          height: 630
        }
      ],
      locale: 'en_US',
      type: 'website'
    },
    twitter: {
      card: 'summary_large_image',
      title,
      description,
      images: [`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`]
    }
  };
}

export default async function OrganizationUserPageWrapper({
  params
}: Readonly<{
  params: { organizationId: string; userId: string };
}>) {
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'organization-user');
  const { organizationId, userId } = await params;
  const cookiesStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookiesStore);

  logger.info('Accessing organization user page', {
    organizationId,
    userId
  });

  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

  if (!claims) {
    logger.warn('User not authenticated', {
      organizationId,
      userId
    });
    return redirect('/');
  }

  logger.info('Fetching user and organization data', {
    organizationId,
    userId
  });

  const [organizationResponse, userResponse, userRolesResponse] =
    await Promise.all([
      fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookiesStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookiesStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          }
        }
      ),
      fetch(`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/users/${userId}`, {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookiesStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookiesStore.toString()
            : cookieString
        }
      }),
      fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-roles/${organizationId}/users/${userId}/roles?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookiesStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookiesStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          }
        }
      )
    ]);

  const [organization, user, userRoles]: [
    GetOrganizationResponse,
    GetUserResponse,
    GetOrganizationRolesForAUserResponse
  ] = await Promise.all([
    organizationResponse.json(),
    userResponse.json(),
    userRolesResponse.json()
  ]);

  logger.info('User and organization data fetched', {
    organizationId,
    userId,
    hasOrganization: !!organization.organization,
    hasUser: !!user.user,
    rolesCount: userRoles?.roles?.length || 0
  });

  if (organization.message !== 'Organization retrieved successfully') {
    logger.error('Organization not found', {
      organizationId,
      userId,
      hasOrganization: !!organization.organization,
      hasUser: !!user.user
    });
    console.error('Error in organization', organization);
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organizations',
        'Organization not found',
        'The organization you are looking for does not exist.'
      )
    );
  }

  if (user.message !== 'User retrieved successfully') {
    logger.error('User not found', {
      organizationId,
      userId,
      hasOrganization: !!organization.organization,
      hasUser: !!user.user
    });
    console.error('Error in user', user);
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organizations',
        'User not found',
        'The organization user you are looking for does not exist.'
      )
    );
  }

  if (userRoles.message !== 'Organization roles retrieved successfully') {
    logger.error('User roles not found', {
      organizationId,
      userId,
      hasOrganization: !!organization.organization,
      hasUser: !!user.user
    });
    console.error('Error in user roles', userRoles);
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations`,
        'User roles not found',
        'The user roles you are looking for do not exist.'
      )
    );
  }

  return (
    <OrganizationUserPage
      cookieString={cookieString}
      user={user.user}
      organizationDetails={organization.organization}
      userRoles={userRoles.roles}
    />
  );
}

import { TeamMemberStatus } from '@signvault/db/types';

import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/label';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/select';
import { MultiSelect } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/multi-select';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { format } from 'date-fns';

type AttendeesListProps = {
  event: GetTeamCalendarEventResponse['event']['database'];
  teamMembers: GetTeamMembersResponse['members'];
  organizationId: string;
  teamId: string;
  canManageEvent: boolean;
  cookieString: string;
  user: IdTokenClaims & { id: string };
}

function getBadgeClassName(status: TeamMemberStatus) {
  switch (status) {
    case TeamMemberStatus.ACTIVE:
      return 'bg-green-500/10 text-green-500 border-green-500/30';
    case TeamMemberStatus.PENDING:
      return 'bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-500 border-yellow-500/30';
    case TeamMemberStatus.INACTIVE:
      return 'bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-500 border-orange-500/30';
    case TeamMemberStatus.BLOCKED:
      return 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 border-red-500/30';
    default:
      return 'bg-gray-500/10 text-gray-500 border-gray-500/30';
  }
}

export function AttendeesList({
  event,
  teamMembers,
  organizationId,
  teamId,
  canManageEvent,
  cookieString,
  user
}: Readonly<AttendeesListProps>) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<TeamMemberStatus | 'ALL'>(
    'ALL'
  );
  const [selectedAttendees] = useState<string[]>(
    event.attendees?.map((attendee) => attendee.userId) || []
  );

  // Filter attendees based on search and status
  const filteredAttendees = event.attendees?.filter((attendee) => {
    const matchesSearch =
      !search ||
      attendee.user?.name?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      attendee.user?.primaryEmail?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());

    const matchesStatus =
      statusFilter === 'ALL' || attendee.status === statusFilter;

    return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
  });

  // Get available team members (not already attendees)
  const availableTeamMembers = teamMembers.filter(
    (member) =>
      !event.attendees?.some((attendee) => attendee.userId === member.user?.id)
  );

  const handleAddAttendees = async (newAttendeeIds: string[]) => {
    try {
      const addedAttendeeIds = newAttendeeIds.filter(
        (id) => !selectedAttendees.includes(id)
      );

      for (const attendeeId of addedAttendeeIds) {
        const response = await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-calendar-events/${event.id}/attendees?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'cookie': cookieString,
              'cookie-string': cookieString
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              eventId: event.id,
              organizationId,
              userId: attendeeId,
              status: TeamMemberStatus.PENDING,
              addedBy: user.id
            })
          }
        );

        if (!response.ok) {
          const error = await response.json();
          clientLogger.error('Failed to add attendee', {
            eventId: event.id,
            attendeeId,
            error
          });
          toast.error(`Failed to add attendee`);
        }
      }

      // Refresh the page to show updated attendees
      window.location.reload();
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error('Error adding attendees', {
        eventId: event.id,
        error
      });
      toast.error('Failed to add attendees');
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveAttendee = async (attendeeId: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-calendar-events/${event.id}/attendees/${attendeeId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          }
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        const error = await response.json();
        clientLogger.error('Failed to remove attendee', {
          eventId: event.id,
          attendeeId,
          error
        });
        toast.error('Failed to remove attendee');
        return;
      }

      // Refresh the page to show updated attendees
      window.location.reload();
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error('Error removing attendee', {
        eventId: event.id,
        attendeeId,
        error
      });
      toast.error('Failed to remove attendee');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className='container mx-auto space-y-6 py-6'>
      <div>
        <div className='mb-8 flex items-center gap-4'>
          <Link
            href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}/events/${event.id}`}
          >
            <Button
              variant='outline'
              className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
            >
              <ChevronLeft className='h-4 w-4' />
              Back to Event
            </Button>
          </Link>
        </div>
        <h1 className='text-2xl font-bold'>{event.title} - Attendees</h1>
        <p className='mt-2 text-muted-foreground'>
          {format(new Date(event.startDate), 'PPp')} -{' '}
          {format(new Date(event.endDate), 'PPp')}
        </p>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader className='flex flex-row items-center justify-between'>
          <CardTitle>Manage Attendees</CardTitle>
          <Badge variant='outline'>
            {event.attendees?.length || 0} attendee
            {event.attendees?.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
          </Badge>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className='space-y-6'>
          {canManageEvent && (
            <div className='space-y-2'>
              <Label>Add Attendees</Label>
              <MultiSelect
                options={availableTeamMembers.map((member) => ({
                  label: member.user?.name || 'Unknown User',
                  value: member.user?.id || ''
                }))}
                onValueChange={handleAddAttendees}
                placeholder='Select team members to add'
              />
            </div>
          )}

          <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2'>
            <div className='space-y-2'>
              <Label>Search</Label>
              <Input
                placeholder='Search by name or email'
                value={search}
                onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>

            <div className='space-y-2'>
              <Label>Filter by Status</Label>
              <Select
                value={statusFilter}
                onValueChange={(value) =>
                  setStatusFilter(value as TeamMemberStatus | 'ALL')
                }
              >
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue placeholder='Select status' />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value='ALL'>All Statuses</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value={TeamMemberStatus.ACTIVE}>
                    Active
                  </SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value={TeamMemberStatus.PENDING}>
                    Pending
                  </SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value={TeamMemberStatus.INACTIVE}>
                    Inactive
                  </SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value={TeamMemberStatus.BLOCKED}>
                    Blocked
                  </SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className='space-y-4'>
            {filteredAttendees && filteredAttendees.length > 0 ? (
              filteredAttendees.map((attendee) => (
                <div
                  key={attendee.id}
                  className='flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-4'
                >
                  <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
                    <Avatar>
                      <AvatarImage
                        src={attendee.user?.avatar || '/default-avatar.png'}
                        alt={attendee.user?.name || 'Unknown'}
                      />
                      <AvatarFallback>
                        {attendee.user?.name?.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase() || '??'}
                      </AvatarFallback>
                    </Avatar>
                    <div>
                      <p className='font-medium'>
                        {attendee.user?.name || 'Unknown User'}
                      </p>
                      <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                        {attendee.user?.primaryEmail || 'No email'}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
                    <Badge
                      variant='outline'
                      className={getBadgeClassName(
                        attendee.status as TeamMemberStatus
                      )}
                    >
                      {attendee.status}
                    </Badge>
                    {canManageEvent && (
                      <Button
                        variant='outline'
                        size='sm'
                        className='text-red-500 hover:text-red-600'
                        onClick={() => handleRemoveAttendee(attendee.userId)}
                      >
                        Remove
                      </Button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))
            ) : (
              <p className='py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground'>
                No attendees found.
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

export function AssignActiveTeamDialog({
  adminIds,
  userId,
  organizationId,
  teamTemplates
}: Readonly<{
  adminIds: (string | bigint)[];
  organizationId?: string | bigint;
  teamTemplates: TeamTemplate[];
  userId?: string | bigint;
}>) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [, setSelectedTab] = useState<'template' | 'custom'>('template');
  const [selectedTemplate, setSelectedTemplate] = useState<TeamTemplate | null>(
    null
  );
  const [selectedCustomTeam, setSelectedCustomTeam] =
    useState<CustomTeamWithMembersCS | null>(null);

  const { data: customTeams, isLoading: isLoadingCustomTeams } = useCustomTeams(
    organizationId || ''
  );

  const handleTabChange = (value: string) => {
    setSelectedTab(value as 'template' | 'custom');
    setSelectedTemplate(null);
    setSelectedCustomTeam(null);
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    setSelectedTemplate(null);
    setSelectedCustomTeam(null);
  };

  const isLoading = isLoadingCustomTeams;

  return (
    <Dialog
      onOpenChange={(isOpen) => {
        setOpen(isOpen);
        if (!isOpen) handleClose();
      }}
      open={open}
    >
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
          size='sm'
          variant='default'
        >
          <Plus className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
          Assign Active Team
        </Button>
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent className='max-h-[90vh] max-w-full overflow-y-auto font-suisse-intl xs:w-[480px] sm:w-[540px] md:w-[600px] lg:w-[660px] xl:w-[720px]'>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className='text-xl font-semibold'>
            Assign Active Team
          </DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>

        {isLoading ? (
          <div className='flex size-full items-center justify-center py-8'>
            <Loader2 className='size-6 animate-spin' />
          </div>
        ) : (
          userId &&
          organizationId && (
            <Tabs
              className='w-full'
              defaultValue='template'
              onValueChange={handleTabChange}
            >
              <TabsList className='mb-6 grid w-full grid-cols-2'>
                <TabsTrigger
                  className='flex items-center gap-2'
                  value='template'
                >
                  <LayoutTemplate className='size-4' />
                  Choose From A Template
                </TabsTrigger>
                <TabsTrigger className='flex items-center gap-2' value='custom'>
                  <BriefcaseBusiness className='size-4' />
                  Choose From A Custom Team
                </TabsTrigger>
              </TabsList>

              <TabsContent value='template'>
                {!selectedTemplate ? (
                  <div className='flex max-h-[452px] flex-col gap-4 overflow-y-auto'>
                    <p className='text-balance text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                      Select a template to inherit and add to your active teams.
                      Scroll through the list below to view all the available
                      templates.
                    </p>
                    {teamTemplates && teamTemplates.length > 0 ? (
                      <div className='divide-y divide-line rounded-lg border border-line'>
                        {teamTemplates.map((template, index) => (

                              'cursor-pointer overflow-hidden p-4 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out sm:p-6',
                              'hover:bg-secondary/50',
                              index === 0 && 'rounded-t-lg',
                              index === teamTemplates.length - 1 &&
                                'rounded-b-lg'
                            )}
                            key={template.id}
                            onClick={() => setSelectedTemplate(template)}
                            onKeyDown={(e) => {
                              if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                                setSelectedTemplate(template);

                            role='button'

                      organizationId={organizationId}

              </TabsContent>

              <TabsContent value='custom'>
                {!selectedCustomTeam ? (
                  <div className='flex max-h-[452px] flex-col gap-4 overflow-y-auto'>
                    <p className='text-balance text-sm text-muted-foreground'>

                        {customTeams.map((customTeam, index) => (

                              'cursor-pointer overflow-hidden p-4 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out sm:p-6',

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/form-templates/publish-template-dialog.tsx ===

'use client';

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type {
  CustomDocumentTemplateCS,
  DocumentTemplate,
  UserCS
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipTrigger,
  TooltipContent
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/tooltip';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogClose
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { Loader2, Copy, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { publishTemplateLink } from '@signvault/frontend/actions/document-templates';
import { useCopyToClipboard } from '@signvault/frontend/hooks/use-copy-to-clipboard';
import { useUserData } from '@/contexts/user-data-context';
import { sendTemplateShareEmail } from '@/actions/email';
import {
  Avatar,
  AvatarFallback,
  AvatarImage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/avatar';

type PublishTemplateDialogProps = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  template: DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS | null;
  organizationId: string | null;
  isPublicLink?: boolean;
};

export function PublishTemplateDialog({
  isOpen,
  onOpenChange,
  template,
  organizationId,
  isPublicLink = false
}: Readonly<PublishTemplateDialogProps>) {
  const { isCopied, copy } = useCopyToClipboard();
  const { organizationData, organizationMembers } = useUserData();
  const currentUser = organizationData?.user;

  // how many days until the link expires
  const [expiry, setExpiry] = useState<number>(1);
  const [sendingStates, setSendingStates] = useState<
    Record<string, 'idle' | 'sending' | 'sent'>
  >({});

  const otherMembers = useMemo(() => {
    if (!currentUser || !organizationMembers) return [];
    return organizationMembers
      .filter((member) => member.id !== currentUser.id)
      .slice(0, 3);
  }, [currentUser, organizationMembers]);

  const {
    mutate: generateLink,
    data: linkData,
    isPending,
    error,
    reset
  } = useMutation<{ shortId: string }, Error, number>({
    // take expiry days as mutation variable
    mutationFn: (expiresInDays: number) => {
      if (!template || !organizationId) {
        throw new Error('Template or Organization ID is missing.');
      }
      return publishTemplateLink(
        template.id,
        BigInt(organizationId),
        expiresInDays,
        isPublicLink || false
      );
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success('Shareable link created!');
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      toast.error(`Failed to create link: ${err.message}`);
    }
  });

  // Reset state when dialog opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      reset();
      setExpiry(1);
      setSendingStates({});
    }
  }, [isOpen, reset]);

  const shareableLink = linkData?.shortId
    ? `${window.location.origin}/account/form-templates/t/${linkData.shortId}`
    : '';

  const handleGenerateLink = () => {
    generateLink(expiry);
  };

  const handleSendEmail = async (recipient: UserCS) => {
    if (!shareableLink || !template || !currentUser) return;
    setSendingStates((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [recipient.id!.toString()]: 'sending'
    }));
    try {
      await sendTemplateShareEmail({
        recipient,
        senderName: currentUser.name || 'A team member',
        templateName: template.name,
        shareLink: shareableLink
      });
      toast.success(`Invitation sent to ${recipient.name}`);
      setSendingStates((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [recipient.id!.toString()]: 'sent'
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to send invitation.');
      setSendingStates((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [recipient.id!.toString()]: 'idle'
      }));
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent
        aria-describedby='publish-template-dialog-description'
        className='max-w-lg font-suisse-intl'
      >
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Share Template: {template?.name}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Configure link settings and share this template with your
            organization members.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className='space-y-4'>
          {/* Link Expiry Controls */}
          <div className='space-y-2'>
            <h4 className='text-sm font-medium'>Link Expiry</h4>
            <div className='flex flex-wrap gap-2'>
              <Button
                className='px-4'
                size='sm'
                variant={expiry === 1 ? 'default' : 'secondary'}
                onClick={() => setExpiry(1)}
                disabled={isPending}
              >
                1 Day
              </Button>
              <Button
                className='px-4'
                size='sm'
                variant={expiry === 3 ? 'default' : 'secondary'}
                onClick={() => setExpiry(3)}
                disabled={isPending}
              >
                3 Days
              </Button>
              <Button
                className='px-4'
                size='sm'
                variant={expiry === 7 ? 'default' : 'secondary'}
                onClick={() => setExpiry(7)}
                disabled={isPending}
              >
                7 Days
              </Button>
              <Tooltip>
                <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                  <Button
                    size='sm'
                    variant='outline'
                    disabled
                    className='pointer-events-none cursor-not-allowed px-4'
                  >
                    Unlimited
                  </Button>
                </TooltipTrigger>
                <TooltipContent>
                  <p>Upgrade to Pro plan</p>
                </TooltipContent>
              </Tooltip>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Loading State */}
          {isPending && (
            <div className='flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 py-6'>
              <Loader2 className='size-6 animate-spin text-primary' />
              <p className='text-muted-foreground'>Generating link...</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Error State */}
          {error && (
            <div className='space-y-2 text-center'>
              <p className='text-sm text-destructive'>Error: {error.message}</p>
              <Button variant='outline' onClick={() => generateLink(expiry)}>
                Retry
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Success State - Generated Link */}
          {shareableLink && (
            <div className='space-y-4'>
              <div className='space-y-2'>
                <h4 className='text-sm font-medium'>Shareable Link</h4>
                <div className='flex items-center space-x-2'>
                  <Input value={shareableLink} readOnly className='flex-1' />
                  <Button
                    size='icon'
                    variant='outline'
                    onClick={() => copy(shareableLink)}
                  >
                    {isCopied ? (
                      <Check className='size-4 text-green-500' />
                    ) : (
                      <Copy className='size-4' />
                    )}
                    <span className='sr-only'>Copy link</span>
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Organization Members Section */}
              {otherMembers.length > 0 && (
                <div className='space-y-2'>
                  <h4 className='text-sm font-medium'>
                    Share With Organization Members
                  </h4>

                            <AvatarImage
                              src={member.avatar ?? undefined}
                              alt={member.name ?? ''}
                            />
                            <AvatarFallback className='text-xs'>
                              {member.name?.[0]}
                            </AvatarFallback>
                          </Avatar>
                          <div className='min-w-0 flex-1'>
                            <p className='truncate text-sm font-medium'>
                              {member.name}
                            </p>
                            <p className='truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                              {member.primaryEmail}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <Button
                          size='sm'
                          onClick={() => handleSendEmail(member)}
                          disabled={
                            sendingStates[member.id!.toString()] ===
                              'sending' ||
                            sendingStates[member.id!.toString()] === 'sent'
                          }
                        >
                          {sendingStates[member.id!.toString()] ===
                            'sending' && (
                            <Loader2 className='mr-2 size-4 animate-spin' />
                          )}
                          {sendingStates[member.id!.toString()] === 'sent'
                            ? 'Sent'
                            : 'Send'}
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <DialogFooter>
          {/* Generate Link Section */}
          <DialogClose asChild>
            <Button type='button' variant='secondary' size='sm'>
              Close
            </Button>
          </DialogClose>
          {!linkData && !isPending && !error && (
            <div className='space-y-2'>
              <Button size='sm' onClick={handleGenerateLink}>
                Generate Shareable Link
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );

'use server';

import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import {
  documentsCS,
  usersCS,
  type DocumentCS
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_';
import { eq, and } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import {
  GetObjectCommand,
  PutObjectCommand,
  S3Client
} from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { AzureKeyVaultService } from '@signvault/pdf-sign/src/infrastructure/services/azure-keyvault.service';
import { KeyVaultSigner } from '@signvault/pdf-sign/src/sign/signers/keyvault.signer';
import { sign } from '@signvault/pdf-sign/src/sign/sign';
import type { SignatureOptions } from '@signvault/pdf-sign/src/sign/interfaces/signature-options.interface';
import type { DocumentStatus } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';
import crypto from 'crypto';
import {
  signatureRequestsCS,
  type UserCS
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_';
import { ROLES } from '@signvault/logto/types';
import { AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS } from '@signvault/core-lib/index';
import { headers } from 'next/headers';
import { getDbUser } from './auth';

async function getFileBuffer(s3Key: string): Promise<Buffer> {
  const s3Client = new S3Client({
    region: process.env.S3_REGION,
    credentials: {
      accessKeyId: process.env.S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID as string,
      secretAccessKey: process.env.S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY as string
    }
  });
  const bucketName = process.env.S3_BUCKET;

  const command = new GetObjectCommand({
    Bucket: bucketName,
    Key: s3Key
  });

  const response = await s3Client.send(command);
  const stream = response.Body;

  if (!stream) {
    throw new Error('Failed to download file from S3.');
  }

  return Buffer.from(await stream.transformToByteArray());
}

// Add permission check helper
async function canSignDocument(
  user: UserCS,
  document: DocumentCS
): Promise<boolean> {
  // a. Super admins
  if (
    AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS.includes(
      user.id.toString() as (typeof AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS)[number]
    )
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // b. Organization-wide admins
  // b.1. Organization creator
  if (user.isCreator && document.organizationId === user.organizationId) {
    return true;
  }
  // b.2. Organization admins
  if (user.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id) {
    return true;
  }
  // c. Document owner
  if (document.ownerId === user.id) {
    return true;
  }
  // d. Valid signature request exists
  const request = await db.query.signatureRequestsCS.findFirst({
    where: and(
      eq(signatureRequestsCS.documentId, document.id),
      eq(signatureRequestsCS.receiverId, user.id)
    )
  });

  if (request) {
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export async function eSignDocument(
  documentId: bigint,
  userSignatureOptions: Pick<
    SignatureOptions,
    | 'reason'
    | 'pageNumber'
    | 'xPosition'
    | 'yPosition'
    | 'width'
    | 'height'
    | 'fontSize'
    | 'pageMargin'
  >
) {
  // 1. Get user and document details
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  if (!claims?.sub) {
    throw new Error('User not authenticated.');
  }

  const user = await db.query.usersCS.findFirst({
    where: eq(usersCS.logtoId, claims.sub)
  });

  if (!user) {
    throw new Error('User not found in database.');
  }

  const document = await db.query.documentsCS.findFirst({
    where: eq(documentsCS.id, documentId)
  });

  if (!document || !document.s3Key) {
    throw new Error('Document not found or does not have a valid S3 key.');
  }

  // permission check
  if (!(await canSignDocument(user, document))) {
    throw new Error('User not authorized to sign this document.');
  }

  // 2. Download PDF from S3
  const pdfBuffer = await getFileBuffer(document.s3Key);

  // 3. Prepare signature options with dynamic location
  // Determine signer location via IP
  let location = 'Unknown';
  const hdrs = await headers();
  const forwardedFor = hdrs.get('x-forwarded-for') || '';
  const ip = forwardedFor.split(',')[0]?.trim();
  if (ip) {
    try {
      const geoRes = await fetch(
        `http://ip-api.com/json/${ip}?fields=status,city,regionName,country`
      );
      const geo = await geoRes.json();
      if (geo.status === 'success') {
        location = `${geo.city}, ${geo.regionName}, ${geo.country}`;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch geolocation:', error);
    }
  }

  const signatureOptions: SignatureOptions = {
    name: user.name || 'Unnamed User',
    location,
    contact: user.primaryEmail || '',
    ...userSignatureOptions
  };

  // 4. Sign the document using Azure Key Vault
  const azureKeyVaultConfig = {
    vaultName: process.env.AZURE_VAULT_NAME as string,
    certificateName: process.env.AZURE_CERT_NAME as string,
    tenantId: process.env.AZURE_TENANT_ID as string,
    clientId: process.env.AZURE_CLIENT_ID as string,
    clientSecret: process.env.AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET as string
  };

  if (!azureKeyVaultConfig.vaultName || !azureKeyVaultConfig.certificateName) {
    throw new Error('E-signing service is currently unavailable.');
  }

  const keyVaultService = new AzureKeyVaultService(azureKeyVaultConfig);
  const cryptoClient = await keyVaultService.getCyptopgraphyClient();
  const fullchain = await keyVaultService.getCertificateFullChain();
  const signer = new KeyVaultSigner(cryptoClient, fullchain);

  const signedPdfBuffer = await sign(pdfBuffer, signer, signatureOptions);

  // 5. Upload signed PDF back to S3
  const s3Client = new S3Client({
    region: process.env.S3_REGION,
    credentials: {
      accessKeyId: process.env.S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID as string,
      secretAccessKey: process.env.S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY as string
    }
  });
  const bucketName = process.env.S3_BUCKET;

  const newHash = crypto
    .createHash('sha256')
    .update(signedPdfBuffer)
    .digest('hex');
  const newFileSize = BigInt(signedPdfBuffer.length);

  const command = new PutObjectCommand({
    Bucket: bucketName,
    Key: document.s3Key, // Overwriting the original file
    Body: signedPdfBuffer,
    ContentType: document.mimeType
  });

  await s3Client.send(command);

  // 6. Update document record in the database
  const [updatedDocument] = await db
    .update(documentsCS)
    .set({
      status: 'SIGNED' as DocumentStatus,
      hash: newHash,
      fileSize: newFileSize,
      updatedAt: new Date(),
      lastModifiedAt: new Date()
    } as Partial<DocumentCS>)
    .where(eq(documentsCS.id, documentId))
    .returning();

  return updatedDocument;
}

/**
 * Add or update a saved signature for the currently authenticated user.
 * If `isDefault` is true, mark all other signatures as non-default.
 */
export async function saveUserSignature(
  signature: Omit<UserSavedSignature, 'id' | 'createdAt'> & { id?: string }
) {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
  if (!dbUser?.id) throw new Error('User not found');

  const current = await getUserById(String(dbUser.id));
  if (current.code !== 'user.found' || !current.user)
    throw new Error('User not found');

  // Validate payload to avoid saving non-serializable values
  if (signature.type === 'typed') {
    if (!signature.text?.value || typeof signature.text.value !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('Typed signature requires a text value');
    }
  } else if (signature.type === 'drawn' || signature.type === 'uploaded') {
    const urlCandidate = signature.image?.url as unknown;
    if (typeof urlCandidate !== 'string' || urlCandidate.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Signature image URL missing or invalid');
    }
  }

  const now = new Date();
  const newSig: UserSavedSignature = {
    id: signature.id ?? nanoid(12),
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
    isDefault: signature.isDefault ?? false,
    type: signature.type,
    text: signature.type === 'typed' ? signature.text : undefined,
    image:
      signature.type === 'drawn' || signature.type === 'uploaded'
        ? signature.image
        : undefined
  };

  let updated = Array.isArray(current.user.savedSignatures)
    ? [...current.user.savedSignatures]
    : [];

  const existingIndex = updated.findIndex((s) => s.id === newSig.id);
  if (existingIndex >= 0) {
    updated[existingIndex] = {
      ...updated[existingIndex],
      ...newSig,
      updatedAt: now
    };
  } else {
    updated.push(newSig);
  }

  if (newSig.isDefault) {
    updated = updated.map((s) => ({ ...s, isDefault: s.id === newSig.id }));
  }

  const userIdBigInt = toBigInt(dbUser.id);

  const [res] = await db
    .update(usersCS)
    .set({
      savedSignatures: updated
    } as Partial<UserCS>)
    .where(eq(usersCS.id, userIdBigInt))
    .returning();

  return res ? res[0]?.savedSignatures : updated;
}

export async function deleteUserSignature(signatureId: string) {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
  if (!dbUser?.id) throw new Error('User not found');

  const current = await getUserById(String(dbUser.id));
  if (current.code !== 'user.found' || !current.user)
    throw new Error('User not found');

  const updated = (current.user.savedSignatures ?? []).filter(
    (s) => s.id !== signatureId
  );
  const userIdBigInt = toBigInt(dbUser.id);
  const [res] = await db
    .update(usersCS)
    .set({
      savedSignatures: updated
    } as Partial<UserCS>)
    .where(eq(usersCS.id, userIdBigInt))
    .returning();

  if (!res) throw new Error('Failed to delete signature');
  return res ? res[0]?.savedSignatures : updated;
}

export async function setDefaultUserSignature(signatureId: string) {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
  if (!dbUser?.id) throw new Error('User not found');

  const current = await getUserById(String(dbUser.id));
  if (current.code !== 'user.found' || !current.user)
    throw new Error('User not found');

  const updated = (current.user.savedSignatures ?? []).map((s) => ({
    ...s,
    isDefault: s.id === signatureId
  }));

  const userIdBigInt = toBigInt(dbUser.id);
  const [res] = await db
    .update(usersCS)
    .set({
      savedSignatures: updated
    } as Partial<UserCS>)
    .where(eq(usersCS.id, userIdBigInt))
    .returning();

  if (!res) throw new Error('Failed to set default signature');
  return res[0]?.savedSignatures ?? updated;
}

          isYearly: false,
          source: CHECKOUT_SOURCES.SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS,
          organizationId: organizationId
        })
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const { url } = await response.json();
        router.push(url);
      } else {
        console.error('Failed to create checkout session');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating checkout session:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleManageSubscription = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);

      // Create customer portal session
      const response = await fetch('/api/stripe/customer-portal', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          returnUrl: window.location.href
        })
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        console.error('Failed to create customer portal session:', errorData);

        // Check if it's a Stripe configuration error
        if (
          errorData.error?.includes('No configuration provided') ||
          errorData.error?.includes('customer portal settings') ||
          errorData.code === 'STRIPE_PORTAL_NOT_CONFIGURED'
        ) {
          const message =
            errorData.details ||
            'Subscription management is not yet configured. Please contact support.';
          toast.error(message);
          return;
        }

        // Check if organization is not linked to Stripe
        if (errorData.code === 'NO_STRIPE_CUSTOMER') {
          toast.error('Please complete your subscription setup first.');
          return;
        }

        throw new Error(
          errorData.error || 'Failed to create customer portal session'
        );
      }

      const { url } = await response.json();

      // Redirect to Stripe customer portal
      if (url) {
        window.location.href = url;
      } else {
        throw new Error('No portal URL received');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating customer portal session:', error);

      // Show user-friendly error message
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        if (
          error.message.includes('No configuration provided') ||
          error.message.includes('customer portal settings')
        ) {
          toast.error(
            'Subscription management is not yet configured. Please contact support.'
          );
        } else {
          toast.error(
            'Unable to open subscription management. Please try again later.'
          );
        }
      } else {
        toast.error('An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.');
      }

      // Fallback to organization page if portal creation fails
      router.push('/account/organization');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Check if user can manage subscription (has Stripe customer ID)
  const canManageSubscription =
    hasSubscription && hasOrganization && hasStripeCustomer;

  return (
    <Card className='border-primary/20 bg-primary/5'>
      <CardHeader className='pb-3'>
        <div className='flex flex-col flex-wrap items-start gap-2 md:flex-row md:items-center'>
          <div className='flex flex-row items-center gap-2'>
            <Crown className='size-5 text-primary' />
            <CardTitle className='text-primary'>Subscription Status</CardTitle>
          </div>
          <Badge variant='secondary' className='ml-auto'>
            {hasSubscription ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
          </Badge>
        </div>
        <CardDescription>
          {hasSubscription
            ? `Current plan: ${currentPlan || 'Unknown'}`
            : 'No active subscription found'}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className='space-y-4'>
        {hasSubscription ? (
          <div className='space-y-2'>
            <div className='flex items-center gap-2 text-sm'>
              <CheckCircle2 className='size-4 text-primary' />
              <span>Plan: {currentPlan || 'Unknown'}</span>
            </div>
            <div className='flex items-center gap-2 text-sm'>
              <CheckCircle2 className='size-4 text-primary' />
              <span>Status: {subscriptionStatus || 'Unknown'}</span>
            </div>
            <div className='flex items-center gap-2 text-sm'>
              <CheckCircle2 className='size-4 text-primary' />
              <span>Active: {isActive ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className='space-y-2'>
            <div className='flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
              <AlertTriangle className='size-4' />
              <span>No active subscription</span>
            </div>
            <div className='flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
              <ArrowRight className='size-4' />
              <span>Upgrade to unlock all features</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className=' flex gap-2'>
          {!hasSubscription ? (
            isLoading ? (
              <Skeleton className='h-8 w-36 rounded' />
            ) : (
              <Button
                onClick={handleUpgrade}
                disabled={isLoading}
                className='zyflo-transition group inline-flex w-full items-center gap-2'
                size='sm'
              >
                Upgrade Now
                <ArrowRight className='zyflo-transition size-3 group-hover:-rotate-45' />
              </Button>
            )
          ) : isLoading ? (
            <Skeleton className='h-8 w-36 rounded' />
          ) : (
            <Button
              onClick={handleManageSubscription}
              disabled={isLoading || !canManageSubscription}
              className='zyflo-transition group inline-flex w-full items-center gap-2'
              size='sm'
              variant='default'
            >
              Manage Subscription
              <ArrowRight className='zyflo-transition size-3 group-hover:-rotate-45' />
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>

        {!canManageSubscription && hasSubscription && (
          <div className='text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
            Subscription management will be available once your billing is fully
            configured
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Show configuration help when there are Stripe issues */}
        {hasSubscription && !canManageSubscription && (
          <div className='rounded bg-muted/50 p-2 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
            <p>
              💡 <strong>Need help?</strong>
            </p>
            <p>
              If you're experiencing issues with subscription management, please
              contact support.
            </p>
            <p>This may be due to incomplete Stripe configuration.</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

'use client';

import type { ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import type {
  InviteUser,
  InviteUsersFormValues,
  TeamData
} from '@signvault/frontend/app/(user)/create-organization/types';

import { PermissionType } from '@signvault/db/types';
import {
  PERMISSION_CATEGORIES,
  PERMISSION_DESCRIPTIONS,
  PERMISSION_ICONS
} from '@signvault/frontend/app/(user)/create-organization/components/invite-users-form/constants';
import { PermissionEvaluator } from '@/lib/permission-evaluator';
import { formatPermissionName } from '@signvault/frontend/app/(user)/create-organization/components/invite-users-form/utils';
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/tooltip';
import { Check, ShieldHalf, UserCog, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useFormContext } from 'react-hook-form';

type PermissionsSectionProps = {
  activeTeams?: ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS[];
  teams?: TeamData[];
  user: InviteUser;
  userIndex: number;
};

/**
 * Permissions section of the invite users form
 * Shows all available permissions grouped by category and their current status
 */
export function PermissionsSection({
  userIndex,
  user,
  teams = [],
  activeTeams = []
}: Readonly<PermissionsSectionProps>) {
  const form = useFormContext<InviteUsersFormValues>();

  // Determine which teams to use based on the available data
  const availableTeams = useMemo(() => {
    // First check if we have teams passed directly
    if (teams && teams.length > 0) {
      return teams;
    }

    // Finally, convert active teams to the format expected if available
    if (activeTeams && activeTeams.length > 0) {
      return activeTeams.map((activeTeam) => ({
        name: activeTeam.name,
        permissions:
          'template' in activeTeam
            ? activeTeam.template.permissions
            : activeTeam.customTeam.permissions
      }));
    }

    return [];
  }, [teams, activeTeams]);

  // Find the team based on user's team value
  const team = useMemo(() => {
    return availableTeams.find((t) => t.name === user.team);
  }, [availableTeams, user.team]);

  // Create permission evaluator instance and calculate results - memoize to prevent recalculation
  const { permissionResults, allowedPermissions } = useMemo(() => {
    const evaluator = new PermissionEvaluator(
      user.role,
      (team?.permissions || []) as PermissionType[],
      team?.name || '',
      user.attributes?.function?.primary,
      user.attributes?.clearance?.level,
      user.attributes?.clearance?.scope
    );

    const results = evaluator.getAllPermissions();
    const allowed = Array.from(results.entries())
      .filter(([_, result]) => result.allowed)
      .map(([permission]) => permission);

    return { permissionResults: results, allowedPermissions: allowed };
  }, [
    user.role,
    team,
    user.attributes?.function?.primary,
    user.attributes?.clearance?.level,
    user.attributes?.clearance?.scope
  ]);

  // Update form state when permissions change
  useEffect(() => {
    const currentPermissions =
      form.getValues(`users.${userIndex}.permissions`) || [];
    const sortedCurrentPermissions = currentPermissions.toSorted((a, b) =>
      a.localeCompare(b)
    );
    const sortedAllowedPermissions = allowedPermissions.toSorted((a, b) =>
      a.localeCompare(b)
    );
    if (
      JSON.stringify(sortedCurrentPermissions) !==
      JSON.stringify(sortedAllowedPermissions)
    ) {
      form.setValue(`users.${userIndex}.permissions`, allowedPermissions, {
        shouldValidate: true
      });
    }
  }, [form, userIndex, allowedPermissions]);

  // Filter categories to only show those with at least one allowed permission
  const filteredCategories = useMemo(() => {
    return PERMISSION_CATEGORIES.filter((category) => {
      return category.permissions.some(
        (permission) => permissionResults.get(permission)?.allowed
      );
    });
  }, [permissionResults]);

  const isAdmin = Array.from(permissionResults.entries()).some(
    ([_, result]) => result.isAdminResult
  );

  return (
    <div className='space-y-6'>
      {isAdmin && (
        <div className='space-y-4'>
          <h3 className='text-base font-medium'>Admin Permissions</h3>
          <div className='divide-y divide-line overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-secondary'>
            {
              <div className='flex items-center justify-between p-4'>
                <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
                  <UserCog className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4 text-primary' />
                  <div>
                    <p className='text-sm font-medium'>Organization Admin</p>
                    <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                      Organization administrators have full access to all
                      features and settings, except for the permissions
                      mentioned below.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <TooltipProvider>
                  <Tooltip>
                    <TooltipTrigger>
                      <div className='flex size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-green-600'>
                        <Check className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-background' />
                      </div>
                    </TooltipTrigger>
                    <TooltipContent className='max-w-lg border-none bg-foreground text-background'>
                      <p>
                        Organization administrators have full access to all
                        features and settings, except for the permissions
                        mentioned below.
                      </p>
                    </TooltipContent>
                  </Tooltip>
                </TooltipProvider>
              </div>
            }
            {PermissionEvaluator.OWNER_ONLY_PERMISSIONS.filter(
              (p) => p !== PermissionType.ALL
            ).map((permission) => (
              <div
                className='flex items-center justify-between p-4'
                key={permission}
              >
                <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
                  {PERMISSION_ICONS[permission] &&
                    (() => {
                      const Icon = PERMISSION_ICONS[permission] ?? ShieldHalf;
                      return (
                        <Icon className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4 text-primary' />
                      );
                    })()}
                  <div>
                    <p className='text-sm font-medium'>
                      {formatPermissionName(permission)}
                    </p>
                    <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                      {PERMISSION_DESCRIPTIONS[permission]}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <TooltipProvider>
                  <Tooltip>
                    <TooltipTrigger>
                      {permissionResults.get(permission)?.allowed ? (
                        <div className='flex size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-green-600'>
                          <Check className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-background' />
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className='flex size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-destructive'>
                          <X className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-background' />
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </TooltipTrigger>
                    <TooltipContent className='max-w-lg border-none bg-foreground text-background'>
                      <p>{permissionResults.get(permission)?.reason}</p>
                    </TooltipContent>
                  </Tooltip>
                </TooltipProvider>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      {!isAdmin &&
        filteredCategories.map((category) => (
          <div className='space-y-4' key={category.title}>
            <h3 className='text-base font-medium'>{category.title}</h3>
            <div className='divide-y divide-line overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-secondary'>
              {category.permissions.map((permission) => {
                const evaluationResult = permissionResults.get(permission);
                const Icon = PERMISSION_ICONS[permission];

                return (
                  <div
                    className='flex items-center justify-between p-4'
                    key={permission}
                  >
                    <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
                      <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
                        {Icon && (
                          <Icon className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4 text-primary' />
                        )}
                        <div>
                          <p className='text-sm font-medium'>
                            {formatPermissionName(permission)}
                          </p>
                          <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                            {PERMISSION_DESCRIPTIONS[permission]}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <TooltipProvider>
                      <Tooltip>
                        <TooltipTrigger>
                          {evaluationResult?.allowed ? (
                            <div className='flex size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-green-600'>
                              <Check className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-background' />
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <div className='flex size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-destructive'>
                              <X className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-background' />
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </TooltipTrigger>
                        <TooltipContent className='max-w-lg border-none bg-foreground text-background'>
                          <p>{evaluationResult?.reason}</p>
                        </TooltipContent>
                      </Tooltip>
                    </TooltipProvider>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export async function generateStaticParams() {
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'content-details-ssg');
  try {
    logger.info('Generating static params for content details page');

    const contentResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/content?bypassToken=${process.env.BYPASS_TOKEN}`
    );

    const content: GetContentsResponse = await contentResponse.json();

    if (content.message !== 'Contents retrieved successfully') {
      logger.error('Error generating static params for content details page', {
        content
      });
      return [];
    }

    return content.contents.database.map((content) => ({
      contentId: content.id.toString(),
      organizationId: content.organizationId.toString()
    }));
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error generating static params for content details page', {
      error
    });
    return [];
  }
}

type Props = {
  params: Promise<{
    organizationId: string;
    contentId: string;
  }>;
};

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { contentId, organizationId } = await params;
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'content-details-metadata');
  logger.info('Generating metadata for content details page', {
    contentId,
    organizationId
  });
  const contentResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/content/${contentId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  );
  const content: GetContentResponse = await contentResponse.json();
  if (content.message !== 'Content retrieved successfully') {
    logger.error('Content not found', {
      contentId,
      organizationId
    });
    return {
      title: 'Content not found',
      description: 'The content you are trying to access does not exist.'
    };
  }
  const contentData = content.content.database
    ? content.content.database
    : null;

  if (!contentData) {
    logger.error('Content data not found', {
      contentId,
      organizationId
    });
    return {
      title: 'Content not found',
      description: 'The content you are trying to access does not exist.'
    };
  }

  return {
    title: `${contentData.title}`,
    description: `View details for ${contentData.title}`,
    keywords: `${contentData.title}, ${contentData.title} content, ${contentData.description}`,
    robots: 'index, follow',
    openGraph: {
      title: `${contentData.title}`,
      description: `View details for ${contentData.title}`,
      images: [`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`],
      type: 'website',
      siteName: 'SignVault',
      locale: 'en_US',
      url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/organizations/${organizationId}/content/${contentId}`
    },
    icons: {
      icon: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/icon.svg`
    },
    twitter: {
      title: `${contentData.title}`,
      description: `View details for ${contentData.title}`,
      images: [`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`],
      card: 'summary_large_image',
      creator: '@signvault',
      site: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/organizations/${organizationId}/content/${contentId}`
    }
  };
}

  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'content-details');

      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({

          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  logger.info('Accessing content details page', {

    contentId
  });

  if (!claims) {

      contentId
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect('/account/settings/basic', 'Not logged in')
    );
  }

  logger.info('Fetching user data', { userId: claims.sub });

  const userResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/users/${claims.sub}`,
    {

      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (userResponse.message !== 'User retrieved successfully') {
    logger.error('User not found', { userId: claims.sub });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect('/account/settings/basic', 'User not found')
    );
  }

  const user = userResponse.user.database ?? userResponse.user.logto ?? null;

  if (!user) {

      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/settings/basic',
        'User not found',
        'The user you are trying to access does not exist.'
      )
    );

      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }

    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations`,
        'Organization not found',
        'The organization you are trying to access does not exist.'
      )
    );
  }

  const organization =
    organizationResponse.organization.database ??
    organizationResponse.organization.logto ??
    null;

  if (!organization) {

      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations`,
        'Organization not found',
        'The organization you are trying to access does not exist.'
      )
    );
  }

  const userRolesResponse: GetOrganizationRolesForAUserResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-roles/${organizationId}/users/${claims.sub}/roles?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {

          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (
    userRolesResponse.message !== 'Organization roles retrieved successfully' ||
    userRolesResponse.roles.length === 0
  ) {

      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}`,
        'Could not verify user roles',
        'The user roles were not found in the database.'
      )

  const userHasL5OrSuperAdminRole = userRolesResponse.roles.some(
    (role) =>
      role.id === ROLES.SUPER_ADMIN.id ||
      role.id === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
      role.id === ROLES.L6_USER.id
  );

  const contentResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/content/${contentId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  );
  const content: GetContentResponse = await contentResponse.json();

  if (
    !content.content.database ||
    content.message !== 'Content retrieved successfully'
  ) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/content`,
        'Content not found',
        'The content you are trying to access does not exist.'
      )
    );
  }

  logger.info('Content details page rendered successfully', {
    organizationId,
    contentId,
    userId: claims.sub
  });

  return (
    <>
      <Button variant='outline' asChild className='mb-8' size='sm'>
        <Link href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/content`}>
          <ChevronLeft className='mr-1 size-4' />
          Back to all content
        </Link>
      </Button>

      <ContentDetails
        cookieStore={cookieStore}
        content={content.content.database}
        organizationId={organizationId}
        isAdmin={userHasL5OrSuperAdminRole}
        organization={organization}
      />
    </>
  );
}
