import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server';

import { logtoClientEdge } from '@/app/logto';
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import type { UserCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import type { LogtoContext } from '@logto/next';

type CreateUserResponse = {
  code: string;
  user: {
    database: UserCS;
  };
};

type GetUserResponse = {
  user: {
    database: UserCS;
  };
};

type GetDbIdFromLogtoIdResponse = {
  userId?: string;
};

const toastKeyMap: { [key: string]: string[] } = {
  status: ['status', 'status_description'],
  error: ['error', 'error_description']
};

const getToastRedirect = (
  path: string,
  toastType: string,
  toastName: string,
  toastDescription: string = '',
  disableButton: boolean = false,
  arbitraryParams: string = ''
): string => {
  const [nameKey, descriptionKey] = toastKeyMap[toastType] ?? ['', ''];

  let redirectPath = `${path}?${nameKey}=${encodeURIComponent(toastName)}`;

  if (toastDescription) {
    redirectPath += `&${descriptionKey}=${encodeURIComponent(toastDescription)}`;
  }

  if (disableButton) {
    redirectPath += `&disable_button=true`;
  }

  if (arbitraryParams) {
    redirectPath += `&${arbitraryParams}`;
  }

  return redirectPath;
};

const getErrorRedirect = (
  path: string,
  errorName: string,
  errorDescription: string = '',
  disableButton: boolean = false,
  arbitraryParams: string = ''
): string =>
  getToastRedirect(
    path,
    'error',
    errorName,
    errorDescription,
    disableButton,
    arbitraryParams
  );

const PUBLIC_PATHS = ['/onboarding', '/api', '/join-organization'];

export function generateRandomUsername(phrase: string) {
  // check if phrase is an email
  // if it is, use the first part of the email to form the username
  let username = '';
  if (phrase.includes('@')) {
    username = phrase.split('@')[0];
  }

  // check if phrase is a name
  // if it is, use the first part of the name to form the username
  if (phrase.includes(' ')) {
    username = phrase.split(' ')[0];
  }

  // if it is not an email or a name, use the phrase as the username
  if (!username) {
    username = phrase;
  }

  // check for username length and trim it to 20 characters
  if (username.length > 20) {
    username = username.substring(0, 20);
  }

  const randomString = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);
  return `${username}_${randomString}`;
}

export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    // Check if path is public
    if (
      PUBLIC_PATHS.some((path) => request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(path))
    ) {
      // Special handling for join-organization route
      if (request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/join-organization')) {
        return handleJoinOrganizationFlow(request);
      }
      return NextResponse.next();
    }

    const { claims } = await logtoClientEdge.getLogtoContext(request);

    if (!claims) {
      return NextResponse.next();
    }

    try {
      // get db id from logto id
      const dbId = await getDbIdFromLogtoId(claims.sub, claims);
      if (!dbId) {
        return NextResponse.redirect(
          new URL(
            getErrorRedirect(
              '/',
              'Not Logged In',
              'You must be logged in to access SignVault.'
            ),
            request.url
          )
        );
      }

      const userData = await fetchUserData(dbId, claims.sub);
      const user = userData.user.database;

      if (!user) {
        return NextResponse.redirect(
          new URL(
            getErrorRedirect(
              '/',
              'Not Logged In',
              'You must be logged in to complete onboarding.'
            ),
            request.url
          )
        );
      }

      // Skip onboarding check for join-organization route
      if (
        !user.onboardingCompleted &&
        !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/join-organization')
      ) {
        return NextResponse.redirect(
          new URL(
            getErrorRedirect(
              '/onboarding',
              'Onboarding Not Completed',
              'You must complete onboarding to access SignVault.'
            ),
            request.url
          )
        );
      }

      return NextResponse.next();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('User data validation error', {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
        path: request.nextUrl.pathname
      });
      return NextResponse.next();
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error in middleware', error);
    console.error('Middleware error', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
      path: request.nextUrl.pathname
    });
    return NextResponse.next();
  }
}

async function fetchUserData(
  dbId: string,
  logtoId: string
): Promise<GetUserResponse> {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users/${dbId}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'x-user-logto-id': logtoId,
          'x-middleware-bypass-token':
            process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
        }
      }
    );

    if (!response.ok && response.status !== 404) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to fetch user data: ${response.status}`);
    }

    const responseData: GetUserResponse = await response.json();

    return responseData;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error in user data operation', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
      dbId,
      logtoId
    });
    throw error;
  }
}

async function handleJoinOrganizationFlow(request: NextRequest) {
  // Allow access to join-organization route without onboarding check
  if (request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/join-organization')) {
    // Get the email from the URL query params
    const searchParams = new URL(request.url).searchParams;
    const email = searchParams.get('email');

    // If no email in params, let the page handle it
    if (!email) {
      return NextResponse.next();
    }

    const { claims } = await logtoClientEdge.getLogtoContext(request);

    // If user is not logged in, let the page handle it
    if (!claims) {
      return NextResponse.next();
    }

    // If user is logged in, check if their email matches the invitation
    try {
      // get db id from logto id
      const dbId = await getDbIdFromLogtoId(claims.sub, claims);
      if (!dbId) {
        return NextResponse.next();
      }
      const userData = await fetchUserData(dbId, claims.sub);
      const user = userData.user.database;

      if (!user) {
        return NextResponse.next();
      }

      // If user's email doesn't match invitation email, show error
      if (user.primaryEmail !== email) {
        return NextResponse.redirect(
          new URL(
            getErrorRedirect(
              '/',
              'Email Mismatch',
              'Please log in with the email address that received the invitation.'
            ),
            request.url
          )
        );
      }

      // If user has completed onboarding and is already in an organization, show error
      if (user.onboardingCompleted && user.organizationId) {
        return NextResponse.redirect(
          new URL(
            getErrorRedirect(
              '/',
              'Organization Conflict',
              'You are already a member of an organization.'
            ),
            request.url
          )
        );
      }

      // Otherwise, let the page handle the flow
      return NextResponse.next();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error in join organization flow', {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
      });
      return NextResponse.next();
    }
  }
}

async function getDbIdFromLogtoId(
  logtoId: string,
  claims: LogtoContext['claims']
): Promise<string | null> {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users/db-id/${logtoId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'x-user-logto-id': logtoId,
        'x-middleware-bypass-token': process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN
      }
    }
  );
  const data: GetDbIdFromLogtoIdResponse = await response.json();

  if (!data.userId) {
    // create a new user
    const createResponse: CreateUserResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'x-user-logto-id': logtoId,
          'x-middleware-bypass-token':
            process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          logtoId: logtoId,
          username: generateRandomUsername(claims.name ?? claims.email ?? ''),
          firstName: claims.name?.split(' ')[0] ?? '',
          lastName: claims.name?.split(' ')[1] ?? '',
          name: claims.name ?? '',
          primaryEmail: claims.email,
          onboardingCompleted: false,
          accessLevel: 'L1',
          creationMethod: 'API',
          userType: 'SYSTEM_DEFAULT',
          verifiedStatus: 'PENDING',
          permissions: []
        } as Partial<UserCS>)
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());

    if (!createResponse || createResponse.code !== 'user.created') {
      throw new Error('Failed to create user');
    }

    // create the customer in stripe
    const stripeResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/api/stripe/create-customer`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          email: claims.email,
          name: claims.name,
          metadata: {
            logtoId,
            dbId: createResponse.user.database.id.toString(),
            username: createResponse.user.database.username,
            email: claims.email,
            name: claims.name
          }
        })
      }
    );

    if (!stripeResponse.ok) {
      console.error('Failed to create Stripe customer');
      // Continue without Stripe customer creation - user can still be created
    }

    return createResponse.user.database.id.toString();
  }

  return data.userId;
}

export const config = {
  matcher: '/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico).*)'
};

import {

  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle

import { EditTeamSheet } from './edit-team-sheet';
import { ManageTeamMembersSheet } from './manage-team-members-sheet';
import type { TeamsContentProps } from '../lib/types';
import type { CustomTeamWithMembers } from '@signvault/db/crud/teams/types';

export function TeamsContent({
  teams: initialTeams,
  organizationId,
  cookieString,
  user,
  allUsers
}: Readonly<TeamsContentProps>) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [deletingTeam, setDeletingTeam] =
    useState<CustomTeamWithMembers | null>(null);
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const [teams, setTeams] = useOptimistic(
    initialTeams,
    (state: CustomTeamWithMembers[], updatedTeam: CustomTeamWithMembers) =>
      state.map((team) => (team.id === updatedTeam.id ? updatedTeam : team))
  );

  const deleteTeamMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (teamId: string) => {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${teamId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          }
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Failed to delete team');
      }

      return teamId;
    },
    onMutate: async (teamId) => {
      await queryClient.cancelQueries({
        queryKey: ['teams', organizationId]
      });
      const previousTeams = queryClient.getQueryData<CustomTeamWithMembers[]>([
        'teams',
        organizationId
      ]);
      queryClient.setQueryData<CustomTeamWithMembers[]>(
        ['teams', organizationId],
        (old) => old?.filter((team) => team.id !== teamId)
      );
      return { previousTeams };
    },
    onError: (err, teamId, context) => {
      queryClient.setQueryData(
        ['teams', organizationId],
        context?.previousTeams
      );
      toast.error('Failed to delete team');
      clientLogger.error('[TeamsContent] Error deleting team', {
        error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error',
        teamId,
        organizationId
      });
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success('Team deleted successfully');
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['teams', organizationId]
      });
    },
    onSettled: () => {
      setDeletingTeam(null);
    }
  });

  const handleTeamUpdated = (updatedTeam: CustomTeamWithMembers) => {
    if (!updatedTeam) return;

    startTransition(() => {
      setTeams(updatedTeam);

      queryClient.setQueryData<CustomTeamWithMembers[]>(
        ['teams', organizationId],
        (old) =>
          old?.map((team) =>
            team.id === updatedTeam.id ? updatedTeam : team
          ) || []
      );

      if (updatedTeam.id) {
        queryClient.setQueryData(
          ['team', organizationId, updatedTeam.id],
          updatedTeam
        );
      }
    });
  };

  const handleDeleteTeam = async () => {
    if (!deletingTeam) return;
    await deleteTeamMutation.mutateAsync(deletingTeam.id);
  };

  const filteredTeams = teams.filter((team) =>
    team.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <>
      <div className='mb-8 flex items-center justify-between'>
        <h1 className='font-signvault text-3xl font-bold'>Teams</h1>
        <Link href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/create`}>
          <Button className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'>
            <Plus className='h-4 w-4' />
            Create Team
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </div>

      <div className='mb-6'>
        <SearchInput
          label='Search teams...'
          showLabel={false}
          placeholder='Search teams...'
          value={searchTerm}
          onChange={(value) => setSearchTerm(value)}
        />
      </div>

      <div className='overflow-x-auto'>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Team Name</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Members</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Created On</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Actions</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {filteredTeams.length === 0 && (
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell colSpan={4} className='text-center'>
                  No teams found
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            )}
            {filteredTeams.map((team) => (
              <TableRow key={team.id}>
                <TableCell className='font-medium'>
                  <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                    {team.icon ? (
                      <img
                        src={team.icon}
                        alt={team.name}
                        className='h-4 w-4 rounded'
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <Users className='h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground' />
                    )}
                    {team.name}
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                    <span>{team.members?.length || 0} members</span>
                    <ManageTeamMembersSheet
                      team={team}
                      organizationId={organizationId}
                      cookieString={cookieString}
                      user={user}
                      allUsers={allUsers}
                      onTeamUpdated={handleTeamUpdated}
                    />
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {formatDate(new Date(team.createdAt), 'PPP')}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <DropdownMenu>
                    <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                      <Button variant='ghost' className='h-8 w-8 p-0'>
                        <MoreHorizontal className='h-4 w-4' />
                      </Button>
                    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                    <DropdownMenuContent align='end'>
                      <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
                        <Link
                          href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${team.id}`}
                          className='flex items-center'
                        >
                          <Eye className='mr-2 h-4 w-4' />
                          View Team Details
                        </Link>
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <EditTeamSheet
                        team={team}
                        organizationId={organizationId}
                        cookieString={cookieString}
                        user={user}
                        onTeamUpdated={handleTeamUpdated}
                        allUsers={allUsers}
                      />
                      <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
                        <Link
                          href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${team.id}/calendar`}
                          className='flex items-center'
                        >
                          <Calendar className='mr-2 h-4 w-4' />
                          View Team Calendar
                        </Link>
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
                        <Link
                          href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${team.id}/documents`}
                          className='flex items-center'
                        >
                          <File className='mr-2 h-4 w-4' />
                          View Team Documents
                        </Link>
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem

                        Delete Team
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                    </DropdownMenuContent>

            ))}
          </TableBody>

        open={!!deletingTeam}

      >
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>

  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Building2, Calendar, Clock, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import {
  getUserJoinRequests,
  revokeJoinRequest
} from '@/actions/organization-join-requests';
import { formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns';
import type { OrganizationJoinRequestCS, UserCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { useUserData } from '@/contexts/user-data-context';
import { OrganizationJoinRequestStatus } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';

/**
 * Page for users to view and manage their organization join requests
 */
export default function JoinRequestsPageClient({
  requests: initialRequests,
  user
}: Readonly<{ requests: OrganizationJoinRequestCS[]; user: UserCS }>) {
  const [requests, setRequests] =
    useState<OrganizationJoinRequestCS[]>(initialRequests);
  const { organization, organizationLoading } = useUserData();
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isRevoking, setIsRevoking] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Load user's join requests
  const loadRequests = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await getUserJoinRequests();
      if (result.success && result.requests) {
        setRequests(result.requests);
      } else {
        toast.error(result.error || 'Failed to load join requests');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error loading requests:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load join requests');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Revoke a join request
  const handleRevoke = async (requestId: string) => {
    setIsRevoking(requestId);
    try {
      const result = await revokeJoinRequest(requestId);
      if (result.success) {
        toast.success('Join request revoked successfully');
        // Remove the request from the list
        setRequests((prev) =>
          prev.filter((req) => String(req.id) !== requestId)
        );
      } else {
        toast.error(result.error || 'Failed to revoke join request');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error revoking request:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to revoke join request');
    } finally {
      setIsRevoking(null);
    }
  };

  // Get status badge variant
  const getStatusBadgeVariant = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'pending':
        return 'secondary';
      case 'approved':
        return 'default';
      case 'rejected':
        return 'destructive';
      default:
        return 'secondary';
    }
  };

  // Get status display text
  const getStatusText = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'pending':
        return 'Pending Review';
      case 'approved':
        return 'Approved';
      case 'rejected':
        return 'Rejected';
      default:
        return status;
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadRequests();
  }, []);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className='space-y-6'>
        <div>
          <h1 className='text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight'>
            Organization Join Requests
          </h1>
          <p className='text-muted-foreground'>
            View and manage your requests to join organizations.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className='space-y-4'>
          {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
            <Card key={i}>
              <CardHeader>
                <Skeleton className='h-6 w-1/3' />
                <Skeleton className='h-4 w-2/3' />
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <Skeleton className='h-4 w-full' />
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>

    );
  }

  return (
    <div className='space-y-6'>
      <div>
        <h1 className='text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight'>
          Organization Join Requests
        </h1>
        <p className='text-muted-foreground'>
          View and manage your requests to join organizations.
        </p>
      </div>

      {requests.length === 0 ? (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className='flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12'>
            <Building2 className='mb-4 size-12 text-muted-foreground' />
            <h3 className='mb-2 text-lg font-semibold'>No Join Requests</h3>
            <p className='mb-4 text-center text-muted-foreground'>
              You haven't sent any organization join requests yet.
            </p>
            <Button onClick={() => window.history.back()} variant='outline'>
              Go Back
            </Button>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className='space-y-4'>
          {requests.map((request) => (
            <Card key={String(request.id)}>
              <CardHeader>
                <div className='flex items-start justify-between'>
                  <div className='space-y-1'>
                    <CardTitle className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                      <Building2 className='size-5' />
                      {!organizationLoading && organization?.name}
                    </CardTitle>
                    {!organizationLoading && organization?.description && (
                      <CardDescription>
                        {!organizationLoading && organization?.description}
                      </CardDescription>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                    <Badge variant={getStatusBadgeVariant(request.status)}>
                      {getStatusText(request.status)}
                    </Badge>
                    {request.status ===
                      OrganizationJoinRequestStatus.PENDING && (
                      <AlertDialog>
                        <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
                          <Button
                            variant='ghost'
                            size='sm'
                            disabled={String(isRevoking) === String(request.id)}
                          >
                            <Trash2 className='size-4' />
                          </Button>
                        </AlertDialogTrigger>
                        <AlertDialogContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
                          <AlertDialogHeader>
                            <AlertDialogTitle>
                              Revoke Join Request
                            </AlertDialogTitle>
                            <AlertDialogDescription>
                              Are you sure you want to revoke your join request
                              to {!organizationLoading && organization?.name}?
                              This action cannot be undone.
                            </AlertDialogDescription>
                          </AlertDialogHeader>
                          <AlertDialogFooter>
                            <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
                            <AlertDialogAction
                              onClick={() => handleRevoke(String(request.id))}
                              className='bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90'
                            >
                              Revoke Request
                            </AlertDialogAction>
                          </AlertDialogFooter>
                        </AlertDialogContent>
                      </AlertDialog>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <div className='space-y-3'>
                  <div className='flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                    <div className='flex items-center gap-1'>
                      <Calendar className='size-4' />
                      <span>
                        Requested{' '}
                        {formatDistanceToNow(new Date(request.createdAt), {
                          addSuffix: true
                        })}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {request.updatedAt !== request.createdAt && (
                      <div className='flex items-center gap-1'>
                        <Clock className='size-4' />
                        <span>
                          Updated{' '}
                          {formatDistanceToNow(new Date(request.updatedAt), {
                            addSuffix: true
                          })}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {request.message && (
                    <div>
                      <h4 className='mb-1 text-sm font-medium'>
                        Your Message:
                      </h4>
                      <p className='rounded-md bg-muted p-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                        {request.message}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {request.reviewMessage && (
                    <div>
                      <h4 className='mb-1 text-sm font-medium'>
                        {request.status ===
                        OrganizationJoinRequestStatus.APPROVED
                          ? 'Approval Message:'
                          : 'Rejection Reason:'}
                      </h4>
                      <p className='rounded-md bg-muted p-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                        {request.reviewMessage}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useId, useRef } from 'react';
import type { UploadableFileDetail } from './upload-types';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/textarea';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  XIcon,
  FileText,
  UploadCloud,
  CheckCircle,
  AlertTriangle
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Progress } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/progress';
import { Label } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/label';
import { type Tag, TagInput } from 'emblor';
import { cn } from '@signvault/ui-lib/lib/utils';
import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';

type FileUploadItemProps = {
  fileDetail: UploadableFileDetail;
  onUpdateField: <K extends keyof UploadableFileDetail>(
    id: string,
    field: K,
    value: UploadableFileDetail[K]
  ) => void;
  onRemoveFile?: (id: string) => void;
  isEditing: boolean;
  isUploadingOrProcessing: boolean;
};

export function FileUploadItem({
  fileDetail,
  onUpdateField,
  onRemoveFile,
  isEditing,
  isUploadingOrProcessing
}: Readonly<FileUploadItemProps>) {
  const tagsInputId = useId();
  const [emblorTags, setEmblorTags] = useState<Tag[]>([]);
  const [activeTagIndex, setActiveTagIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // Effect 1: Sync from parent prop (fileDetail.tags: string[]) to local state (emblorTags: Tag[])
  useEffect(() => {
    const newEmblorTags = fileDetail.tags.map((tagText) => ({
      id: getRandomUUID(),
      text: tagText
    }));
    // Only update if they are different to avoid potential loops with Effect 2
    if (
      JSON.stringify(newEmblorTags.map((t) => t.text)) !==
      JSON.stringify(emblorTags.map((t) => t.text))
    ) {
      setEmblorTags(newEmblorTags);
    }
  }, [fileDetail.tags]); // Only run when fileDetail.tags changes

  // Effect 2: Sync from local state (emblorTags) to parent prop only after initial mount
  const isFirstTagSync = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isFirstTagSync.current) {
      isFirstTagSync.current = false;
      return;
    }
    const currentStringTags = emblorTags.map((tag) => tag.text);
    if (JSON.stringify(currentStringTags) !== JSON.stringify(fileDetail.tags)) {
      onUpdateField(fileDetail.id, 'tags', currentStringTags);
    }
    // Only depend on emblorTags to trigger on user changes
  }, [emblorTags]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const getStatusIcon = () => {
    switch (fileDetail.status) {
      case 'pending':
        return <FileText className='size-5 text-primary/80' />;
      case 'uploading-s3':
      case 'creating-record':
        return <UploadCloud className='size-5 animate-pulse text-primary' />;
      case 'completed':
        return <CheckCircle className='size-5 text-green-500' />;
      case 'error':
        return <AlertTriangle className='size-5 text-destructive' />;
      default:
        return <FileText className='size-5 text-primary/80' />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        'rounded-xl border transition-all duration-200',
        isEditing
          ? 'border-border bg-card hover:shadow-xs'
          : 'border-border/50 bg-muted/30',
        fileDetail.status === 'error' &&
          'border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5',
        fileDetail.status === 'completed' && 'border-green-200 bg-green-50/50'
      )}
    >
      <div className='p-4'>
        <div className='flex items-start gap-4'>
          <div className='mt-1 shrink-0'>{getStatusIcon()}</div>
          <div className='min-w-0 flex-1'>
            <div className='flex items-start justify-between gap-3'>
              <div className='min-w-0 flex-1'>
                <h4
                  className={cn(
                    'truncate font-medium',
                    fileDetail.title.trim() === '' &&
                      isEditing &&
                      'text-muted-foreground italic'
                  )}
                >
                  {fileDetail.title.trim() !== ''
                    ? fileDetail.title
                    : 'Untitled Document'}
                </h4>
                <div className='mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                  <span className='font-mono text-xs'>
                    {fileDetail.file.name}
                  </span>
                  <span>•</span>
                  <span>{(fileDetail.file.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB</span>
                  {fileDetail.draftId && (
                    <>
                      <span>•</span>
                      <span className='flex items-center gap-1'>
                        <CheckCircle className='size-3' />
                        Draft Saved
                      </span>
                    </>
                  )}
                  {fileDetail.mimeType && (
                    <>
                      <span>•</span>
                      <span className='text-xs uppercase'>
                        {fileDetail.mimeType.split('/')[1] || 'Unknown'}
                      </span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              {isEditing && onRemoveFile && (
                <Button
                  onClick={() => onRemoveFile(fileDetail.id)}
                  variant='ghost'
                  size='sm'
                  className='size-8 p-0 text-muted-foreground'
                  disabled={isUploadingOrProcessing}
                >
                  <XIcon className='size-4' />
                  <span className='sr-only'>Remove file</span>
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>

            {(fileDetail.status === 'uploading-s3' ||
              fileDetail.status === 'creating-record') && (
              <div className='mt-3'>
                <div className='mb-1 flex justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                  <span>
                    {fileDetail.status === 'uploading-s3'
                      ? 'Uploading...'
                      : 'Processing...'}
                  </span>
                  <span>{fileDetail.progress}%</span>
                </div>
                <Progress value={fileDetail.progress} className='h-1.5' />
              </div>
            )}

            {fileDetail.status === 'error' && fileDetail.error && (
              <div className='mt-3 rounded-lg border border-destructive/20 bg-destructive/10 p-3'>
                <p className='text-sm text-destructive'>{fileDetail.error}</p>
              </div>
            )}

            {isEditing && (
              <div className='mt-4 space-y-2'>
                <div className='grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2'>
                  <div>
                    <Label
                      htmlFor={`title-${fileDetail.id}`}
                      className='mb-2 block text-sm font-medium'
                    >
                      Title <span className='text-destructive'>*</span>
                    </Label>
                    <Input
                      id={`title-${fileDetail.id}`}
                      value={fileDetail.title}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        onUpdateField(fileDetail.id, 'title', e.target.value)
                      }
                      placeholder='Enter document title'
                      disabled={isUploadingOrProcessing}
                      className={cn(
                        fileDetail.title.trim() === '' &&
                          'border-amber-300 focus:border-amber-500'
                      )}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <Label
                      htmlFor={`description-${fileDetail.id}`}
                      className='mb-2 block text-sm font-medium'
                    >
                      Description
                    </Label>
                    <Textarea
                      id={`description-${fileDetail.id}`}
                      value={fileDetail.description}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        onUpdateField(
                          fileDetail.id,
                          'description',
                          e.target.value
                        )
                      }
                      placeholder='Enter document description (optional)'
                      rows={1}
                      disabled={isUploadingOrProcessing}
                      className='resize-none whitespace-pre-wrap'
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <Label
                    htmlFor={tagsInputId}
                    className='mb-2 block text-sm font-medium'
                  >
                    Tags
                  </Label>
                  <TagInput
                    id={tagsInputId}
                    tags={emblorTags}
                    setTags={setEmblorTags}
                    activeTagIndex={activeTagIndex}
                    setActiveTagIndex={setActiveTagIndex}
                    placeholder='Add tags...'
                    disabled={isUploadingOrProcessing}
                    styleClasses={{
                      inlineTagsContainer:
                        'rounded-md border border-input shadow-xs bg-transparent focus-within:border-primary transition-[color,box-shadow] outline-hidden p-2 gap-1',
                      input:
                        'w-full min-w-[80px] shadow-none px-2 h-7 bg-transparent',
                      tag: {
                        body: 'h-7 relative bg-secondary/40 border border-secondary/50 hover:bg-secondary/30 rounded-md font-medium text-xs ps-2 pe-7',
                        closeButton:
                          'absolute -inset-y-px -end-px p-0 rounded-e-md flex size-7 transition-[color,box-shadow] outline-hidden focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px] text-muted-foreground/80 hover:text-foreground'
                      }
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

# SignVault Frontend

The main frontend application for SignVault, a secure digital signature platform built with Next.js 15 and React 19.

## Overview

This is a full-featured web application that provides users with a comprehensive document signing and management experience. The frontend handles authentication, document upload/management, electronic signatures, team collaboration, and organization management.

## Architecture

- **Framework**: Next.js 15 with App Router
- **React Version**: React 19 with React DOM 19
- **Authentication**: Logto integration with JWT tokens
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with custom design system
- **UI Components**: Radix UI primitives with custom components
- **State Management**: Zustand for global state
- **API Integration**: tRPC for type-safe API calls
- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM
- **File Storage**: AWS S3 integration
- **Payment**: Stripe integration
- **Real-time**: Socket.IO for live updates

## Key Features

### Core Functionality
- **Document Management**: Upload, organize, and manage documents
- **Digital Signatures**: Create and apply electronic signatures
- **Document Templates**: Create reusable document templates
- **PDF Processing**: View, edit, and manipulate PDF documents
- **Audit Trail**: Complete audit logging for all document actions

### User Management
- **Authentication**: Secure login with Logto
- **User Profiles**: Comprehensive user profile management
- **Multi-tenancy**: Organization and team support
- **Role-based Access**: Granular permissions system

### Collaboration Features
- **Team Management**: Create and manage teams
- **Document Sharing**: Share documents with team members
- **Calendar Integration**: Schedule signing events
- **Notifications**: Real-time notifications for document updates

### Business Features
- **Analytics Dashboard**: Document and user analytics
- **Billing Integration**: Stripe-powered subscription management
- **Data Provenance**: Track document history and changes
- **LinkedIn Integration**: Professional verification features

## Tech Stack

### Core Dependencies
- **Next.js**: `^15.4.6` - React framework with App Router
- **React**: `^19.1.1` - UI library
- **TypeScript**: `^5.7.3` - Type safety
- **Tailwind CSS**: `^4.1.11` - Utility-first CSS framework

### UI & Components

- **Lucide React**: Icon library
- **Framer Motion**: Animation library

### Document Processing

- **react-signature-canvas**: Signature capture

### Authentication & Security

### External Integrations

'use client';

import { type ReactNode, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '@/contexts/auth-context';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/card';
import { Shield, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { LogtoService } from '@signvault/logto';
import { PermissionEvaluator } from '../lib/permission-evaluator';
import {
  PermissionType,
  type UserCS,
  FunctionPrimaryRole,
  ClearanceSecurityLevel
} from '@signvault/db/types';

// Legacy types for backward compatibility
type Permission = string;
type UserRole = string;

// Helper function for legacy permission checking
function hasPermission(user: UserCS, permission: Permission): boolean {
  // Legacy permission check - can be customized based on your needs
  return user.permissions?.includes(permission as PermissionType) || false;
}

type PermissionGuardProps = {
  children: ReactNode;
  permission?: Permission;
  allowedRoles?: UserRole[];
  requireAuth?: boolean;
  fallback?: ReactNode;
  requiredPermissions?: PermissionType[];
  requiredClearanceLevel?: string;
};

export function PermissionGuard({
  children,
  permission,
  allowedRoles,
  requireAuth = true,
  fallback,
  requiredPermissions,
  requiredClearanceLevel
}: PermissionGuardProps) {
  const { dbUser, isAuthenticated, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const user = dbUser as UserCS;

  // Initialize services with memoization for performance
  const logtoService = useMemo(() => new LogtoService(), []);
  const permissionEvaluator = useMemo(() => {
    if (!user) return null;
    // PermissionEvaluator constructor expects specific parameters
    // Use a valid role ID from ROLE_IDS if organizationRoleId is not available
    const roleId = user.organizationRoleId || 'y3xwwl7cpwrc8ye1o3yxn'; // Default to L1_USER
    return new PermissionEvaluator(
      roleId,
      user.permissions || [],
      user.activeTeamId?.toString() || 'no-team',
      user.attributes?.function?.primary || FunctionPrimaryRole.VIEWER,
      user.attributes?.clearance?.level || ClearanceSecurityLevel.PUBLIC,
      user.attributes?.clearance?.scope || []
    );
  }, [user]);

  // Early returns for loading and authentication states
  if (isLoading) {
    return fallback || <div>Loading...</div>;
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated || !user || !permissionEvaluator) {
    return fallback || <div>Please log in to access this content.</div>;
  }

  // Check if user is active
  if (user && !user.onboardingCompleted) {
    return fallback || <AccountInactive />;
  }

  // Check clearance level
  if (requiredClearanceLevel) {
    const userClearanceLevel = parseInt(
      user.currentLevel?.replace('L', '') || '0'
    );
    const requiredLevel = parseInt(requiredClearanceLevel.replace('L', ''));

    if (userClearanceLevel < requiredLevel) {
      return (
        fallback || (
          <div>
            Insufficient clearance level. Required: {requiredClearanceLevel},
            Current: {user.currentLevel}
          </div>
        )
      );
    }
  }

  // Check permissions
  if (requiredPermissions && requiredPermissions.length > 0) {
    const hasRequiredPermissions = requiredPermissions.every((permission) => {
      const result = permissionEvaluator.evaluatePermission(permission);
      return result.allowed;
    });

    if (!hasRequiredPermissions) {
      const failedPermissions = requiredPermissions.filter((permission) => {
        const result = permissionEvaluator.evaluatePermission(permission);
        return !result.allowed;
      });

      return (
        fallback || (
          <div>
            Insufficient permissions. Missing: {failedPermissions.join(', ')}
          </div>
        )
      );
    }
  }

  // Check permission if provided
  if (permission && user && !hasPermission(user, permission)) {
    return fallback || <PermissionDenied permission={permission} />;
  }

  // Check role if provided
  if (
    allowedRoles &&
    user &&
    !allowedRoles.includes(user.organizationRoleId ?? 'anonymous')
  ) {
    return (
      fallback || (
        <RoleDenied
          allowedRoles={allowedRoles}
          userRole={user.organizationRoleId ?? 'anonymous'}
        />
      )
    );
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}

// Convenience components for common use cases
export function RequirePermission({
  permission,
  children,
  fallback
}: {
  permission: Permission | PermissionType;
  children: ReactNode;
  fallback?: ReactNode;
}) {
  // Handle both old Permission type and new PermissionType
  if (
    typeof permission === 'string' &&
    Object.values(PermissionType).includes(permission as PermissionType)
  ) {
    return (
      <PermissionGuard
        requiredPermissions={[permission as PermissionType]}
        fallback={fallback}
      >
        {children}
      </PermissionGuard>
    );
  }

  return (
    <PermissionGuard permission={permission as Permission} fallback={fallback}>
      {children}
    </PermissionGuard>
  );
}

export function RequireRole({
  role,
  children,
  fallback
}: {
  role: UserRole;
  children: ReactNode;
  fallback?: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <PermissionGuard allowedRoles={[role]} fallback={fallback}>
      {children}
    </PermissionGuard>
  );
}

export function RequireClearanceLevel({
  level,
  children,
  fallback
}: {
  level: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  fallback?: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <PermissionGuard requiredClearanceLevel={level} fallback={fallback}>
      {children}
    </PermissionGuard>
  );
}

export function RequireAdmin({
  children,
  fallback
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  fallback?: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <PermissionGuard allowedRoles={['SUPER_ADMIN']} fallback={fallback}>
      {children}
    </PermissionGuard>
  );
}

export async function generateStaticParams() {

    getRandomUUID(),
    'organization-source-systems-ssg'
  );
  try {
    logger.info('Generating static params for source systems');
    const organizationsRequest = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations?bypassToken=${process.env.BYPASS_TOKEN}`
    );
    const organizationsResponse: GetAllOrganizationsResponse =
      await organizationsRequest.json();

      organizationsResponse.organizations.logto ||
      organizationsResponse.organizations.database;

      organizationId: org.id
    }));

    logger.error('Error generating static params for source systems', {
      error
    });
    return [];
  }
}

import type { LogtoContext } from '@logto/next';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';

import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getErrorRedirect,
  getRandomUUID
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

import { getServerLogger } from './server-logger';

/**
 * Checks if a user exists in the database and creates them if they don't
 * @param userId - The user ID to check
 * @param claims - The claims object from Logto context
 * @param cookieStore - The cookie store containing authentication cookies
 * @returns A promise that resolves to the user data if exists or was created successfully, null otherwise
 */
export async function checkUserInDatabase(
  userId: string,
  claims: LogtoContext['claims'] | null,
  cookieStore: { name: string; value: string }[]
): Promise<{
  database: { onboardingCompleted: boolean };
} | null> {
  if (!userId || !claims) {
    return null;
  }

  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookieStore);

  try {
    const userResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/users/${userId}`,
      {
        method: 'GET',
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString
        }
      }
    );

    const userData = await userResponse.json();

    if (
      !userResponse.ok ||
      userData.message !== 'User retrieved successfully' ||
      !userData.user.database
    ) {
      // User doesn't exist, create them
      const createUserResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/users`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            id: claims.sub,
            logtoId: claims.sub,
            username: generateRandomUsername(claims.name || claims.email || ''),
            primaryEmail: claims.email,
            organizationRoleId: 1
          })
        }
      );

      if (!createUserResponse.ok) {
        console.error(
          'Failed to create user:',
          await createUserResponse.text()
        );
        return null;
      }

      const newUserData = await createUserResponse.json();
      return newUserData.user;
    }

    return userData.user;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error checking/creating user in database:', error);
    return null;
  }
}

export function generateRandomUsername(phrase: string) {
  // check if phrase is an email
  // if it is, use the first part of the email to form the username
  let username = '';
  if (phrase.includes('@')) {
    username = phrase.split('@')[0];
  }

  // check if phrase is a name
  // if it is, use the first part of the name to form the username
  if (phrase.includes(' ')) {
    username = phrase.split(' ')[0];
  }

  // if it is not an email or a name, use the phrase as the username
  if (!username) {
    username = phrase;
  }

  // check for username length and trim it to 20 characters
  if (username.length > 20) {
    username = username.substring(0, 20);
  }

  const randomString = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);
  return `${username}_${randomString}`;
}

/**
 * Handles user check for Logto authentication in middleware.
 * @param claims - The claims object from Logto context
 * @param logger - The logger
 * @param cookieString - The cookie string
 * @returns A promise that resolves to true if the user is found or created successfully, false otherwise
 */
export async function handleMiddlewareUserCheck(
  claims: LogtoContext['claims'] | null,
  logger: ReturnType<typeof getServerLogger>,
  cookieString: string
) {
  if (!claims?.sub) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    logger.info('Checking user in database', {
      userId: claims.sub,
      cookieHeader: cookieString
    });

    const userResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/users/${claims.sub}`,
      {
        method: 'GET',
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString
        }
      }
    );

    const userData = await userResponse.json();

    if (
      !userResponse.ok ||
      userData.message !== 'User retrieved successfully' ||
      !userData.user.database
    ) {
      logger.info('User not found in database, creating user', {
        userId: claims.sub
      });

      const createUserResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/users`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            id: claims.sub,
            logtoId: claims.sub,
            username: generateRandomUsername(claims.name || claims.email || ''),
            primaryEmail: claims.email,
            organizationRoleId: 1
          })
        }
      );

      if (!createUserResponse.ok) {
        logger.error('Failed to create user', {
          error: await createUserResponse.text()
        });
        return false;
      }

      logger.info('User created successfully', {
        userId: claims.sub
      });

      return true;
    }

    logger.info('User found in database', {
      userId: claims.sub,
      onboardingCompleted: userData.user.database.onboardingCompleted
    });

    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error in middleware user check', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    });
    console.error(error);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Handles user check for Logto authentication.
 *
 * @param claims - The claims object from Logto context.
 * @param request - The request object.
 * @param cookieStore - The cookie store object.
 * @param isCallback - Whether the request is a callback.
 * @returns A promise that resolves to null if the user is not found, or the user data if the user is found.
 */
export async function handleUserCheck(
  claims: LogtoContext['claims'] | null,
  request: NextRequest,
  isCallback = false,
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies
) {
  if (!claims?.sub) {
    return null;
  }

  const requestId = request.headers.get('x-request-id') ?? getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'user-check');

  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  try {
    logger.info('Checking user in database', {
      userId: claims.sub,
      cookieString
    });

    const userResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/users/${claims.sub}`,
      {
        method: 'GET',
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString
        }
      }
    );

    const userData = await userResponse.json();

    if (
      !userResponse.ok ||
      userData.message !== 'User retrieved successfully' ||
      !userData.user.database
    ) {
      logger.info('User not found in database, creating user', {
        userId: claims.sub
      });

      const createUserResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/users`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            id: claims.sub,
            logtoId: claims.sub,
            username: generateRandomUsername(claims.name || claims.email || ''),
            primaryEmail: claims.email,
            organizationRoleId: 1
          })
        }
      );

      if (!createUserResponse.ok) {
        logger.error('Failed to create user', {
          error: await createUserResponse.text()
        });
        return isCallback
          ? null
          : NextResponse.redirect(
              new URL(
                getErrorRedirect('/', 'Error', 'Failed to create user.'),
                request.url
              )
            );
      }

      logger.info('User created successfully', {
        userId: claims.sub
      });

      return isCallback
        ? null
        : NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/onboarding', request.url));
    }

    logger.info('User found in database', {
      userId: claims.sub,
      onboardingCompleted: userData.user.database.onboardingCompleted
    });

    if (!userData.user.database.onboardingCompleted && !isCallback) {
      return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/onboarding', request.url));
    }

    return null;
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error in user check', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    });
    return isCallback
      ? null
      : NextResponse.redirect(
          new URL(
            getErrorRedirect('/', 'Error', 'An unexpected error occurred.'),
            request.url
          )
        );
  }
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/table';

  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import { MoreHorizontal } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getUserRoleNameFromRole,
  hasPermissionToRemoveOrganizationUser
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/select';
import { ROLES } from '@/lib/logto-roles-and-permissions';
import SearchInput from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/search-input';
import type { DeleteOrganizationUserResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organizations';
import type { UpdateOrganizationRolesForAUserResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organization-roles';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';

type UserManagementProps = {
  organizationId: string;
  organizationUsers: any[];
  currentUserId: string;
  onUpdateUsersAction: () => void;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}

export default function UserManagement({
  organizationId,
  organizationUsers,
  currentUserId,
  onUpdateUsersAction,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<UserManagementProps>) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [users, setUsers] = useState(organizationUsers);
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  const filteredUsers = users.filter((user) =>
    user.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  const currentUser = users.find((user) => user.id === currentUserId);

  clientLogger.info('Rendering user management component', {
    organizationId,
    users,
    currentUser
  });

  const handleRemoveUser = async (userId: string) => {
    clientLogger.info('Removing user from organization', {
      organizationId,
      userId
    });
    try {
      const response: DeleteOrganizationUserResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}/users/${userId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'DELETE',
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          }
        }
      ).then((res) => res.json());
      if (response.message !== 'User removed from organization successfully') {
        toast.error(response.message);
      } else {
        setUsers(users.filter((user) => user.id !== userId));
        onUpdateUsersAction();
        toast.success(response.message);
      }
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        toast.error(
          `Failed to remove user from organization: ${error.message}`
        );
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to remove user from organization');
      }
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateUserRole = async (userId: string, newRole: string) => {
    try {
      clientLogger.info('Updating user role', {
        organizationId,
        userId,
        newRole
      });
      const response: UpdateOrganizationRolesForAUserResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-roles/${organizationId}/users/${userId}/roles?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'PUT',
          cache: 'no-store',
          body: JSON.stringify({
            organizationRoleIds: [newRole]
          }),
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          }
        }
      ).then((res) => res.json());
      setUsers(
        users.map((user) =>
          user.id === userId
            ? {
                ...user,
                organizationRoles: [
                  {
                    id: newRole,
                    name: getRoleNameById(newRole)
                  }
                ]
              }
            : user
        )
      );
      if (
        response.message !== 'Organization roles updated for user successfully'
      ) {
        toast.error(response.message);
      } else toast.success(response.message);
      onUpdateUsersAction();
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to update user role');
    }
  };

  const getRoleNameById = (roleId: string): string => {
    const role = Object.entries(ROLES).find(
      ([key, value]) => value.id === roleId
    );
    return role ? role[1].name : 'Unknown Role';
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <div className='mb-6 flex items-center justify-between'>
        <div className='relative'>
          <SearchInput
            label='Search members...'
            showLabel={false}
            placeholder='Search members...'
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(value) => setSearchTerm(value)}
            className='pl-10'
          />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className='overflow-x-auto'>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Name</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Email</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Role</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Actions</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {filteredUsers.map((user) => (
              <TableRow key={user.id}>
                <TableCell className='font-medium'>{user.name}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{user.primaryEmail}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {user.organizationRoles.map((role: any) => (
                    <span
                      key={role.id}
                      className='mr-2 inline-block rounded-full bg-primary/10 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-primary'
                    >
                      {getUserRoleNameFromRole(role.name)}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <DropdownMenu>
                    <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                      <Button variant='ghost' className='h-8 w-8 p-0'>
                        <MoreHorizontal className='h-4 w-4' />
                      </Button>
                    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                    <DropdownMenuContent align='end'>
                      <Dialog>
                        <DialogTrigger asChild>
                          <DropdownMenuItem
                            onSelect={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                          >
                            Update Role
                          </DropdownMenuItem>
                        </DialogTrigger>
                        <DialogContent>
                          <DialogHeader>
                            <DialogTitle>Update User Role</DialogTitle>
                            <DialogDescription>
                              Select a new role for {user.name}
                            </DialogDescription>
                          </DialogHeader>
                          <Select
                            onValueChange={(value) =>
                              handleUpdateUserRole(user.id, value)
                            }
                            defaultValue={user.organizationRoles[0]?.id}
                          >
                            <SelectTrigger>
                              <SelectValue placeholder='Select a role' />
                            </SelectTrigger>
                            <SelectContent>
                              {Object.entries(ROLES)
                                .filter((role) => {
                                  return role[1].name !== 'Super_Admin';
                                })
                                .map(([key, role]) => (
                                  <SelectItem key={role.id} value={role.id}>
                                    {role.description}
                                  </SelectItem>
                                ))}
                            </SelectContent>
                          </Select>
                        </DialogContent>
                      </Dialog>
                      {currentUser &&
                        hasPermissionToRemoveOrganizationUser(
                          currentUser,
                          user
                        ) && (
                          <DropdownMenuItem
                            onSelect={() => handleRemoveUser(user.id)}
                            className='text-red-600 focus:text-red-600 focus-visible:text-red-600'
                          >
                            Remove from Organization
                          </DropdownMenuItem>
                        )}
                    </DropdownMenuContent>
                  </DropdownMenu>
                </TableCell>

            ))}

  );
}
