'use client';

import { useSortable } from '@dnd-kit/sortable';
import type { FormElementInstance } from './types';
import { FormElementExampleLabels, FormElements } from './form-elements';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { Eye, GripVertical, Trash2, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { useFormBuilderStore } from '@signvault/frontend/components/form-builder/store-provider';
import { CSS } from '@dnd-kit/utilities';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { Switch } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/switch';
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
  TooltipContent
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/tooltip';
import { OptionsTagInputField } from '../form/options-tag-input-field';
import { cn } from '@signvault/ui-lib/lib/utils';

const propertiesSchema = z.object({
  label: z.string().min(2, 'Name must be at least 2 characters.'),
  description: z.string().optional(),
  required: z.boolean().optional(),
  options: z.string().optional()
});

type PropertiesFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof propertiesSchema>;

export default function FieldWrapper({
  element,
  className
}: {
  element: FormElementInstance;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const { removeElement, updateElement } = useFormBuilderStore();
  const DesignerComponent = FormElements[element.type].designerComponent;
  const [isPreviewing, setIsPreviewing] = useState(false);
  const {
    attributes,
    listeners,
    setNodeRef,
    transform,
    transition,
    isDragging
  } = useSortable({
    id: element.id,
    data: {
      type: element.type,
      elementId: element.id,
      isCanvasElement: true
    }
  });

  const { icon: Icon, label: fieldLabel } =
    FormElements[element.type].designerButtonElement;

  const form = useForm<PropertiesFormSchemaType>({
    resolver: zodResolver(propertiesSchema),
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      label: element.label,
      description: element.description,
      required: element.required
    }
  });

  const labelInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    form.reset({
      label: element.label,
      description: element.description,
      required: element.required,
      options: element.options?.join(',')
    });
    // Enable auto-focus by disabling this
    // if (!element.label && labelInputRef.current) {
    //   labelInputRef.current.focus();
    // }
  }, [element, form]);

  const applyChanges = (values: PropertiesFormSchemaType) => {
    updateElement(element.id, {
      ...element,
      ...values,
      options: values.options?.split(',') ?? []
    });
  };

  const style = {
    transform: CSS.Transform.toString(transform),
    transition
  };

  if (isDragging) {
    return (
      <div
        ref={setNodeRef}
        style={style}
        className={cn('w-full rounded-lg bg-primary/30', className)}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      ref={setNodeRef}
      style={style}
      className={cn(
        'group relative flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg border bg-white dark:bg-card dark:border-solid dark:border-border dark:border-1 p-4 transition-colors',
        className
      )}
    >
      <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
        <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
          <div
            {...attributes}
            {...listeners}
            className='cursor-grab rounded-md bg-muted/60 px-3 py-1.5 transition-all hover:bg-muted/50 dark:bg-secondary/50 dark:hover:bg-secondary/60'
          >
            <GripVertical className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 text-foreground' />
          </div>
          <div className='flex flex-row items-center gap-2'>
            <Icon className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 text-primary' />
            <p className='text-md inline-flex flex-row gap-1'>
              <span>{fieldLabel}</span>{' '}
              <span className='hidden sm:block'>Field</span>
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
          <TooltipProvider>
            <Tooltip>
              <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                <Button
                  className={cn('size-8', isPreviewing && 'border-none')}
                  disabled={form.formState.isDirty}
                  variant={isPreviewing ? 'light' : 'secondary'}
                  size='icon'
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    setIsPreviewing(!isPreviewing);
                  }}
                >
                  {isPreviewing ? (
                    <EyeOff className='size-4' />
                  ) : (
                    <Eye className='size-4' />
                  )}
                </Button>
              </TooltipTrigger>
              <TooltipContent className='bg-foreground text-background'>
                {isPreviewing ? 'Hide preview' : 'Preview field'}
              </TooltipContent>
            </Tooltip>
            <Tooltip>
              <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                <Button
                  className='size-8 bg-destructive/10 hover:bg-destructive/20 focus:bg-destructive/20'
                  variant='light'
                  size='icon'
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    removeElement(element.id);
                  }}
                >
                  <Trash2 className='size-4 text-destructive' />
                </Button>
              </TooltipTrigger>
              <TooltipContent className='bg-foreground text-background'>
                Remove field
              </TooltipContent>
            </Tooltip>
          </TooltipProvider>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Form {...form}>
        <form
          onBlur={form.handleSubmit(applyChanges)}
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
          }}
          className='flex flex-col gap-1.5'
        >
          <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2'>
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='label'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
                  <FormLabel>Name</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Input
                      placeholder={`Name of the ${fieldLabel} field (e.g. ${FormElementExampleLabels[element.type]})`}
                      {...field}
                      ref={labelInputRef}
                      className='bg-background'
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            {element.hasOwnProperty('required') && (
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='required'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem className='flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-lg border bg-background px-4 py-2'>
                    <div className=''>
                      <FormLabel className='text-sm'>Required</FormLabel>
                      <FormDescription className='text-xs'>
                        Mark this field as required.
                      </FormDescription>
                    </div>
                    <FormControl className='mt-0'>
                      <Switch
                        checked={field.value}
                        onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                          field.onChange(checked);
                          form.handleSubmit(applyChanges)();
                        }}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            )}
          </div>
          {element.hasOwnProperty('options') &&
            (element.type === 'select' || element.type === 'multi-select') && (
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='options'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
                    <FormLabel>Options</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <OptionsTagInputField
                        value={field.value ?? ''}
                        onChange={field.onChange}
                        styleClasses={{
                          inlineTagsContainer: 'bg-background'
                        }}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            )}
          {element.hasOwnProperty('description') && (
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='description'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
                  <FormLabel>Description (optional)</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Input
                      placeholder='Help text for the user, displayed below the field name (e.g. "Enter your email address")'
                      {...field}
                      className='max-h-14 min-h-0 resize-none bg-background'
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
          )}
        </form>
      </Form>

      {isPreviewing && (
        <div className='flex flex-col gap-2'>
          <h4 className='text-md'>Preview (User view)</h4>
          <div className='pointer-events-none select-none'>
            <DesignerComponent element={element} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/api/auth/twitter/callback/route.ts ===

import type {
  GetUserResponse,
  UpdateUserCustomDataResponse,
  UpdateUserResponse,
  UpdateUserSocialProfilesResponse
} from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/v2/users';

import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import { twitterParams } from '@/lib/twitter';
import {
  getErrorRedirect,
  getRandomUUID,
  getStatusRedirect
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { auth, Client } from 'twitter-api-sdk';
import { type TwitterParams } from 'twitter-api-sdk/dist/types';

const TWITTER_CLIENT_ID = process.env.TWITTER_CLIENT_ID;
const TWITTER_CLIENT_SECRET = process.env.TWITTER_CLIENT_SECRET;
const TWITTER_REDIRECT_URI = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/auth/twitter/callback`;

/**
 * Handles the Twitter callback.
 * @param req - The request object.
 * @returns A redirect response.
 */
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  // Setup logger
  const requestId = req.headers.get('x-request-id') ?? getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'twitter-callback');

  // Get code and state from request
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const code = searchParams.get('code');
  const state = searchParams.get('state');

  // Check if code and state are missing or invalid
  if (!code || state !== 'twitter-state') {
    logger.warn('Invalid request parameters', {
      code,
      state
    });
    return NextResponse.redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings/social-media`,
        'Invalid request',
        'The request to connect your Twitter account is invalid. Please try again.'
      )
    );
  }

  try {
    // Get Logto context
    logger.info('Fetching Logto context');
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

    // Check if claims are missing or invalid
    if (!claims || !claims.sub) {
      logger.warn('Invalid Logto claims', { claims });
      return NextResponse.redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings/social-media`,
          'Invalid request',
          'The request to connect your Twitter account is invalid. Please try again.'
        )
      );
    }

    // Get user data
    logger.info('Fetching user data', {
      userId: claims.sub
    });
    const userResponse: GetUserResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users/logto/${claims.sub}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'x-user-logto-id': claims.sub,
          'x-middleware-bypass-token':
            process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
        }
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());

    // Check if user data is missing or retrieval failed
    const userData =
      userResponse.user.logto ?? userResponse.user.database ?? null;

    // Check if user data is missing or retrieval failed
    if (!userData || userResponse.code !== 'user.found') {
      logger.warn('User not found or retrieval failed', {
        userId: userResponse.user.database.id,
        code: userResponse.code
      });
      return NextResponse.redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings/social-media`,
          'User not found',
          'The user associated with your account was not found. Please try again.'
        )
      );
    }

    // Initialize Twitter OAuth client
    logger.info('Initializing Twitter OAuth client');
    const authClient = new auth.OAuth2User({
      client_id: TWITTER_CLIENT_ID,
      client_secret: TWITTER_CLIENT_SECRET,
      callback: TWITTER_REDIRECT_URI,
      scopes: ['tweet.read', 'users.read', 'offline.access']
    });

    // Generate authorization URL
    authClient.generateAuthURL({
      state: 'twitter-state',
      code_challenge: 'challenge',
      code_challenge_method: 'plain'
    });

    // Request Twitter access token
    logger.info('Requesting Twitter access token');
    await authClient.requestAccessToken(code);

    // Initialize Twitter client
    const client = new Client(authClient);

    // Fetch Twitter user data
    logger.info('Fetching Twitter user data');
    const { data: twitterUser } = await client.users.findMyUser({
      'tweet.fields': twitterParams[
        'tweet.fields'
      ] as TwitterParams<'tweet.fields'>,
      'expansions': twitterParams['expansions'] as TwitterParams<'expansions'>,
      'user.fields': twitterParams[
        'user.fields'
      ] as TwitterParams<'user.fields'>
    });

    // Check if Twitter user data is missing or retrieval failed
    if (!twitterUser) {
      logger.error('Failed to fetch Twitter user data');
      throw new Error('Failed to fetch Twitter user data');
    }

    // Update user custom data with Twitter information
    logger.info('Updating user custom data with Twitter information');
    const newCustomData = {
      ...(userData.customData as Record<string, unknown>),
      twitter: {
        ...((userData.customData as Record<string, unknown>).twitter as Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >),
        connected: true,
        connected_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        ...twitterUser
      }
    };

    // Update user custom data
    const updateResponse: UpdateUserCustomDataResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users/${userResponse.user.database.id}/custom-data`,
      {
        method: 'PATCH',
        cache: 'no-store',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          customData: newCustomData,
          xVerified: twitterUser.verified
        }),
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'x-user-logto-id': claims.sub,
          'x-middleware-bypass-token':
            process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
        }
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());

    // Update user social profiles
    logger.info('Updating user social profiles');
    const updateSocialProfilesResponse: UpdateUserSocialProfilesResponse =
      await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users/${userResponse.user.database.id}/social-profiles`,
        {
          method: 'PATCH',
          body: JSON.stringify({
            socialProfiles: {
              twitter: `https://twitter.com/${twitterUser.username}`
            }
          }),
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'x-user-logto-id': claims.sub,
            'x-middleware-bypass-token':
              process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
          }
        }
      ).then((res) => res.json());

    if (updateSocialProfilesResponse.code !== 'user.updated') {
      logger.error('Failed to update user social profiles', {
        userId: userResponse.user.database.id
      });
      return NextResponse.redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings/social-media`,
          'Twitter connection failed',
          'Failed to connect your Twitter account. Please try again.'
        )
      );
    }

    if (updateResponse.code !== 'user.updated') {
      logger.error('Failed to update user custom data', {
        userId: userResponse.user.database.id
      });
      return NextResponse.redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings/social-media`,
          'Twitter connection failed',
          'Failed to connect your Twitter account. Please try again.'
        )
      );
    }

    // Update user role and verification status
    logger.info('Updating user role and verification status');
    const updatedUserResponse: UpdateUserResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users/${userResponse.user.database.id}?dbOnly=true`,
      {
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          xVerified: twitterUser.verified
        }),
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'x-user-logto-id': claims.sub,
          'x-middleware-bypass-token':
            process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
        }
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());

    // Check if user role and verification status are updated successfully
    if (updatedUserResponse.code !== 'user.updated') {
      logger.error('Failed to update user role or verification status', {
        userId: userResponse.user.database.id
      });
      return NextResponse.redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings/social-media`,
          'Twitter connection failed',
          'Failed to connect your Twitter account. Please try again.'
        )
      );
    }

    // Log success
    logger.info('Twitter account connected successfully', {
      userId: userResponse.user.database.id
    });

    // Return success response
    return NextResponse.redirect(
      getStatusRedirect(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings/social-media`,
        'Twitter connected',
        'Your Twitter account has been connected successfully.'
      )
    );
  } catch (error) {
    // Log error
    logger.error('Error connecting Twitter account', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    });

    // Return error response
    return NextResponse.redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings/social-media`,
        'Twitter Connection Failed',
        'Failed to connect your Twitter account. Please try again.'
      )
    );
  }
}

export async function generateMetadata({
  params
}: {
  params: { organizationId: string; contentId: string };
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'content-view-metadata');
  logger.info('Generating metadata for content view page');
  const { organizationId, contentId } = await params;

  const contentResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/content/${contentId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`
  );
  const content: GetContentResponse = await contentResponse.json();

  if (content.message !== 'Content retrieved successfully') {
    logger.error('Content not found', {
      organizationId,
      contentId
    });
    return {
      title: 'Content View'
    };
  }

  if (!content.content.database) {
    logger.error('Content not found', {
      organizationId,
      contentId
    });
    return {
      title: 'Content View'
    };
  }

  return {
    title: `View ${content.content.database.title}`,
    description: `View the content for ${content.content.database.title}. Content description: ${content.content.database.description}`,
    keywords: `view ${content.content.database.title}, ${content.content.database.title} content, ${content.content.database.title} description, ${content.content.database.title} organization, ${content.content.database.title}`,
    robots: 'index, follow',
    openGraph: {
      title: `View ${content.content.database.title}`,
      description: `View the content for ${content.content.database.title}. Content description: ${content.content.database.description}`,
      images: [
        {
          url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`,
          alt: content.content.database.title
        }
      ],
      type: 'website',
      siteName: 'SignVault',
      locale: 'en_US',
      url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/organizations/${organizationId}/content/${contentId}/view`
    },
    twitter: {
      title: `View ${content.content.database.title}`,
      description: `View the content for ${content.content.database.title}. Content description: ${content.content.database.description}`,
      images: [`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`],
      creator: '@signvault',
      site: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/organizations/${organizationId}/content/${contentId}/view`,

    },
    icons: {

export default async function ContentViewPage({
  params
}: Readonly<{
  params: { organizationId: string; contentId: string };
}>) {
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'content-view');
  const { organizationId, contentId } = await params;
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  try {
    logger.info('Accessing content view page', {
      organizationId,
      contentId
    });

    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

    if (!claims) {
      logger.warn('User not authenticated', {
        organizationId,
        contentId
      });
      return redirect(
        getErrorRedirect('/account/settings/basic', 'Unauthorized')
      );
    }

    logger.info('Fetching organization data', {
      organizationId
    });
    const organizationResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString
        }
      }
    );
    const organizationResponseData: GetOrganizationResponse =
      await organizationResponse.json();

    if (
      organizationResponseData.message !== 'Organization retrieved successfully'
    ) {
      logger.error('Organization not found', {
        organizationId
      });
      return redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/content`,
          'Organization not found'
        )
      );
    }

    const organization =
      organizationResponseData.organization.database ||
      organizationResponseData.organization.logto;

    if (!organization) {
      logger.error('Invalid organization data', {
        organizationId
      });
      return redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/content`,
          'Organization not found'
        )
      );
    }

    logger.info('Content view page loaded successfully', {
      organizationId,
      contentId,
      organizationName: organization.name
    });

    const contentResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/content/${contentId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString
        }
      }
    );
    const content: GetContentResponse = await contentResponse.json();

    if (
      !content.content.database ||
      content.message !== 'Content retrieved successfully'
    ) {
      return redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/content`,
          'Content not found',
          'The content you are trying to access does not exist.'
        )
      );
    }

    return (
      <>
        <Button variant='outline' asChild className='mb-8' size='sm'>
          <Link
            href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/content/${contentId}`}
            className='text-foreground no-underline'
          >
            <ChevronLeft className='mr-1 size-4' />
            Back to content details
          </Link>
        </Button>
        <div className='mb-8 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4'>
          <Badge
            variant={
              content.content.database.status === 'ACTIVE'
                ? 'default'
                : 'secondary'
            }
          >
            {content.content.database.status === 'ACTIVE' ? (
              <CheckCircle className='mr-1 size-3' strokeWidth={2.5} />
            ) : (
              <Ellipsis className='mr-1 size-3' strokeWidth={2.5} />
            )}
            {toTitleCase(
              content.content.database.status.toLowerCase().replace(/_/gu, ' ')
            )}
          </Badge>
          {content.content.database.organizationSourceSystemRef &&
            (() => {
              const organizationSourceSystemRef = JSON.parse(
                JSON.stringify(
                  content.content.database.organizationSourceSystemRef
                )
              );
              return (
                <Link
                  href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/source-systems/${organizationSourceSystemRef.sourceSystemId}`}
                  className='group text-sm text-muted-foreground no-underline transition-colors hover:text-primary'
                >
                  <Badge
                    variant='outline'
                    className='flex items-center gap-1 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out group-hover:bg-primary/10'
                  >
                    <TableOfContents className='size-3' />
                    <span className='text-xs'>
                      {organizationSourceSystemRef.sourceSystemName}
                    </span>
                  </Badge>
                </Link>
              );
            })()}
        </div>
        <article className='prose prose-sm prose-purple mx-auto max-w-full! sm:prose-sm md:prose-base lg:prose-lg xl:prose-lg prose-headings:break-words'>
          {/* <h1>{content.content.database.title}</h1> */}
          <div
            className='mt-8'
            dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
              __html: replaceEmptyParagraphsWithBr(
                htmlSanitize(content.content.database.content)
              )
            }}
          />
        </article>
      </>
    );
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error in content view page', {
      organizationId,
      contentId,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect('/account/settings/basic', 'Error loading content')
    );
  }
}

    case NotificationStatus_.DELIVERED:

    case NotificationStatus_.DELIVERING:
      return ArrowRightLeft;
    case NotificationStatus_.FAILED:
      return MailWarning;

export function NotificationList({
  notifications
}: Readonly<NotificationListProps>) {
  const { markAsRead, isLoading } = useNotifications();
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
  }, []);

  const handleNotificationClick = async (notification: NotificationANS) => {
    if (notification.status !== NotificationStatus_.READ) {
      await markAsRead(notification.id);
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return <NotificationListSkeleton />;
  }

  if (!mounted) {
    return <NotificationListSkeleton />;
  }

  if (notifications.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className='flex items-center justify-center p-6 text-muted-foreground'>
        No notifications to display
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className='flex h-[500px] flex-col gap-4 overflow-y-auto'>
      {notifications.map((notification) => {
        const id = getNotificationId(notification);
        const title = getNotificationTitle(notification);
        const message = getNotificationMessage(notification);
        const date = getNotificationDate(notification);
        const isUnread = notification.status !== 'READ';

        return (
          <Link
            href={`/account/notifications/${id}`}
            key={id}
            onClick={() => handleNotificationClick(notification)}
          >
            <Card
              className={`cursor-pointer p-4 transition-colors duration-300 ease-in-out hover:bg-accent/5 ${
                isUnread ? 'bg-accent/5' : ''
              }`}
            >
              <div className='space-y-1'>
                <div className='flex flex-col items-start justify-start gap-2 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between'>
                  <h4 className='line-clamp-1 max-w-[400px] truncate break-all font-britanica text-lg font-medium'>
                    {title}
                  </h4>
                  <div className='mb-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 md:mb-0'>
                    {notification.notificationType && (
                      <React.Fragment>
                        {notification.notificationType && (
                          <Badge
                            className='inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 border border-line text-xs text-muted-foreground'
                            variant='simple'
                          >
                            {(() => {
                              const Icon = getNotificationTypeIcon(
                                notification.notificationType as NotificationTypePS
                              );
                              return (
                                <Icon className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3' />
                              );
                            })()}
                            {
                              NOTIFICATION_TYPE_LABELS[
                                notification.notificationType as NotificationTypePS
                              ]
                            }
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                        {notification.status && (
                          <Badge
                            className='inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 border border-line text-xs text-muted-foreground'
                            variant='simple'
                          >
                            {(() => {

                              );
                              return (
                                <Icon className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3' />
                              );
                            })()}
                            {toTitleCase(notification.status)}
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </React.Fragment>
                    )}
                    <Badge
                      className='inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 border border-line text-xs text-muted-foreground'
                      variant='simple'
                    >
                      <Clock className='size-3' />
                      {formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true })}

                  {message}

    </div>
  );

'use client';

import { format, isAfter, isBefore } from 'date-fns';
import {
  Avatar,
  AvatarFallback,
  AvatarImage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/avatar';
import { Badge } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/card';
import { Clock, MapPin, PlusCircle, Users } from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  Tabs,
  TabsContent,
  TabsList,
  TabsTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/tabs';
import { EventFilters } from './event-filters';
import { useQueryParam, StringParam, withDefault } from 'use-query-params';
import type { GetTeamCalendarEventsResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/team-calendar-events';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/tooltip';

type AllTeamEventsPageProps = {
  events: GetTeamCalendarEventsResponse['events']['database'];
  organizationId: string;
  teamId: string;
}

export function AllTeamEventsPage({
  events: allEvents,
  organizationId,
  teamId
}: Readonly<AllTeamEventsPageProps>) {
  // Set up query params with defaults
  const [search, setUrlSearch] = useQueryParam(
    'search',
    withDefault(StringParam, '')
  );
  const [startDate, setUrlStartDate] = useQueryParam(
    'startDate',
    withDefault(StringParam, '')
  );
  const [endDate, setUrlEndDate] = useQueryParam(
    'endDate',
    withDefault(StringParam, '')
  );
  const [eventType, setUrlEventType] = useQueryParam(
    'eventType',
    withDefault(StringParam, '')
  );

  // Local state for immediate UI updates
  const [localSearch, setLocalSearch] = useState(search);
  const [localStartDate, setLocalStartDate] = useState(startDate);
  const [localEndDate, setLocalEndDate] = useState(endDate);
  const [localEventType, setLocalEventType] = useState(eventType);

  // Apply filters using local state for immediate feedback
  const filteredEvents = allEvents.filter((event) => {
    if (
      localStartDate &&
      isBefore(new Date(event.startDate), new Date(localStartDate))
    )
      return false;
    if (
      localEndDate &&
      isAfter(new Date(event.startDate), new Date(localEndDate))
    )
      return false;
    if (localEventType && event.eventType !== localEventType) return false;
    if (
      localSearch &&
      !event.title.toLowerCase().includes(localSearch.toLowerCase())
    )
      return false;
    return true;
  });

  // Split into upcoming and past events
  const now = new Date();
  const upcomingEvents = filteredEvents.filter((event) =>
    isAfter(new Date(event.startDate), now)
  );
  const pastEvents = filteredEvents.filter((event) =>
    isBefore(new Date(event.startDate), now)
  );

  // Handler for filter changes
  const handleFilterChange = (filters: {
    search?: string;
    startDate?: string;
    endDate?: string;
    eventType?: string;
  }) => {
    // Update local state immediately
    if ('search' in filters) setLocalSearch(filters.search);
    if ('startDate' in filters) setLocalStartDate(filters.startDate);
    if ('endDate' in filters) setLocalEndDate(filters.endDate);
    if ('eventType' in filters) setLocalEventType(filters.eventType);

    // Update URL state
    if ('search' in filters) setUrlSearch(filters.search);
    if ('startDate' in filters) setUrlStartDate(filters.startDate);
    if ('endDate' in filters) setUrlEndDate(filters.endDate);
    if ('eventType' in filters) setUrlEventType(filters.eventType);

    clientLogger.info('Changed event filters', {
      organizationId,
      teamId,
      filters
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className='container mx-auto space-y-6 py-6'>
      <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
        <div>
          <h1 className='text-2xl font-bold'>Team Events</h1>
          <p className='text-muted-foreground'>
            View and manage all team events
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
          <EventFilters
            defaultFilters={{
              search: localSearch,
              startDate: localStartDate,
              endDate: localEndDate,
              eventType: localEventType
            }}
            onFilterChange={handleFilterChange}
          />
          <Button asChild>
            <Link
              href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}/calendar`}
              className='flex items-center gap-2'
            >
              <PlusCircle className='h-4 w-4' />
              Create Event
            </Link>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Tabs defaultValue='upcoming'>
        <TabsList>
          <TabsTrigger value='upcoming'>
            Upcoming Events ({upcomingEvents.length})
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value='past'>
            Past Events ({pastEvents.length})
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value='upcoming' className='mt-6'>
          <div className='space-y-4'>
            {upcomingEvents.length > 0 ? (
              upcomingEvents.map((event) => (
                <EventCard
                  key={event.id}
                  event={event}
                  organizationId={organizationId}
                />
              ))
            ) : (
              <p className='py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground'>
                No upcoming events found.
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value='past' className='mt-6'>
          <div className='space-y-4'>
            {pastEvents.length > 0 ? (
              pastEvents.map((event) => (
                <EventCard
                  key={event.id}
                  event={event}
                  organizationId={organizationId}
                />
              ))
            ) : (
              <p className='py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground'>
                No past events found.
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

function getBadgeColor(eventType: string) {
  switch (eventType) {
    case 'MEETING':
      return 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-500 border-blue-500/30';
    case 'DEADLINE':
      return 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 border-red-500/30';
    case 'REMINDER':
      return 'bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-500 border-yellow-500/30';
    default:
      return 'bg-gray-500/10 text-gray-500 border-gray-500/30';
  }
}

function EventCard({
  event,
  organizationId
}: Readonly<{
  event: GetTeamCalendarEventsResponse['events']['database'][number];
  organizationId: string;
}>) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardContent className='p-6'>
        <div className='flex items-start justify-between'>
          <div className='space-y-1'>
            <Link
              href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${event.teamId}/events/${event.id}`}
              className='text-lg font-medium hover:underline'
            >
              {event.title}
            </Link>
            <div className='flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
              <div className='flex items-center gap-1'>
                <Clock className='h-4 w-4' />
                {format(new Date(event.startDate), 'PPp')}
              </div>
              {event.location && (
                <div className='flex items-center gap-1'>
                  <MapPin className='h-4 w-4' />
                  {event.location}
                </div>
              )}
              <div className='flex items-center gap-1'>
                <Users className='h-4 w-4' />
                {event.attendees?.length || 0} attendee
                {event.attendees?.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Badge variant='outline' className={getBadgeColor(event.eventType)}>
            {event.eventType}
          </Badge>
        </div>

        {event.description && (
          <p className='mt-4 line-clamp-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
            {event.description}
          </p>
        )}

        {event.attendees?.length > 0 && (
          <div className='mt-4 flex items-center -space-x-3'>
            {event.attendees.slice(0, 5).map((attendee) => (
              <TooltipProvider key={attendee.id}>
                <Tooltip>
                  <TooltipTrigger>
                    <Avatar
                      key={attendee.id}
                      className='border-2 border-background bg-background'
                    >
                      <AvatarImage
                        src={attendee.user?.avatar || '/default-avatar.png'}
                        alt={attendee.user?.name || 'Unknown'}
                      />
                      <AvatarFallback>
                        {attendee.user?.name?.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase() || '??'}
                      </AvatarFallback>
                    </Avatar>
                  </TooltipTrigger>
                  <TooltipContent>
                    {attendee.user?.name || 'Unknown'}
                  </TooltipContent>
                </Tooltip>
              </TooltipProvider>
            ))}
            {event.attendees.length > 5 && (
              <div className='relative flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-muted text-xs'>
                +{event.attendees.length - 5}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

'use client';

import { formatDate } from 'date-fns';
import type { TeamMemberActivityLog, User } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  Clock,
  User as UserIcon,
  MessageSquare,
  History,
  ArrowRightLeft,
  Info,
  Users as UsersIcon,
  GitCommit,
  Tag,
  Database
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Badge } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/badge';
import {
  TooltipContent,
  Tooltip,
  TooltipTrigger,
  TooltipProvider
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/tooltip';
import {
  Avatar,
  AvatarFallback,
  AvatarImage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/avatar';
import { toTitleCase } from '@/lib/utils';

type ActivityLogDetailsCardProps = {
  log: TeamMemberActivityLog;
  users: User[];
}

const container = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0 },
  show: {
    opacity: 1,
    transition: {
      staggerChildren: 0.1
    }
  }
};

const item = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 20 },
  show: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }
};

export function ActivityLogDetailsCard({
  log,
  users
}: Readonly<ActivityLogDetailsCardProps>) {
  const getUserName = (userId: string) => {
    const user = users.find((u) => u.id === userId);
    return user?.name || userId;
  };

  const performedByUser = users.find((u) => u.id === log.metadata.performedBy);

  const formatValue = (value: any) => {
    if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) {
      return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
    }
    return String(value);
  };

  return (
    <motion.div
      variants={container}
      initial='hidden'
      whileInView='show'
      viewport={{ once: true }}
      className='space-y-6 p-1'
    >
      <motion.div
        variants={item}
        className='space-y-4'
        whileInView='show'
        viewport={{ once: true }}
      >
        <div className='flex items-center gap-2 pb-2'>
          <MessageSquare className='h-5 w-5 text-primary' />
          <h4 className='text-sm font-semibold'>Activity Details</h4>
        </div>
        <div className='space-y-3 rounded-lg border p-4'>
          <div className='flex items-start gap-3'>
            <MessageSquare className='mt-1 h-4 min-h-4 w-4 min-w-4 text-foreground/90' />
            <div className='space-y-1'>
              <span className='text-sm font-medium'>Message</span>
              <p className='whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm text-foreground/90'>
                {log.details.message}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className='flex items-start gap-3'>
            <Clock className='mt-1 h-4 min-h-4 w-4 min-w-4 text-foreground/90' />
            <div className='space-y-1'>
              <span className='text-sm font-medium'>Timestamp</span>
              <p className='text-sm text-foreground/90'>
                {formatDate(new Date(log.details.changedAt), 'PPPPpppp')}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className='flex items-start gap-3'>
            <UserIcon className='mt-1 h-4 min-h-4 w-4 min-w-4 text-foreground/90' />
            <div className='space-y-1'>
              <span className='text-sm font-medium'>Changed By</span>
              <p className='text-sm text-foreground/90'>
                {getUserName(log.details.changedBy)}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </motion.div>

      {Object.keys(log.details.oldValues).length > 0 && (
        <motion.div variants={item}>
          <div className='flex items-center gap-2 pb-2'>
            <History className='h-5 w-5 text-primary' />
            <h4 className='text-sm font-semibold'>Previous State</h4>
          </div>
          <div className='rounded-lg border p-4'>
            <div className='space-y-2'>
              {Object.entries(log.details.oldValues).map(([key, value]) => (
                <div key={key} className='flex items-start gap-2'>
                  <Badge variant='outline'>{toTitleCase(key)}</Badge>
                  <span className='line-clamp-1 text-sm text-foreground/90'>
                    {formatValue(value)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}

      {Object.keys(log.details.newValues).length > 0 && (
        <motion.div variants={item}>
          <div className='flex items-center gap-2 pb-2'>
            <ArrowRightLeft className='h-5 w-5 text-primary' />
            <h4 className='text-sm font-semibold'>Updated State</h4>
          </div>
          <div className='rounded-lg border p-4'>
            <div className='space-y-2'>
              {Object.entries(log.details.newValues).map(([key, value]) => (
                <div key={key} className='flex items-start gap-2'>
                  <Badge variant='outline'>{toTitleCase(key)}</Badge>
                  <span className='line-clamp-1 text-sm text-foreground/90'>
                    {formatValue(value)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}

      {log.metadata && (
        <motion.div variants={item}>
          <div className='flex items-center gap-2 pb-4'>
            <Info className='h-5 w-5 text-primary' />
            <h4 className='text-sm font-semibold'>Additional Information</h4>
          </div>
          <div className='space-y-4 rounded-lg border p-4'>
            <div className='flex flex-col items-start gap-3'>
              <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                <Tag className='mt-1 h-4 min-h-4 w-4 min-w-4 text-foreground/90' />
                <span className='text-sm font-medium'>Version</span>
              </div>
              <Badge variant='secondary' className='ml-6'>
                {log.metadata.version ?? '1.0.0'}
              </Badge>
            </div>

            <div className='flex items-start gap-3'>
              <UsersIcon className='mt-1 h-4 min-h-4 w-4 min-w-4 text-foreground/90' />
              <div className='space-y-1'>
                <span className='text-sm font-medium'>Users Involved</span>
                <div className='flex flex-wrap gap-2 -space-x-4'>
                  <TooltipProvider>
                    {log.metadata.usersInvolved.map((userId) => {
                      const user = users.find((u) => u.id === userId);
                      return (
                        <Tooltip key={userId}>
                          <TooltipTrigger>
                            <Avatar className='size-8 border border-border'>
                              <AvatarImage src={user?.avatar} />
                              <AvatarFallback className='text-xs uppercase'>
                                {user?.name
                                  ?.split(' ')
                                  .map((word) => word[0])
                                  .join('')
                                  .slice(0, 2)}
                              </AvatarFallback>
                            </Avatar>
                          </TooltipTrigger>
                          <TooltipContent>{user?.name}</TooltipContent>
                        </Tooltip>
                      );
                    })}
                  </TooltipProvider>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className='flex items-start gap-3'>
              <div className='space-y-1'>
                <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                  <GitCommit className='mt-1 h-4 min-h-4 w-4 min-w-4 text-foreground/90' />
                  <span className='text-sm font-medium'>Performed By</span>
                </div>
                <TooltipProvider>
                  <Tooltip>
                    <TooltipTrigger>
                      <Avatar className='ml-7 size-8 border border-border'>
                        <AvatarImage src={performedByUser?.avatar} />
                        <AvatarFallback className='text-xs uppercase'>
                          {performedByUser?.name
                            ?.split(' ')
                            .map((word) => word[0])
                            .join('')
                            .slice(0, 2)}
                        </AvatarFallback>
                      </Avatar>
                    </TooltipTrigger>
                    <TooltipContent>
                      {getUserName(log.metadata.performedBy)}
                    </TooltipContent>
                  </Tooltip>
                </TooltipProvider>
              </div>
            </div>

            {log.metadata.metadata &&
              Object.keys(log.metadata.metadata).length > 0 && (
                <div className='flex items-start gap-3'>
                  <Database className='mt-1 h-4 min-h-4 w-4 min-w-4 text-foreground/90' />
                  <div className='space-y-1'>
                    <span className='text-sm font-medium'>
                      Additional Metadata
                    </span>
                    <div className='rounded-md bg-muted/50 p-2'>

/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any */

'use server';

import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import { provenanceRecordsPS } from '@signvault/db/schemas/provenance/schema';
import { customProvenanceQueriesCS } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/schema';
import { eq, and, or, sql, not, ilike, type SQL } from '@signvault/db/drizzle';
import type {
  ProvenanceRecords,
  CustomProvenanceQueryCS,
  CustomProvenanceQueryCSInsert,
  UserTypePS,
  ProvenanceEntityPSType
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { EntityIdGenerator } from '@signvault/core-id-ts';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getDbUser } from './auth';

function buildWhereClause(query: any): SQL | undefined {
  if (
    query &&
    typeof query === 'object' &&
    'combinator' in query &&
    'rules' in query &&
    Array.isArray(query.rules)
  ) {
    const conditions = query.rules
      .map((rule) => buildWhereClause(rule))
      .filter((c) => c !== undefined) as SQL[];
    if (conditions.length === 0) return undefined;
    return query.combinator === 'and' ? and(...conditions) : or(...conditions);
  }

  if (
    query &&
    typeof query === 'object' &&
    'field' in query &&
    'operator' in query
  ) {
    const { field, operator, value } = query;
    const column = (provenanceRecordsPS as Record<string, any>)[field];
    if (!column) throw new Error(`Invalid field: ${field}`);

    let processedValue: any = value;
    if (field === 'id' || field === 'userId' || field === 'entityId') {
      try {
        processedValue = BigInt(value);
      } catch (e) {
        /* ignore */
      }
    } else if (field === 'userType') {
      processedValue = value as UserTypePS;
    } else if (field === 'entityType') {
      processedValue = value as ProvenanceEntityPSType;
    }

    switch (operator) {
      case '=':
        return eq(column, processedValue);
      case '!=':
        return not(eq(column, processedValue));
      case 'contains':
        return ilike(column, `%${value}%`);
      case 'beginsWith':
        return ilike(column, `${value}%`);
      case 'endsWith':
        return ilike(column, `%${value}`);
      case 'doesNotContain':
        return not(ilike(column, `%${value}%`));
      case 'doesNotBeginWith':
        return not(ilike(column, `${value}%`));
      case 'doesNotEndWith':
        return not(ilike(column, `%${value}`));
      case 'null':
        return sql`${column} IS NULL`;
      case 'notNull':
        return sql`${column} IS NOT NULL`;
      default:
        throw new Error(`Unsupported operator: ${operator}`);
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * Execute a provenance query and return the results
 * @param queryAsString - The query object from the query builder, as a JSON string
 * @returns The query results
 */
export async function executeProvenanceQuery(queryAsString: string): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  data?: ProvenanceRecords[];
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    if (!claims) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };
    }

    const user = await getDbUser({ claims });
    if (!user) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not found' };
    }

    const query = JSON.parse(queryAsString);
    const whereClause = buildWhereClause(query);

    const conditions: (SQL | undefined)[] = [
      eq(provenanceRecordsPS.userId, user.id)
    ];
    if (whereClause) {
      conditions.push(whereClause);
    }

    const results = await db
      .select()
      .from(provenanceRecordsPS)
      .where(and(...conditions));

    return {
      success: true,
      data: results
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error executing provenance query:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Save a custom provenance query
 * @param queryData - The query data to save
 * @returns The saved query
 */
export async function saveProvenanceQuery(queryData: {
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  query: any;
  organizationId: string;
}): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  data?: CustomProvenanceQueryCS;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    if (!claims) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };
    }

    const user = await getDbUser({ claims });
    if (!user) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not found' };
    }

    const idGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();
    const queryId = await idGenerator.generateProvenanceId();

    const insertData: CustomProvenanceQueryCSInsert = {
      id: queryId,
      organizationId: BigInt(queryData.organizationId),
      name: queryData.name,
      query: queryData.query,
      createdBy: BigInt(user.id),
      // @ts-expect-error - description does not exist on the insert type
      description: queryData.description
    };

    const [savedQuery] = await db
      .insert(customProvenanceQueriesCS)
      .values(insertData)
      .returning();

    return { success: true, data: savedQuery };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error saving provenance query:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Get saved provenance queries for an organization
 * @param organizationId - The organization ID
 * @returns Array of saved queries
 */
export async function getSavedProvenanceQueries(
  organizationId: string
): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  data?: CustomProvenanceQueryCS[];
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const queries = await db
      .select()
      .from(customProvenanceQueriesCS)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(customProvenanceQueriesCS.organizationId, BigInt(organizationId)),
          eq(customProvenanceQueriesCS.isDeleted, false)
        )
      )
      .orderBy(customProvenanceQueriesCS.createdAt);

    return { success: true, data: queries };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching saved queries:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Execute a saved provenance query
 * @param queryId - The query ID to execute
 * @param organizationId - The organization ID for security verification
 * @returns The query results with metadata
 */
export async function executeSavedQuery(
  queryId: string,
  organizationId: string
): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  data?: ProvenanceRecords[];
  error?: string;
  executedQuery?: string;
  queryName?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    if (!claims) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };
    }

    const user = await getDbUser({ claims });
    if (!user) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not found' };
    }

    // First, get the saved query
    const [savedQuery] = await db
      .select()
      .from(customProvenanceQueriesCS)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(customProvenanceQueriesCS.id, BigInt(queryId)),
          eq(customProvenanceQueriesCS.organizationId, BigInt(organizationId)),
          eq(customProvenanceQueriesCS.isDeleted, false)
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    if (!savedQuery) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Query not found' };
    }

    // Execute the query using the existing function
    const result = await executeProvenanceQuery(
      JSON.stringify(savedQuery.query)
    );

    if (result.success) {
      return {
        ...result,
        queryName: savedQuery.name,
        executedQuery: JSON.stringify(savedQuery.query, null, 2) // Return the stored JSON query
      };
    }

    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error executing saved query:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Delete a saved provenance query (soft delete)
 * @param queryId - The query ID to delete
 * @param organizationId - The organization ID for security verification
 * @returns Success status
 */
export async function deleteProvenanceQuery(
  queryId: string,
  organizationId: string
): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    if (!claims) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' };
    }

    await db
      .update(customProvenanceQueriesCS)
      .set({
        deletedAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date()
      } as Partial<CustomProvenanceQueryCS>)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(customProvenanceQueriesCS.id, BigInt(queryId)),
          eq(customProvenanceQueriesCS.organizationId, BigInt(organizationId))
        )
      );

    return { success: true };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error deleting provenance query:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    };
  }
}

'use server';

import type {
  CreateActiveTeamResponse,
  DeleteActiveTeamResponse,
  GetActiveTeamsResponse,
  UpdateActiveTeamResponse
} from '@signvault/backend/routes/v2/active-teams';
import {
  TeamInheritanceType,
  type ActiveTeamCS,
  type ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS,
  type CustomTeamCS,
  type EntityStatusPSType
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import {
  createActiveTeam,
  deleteActiveTeam,
  getActiveTeamsByOrganization,
  updateActiveTeam
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud/active-teams/operations';
import {
  createTrackedTeam,
  getTrackedTeamIdFromCustomTeamId,
  getTrackedTeamIdFromTemplateId,
  updateTrackedTeam,
  updateTrackedTeamFromSource
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud/tracked-teams/operations';
import { cloneTeamTemplateForOrganization } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud';
import { execute } from '@signvault/gql-client/execute';
import { TeamTemplate } from '@signvault/gql-client/graphql';
import { CreateTeamDocument } from '@signvault/gql-client/graphql';
import { print } from 'graphql';
import { createAuditLogEntry } from './audit-logs';
import {
  AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';

/**
 * Get active teams for an organization
 * @param organizationId - The ID of the organization
 * @returns The active teams with details
 */
export async function getActiveTeams(
  organizationId: string
): Promise<GetActiveTeamsResponse> {
  const result = await getActiveTeamsByOrganization(organizationId);

  return {
    code: result.code,
    teams: result.teams || []
  };
}

/**
 * Create a new active team
 * @param data - The active team data
 * @param creatorId - The ID of the user creating the team
 * @returns The created active team
 */
export async function createActiveTeamData(
  data: {
    organizationId: string | bigint;
    name: string;
    inheritedFrom: TeamInheritanceType;
    customTeamId?: string | bigint | null;
    teamTemplateId?: string | bigint | null;
    description?: string;
  },
  creatorId: string
): Promise<CreateActiveTeamResponse> {
  // This is the template ID from the template_schema
  let templateId = data.teamTemplateId?.toString();

  if (templateId) {
    const { code, cloneId } = await cloneTeamTemplateForOrganization(
      BigInt(templateId),
      typeof data.organizationId === 'bigint'
        ? data.organizationId
        : BigInt(data.organizationId),
      BigInt(creatorId)
    );

    if (code === 'template.cloned') {
      templateId = cloneId;
    }
  }

  // Create active team
  const result = await createActiveTeam({
    organizationId:
      typeof data.organizationId === 'bigint'
        ? data.organizationId
        : BigInt(data.organizationId),
    name: data.name,
    inheritedFrom: data.inheritedFrom,
    customTeamId: data.customTeamId
      ? typeof data.customTeamId === 'bigint'
        ? data.customTeamId
        : BigInt(data.customTeamId)
      : null,
    teamTemplateId: data.teamTemplateId
      ? typeof data.teamTemplateId === 'bigint'
        ? data.teamTemplateId
        : BigInt(data.teamTemplateId)
      : null,
    description: data.description
  });

  // Create tracked team
  await createTrackedTeam({
    organizationId:
      typeof data.organizationId === 'bigint'
        ? data.organizationId
        : BigInt(data.organizationId),
    inheritedFrom: data.inheritedFrom,
    teamId: data.customTeamId
      ? typeof data.customTeamId === 'bigint'
        ? data.customTeamId
        : BigInt(data.customTeamId)
      : templateId
        ? BigInt(templateId)
        : undefined,
    templateId: data.teamTemplateId
      ? typeof data.teamTemplateId === 'bigint'
        ? data.teamTemplateId
        : BigInt(data.teamTemplateId)
      : null,
    creatorId: BigInt(creatorId),
    status: 'ACTIVE' as EntityStatusPSType
  });

  // --- Provenance Tracking ---
  await execute(print(CreateTeamDocument), {
    input: {
      teamId: result.activeTeam?.id.toString() ?? '',
      teamName: result.activeTeam?.name ?? '',
      description: result.activeTeam?.description ?? '',
      createdFromTemplate:
        data.inheritedFrom === TeamInheritanceType.TEAM_TEMPLATE,
      teamType:
        data.inheritedFrom === TeamInheritanceType.TEAM_TEMPLATE
          ? TeamTemplate.Operations
          : ('CUSTOM' as unknown as TeamTemplate)
    },
    organizationId: data.organizationId.toString(),
    userId: creatorId
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log create active team event');
  });

  // Provenance: create audit log entry
  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.TEAM_CREATED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.TEAM_MANAGEMENT,
    description: `Team ${result.activeTeam?.name} created by ${creatorId}`,
    entityName: result.activeTeam?.name ?? '',
    teamId: result.activeTeam?.id.toString() ?? '',
    entityId: result.activeTeam?.id.toString() ?? '',
    entityType: 'TEAM',
    success: true
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[AUDIT LOGS] Failed to log create active team event');
  });

  if (result.code !== 'active.team.created' || !result.activeTeam) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to create active team: ${result.code}`);
  }

  // Convert to ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS format
  const team: ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS = {
    ...result.activeTeam,
    customTeam: {
      id: result.activeTeam.customTeamId || BigInt(0),
      name: result.activeTeam.name,
      description: result.activeTeam.description,
      createdAt: result.activeTeam.createdAt || new Date(),
      updatedAt: result.activeTeam.updatedAt || new Date(),
      organizationId: result.activeTeam.organizationId,
      type: result.activeTeam.inheritedFrom
    } as CustomTeamCS,
    members: []
  };

  return {
    code: result.code,
    team
  };
}

/**
 * Update an existing active team
 * @param teamId - The ID of the active team to update
 * @param data - The data to update
 * @returns The updated active team
 */
export async function updateActiveTeamData(
  teamId: string,
  data: Partial<ActiveTeamCS> & { status?: EntityStatusPSType }
): Promise<UpdateActiveTeamResponse> {
  const updateData: Partial<ActiveTeamCS> = {};

  if (data.name) updateData.name = data.name;
  if (data.description !== undefined) updateData.description = data.description;
  if (data.customTeamId)
    updateData.customTeamId =
      typeof data.customTeamId === 'bigint'
        ? data.customTeamId
        : BigInt(data.customTeamId);
  if (data.teamTemplateId)
    updateData.teamTemplateId =
      typeof data.teamTemplateId === 'bigint'
        ? data.teamTemplateId
        : BigInt(data.teamTemplateId);

  const result = await updateActiveTeam(teamId, updateData);

  if (data.customTeamId || data.teamTemplateId) {
    await updateTrackedTeamFromSource(
      data.customTeamId?.toString() ?? data.teamTemplateId?.toString(),
      {
        inheritedFrom: data.customTeamId
          ? TeamInheritanceType.CUSTOM_TEAM
          : TeamInheritanceType.TEAM_TEMPLATE,
        status: data.status
      }
    );
  }

  if (result.code !== 'active.team.updated' || !result.activeTeam) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to update active team: ${result.code}`);
  }

  // Convert to ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS format
  const team: ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS = {
    ...result.activeTeam,
    customTeam: {
      id: result.activeTeam.customTeamId || BigInt(0),
      name: result.activeTeam.name,
      description: result.activeTeam.description,
      createdAt: result.activeTeam.createdAt || new Date(),
      updatedAt: result.activeTeam.updatedAt || new Date(),
      organizationId: result.activeTeam.organizationId,
      type: result.activeTeam.inheritedFrom
    } as CustomTeamCS,
    members: []
  };

  return {
    code: result.code,
    team
  };
}

/**
 * Delete an active team
 * @param teamId - The ID of the active team to delete
 * @param options - Additional options
 * @returns Success code
 */
export async function deleteActiveTeamData(
  teamId: string,
  options?: {
    customTeamId?: string;
    teamTemplateId?: string;
    organizationId: string;
  }
): Promise<DeleteActiveTeamResponse> {
  const result = await deleteActiveTeam(teamId);

  if (options?.customTeamId) {
    const { trackedTeamId } = await getTrackedTeamIdFromCustomTeamId(
      options.customTeamId,
      options.organizationId
    );

    if (trackedTeamId) {
      await updateTrackedTeam(trackedTeamId.toString(), {
        status: 'INACTIVE',
        deletedAt: new Date()
      });
    }
  }

  if (options?.teamTemplateId) {
    const { trackedTeamId } = await getTrackedTeamIdFromTemplateId(
      options.teamTemplateId,
      options.organizationId
    );

    if (trackedTeamId) {
      await updateTrackedTeam(trackedTeamId.toString(), {
        status: 'INACTIVE',
        deletedAt: new Date()
      });
    }
  }

  if (result.code !== 'active.team.deleted') {
    throw new Error(`Failed to delete active team: ${result.code}`);
  }

  return {
    code: result.code
  };
}

import { Copy, Download } from 'lucide-react';
import { RiFingerprintFill } from 'react-icons/ri';
import { format } from 'date-fns';
import { useState } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import type { ProvenanceRecords } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { ENTITY_CONTEXT_LABELS, ENTITY_TYPE_LABELS } from './types';
import { Textarea } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/textarea';
import {
  Collapsible,
  CollapsibleContent,
  CollapsibleTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/collapsible';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';

type QueryResultsSheetProps = {
  data: ProvenanceRecords[] | null;
  executedQuery?: string;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  queryName?: string;
  totalCount?: number;
};

export function QueryResultsSheet({
  data,
  executedQuery,
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  queryName,
  totalCount
}: QueryResultsSheetProps) {
  const [showQuery, setShowQuery] = useState(false);

  const copyToClipboard = async (text: string) => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      toast.success('Copied to clipboard');
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to copy to clipboard');
    }
  };

  const exportResults = () => {
    if (!data) return;

    const csvData = [
      // Headers
      [
        'ID',
        'Title',
        'Entity Type',
        'Entity Context',
        'User Type',
        'Created At'
      ].join(','),
      // Data rows
      ...data.map((item) =>
        [
          item.id,
          `"${item.title}"`,
          item.entityType,
          item.entityContext,
          item.userType || 'N/A',
          format(new Date(item.associationTimestamp), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')
        ].join(',')
      )
    ].join('\n');

    const blob = new Blob([csvData], { type: 'text/csv' });
    const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `provenance-query-results-${Date.now()}.csv`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    toast.success('Results exported successfully');
  };

  return (
    <Sheet open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onClose}>
      <SheetContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
        <SheetHeader className='space-y-4'>
          <div className='flex items-start justify-between'>
            <div>
              <SheetTitle className='font-britanica text-2xl'>
                {queryName ? `Query Results: ${queryName}` : 'Query Results'}
              </SheetTitle>
              <SheetDescription>
                {totalCount !== undefined
                  ? `Found ${totalCount} record${totalCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`
                  : 'Query execution results'}
              </SheetDescription>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className='flex items-start gap-2'>
            <Button
              variant='outline'
              size='sm'
              onClick={exportResults}
              disabled={!data || data.length === 0}
              className='gap-2'
            >
              <Download className='size-4' />
              Export CSV
            </Button>
            {executedQuery && (
              <Collapsible open={showQuery} onOpenChange={setShowQuery}>
                <CollapsibleTrigger asChild>
                  <Button variant='outline' size='sm' className='gap-2'>
                    {showQuery ? (
                      <ChevronDown className='size-4' />
                    ) : (
                      <ChevronRight className='size-4' />
                    )}
                    {showQuery ? 'Hide Query' : 'Show Query'}
                  </Button>
                </CollapsibleTrigger>
                <CollapsibleContent className='mt-4 w-full'>
                  <div className='space-y-2'>
                    <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
                      <h4 className='text-sm font-medium'>
                        Executed SQL Query
                      </h4>
                      <Button
                        variant='light'
                        size='icon'
                        onClick={() => copyToClipboard(executedQuery)}
                        className='size-8 gap-2 rounded-md'
                      >
                        <Copy className='size-3' />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                    <Textarea
                      value={
                        executedQuery ? executedQuery : 'Failed to parse query'
                      }
                      readOnly
                      className='resize-none font-mono text-xs'
                      rows={8}
                    />
                  </div>
                </CollapsibleContent>
              </Collapsible>
            )}
          </div>
        </SheetHeader>

        <div className='mt-6'>
          {data === null ? (
            <div className='flex h-32 items-center justify-center'>
              <p className='text-muted-foreground'>No query executed yet</p>
            </div>
          ) : data.length === 0 ? (
            <div className='flex h-32 items-center justify-center'>
              <p className='text-muted-foreground'>No results found</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>Name</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className='hidden sm:table-cell'>Event</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className='hidden lg:table-cell'>Entity</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className='hidden xl:table-cell'>
                    User Type
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableHead className='hidden md:table-cell'>Date</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className='hidden md:table-cell'>
                    Record ID
                  </TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody className='font-suisse-intl'>
                {data.map((item) => (
                  <TableRow key={item.id}>
                    <TableCell className='max-w-[200px]'>
                      <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
                        <span className='shrink-0 rounded-lg bg-muted p-2'>
                          <RiFingerprintFill size={16} />
                        </span>
                        <div className='min-w-0 flex-1'>
                          <p className='truncate font-medium capitalize'>

import { type Metadata } from 'next';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import OrganizationUsersPage from './organization-users-page';
import type {
  GetOrganizationResponse,
  GetOrganizationUsersResponse,
  GetUserOrganizationsResponse
} from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organizations';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getErrorRedirect,
  getRandomUUID
} from '@/lib/utils';
