import type { Organization } from '@signvault/db/types';

export const revalidate = 60;
export const dynamicParams = true;

export async function generateStaticParams() {
  const logger = getServerLogger(getRandomUUID(), 'organization-users-ssg');
  try {
    logger.info('Generating static params for organization users');

    const organizationsResponse: GetUserOrganizationsResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations?bypassToken=${process.env.BYPASS_TOKEN}`,
      {
        method: 'GET'
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());

    if (
      organizationsResponse.message !== 'Organizations retrieved successfully'
    ) {
      logger.error('Error fetching organizations', {
        organizationsResponse
      });
      return [];
    }

    const organizations =
      organizationsResponse.organizations.logto ??
      organizationsResponse.organizations.database ??
      null;

    if (
      !organizations ||
      organizationsResponse.message !== 'Organizations retrieved successfully'
    ) {
      logger.error('Error fetching organizations', {
        organizationsResponse
      });
      return [];
    }

    return organizations.map((org) => ({
      organizationId: org.id
    }));
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error generating static params for organization users', {
      error
    });
    return [];
  }
}

export async function generateMetadata({
  params
}: {
  params: { organizationId: string };
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  const { organizationId } = await params;

  const organizationResponse: GetOrganizationResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      },
      cache: 'no-store'
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());
  const logger = getServerLogger(getRandomUUID(), 'organization-users-page');

  logger.info('Fetching organization details', {
    organizationId
  });

  if (organizationResponse.message !== 'Organization retrieved successfully') {
    logger.error('Failed to fetch organization details', {
      organizationResponse
    });
    return {
      title: 'Unknown Organization - Organization Users',
      description: `Manage unknown organization users with SignVault.`
    };
  }

  const organizationDetails =
    organizationResponse.organization.database ??
    organizationResponse.organization.logto ??
    null;

  if (!organizationDetails) {
    logger.error('Failed to fetch organization details', {
      organizationResponse
    });
    return {
      title: 'Unknown Organization - Organization Users',
      description: `Manage unknown organization users with SignVault.`
    };
  }

  const title = `${organizationDetails.name} - Organization Users`;
  const description = `Manage users in ${organizationDetails.name} organization. Add, remove, and update user roles and permissions with SignVault's secure identity management system.`;

  return {
    title,
    description,
    keywords: [
      'SignVault',
      'user management',
      'organization users',
      'role-based access control',
      'user permissions',
      'enterprise identity',
      'secure access management',
      organizationDetails.name
    ],
    openGraph: {
      title: title + ' | SignVault',
      description,
      url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/organizations/${organizationId}/users`,
      siteName: 'SignVault',
      images: [
        {
          url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`,
          width: 1200,
          height: 630
        }
      ],
      locale: 'en_US',
      type: 'website'
    },
    twitter: {
      card: 'summary_large_image',
      title: title + ' | SignVault',
      description,
      images: [`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`]
    }
  };
}

export default async function OrganizationUsersPageWrapper({
  params
}: Readonly<{ params: { organizationId: string } }>) {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const logger = getServerLogger(getRandomUUID(), 'organization-users-page');
  if (!claims) {
    return redirect('/');
  }
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );
  const { organizationId } = await params;

  const userOrganizationsResponse: GetUserOrganizationsResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/user/${claims.sub}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      },
      cache: 'no-store'
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (
    userOrganizationsResponse.message !== 'Organizations retrieved successfully'
  ) {
    logger.error('Failed to fetch user organizations', {
      userOrganizationsResponse
    });
    return redirect('/account/organizations');
  }

  const userOrganizations =
    userOrganizationsResponse.organizations.database ??
    userOrganizationsResponse.organizations.logto ??
    null;

  if (!userOrganizations) {
    logger.error('Failed to fetch user organizations', {
      userOrganizationsResponse
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organizations',
        'Error',
        'Failed to fetch user organizations'
      )
    );
  }

  if (
    userOrganizations.length === 0 ||
    !Array.isArray(userOrganizations) ||
    !userOrganizations.some((org) => org.id === organizationId)
  ) {
    logger.error('User is not a member of the organization', {
      userOrganizations
    });
    return redirect('/account/organizations');
  }

  const organizationResponse: GetOrganizationResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      },
      cache: 'no-store'
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  const organizationDetails = organizationResponse.organization.database
    ? organizationResponse.organization.database
    : (organizationResponse.organization.logto ?? null);

  const organizationUsersResponse: GetOrganizationUsersResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}/users?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      },
      cache: 'no-store'
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  const organizationUsers =
    organizationUsersResponse.users.database ??
    organizationUsersResponse.users.logto ??
    null;

  if (!organizationUsers) {
    logger.error('Failed to fetch organization users', {
      organizationUsersResponse
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organizations',
        'Error',
        'Failed to fetch organization users'
      )
    );
  }

  return (
    <OrganizationUsersPage
      organizationDetails={organizationDetails}
      organizationUsers={organizationUsers}
    />
  );
}

'use client';

import type { DeleteCaseStudyResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/case-studies';
import type { CaseStudy } from '@signvault/db/types';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';

import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/popover';
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/table';
import { EllipsisVertical, Eye, Loader2, Pencil, Trash } from 'lucide-react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';

import EditCaseStudyDialog from './edit-case-study-dialog';

export default function CaseStudiesTable({
  caseStudies,
  onUpdate,
  isLoading,
  cookieStore,
  organizationId
}: Readonly<{
  caseStudies: CaseStudy[];
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
  isLoading: boolean;
  onUpdate: () => void;
  organizationId: string;
}>) {
  const [editingCaseStudy, setEditingCaseStudy] = useState<CaseStudy | null>(
    null
  );
  const [deletingCaseStudy, setDeletingCaseStudy] = useState<CaseStudy | null>(
    null
  );
  const handleEdit = (caseStudy: CaseStudy) => {
    setEditingCaseStudy(caseStudy);
  };

  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  const handleDelete = (caseStudy: CaseStudy) => {
    setDeletingCaseStudy(caseStudy);
  };

  const confirmDelete = async () => {
    if (deletingCaseStudy) {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/case-studies/${deletingCaseStudy.slug}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'DELETE',
            cache: 'no-store',
            headers: {
              'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
                ? cookieStore.toString()
                : cookieString,
              'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
                ? cookieStore.toString()
                : cookieString
            }
          }
        );
        const data: DeleteCaseStudyResponse = await response.json();
        if (data.message === 'Case study deleted successfully') {
          toast.success(data.message);
          clientLogger.info('Case study deleted successfully', {
            message: data.message
          });
          onUpdate();
        } else {
          clientLogger.error('Failed to delete case study', {
            message: data.message
          });
          toast.error('Failed to delete case study');
        }
      } catch (error) {
        clientLogger.error('Error deleting case study', {
          error
        });
        toast.error('An error occurred while deleting the case study');
      }
      setDeletingCaseStudy(null);
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className='flex h-full items-center justify-center'>
        <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className='rounded-lg p-6 shadow-sm' id='case-studies-table'>
      <h2 className='mb-4 text-2xl font-semibold'>
        All Case Studies Published
      </h2>
      <Table>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead>Title</TableHead>
            <TableHead className='hidden lg:table-cell'>Icon</TableHead>
            <TableHead className='hidden xl:table-cell'>Image</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Actions</TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {caseStudies.map((study) => (
            <TableRow key={study.id}>
              <TableCell>{study.title}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className='hidden lg:table-cell'>
                <Popover>
                  <PopoverTrigger>
                    <img
                      alt={study.title ?? 'Icon'}
                      className='aspect-square rounded-lg object-contain'
                      height={48}
                      src={study.icon}
                      width={48}
                    />
                  </PopoverTrigger>
                  <PopoverContent>
                    <img
                      alt='Icon'
                      className='h-auto w-full rounded-lg object-contain'
                      height={200}
                      src={study.icon}
                      width={200}
                    />
                  </PopoverContent>
                </Popover>
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell className='hidden xl:table-cell'>
                <Popover>
                  <PopoverTrigger>
                    <img
                      alt={study.title ?? 'Image'}
                      className='aspect-square rounded-lg object-cover'
                      height={48}
                      src={study.image}
                      width={48}
                    />
                  </PopoverTrigger>
                  <PopoverContent>
                    <img
                      alt='Case study thumbnail'
                      className='h-auto w-full rounded-lg object-contain'
                      height={1080}
                      src={study.image}
                      width={1920}
                    />
                  </PopoverContent>
                </Popover>
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell>
                <DropdownMenu>
                  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                    <Button
                      className='transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:bg-primary/10'
                      size='icon'
                      variant='outline'
                    >
                      <EllipsisVertical className='size-4' />
                    </Button>
                  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                  <DropdownMenuContent className='flex flex-col gap-2'>
                    <DropdownMenuItem
                      className='inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2'
                      onClick={() =>
                        window.open(`/case-studies/${study.slug}`, '_blank')
                      }
                    >
                      <Eye className='size-4' />
                      View
                    </DropdownMenuItem>
                    <DropdownMenuItem
                      className='inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2'
                      onClick={() => {
                        handleEdit(study);
                      }}
                    >
                      <Pencil className='size-4' />
                      Edit
                    </DropdownMenuItem>
                    <DropdownMenuItem
                      className='inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2'
                      onClick={() => handleDelete(study)}
                    >
                      <Trash className='size-4' />
                      Delete
                    </DropdownMenuItem>
                  </DropdownMenuContent>
                </DropdownMenu>
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>

      <EditCaseStudyDialog
        caseStudy={editingCaseStudy ?? null}
        cookieStore={cookieStore}
        onClose={() => setEditingCaseStudy(null)}
        onUpdate={() => {
          onUpdate();
          setEditingCaseStudy(null);
        }}
        organizationId={organizationId}
      />

      <Dialog
        onOpenChange={() => setDeletingCaseStudy(null)}
        open={!!deletingCaseStudy}
      >
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Confirm Deletion</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              Are you sure you want to delete the case study
              <strong>{deletingCaseStudy?.title}</strong>? This action is not
              reversible and it will permanently delete the case study.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button
              onClick={() => setDeletingCaseStudy(null)}
              variant='outline'
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={confirmDelete} variant='destructive'>
              Delete
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';

  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';

  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import * as z from 'zod';

const formSchema = z.object({
  slug: z.string().min(5, 'Slug must be at least 5 characters long'),
  title: z.string().min(5, 'Title must be at least 5 characters long'),
  image: z.string().url('Must be a valid URL').optional(),
  description: z
    .string()
    .min(10, 'Description must be at least 10 characters long')
    .optional(),
  authorName: z
    .string()
    .min(2, 'Author name must be at least 2 characters long'),
  authorAvatar: z.string().url('Must be a valid URL').optional(),
  date: z.string(),
  content: z
    .string()
    .min(50, 'Content must be at least 50 characters long')
    .optional()
});

export default function EditBlogDialog({
  blog,
  onClose,
  onUpdate,
  cookieStore,
  organizationId
}: Readonly<{
  blog: Blog | null;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUpdate: () => void;
  organizationId: string;
}>) {
  const form = useForm<z.infer<typeof formSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(formSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      slug: blog?.slug || '',
      title: blog?.title || '',
      image: blog?.image || '',
      description: blog?.description || '',
      authorName: blog?.authorName || '',
      authorAvatar: blog?.authorAvatar || '',
      date: blog?.date || new Date().toISOString(),
      content: blog?.content || ''
    }
  });
  const logger = clientLogger;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (blog) {
      form.reset(blog);
    }
  }, [blog, form]);

  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  const onSubmit = async (data: z.infer<typeof formSchema>) => {
    const response = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/blogs/${blog.slug}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
      {
        method: 'PATCH',
        cache: 'no-store',
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString
        }
      }
    );
    const responseData: UpdateBlogResponse = await response.json();
    if (responseData.message === 'Blog updated successfully') {
      toast.success(responseData.message);
      logger.info('Blog updated successfully', {
        message: responseData.message
      });
      onUpdate();
    } else {
      toast.error('Failed to update blog');
      logger.error('Failed to update blog', {
        message: responseData.message
      });
    }
  };

  if (!blog) return null;

  return (
    <Dialog onOpenChange={onClose} open={!!blog}>
      <DialogContent className='flex max-h-[90dvh] flex-col gap-8 md:max-h-[85dvh] lg:max-h-[85dvh]'>

          <DialogTitle>Edit Blog</DialogTitle>

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='title'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Title</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input placeholder='Blog title' {...field} />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='slug'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Slug</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input placeholder='blog-post-slug' {...field} />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormDescription>
                      URL-friendly version of the title (e.g., blog-post-slug)
                    </FormDescription>

                    <FormControl>

                        {...field}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/documents/documents-page.tsx ===

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { DocumentUploadSection } from './document-upload-section';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { Sheet, SheetContent } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/sheet';
import type { DocumentCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import PageHeader from '@/components/pages/account/page-header';
import { Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { softDeleteDocument, updateDocumentStatus } from '@/actions/documents';
import type { DocumentStatus } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';
import { DocumentList } from './document-list';
import type { UserCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { createAuditLogEntry } from '@/actions/audit-logs';
import {
  AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';

export default function DocumentsPageClient({
  user,
  documents
}: {
  user: UserCS;
  documents: DocumentCS[];
}) {
  const [isUploadSheetOpen, setIsUploadSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  // New states
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'list' | 'grid'>('list'); // Default to list view
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<
    'title' | 'updatedAt' | 'status' | 'createdAt'
  >('updatedAt'); // Default sort by updatedAt
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const deleteMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (document: DocumentCS) =>
      toast.promise(
        softDeleteDocument(
          document.id,
          `Document ${document.id.toString()} deleted by user ${user.id.toString()}`
        ),
        {
          loading: `Deleting "${document.title || document.filename || 'Untitled'}"...`,
          success: `Document "${document.title || document.filename || 'Untitled'}" has been moved to trash/archived.`,
          error: `Failed to delete "${document.title || document.filename || 'Untitled'}". Please try again.`
        }
      ),
    onSuccess: (_, document) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['organizationDocuments'] });
      toast.success(
        `Document "${document.title || document.filename || 'Untitled'}" has been archived successfully.`
      );
      createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.DOCUMENT_DELETED,
        category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
        entityId: document.id,
        entityType: 'document',
        entityName: document.title || document.filename,
        description: `User soft-deleted document: "${document.title || document.filename}"`
      }).catch(console.error);
    },
    onError: (error: Error, document) => {
      toast.error(
        `Failed to delete "${document.title || document.filename || 'Untitled'}": ${error.message}`
      );
    }
  });

  const archiveOrUnarchiveMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (data: {
      documentId: bigint;
      status: DocumentStatus;
      filename?: string;
    }) => updateDocumentStatus(data.documentId, data.status),
    onSuccess: (updatedDocument, variables) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['organizationDocuments'] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['document', updatedDocument.id.toString()]
      });
      const action = variables.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'unarchived' : 'archived';
      toast.success(
        `Document "${variables.filename || updatedDocument.filename || 'Untitled'}" ${action}.`
      );
      createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.DOCUMENT_STATUS_CHANGED,
        category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
        entityId: updatedDocument.id,
        entityType: 'document',
        entityName: updatedDocument.title,
        description: `User ${action} document: "${updatedDocument.title}"`,
        beforeState: {
          status: variables.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'ARCHIVED' : 'ACTIVE'
        },
        afterState: { status: variables.status }
      }).catch(console.error);
    },
    onError: (error: Error, variables) => {
      const action = variables.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'unarchive' : 'archive';
      toast.error(
        `Failed to ${action} "${variables.filename || 'document'}": ${error.message}`
      );
    }
  });

  const handleUploadSuccess = (newDocuments: DocumentCS[]) => {
    queryClient.setQueryData(
      ['organizationDocuments'],
      (oldData: DocumentCS[] = []) => [...oldData, ...newDocuments]
    );
    // Note: Don't close the sheet here - let DocumentUploadSection handle the timing
  };

  const handleDeleteDocument = (document: DocumentCS) => {
    deleteMutation.mutate(document);
  };

  const handleUpdateDocumentStatus = (
    document: DocumentCS,
    newStatus: DocumentStatus
  ) => {
    archiveOrUnarchiveMutation.mutate({
      documentId: document.id,
      status: newStatus,
      filename: document.filename || undefined
    });
  };

  const documentsToDisplay = documents
    .filter((doc) => {
      const searchLower = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
      const matchesSearch =
        !searchTerm || // Show all if search term is empty
        doc.filename?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
        doc.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower);
      const matchesFilter = !filterStatus || doc.status === filterStatus; // Apply status filter
      const matchesStatus =
        doc.status === 'INACTIVE' ||
        doc.status === 'DELETED' ||
        doc.status === 'DRAFT'; // filter out "INACTIVE" and "DELETED" and "DRAFT" documents
      const isOwner = doc.ownerId === user.id;
      return matchesSearch && matchesFilter && !matchesStatus && isOwner;
    })
    .sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortBy === 'title') {
        return (a.filename || '').localeCompare(b.filename || '');
      }
      if (sortBy === 'updatedAt') {
        const dateA = a.updatedAt ? new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime() : 0;
        const dateB = b.updatedAt ? new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime() : 0;
        return dateB - dateA; // Sort by most recently updated
      }
      if (sortBy === 'status') {
        return (a.status || '').localeCompare(b.status || '');
      }
      if (sortBy === 'createdAt') {
        const dateA = a.createdAt ? new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() : 0;
        const dateB = b.createdAt ? new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() : 0;
        return dateA - dateB; // Sort by oldest to newest
      }
      return 0;
    });

  return (
    <div className='space-y-6'>
      <PageHeader
        heading='Documents'
        rightElement={
          <Button onClick={() => setIsUploadSheetOpen(true)} className='gap-2'>
            <Plus className='size-4' />
            Upload Document
          </Button>
        }
        subheading={`View and manage your documents in one place.`}
      />
      {/* <Tabs
        value={activeTab}
        onValueChange={(value) => setActiveTab(value as 'active' | 'archive')}
        className='mt-6'
      >
        <TabsList className='grid w-full grid-cols-2 sm:w-[300px]'>
          <TabsTrigger value='active'>Active</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value='archive'>Archive</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>
        <TabsContent value='active' className='mt-4'>

        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value='archive' className='mt-4'>
          <DocumentList
            documents={documentsToDisplay}
            onUpdateDocumentStatus={handleUpdateDocumentStatus}
            viewMode={viewMode}
            searchTerm={searchTerm}
            sortBy={sortBy}
            onSearchChange={setSearchTerm}
            onSortChange={setSortBy}
            onViewModeChange={setViewMode}
            filterStatus={filterStatus}
            onFilterStatusChange={setFilterStatus}
          />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs> */}
      <DocumentList
        documents={documentsToDisplay}
        onUpdateDocumentStatus={handleUpdateDocumentStatus}
        viewMode={viewMode}
        searchTerm={searchTerm}
        sortBy={sortBy}
        onSearchChange={setSearchTerm}
        onSortChange={setSortBy}
        onViewModeChange={setViewMode}
        filterStatus={filterStatus}
        onFilterStatusChange={setFilterStatus}
      />

      {/* Upload Document Sheet */}
      <Sheet open={isUploadSheetOpen} onOpenChange={setIsUploadSheetOpen}>
        <SheetContent
          aria-describedby='upload-document-sheet-description'
          className='w-full overflow-hidden p-0 font-suisse-intl sm:max-w-4xl lg:max-w-5xl'
        >
          <DocumentUploadSection
            onUploadSuccess={handleUploadSuccess}
            onClose={() => setIsUploadSheetOpen(false)}
          />
        </SheetContent>

=== FILE: ./actions/tns.ts ===

'use server';

import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import {
  signatureRequestsCS,
  usersCS
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/schema';
import type { UserCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { EntityIdGenerator } from '@signvault/core-id-ts';

import { sendEmail } from './email';
import {
  sendOrganizationNotification,
  type NotificationAction
} from './notifications';
import type { ReminderFrequency } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';
import { extractNameFromUser } from '@/lib/utils';

export type SendTnsPayload = {
  documentId: string | bigint;
  isRecurring: boolean;
  message: string;
  organizationId: string;
  senderId: string;
  userIds: (string | bigint)[];
  // for recurring
  frequency?: ReminderFrequency;
  startDate?: Date;
};

async function getUsersByIds(userIds: (string | bigint)[]): Promise<UserCS[]> {
  if (userIds.length === 0) return [];
  const users = await db
    .select()
    .from(usersCS)
    .where(
      inArray(
        usersCS.id,
        userIds.map((id) => BigInt(id))
      )
    );
  return users;
}

function createSignatureRequestEmailHtml(params: {
  recipientName: string;
  senderName: string;
  organizationName: string;
  documentCount: number;
  message: string;
  documentLink: string;
  senderEmail: string;
}): string {
  const messageBlock = params.message
    ? `<div class='message-box'>
        <p><strong>Message from ${params.senderName}:</strong></p>
        <p>"${params.message}"</p>
    </div>`
    : '';

  return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang='en'>
<head>
    <meta charset='UTF-8'>
    <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0'>
    <style>
        body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: #f4f4f4; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
        .container { max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; background-color: #ffffff; padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); }
        .header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px; }
        .content { font-size: 16px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.6; }
        .button { background-color: #7A3CFF; color: #ffffff !important; text-decoration: none; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; width: 100%; display: inline-block; text-align: center; }
        .button-container { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 10px; }
        .footer { margin-top: 30px; font-size: 12px; color: #777777; text-align: center; }
        .header img { max-width: 250px; }
        .message-box { background-color: #f9f9f9; border-left: 4px solid #7A3CFF; padding: 15px; margin: 20px 0; }
        .message-box p { margin: 0; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class='container'>
    <div class='header'>
        <img src='https://signvault-docs.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/logo-light.png' alt='SignVault Logo'/>
    </div>
    <div class='content'>
        <h1>Signature Request</h1>
        <p>Hello ${params.recipientName},</p>
        <p><strong>${params.senderName}</strong> from <strong>${params.organizationName}</strong> has requested your signature on ${params.documentCount} document(s).</p>
        
        ${messageBlock}

        <p>Please review and sign the document(s) at your earliest convenience.</p>

        <div class='button-container'>
            <a href='${params.documentLink}' style='color: #ffffff !important;' class='button'>View & Sign Document(s)</a>
        </div>
        
        <p>If you have any questions, please contact <strong>${params.senderName} (${params.senderEmail})</strong>.</p>
        <p>If you believe this request was sent in error, please disregard this email.</p>
    </div>
    <div class='footer'>
        <p>&copy; 2025 SignVault. All rights reserved.</p>
    </div>
</div>
</body>
</html>`;
}

export async function sendTns(payload: SendTnsPayload): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const users = await getUsersByIds(payload.userIds);
    if (!users.length) {
      return { success: false, error: 'No users found.' };
    }

    const sender = await db.query.usersCS.findFirst({
      where: (user, { eq }) => eq(user.id, BigInt(payload.senderId))
    });
    if (!sender) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Sender not found.' };
    }

    const organization = await db.query.organizationsCS.findFirst({
      where: (org, { eq }) => eq(org.id, BigInt(payload.organizationId))
    });
    if (!organization) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Organization not found.' };
    }

    const entityIdGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();

    // Insert into signature_requests table (one record per recipient)
    const requests = await Promise.all(
      users.map(async (user) => {
        const id = await entityIdGenerator.generateNotificationRecipientId();
        return {
          id,
          organizationId: BigInt(payload.organizationId),
          senderId: BigInt(payload.senderId),
          recipientId: user.id,
          receiverId: user.id,
          documentId: BigInt(payload.documentId),
          documentIds: [payload.documentId.toString()], // Assuming text[] column
          message: payload.message,
          isRecurring: payload.isRecurring,
          frequency: payload?.frequency?.toUpperCase() ?? null,
          startDate: payload.startDate ?? null,
          createdAt: new Date(),
          updatedAt: new Date(),
          userIds: payload.userIds,
          sentAt: new Date()
        };
      })
    );

    await db.insert(signatureRequestsCS).values(requests);

    // !!TODO: implement recurring notifications and recurring emails
    // For now, we handle one-off and recurring the same way.
    // In the future, recurring notifications would be handled by a job scheduler.

    const senderName = extractNameFromUser(sender);

    // Filter out the sender from recipients to avoid sending signature request to themselves
    const recipients = users.filter(
      (user) => user.id.toString() !== payload.senderId
    );

    // Send signature request notifications to recipients only
    for (const user of recipients) {
      const recipientName = extractNameFromUser(user);
      const subject = `${senderName} wants you to sign a document`;

      const notificationMessage = `You have recieved a signature request sent from ${senderName} to sign a document.\n\nMessage from the sender: ${payload.message}`;
      // Send in-app notification
      await sendOrganizationNotification({
        action: 'SIGNATURE_REQUEST_SENT',
        creatorId: payload.senderId,
        receiverId: user.id.toString(),
        organizationId: payload.organizationId,
        title: subject,
        message: notificationMessage,
        targetEntityType: 'DOCUMENT',
        data: {
          documentIds: [payload.documentId.toString()],
          isRecurring: payload.isRecurring,
          frequency: payload.frequency
        }
      });

      const documentLink = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/documents/${payload.documentId}/esign`;

      const htmlContent = createSignatureRequestEmailHtml({
        recipientName,
        senderName,
        organizationName: organization.name,
        documentCount: 1,
        message: payload.message,
        documentLink,
        senderEmail: sender.primaryEmail
      });

      // Send email
      await sendEmail({
        to: user.primaryEmail,
        subject,
        html: htmlContent
      });
    }

    // Send confirmation notification to sender if multiple users were selected
    if (recipients.length > 1) {
      const recipientNames = recipients
        .map((user) => extractNameFromUser(user))
        .join(', ');
      const confirmationSubject = 'TNS sent successfully';
      const confirmationMessage = `Your signature request has been sent to the following ${recipients.length} users: ${recipientNames}.\n\nMessage sent: ${payload.message}`;

      // Send confirmation notification to sender
      await sendOrganizationNotification({
        action: 'TNS_CONFIRMATION_SENT' as NotificationAction,
        creatorId: payload.senderId,
        receiverId: payload.senderId,
        organizationId: payload.organizationId,
        title: confirmationSubject,
        message: confirmationMessage,
        targetEntityType: 'DOCUMENT',
        data: {
          documentIds: [payload.documentId.toString()],
          isRecurring: payload.isRecurring,
          frequency: payload.frequency,
          recipientCount: recipients.length,
          recipientNames: recipients.map((user) => extractNameFromUser(user))
        }
      });
    }

    return { success: true };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to send TNS:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to send TNS.' };
  }
}

  // Create team options based on teams created in the previous step or active teams
  const availableTeamOptions = useMemo(() => {

        label: team.name

export function RolesPage({
  roleTemplates
}: Readonly<{ roleTemplates: RoleTemplate[] }>) {
  const {
    organizationData,
    organizationLoading,
    organizationMembers,
    organizationMembersLoading
  } = useUserData();
  const isAdmin =
    organizationData?.user?.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
    organizationData?.user?.isCreator;

  // Separate states for default and custom role selection
  const [selectedRoleTemplate, setSelectedRoleTemplate] =
    useState<RoleTemplate | null>(null);
  const [selectedCustomRole, setSelectedCustomRole] = useState<RoleCS | null>(
    null
  );

  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<'name' | 'type' | 'createdAt'>('name');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  const debouncedSearch = useMemo(
    () =>
      debounce((value: string) => {
        setSearch(value);
        // When filtering, close any open sheet(s)
        setSelectedRoleTemplate(null);
        setSelectedCustomRole(null);
      }, 300),
    []
  );

  const filteredRoles = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = [...roleTemplates];

    if (search) {
      const searchLower = search.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(
        (role) =>
          role.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          role.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          role.attributes.function.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          role.attributes.level.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)
      );
    }

    filtered.sort((a, b) => {
      switch (sortBy) {
        case 'name':
          return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
        default:
          return 0;
      }
    });

    return filtered;
  }, [roleTemplates, search, sortBy]);

  if (organizationLoading || organizationMembersLoading) {
    return (
      <div className='flex size-full flex-col'>
        <PageHeader
          heading={isAdmin ? 'Role Management' : 'Roles'}
          subheading={`View ${
            isAdmin ? 'and manage' : ''
          } roles ${isAdmin ? 'and their permissions' : ''} in your organization.`}
        />
        <div className='flex size-full items-center justify-center'>
          <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const adminIds = organizationMembers
    ?.filter(
      (member) =>
        member.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
        member.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L6_USER.id
    )
    .map((member) => member.id);

  return (
    <div className='flex size-full flex-col pb-24'>
      <PageHeader
        heading={isAdmin ? 'Role Management' : 'Roles'}
        rightElement={
          isAdmin ? (
            <CreateRole
              adminIds={adminIds}
              roleTemplates={roleTemplates}
              organizationId={organizationData?.organization?.id}
              userId={organizationData?.user?.id}
            />
          ) : null
        }
        subheading={`View ${
          isAdmin ? 'and manage' : ''
        } roles ${isAdmin ? 'and their permissions' : ''} in your organization.`}
      />
      <Tabs defaultValue='default'>
        <div className='mb-6 mt-2 flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between'>
          <TabsList className='w-fit'>
            <TabsTrigger value='default'>Templates</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value='custom'>Custom</TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>
          <RoleTableControls
            onSearch={debouncedSearch}
            onSortChange={(value) =>
              setSortBy(value as 'name' | 'type' | 'createdAt')
            }
            sortBy={sortBy}
          />
        </div>
        <TabsContent
          className='divide-y divide-line rounded-lg border border-line'
          value='default'
        >
          {filteredRoles.map((role) => (
            <div
              className={cn(
                'cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-300 ease-in-out',
                selectedRoleTemplate?.id === role.id ? 'bg-secondary' : ''
              )}
              key={role.id}
              onClick={() => setSelectedRoleTemplate(role)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                  setSelectedRoleTemplate(role);
                }
              }}
              role='button'
              tabIndex={0}
            >
              <RoleCard className='flex flex-col gap-3 p-6' role={role} />
            </div>
          ))}
          {!filteredRoles.length && (
            <div className='flex h-24 items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground'>
              No default roles found.
            </div>
          )}
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value='custom'>
          {organizationData?.organization?.id && organizationData?.user?.id && (
            <CustomRoleTabContent
              onSelectRole={setSelectedCustomRole}
              organizationId={organizationData.organization.id}
              search={search}
              sortBy={sortBy}
              userId={organizationData.user.id}
            />
          )}
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>

      {/* Render separate sheets based on which state is set */}
      {selectedRoleTemplate && (
        <RoleTemplateSheet
          onClose={() => setSelectedRoleTemplate(null)}
          role={selectedRoleTemplate}
        />
      )}
      {selectedCustomRole && (
        <CustomRoleSheet
          onClose={() => setSelectedCustomRole(null)}
          role={selectedCustomRole}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import * as z from 'zod';

const formSchema = z.object({
  title: z.string().min(5, 'Title must be at least 5 characters long'),
  description: z
    .string()
    .min(10, 'Description must be at least 10 characters long'),
  content: z.string().min(50, 'Content must be at least 50 characters long'),
  image: z.string().url('Must be a valid URL'),
  authorName: z
    .string()
    .min(2, 'Author name must be at least 2 characters long'),
  authorAvatar: z.string().url('Must be a valid URL'),
  date: z.coerce.date(),
  slug: z.string().min(5, 'Slug must be at least 5 characters long')
});

export default function CreateBlogForm({
  userId,
  name,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<{
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
  name: string;
  userId: string;
}>) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const form = useForm<z.infer<typeof formSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(formSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      title: '',
      description: '',
      content: '',
      image: '',
      authorName: name,
      authorAvatar: '',
      date: new Date(),
      slug: ''
    }
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  // Add this function to generate slug from title
  const generateSlug = (title: string) => {
    return title
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll(/[^\w\s-]/gu, '')
      .replaceAll(/\s+/gu, '-');
  };

  const onSubmit = async (data: z.infer<typeof formSchema>) => {
    setLoading(true);
    const pairGeneratedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    const { shortId: id, uuid: uid } = ShortIdMapper.generatePair();
    const blogCreationBody = {
      ...data,
      id,
      uid,
      authorId: userId
    };
    const metadata = {
      table: `"public"."blogs"`,
      purpose: 'blog',
      source: 'frontend_app',
      context: {
        action: 'CREATE_BLOG',
        blogCreationBody
      },
      createdBy: {
        application: 'frontend_app',
        url: window.location.href
      },
      version: '1.0',
      sourceGeneratedAt: pairGeneratedAt
    } as IdMappingMetadata;

    const idMappingResponse = await createIdMapping(
      id,
      uid,
      metadata,
      cookieStore.toString()
    );

    if (idMappingResponse.message !== 'ID mapping created successfully') {
      toast.error(idMappingResponse.message);
      return;
    }

    const response = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/blogs`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        cache: 'no-store',
        body: JSON.stringify(blogCreationBody),
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        }
      }
    );
    if (response.ok) {
      toast.success('Blog post created successfully');
      router.push('/blogs');
    } else {
      const errorData = await response.json();
      toast.error(errorData.error || 'Failed to create blog post');
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form className='space-y-8' onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='title'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Title</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  placeholder='Blog post title'
                  {...field}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    field.onChange(e);
                    const newSlug = generateSlug(e.target.value);
                    form.setValue('slug', newSlug);
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='description'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  placeholder='Short description of the blog post'
                  {...field}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='content'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Content</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <BlockNoteEditor
                  content={field.value}
                  onChange={(html) => field.onChange(html)}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='image'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Image URL</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input placeholder='https://example.com/image.jpg' {...field} />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='authorName'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Author Name</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input placeholder='John Doe' {...field} />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='authorAvatar'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Author Avatar URL</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  placeholder='https://example.com/avatar.jpg'
                  {...field}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='date'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Publication Date</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  type='date'
                  {...field}
                  value={
                    field.value ? field.value.toString().split('T')[0] : ''
                  }
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>
                Publication date of the blog post
              </FormDescription>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='slug'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Slug</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input placeholder='my-blog-post' {...field} />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>
                URL-friendly version of the title (e.g., my-blog-post)
              </FormDescription>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <Button
          className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
          disabled={loading}
          type='submit'
        >
          {loading && <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />}
          {loading ? 'Creating Blog Post...' : 'Create Blog Post'}
        </Button>
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/organizations/[organizationId]/manage/single-user-invite.tsx ===

'use client';

import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import * as z from 'zod';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/select';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { ROLES } from '@/lib/logto-roles-and-permissions';
import type { CreateInvitationResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organization-invitations';
import type { CreatePendingUserResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/pending-users';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';
import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore } from '@/lib/utils';

const inviteSchema = z.object({
  email: z.string().email('Invalid email address'),
  role: z.string().min(1, 'Role is required'),
  expiryDays: z.number().min(1).max(30).default(3)
});

type FormData = z.infer<typeof inviteSchema>;

type SingleUserInviteProps = {
  organizationId: string;
  organizationName: string;
  user: any;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}

export default function SingleUserInvite({
  organizationId,
  organizationName,
  user,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<SingleUserInviteProps>) {
  const form = useForm<FormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(inviteSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      email: '',
      role: '',
      expiryDays: 3
    }
  });

  clientLogger.info('Rendering single-user invite component', {
    organizationId,
    organizationName,
    user
  });

  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  const onSubmit = async (data: FormData) => {
    if (data.email === user.primaryEmail) {
      form.setError('email', {
        message: 'You cannot invite yourself'
      });
      return;
    }

    clientLogger.info('Sending single-user invitation', {
      organizationId,
      email: data.email,
      role: data.role,
      expiryDays: data.expiryDays
    });

    try {
      const expiresAt = new Date();
      expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + data.expiryDays);
      const invitationLink = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/join-organization/${organizationId}`;

      const [invitationResponse, pendingUserResponse] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-invitations?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            body: JSON.stringify({
              invitee: data.email,
              organizationRoleIds: [data.role],
              inviterId: user.id,
              organizationId,
              expiresAt: expiresAt.getTime(),
              messagePayload: {
                code: '',
                link: invitationLink,
                key: '',
                organizationName,
                inviterName: user.name,
                expiryDate: expiresAt.toLocaleDateString()
              }
            }),
            cache: 'no-store',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
                ? cookieStore.toString()
                : cookieString,
              'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
                ? cookieStore.toString()
                : cookieString
            }
          }
        ).then((res) => res.json() as Promise<CreateInvitationResponse>),
        fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/pending-users?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            cache: 'no-store',
            body: JSON.stringify({
              email: data.email,
              organizationId: organizationId,
              organizationRoleIds: [data.role]
            }),
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
                ? cookieStore.toString()
                : cookieString,
              'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
                ? cookieStore.toString()
                : cookieString
            }
          }
        ).then((res) => res.json() as Promise<CreatePendingUserResponse>)
      ]);

      if (
        invitationResponse.message ===
          'Organization invitation created successfully' &&
        pendingUserResponse.message === 'Pending user created successfully'
      ) {
        toast.success('Invitation sent successfully');
        form.reset();
      } else {
        handleError(pendingUserResponse, invitationResponse);
      }
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      handleError(error);
    }
  };

  const handleError = (
    error: unknown,
    invitationResponse?: CreateInvitationResponse
  ) => {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      if (
        error.message.toLowerCase().includes('unprocessable entity') ||
        error.message.includes('422')
      ) {
        toast.error(
          'User with this email already exists in this organization or an invite has already been sent to this email.'
        );
      } else if (error.message.includes('entity does not exist')) {
        toast.error('User with this email does not exist.');
      } else {
        toast.error(error.message);
      }
    } else if (typeof error === 'object' && error !== null) {
      const response = error as { message?: string };
      if (
        response.message?.includes(
          'duplicate key value violates unique constraint'
        )
      ) {
        toast.error(
          'User with this email already exists in this organization or an invite has already been sent to this email.'
        );
      } else {
        toast.error(`Failed to send invitation: ${response.message}`);
      }
    } else {
      toast.error('Failed to send invitation');
    }
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className='space-y-4'>
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='email'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Email Address</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input type='email' placeholder='Email address' {...field} />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />

        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='role'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Role</FormLabel>
              <Select onValueChange={field.onChange} value={field.value}>
                <FormControl>
                  <SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectValue placeholder='Select a role' />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                </FormControl>
                <SelectContent>
                  {Object.entries(ROLES)
                    .filter(([key, role]) => key !== 'SUPER_ADMIN')
                    .map(([key, role]) => (
                      <SelectItem key={role.id} value={role.id}>
                        {role.description.split('-')[0]}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />

        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='expiryDays'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Invitation Expiry (Days)</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  type='number'
                  min={1}
                  max={30}
                  {...field}
                  onChange={(e) => field.onChange(parseInt(e.target.value))}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />

        <Button
          type='submit'
          disabled={!form.formState.isValid || form.formState.isSubmitting}
        >
          {form.formState.isSubmitting
            ? 'Sending Invitation...'
            : 'Send Invitation'}
        </Button>
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
}

import type { GetActiveTeamsResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/v2/active-teams';
import type { GetOrganizationResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/v2/organizations';
import type { GetSocCodesResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/soc-codes';

import { getAdmins } from '@/actions/admins';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';

const getOrganizationToken = async (
  organizationId: string,
  inviteeEmail: string,
  cookieString: string
) => {
  const joinTokenResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/organization-join/token/${organizationId}/${inviteeEmail}?organizationId=${organizationId}&inviteeEmail=${inviteeEmail}`,
    {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((response) => response.json());

  if (!joinTokenResponse.token) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/',
        'Failed to join organization',
        'Please try again later. ' + joinTokenResponse.message
      )
    );
  }

  return joinTokenResponse.token;
};

export default async function JoinOrganizationPage({
  params,
  searchParams
}: Readonly<{
  params: { organizationId: string };
  searchParams: { [key: string]: string | undefined };
}>) {
  const cookiesStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookiesStore);
  const { organizationId } = await params;
  const { email } = await searchParams;
  const inviteeEmail = decodeURIComponent(email);
  const admins = await getAdmins(organizationId);
  const adminIds = admins.map((admin) => admin.id);

  if (!inviteeEmail) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/',
        'Invalid Invitation',
        'No email provided in the invitation link.'
      )
    );
  }

  // Get Logto context
  const { claims, isAuthenticated } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  const organizationToken = await getOrganizationToken(
    organizationId,
    inviteeEmail,
    cookieString
  );

  const headers = {
    'x-organization-join-token': organizationToken,
    'cookie': cookieString,
    'cookie-string': cookieString,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  };

  // Fetch organization data
  const organizationResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers
    }
  );
  const organizationData: GetOrganizationResponse =
    await organizationResponse.json();
  const organization = organizationData.organization.database;

  if (!organization) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/',
        'Organization Not Found',
        'The organization you are trying to join does not exist.'
      )
    );
  }

  // If user is not logged in, show create account component
  if (!isAuthenticated || !dbUser) {
    // Validate invitation without user context
    const invitationEmail = inviteeEmail;

    if (!invitationEmail) {
      return redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          '/',
          'Invalid Invitation',
          'No email provided in the invitation link.'
        )
      );
    }

    const invitation = await validateInvitation(
      organizationId,
      invitationEmail
    );
    if (!invitation) {
      return redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          '/',
          'Invalid Invitation',
          'The invitation is not valid or has expired.'
        )
      );
    }

    const pendingUser = await validatePendingUser(
      organizationId,
      invitationEmail
    );

    if (!pendingUser) {
      return redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          '/',
          'Invalid Invitation',
          'You are not invited to join this organization.'
        )
      );
    }

    return (
      <CreateAccount
        invitationEmail={invitationEmail}
        organization={organization}
        pendingUser={pendingUser}
      />
    );
  }

  // User is logged in, fetch user data
  // Validate invitation for logged-in user
  const invitation = await validateInvitation(
    organizationId,
    dbUser.primaryEmail
  );
  if (!invitation) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/',
        'Invalid Invitation',
        'The invitation is not valid or has expired.'
      )
    );
  }

  const pendingUser = await validatePendingUser(
    organizationId,
    dbUser.primaryEmail
  );

  if (!pendingUser) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/',
        'Invalid Invitation',
        'You are not invited to join this organization.'
      )
    );
  }

  // If user is already a member of another organization
  if (dbUser.organizationId) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/',
        'Organization Conflict',
        'You are already a member of another organization.'
      )
    );
  }

  // Check if user is already a member of the organization
  if (dbUser.organizationId === BigInt(organizationId)) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/',
        'Already a Member',
        'You are already a member of this organization.'
      )
    );
  }

  // Fetch SOC codes needed for onboarding
  let socCodes = [];

  if (!dbUser.onboardingCompleted) {
    const socCodesResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/soc-codes?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers
      }
    );
    const socCodesData: GetSocCodesResponse = await socCodesResponse.json();
    if (socCodesData.message === 'SOC codes retrieved successfully') {
      socCodes = socCodesData.socCodes.database;
    }
  }

  let activeTeam;

  if (pendingUser) {
    const activeTeamResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/active-teams/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers
      }
    );
    const activeTeamData: GetActiveTeamsResponse =
      await activeTeamResponse.json();

    activeTeam = activeTeamData.teams.find(
      (team) => String(team.id) === String(pendingUser.activeTeamId)
    );
  }

  // Handle different user states
  if (!dbUser.onboardingCompleted) {
    return (
      <CompleteOnboarding
        organization={organization}
        pendingUser={pendingUser}
        socCodes={socCodes}
        user={dbUser}
      />
    );
  }

  // User has completed onboarding, show join organization component
  return (
    <JoinOrganization
      activeTeam={activeTeam}
      adminIds={adminIds}
      invitation={invitation}
      joinToken={organizationToken}
      organization={organization}
      pendingUser={pendingUser}
      user={dbUser}
      cookieString={cookieString}
    />
  );
}

=== FILE: ./hooks/use-audit-logs.ts ===

'use client';

import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
  parseAsString,
  parseAsInteger,
  parseAsIsoDate,
  parseAsArrayOf,
  useQueryStates
} from 'nuqs';
import {
  getAuditLogs,
  getAuditLogStats,
  getAuditLogById,
  exportAuditLogsToCSV,
  type AuditLogFiltersType,
  type AuditLogSort,
  type GetAuditLogsSchema
} from '@/actions/audit-logs';
import {
  type AuditLogAction,
  type AuditLogCategory,
  type AuditLogSeverity
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';

// Define the search params schema for nuqs
const auditLogsSearchParams = {
  page: parseAsInteger.withDefault(1),
  pageSize: parseAsInteger.withDefault(10),
  search: parseAsString,
  actions: parseAsArrayOf(parseAsString),
  categories: parseAsArrayOf(parseAsString),
  severities: parseAsArrayOf(parseAsString),
  dateFrom: parseAsIsoDate,
  dateTo: parseAsIsoDate,
  entityTypes: parseAsArrayOf(parseAsString),
  entityNames: parseAsArrayOf(parseAsString),
  targetUserIds: parseAsArrayOf(parseAsString),
  teamIds: parseAsArrayOf(parseAsString),
  documentIds: parseAsArrayOf(parseAsString),
  sortField: parseAsString.withDefault('createdAt'),
  sortDirection: parseAsString.withDefault('desc')
};

type AuditLogStats = {
  total: number;
  failedCount: number;
  successRate: number;
  categoryStats: { category: string; count: number }[];
  severityStats: { severity: string; count: number }[];
};

export function useAuditLogs() {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useQueryStates(
    auditLogsSearchParams,
    {
      shallow: false
    }
  );

  // Convert search params to filters format
  const filters = useMemo((): AuditLogFiltersType => {
    return {
      search: searchParams.search || undefined,
      actions: searchParams.actions?.length
        ? (searchParams.actions as AuditLogAction[])
        : undefined,
      categories: searchParams.categories?.length
        ? (searchParams.categories as AuditLogCategory[])
        : undefined,
      severities: searchParams.severities?.length
        ? (searchParams.severities as AuditLogSeverity[])
        : undefined,
      dateFrom: searchParams.dateFrom || undefined,
      dateTo: searchParams.dateTo || undefined,
      entityTypes: searchParams.entityTypes?.length
        ? searchParams.entityTypes
        : undefined,
      entityNames: searchParams.entityNames?.length
        ? searchParams.entityNames
        : undefined,
      targetUserIds: searchParams.targetUserIds?.length
        ? searchParams.targetUserIds.map((id) => BigInt(id))
        : undefined,
      teamIds: searchParams.teamIds?.length
        ? searchParams.teamIds.map((id) => BigInt(id))
        : undefined,
      documentIds: searchParams.documentIds?.length
        ? searchParams.documentIds.map((id) => BigInt(id))
        : undefined
    };
  }, [searchParams]);

  // Convert search params to sort format
  const sort = useMemo((): AuditLogSort => {
    return {
      field: searchParams.sortField as AuditLogSort['field'],
      direction: searchParams.sortDirection as AuditLogSort['direction']
    };
  }, [searchParams.sortField, searchParams.sortDirection]);

  // Build query input
  const queryInput = useMemo((): GetAuditLogsSchema => {
    return {
      page: searchParams.page,
      pageSize: searchParams.pageSize,
      filters,
      sort
    };
  }, [searchParams.page, searchParams.pageSize, filters, sort]);

  // Main audit logs query
  const auditLogsQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['auditLogs', queryInput],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const result = await getAuditLogs(queryInput);
      if (!result.success) {
        throw new Error(result.error);
      }
      return result.data;
    },
    staleTime: 30000 // 30 seconds
  });

  // Stats query
  const statsQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['auditLogStats', filters.dateFrom, filters.dateTo],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const result = await getAuditLogStats({
        dateFrom:
          filters.dateFrom || new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000), // Last 30 days
        dateTo: filters.dateTo || new Date()
      });
      if (!result.success) {
        throw new Error(result.error);
      }
      return result.data;
    },
    staleTime: 60000 // 1 minute
  });

  // Update functions
  const updatePage = useCallback(
    (page: number) => {
      setSearchParams({ page });
    },
    [setSearchParams]
  );

  const updatePageSize = useCallback(
    (pageSize: number) => {
      setSearchParams({ pageSize, page: 1 });
    },
    [setSearchParams]
  );

  const updateFilters = useCallback(
    (newFilters: Partial<AuditLogFiltersType>) => {
      setSearchParams({
        search: newFilters.search || null,
        actions: newFilters.actions?.length ? newFilters.actions : null,
        categories: newFilters.categories?.length
          ? newFilters.categories
          : null,
        severities: newFilters.severities?.length
          ? newFilters.severities
          : null,
        dateFrom: newFilters.dateFrom || null,
        dateTo: newFilters.dateTo || null,
        entityTypes: newFilters.entityTypes?.length
          ? newFilters.entityTypes
          : null,
        entityNames: newFilters.entityNames?.length
          ? newFilters.entityNames
          : null,
        targetUserIds: newFilters.targetUserIds?.length
          ? newFilters.targetUserIds.map((id) => id.toString())
          : null,
        teamIds: newFilters.teamIds?.length
          ? newFilters.teamIds.map((id) => id.toString())
          : null,
        documentIds: newFilters.documentIds?.length
          ? newFilters.documentIds.map((id) => id.toString())
          : null,
        page: 1 // Reset to first page when filters change
      });
    },
    [setSearchParams]
  );

  const updateSort = useCallback(
    (newSort: Partial<AuditLogSort>) => {
      setSearchParams({
        sortField: newSort.field || 'createdAt',
        sortDirection: newSort.direction || 'desc'
      });
    },
    [setSearchParams]
  );

  const clearFilters = useCallback(() => {
    setSearchParams({
      search: null,
      actions: null,
      categories: null,
      severities: null,
      dateFrom: null,
      dateTo: null,
      entityTypes: null,
      entityNames: null,
      targetUserIds: null,
      teamIds: null,
      documentIds: null,
      page: 1,
      sortField: 'createdAt',
      sortDirection: 'desc'
    });
  }, [setSearchParams]);

  return {
    // Data
    data: auditLogsQuery.data,
    stats: statsQuery.data,
    isLoading: auditLogsQuery.isLoading,
    isStatsLoading: statsQuery.isLoading,
    error: auditLogsQuery.error,
    statsError: statsQuery.error,

    // Current state
    currentPage: searchParams.page,
    pageSize: searchParams.pageSize,
    filters,
    sort,

    // Actions
    updatePage,
    updatePageSize,
    updateFilters,
    updateSort,
    clearFilters,

    // Refresh
    refetch: auditLogsQuery.refetch,
    refetchStats: statsQuery.refetch
  };
}

// Hook for getting a specific audit log by ID
export function useAuditLogById(logId?: string | null) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['auditLog', logId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!logId) return null;
      const result = await getAuditLogById(logId);
      if (!result.success) {
        throw new Error(result.error);
      }
      return result.data;
    },
    enabled: !!logId,
    staleTime: 60000 // 1 minute
  });
}

// Hook for exporting audit logs
export function useExportAuditLogs() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      filters,
      selectedIds
    }: {
      filters?: AuditLogFiltersType;
      selectedIds?: bigint[];
    }) => {
      const result = await exportAuditLogsToCSV({
        filters: filters || {},
        selectedIds
      });

      if (!result.success) {
        throw new Error(result.error);
      }

      return result.data;
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      // Create and download CSV file
      const blob = new Blob([data.csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.setAttribute('download', data.filename);
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      link.remove();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

      // Invalidate queries to refresh data
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['auditLogs'] });
    }
  });
}

) {

  });

/**
 * Assign organization scopes to the specified organization role.
 * @param {string} id - The unique identifier of the organization role.
 * @param {string[]} organizationScopeIds - An array of organization scope IDs to be assigned.
 * @returns {Promise<void>}

export async function assignOrganizationRoleScopes(
  id: string,
  organizationScopeIds: string[]
) {

    organizationScopeIds
  });
}

/**
 * Create a new organization role with the given data.
 * @param {object} roleData - The data for the new organization role.
 * @param {string} [roleData.tenantId] - The tenant ID for the organization role.
 * @param {string} roleData.name - The name of the organization role.
 * @param {string|null} [roleData.description] - The description of the organization role.
 * @param {'User'|'MachineToMachine'} [roleData.type] - The type of the organization role.
 * @param {string[]} roleData.organizationScopeIds - The IDs of the organization scopes to assign to the role.
 * @param {string[]} roleData.resourceScopeIds - The IDs of the resource scopes to assign to the role.
