/**
 * Update organization role details by ID with the given data.
 * @param {string} id - The unique identifier of the organization role.
 * @param {object} roleData - The data to update the organization role with.
 * @param {string} [roleData.tenantId] - The tenant ID for the organization role.
 * @param {string} [roleData.id] - The ID of the organization role.
 * @param {string} [roleData.name] - The name of the organization role.
 * @param {string|null} [roleData.description] - The description of the organization role.
 * @param {'User'|'MachineToMachine'} [roleData.type] - The type of the organization role.
 * @returns {Promise<object>} The updated organization role.
 */
export async function updateOrganizationRole(
  id: string,
  roleData: Partial<{
    description: string | null;
    id: string;
    name: string;
    tenantId: string;
    type: 'User' | 'MachineToMachine';
  }>
) {
  return makeApiRequest(`/${id}`, 'PATCH', roleData);
}

/**
 * Make an API request to the Logto organization roles API.
 * @param {string} endpoint - The API endpoint.
 * @param {'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE'} [method='GET'] - The HTTP method.
 * @param {object} [body] - The request body.
 * @returns {Promise<any>} The API response.
 * @throws {Error} If the API request fails.
 */
async function makeApiRequest(
  endpoint: string,
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE' = 'GET',
  body?: object
) {
  const url = `${BASE_URL}/api/organization-roles${endpoint}`;
  const options: RequestInit = {
    method,
    headers:
      method !== 'GET' ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : undefined,
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined
  };

  const response = await fetch(url, options);

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      `Logto organization roles API call failed: ${response.statusText}`
    );
  }

  return method === 'DELETE' ? undefined : response.json();
}

/**
 * Convert an object of parameters to a query string.
 * @param {Record<string, unknown>} params - The parameters to convert.
 * @returns {string} The query string.
 */
function paramsToQueryString(params: Record<string, unknown>) {
  return new URLSearchParams(params as Record<string, string>).toString();
}

function getBadgeClassName(status: TeamMemberStatus) {
  switch (status) {
    case TeamMemberStatus.ACTIVE:
      return 'bg-green-500/10 text-green-500 border-green-500/30';
    case TeamMemberStatus.PENDING:
      return 'bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-500 border-yellow-500/30';
    case TeamMemberStatus.INACTIVE:
      return 'bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-500 border-orange-500/30';
    case TeamMemberStatus.BLOCKED:
      return 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 border-red-500/30';
    default:
      return 'bg-gray-500/10 text-gray-500 border-gray-500/30';
  }
}

export default async function EventDetailsPage({
  params
}: Readonly<{
  params: Readonly<{
    organizationId: string;
    teamId: string;
    eventId: string;
  }>;
}>) {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const data = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookieStore.getAll());
  const { organizationId, teamId, eventId } = await params;

  // 0. check if the user is authenticated
  if (!data.isAuthenticated) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/`,
        'Not Logged In',
        'You are not logged in. Please log in to continue.'
      )
    );
  }

  // 1. Validate organization access
  const validationError = await validateOrganizationAccess(
    data.claims.sub,
    organizationId,
    ROLES.L1_USER.id,
    cookieString,
    `/account/organizations/${organizationId}`
  );

  if (validationError) {
    return validationError;
  }

  // 2. Fetch event details
  const eventResponse: GetTeamCalendarEventResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-calendar-events/event/${eventId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (eventResponse.message !== 'Team calendar event retrieved successfully') {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}/events`,
        'Event Not Found',
        'The requested event could not be found.'
      )
    );
  }

  const event = eventResponse.event.database;
  const isCreator = event.createdBy === data.claims.sub;

  // 3. Check if user has access to manage the event
  const canManageEvent =
    isCreator ||
    (await validateOrganizationAccess(
      data.claims.sub,
      organizationId,
      ROLES.L5_USER.id,
      cookieString,
      `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${event.teamId}/events/${eventId}`
    )) === undefined;

  const createdByUser = (await getUser(event.createdBy)) as LogtoUser;

  return (
    <div className='container mx-auto space-y-6 py-6'>
      <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
        <div>
          <h1 className='text-2xl font-bold'>{event.title}</h1>
          <p className='text-muted-foreground'>
            Created by {createdByUser.name || 'Unknown'} on{' '}
            {format(new Date(event.createdAt), 'PPP')}
          </p>
        </div>
        {canManageEvent && (
          <Button asChild>
            <Link
              href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${event.teamId}/events/${eventId}/manage`}
            >
              Manage Event
            </Link>
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-3'>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Event Details</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className='space-y-4'>
            <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
              <Clock className='h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground' />
              <div>
                <p className='font-medium'>Time</p>
                <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                  {format(new Date(event.startDate), 'PPp')} -{' '}
                  {format(new Date(event.endDate), 'PPp')}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
              <MapPin className='h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground' />
              <div>
                <p className='font-medium'>Location</p>
                <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                  {event.location || 'No location specified'}

              </div>
            </div>

              <CalendarIcon className='h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground' />

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/select';
import { Loader2, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import {
  createJoinRequest,
  searchPublicOrganizations
} from '@/actions/organization-join-requests';
import type { OrganizationCS } from '@signvault/db/types';

// Form validation schema
const joinOrganizationSchema = z.object({
  organizationId: z.string().min(1, 'Please select an organization'),
  searchQuery: z.string().optional()
});

type JoinOrganizationFormValues = z.infer<typeof joinOrganizationSchema>;

type JoinOrganizationDialogProps = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess?: () => void;
};

/**
 * Dialog component for joining an existing organization
 * Allows users to search for public organizations and send join requests
 */
export function JoinOrganizationDialog({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSuccess
}: JoinOrganizationDialogProps) {
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);
  const [organizations, setOrganizations] = useState<OrganizationCS[]>([]);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

  const form = useForm<JoinOrganizationFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(joinOrganizationSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      organizationId: '',
      searchQuery: ''
    }
  });

  // Search for public organizations
  const handleSearch = async (query: string) => {
    if (!query.trim()) {
      setOrganizations([]);
      return;
    }

    setIsSearching(true);
    try {
      const result = await searchPublicOrganizations(query);
      if (result.success) {
        setOrganizations(result.organizations);
      } else {
        toast.error(result.error || 'Failed to search organizations');
        setOrganizations([]);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Search error:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to search organizations');
      setOrganizations([]);
    } finally {
      setIsSearching(false);
    }
  };

  // Handle search input change with debouncing
  const handleSearchChange = (value: string) => {
    setSearchQuery(value);
    form.setValue('searchQuery', value);

    // Clear previous organization selection when search changes
    form.setValue('organizationId', '');

    // Debounce search
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
      handleSearch(value);
    }, 300);

    return () => clearTimeout(timeoutId);
  };

  // Submit join request
  const onSubmit = async (values: JoinOrganizationFormValues) => {
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const result = await createJoinRequest({
        organizationId: values.organizationId
      });

      if (result.success) {
        toast.success('Join request sent successfully!');
        form.reset();
        setOrganizations([]);
        setSearchQuery('');
        onClose();
        onSuccess?.();
      } else {
        toast.error(result.error || 'Failed to send join request');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Submit error:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to send join request');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Handle dialog close
  const handleClose = () => {
    if (!isSubmitting) {
      form.reset();
      setOrganizations([]);
      setSearchQuery('');
      onClose();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={handleClose}>
      <DialogContent className='font-suisse-intl sm:max-w-[500px]'>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Join an Existing Organization</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Search for public organizations and send a join request.
            Organization admins will review your request.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <Form {...form}>
          <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className='space-y-6'>
            <div className='space-y-4'>
              {/* Search Input */}
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='searchQuery'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Search Organizations</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <div className='relative'>
                        <Search className='absolute left-3 top-3 size-4 text-muted-foreground' />
                        <Input
                          {...field}
                          placeholder='Enter organization name...'
                          className='pl-10'
                          value={searchQuery}
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            field.onChange(e);
                            handleSearchChange(e.target.value);
                          }}
                        />
                        {isSearching && (
                          <Loader2 className='absolute right-3 top-3 size-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground' />
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              {/* Organization Selection */}
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='organizationId'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Select Organization</FormLabel>
                    <Select
                      onValueChange={field.onChange}
                      value={field.value}
                      disabled={organizations.length === 0}
                    >
                      <FormControl>
                        <SelectTrigger className='font-suisse-intl'>
                          <SelectValue
                            placeholder={
                              organizations.length === 0
                                ? 'Search for organizations above'
                                : 'Select an organization'
                            }
                          />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                      </FormControl>
                      <SelectContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
                        {organizations.map((org) => (
                          <SelectItem key={org.id} value={String(org.id)}>
                            <div className='flex flex-col'>
                              <span className='font-medium'>{org.name}</span>
                              {org.description && (
                                <span className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                                  {org.description}
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </SelectItem>
                        ))}
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            </div>

            <DialogFooter>
              <Button
                type='button'
                variant='outline'
                onClick={handleClose}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button
                type='submit'
                disabled={isSubmitting || !form.watch('organizationId')}
              >
                {isSubmitting && (
                  <Loader2 className='mr-2 size-4 animate-spin' />
                )}
                {isSubmitting ? 'Sending Request...' : 'Send Join Request'}
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </form>
        </Form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

export function AccountBreadcrumb() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const { organizationData, organizationLoading } = useUserData();

  const userHasJoinedOrganization = organizationData?.organizationJoined;
  const isAdmin =
    organizationData?.user?.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
    organizationData?.user?.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L6_USER.id ||
    organizationData?.user?.isCreator;

  // Function to generate breadcrumb segments from the current path
  const generateBreadcrumbs = (path: string): BreadcrumbSegment[] => {
    // Remove trailing slash and split path into segments
    const segments = path.replace(/\/$/u, '').split('/').filter(Boolean);

    if (segments[0] !== 'account') return [];

    // Handle base account path
    if (segments.length === 1) {
      return [
        {
          title: 'Account',
          url: '/account',
          icon: UserCircle
        },
        {
          title: 'Settings',
          url: '/account/settings/basic',
          icon: Settings
        }
      ];
    }

    if (
      segments[0] === 'account' &&
      segments[1] === 'documents' &&
      !isNaN(Number(segments[2])) &&
      segments[3] === 'esign'
    ) {
      return [
        {
          title: 'Account',
          url: '/account',
          icon: UserCircle
        },
        {
          title: 'Documents',
          url: '/account/documents',
          icon: FileText
        },
        {
          title: 'Document',
          url: `/account/documents/${segments[2]}`,
          icon: FileText
        },
        {
          title: 'E-Sign',
          url: `/account/documents/${segments[2]}/esign`,
          icon: Signature
        }
      ];
    }

    // Notifications
    if (segments[1] === 'notifications') {
      return [
        {
          title: 'Account',
          url: '/account',
          icon: UserCircle
        },
        {
          title: 'Notifications',
          url: '/account/notifications',
          icon: BellIcon
        }
      ];
    }

    // Documents
    if (segments[1] === 'documents' && !isNaN(Number(segments[2]))) {
      return [
        {
          title: 'Account',
          url: '/account',
          icon: UserCircle
        },
        {
          title: 'Documents',
          url: '/account/documents',
          icon: FileText
        }
      ];
    }

    if (
      segments[1] === 'form-templates' &&
      segments[2] === 't' &&
      segments[3]
    ) {
      return [
        {
          title: 'Account',
          url: '/account',
          icon: UserCircle
        },
        {
          title: 'Form Templates',
          url: '/account/form-templates',
          icon: FileAxis3dIcon
        },
        {
          title: 'Template',
          url: `/account/form-templates`,
          icon: FileText
        }
      ];
    }
    if (segments[1] === 'form-templates' && segments[2] === 'create') {
      return [
        {
          title: 'Account',
          url: '/account',
          icon: UserCircle
        },
        {
          title: 'Form Templates',
          url: `/account/form-templates`,
          icon: FileAxis3dIcon
        },
        {
          title: 'Create',
          url: `/account/form-templates/create`,
          icon: PlusCircle
        }
      ];
    }

    const breadcrumbs: BreadcrumbSegment[] = [
      {
        title: 'Account',
        url: '/account',
        icon: UserCircle
      }
    ];

    let currentPath = '';
    let currentNavItems = mainNavItems(userHasJoinedOrganization, isAdmin);

    // Process each segment after 'account'
    for (let i = 1; i < segments.length; i++) {
      const segment = segments[i];
      currentPath += `/${segment}`;

      // Try to find matching nav item at current level
      let matchingItem = currentNavItems?.find((item) => {
        // Check main item URL
        if (item?.url?.endsWith(currentPath)) {
          return true;
        }
        // Check sub-items if they exist
        if (item.items) {
          return item.items.some((subItem) =>
            subItem?.url?.endsWith(currentPath)
          );
        }
        return false;
      });

      // If no direct match found but we have a parent with sub-items
      if (!matchingItem && currentNavItems) {
        for (const item of currentNavItems) {
          if (item.items) {
            const subItem = item.items.find((sub) =>
              sub?.url?.endsWith(currentPath)
            );
            if (subItem) {
              // Add the parent first if it hasn't been added
              if (breadcrumbs[breadcrumbs.length - 1].title !== item.title) {
                breadcrumbs.push({
                  title: item.title,
                  url: item.url || '#',
                  icon: item.icon
                });
              }
              matchingItem = { ...subItem, icon: item.icon };
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }

      if (matchingItem) {
        breadcrumbs.push({
          title: matchingItem.title,
          url: matchingItem.url || '#',
          icon: matchingItem.icon
        });

        // Update current nav items for next iteration
        currentNavItems = matchingItem.items || [];
      } else {
        // Handle unknown segments by using capitalized segment name
        breadcrumbs.push({
          title:
            segment.charAt(0).toUpperCase() +
            segment.slice(1).replace(/-/gu, ' '),
          url: `/account${currentPath}`,
          icon: undefined
        });
      }
    }

    return breadcrumbs;
  };

  const breadcrumbs = generateBreadcrumbs(pathname);
  if (breadcrumbs.length <= 1) return null;

  return (
    <div className='flex w-full items-center justify-between'>
      <Breadcrumb>
        <BreadcrumbList>
          {organizationLoading ? (
            <Skeleton className='h-6 w-96' />
          ) : (
            breadcrumbs.map((item, index) => (
              <React.Fragment key={item.url}>
                <BreadcrumbItem>
                  {index === breadcrumbs.length - 1 ? (
                    <BreadcrumbPage className='inline-flex items-center gap-1.5'>
                      {item.icon && (
                        <item.icon
                          aria-hidden='true'
                          size={16}
                          strokeWidth={2}
                        />
                      )}
                      {item.title}
                    </BreadcrumbPage>
                  ) : (
                    <BreadcrumbLink
                      asChild
                      className='inline-flex items-center gap-1.5'
                    >
                      <Link href={item.url}>
                        {item.icon && (
                          <item.icon
                            aria-hidden='true'
                            size={16}
                            strokeWidth={2}
                          />
                        )}
                        {item.title}
                      </Link>
                    </BreadcrumbLink>
                  )}
                </BreadcrumbItem>
                {index < breadcrumbs.length - 1 && <BreadcrumbSeparator />}
              </React.Fragment>
            ))
          )}
        </BreadcrumbList>
      </Breadcrumb>

      <MobileNavigation />
      <ThemeToggle
        variant='button'
        size='sm'
        className='hidden h-5 border-none bg-background text-foreground lg:block'
        themes={['light', 'dark']}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { countryList } from '../constants';

const MapboxAddressSearch = dynamic(
  () => import('@/components/address-autofill'),
  { ssr: false }
);

// Create a map for quick country code lookup
const countryMap = new Map(
  countryList.map((country) => [country.code, country])
);

export function BillingForm() {
  const [selectedCountryCode, setSelectedCountryCode] = useState('');
  const form = useFormContext();

  // Initialize selectedCountryCode from form values
  useEffect(() => {
    const values = form.getValues();
    if (values.country) {
      setSelectedCountryCode(values.country);
    }
  }, [form]);

  const handleCountryChange = useCallback(
    (countryCode: string) => {
      setSelectedCountryCode(countryCode);
      const country = countryMap.get(countryCode);
      if (country) {
        form.setValue('country', countryCode);
        // Reset state, city and postal code when country changes
        form.setValue('state', '');
        form.setValue('city', '');
        form.setValue('postalCode', '');
      }
    },
    [form]
  );

  const handleAddressSelect = useCallback(
    (feature: MapboxFeature) => {
      const countryCode =
        feature.properties?.context?.country?.country_code?.toUpperCase() ?? '';
      const country = countryMap.get(countryCode);

      if (country) {
        const regionName = feature.properties?.context?.region?.name ?? '';
        form.setValue('address', feature.properties?.full_address ?? '');
        form.setValue('country', countryCode);
        form.setValue('state', regionName);
        form.setValue('city', feature.properties?.context?.place?.name ?? '');
        form.setValue(
          'postalCode',
          feature.properties?.context?.postcode?.name ?? ''
        );
        setSelectedCountryCode(countryCode);
      }
    },
    [form]
  );

  const states = selectedCountryCode
    ? State.getStatesOfCountry(selectedCountryCode).map((state) => ({
        value: state.name,
        label: state.name
      }))
    : [];

  return (
    <div className='flex flex-col gap-4'>
      <FormField
        name='billingEmail'
        render={({ field }) => (
          <FormItem>
            <FormLabel>Email</FormLabel>
            <FormControl>
              <Input
                placeholder='acme@example.com'
                required
                type='email'
                {...field}
              />
            </FormControl>
            <FormMessage />
          </FormItem>
        )}
      />
      <FormField
        name='address'
        render={({ field }) => (
          <FormItem>
            <FormLabel>Address</FormLabel>
            <FormControl>
              <MapboxAddressSearch
                onChange={field.onChange}
                onSelect={handleAddressSelect}
                value={field.value}
              />
            </FormControl>
            <FormMessage />
          </FormItem>
        )}
      />
      <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2'>
        <FormField
          name='country'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Country</FormLabel>
              <Select onValueChange={handleCountryChange} value={field.value}>
                <FormControl>
                  <SelectTrigger className='font-suisse-intl [&>span]:flex [&>span]:items-center [&>span]:gap-2 [&>span_svg]:shrink-0 [&>span_svg]:text-muted-foreground/80'>
                    <SelectValue placeholder='Select country' />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                </FormControl>

                  {countryList.map((country) => (

              <FormMessage />

        />
        <FormField

              <Select
                disabled={!selectedCountryCode}
                onValueChange={field.onChange}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/table';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  EllipsisVertical,
  Eye,
  Pencil,
  Trash,
  Loader2,
  Database
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import type { OrganizationSourceSystem } from '@signvault/db/types';
import EditSourceSystemDialog from './edit-source-system-dialog';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getSourceSystemConfig
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';

export default function SourceSystemsTable({
  organizationId,
  sourceSystems,
  onUpdate,
  isLoading,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<{
  organizationId: string;
  sourceSystems: OrganizationSourceSystem[];
  onUpdate: () => void;
  isLoading: boolean;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}>) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [editingSystem, setEditingSystem] =
    useState<OrganizationSourceSystem | null>(null);
  const [deletingSystem, setDeletingSystem] =
    useState<OrganizationSourceSystem | null>(null);
  clientLogger.info('Rendering source systems table', {
    sourceSystems,
    organizationId
  });
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!deletingSystem) return;

    try {
      clientLogger.info('Deleting source system', {
        organizationId,
        deletingSystem
      });
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-source-systems/organizations/${organizationId}/${deletingSystem.id}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          },
          cache: 'no-store'
        }
      );

      if (response.ok) {
        clientLogger.info('Source system deleted successfully');
        toast.success('Source system deleted successfully');
        onUpdate();
      } else {
        toast.error('Failed to delete source system');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error('Error deleting source system', {
        error,
        organizationId,
        deletingSystem
      });
      toast.error('An error occurred while deleting the source system');
    }
    setDeletingSystem(null);
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    clientLogger.info('Source systems table is loading', {
      organizationId
    });
    return (
      <div className='flex h-40 items-center justify-center'>
        <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Table>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead className='hidden sm:table-cell'>Name</TableHead>
            <TableHead className='hidden sm:table-cell'>Type</TableHead>
            <TableHead className='hidden md:table-cell'>Visibility</TableHead>
            <TableHead className='hidden lg:table-cell'>Entity Type</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Actions</TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {sourceSystems.length === 0 ? (
            <TableRow>
              <TableCell colSpan={5} className='text-center text-sm'>
                No source systems available. Please click on the{' '}
                <span className='font-bold'>Create Source System</span> button
                above to create a new source system.
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ) : (
            sourceSystems.map((system) => {
              const config = getSourceSystemConfig(system.configuration);
              return (
                <TableRow key={system.id}>
                  <TableCell>{config.name}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className='hidden capitalize sm:table-cell'>
                    {config.type.toLowerCase().replaceAll('_', ' ')}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className='hidden capitalize md:table-cell'>
                    {system.visibility.toLowerCase()}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className='hidden capitalize lg:table-cell'>
                    {system.entityType.toLowerCase()}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <DropdownMenu>
                      <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                        <Button variant='ghost' size='sm'>
                          <EllipsisVertical className='h-4 w-4' />
                        </Button>
                      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                      <DropdownMenuContent align='end'>
                        <DropdownMenuItem
                          onClick={() =>
                            router.push(
                              `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/source-systems/${system.id}/content`
                            )
                          }
                        >
                          <Database className='mr-2 h-4 w-4' />
                          View Content
                        </DropdownMenuItem>
                        <DropdownMenuItem
                          onClick={() =>
                            router.push(
                              `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/source-systems/${system.id}`
                            )
                          }
                        >
                          <Eye className='mr-2 h-4 w-4' />

                        >

                    </DropdownMenu>
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              );
            })
          )}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>

        <EditSourceSystemDialog

          onUpdate={() => {

            setEditingSystem(null);
          }}
        />
      )}

        open={!!deletingSystem}
        onOpenChange={() => setDeletingSystem(null)}
      >
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Delete Source System</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              Are you sure you want to delete this source system? This action
              cannot be undone.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

            <Button variant='outline' onClick={() => setDeletingSystem(null)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button variant='destructive' onClick={handleDelete}>
              Delete
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>

const generalSettingsSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(1, 'Name is required'),
  description: z.string().optional(),
  type: z.enum(
    sourceSystemTypeEnum.enumValues.map((type) => type.toString()) as [
      string,
      ...string[]
    ]
  ),
  visibility: z.enum(
    visibilityEnum.enumValues.map((visibility) => visibility.toString()) as [
      string,
      ...string[]
    ]
  )
});

export default function GeneralSettings({
  sourceSystem,
  organizationId,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<{
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
  sourceSystem: OrganizationSourceSystem;
  organizationId: string;
}>) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const config = getSourceSystemConfig(sourceSystem.configuration);
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  const form = useForm<z.infer<typeof generalSettingsSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(generalSettingsSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      name: config.name,
      description: config.description,
      type: config.source_system_type,
      visibility: String(sourceSystem.visibility)
    }
  });

  clientLogger.info('Rendering general settings form', {
    form,
    sourceSystemId: sourceSystem.id,
    organizationId
  });

  const onSubmit = async (values: z.infer<typeof generalSettingsSchema>) => {
    try {
      const config = getSourceSystemConfig(sourceSystem.configuration);
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-source-systems/organizations/${organizationId}/${sourceSystem.id}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
          },
          method: 'PATCH',
          body: JSON.stringify({
            configuration: {
              ...config,
              source_system_name: values.name,
              source_system_description: values.description
            },
            type: values.type,
            visibility: values.visibility
          })
        }
      );

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        return toast.error(data.message ?? 'Failed to update settings');
      }

      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['sourceSystem', sourceSystem.id]
      });

      form.reset();

      return toast.success('Settings updated successfully');
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to update settings');
    }
  };
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>General Settings</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          Configure the basic settings for your source system
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <Form {...form}>
          <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className='space-y-6'>
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='name'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Name</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Input {...field} />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>

            />
            <FormField

              name='description'

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/table';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Check, X, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { type GetPendingInvitationsResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organization-invitations';
import type { PendingUser } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';
import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore } from '@/lib/utils';

type PendingInvitationsDialogProps = {
  organizationId: string;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUpdate: () => void;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}

export default function PendingInvitationsDialog({
  organizationId,
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onUpdate,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<PendingInvitationsDialogProps>) {
  const logger = clientLogger;

  const [pendingInvitations, setPendingInvitations] = useState<PendingUser[]>(
    []
  );
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);

  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  const fetchPendingInvitations = useCallback(async () => {
    logger.info('Fetching pending invitations', {
      organizationId
    });
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-invitations/${organizationId}/pending-invitations?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          }
        }
      );
      const responseData: GetPendingInvitationsResponse = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Failed to fetch pending invitations');
      }
      if (responseData.pendingInvitations.database) {
        setPendingInvitations(responseData.pendingInvitations.database);
      } else {
        setPendingInvitations([]);
      }
      logger.info('Pending invitations fetched successfully', {
        count: pendingInvitations.length
      });
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        logger.error('Error fetching pending invitations', {
          message: error.message,
          stack: error.stack
        });
        toast.error(`Failed to fetch pending invitations: ${error.message}`);
      } else {
        logger.error('Error fetching pending invitations', {
          error
        });
        toast.error('Failed to fetch pending invitations');
      }
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [organizationId, logger]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      fetchPendingInvitations();
    }
  }, [isOpen, organizationId, fetchPendingInvitations]);

  const handleAccept = async (invitation: PendingUser) => {
    logger.info('Accepting invitation', {
      email: invitation.email
    });
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-invitations/${organizationId}/accept-invitation/${invitation.email}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          }
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Failed to accept invitation');
      }

      toast.success('User added to the organization');
      fetchPendingInvitations();
      onUpdate();
      logger.info('Invitation accepted successfully', {
        email: invitation.email
      });
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Error accepting invitation', {
        email: invitation.email,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
      });
      toast.error('Failed to accept invitation');
    }
  };

  const handleReject = async (invitation: PendingUser) => {
    logger.info('Rejecting invitation', {
      email: invitation.email
    });
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-invitations/${organizationId}/reject-invitation/${invitation.email}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          }
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Failed to reject invitation');
      }

      toast.success('Invitation rejected');
      fetchPendingInvitations();
      onUpdate();
      logger.info('Invitation rejected successfully', {
        email: invitation.email
      });
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Error rejecting invitation', {
        email: invitation.email,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
      });
      toast.error('Failed to reject invitation');
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onClose}>
      <DialogContent className='sm:max-w-[425px]'>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Pending Join Requests</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Review and manage pending requests to join the organization.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        {isLoading ? (
          <div className='flex items-center justify-center py-4'>
            <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {pendingInvitations.length === 0 ? (
              <p className='py-4 text-center'>No pending invitations</p>
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>User</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Actions</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {pendingInvitations.map((invitation) => (
                    <TableRow key={invitation.email}>
                      <TableCell>{invitation.email}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className='flex gap-2'>
                        <Button
                          size='sm'
                          onClick={() => handleAccept(invitation)}
                          className='bg-green-500 hover:bg-green-600'
                        >
                          <Check className='h-4 w-4' />
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          size='sm'
                          onClick={() => handleReject(invitation)}
                          variant='destructive'
                        >
                          <X className='h-4 w-4' />
                        </Button>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

  const [deletingBlog, setDeletingBlog] = useState<Blog | null>(null);
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  const handleEdit = (blog: Blog) => {
    setEditingBlog(blog);
  };

  const handleDelete = (blog: Blog) => {
    setDeletingBlog(blog);
  };

  const confirmDelete = async () => {
    if (deletingBlog) {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/blogs/${deletingBlog.slug}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
          {
            method: 'DELETE',
            cache: 'no-store',
            headers: {
              'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
                ? cookieStore.toString()
                : cookieString,
              'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
                ? cookieStore.toString()
                : cookieString
            }
          }
        );
        const responseData: DeleteBlogResponse = await response.json();
        if (responseData.message === 'Blog deleted successfully') {
          toast.success(responseData.message);
          clientLogger.info('Blog deleted successfully', {
            message: responseData.message
          });
          onUpdate();
        } else {
          clientLogger.error('Failed to delete blog', {
            message: responseData.message,
            responseData
          });
          toast.error('Failed to delete blog');
        }
      } catch (error) {
        clientLogger.error('Error deleting blog', {
          error
        });
        toast.error('An error occurred while deleting the blog');
      }
      setDeletingBlog(null);
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className='flex h-full items-center justify-center'>
        <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className='rounded-lg p-6 shadow-sm' id='blogs-table'>
      <h2 className='mb-4 text-2xl font-semibold'>All Blogs Published</h2>
      <Table>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead>Title</TableHead>
            <TableHead className='hidden lg:table-cell'>Image</TableHead>
            <TableHead className='hidden xl:table-cell'>Author</TableHead>
            <TableHead className='hidden 2xl:table-cell'>Date</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Actions</TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {blogs.map((blog) => (
            <TableRow key={blog.id}>
              <TableCell>
                <div className='font-medium'>{blog.title}</div>
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell className='hidden lg:table-cell'>
                <Popover>
                  <PopoverTrigger>
                    <img
                      alt={blog.title}
                      className='size-10 rounded-lg object-cover'
                      src={blog.image}
                    />
                  </PopoverTrigger>
                  <PopoverContent>
                    <img
                      alt='Blog thumbnail'
                      className='h-auto w-full rounded-lg object-cover'
                      height={1080}
                      src={blog.image}
                      width={1920}
                    />
                  </PopoverContent>
                </Popover>
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell className='hidden xl:table-cell'>
                {blog.authorName}
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell className='hidden 2xl:table-cell'>
                {formatDate(blog.date, 'PPP')}
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell>
                <DropdownMenu>
                  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                    <Button
                      className='transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:bg-primary/10'
                      size='icon'
                      variant='outline'
                    >
                      <EllipsisVertical className='size-4' />
                    </Button>
                  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                  <DropdownMenuContent className='flex flex-col gap-2'>
                    <DropdownMenuItem
                      className='inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2'
                      onClick={() =>
                        window.open(`/blogs/${blog.slug}`, '_blank')
                      }
                    >
                      <Eye className='size-4' />
                      View
                    </DropdownMenuItem>
                    <DropdownMenuItem
                      className='inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2'
                      onClick={() => handleEdit(blog)}
                    >
                      <Pencil className='size-4' />
                      Edit
                    </DropdownMenuItem>
                    <DropdownMenuItem
                      className='inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2'
                      onClick={() => handleDelete(blog)}
                    >
                      <Trash className='size-4' />
                      Delete
                    </DropdownMenuItem>
                  </DropdownMenuContent>
                </DropdownMenu>
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>

      <EditBlogDialog
        blog={editingBlog}
        cookieStore={cookieStore}
        onClose={() => setEditingBlog(null)}
        onUpdate={() => {
          onUpdate();
          setEditingBlog(null);
        }}
        organizationId={organizationId}
      />

      <Dialog onOpenChange={() => setDeletingBlog(null)} open={!!deletingBlog}>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Confirm Deletion</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              Are you sure you want to delete the blog{' '}
              <strong>{deletingBlog?.title}</strong>? This action is not
              reversible and it will permanently delete the blog.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button onClick={() => setDeletingBlog(null)} variant='outline'>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={confirmDelete} variant='destructive'>
              Delete
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./actions/document-drafts.ts ===

'use server';

import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import { documentsCS } from '@signvault/db/schema';
import { and, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { DocumentCS, MimeTypePSType } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { revalidateTag } from 'next/cache';
import { updateDocumentMetadata, updateDocumentStatus } from './documents';
import { EntityIdGenerator } from '@signvault/core-id-ts';
import type { DocumentStatus } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';

export type CreateDraftInput = {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  tags: string[];
  organizationId: bigint;
  ownerId: bigint;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  mimeType?: string;
  fileSize?: bigint;
  hash?: string;
  storageLocation?: string;
  s3Key?: string;
};

/**
 * Creates a new uploaded document.
 * @param input The document details
 * @returns The created DocumentCS record
 */
export async function createDocumentDraft(
  input: CreateDraftInput
): Promise<DocumentCS> {
  const idGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();
  const documentId = await idGenerator.generateDocumentId();

  const [createdDraft] = await db
    .insert(documentsCS)
    .values({
      id: documentId,
      organizationId: input.organizationId,
      ownerId: input.ownerId,
      filename: input.title,
      description: input.description,
      tags: input.tags,
      status: 'UPLOADED' as DocumentStatus,
      metadata: input.metadata || {},
      mimeType: (input.mimeType as MimeTypePSType) || 'application/pdf',
      fileSize: input.fileSize || BigInt(0),
      hash: input.hash,
      storageLocation: input.storageLocation,
      s3Key: input.s3Key,
      isPublic: false,
      createdAt: new Date(),
      updatedAt: new Date(),
      lastModifiedAt: new Date()
    } as DocumentCS)
    .returning();

  if (!createdDraft) {
    throw new Error('Failed to create draft document');
  }

  revalidateTag(`drafts-for-org-${input.organizationId}`);
  return createdDraft as DocumentCS;
}

/**
 * Updates an existing uploaded document.
 * @param draftId The ID of the document to update
 * @param input The updated document details
 * @returns The updated DocumentCS record
 */
export async function updateDocumentDraft(
  draftId: bigint,
  input: Partial<CreateDraftInput>
): Promise<DocumentCS> {
  const updateData: Partial<DocumentCS> = {
    updatedAt: new Date(),
    lastModifiedAt: new Date()
  };

  // Map input fields to database fields correctly
  if (input.title !== undefined) {
    updateData.filename = input.title;
  }
  if (input.description !== undefined) {
    updateData.description = input.description;
  }
  if (input.tags !== undefined) {
    updateData.tags = input.tags;
  }
  if (input.mimeType !== undefined) {
    updateData.mimeType = input.mimeType as MimeTypePSType;
  }
  if (input.fileSize !== undefined) {
    updateData.fileSize = input.fileSize;
  }
  if (input.hash !== undefined) {
    updateData.hash = input.hash;
  }
  if (input.storageLocation !== undefined) {
    updateData.storageLocation = input.storageLocation;
  }
  if (input.s3Key !== undefined) {
    updateData.s3Key = input.s3Key;
  }
  if (input.metadata !== undefined) {
    updateData.metadata = input.metadata;
  }

  const [updatedDraft] = await db
    .update(documentsCS)
    .set(updateData)
    .where(eq(documentsCS.id, draftId))
    .returning();

  if (!updatedDraft) {
    throw new Error('Failed to update draft document or draft not found');
  }

  revalidateTag(`drafts-for-org-${updatedDraft.organizationId}`);
  return updatedDraft as DocumentCS;
}

/**
 * Get uploaded documents for a specific user in an organization.
 * @param organizationId The ID of the organization.
 * @param userId The ID of the user.
 * @returns Array of DocumentCS records with 'UPLOADED' status.
 */
export async function getOrganizationDrafts(
  organizationId: bigint,
  userId: bigint
): Promise<DocumentCS[]> {
  const drafts = await db.query.documentsCS.findMany({
    where: and(
      eq(documentsCS.organizationId, organizationId),
      eq(documentsCS.ownerId, userId),
      eq(documentsCS.status, 'UPLOADED' as DocumentStatus)
    )
  });
  return drafts;
}

/**
 * Updates the metadata of an uploaded document.
 * This is a wrapper around updateDocumentMetadata to scope it for uploaded documents.
 * @param draftId The ID of the document to update.
 * @param data The metadata fields to update (e.g., filename, description, tags).
 * @returns The updated DocumentCS record.
 */
export async function updateDraftMetadata(
  draftId: bigint,
  data: {
    filename?: string;
    description?: string;
    tags?: string[];
    mimeType?: string;
    fileSize?: bigint;
    hash?: string;
    storageLocation?: string;
    s3Key?: string;
    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  }
): Promise<DocumentCS> {
  // We can reuse the generic updateDocumentMetadata function.
  // We might add uploaded document-specific logic here if needed in the future.
  const updatedDocument = await updateDocumentMetadata(draftId, data);
  revalidateTag(`drafts-for-org-${updatedDocument.organizationId}`);
  revalidateTag(`draft-${draftId}`);
  return updatedDocument;
}

/**
 * Deletes an uploaded document by marking it as 'DELETED'.
 * @param draftId The ID of the document to delete.
 * @returns The updated DocumentCS record.
 */
export async function deleteDraft(draftId: bigint): Promise<DocumentCS> {
  const [deletedDraft] = await db
    .update(documentsCS)
    .set({
      status: 'DELETED',
      updatedAt: new Date(),
      deletedAt: new Date()
    } as Partial<DocumentCS>)
    .where(eq(documentsCS.id, draftId))
    .returning();

  if (!deletedDraft) {
    throw new Error('Failed to delete draft or draft not found.');
  }
  revalidateTag(`drafts-for-org-${deletedDraft.organizationId}`);
  return deletedDraft;
}

/**
 * Publishes an uploaded document, changing its status to 'PUBLISHED'.
 * @param draftId The ID of the document to publish.
 * @returns The updated DocumentCS record.
 */
export async function publishDraft(draftId: bigint): Promise<DocumentCS> {
  const publishedDocument = await updateDocumentStatus(
    draftId,
    'PUBLISHED' as DocumentStatus
  );
  revalidateTag(`drafts-for-org-${publishedDocument.organizationId}`);
  revalidateTag(`documents-for-org-${publishedDocument.organizationId}`);
  revalidateTag(`draft-${draftId}`);
  return publishedDocument;
}

/**
 * Creates multiple uploaded documents for file uploads.
 * Each file becomes a separate document record in the database.
 * @param uploads Array of document inputs for multiple files
 * @returns Array of created DocumentCS records
 */
export async function createMultipleDocumentDrafts(
  uploads: CreateDraftInput[]
): Promise<DocumentCS[]> {
  const createdDrafts: DocumentCS[] = [];
  const idGenerator = await EntityIdGenerator.create();

  for (const input of uploads) {
    const documentId = await idGenerator.generateDocumentId();

    const [createdDraft] = await db
      .insert(documentsCS)
      .values({
        id: documentId,
        organizationId: input.organizationId,
        ownerId: input.ownerId,
        filename: input.title,
        description: input.description,
        tags: input.tags,
        status: 'UPLOADED' as DocumentStatus,
        metadata: input.metadata || {},
        mimeType: (input.mimeType as MimeTypePSType) || 'application/pdf',
        fileSize: input.fileSize || BigInt(0),
        hash: input.hash,
        storageLocation: input.storageLocation,
        s3Key: input.s3Key,
        isPublic: false,
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
        lastModifiedAt: new Date()
      } as DocumentCS)
      .returning();

    if (!createdDraft) {
      throw new Error(
        `Failed to create draft document for file: ${input.title}`
      );
    }

    createdDrafts.push(createdDraft as DocumentCS);
  }

  // Revalidate cache for the organization
  if (uploads.length > 0) {
    revalidateTag(`drafts-for-org-${uploads[0].organizationId}`);
  }

  return createdDrafts;
}

              <Link
                href={`/account/organizations/${organizationDetails.id}/users`}
              >

              </Link>
            </Button>
          </>
        )}

      <div className='rounded-lg border border-line p-6 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out'>
        <h2 className='mb-4 font-britanica text-xl font-semibold'>
          Source Systems ({organizationsSourceSystems.length})
        </h2>
        {organizationsSourceSystems.length === 0 ? (
          <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
            This organization currently has no source systems
          </p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <ul className='space-y-2'>
              {organizationsSourceSystems.slice(0, 5).map((sourceSystem) => {
                let config: SourceSystemConfig;
                try {
                  config = getSourceSystemConfig(sourceSystem.configuration);
                } catch (error) {
                  // Fallback configuration if parsing fails

                return (

                    className='flex items-center justify-between'
                  >
                    <span className='inline-flex items-center'>
                      <TableOfContents className='mr-2 h-4 min-h-4 w-4 min-w-4 text-primary' />
                      {config?.source_system_name || 'Unnamed System'}
                    </span>
                    <Button variant='outline' size='icon' asChild>
                      <Link
                        href={`/account/organizations/${organizationDetails.id}/source-systems/${sourceSystem.id}`}
                      >
                        <ChevronRight className='h-4 min-h-4 w-4 min-w-4' />
                      </Link>
                    </Button>
                  </li>

              })}
            </ul>
            <Button variant='outline' className='mt-4 w-full' asChild>
              <Link
                href={`/account/organizations/${organizationDetails.id}/source-systems`}
              >
                View all source systems
              </Link>
            </Button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Content */}
      <div className='rounded-lg border border-line p-6 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out'>
        <h2 className='mb-4 font-britanica text-xl font-semibold'>
          Content ({organizationContent.length})

'use server';

import type { InviteUsersValues } from '@/app/(user)/account/organization/users/invite-users-schema';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import {
  createInvite,
  createPendingUser,
  updateInvite,
  getPendingUserByEmail,
  getInviteById,
  deletePendingUserByOrgAndEmail,
  deleteInvite
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud';
import { getOrganizationById } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud';
import type { OnReturn } from '@formity/react';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { getUserByLogtoId } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud';
import {
  InviteStatus,
  type InviteCS,
  type PendingUserCS
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import type { OrganizationInvitation as LogtoOrganizationInvitation } from '@signvault/logto/organization-invitations/types';
import type { InviteUsersResponse } from '@signvault/backend/routes/v2/invite-users';

/**
 * Server action that invites selected users to an organization
 * @param invites - The invites to invite
 * @param organizationId - The organization ID
 * @returns The invite users response
 */
export async function inviteUsers(
  invites: Parameters<OnReturn<InviteUsersValues>>[0]['invites'],
  organizationId: string
) {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const now = new Date();

  const expiresAt = new Date(now);
  expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 7);

  const userResult = await getUserByLogtoId(claims?.sub ?? '');

  const user = userResult.user;

  const organizationResult = await getOrganizationById(
    typeof organizationId === 'string' ? BigInt(organizationId) : organizationId
  );

  const userOrganization = organizationResult.organization;

  const logtoInvitations: LogtoOrganizationInvitation[] = [];
  const dbInvitations: InviteCS[] = [];
  const dbPendingUsers: PendingUserCS[] = [];

  for (const invitee of invites) {
    const tokenData = {
      inviteeEmail: invitee.email,
      inviterId: String(user.id),
      organizationId,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    };

    const invitesSecret = process.env.INVITES_TOKEN_SECRET;
    if (!invitesSecret) {
      throw new Error('INVITES_TOKEN_SECRET is not configured');
    }
    const token = jwt.sign(tokenData, invitesSecret, { expiresIn: '5m' });

    const inviteLink = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/join-organization/${organizationId}?email=${encodeURIComponent(invitee.email)}`;

    // First create the database invitation
    const dbInvitation = await createInvite({
      organizationId:
        typeof organizationId === 'string'
          ? BigInt(organizationId)
          : organizationId,
      inviteToken: token,
      expiresAt,
      inviteLink: inviteLink,
      inviteType: 'single',
      inviterId: user.id,
      status: InviteStatus.PENDING,
      inviteeEmail: invitee.email,
      organizationRoleId: invitee.role,
      acceptedUserId: null,
      isMultiUse: false,
      logtoId: null,
      organizationRoleIds: [invitee.role]
    });

    // Then create the Logto invitation
    const logtoInvitation = (await fetch(
      `${process.env.API_URL}/api/logto/management/organization-invitations`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          invitee: invitee.email,
          // The Logto-provided inviterId and organizationId must be used here (do not use internal or database IDs)
          inviterId: user.logtoId!,
          organizationId: userOrganization.logtoId!,
          expiresAt: expiresAt.getTime(),
          organizationRoleIds: [invitee.role],
          messagePayload: {
            code: token,
            link: inviteLink,
            key: `organization_invitation_${organizationId}_${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
            organizationName: userOrganization.name,
            inviterName:
              user.name ?? user.firstName ?? user.lastName ?? user.username,
            inviterEmail: user.primaryEmail,
            expiryDate: expiresAt.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
              month: 'long',
              day: 'numeric',
              year: 'numeric'
            })
          }
        })
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json())) as LogtoOrganizationInvitation;

    // Create the pending user
    const dbPendingUser = await createPendingUser({
      inviteId: dbInvitation.invite.id,
      email: invitee.email,
      firstName: invitee.firstName,
      lastName: invitee.lastName,
      organizationId:
        typeof organizationId === 'string'
          ? BigInt(organizationId)
          : organizationId,
      organizationRoleId: invitee.role,
      activeTeamId:
        typeof invitee.activeTeamId === 'string'
          ? BigInt(invitee.activeTeamId)
          : invitee.activeTeamId,
      // @ts-expect-error - Strict typing error, can be ignored
      attributes: invitee.attributes,
      permissions: invitee.permissions,
      joinedAt: null,
      rolePermissions: []
    });

    // Update `logto_id` in the database invitation
    await updateInvite(dbInvitation.invite.id, {
      logtoId: logtoInvitation.id
    } as Partial<InviteCS>);

    // Store results
    logtoInvitations.push(logtoInvitation);
    dbInvitations.push(dbInvitation.invite);
    dbPendingUsers.push(dbPendingUser.pendingUser);
  }

  return {
    message: 'Users invited successfully',
    invites: {
      database: dbInvitations,
      logto: logtoInvitations
    },
    pendingUsers: {
      database: dbPendingUsers
    }
  } as InviteUsersResponse;
}

/**
 * Server action that revokes an organization invitation
 * - Deletes Logto organization invitation
 * - Deletes the pending user record
 * - Deletes the invite record
 * @param organizationId - The organization ID
 * @param email - The email of the user to revoke
 * @returns The revoke invitation response
 */
export async function revokeInvitation({
  organizationId,
  email
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  email: string;
}) {
  // Fetch pending user by email to get invite linkage
  const { pendingUser, code: getPendingCode } =
    await getPendingUserByEmail(email);

  if (!pendingUser) {
    throw new Error(
      getPendingCode === 'pending.user.not.found'
        ? 'Invited user not found'
        : 'Failed to load invited user'
    );
  }

  // Ensure organization matches
  if (pendingUser.organizationId.toString() !== organizationId.toString()) {
    throw new Error('Invited user does not belong to this organization');
  }

  // Get invite to retrieve Logto invitation id
  const { invite, code: getInviteCode } = await getInviteById(
    pendingUser.inviteId
  );

  if (!invite) {
    throw new Error(
      getInviteCode === 'invite.not.found'
        ? 'Invitation not found'
        : 'Failed to load invitation'
    );
  }

  // If a Logto invitation exists, delete it via Logto Management API
  if (invite.logtoId) {
    const response = await fetch(
      `${process.env.API_URL}/api/logto/management/organization-invitations/${invite.logtoId}`,
      {
        method: 'DELETE',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        }
      }
    );

    if (!response.ok && response.status !== 204) {
      // Attempt to read error body when available
      let message = 'Failed to delete Logto invitation';
      try {
        const data = await response.json();
        if (data?.error) message = data.error as string;
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
      throw new Error(message);
    }
  }

  // Delete pending user
  const pendingDelete = await deletePendingUserByOrgAndEmail(
    organizationId,
    email
  );
  if (pendingDelete.code !== 'pending.user.deleted') {
    throw new Error('Failed to delete pending user');
  }

  // Delete invite
  const inviteDelete = await deleteInvite(invite.id);
  if (inviteDelete.code !== 'invite.deleted') {
    throw new Error('Failed to delete invitation');
  }

  return { message: 'Invitation revoked successfully' } as const;
}

'use client';

import { useNotifications } from '@/contexts/notifications-context';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import {
  Collapsible,
  CollapsibleContent,
  CollapsibleTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/collapsible';
import {
  SidebarMenu,
  SidebarMenuButton,
  SidebarMenuItem,
  SidebarMenuSub,
  SidebarMenuSubButton,
  SidebarMenuSubItem,
  useSidebar
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/sidebar';
import { ChevronRight, type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export function AccountNavMain({
  items,
  onClose
}: Readonly<{
  items: {
    icon?: LucideIcon;
    isActive?: boolean;
    items?: {
      title: string;
      url: string;
    }[];
    title: string;
    url: string;
  }[];
  onClose?: () => void;
}>) {
  const { unreadCount } = useNotifications();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const { open } = useSidebar();

  // State to track which group is open (by index)
  const [openIndex, setOpenIndex] = useState<number | null>(() => {
    // Find the first item that is active or matches the pathname
    const idx = items.findIndex(
      (item) => item.isActive || pathname.startsWith(item.url)
    );
    return idx !== -1 ? idx : null;
  });

  // Update openIndex if pathname changes (e.g., via navigation)
  useEffect(() => {
    const idx = items.findIndex(
      (item) => item.isActive || pathname.startsWith(item.url)
    );
    if (items.length > 0 && items[idx]?.items && items[idx]?.items.length > 0) {
      setOpenIndex(idx !== -1 ? idx : null);
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [pathname]);

  return (
    <SidebarMenu>
      {items.map((item, idx) => (
        <Collapsible
          asChild
          className={'group/collapsible'}
          open={openIndex === idx}
          key={item.title}
          onOpenChange={(isOpen: boolean) => {
            setOpenIndex(isOpen ? idx : null);
          }}
        >
          <SidebarMenuItem>
            <CollapsibleTrigger asChild>
              <SidebarMenuButton asChild tooltip={item.title}>
                {item.items ? (
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      'cursor-pointer text-muted-foreground transition-colors duration-300 ease-in-out hover:bg-accent/10',
                      isHighlighted(pathname, item.url, !!item.items) &&
                        'bg-secondary text-foreground hover:bg-secondary!'
                    )}
                    onClick={() => {
                      // If sidebar is not open, navigate
                      if (!open) {
                        window.location.assign(item.url);
                        onClose?.();
                      } else {
                        if (item.items) {
                          // Toggle openIndex for collapsible
                          setOpenIndex(openIndex === idx ? null : idx);
                        } else {
                          window.location.assign(item.url);
                          onClose?.();
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => {
                      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                        if (!open) {
                          window.location.assign(item.url);
                          onClose?.();
                        } else {
                          setOpenIndex(openIndex === idx ? null : idx);
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    role='button'
                    tabIndex={0}
                  >
                    {item.icon &&
                      (() => {
                        if (item.url === '/account/notifications') {
                          return (
                            <div className='relative'>
                              <item.icon className='size-4' />
                              {unreadCount > 0 && (
                                <div className='absolute -right-1.5 -top-1.5 flex size-4 scale-[0.85] items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary font-sora text-[8px] tracking-tighter text-primary-foreground'>
                                  {/* 9+ */}
                                  {unreadCount > 9 ? '9+' : unreadCount}
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          );
                        }
                        return <item.icon />;
                      })()}
                    <span>{item.title}</span>
                    <ChevronRight className='ml-auto transition-transform duration-200 group-data-[state=open]/collapsible:rotate-90' />
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <Link
                    className={cn(
                      'text-muted-foreground transition-colors duration-300 ease-in-out hover:bg-accent/10',
                      isHighlighted(pathname, item.url, !!item.items) &&
                        'bg-secondary text-foreground hover:bg-secondary!'
                    )}
                    href={item.url}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (item.url !== '') {
                        onClose?.();
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    {item.icon &&
                      (() => {
                        if (item.url === '/account/notifications') {
                          return (
                            <div className='relative'>
                              <item.icon className='size-4' />
                              {unreadCount > 0 && (
                                <div className='absolute -right-1.5 -top-1.5 flex size-4 scale-[0.85] items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary font-sora text-[8px] tracking-tighter text-primary-foreground'>
                                  {/* 9+ */}
                                  {unreadCount > 9 ? '9+' : unreadCount}
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          );
                        }
                        return <item.icon />;
                      })()}
                    <span>{item.title}</span>
                  </Link>
                )}
              </SidebarMenuButton>
            </CollapsibleTrigger>
            {item.items && (
              <CollapsibleContent>
                <SidebarMenuSub>
                  {item.items.map((subItem) => (
                    <SidebarMenuSubItem key={subItem.title}>
                      <SidebarMenuSubButton
                        asChild
                        className={cn(
                          'text-muted-foreground transition-colors duration-300 ease-in-out',
                          isHighlighted(pathname, subItem.url) &&
                            'bg-secondary text-foreground hover:bg-secondary!'
                        )}
                      >
                        <Link
                          href={subItem.url === '' ? '#' : subItem.url}
                          onClick={() => {
                            if (subItem.url !== '') {
                              onClose?.();
                            }
                          }}
                        >
                          <span>{subItem.title}</span>
                        </Link>
                      </SidebarMenuSubButton>
                    </SidebarMenuSubItem>
                  ))}
                </SidebarMenuSub>
              </CollapsibleContent>
            )}
          </SidebarMenuItem>
        </Collapsible>
      ))}
    </SidebarMenu>
  );
}

function isHighlighted(pathname: string, url: string, hasItems?: boolean) {
  if (hasItems) {
    return pathname === url;
  }
