export async function generateStaticParams(): Promise<
  {
    organizationId: string;
    organizationSourceSystemId: string;
  }[]
> {
  const logger = getServerLogger(getRandomUUID(), 'source-system-page-ssg');
  try {
    logger.info('Generating static params for source system page');
    const organizationSourceSystemsRequest = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-source-systems?bypassToken=${process.env.BYPASS_TOKEN}`
    );
    const organizationSourceSystemsResponse: GetOrganizationSourceSystemsResponse =
      await organizationSourceSystemsRequest.json();

    if (
      !organizationSourceSystemsResponse.organizationSourceSystems ||
      organizationSourceSystemsResponse.message !==
        'Organization source systems retrieved successfully'
    ) {
      logger.error('No organization source systems found', {
        organizationSourceSystemsResponse
      });
      return [];
    }

    return organizationSourceSystemsResponse.organizationSourceSystems.database.map(
      (sourceSystem: OrganizationSourceSystem) => ({
        organizationId: sourceSystem.organizationId,
        organizationSourceSystemId: sourceSystem.id
      })
    );
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error generating static params for source system page', {
      error
    });
    return [];
  }
}

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { organizationId, organizationSourceSystemId } = await params;
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );
  const sourceSystemResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-source-systems/organizations/${organizationId}/${organizationSourceSystemId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  );
  const sourceSystem = await sourceSystemResponse.json();
  const logger = getServerLogger(getRandomUUID(), 'content-page-metadata');
  logger.info('Generating metadata for content page', {
    sourceSystem
  });
  return {
    title: `${
      sourceSystem.organizationSourceSystem
        ? sourceSystem.organizationSourceSystem.database.configuration
            .source_system_name
        : 'Source System'
    } Content`,
    description: `View content for ${
      sourceSystem.organizationSourceSystem
        ? sourceSystem.organizationSourceSystem.database.configuration
            .source_system_name
        : 'Source System'
    }`
  };
}

export default async function SourceSystemContentPage({
  params
}: Readonly<Props>) {
  const { organizationId, organizationSourceSystemId } = await params;
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  if (!claims) {
    return redirect('/');
  }

  const userRolesResponse: GetOrganizationRolesForAUserResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-roles/${organizationId}/users/${claims.sub}/roles?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (
    userRolesResponse.message !== 'Organization roles retrieved successfully' ||
    userRolesResponse.roles.length === 0
  ) {
    redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}`,
        'User Roles Not Found',
        'The user roles were not found in the database.'
      )
    );
  }

  const userHasL5OrSuperAdminRole = userRolesResponse.roles.some(
    (role) =>
      role.id === ROLES.SUPER_ADMIN.id ||
      role.id === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
      role.id === ROLES.L6_USER.id
  );

  const [sourceSystemResponse, contentsResponse] = await Promise.all([
    fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-source-systems/organizations/${organizationId}/${organizationSourceSystemId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString
        }
      }
    ),
    fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/content/organization/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString
        }
      }
    )
  ]);

  const sourceSystem = await sourceSystemResponse.json();
  const contents = await contentsResponse.json();

  if (!sourceSystem.organizationSourceSystem) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/source-systems`,
        'Source system not found',
        'The source system you are trying to access does not exist.'
      )
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <FilledCircle className='absolute bottom-0 right-0 block translate-x-1/2 translate-y-1/2 xs:block sm:block md:hidden lg:hidden xl:block' />
      <Button variant='outline' asChild className='mb-8' size='sm'>
        <Link href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/source-systems`}>
          <ChevronLeft className='mr-1 size-4' />
          Back to source systems
        </Link>
      </Button>
      <ContentPage
        organizationId={organizationId}
        sourceSystem={sourceSystem.organizationSourceSystem.database}
        initialContents={contents.contents.database}
        isAdmin={userHasL5OrSuperAdminRole}
        cookieStore={cookieStore}
      />
    </>
  );
}

'use client';

import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Database,
  Eye,
  PlayCircle,
  Save,
  ArrowLeft,
  Loader2
} from 'lucide-react';
import QueryBuilder, {
  formatQuery,
  type Field,
  type RuleGroupType
} from 'react-querybuilder';
import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { ENTITY_TYPE_LABELS, USER_TYPE_LABELS } from './types';
import { QueryBuilderShadcnUi } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/query-builder';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import type { NestedRecord, ProvenanceRecords } from '@signvault/db/types';
import {
  executeProvenanceQuery,
  saveProvenanceQuery
} from '@/actions/provenance-queries';
import { SaveQueryDialog } from './save-query-dialog';

import {
  AuditLogAction,

} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';

const fields: Field[] = [
  { name: 'id', label: 'ID', inputType: 'text' },
  { name: 'title', label: 'Title' },

type PreviewProps = {
  query: RuleGroupType;
  onBack: () => void;
};

function Preview({ query, onBack }: PreviewProps) {
  const whereClause = formatQuery(query, 'sql');
  const fullQuery = `SELECT * FROM "provenance_records"\nWHERE ${whereClause};`;

  return (
    <div className='space-y-4'>
      <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
        <Button variant='secondary' size='sm' onClick={onBack}>
          <ArrowLeft size={16} className='mr-2' />
          Back to Query Builder
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div className='rounded-lg bg-muted p-4'>
        <pre className='whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono text-sm'>{fullQuery}</pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

type QueryExecutionResults = {
  data?: ProvenanceRecords[];
  executedQuery?: string;
  queryName?: string;
  totalCount?: number;
};

export function QueryBuilderDialog({
  onQueryExecuted,
  onQuerySaved,
  organizationId
}: {
  onQueryExecuted: (results: QueryExecutionResults) => void;
  onQuerySaved: () => void;
  organizationId: string;
}) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState<RuleGroupType>({
    combinator: 'and',
    rules: []
  });
  const [showPreview, setShowPreview] = useState(false);
  const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState(false);
  const [isSaveDialogOpen, setIsSaveDialogOpen] = useState(false);

  const handleRunQuery = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsRunning(true);
    const toastId = toast.loading('Executing query...');
    try {
      const queryAsString = JSON.stringify(query);
      const result = await executeProvenanceQuery(queryAsString);

      if (result.success) {
        toast.success('Query executed successfully.', { id: toastId });
        const formattedSql = formatQuery(query, 'sql');
        const displayQuery = `SELECT * FROM "provenance_records"\nWHERE ${formattedSql};`;
        onQueryExecuted({
          data: result.data,
          executedQuery: displayQuery,
          queryName: 'Live Query',
          totalCount: result.data?.length ?? 0
        });
      } else {
        toast.error(result.error || 'Failed to execute query.', {
          id: toastId
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error('An unexpected error occurred.', { id: toastId });
    } finally {
      setIsRunning(false);
    }
  }, [query, onQueryExecuted]);

  const handleSaveQuery = async (saveData: {
    name: string;
    description?: string;
  }) => {
    const toastId = toast.loading('Saving query...');
    try {
      const result = await saveProvenanceQuery({
        ...saveData,
        query,
        organizationId
      });

      if (result.success && result.data) {
        toast.success(`Query "${result.data?.name}" saved.`, { id: toastId });
        await createAuditLogEntry({
          action: AuditLogAction.PROVENANCE_QUERY_SAVED,
          category: AuditLogCategory.DATA_PROVENANCE,
          entityId: result.data.id,
          entityType: 'provenance_query',
          entityName: result.data.name,
          description: `User saved data provenance query: "${result.data.name}"`,
          afterState: { query: result.data.query } as NestedRecord
        }).catch(console.error);
        onQuerySaved();
        setIsSaveDialogOpen(false); // Close save dialog on success
      } else {
        toast.error(result.error || 'Failed to save query.', { id: toastId });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error('An unexpected error occurred.', { id: toastId });
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Dialog>
        <DialogTrigger asChild>
          <Button className='gap-2' variant='default'>
            <Database size={16} />
            Query Builder
          </Button>
        </DialogTrigger>
        <DialogContent className='max-w-3xl font-suisse-intl'>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>
              {showPreview ? 'Preview Query' : 'Build Provenance Query'}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {showPreview
                ? 'Preview the SQL query that will be executed.'
                : 'Create custom queries for your data provenance records.'}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className={cn('py-4', showPreview ? 'min-h-[300px]' : '')}>
            {showPreview ? (
              <Preview query={query} onBack={() => setShowPreview(false)} />
            ) : (
              <QueryBuilderShadcnUi>
                <QueryBuilder
                  fields={fields}
                  query={query}
                  onQueryChange={(q) => setQuery(q)}
                />
              </QueryBuilderShadcnUi>
            )}
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className='flex flex-row justify-between sm:justify-between'>
            <div className='flex gap-2'>
              <Button
                type='button'
                variant='secondary'
                onClick={() => setIsSaveDialogOpen(true)}
                disabled={query.rules.length === 0}
              >
                <Save size={16} className='mr-2' />
                Save Query
              </Button>
              <Button
                type='button'
                variant='secondary'
                onClick={() => setShowPreview(true)}
                disabled={showPreview || query.rules.length === 0}
              >
                <Eye size={16} className='mr-2' />
                View Preview
              </Button>
            </div>
            <Button
              type='submit'
              variant='light'
              disabled={query.rules.length === 0 || isRunning}
              onClick={handleRunQuery}
            >
              {isRunning ? (
                <Loader2 className='mr-2 size-4 animate-spin' />
              ) : (
                <PlayCircle size={16} className='mr-2' />
              )}
              Run Query
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
      <SaveQueryDialog
        isOpen={isSaveDialogOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsSaveDialogOpen(false)}
        onSave={handleSaveQuery}
      />
    </>
  );
}

  const baseStyle = 'transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out';
  switch (status) {
    case 'DELIVERED':
    case 'READ':
      return cn(
        baseStyle,
        'bg-green-500/10 text-green-500 border-green-500/20 hover:border-green-500/20 hover:bg-green-500/10'
      );
    case 'DELIVERING':

      return cn(

      );

const BASE_URL = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/logto/management`;

/**
 * Create an organization invitation and optionally send it via email.
 * @param {object} invitationData - The organization invitation data to create.
 * @param {string|null} [invitationData.inviterId] - The ID of the user who is inviting.
 * @param {string} invitationData.invitee - The email address of the user to invite.
 * @param {string} invitationData.organizationId - The ID of the organization to invite the user to.
 * @param {number} invitationData.expiresAt - The expiration time of the invitation in milliseconds since epoch.
 * @param {string[]} [invitationData.organizationRoleIds] - The IDs of the organization roles to assign to the user.
 * @param {object|false} invitationData.messagePayload - The message payload for the invitation template, or false to not send an email.
 * @param {boolean} [invitationData.isMultiUse] - Whether the invitation is multi-use.
 * @param {string} invitationData.inviteType - The type of invitation.
 * @returns {Promise<{ invite: object, pendingUser: object, response: object }>} The created organization invitation, pending user, and the response from the API.
 */
export async function createOrganizationInvitation(invitationData: {
  expiresAt: number;
  invitationExpiryDays?: number;
  invitee: string;
  inviterId?: string | null;
  inviteType: 'single' | 'multi';
  isMultiUse?: boolean;
  messagePayload: object | false | string;
  organizationId: string;
  organizationRoleIds?: string[];
}) {
  const response = await makeApiRequest('', 'POST', {
    ...invitationData,
    isMultiUse: undefined,
    inviteType: undefined
  });
  if (!response) throw new Error('Failed to create invite');

  const inviteData = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/invites`,
    {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        id: response.id,
        organization_id: invitationData.organizationId,
        inviter_id: invitationData.inviterId,
        invitee_email: invitationData.invitee,
        invite_link: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/join-organization/${invitationData.organizationId}?code=${response.id}`,
        is_multi_use: invitationData.isMultiUse,
        expires_at: invitationData.expiresAt,
        status: 'PENDING',
        invite_type: invitationData.inviteType,
        organization_role_ids: invitationData.organizationRoleIds
      })
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  const pendingUserData = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/pending-users`,
    {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        organization_id: invitationData.organizationId,
        email: invitationData.invitee,
        organization_role_ids: invitationData.organizationRoleIds
      })
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (!inviteData || !pendingUserData)
    throw new Error('Failed to create invite');
  return {
    invite: inviteData,
    pendingUser: pendingUserData,
    response
  };
}

/**
 * Delete an organization invitation by ID.
 * @param {string} id - The unique identifier of the organization invitation.
 * @returns {Promise<void>}
 */
export async function deleteOrganizationInvitation(id: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    return makeApiRequest(`/${id}`, 'DELETE');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error deleting organization invitation:', error);
    // throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Get an organization invitation by ID.
 * @param {string} id - The unique identifier of the organization invitation.
 * @returns {Promise<object>} The organization invitation details.
 */
export async function getOrganizationInvitation(id: string) {
  return makeApiRequest(`/${id}`);
}

/**
 * Get organization invitations.
 * @param {object} params - Query parameters for filtering invitations.
 * @param {string} [params.organizationId] - The ID of the organization to filter invitations.
 * @param {string} [params.inviterId] - The ID of the inviter to filter invitations.
 * @param {string} [params.invitee] - The email of the invitee to filter invitations.
 * @returns {Promise<object[]>} A list of organization invitations.
 */
export async function getOrganizationInvitations(params: {
  invitee?: string;
  inviterId?: string;
  organizationId?: string;
}) {
  return makeApiRequest(`?${paramsToQueryString(params)}`);
}

/**
 * Resend the invitation message to the invitee.
 * @param {string} id - The unique identifier of the organization invitation.
 * @param {object} messagePayload - The message payload for the invitation template.
 * @param {string} [messagePayload.code] - The invitation code.
 * @param {string} [messagePayload.link] - The invitation link.
 * @param {string} [messagePayload.data] - Any additional key-value pairs for the message template.
 * @returns {Promise<void>}
 */
export async function resendInvitationMessage(
  id: string,
  messagePayload: {
    [key: string]: string | undefined;
    code?: string;
    link?: string;
  }
) {
  return makeApiRequest(`/${id}/message`, 'POST', messagePayload);
}

/**
 * Update the status of an organization invitation by ID.
 * @param {string} id - The unique identifier of the organization invitation.
 * @param {object} statusData - The organization invitation status data to update.
 * @param {string|null} [statusData.acceptedUserId] - The ID of the user who accepted the invitation.
 * @param {'Accepted'|'Revoked'} statusData.status - The new status of the invitation.
 * @returns {Promise<object>} The updated organization invitation.
 */
export async function updateOrganizationInvitationStatus(
  id: string,
  statusData: {
    acceptedUserId?: string | null;
    status: 'Accepted' | 'Revoked';
  }
) {
  try {
    return makeApiRequest(`/${id}/status`, 'PUT', statusData);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error updating organization invitation status:', error);
    // throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Make an API request to the Logto organization invitations API.
 * @param {string} endpoint - The API endpoint.
 * @param {'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE'} [method='GET'] - The HTTP method.
 * @param {object} [body] - The request body.
 * @returns {Promise<any>} The API response.
 * @throws {Error} If the API request fails.
 */
async function makeApiRequest(
  endpoint: string,
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE' = 'GET',
  body?: object
) {
  const url = `${BASE_URL}/api/organization-invitations${endpoint}`;
  const options: RequestInit = {
    method,
    headers:
      method !== 'GET' ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : undefined,
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined
  };

  const response = await fetch(url, options);

  if (!response.ok) {
    console.error(
      'Logto organization invitations API call failed:',
      response.statusText
    );
    console.error('response:', response);
    throw new Error(
      `Error code: ${response.status}, message: ${response.statusText}`
    );
  }

  if (method === 'DELETE') {
    return undefined;
  }

  try {
    return await response.json();
  } catch (error) {
    if (
      error instanceof TypeError &&
      error.message.includes('Body is unusable')
    ) {
      console.warn('Response body has already been consumed');
      return null;
    }
    console.error('Error parsing API response:', error);
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Convert an object to a query string.
 * @param {Record<string, unknown>} params - The object to convert to a query string.
 * @returns {string} The query string.
 */
function paramsToQueryString(params: Record<string, unknown>) {
  return new URLSearchParams(params as Record<string, string>).toString();
}

  FormItem,

} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';

import { Textarea } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/textarea';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/select';
import {
  type OrganizationSourceSystem,
  SourceSystemTypeEnums,
  VisibilityEnums
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getSourceSystemConfig,
  toTitleCase
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';

const sourceSystemSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(1, 'Name is required'),
  type: z.enum(
    SourceSystemTypeEnums.map((type) => type.toString()) as [
      string,
      ...string[]
    ]
  ),
  description: z.string().optional(),
  visibility: z.enum(
    VisibilityEnums.map((visibility) => visibility.toString()) as [
      string,
      ...string[]
    ]
  )
});

export default function EditSourceSystemDialog({
  sourceSystem,
  onClose,
  onUpdate,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<{
  sourceSystem: OrganizationSourceSystem | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUpdate: () => void;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}>) {
  clientLogger.info('Rendering edit source system dialog', {
    sourceSystem
  });
  const form = useForm<z.infer<typeof sourceSystemSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(sourceSystemSchema)
  });
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );
  const config = getSourceSystemConfig(sourceSystem.configuration);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sourceSystem) {
      form.reset({
        name: config.name,
        type: config.type,
        description: config.description || '',
        visibility: sourceSystem.visibility
      });
    }
  }, [sourceSystem, form]);

  const onSubmit = async (data: z.infer<typeof sourceSystemSchema>) => {
    if (!sourceSystem) return;

    try {
      clientLogger.info('Submitting edit source system form', {
        data,
        sourceSystem
      });
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-source-systems/organizations/${sourceSystem.organizationId}/${sourceSystem.id}?organizationId=${sourceSystem.organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'PATCH',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          },
          cache: 'no-store',
          body: JSON.stringify(data)
        }
      );

      if (response.ok) {
        clientLogger.info('Source system updated successfully', {
          data,
          sourceSystem
        });
        toast.success('Source system updated successfully');
        onUpdate();
      } else {
        clientLogger.error('Failed to update source system', {
          data,
          sourceSystem
        });
        toast.error('Failed to update source system');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error('Error updating source system', {
        error,
        data,
        sourceSystem
      });
      toast.error('An error occurred while updating the source system');
    }
  };

  if (!sourceSystem) return null;

  return (
    <Dialog open={!!sourceSystem} onOpenChange={onClose}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Edit Source System</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <Form {...form}>
          <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className='space-y-4'>
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='name'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Name</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Input {...field} />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='type'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Type</FormLabel>
                  <Select
                    onValueChange={field.onChange}
                    defaultValue={field.value}
                  >
                    <SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectValue />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>

                        <SelectItem key={type} value={type}>
                          {toTitleCase(

        >
          {steps.map((step, index) => (
            <React.Fragment key={step.title}>
              <ProcessStep
                description={step.description}
                imageSrc={step.imageSrc}
                index={index}
                title={step.title}
              />
              {index === 3 && (
                <MotionImage
                  alt='Process Line'
                  className='col-span-4 -mb-4 hidden h-auto w-full dark:hue-rotate-180 dark:invert lg:block'
                  height={200}
                  initial='initial'
                  loading='lazy'
                  fetchPriority='high'
                  src={`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_S3_BUCKET_URL}/public/process-line.svg`}
                  transition={{
                    duration: 0.5,
                    delay: 0.2 * index + 0.4
                  }}
                  variants={{
                    initial: { opacity: 0, y: -40 },
                    animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }
                  }}
                  viewport={{ once: true }}
                  whileInView='animate'
                  width={1920}
                />
              )}
            </React.Fragment>
          ))}
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';

export const revalidate = 60;
export const dynamicParams = true;

export async function generateStaticParams() {
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'org-content-ssg');
  try {
    logger.info('Generating static params for organization content');

    const organizationsRequest = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations?bypassToken=${process.env.BYPASS_TOKEN}`
    );
    const organizationsResponse: GetAllOrganizationsResponse =
      await organizationsRequest.json();

    if (
      !organizationsResponse.organizations ||
      organizationsResponse.message !== 'Organizations retrieved successfully'
    ) {
      logger.error('Error fetching organizations', {
        organizationsResponse
      });
      return [];
    }

    return organizationsResponse.organizations.logto.map((org: any) => ({
      organizationId: org.id
    }));
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error generating static params for organization content', {
      error
    });
    return [];
  }
}

export default async function OrganizationContentPage({
  params
}: Readonly<Props>) {
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'organization-content');
  const { organizationId } = await params;
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  logger.info('Accessing organization content page', {
    organizationId
  });

  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

  if (!claims) {
    logger.warn('No claims found, redirecting to sign-in', {
      organizationId
    });
    return redirect('/');
  }

  logger.info('Fetching organization and content data', {
    organizationId
  });

  const [organizationResponse, contentsResponse] = await Promise.all([
    fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString
        }
      }
    ),
    fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/content/organization/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString
        }
      }
    )
  ]);

  const [organization, contents] = await Promise.all([
    organizationResponse.json(),
    contentsResponse.json()
  ]);

  logger.info('Organization and content data fetched', {
    organizationId,
    hasOrganization: !!organization.organization,
    contentsCount: contents?.contents?.database?.length || 0
  });

  if (!organization.organization) {
    logger.error('Organization not found', {
      organizationId
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect('/account/organizations', 'Organization not found')
    );
  }

  const org =
    organization.organization.database || organization.organization.logto;

  return (
    <>
      <Button variant='outline' asChild className='mb-16' size='sm'>
        <Link href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}`}>
          <ChevronLeft className='mr-1 size-4' />
          Back to organization
        </Link>
      </Button>

      <div className='mb-8 flex items-center justify-between'>
        <h1 className='font-signvault text-3xl font-bold md:text-4xl'>
          {org.name} Content
        </h1>
        {(org.branding as { logoUrl: string })?.logoUrl && (
          <img
            src={(org.branding as { logoUrl: string }).logoUrl}
            alt={`${org.name} logo`}
            className='h-12 w-auto object-contain'
          />
        )}
      </div>

      <ContentPage
        //   organization={organization.organization}
        contents={contents.contents.database}
        isLoading={false}
        organization={org as Organization}
        cookieStore={cookieStore}
      />
    </>
  );
}

import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore } from '@/lib/utils';

const formSchema = z.object({
  title: z.string().min(5, 'Title must be at least 5 characters long'),
  description: z.string().optional(),
  content: z.string().min(10, 'Content must be at least 10 characters long'),
  status: z.enum(
    Object.values(ContentStatus) as [ContentStatus, ...ContentStatus[]]
  )
});

export default function EditContentDialog({
  content,
  onClose,
  organization,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<{
  content: Content | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  organization: Pick<Organization, 'id'>;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}>) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  const form = useForm<z.infer<typeof formSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(formSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      title: content?.title,
      description: content?.description,
      content: content?.content,
      status: content?.status as ContentStatus
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (content) {
      form.reset(content);
    }
  }, [content, form]);

  clientLogger.info('Rendering edit content dialog', {
    contentId: content?.id,
    organizationId: organization.id
  });

  const onSubmit = async (data: z.infer<typeof formSchema>) => {
    try {
      clientLogger.info('Submitting edit content form', {
        contentId: content?.id,
        organizationId: organization.id,
        data
      });
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/content/${content?.id}?organizationId=${organization.id}`,
        {
          method: 'PATCH',
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            ...data,
            updatedAt: new Date()
          })
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to update content');

      toast.success('Content updated successfully');
      router.refresh();
      onClose();
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error('Error submitting edit content form', {
        contentId: content?.id,
        organizationId: organization.id,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
      });
      toast.error('Failed to update content');
    }
  };

  if (!content) return null;

  return (
    <Dialog open={!!content} onOpenChange={onClose}>
      <DialogContent className='flex max-h-[90dvh] w-full flex-col gap-8 md:max-h-[85dvh] lg:max-h-[85dvh]'>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Edit Content</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>

        <Form {...form}>
          <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className='space-y-4'>
            <ScrollArea className='max-h-[60dvh] overflow-y-auto overflow-x-visible md:max-h-[50dvh] lg:max-h-[50dvh]'>
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='title'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Title</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input placeholder='Content title' {...field} />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='description'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Textarea
                        placeholder='Content description'
                        rows={3}

                      />
                    </FormControl>

                )}
              />

type ReviewSectionProps = {
  activeTeams?: ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS[];
  createdTeams?: TeamData[];
  teamData?: TeamData;
  user: InviteUser;
  userIndex: number;
};

/**
 * Review section of the invite users form
 * Shows a summary of all the user's information and settings
 */
export function ReviewSection({
  teamData,
  activeTeams = [],
  createdTeams = [],
  user
}: Readonly<ReviewSectionProps>) {
  // Determine the team name based on available data
  const teamName = useMemo(() => {
    // If teamData is directly provided, use it
    if (teamData?.name) {
      return teamData.name;
    }

    // If we have a user with a team value
    if (user.team) {
      // First check if we have teams created in the current form
      const createdTeam = createdTeams?.find((team) => team.name === user.team);
      if (createdTeam) {
        return createdTeam.name;
      }

      // Then check if we have active teams from the organization
      const activeTeam = activeTeams?.find((team) => team.name === user.team);
      if (activeTeam) {
        return activeTeam.name;
      }
    }

    // Fallback
    return 'Unknown Team';
  }, [teamData, user.team, activeTeams, createdTeams]);

  return (
    <div className='flex flex-col gap-4'>
      <div className='flex flex-col gap-4'>
        <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
          <Avatar className='flex size-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-none bg-secondary'>
            <AvatarFallback className='text-base'>
              {user.firstName?.[0]?.toUpperCase()}
              {user.lastName?.[0]?.toUpperCase()}
            </AvatarFallback>
          </Avatar>
          <div>
            <h4 className='text-base font-medium'>
              {user.firstName} {user.lastName}
            </h4>
            <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>{user.email}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Teams, Source System & Role */}
        <div className='flex flex-wrap gap-2'>
          <div className='inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-secondary px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-foreground/80'>
            <Users className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
            {teamName}
          </div>
          {user.role && (
            <div className='inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-secondary px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-foreground/80'>
              <Settings className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
              {
                organizationRoleOptions.find((r) => r.value === user.role)
                  ?.label
              }
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className='grid grid-cols-1 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-secondary md:grid-cols-2'>
        <div className='flex flex-col gap-0.5 border-b border-r p-4'>
          <p className='text-sm'>Role</p>

      source: 'frontend_app',
      context: {
        action: 'CREATE_CASE_STUDY',
        caseStudyCreationBody
      },
      createdBy: {
        application: 'frontend_app',
        url: window.location.href
      },
      version: '1.0',
      sourceGeneratedAt: pairGeneratedAt
    } as IdMappingMetadata;
    const idMappingResponse = await createIdMapping(
      id,
      uid,
      metadata,
      cookieStore.toString()
    );

    if (idMappingResponse.message !== 'ID mapping created successfully') {
      toast.error(idMappingResponse.message);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const response = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/case-studies`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        cache: 'no-store',
        body: JSON.stringify(caseStudyCreationBody),
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        }
      }
    );
    if (response.ok) {
      toast.success('Case study created successfully');
      router.push('/case-studies');
    } else {
      const errorData = await response.json();
      toast.error(errorData.error || 'Failed to create case study');
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form className='space-y-8' onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='title'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Title</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  placeholder='Case study title'
                  {...field}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    field.onChange(e);
                    const newSlug = generateSlug(e.target.value);
                    form.setValue('slug', newSlug);
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='slug'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Slug</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input placeholder='company-name-case-study' {...field} />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>
                URL-friendly version of the title (e.g.,
                company-name-case-study)
              </FormDescription>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}

          render={({ field }) => (

export function SavedQueriesTable({

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/data-provenance/queries/queries-page.tsx ===

'use client';

import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import type { CustomProvenanceQueryCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { useUserData } from '@/contexts/user-data-context';
import {
  getSavedProvenanceQueries,
  executeSavedQuery,
  deleteProvenanceQuery
} from '@/actions/provenance-queries';
import { useProvenance } from '../provenance-context';
import { QueriesPageControls } from './queries-page-controls';
import debounce from 'lodash/debounce';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { QueryList } from './query-list';
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { createAuditLogEntry } from '@/actions/audit-logs';
import {
  AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';

export function QueriesPage({
  initialSavedQueries
}: {
  initialSavedQueries: CustomProvenanceQueryCS[];
}) {
  const { organizationData } = useUserData();
  const { showQueryResults } = useProvenance();
  const [savedQueries, setSavedQueries] =
    useState<CustomProvenanceQueryCS[]>(initialSavedQueries);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<'createdAt' | 'name'>('createdAt');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'grid' | 'list'>('list');

  const [loadingQueryId, setLoadingQueryId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deletingQueryId, setDeletingQueryId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [queryToDelete, setQueryToDelete] =
    useState<CustomProvenanceQueryCS | null>(null);
  const [queryToPreview, setQueryToPreview] =
    useState<CustomProvenanceQueryCS | null>(null);

  const organizationId = String(organizationData?.organization.id || '');

  const loadSavedQueries = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!organizationId) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await getSavedProvenanceQueries(organizationId);
      if (result.success && result.data) {
        setSavedQueries(result.data);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error loading saved queries:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [organizationId]);

  const handleExecuteQuery = async (query: CustomProvenanceQueryCS) => {
    setLoadingQueryId(String(query.id));
    try {
      const result = await executeSavedQuery(String(query.id), organizationId);
      if (result.success) {
        showQueryResults({
          data: result.data,
          executedQuery: result.executedQuery,
          queryName: result.queryName,
          totalCount: result.data?.length
        });
        toast.success(`Query "${query.name}" executed successfully`);
        await createAuditLogEntry({
          action: AuditLogAction.PROVENANCE_QUERY_EXECUTED,
          category: AuditLogCategory.DATA_PROVENANCE,
          entityId: query.id,
          entityType: 'provenance_query',
          entityName: query.name,
          description: `User executed data provenance query: "${query.name}"`
        }).catch(console.error);
      } else {
        toast.error(result.error || 'Failed to execute query');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to execute query');
    } finally {
      setLoadingQueryId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteQuery = async (query: CustomProvenanceQueryCS) => {
    setDeletingQueryId(String(query.id));
    try {
      const result = await deleteProvenanceQuery(
        String(query.id),
        organizationId
      );
      if (result.success) {
        toast.success(`Query "${query.name}" deleted successfully`);
        loadSavedQueries();
        await createAuditLogEntry({
          action: AuditLogAction.PROVENANCE_QUERY_DELETED,
          category: AuditLogCategory.DATA_PROVENANCE,
          entityId: query.id,
          entityType: 'provenance_query',
          entityName: query.name,
          description: `User deleted data provenance query: "${query.name}"`
        }).catch(console.error);
      } else {
        toast.error(result.error || 'Failed to delete query');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to delete query');
    } finally {
      setDeletingQueryId(null);
      setQueryToDelete(null);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // Refresh logic is handled by calling `loadSavedQueries` after actions
  }, []);

  const debouncedSearch = useMemo(
    () =>
      debounce((value: string) => {
        setSearch(value);
      }, 300),
    []
  );

  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = [...savedQueries];
    if (search) {
      const searchLower = search.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          item.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)
      );
    }
    filtered.sort((a, b) => {
      switch (sortBy) {
        case 'createdAt':
          return (
            new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime()
          );
        case 'name':
          return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
        default:
          return 0;
      }
    });
    return filtered;
  }, [savedQueries, search, sortBy]);

  return (
    <div className='space-y-6'>
      <QueriesPageControls
        onSearch={debouncedSearch}
        onSortChange={(value) => setSortBy(value as 'createdAt' | 'name')}
        sortBy={sortBy}
        onViewModeChange={setViewMode}
        viewMode={viewMode}
      />
      {loading ? (
        <div className='flex h-40 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-dashed text-muted-foreground'>
          Loading saved queries...
        </div>
      ) : (
        <QueryList
          queries={filteredData}
          viewMode={viewMode}
          onQueryExecuted={showQueryResults}
          onRefresh={loadSavedQueries}
          organizationId={organizationId}
          loadingQueryId={loadingQueryId}
          deletingQueryId={deletingQueryId}
          handleExecuteQuery={handleExecuteQuery}
          handleDeleteQuery={handleDeleteQuery}
          setQueryToDelete={setQueryToDelete}
          setQueryToPreview={setQueryToPreview}
        />
      )}
      <AlertDialog
        open={!!queryToDelete}
        onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setQueryToDelete(null)}
      >
        <AlertDialogContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>Delete Query</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              Are you sure you want to delete the query "{queryToDelete?.name}"?
              This action cannot be undone.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction
              onClick={() => queryToDelete && handleDeleteQuery(queryToDelete)}
              className='bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90'
            >
              Delete
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/documents/my-drafts/draft-list.tsx ===

'use client';

import type { DocumentCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { DraftCard } from './draft-card';
import { Skeleton } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/skeleton';
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/table';
import { format } from 'date-fns';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { MoreVertical, Edit3, Trash2, Send, Eye, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import { Badge } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/badge';

type DraftListProps = {
  drafts: DocumentCS[];
  viewMode: 'grid' | 'list';
  onEdit: (draft: DocumentCS) => void;
  onDelete: (draftId: bigint) => void;
  onPublish: (draftId: bigint) => void;
  onView: (draft: DocumentCS) => void;
  isLoading: boolean;
};

const DraftListSkeleton = ({ viewMode }: { viewMode: 'grid' | 'list' }) => {
  if (viewMode === 'grid') {
    return (
      <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3'>
        {Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, i) => (
          <Skeleton key={i} className='h-[220px] rounded-xl' />
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className='space-y-4'>
      {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
        <Skeleton key={i} className='h-16 w-full' />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

const EmptyState = () => (
  <div className='flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed border-muted bg-muted/30 py-12 text-center'>
    <h3 className='text-xl font-semibold'>No uploaded documents found</h3>
    <p className='mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
      You haven't uploaded any documents yet.
    </p>
  </div>
);

export function DraftList({
  drafts,
  viewMode,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onPublish,
  onView,
  isLoading
}: DraftListProps) {
  if (isLoading) {
    return <DraftListSkeleton viewMode={viewMode} />;
  }

  if (drafts.length === 0) {
    return <EmptyState />;
  }

  if (viewMode === 'grid') {
    return (
      <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3'>
        {drafts.map((draft) => (
          <DraftCard
            key={draft.id}
            draft={draft}
            onEdit={onEdit}
            onDelete={onDelete}
            onPublish={onPublish}
            onView={onView}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // List View (Table)
  return (
    <div className='overflow-hidden rounded-lg border'>
      <Table>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow className='bg-muted/50'>
            <TableHead className='w-2/5 px-4 py-3 sm:w-[35%]'>Name</TableHead>
            <TableHead className='hidden px-4 py-3 md:table-cell'>
              Description
            </TableHead>
            <TableHead className='hidden px-4 py-3 lg:table-cell'>
              Tags
            </TableHead>
            <TableHead className='hidden px-4 py-3 sm:table-cell'>
              Last Updated
            </TableHead>
            <TableHead className='px-4 py-3 text-right'>
              <span className='sr-only'>Actions</span>
            </TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {drafts.map((draft) => {
            const displayTitle =
              draft.title ||
              draft.filename?.split('.')[0] ||
              'Untitled Document';

            // Limit tags to display
            const MAX_VISIBLE_TAGS = 3;
            const visibleTags = draft.tags
              ? draft.tags.slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE_TAGS)
              : [];

            const hasMoreTags =
              draft.tags && draft.tags.length > MAX_VISIBLE_TAGS;
            const extraTagsCount = draft.tags
              ? Math.max(0, draft.tags.length - MAX_VISIBLE_TAGS)
              : 0;

            return (
              <TableRow key={draft.id} className='hover:bg-muted/50'>
                <TableCell className='px-4 py-3 font-medium'>
                  <div className='flex items-center gap-3'>
                    <FileText className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 shrink-0 text-primary' />
                    <div>
                      <div className='line-clamp-1 truncate font-semibold text-foreground'>
                        {displayTitle}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className='hidden max-w-xs truncate px-4 py-3 text-muted-foreground md:table-cell'>
                  {draft.description || '-'}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className='hidden px-4 py-3 lg:table-cell'>
                  <div className='flex flex-wrap gap-1'>
                    {visibleTags.map((tag) => (
                      <Badge key={tag} variant='light' className='font-normal'>
                        {tag}
                      </Badge>
                    ))}
                    {hasMoreTags && (
                      <Badge variant='light' className='font-normal'>
                        +{extraTagsCount} more
                      </Badge>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className='hidden px-4 py-3 text-muted-foreground sm:table-cell'>
                  {format(new Date(draft.updatedAt), 'MMM d, yyyy')}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className='px-4 py-3 text-right'>
                  <DropdownMenu modal={false}>
                    <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                      <Button variant='ghost' size='icon' className='size-8'>
                        <MoreVertical className='size-4' />
                        <span className='sr-only'>Open menu</span>
                      </Button>
                    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                    <DropdownMenuContent
                      align='end'
                      className='w-[180px] font-suisse-intl'
                    >
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => onView(draft)}>
                        <Eye className='mr-2 size-4' />
                        View
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => onEdit(draft)}>
                        <Edit3 className='mr-2 size-4' />
                        Edit
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => onPublish(draft.id)}>
                        <Send className='mr-2 size-4' />
                        Publish
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      <DropdownMenuItem
                        onSelect={() => onDelete(draft.id)}
                        className='text-destructive focus:bg-destructive/10 focus:text-destructive'
                      >
                        <Trash2 className='mr-2 size-4' />
                        Delete
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                    </DropdownMenuContent>
                  </DropdownMenu>
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            );
          })}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./lib/browser-notification.ts ===

'use client';

import { clientLogger } from './client-logger';
import { notificationSound } from './notification-sound';

/**
 * The browser notification service.
 */
export class BrowserNotificationService {
  private static instance: BrowserNotificationService;
  private notificationPermission: NotificationPermission = 'default';
  private initialized: boolean = false;

  /**
   * The constructor for the browser notification service.
   */
  private constructor() {
    clientLogger.info('Initializing BrowserNotificationService');
    this.initializeService();
  }

  /**
   * Initializes the browser notification service.
   */
  private async initializeService() {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
      this.notificationPermission = 'denied';
      return;
    }

    if (!('Notification' in window)) {
      this.notificationPermission = 'denied';
      clientLogger.warn(
        'Notifications API not available in this browser',
        {},
        'frontend-browser-notifications'
      );
      return;
    }

    this.notificationPermission = Notification.permission;
    clientLogger.info(
      '[BrowserNotificationService] Initial permission:',
      { permission: this.notificationPermission },
      'frontend-browser-notifications'
    );
    this.initialized = true;
    clientLogger.info(
      'Notification permission initialized',
      { permission: this.notificationPermission },
      'frontend-browser-notifications'
    );

    if ('permissions' in navigator) {
      try {
        const permissionStatus = await navigator.permissions.query({
          name: 'notifications' as PermissionName
        });
        permissionStatus.onchange = () => {
          this.notificationPermission = Notification.permission;
          clientLogger.info(
            'Notification permission changed',
            { permission: this.notificationPermission },
            'frontend-browser-notifications'
          );
        };
      } catch (error) {
        clientLogger.error(
          'Failed to setup permission listener',
          { error },
          'frontend-browser-notifications'
        );
      }
    }
  }

  public static getInstance(): BrowserNotificationService {
    if (!BrowserNotificationService.instance) {
      clientLogger.info('Creating new instance of BrowserNotificationService');
      BrowserNotificationService.instance = new BrowserNotificationService();
    }
    return BrowserNotificationService.instance;
  }

  /**
   * Requests the notification permission.
   * @returns A boolean indicating whether the permission was granted.
   */
  public async requestPermission(): Promise<boolean> {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
      return false;
    }
    if (!('Notification' in window)) {
      clientLogger.warn(
        'Notification API not available, cannot request permission',
        {},
        'frontend-browser-notifications'
      );
      return false;
    }

    try {
      const permission =
        'Notification' in window
          ? await Notification.requestPermission()
          : 'denied';
      this.notificationPermission = permission;
      clientLogger.info(
        'Notification permission requested',
        { permission },
        'frontend-browser-notifications'
      );
      return permission === 'granted';
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error(
        'Error requesting notification permission',
        { error },
        'frontend-browser-notifications'
      );
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Gets the current notification permission.
   * @returns The current notification permission.
   */
  public getPermission(): NotificationPermission {
    clientLogger.info(
      'Getting current notification permission',
      { permission: this.notificationPermission },
      'frontend-browser-notifications'
    );
    return this.notificationPermission;
  }

  /**
   * Shows a notification.
   * @param title - The title of the notification.
   * @param options - The options for the notification.
   * @returns A boolean indicating whether the notification was shown.
   */
  public async showNotification(
    title: string,
    options?: NotificationOptions
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    clientLogger.info(
      '[BrowserNotificationService] Attempting to show notification:',
      {
        title,
        options,
        currentPermission: this.notificationPermission,
        initialized: this.initialized
      }
    );

    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('Notification' in window)) {
      clientLogger.warn(
        '[BrowserNotificationService] Notifications API not available',
        {},
        'frontend-browser-notifications'
      );
      return false;
    }

    if (!this.initialized) {
      clientLogger.info(
        '[BrowserNotificationService] Service not initialized, initializing now',
        {},
        'frontend-browser-notifications'
      );
      await this.initializeService();
    }

    // Double check permission
    this.notificationPermission = Notification.permission;
    clientLogger.info(
      '[BrowserNotificationService] Current permission:',
      { permission: this.notificationPermission },
      'frontend-browser-notifications'
    );

    if (this.notificationPermission !== 'granted') {
      clientLogger.info(
        '[BrowserNotificationService] Permission not granted, requesting permission',
        {},
        'frontend-browser-notifications'
      );
      const granted = await this.requestPermission();
      if (!granted) {
        clientLogger.info(
          '[BrowserNotificationService] Permission denied',
          {},
          'frontend-browser-notifications'
        );
        return false;
      }
    }

    try {
      clientLogger.info(
        '[BrowserNotificationService] Creating notification with:',
        {
          title,
          options: {
            ...options,
            requireInteraction: true,
            silent: false
          }
        },
        'frontend-browser-notifications'
      );

      const notification = new Notification(title, {
        ...options,
        requireInteraction: true,
        silent: false
      });

      clientLogger.info(
        '[BrowserNotificationService] Notification created:',
        { notification },
        'frontend-browser-notifications'
      );

      notification.onclick = () => {
        clientLogger.info(
          'Notification clicked',
          {},
          'frontend-browser-notifications'
        );
        window?.focus();
        notification?.close();
      };

      notification.onshow = () => {
        clientLogger.info(
          'Notification shown',
          {},
          'frontend-browser-notifications'
        );
      };

      notification.onerror = (error) => {
        clientLogger.error(
          '[BrowserNotificationService] Notification error:',
          { error },
          'frontend-browser-notifications'
        );
      };

      await notificationSound.play();
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error(
        '[BrowserNotificationService] Error showing notification:',
        { error },
        'frontend-browser-notifications'
      );
      return false;
    }
  }
}

'use client';

import type { Form, Return, Schema } from '@formity/react';

import { DEFAULT_USER } from '@/app/(user)/create-organization/components/invite-users-form/constants';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  AccessScope,
  ClearanceSecurityLevel,
  PermissionType,
  Weekday
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer/enums';
import {
  type ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS,
  FunctionPrimaryRole,
  FunctionSpecialization
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { FormController } from '@signvault/frontend/app/(user)/create-organization/components/form-controller';
import { FormLayout } from '@signvault/frontend/app/(user)/create-organization/components/form-layout';
import { FormView } from '@signvault/frontend/app/(user)/create-organization/components/form-view';
import { InviteUsersForm } from '@signvault/frontend/app/(user)/create-organization/components/invite-users-form/index';
import { type OrganizationRoleId, ROLES } from '@signvault/logto';
import { z } from 'zod';

export type InviteUsersValues = [
  Form<{
    users: {
      activeTeamId: string;
      attributes: {
        clearance: {
          level: ClearanceSecurityLevel;
          scope: AccessScope[];
        };
        function: {
          primary: FunctionPrimaryRole;
          specialization: FunctionSpecialization;
        };
        temporalAccess: {
          schedule: {
            days: Weekday[];
            hours: {
              end: string;
              start: string;
            };
            timeRange: string;
          };
          timezone: string;
        };
      };
      email: string;
      firstName: string;
      lastName: string;
      permissions: PermissionType[];
      role: OrganizationRoleId;
    }[];
  }>,
  Return<{
    invites: {
      activeTeamId: string;
      attributes: {
        clearance: {
          level: ClearanceSecurityLevel;
          scope: AccessScope[];
        };
        function: {
          primary: FunctionPrimaryRole;
          specialization: FunctionSpecialization;
        };
        temporalAccess: {
          schedule: {
            days: Weekday[];
            hours: {
              end: string;
              start: string;
            };
            timeRange: string;
          };
          timezone: string;
        };
      };
      email: string;
      firstName: string;
      lastName: string;
      permissions: PermissionType[];
      role: OrganizationRoleId;
    }[];
  }>
];

export const inviteUsersResolver = zodResolver(
  z.object({
    users: z
      .array(
        z.object({
          firstName: z.string().min(1, 'First name is required').max(128),
          lastName: z.string().min(1, 'Last name is required').max(128),
          email: z.string().email('Invalid email address').max(256),
          role: z.enum(
            Object.values(ROLES).map((role) => role.id) as [string, ...string[]]
          ),
          activeTeamId: z.string().min(1, 'Team is required'),
          attributes: z.object({
            function: z.object({
              primary: z.nativeEnum(FunctionPrimaryRole),
              specialization: z.nativeEnum(FunctionSpecialization)
            }),
            clearance: z.object({
              level: z.nativeEnum(ClearanceSecurityLevel),
              scope: z
                .array(z.nativeEnum(AccessScope))
                .min(1, 'At least one access scope is required')
                .max(5, 'You can only select 5 access scopes')
            }),
            temporalAccess: z.object({
              timezone: z.string().superRefine((data, ctx) => {
                if (!Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone').includes(data)) {
                  ctx.addIssue({
                    code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
                    message: 'Invalid timezone'
                  });
                }
              }),
              schedule: z.object({
                days: z
                  .array(z.nativeEnum(Weekday))
                  .min(1, 'At least one day is required'),
                hours: z
                  .object({
                    start: z.string(),
                    end: z.string()
                  })
                  .superRefine((data, ctx) => {
                    // Use a fixed date to compare times
                    const startTime = new Date(`1970-01-01T${data.start}:00`);
                    const endTime = new Date(`1970-01-01T${data.end}:00`);
                    if (startTime >= endTime) {
                      ctx.addIssue({
                        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
                        message: 'Start time must be before end time'
                      });
                    }
                  }),
                timeRange: z
                  .string()
                  .optional()
                  .superRefine((data, ctx) => {
                    if (data) {
                      const [start, end] = data.split('-');
                      const startTime = new Date(`1970-01-01T${start}:00`);
                      const endTime = new Date(`1970-01-01T${end}:00`);
                      if (startTime >= endTime) {
                        ctx.addIssue({
                          code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
                          message: 'Start time must be before end time'
                        });
                      }
                    }
                  })
              })
            })
          }),
          permissions: z.array(z.nativeEnum(PermissionType))
        })
      )
      .min(1, 'At least one user must be added')
  })
);

export function getSchema(
  organizationId: string,
  isDialog: boolean = false
): Schema<InviteUsersValues> {
  return [
    {
      form: {
        values: () => ({
          users: [[{ ...DEFAULT_USER, activeTeamId: '' }], []]
        }),
        render: ({ values, onNext, onBack, getState, setState, params }) => (
          <FormController
            getState={getState}
            isDialog={isDialog}
            onBack={onBack}
            onNext={onNext}
            progress={{ current: 1, total: 1 }}
            setState={setState}
            step='invite-users'
          >
            <FormView
              defaultValues={values}
              itemName='invite-users-form-state'
              resolver={inviteUsersResolver}
            >
              <FormLayout
                description='Add team members to your organization'
                fields={[
                  <InviteUsersForm
                    activeTeams={
                      (params as { activeTeams: ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS[] })
                        ?.activeTeams
                    }
                    key='invite-users'
                    organizationId={organizationId}
                  />
                ]}
                heading='Invite Users'
                isDialog={isDialog}
                nextButtonText='Invite Users'
                showBackButton={!isDialog}
              />
            </FormView>
          </FormController>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      return: ({ users }) => {
        return {
          invites: users
        };
      }
    }
  ];
}

/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any */

import { CSS } from '@dnd-kit/utilities';
import { GripVertical } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { FormLabel } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/select';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import {
  DndContext,
  closestCenter,
  KeyboardSensor,
  PointerSensor,
  useSensor,
  useSensors
} from '@dnd-kit/core';
import {
  SortableContext,
  sortableKeyboardCoordinates,
  verticalListSortingStrategy,
  useSortable
} from '@dnd-kit/sortable';
import type { Stage } from '../types';
import { SortableTask } from './sortable-task';
import { createNewTask } from '../utils';

type SortableStageProps = {
  stage: Stage;
  index: number;
  field: any;
  memberOptions: { value: string; label: string }[];
};

export function SortableStage({
  stage,
  index,
  field,
  memberOptions
}: Readonly<SortableStageProps>) {
  const {
    attributes,
    listeners,
    setNodeRef,
    transform,
    transition,
    isDragging
  } = useSortable({ id: stage.id });

  const style = {
    transform: CSS.Transform.toString(transform),
    transition,
    zIndex: isDragging ? 1 : 0
  };

  const sensors = useSensors(
    useSensor(PointerSensor),
    useSensor(KeyboardSensor, {
      coordinateGetter: sortableKeyboardCoordinates
    })
  );

  const handleDragEnd = (event: any) => {
    const { active, over } = event;
    if (active.id !== over?.id) {
      const oldIndex = stage.tasks.findIndex((task) => task.id === active.id);
      const newIndex = stage.tasks.findIndex((task) => task.id === over?.id);
      const newStages = [...field.value];
      const newTasks = [...stage.tasks];
      const [movedTask] = newTasks.splice(oldIndex, 1);
      newTasks.splice(newIndex, 0, movedTask);
      newStages[index] = {
        ...stage,
        tasks: newTasks
      };
      field.onChange(newStages);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={setNodeRef}
      style={style}
      className={cn(
        'space-y-4 rounded-lg border bg-background p-4',
        isDragging && 'shadow-lg'
      )}
    >
      <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
        <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
          <button
            type='button'
            {...attributes}
            {...listeners}
            className='cursor-grab rounded p-1 hover:bg-muted'
          >
            <GripVertical className='h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground' />
          </button>
          <span className='font-medium'>Stage {index + 1}</span>
        </div>
        <Button
          type='button'
          variant='ghost'
          size='sm'
          className='text-destructive'
          onClick={() => {
            const newStages = [...field.value];
            newStages.splice(index, 1);
            field.onChange(newStages);
          }}
        >
          Remove
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div className='space-y-4'>
        <div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'>
          <div>
            <FormLabel>Stage Name</FormLabel>
            <Input
              value={stage.name}
              onChange={(e) => {
                const newStages = [...field.value];
                newStages[index] = {
                  ...stage,
                  name: e.target.value
                };
                field.onChange(newStages);
              }}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <FormLabel>Stage Type</FormLabel>
            <Select
              value={stage.type}
              onValueChange={(value) => {
                const newStages = [...field.value];
                newStages[index] = {
                  ...stage,
                  type: value as Stage['type'],
                  settings: value === 'QUORUM' ? { quorumThreshold: 1 } : {}
                };
                field.onChange(newStages);
              }}
            >
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue placeholder='Select stage type' />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value='SEQUENTIAL'>Sequential</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value='PARALLEL'>Parallel</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value='QUORUM'>Quorum</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {stage.type === 'QUORUM' && (
          <div>
            <FormLabel>Quorum Threshold</FormLabel>
            <Input
              type='number'
              value={stage.settings?.quorumThreshold || ''}
              onChange={(e) => {
                const newStages = [...field.value];
                newStages[index] = {
                  ...stage,
                  settings: {
                    ...stage.settings,
                    quorumThreshold: parseInt(e.target.value) || 1
                  }
                };
                field.onChange(newStages);
              }}
              min={1}
              placeholder='Enter minimum required approvals'
            />
          </div>
        )}

        <div className='space-y-4'>
          <FormLabel>Stage Tasks</FormLabel>
          <div className='space-y-4'>
            <DndContext
              sensors={sensors}
              collisionDetection={closestCenter}
              onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
            >
              <SortableContext
                items={stage.tasks?.map((task) => task.id) || []}
                strategy={verticalListSortingStrategy}
              >
                {stage.tasks?.map((task, taskIndex) => (
                  <SortableTask
                    key={task.id}
                    task={task}
                    index={taskIndex}
                    field={{
                      value: stage.tasks,
                      onChange: (newTasks: any) => {
                        const newStages = [...field.value];
                        newStages[index] = {
                          ...stage,
                          tasks: newTasks
                        };
                        field.onChange(newStages);
                      }
                    }}
                    memberOptions={memberOptions}
                  />
                ))}
              </SortableContext>
            </DndContext>
            <Button
              type='button'
              variant='outline'
              onClick={() => {
                const newStages = [...field.value];
                newStages[index] = {
                  ...stage,
                  tasks: [
                    ...(stage.tasks || []),
                    createNewTask(stage.tasks?.length + 1 || 0)
                  ]
                };
                field.onChange(newStages);
              }}
            >
              Add Task
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
