'use client';

import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import * as z from 'zod';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage,
  FormDescription
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { Switch } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/switch';
import type { OrganizationSourceSystem } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getSourceSystemConfig
} from '@/lib/utils';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';

const integrationSettingsSchema = z.object({
  webhookUrl: z.string().url().optional().or(z.literal('')),
  enableWebhooks: z.boolean(),
  customHeaders: z.string().optional(),
  retryOnFailure: z.boolean()
});

export default function IntegrationSettings({
  sourceSystem,
  organizationId,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<{
  sourceSystem: OrganizationSourceSystem;
  organizationId: string;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}>) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );
  const config = getSourceSystemConfig(sourceSystem.configuration);

  const form = useForm<z.infer<typeof integrationSettingsSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(integrationSettingsSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      webhookUrl: config.webhookUrl || '',
      enableWebhooks: config.enableWebhooks || false,
      customHeaders: config.customHeaders || '',
      retryOnFailure: config.retryOnFailure || false
    }
  });

  const onSubmit = async (
    values: z.infer<typeof integrationSettingsSchema>
  ) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-source-systems/organizations/${organizationId}/${sourceSystem.id}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
          },
          method: 'PATCH',
          body: JSON.stringify({
            configuration: {
              ...config,
              webhook_url: values.webhookUrl,
              enable_webhooks: values.enableWebhooks,
              custom_headers: values.customHeaders,
              retry_on_failure: values.retryOnFailure
            }
          })
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok)
        throw new Error('Failed to update integration settings');

      toast.success('Integration settings updated successfully');
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['sourceSystem', sourceSystem.id]
      });
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to update integration settings');
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Integration Settings</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          Configure integration settings for your source system
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <Form {...form}>
          <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className='space-y-6'>
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='enableWebhooks'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-4'>
                  <div className='space-y-0.5'>
                    <FormLabel className='text-base'>Enable Webhooks</FormLabel>
                    <FormDescription>
                      Send webhook notifications for content updates
                    </FormDescription>
                  </div>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Switch
                      checked={field.value}
                      onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            {form.watch('enableWebhooks') && (
              <>
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name='webhookUrl'
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem>
                      <FormLabel>Webhook URL</FormLabel>
                      <FormControl>
                        <Input
                          {...field}
                          placeholder='https://api.example.com/webhook'
                        />
                      </FormControl>
                      <FormMessage />
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name='customHeaders'
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem>
                      <FormLabel>Custom Headers (JSON)</FormLabel>
                      <FormControl>
                        <Input
                          {...field}
                          placeholder='{"Authorization": "Bearer token"}'
                        />
                      </FormControl>
                      <FormMessage />
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name='retryOnFailure'
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-4'>
                      <div className='space-y-0.5'>
                        <FormLabel className='text-base'>
                          Retry on Failure
                        </FormLabel>
                        <FormDescription>
                          Automatically retry failed webhook deliveries
                        </FormDescription>
                      </div>
                      <FormControl>
                        <Switch
                          checked={field.value}
                          onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                        />
                      </FormControl>
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />
              </>
            )}
            <Button type='submit'>Save changes</Button>
          </form>
        </Form>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

  switch (status) {

      return 'bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-500 border-yellow-500/30';

      return 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 border-red-500/30';

'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import * as z from 'zod';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogFooter
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/textarea';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/select';
import {
  type Content,
  ContentStatusEnums,
  type OrganizationSourceSystem
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';
import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore } from '@/lib/utils';

const contentSchema = z.object({
  title: z.string().min(1, 'Title is required'),
  description: z.string().optional(),
  status: z.enum(ContentStatusEnums as [string, ...string[]]),
  content: z.string().min(1, 'Content is required')
});

export default function EditContentDialog({
  content,
  onClose,
  sourceSystem,
  cookieStore,
  organizationId
}: Readonly<{
  content: Content | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  sourceSystem: OrganizationSourceSystem;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
  organizationId: string;
}>) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const form = useForm<z.infer<typeof contentSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(contentSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      title: content?.title || '',
      description: content?.description || '',
      status: content?.status || 'ACTIVE',
      content: content?.content || ''
    }
  });
  clientLogger.info('Rendering edit content dialog', {
    content,
    form
  });
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (content) {
      form.reset({
        title: content.title,
        description: content.description || '',
        status: content.status,
        content: content.content
      });
    }
  }, [content, form]);

  const onSubmit = async (values: z.infer<typeof contentSchema>) => {
    if (!content) return;

    try {
      clientLogger.info('Submitting edit content form', {
        values,
        contentId: content.id,
        sourceSystemId: sourceSystem.id,
        organizationId: sourceSystem.organizationId
      });
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/content/${content.id}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'PATCH',
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(values)
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        clientLogger.error('Failed to update content', {
          response
        });
        throw new Error('Failed to update content');
      }

      toast.success('Content updated successfully');
      clientLogger.info('Content updated successfully', {
        contentId: content.id,
        sourceSystemId: sourceSystem.id,
        organizationId: sourceSystem.organizationId
      });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['contents', sourceSystem.id]
      });
      onClose();
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error('Failed to update content', {
        error
      });
      toast.error('Failed to update content');
    }
  };

  if (!content) return null;

  return (
    <Dialog open={!!content} onOpenChange={onClose}>
      <DialogContent className='sm:max-w-[600px]'>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Edit Content</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <Form {...form}>
          <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className='space-y-4'>
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='title'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Title</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Input {...field} />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='description'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Textarea {...field} />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='status'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Status</FormLabel>
                  <Select
                    onValueChange={field.onChange}
                    defaultValue={field.value}
                  >
                    <FormControl>
                      <SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectValue />
                      </SelectTrigger>
                    </FormControl>
                    <SelectContent>
                      <SelectItem value='ACTIVE'>Active</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value='INACTIVE'>Inactive</SelectItem>
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='content'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Content</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Textarea {...field} className='min-h-[200px]' />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            <DialogFooter>
              <Button type='submit'>Save changes</Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </form>
        </Form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore } from '@/lib/utils';
import MemberInvite from './member-invite';
import { useQueryParam, StringParam, withDefault } from 'use-query-params';

type OrganizationAdminDashboardProps = {
  organizationDetails: LogtoOrganization;
  organizationUsers: (DbUser | LogtoUser)[];
  currentUserId: string;
  user: LogtoUser;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
  organizationSourceSystems: OrganizationSourceSystem[];
}

export default function OrganizationAdminDashboard({
  organizationDetails,
  organizationUsers: initialOrganizationUsers,
  currentUserId,
  user,
  cookieStore,
  organizationSourceSystems
}: Readonly<OrganizationAdminDashboardProps>) {
  // check if the tab is in the url and set it as the active tab
  const tab = useQueryParam('tab', withDefault(StringParam, 'users'));
  const [localTab, setLocalTab] = useState(tab[0] ?? 'users');
  const [_, setUrlTab] = useQueryParam(
    'tab',
    withDefault(StringParam, 'users')
  );
  const [isPendingInvitationsOpen, setIsPendingInvitationsOpen] =
    useState(false);
  const [organizationUsers, setOrganizationUsers] = useState(
    initialOrganizationUsers
  );

  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  const handleUpdateUsers = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationDetails.id}/users?page=1&page_size=100&organizationId=${organizationDetails.id}`,
        {
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          }
        }
      );
      const updatedUsers: GetOrganizationUsersResponse = await response.json();
      setOrganizationUsers(
        updatedUsers.users.logto ?? updatedUsers.users.database ?? []
      );
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to update user list');
    }
  };

  const handleTabChange = (tab: string) => {
    // Update local state immediately
    setLocalTab(tab);

    // Update URL state asynchronously
    setUrlTab(tab);

    clientLogger.info('Changed admin dashboard tab', {
      organizationId: organizationDetails.id,
      previousTab: localTab,
      newTab: tab
    });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Link href={`/account/organizations/${organizationDetails.id}`}>
        <Button
          variant='outline'
          size='sm'
          className='mb-8 inline-flex items-center gap-2'
        >
          <ChevronLeft className='h-4 w-4' />
          Back to organization
        </Button>
      </Link>

      <Tabs value={localTab} onValueChange={handleTabChange}>
        <TabsList className='mb-6'>
          <TabsTrigger value='users' className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'>
            <Users className='h-4 w-4' />
            Manage Users
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger
            value='invite-single'
            className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
          >
            <UserPlus className='h-4 w-4' />
            Invite Single User
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger
            value='invite-bulk'
            className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
          >
            <Users className='h-4 w-4' />
            Invite Multiple Users
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger
            value='invite-multi'
            className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
          >
            <LinkIcon className='h-4 w-4' />
            Invitation Link
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>
        <TabsContent value='users'>
          <div className='mb-4 flex items-center justify-between'>
            <h2 className='text-xl font-semibold'>Organization Users</h2>
            <Button
              onClick={() => setIsPendingInvitationsOpen(true)}
              className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
            >
              <UserCheck className='h-4 w-4' />
              Pending Invitations
            </Button>
          </div>
          <UserManagement
            organizationId={organizationDetails.id}
            organizationUsers={organizationUsers}
            currentUserId={currentUserId}
            onUpdateUsersAction={handleUpdateUsers}
            cookieStore={cookieStore}
          />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value='invite-single'>
          <SingleUserInvite
            organizationId={organizationDetails.id}
            organizationName={organizationDetails.name}
            user={user}
            cookieStore={cookieStore}
          />

          />

        cookieStore={cookieStore}

        onClose={() => setIsPendingInvitationsOpen(false)}
        onUpdate={handleUpdateUsers}

    </>
  );

export type UserTemplatePermissions = {
  canManageGlobalTemplates: boolean;
  canInheritTemplates: boolean;
  canViewTemplates: boolean;
  canPublishTemplates: boolean;
};

type TemplateCardProps = {
  template: DocumentTemplate;
  permissions: UserTemplatePermissions;
  onUseTemplate: (template: DocumentTemplate) => void;
  onEditTemplate: (template: DocumentTemplate) => void;
  onDeleteTemplate: (templateId: bigint) => void;
  onViewTemplate?: (template: DocumentTemplate) => void; // Optional: for a detailed view dialog
  onPreviewTemplate?: (template: DocumentTemplate) => void;
  onCloneToCustom?: (template: DocumentTemplate) => void;
  onPublishLink?: (template: DocumentTemplate) => void;
  onViewResponses?: (template: DocumentTemplate) => void;
} & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>;

export function TemplateCard({
  template,
  permissions,
  onUseTemplate,
  onEditTemplate,
  onDeleteTemplate,
  onViewTemplate,
  onPreviewTemplate,
  onCloneToCustom,
  onPublishLink,
  onViewResponses,
  className,
  ...props
}: Readonly<TemplateCardProps>) {
  const _handleUseTemplate = () => {
    if (permissions?.canInheritTemplates) {
      onUseTemplate(template);
    }
  };

  const handleEdit = () => {
    if (permissions?.canManageGlobalTemplates) {
      onEditTemplate(template);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = () => {
    if (permissions?.canManageGlobalTemplates) {
      onDeleteTemplate(template.id);
    }
  };

  const handleView = () => {
    onViewTemplate?.(template);
  };

  const handlePublishLink = () => {
    if (permissions?.canPublishTemplates) {
      onPublishLink?.(template);
    }
  };

  const handleViewResponses = () => {
    if (permissions?.canPublishTemplates) {
      onViewResponses?.(template);
    }
  };

  const handlePreviewTemplate = () => {
    onPreviewTemplate?.(template);
  };

  const handleCloneToCustom = () => {
    if (permissions?.canInheritTemplates) {
      onCloneToCustom?.(template);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        'group relative flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {/* Header Row */}
      <div className='flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-5 pb-2 pt-4'>
        <div className='flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3'>
          <div className='flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 p-2.5'>

          </h3>
        </div>
        <DropdownMenu modal={false}>
          <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
            <Button
              variant='ghost'
              size='icon'
              className='size-8 shrink-0 data-[state=open]:bg-muted'
              aria-label='Open menu'
            >
              <MoreVertical className='size-4' />
            </Button>
          </DropdownMenuTrigger>
          <DropdownMenuContent
            align='end'
            className='w-[180px] font-suisse-intl'
          >
            {onPreviewTemplate && (
              <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={handlePreviewTemplate}>
                <FileSearch className='mr-2 size-4' />
                Preview Template
              </DropdownMenuItem>
            )}
            {permissions?.canViewTemplates && onViewTemplate && (
              <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={handleView}>
                <Eye className='mr-2 size-4' />
                View Details
              </DropdownMenuItem>
            )}
            {permissions?.canInheritTemplates && onCloneToCustom && (
              <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={handleCloneToCustom}>
                <Copy className='mr-2 size-4' />
                Clone & Customize
              </DropdownMenuItem>

            {permissions?.canPublishTemplates && onPublishLink && (

              <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={handleViewResponses}>
                <FileText className='mr-2 size-4' />
                View Responses
              </DropdownMenuItem>
            )}
            {permissions?.canManageGlobalTemplates && (
              <>
                <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={handleEdit}>
                  <Edit3 className='mr-2 size-4' />
                  Edit Template
                </DropdownMenuItem>
                <DropdownMenuItem
                  onSelect={handleDelete}
                  className='text-destructive focus:bg-destructive/10 focus:text-destructive'
                >
                  <Trash2 className='mr-2 size-4' />

              </>
            )}

        </DropdownMenu>
      </div>

      </p>

      {/* Meta Row */}

import { RestliClient } from 'linkedin-api-client';
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID = process.env.LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID;
const LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET = process.env.LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET;
const LINKEDIN_REDIRECT_URI = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/auth/linkedin/callback`;

/**
 * Handles the LinkedIn callback.
 * @param req - The request object.
 * @returns A redirect response.
 */
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  // Setup logger
  const requestId = req.headers.get('x-request-id') ?? getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'linkedin-callback');

  // Get code from request
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const code = searchParams.get('code');

  // Check if code is missing
  if (!code) {
    logger.warn('Authorization code is missing', {
      url: req.url
    });
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    logger.info('Processing LinkedIn callback', {
      url: req.url
    });

    // Get Logto context
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

    // Setup Restli client
    const restliClient = new RestliClient();
    restliClient.setDebugParams({ enabled: true });

    // Check if claims are missing or invalid
    if (!claims || !claims.sub) {
      logger.warn('Claims are missing or invalid', {
        url: req.url
      });
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    // Get user data
    const userResponse: GetUserResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users/logto/${claims.sub}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'x-user-logto-id': claims.sub,
          'x-middleware-bypass-token':
            process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
        }
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());

    // Check if user data is missing
    if (userResponse.code !== 'user.found') {
      logger.error('Failed to retrieve user', {
        userId: userResponse.user.database.id
      });
      return NextResponse.redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings/social-media`,
          'Failed to retrieve user',
          'Failed to retrieve your user data. Please try again.'
        )
      );
    }

    // Get user data
    const userData =
      userResponse.user.logto ?? userResponse.user.database ?? null;

    if (!userData) {
      logger.error('User data is missing', {
        userId: userResponse.user.database.id
      });
      return NextResponse.redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings/social-media`,
          'Failed to retrieve user',
          'Failed to retrieve your user data. Please try again.'
        )
      );
    }

    // Get access token
    const tokenResponse = await fetch(
      'https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/accessToken',
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
        },
        body: new URLSearchParams({
          grant_type: 'authorization_code',
          code,
          redirect_uri: LINKEDIN_REDIRECT_URI,
          client_id: LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID,
          client_secret: LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET
        })
      }
    );

    // Get access token data
    const tokenData = await tokenResponse.json();

    // Get profile data
    const profileResponse = await fetch(
      'https://api.linkedin.com/v2/userinfo',
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${tokenData.access_token}`
        }
      }
    );

    // Get profile data
    const profileData = await profileResponse.json();

    // Update user custom data
    if (profileData) {
      const newCustomData = {
        ...(userData.customData as Record<string, unknown>),
        linkedin: {
          ...((userData.customData as Record<string, unknown>)
            .linkedin as Record<string, unknown>),
          connected: true,
          connected_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          ...profileData
        }
      };

      // Update user custom data
      const updateResponse: UpdateUserCustomDataResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users/${userResponse.user.database.id}/custom-data`,
        {
          method: 'PATCH',
          cache: 'no-store',
          body: JSON.stringify({
            customData: newCustomData,
            linkedinVerified: true
          }),
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'x-user-logto-id': claims.sub,
            'x-middleware-bypass-token':
              process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
          }
        }
      ).then((res) => res.json());

      // Check if user custom data is updated successfully
      if (updateResponse.code !== 'user.updated') {
        logger.error('Failed to update user custom data', {
          userId: userResponse.user.database.id
        });
        return NextResponse.redirect(
          getErrorRedirect(
            `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings/social-media`,
            'Failed to update user custom data',
            'Failed to update your user custom data. Please try again.'
          )
        );
      }

      // Log success
      logger.info('LinkedIn account connected successfully', {
        userId: userResponse.user.database.id
      });

      // Redirect to account page
      return NextResponse.redirect(
        getStatusRedirect(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings/social-media`,
          'LinkedIn Connected',
          'Your LinkedIn account has been connected successfully.'
        )
      );
    } else {
      throw new Error('Failed to fetch LinkedIn user data');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // Log error
    logger.error('Error connecting LinkedIn account', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
      url: req.url
    });

    // Redirect to account page
    return NextResponse.redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings/social-media`,
        'LinkedIn Connection Failed',
        'Failed to connect your LinkedIn account. Please try again.'
      )
    );
  }
}

import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';

  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Switch } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/switch';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import type { OrganizationSourceSystem } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getSourceSystemConfig
} from '@/lib/utils';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';

const securitySettingsSchema = z.object({
  enableApiKeyAuth: z.boolean(),
  apiKey: z.string().optional(),
  enableIpWhitelist: z.boolean(),
  ipWhitelist: z.string().optional()
});

export default function SecuritySettings({
  sourceSystem,
  organizationId,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<{
  sourceSystem: OrganizationSourceSystem;
  organizationId: string;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}>) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );
  const config = getSourceSystemConfig(sourceSystem.configuration);
  const form = useForm<z.infer<typeof securitySettingsSchema>>({
    resolver: zodResolver(securitySettingsSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      enableApiKeyAuth: config.enableApiKeyAuth || false,
      apiKey: config.apiKey || '',
      enableIpWhitelist: config.enableIpWhitelist || false,
      ipWhitelist: config.ipWhitelist || ''
    }
  });

  const onSubmit = async (values: z.infer<typeof securitySettingsSchema>) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-source-systems/organizations/${organizationId}/${sourceSystem.id}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
          },
          method: 'PATCH',
          body: JSON.stringify({
            configuration: {
              ...config,
              enable_api_key_auth: values.enableApiKeyAuth,
              api_key: values.apiKey,
              enable_ip_whitelist: values.enableIpWhitelist,
              ip_whitelist: values.ipWhitelist
            }
          })
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to update security settings');

      toast.success('Security settings updated successfully');
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['sourceSystem', sourceSystem.id]
      });
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to update security settings');
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Security Settings</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          Configure security settings for your source system
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <Form {...form}>
          <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className='space-y-6'>
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='enableApiKeyAuth'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-4'>
                  <div className='space-y-0.5'>
                    <FormLabel className='text-base'>
                      API Key Authentication
                    </FormLabel>
                    <FormDescription>
                      Enable API key authentication for secure access
                    </FormDescription>
                  </div>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Switch
                      checked={field.value}
                      onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            {form.watch('enableApiKeyAuth') && (
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='apiKey'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>API Key</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input {...field} type='password' />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            )}
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='enableIpWhitelist'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem className='flex flex-row items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-4'>
                  <div className='space-y-0.5'>
                    <FormLabel className='text-base'>IP Whitelist</FormLabel>
                    <FormDescription>
                      Restrict access to specific IP addresses
                    </FormDescription>
                  </div>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Switch
                      checked={field.value}
                      onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            {form.watch('enableIpWhitelist') && (
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name='ipWhitelist'
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>IP Addresses (comma-separated)</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input {...field} placeholder='192.168.1.1, 10.0.0.1' />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            )}
            <Button type='submit'>Save changes</Button>
          </form>
        </Form>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

'use client';

import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import { env } from '@signvault/backend/src/config/env';
import { MAX_SOCKET_RETRIES, SOCKET_RETRY_DELAY } from '@signvault/core-lib';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { io, type Socket } from 'socket.io-client';

/**
 * The socket client.
 */
class SocketClient {
  private static instance: Socket | null = null;
  private static userId: string | null = null;
  private static retryCount: number = 0;
  private static readonly maxRetries: number = MAX_SOCKET_RETRIES;
  private static readonly socketUrl: string = env.SOCKET_URL;
  private static isConnecting: boolean = false;
  private static reconnectTimeout: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
  private static connectionLock: boolean = false;
  private static connectionPromise: Promise<Socket | null> | null = null;

  private constructor() {}

  public static setUserId(userId: string) {
    if (this.userId === userId) return;
    this.userId = userId;
    if (this.instance) {
      this.cleanupConnection();
    }
  }

  private static async acquireLock(): Promise<boolean> {
    if (this.connectionLock) return false;
    this.connectionLock = true;
    return true;
  }

  private static releaseLock(): void {
    this.connectionLock = false;
    this.connectionPromise = null;
  }

  private static cleanupConnection(): void {
    if (this.reconnectTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimeout);
      this.reconnectTimeout = null;
    }

    if (this.instance) {
      try {
        this.instance.removeAllListeners();
        this.instance.disconnect();
      } catch (error) {
        clientLogger.error(
          'Error cleaning up socket:',
          {
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
          },
          'frontend-socket'
        );
      }
      this.instance = null;
    }
    this.retryCount = 0;
    this.isConnecting = false;
    this.connectionPromise = null;
  }

  public static async getInstance(): Promise<Socket | null> {
    if (!this.userId) {
      return null;
    }

    if (this.instance?.connected) {
      return this.instance;
    }

    if (this.connectionPromise) {
      return this.connectionPromise;
    }

    if (!this.isConnecting) {
      this.connectionPromise = this.initializeSocket();
    }

    return this.connectionPromise;
  }

  private static async initializeSocket(): Promise<Socket | null> {
    if (!(await this.acquireLock())) return null;

    try {
      this.isConnecting = true;
      clientLogger.info(
        'Initializing socket connection',
        { socketUrl: this.socketUrl },
        'frontend-socket'
      );

      this.cleanupConnection();

      this.instance = io(this.socketUrl, {
        path: '/notifications',
        autoConnect: false,
        transports: ['websocket', 'polling'],
        reconnectionAttempts: this.maxRetries,
        reconnectionDelay: SOCKET_RETRY_DELAY,
        timeout: 60000,
        forceNew: true,
        query: this.userId ? { userId: this.userId } : undefined
      });

      this.setupEventHandlers();

      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        if (!this.instance) {
          reject(new Error('Socket instance not created'));
          return;
        }

        const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
          reject(new Error('Socket connection timeout'));
        }, 5000);

        this.instance.once('connect', () => {
          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
          resolve(this.instance);
        });

        this.instance.once('connect_error', (error) => {
          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
          reject(error);
        });

        this.instance.connect();
      });
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error(
        'Failed to create socket instance:',
        {
          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
          socketUrl: this.socketUrl
        },
        'frontend-socket'
      );
      this.cleanupConnection();
      return null;
    } finally {
      this.releaseLock();
    }
  }

  private static setupEventHandlers(): void {
    if (!this.instance) return;

    this.instance.on('connect_error', (error) => {
      clientLogger.error(
        'Socket connection error:',
        {
          error: error.message,
          socketUrl: this.socketUrl,
          retryCount: this.retryCount
        },
        'frontend-socket'
      );

      if (this.retryCount >= this.maxRetries) {
        clientLogger.error(
          'Max retry attempts reached',
          {
            maxRetries: this.maxRetries
          },
          'frontend-socket'
        );
        this.cleanupConnection();
        return;
      }

      this.retryCount++;
    });

    this.instance.on('connect', () => {
      this.retryCount = 0;
      this.isConnecting = false;
      clientLogger.info(
        'Socket connected successfully',
        {
          socketUrl: this.socketUrl,
          socketId: this.instance?.id
        },
        'frontend-socket'
      );
    });

    this.instance.on('disconnect', (reason) => {
      clientLogger.info(
        'Socket disconnected:',
        {
          reason,
          socketUrl: this.socketUrl
        },
        'frontend-socket'
      );

      if (
        reason === 'io server disconnect' ||
        reason === 'io client disconnect'
      ) {
        this.cleanupConnection();
      }
    });
  }

  public static disconnect(): void {
    this.cleanupConnection();
  }
}

export const socket = {
  connect: async (userId?: string): Promise<Socket | null> => {
    if (userId) {
      SocketClient.setUserId(userId);
    }
    return SocketClient.getInstance();
  },
  disconnect: () => {
    SocketClient.disconnect();
  },
  on: (event: string, callback: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => {
    SocketClient.getInstance().then((instance) => {
      if (instance) {
        instance.on(event, callback);
      }
    });
  },
  off: (event: string, callback?: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => {
    SocketClient.getInstance().then((instance) => {
      if (instance) {
        instance.off(event, callback);
      }
    });
  }
};

export function useSocket(userId?: string): Socket | null {
  const [socketInstance, setSocketInstance] = useState<Socket | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (userId) {
      SocketClient.setUserId(userId);
      SocketClient.getInstance().then((instance) => {
        setSocketInstance(instance);
      });
    }

    return () => {
      if (socketInstance) {
        socketInstance.disconnect();
      }
    };
  }, [userId]);

  return socketInstance as Socket | null;
}

import type {

  getTeamMemberById,

} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud/team-members/operations';
import { addTeamMember as createTeamMemberDb } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud/team-members/operations';
import { execute } from '@signvault/gql-client/execute';
import {
  EnqueueTeamMemberAdded,
  EnqueueTeamMemberRemoved
} from '@signvault/gql-client/mutations/team';
import { print, type ASTNode } from 'graphql';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getDbUser } from './auth';
import { createAuditLogEntry } from './audit-logs';
import {
  AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';
import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import { usersCS, activeTeamsCS } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/schema';
import { eq } from '@signvault/db/drizzle';

/**
 * Server action that adds a new team member
 * @param data - The team member data
 * @returns Success message and the created team member
 */
export async function createTeamMember(
  data: Omit<TeamMemberCS, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>
): Promise<CreateTeamMemberResponse> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const adminUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
  if (!adminUser) {
    throw new Error('Admin user not found');
  }

  const result = await createTeamMemberDb(data);

  if (result.code !== 'team.member.added' || !result.teamMember) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to create team member: ${result.code}`);
  }

  // Fetch additional data for provenance and audit logs
  const [user, team] = await Promise.all([
    db.query.usersCS.findFirst({
      where: eq(usersCS.id, result.teamMember.userId)
    }),
    db.query.activeTeamsCS.findFirst({
      where: eq(activeTeamsCS.id, result.teamMember.teamId)
    })
  ]);

  const userName = user?.name || user?.username || 'Unknown User';
  const teamName = team?.name || 'Unknown Team';
  const jobScopes = result.teamMember?.jobScopes || [];

  // Provenance: enqueue team member added event
  await execute(print(EnqueueTeamMemberAdded as ASTNode), {
    input: {
      actorUserId: String(adminUser.id),
      organizationId: String(result.teamMember.organizationId),
      teamId: String(result.teamMember.teamId),
      teamName: teamName,
      memberDetails: {
        teamMemberId: String(result.teamMember.id),
        userId: String(result.teamMember.userId),
        userName: userName,
        status: result.teamMember.status,
        invitedBy: String(adminUser.id),
        jobScopes: jobScopes
      }
    }
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log team member added event');
  });

  // Create audit log entry
  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.TEAM_MEMBER_ADDED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.TEAM_MANAGEMENT,
    metadata: {
      teamMemberId: String(result.teamMember.id),
      userId: String(result.teamMember.userId),
      userName: userName,
      status: result.teamMember.status,
      invitedBy: String(adminUser.id),
      jobScopes: jobScopes
    },
    description: `Team member ${userName} added to team ${teamName}`,
    entityId: String(result.teamMember.id),
    entityType: 'TEAM_MEMBER',
    entityName: userName,
    targetUserId: String(adminUser.id),
    success: true
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[AUDIT LOG] Failed to log team member added event');
  });

  return {
    message: 'Team member added successfully',
    teamMember: result.teamMember
  };
}

/**
 * Server action that removes a team member
 * @param memberId - The ID of the team member to remove
 * @returns Success message
 */
export async function deleteTeamMember(
  memberId: string
): Promise<DeleteTeamMemberResponse> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const adminUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
  if (!adminUser) {
    throw new Error('Admin user not found');
  }

  // Get the team member details before removing for provenance
  const memberResult = await getTeamMemberById(memberId);
  if (memberResult.code !== 'team.member.found' || !memberResult.teamMember) {
    throw new Error('Team member not found');
  }
  const teamMember = memberResult.teamMember;

  const result = await removeTeamMember(memberId);

  if (result.code !== 'team.member.removed') {
    throw new Error(`Failed to remove team member: ${result.code}`);
  }

  // Fetch additional data for provenance and audit logs
  const [user, team] = await Promise.all([
    db.query.usersCS.findFirst({
      where: eq(usersCS.id, teamMember.userId)
    }),
    db.query.activeTeamsCS.findFirst({
      where: eq(activeTeamsCS.id, teamMember.teamId)
    })
  ]);

  const userName = user?.name || user?.username || 'Unknown User';
  const teamName = team?.name || 'Unknown Team';
  const jobScopes = teamMember?.jobScopes || [];

  // Provenance: enqueue team member removed event
  await execute(print(EnqueueTeamMemberRemoved as ASTNode), {
    input: {
      actorUserId: String(adminUser.id),
      organizationId: String(teamMember.organizationId),
      teamId: String(teamMember.teamId),
      teamName: teamName,
      memberDetails: {
        teamMemberId: String(teamMember.id),
        userId: String(teamMember.userId),
        userName: userName,
        status: teamMember.status,
        invitedBy: String(adminUser.id),
        jobScopes: jobScopes
      }
    }
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log team member removed event');
  });

  // Create audit log entry
  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.TEAM_MEMBER_REMOVED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.TEAM_MANAGEMENT,
    metadata: {
      teamMemberId: String(teamMember.id),
      userId: String(teamMember.userId),
      userName: userName,
      status: teamMember.status,
      invitedBy: String(adminUser.id),
      jobScopes: jobScopes

    success: true

    .string()
    .min(10, 'Description must be at least 10 characters long')
    .optional()

type AssignActiveTeamFormProps = {
  adminIds: (string | bigint)[];
  defaultValues?: {
    description: string;
    name: string;
  };
  inheritanceType: TeamInheritanceType;
  onCancel: () => void;
  onSuccess: () => void;
  organizationId: string | bigint;
  sourceTeam: TeamTemplate | CustomTeamWithMembersCS;
  userId: string | bigint;
} & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLFormElement>;

export function AssignActiveTeamForm({
  adminIds,
  userId,
  organizationId,
  onSuccess,
  onCancel,
  className,
  inheritanceType,
  sourceTeam,
  defaultValues
}: Readonly<AssignActiveTeamFormProps>) {
  const form = useForm<AssignActiveTeamFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(formSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      name: defaultValues?.name || '',
      description: defaultValues?.description || ''
    },
    mode: 'onBlur',
    reValidateMode: 'onBlur'
  });

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const createActiveTeam = useCreateActiveTeam();

  const onSubmit = async (values: AssignActiveTeamFormValues) => {
    setError(null);
    try {
      setLoading(true);

      const payload = {
        organizationId:
          typeof organizationId !== 'string'
            ? organizationId
            : BigInt(organizationId),
        name: values.name,
        description: values.description,
        creatorUserId: typeof userId !== 'string' ? userId : BigInt(userId),
        inheritedFrom: inheritanceType,
        customTeamId: null,
        teamTemplateId: null,
        archivedAt: null,
        isArchived: false
      };

      // Add the appropriate ID based on inheritance type
      if (inheritanceType === TeamInheritanceType.TEAM_TEMPLATE) {
        Object.assign(payload, { teamTemplateId: sourceTeam.id });
      } else {
        Object.assign(payload, { customTeamId: sourceTeam.id });
      }

      const resultTeam = await createActiveTeam.mutateAsync({
        data: payload,
        creatorId: userId.toString()
      });

      toast.success(
        `Team "${values.name}" created successfully from ${
          inheritanceType === TeamInheritanceType.TEAM_TEMPLATE
            ? 'template'
            : 'custom team'
        } "${sourceTeam.name}"`
      );

      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['activeTeams'] });

      await sendActiveTeamSetupNotification({
        organizationId,
        teamId: resultTeam.id,
        teamName: values.name,
        adminIds,
        creatorId: userId
      });

      if (onSuccess) {
        onSuccess();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to create team', error);
      const errorMessage =
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error';
      setError(`Failed to create team: ${errorMessage}`);
      toast.error(`Failed to create team: ${errorMessage}`);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form
        className={cn('space-y-4', className)}
        onBlur={() => form.trigger()}
        onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
      >
        {error && (
          <Alert className='mb-4' variant='destructive'>
            <AlertCircle className='size-4' />
            <AlertDescription>{error}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}

        <div className='space-y-4'>
          <FormField
            control={form.control}
            name='name'
            render={({ field }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>Team Name</FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Input placeholder='Enter team name' {...field} />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />

          <FormField
            control={form.control}
            name='description'
            render={({ field }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Textarea
                    className='resize-none'
                    placeholder='Enter team description'
                    rows={3}
                    {...field}
                  />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
        </div>

        <div className='flex items-center justify-end gap-2'>
          <Button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
              form.reset();
              onCancel();
            }}
            variant='outline'
          >
            Cancel

            )}

              ? 'Creating Team...'
              : 'Create Team'}

const getValueIcon = (value: unknown) => {
  if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
    return value ? (
      <CheckCircle className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
    ) : (
      <XCircle className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />
    );
  }
  if (typeof value === 'number') {
    return <Code className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />;
  }
  return <Key className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-primary' />;
};

const getDisplayValue = (value: unknown) => {
  if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
    return value ? 'Yes' : 'No';
  }
  if (typeof value === 'number') {
    return value.toString();
  }
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
  }
  return toTitleCase(value.toString());
};

=== FILE: ./actions/waitlist.ts ===

'use server';

import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import { waitlistPublic } from '@signvault/db/schema';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { sendEmail } from './email';
import type { WaitlistPublicInsert } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { count } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { randomWaitlistTemplate, waitlistTemplate } from '@/templates/waitlist';

const waitlistSchema = z.object({
  email: z.string().email(),
  name: z.string().min(1),
  type: z.enum(['INDIVIDUAL', 'BUSINESS'])
});

export async function addToWaitlist(data: {
  email: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'INDIVIDUAL' | 'BUSINESS';
}) {
  try {
    const validatedData = waitlistSchema.parse(data);

    const userId = uuidv4();
    await db.insert(waitlistPublic).values({
      id: userId,
      email: validatedData.email,
      name: validatedData.name,
      type: validatedData.type,
      joinedAt: new Date()
    } as WaitlistPublicInsert);

    const year = new Date().getFullYear();
    const subject = `Welcome to the SignVault Waitlist, ${validatedData.name}!`;
    const html = `<!DOCTYPE html>
  <html lang='en'>
  <head>
  <meta charset='UTF-8'>
  <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0'>
  <style>
  body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: #f4f4f4; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .container { max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; background-color: #ffffff; padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); } .header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px; } .content { font-size: 16px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.6; } .footer { margin-top: 30px; font-size: 12px; color: #777777; text-align: center; } .header img { max-width: 250px; }</style>
  </head>
  <body>
  <div class='container'>
  <div class='header'><img src='https://signvault-docs.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/logo-light.png' alt='SignVault Logo'/></div><div class='content'><h1>Thank you for joining the SignVault Waitlist!</h1><p>Hi <strong>${validatedData.name}</strong>,</p><p>You've been successfully added to the SignVault waitlist. We're excited to have you on board!</p><p>We'll be in touch within the next 3 business days with more information and updates.</p><br><p>If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at <a href='mailto:harjot@signvault.io'>support@signvault.io</a>.</p><p>Thanks,</p><p>Harjot Singh Rana<br/>Co-Founder & CTO <br/> SignVault.io</p></div><div class='footer'><p>&copy; ${year} SignVault. All rights reserved.</p></div></div></body></html>`;

    await sendEmail({
      to: validatedData.email,
      subject,
      html
    });

    // Schedule delayed email (1-4 days)
    const randomDays = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4) + 1; // 1-4 days
    const delayMs = randomDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // Convert to milliseconds

    setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        await sendWaitlistEmail(userId);
        console.log(
          `Delayed waitlist email sent to user ${userId} after ${randomDays} days`
        );
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          `Failed to send delayed waitlist email to user ${userId}:`,
          error
        );
      }
    }, delayMs);

    // Also send a random email to an existing waitlist user
    try {
      const result = await sendRandomWaitlistEmail();
      if (result.success) {
        console.log(`Random waitlist email sent to: ${result.sentTo}`);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to send random waitlist email:', error);
    }

    return { success: true };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Invalid input.' };
    }
    // Potentially handle unique constraint violation for email
    if (error instanceof Error && 'code' in error && error.code === '23505') {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'This email is already on the waitlist.'
      };
    }
    console.error('Error adding to waitlist:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'An unexpected error occurred.' };
  }
}

export async function getTotalUsersOnWaitlist() {
  const totalUsers = await db.select({ count: count() }).from(waitlistPublic);
  return (totalUsers[0].count ?? 999) + 120;
}

export async function sendWaitlistEmail(userId: string) {
  try {
    // Get user from waitlist
    const user = await db.query.waitlistPublic.findFirst({
      where: (waitlist, { eq }) => eq(waitlist.id, userId)
    });

    if (!user) {
      return { success: false, error: 'User not found in waitlist.' };
    }

    const subject = `Your SignVault Beta Access is Ready, ${user.name}!`;
    const signupLink = 'https://signvault.io/signup';

    const html = waitlistTemplate(
      user?.name ?? user?.email?.split('@')[0] ?? 'SignVault Beta Tester',
      signupLink
    );

    await sendEmail({
      to: user.email,
      subject,
      html
    });

    return { success: true };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error sending waitlist email:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to send waitlist email.' };
  }
}

export async function sendRandomWaitlistEmail() {
  try {
    // Get all users from waitlist
    const allUsers = await db.query.waitlistPublic.findMany({
      orderBy: (waitlist, { desc }) => desc(waitlist.joinedAt)
    });

    if (allUsers.length === 0) {
      return { success: false, error: 'No users found in waitlist.' };
    }

    const randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * allUsers.length);
    const randomUser = allUsers[randomIndex];

    const subject = `SignVault Update: We're Growing Fast!`;
    const signupLink = 'https://signvault.io/signup';

    const html = randomWaitlistTemplate(
      randomUser?.name ??
        randomUser?.email?.split('@')[0] ??
        'SignVault Beta Tester',
      signupLink
    );

    await sendEmail({
      to: randomUser.email,
      subject,
      html
    });

    return { success: true, sentTo: randomUser.email };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error sending random waitlist email:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to send random waitlist email.' };
  }
}

// Utility function for testing - sends immediate waitlist email
export async function sendImmediateWaitlistEmail(userId: string) {
  return await sendWaitlistEmail(userId);
}

// Utility function for testing - sends immediate random waitlist email
export async function sendImmediateRandomWaitlistEmail() {
  return await sendRandomWaitlistEmail();
}

=== FILE: ./components/notifications/notification-preferences.tsx ===

'use client';

import type { NotificationPreferenceANS } from '@signvault/db/schemas/notifications_/types';
import { type EmailFrequency } from '@signvault/db/schemas/notifications/enums';

import { useNotifications } from '@/contexts/notifications-context';
import { BrowserNotificationService } from '@/lib/browser-notification';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/select';
import { Switch } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/switch';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';

type NotificationPreferencesProps = {
  className?: string;
} & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>;

export function NotificationPreferences({
  className,
  ...props
}: Readonly<NotificationPreferencesProps>) {
  const { preferences, updatePreferences } = useNotifications();
  const [browserPermission, setBrowserPermission] =
    useState<NotificationPermission>('default');
  const [updating, setUpdating] = useState(false);
  const [optimisticPreferences, setOptimisticPreferences] =
    useState(preferences);

  useEffect(() => {
    setOptimisticPreferences(preferences);
  }, [preferences]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'Notification' in window) {
      setBrowserPermission(Notification.permission);

      // Listen for permission changes
      const handlePermissionChange = () => {
        setBrowserPermission(Notification.permission);
        if (Notification.permission === 'denied') {
          handleUpdate({
            browserNotificationsEnabled: false
          });
        }
      };

      // Modern browsers support the permissions API
      if ('permissions' in navigator) {
        navigator.permissions
          .query({ name: 'notifications' })
          .then((permissionStatus) => {
            permissionStatus.onchange = handlePermissionChange;
          })
          .catch((error) => {
            clientLogger.error(
              'Failed to query notification permission:',
              error
            );
          });
      }
    }
  }, []);

  const handleBrowserNotificationToggle = async (checked: boolean) => {
    try {
      if (checked && browserPermission === 'default') {
        const browserNotification = BrowserNotificationService.getInstance();
        const granted = await browserNotification.requestPermission();
        if (!granted) {
          return;
        }
        setBrowserPermission('granted');
      }
      await handleUpdate({
        browserNotificationsEnabled: checked
      });
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error(
        'Failed to toggle browser notifications:',
        {
          message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
        },
        'notification-preferences'
      );
      toast.error(
        `Failed to update browser notifications: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}`
      );
    }
  };

  const handleUpdate = async (updates: Partial<NotificationPreferenceANS>) => {
    try {
      setUpdating(true);
      setOptimisticPreferences((prev) =>
        prev ? { ...prev, ...updates } : null
      );
      await updatePreferences(updates);
      toast.success('Preferences updated successfully.');
    } catch (error) {
      setOptimisticPreferences(preferences);
      clientLogger.error(
        'Failed to update preferences:',
        {
          message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
        },
        'notification-preferences'
      );
      toast.error(
        `Failed to update preferences: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}`
      );
    } finally {
      setUpdating(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn('space-y-6', className)} {...props}>
      <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
        <div className='space-y-2'>
          <h4 className='text-sm font-medium'>Enable Notifications</h4>
          <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
            Receive notifications about important updates
          </p>
        </div>
        <Switch
          checked={optimisticPreferences?.enabled}
          disabled={updating}
          onCheckedChange={(checked) => handleUpdate({ enabled: checked })}
        />
      </div>

      <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
        <div className='space-y-2'>
          <h4 className='text-sm font-medium'>Browser Notifications</h4>
          <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
            Show desktop notifications when browser is in background
          </p>
          {browserPermission === 'denied' && (
            <p className='text-xs text-destructive'>
              Please enable notifications in your browser settings
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <Switch
          checked={optimisticPreferences?.browserNotificationsEnabled}
          disabled={
            updating ||
            browserPermission === 'denied' ||
            !optimisticPreferences?.enabled
          }
          onCheckedChange={handleBrowserNotificationToggle}
        />
      </div>

      <div className='space-y-3'>
        <div className='space-y-2'>
          <h4 className='text-sm font-medium'>Email Notifications</h4>
          <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
            Choose when to receive email notifications
          </p>
        </div>
        <Select
          disabled={updating || !optimisticPreferences?.enabled}
          onValueChange={(value) =>
            handleUpdate({
              emailFrequency: value.toUpperCase() as EmailFrequency,
              emailNotificationsEnabled: value !== 'NEVER'
            })
          }
          value={optimisticPreferences?.emailFrequency}
        >
          <SelectTrigger>
            <SelectValue />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
            <SelectItem value='IMMEDIATE'>Immediate</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value='DAILY'>Daily Digest</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value='WEEKLY'>Weekly Digest</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value='MONTHLY'>Monthly Digest</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value='NEVER'>Never</SelectItem>
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default async function CreateContentPage({
  params
}: Readonly<{ params: { organizationId: string } }>) {
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'content-create');
  const { organizationId } = await params;
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  try {
    logger.info('Accessing content creation page', {
      organizationId
    });

    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

    if (!claims) {
      logger.warn('User not authenticated', {
        organizationId
      });
      return redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          '/',
          'Not logged in',
          'You must be logged in to create content'
        )
      );
    }

    logger.info('Fetching organization data', {
      organizationId
    });
    const organizationResponse: GetOrganizationResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString
        }
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());

    if (
      organizationResponse.message !== 'Organization retrieved successfully'
    ) {
      logger.error('Organization not found', {
        organizationId
      });
      return redirect(getErrorRedirect('/', 'Organization not found'));
    }

    const organization = organizationResponse.organization.database
      ? organizationResponse.organization.database
      : organizationResponse.organization.logto;

    if (!organization) {
      logger.error('Invalid organization data', {
        organizationId
      });
      return redirect(getErrorRedirect('/', 'Organization not found'));
    }

    logger.info('Fetching organization source systems', {
      organizationId
    });
    const organizationSourceSystemsResponse: GetOrganizationSourceSystemsResponse =
      await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-source-systems/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          }
        }
      ).then((res) => res.json());

    logger.info('Content creation page loaded successfully', {
      organizationId,
      organizationName: organization.name,
      hasSourceSystems:
        !!organizationSourceSystemsResponse.organizationSourceSystems.database
    });

    const organizationSourceSystems =
      organizationSourceSystemsResponse.organizationSourceSystems.database ??
      [];

    return (
      <>
        <Button variant='outline' asChild className='mb-16' size='sm'>
          <Link href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/content`}>
            <ChevronLeft className='mr-1 size-4' />
            Back to content
          </Link>
        </Button>

        <div className='mr-auto max-w-3xl'>
          <h1 className='mb-8 font-signvault text-3xl font-bold'>
            Create New Content
          </h1>
          <CreateContentForm
            userId={claims.sub}
            organizationId={organizationId}
            organizationSourceSystems={organizationSourceSystems}
            cookieStore={cookieStore}
          />
        </div>
      </>
    );
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error in content creation page', {
      organizationId,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect('/', 'Error', 'Failed to load content creation page')
    );
  }
}

'use client';

import type { GetBlogsResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/blogs';
import type { GetCaseStudiesResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/case-studies';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';

import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import { authorizedUsers } from '@/site';
import { type LogtoContext } from '@logto/next';
import FilledCircle from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/filled-circle';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';

import BlogsGraph from './blogs-graph';
import BlogsTable from './blogs-table';
import CaseStudiesGraph from './case-studies-graph';
import CaseStudiesTable from './case-studies-table';
import DashboardHeader from './dashboard-header';
import QuickActions from './quick-actions';
import RecentActivity from './recent-activity';

function DashboardContent({
  data,
  cookieStore,
  organizationId
}: Readonly<{
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
  data: LogtoContext;
  organizationId: string;
}>) {
  const logger = clientLogger;
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const { data: caseStudies = [], isLoading: isCaseStudiesLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['caseStudies'],
    queryFn: () => fetchCaseStudies()
  });

  const { data: blogs = [], isLoading: isBlogsLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['blogs'],
    queryFn: () => fetchBlogs()
  });

  const onUpdate = () => {
    logger.info('Invalidating dashboard queries');
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({
      queryKey: ['caseStudies']
    });
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['blogs'] });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!data.isAuthenticated || !data.claims) {
      logger.warn('Unauthenticated user in dashboard', {
        isAuthenticated: data.isAuthenticated,
        hasClaims: !!data.claims
      });
      return;
    }
    logger.info('Dashboard content mounted', {
      userId: data.claims.sub
    });
  }, [data]);

  if (!data.isAuthenticated || !data.claims) {
    return redirect('/');
  }
  if (!authorizedUsers.includes(data.claims?.sub)) {
    return redirect('/');
  }

  return (
    <main className='w-full border-b border-line'>
      <div className='relative mx-4 max-w-5xl border-x border-line px-4 py-16 sm:px-6 md:mx-auto lg:px-8'>
        <FilledCircle className='absolute bottom-0 left-0 -translate-x-1/2 translate-y-1/2' />
        <FilledCircle className='absolute bottom-0 right-0 block translate-x-1/2 translate-y-1/2 xs:block sm:block md:hidden lg:hidden xl:block' />
        <DashboardHeader />
        {!isCaseStudiesLoading && !isBlogsLoading ? (
          <div className='mt-8 flex w-full flex-col gap-6'>
            <div className='col-span-3'>
              <QuickActions />
            </div>
            <div className='col-span-3 grid w-full grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-2'>
              <CaseStudiesGraph
                caseStudies={caseStudies}
                isLoading={isCaseStudiesLoading}
              />
              <BlogsGraph blogs={blogs} isLoading={isBlogsLoading} />
            </div>
            <div className='col-span-2'>
              <RecentActivity />
            </div>
            <div className='col-span-2'>
              <CaseStudiesTable
                caseStudies={caseStudies}
                cookieStore={cookieStore}
                isLoading={isCaseStudiesLoading}
                onUpdate={onUpdate}
                organizationId={organizationId}
              />
            </div>
            <div className='col-span-1 md:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3'>
              <BlogsTable
                blogs={blogs}
                cookieStore={cookieStore}
                isLoading={isBlogsLoading}
                onUpdate={onUpdate}
                organizationId={organizationId}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className='flex size-full min-h-[400px] items-center justify-center'>
            <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

async function fetchBlogs() {
  const logger = clientLogger;
  try {
    logger.info('Fetching blogs');
    const response = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/blogs`
    );
    if (!response.ok) {
      logger.error('Failed to fetch blogs', {
        status: response.status,
        statusText: response.statusText
      });
      throw new Error('Failed to fetch blogs');
    }
    const data: GetBlogsResponse = await response.json();
    if (!data.blogs.database) {
      logger.error('No blogs found in response');
      throw new Error('No blogs found');
    }
    logger.info('Successfully fetched blogs', {
      count: data.blogs.database.length
    });
    return data.blogs.database;
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error in fetchBlogs', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    });
    throw error;
  }
}

async function fetchCaseStudies() {
  const logger = clientLogger;
  try {
    logger.info('Fetching case studies');
    const response = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/case-studies`,
      {
        next: {
          tags: ['case-studies'],
          revalidate: 3600 // Revalidate every hour
        }
      }
    );
    if (!response.ok) {
      logger.error('Failed to fetch case studies', {
        status: response.status,
        statusText: response.statusText
      });
      throw new Error('Failed to fetch case studies');
    }
    const data: GetCaseStudiesResponse = await response.json();
    if (!data.caseStudies.database) {
      logger.error('No case studies found in response');
      throw new Error('No case studies found');
    }
    logger.info('Successfully fetched case studies', {
      count: data.caseStudies.database.length
    });
    return data.caseStudies.database;
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error in fetchCaseStudies', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    });
    throw error;
  }
}

export default DashboardContent;

import type {

  EntityStatusPSType

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

  getCustomTeams,
  createCustomTeam,
