// Custom Teams
export const useCustomTeams = (organizationId: bigint | string) => {
  return useQuery<CustomTeamWithMembersCS[]>({
    queryKey: ['customTeams'],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const response = await getCustomTeams(
        typeof organizationId === 'string'
          ? organizationId
          : organizationId.toString()
      );
      return response.teams;
    },
    enabled: !!organizationId
  });
};

export function useCreateCustomTeam() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      data,
      creatorId
    }: {
      data: Omit<CustomTeamCS, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt' | 'isArchived'>;
      creatorId: string;
    }) => {
      const { team } = await createCustomTeam(
        {
          ...data,
          organizationId:
            typeof data.organizationId === 'bigint'
              ? data.organizationId
              : BigInt(data.organizationId)
        },
        creatorId
      );
      return team;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['customTeams'] });
    }
  });
}

export function useUpdateCustomTeam() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      id,
      data,
      actorUserId
    }: {
      data: Partial<CustomTeamWithMembersCS>;
      id: bigint | string;
      actorUserId: string | bigint;
    }) => {
      const { team } = await updateCustomTeamData(
        typeof id === 'string' ? id : id.toString(),
        {
          ...data,
          organizationId:
            typeof data.organizationId === 'bigint'
              ? data.organizationId
              : BigInt(data.organizationId)
        },
        actorUserId
      );
      return team;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['customTeams'] });
    }
  });
}

export const useActiveTeams = (organizationId: bigint | string) => {
  return useQuery<ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS[]>({
    queryKey: ['activeTeams'],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const response = await getActiveTeams(
        typeof organizationId === 'string'
          ? organizationId
          : organizationId.toString()
      );
      return response.teams ?? [];
    },
    enabled: !!organizationId
  });
};

export const useCreateActiveTeam = () => {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      data,
      creatorId
    }: {
      data: Omit<ActiveTeamCS, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt' | 'archivedAt'>;
      creatorId: string;
    }) => {
      const { team, code } = await createActiveTeamData(
        {
          organizationId:
            typeof data.organizationId === 'bigint'
              ? data.organizationId
              : BigInt(data.organizationId),
          name: data.name,
          inheritedFrom: data.inheritedFrom,
          customTeamId: data.customTeamId,
          teamTemplateId: data.teamTemplateId,
          description: data.description
        },
        creatorId
      );

      switch (code) {
        case 'active.team.created':
          return team;
        case 'active.team.creation.failed':
          throw new Error('Failed to create active team');
        case 'active.team.name.exists':
          throw new Error('Active team name already exists');
        case 'organization.not.found':
          throw new Error('Organization not found');
        case 'custom.team.not.found':
          throw new Error('Custom team not found');
        case 'team.template.not.found':
          throw new Error('Team template not found');
        case 'internal.server.error':
          throw new Error('Internal server error');
        default:
          throw new Error('Unknown error');
      }
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['activeTeams']
      });
    }
  });
};

export const useUpdateActiveTeam = () => {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

      organizationId
    }: {
      data: Partial<ActiveTeamCS> & { status?: EntityStatusPSType };
      organizationId: bigint | string;
      teamId: bigint | string;
    }) => {
      const { team } = await updateActiveTeamData(
        typeof teamId === 'string' ? teamId : teamId.toString(),
        {
          ...data,
          organizationId:
            typeof organizationId === 'bigint'
              ? organizationId
              : BigInt(organizationId.toString())
        }
      );
      return team;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['activeTeams']
      });
    }
  });
};

=== FILE: ./lib/server-logger.ts ===

import { DISABLE_LOGGING } from '@/site';
import ansis from 'ansis';

/**
 * The Logto server logger.
 */
type LogEntry = {
  streams: [
    {
      stream: {
        app: string;
        level: string;
        module?: string;
      };
      values: [string, string][];
    }
  ];
};

/**
 * Gets the server logger.
 * @param requestId - The request ID.
 * @param moduleName - The module name.
 * @returns The server logger.
 */
export const getServerLogger = (
  requestId: string,
  moduleName: string = 'default'
) => {
  /**
   * Creates a log entry.
   * @param level - The log level.
   * @param message - The log message.
   * @param meta - The log metadata.
   * @returns The log entry.
   */
  const createLogEntry = (
    level: string,
    message: string,
    meta: Record<string, unknown> = {}
  ) => {
    const timestamp = Date.now() * 1000000;
    const sanitizedMeta = Object.entries(meta).reduce(
      (acc, [key, value]) => {
        acc[key] = typeof value === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(value) : value;
        return acc;
      },
      {} as Record<string, unknown>
    );

    // Development logging

    const logData = {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      level,
      module: moduleName,
      requestId,
      message,
      ...sanitizedMeta
    };

    const border = '═'.repeat(40);

    // Color-coded level with emojis
    const levelColors: Record<string, (text: string) => string> = {
      debug: (text) => ansis.blue.bold(`🐛  ${text}`),
      info: (text) => ansis.green.bold(`ℹ️  ${text}`),
      warn: (text) => ansis.yellow.bold(`⚠️  ${text}`),
      error: (text) => ansis.red.bold(`❌  ${text}`)
    };

    // Ensure we have a valid color function
    const levelColor = levelColors[level] || ansis.white;

    const output = [
      ansis.gray(border),
      ansis.cyan.bold('[SERVER] 📝 Log Entry:'),
      `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('🔍 Level:')}       ${level}`,
      `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('🕒 Timestamp:')}   ${ansis.white(logData.timestamp)}`,
      `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('📦 Module:')}      ${ansis.white(logData.module)}`,
      `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('🆔 Request ID:')}  ${ansis.white(logData.requestId)}`,
      `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('💬 Message:')}     ${ansis.white(logData.message)}`
    ];

    // Convert metadata to a structured, indented list
    const formatMetadata = (
      metadata: Record<string, unknown>,
      prefix = '  - ',
      connector = '├─'
    ) => {
      return Object.entries(metadata)
        .map(([key, value]) => {
          const valueString =
            typeof value === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(value) : value;
          return `${ansis.gray(prefix)}${ansis.gray(connector)} ${ansis.magenta.bold(key)}: ${valueString}`;
        })
        .join('\n');
    };

    const metadataTree = formatMetadata(sanitizedMeta, '   ', '└─');

    output.push(
      `${ansis.gray(border)}\n`,
      `${ansis.cyan.bold('[SERVER] 📝 Log Entry:')}\n`,
      `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('🔍 Level:')}       ${level}`,
      `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('🕒 Timestamp:')}   ${ansis.white(logData.timestamp)}`,
      `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('📦 Module:')}      ${ansis.white(logData.module)}`,
      `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('🆔 Request ID:')}  ${ansis.white(logData.requestId)}`,
      `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('💬 Message:')}     ${ansis.white(logData.message)}`,
      `${ansis.gray('└─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('📄 Metadata:')}\n${metadataTree}\n`,
      `${ansis.gray(border)}\n`,
      ''
    );

    // Print each line separately to ensure proper color rendering
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'development') {
      output.forEach((line) => console.log(line));
    }

    return {
      streams: [
        {
          stream: {
            app: 'signvault-frontend',
            level,
            module: moduleName
          },
          values: [
            [
              timestamp.toString(),
              JSON.stringify({
                requestId,
                message,
                ...sanitizedMeta,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
              })
            ]
          ]
        }
      ]
    } as LogEntry;
  };

  /**
   * Sends a log entry to Loki.
   * @param entry - The log entry.
   */
  const sendToLoki = async (entry: LogEntry) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.GRAFANA_URL}/loki/api/v1/push`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': `Basic ${Buffer.from(`${process.env.GRAFANA_USER}:${process.env.GRAFANA_TOKEN}`).toString('base64')}`
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(entry)
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        const responseText = await response.text();
        console.error('Failed to send log to Loki:', {
          status: response.status,
          response: responseText,
          url: process.env.GRAFANA_URL
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        'Failed to send log to Loki:',
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
      );
    }
  };

  return {
    debug: (message: string, meta: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => {
      if (DISABLE_LOGGING) return;
      void sendToLoki(createLogEntry('debug', message, meta));
    },
    info: (message: string, meta: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => {
      if (DISABLE_LOGGING) return;
      void sendToLoki(createLogEntry('info', message, meta));
    },
    warn: (message: string, meta: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => {
      if (DISABLE_LOGGING) return;
      void sendToLoki(createLogEntry('warn', message, meta));
    },
    error: (message: string, meta: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => {
      if (DISABLE_LOGGING) return;
      void sendToLoki(createLogEntry('error', message, meta));
    }
  };
};

function FormComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  // This will be the actual component rendered in the final form
  return <div>{element.label}</div>;

const propertiesSchema = z.object({
  label: z.string().min(2).max(50),
  description: z.string().max(100),
  placeholder: z.string().max(50),
  required: z.boolean().default(false),
  options: z.string().optional()
});

type PropertiesFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof propertiesSchema>;

function PropertiesComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {

  addBase,
  theme

  addBase: Function;

    ':root': newVars

}

'use server';

import { execute } from '@signvault/gql-client/execute';
import {
  EnqueueOrganizationCreationDocument,
  type UpdateOrganizationMutationVariables
} from '@signvault/gql-client/graphql';
import { UpdateOrganization } from '@signvault/gql-client/mutations/organization';
import { print, type ASTNode } from 'graphql';
import { updateOrganization as updateOrganizationDb } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud/organizations/operations';
import { getOrganizationById } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud/organizations/operations';
import type { NestedRecord, OrganizationCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getDbUser } from './auth';
import { createAuditLogEntry } from './audit-logs';
import {
  AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';
import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import { organizationsCS } from '@signvault/db/schema';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';

/**
 * Server action that enqueues an organization creation event
 * @param data - The data of the organization to create
 * @returns The updated organization
 */
export async function enqueueOrganizationCreation(data: {
  industry: string;
  name: string;
  orgType: string;
  organizationId: string;
  userCorrelationId: string;
  userId: string;
  subscriptionId?: string;
  industryType?: string;
}) {
  await execute(print(EnqueueOrganizationCreationDocument as ASTNode), {
    input: data
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log organization creation event');
  });
  // Create audit log entry
  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.ORGANIZATION_CREATED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.ORGANIZATION,
    metadata: {
      organizationId: data.organizationId,
      organizationName: data.name,
      organizationType: data.orgType,
      organizationIndustry: data.industry,
      organizationStatus: 'ACTIVE',
      organizationIndustryType: data.industryType
    },
    description: `Organization ${data.name} created by ${data.userId}`,
    entityId: data.organizationId,
    entityType: 'ORGANIZATION',
    entityName: data.name,
    targetUserId: String(data.userId),
    success: true
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[AUDIT LOG] Failed to log organization creation event');
  });
}

/**
 * Server action that updates organization information with provenance tracking
 * @param organizationId - The ID of the organization to update
 * @param updateData - The data to update the organization with
 * @returns The updated organization
 */
export async function updateOrganizationInfo(
  organizationId: string | bigint,
  updateData: Partial<{
    name: string;
    description: string;
    industryType: string;
    billingEmail: string;
    billingAddress: string;
    billingCity: string;
    billingState: string;
    billingCountry: string;
    billingPostalCode: string;
    phone: string;
    website: string;
    sizeCategory: string;
    isVerified: boolean;
    primaryContactName: string;
    primaryContactEmail: string;
    primaryContactPhone: string;
    branding: Record<string, unknown>;
    isMfaRequired: boolean;
  }>
): Promise<OrganizationCS> {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const adminUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
  if (!adminUser) {
    throw new Error('Admin user not found');
  }

  // Get original organization record for provenance
  const originalOrgResult = await getOrganizationById(organizationId);
  if (
    originalOrgResult.code !== 'organization.found' ||
    !originalOrgResult.organization
  ) {
    throw new Error('Organization not found');
  }

  // Update organization in database
  const updateResult = await updateOrganizationDb(organizationId, updateData);

  if (
    updateResult.code !== 'organization.updated' ||
    !updateResult.organization
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to update organization: ${updateResult.code}`);
  }

  // Track organization update in provenance system
  await execute(print(UpdateOrganization as ASTNode), {
    input: {
      organizationId: organizationId.toString(),
      name: updateResult.organization.name,
      orgType: updateResult.organization.orgType || 'BUSINESS',
      industry: updateResult.organization.industryType || '',
      organizationStatus: 'ACTIVE'
    }
  } as UpdateOrganizationMutationVariables).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log update organization event');
  });
  // Create audit log entry
  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.ORGANIZATION_UPDATED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.ORGANIZATION,
    metadata: {
      organizationId: organizationId.toString(),
      organizationName: updateResult.organization.name,
      organizationType: updateResult.organization.orgType || 'BUSINESS',
      organizationIndustry: updateResult.organization.industryType || '',
      organizationStatus: 'ACTIVE'
    },
    beforeState: originalOrgResult.organization as NestedRecord,
    afterState: updateResult.organization as NestedRecord,
    description: `Organization ${updateResult.organization.name} updated by ${adminUser.name}`,
    entityId: organizationId.toString(),
    entityType: 'ORGANIZATION',
    entityName: updateResult.organization.name,
    targetUserId: String(adminUser.id),
    success: true
  });

  return updateResult.organization;
}

export async function getOrganization(
  organizationId: string | bigint | null | undefined
) {
  if (!organizationId) {
    return null;
  }
  const organizationIdBigInt =
    typeof organizationId === 'string'
      ? BigInt(organizationId)
      : organizationId;
  const result = await db
    .select()
    .from(organizationsCS)
    .where(eq(organizationsCS.id, organizationIdBigInt))
    .limit(1);
  return result.length > 0 ? result[0] : null;
}

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import {
  type CalendarEventType,
  type TeamCalendarEvent,
  type TeamMember
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import {
  eachDayOfInterval,
  endOfDay,
  endOfMonth,
  endOfWeek,
  format,
  isSameDay,
  isSameMonth,
  startOfDay,
  startOfMonth,
  startOfWeek
} from 'date-fns';
import { useEffect } from 'react';

import { useCalendarContext } from '../../calendar-context';
import CalendarEvent from '../../calendar-event';

export type ProcessedEvent = {
  daySpecificDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  startDate: Date;
} & Omit<BaseEvent, 'startDate' | 'endDate'>;

type BaseEvent = {
  attendees?: TeamMember[];
  color: string;
  createdAt: Date;
  createdBy: string;
  dataProvenanceId: string;
  description: string;
  endDate: Date;
  eventType: CalendarEventType;
  id: string;
  lastModifiedBy: string;
  location: string;
  organizationId: string;
  securityContextId: string;
  startDate: Date;
  teamId: string;
  title: string;
  uid: string;
  updatedAt: Date;
};

export default function CalendarBodyMonth() {
  const {
    date,
    events,
    setDate,
    setMode,
    setDayEventsDialogOpen,
    setProcessedEvents
  } = useCalendarContext();

  // Get the first day of the month
  const monthStart = startOfMonth(date);
  // Get the last day of the month
  const monthEnd = endOfMonth(date);

  // Get the first Monday of the first week (may be in previous month)
  const calendarStart = startOfWeek(monthStart, {
    weekStartsOn: 1
  });
  // Get the last Sunday of the last week (may be in next month)
  const calendarEnd = endOfWeek(monthEnd, {
    weekStartsOn: 1
  });

  // Get all days between start and end
  const calendarDays = eachDayOfInterval({
    start: calendarStart,
    end: calendarEnd
  });

  const today = new Date();

  // Process events to handle multi-day events
  const processedEvents: ProcessedEvent[] = events.flatMap((event) => {
    const eventStart = startOfDay(new Date(event.startDate));
    const eventEnd = endOfDay(new Date(event.endDate));

    // Create a day-specific event for each day in the interval
    const daysInBetween = eachDayOfInterval({
      start: eventStart,
      end: eventEnd
    });

    return daysInBetween.map((day) => ({
      ...event,
      id: `${event.id}_processed_${day.toISOString()}`,
      startDate: eventStart,
      endDate: eventEnd,
      daySpecificDate: day
    }));
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    setProcessedEvents(processedEvents);
  });

  return (
    <div className='flex grow flex-col overflow-hidden'>
      <div className='hidden grid-cols-7 divide-x divide-border border-border md:grid'>
        {['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'].map((day) => (
          <div
            className='border-b border-border py-2 text-center text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground'
            key={day}
          >
            {day}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className='grid grow overflow-y-auto md:grid-cols-7'>
        {calendarDays.map((day) => {
          // Filter events for this specific day
          const validEvents = processedEvents.filter((event) => {
            const currentDay = startOfDay(day);
            const eventDay = startOfDay(event.daySpecificDate);
            return isSameDay(eventDay, currentDay);
          });
          const isToday = isSameDay(day, today);

          return (
            <div
              className={cn(
                'relative flex aspect-square cursor-pointer flex-col border-b border-r p-2',
                !isSameMonth(day, date) && 'hidden bg-muted md:flex'
              )}
              key={day.toISOString()}
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (validEvents.length > 2) {
                  setDate(day);
                  setDayEventsDialogOpen(true);
                } else {
                  setDate(day);
                  setMode('day');
                }
              }}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  setDate(day);
                  setDayEventsDialogOpen(true);
                }
              }}
              role='button'
              tabIndex={0}
            >
              <div
                className={cn(
                  'flex aspect-square w-fit flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-full p-1 text-sm font-medium',
                  isToday && 'bg-primary text-background',
                  !isSameMonth(day, date) && !isToday && 'text-muted-foreground'
                )}
              >
                {format(day, 'd')}
              </div>
              <div className='mt-1 flex flex-col gap-1'>
                {validEvents.slice(0, 2).map((event) => (
                  <CalendarEvent
                    className='relative h-auto'
                    event={event as TeamCalendarEvent}
                    key={event.id}
                    month
                  />
                ))}
                {validEvents.length > 2 && (
                  <div
                    className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      setDate(day);
                      setDayEventsDialogOpen(true);
                    }}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => {
                      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        setDate(day);
                        setDayEventsDialogOpen(true);
                      }
                    }}
                    role='button'
                    tabIndex={0}
                  >
                    +{validEvents.length - 2} more
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function ContentList({
  contents,
  isLoading,
  sourceSystem,
  isAdmin,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<{
  contents: Content[];
  isLoading: boolean;
  sourceSystem: OrganizationSourceSystem;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}>) {

  const [deletingContent, setDeletingContent] = useState<Content | null>(null);

          <Input
            placeholder='Search content...'
            className='pl-8'
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
        <Button asChild>
          <Link
            href={`/account/organizations/${sourceSystem.organizationId}/content/create`}
          >
            <Plus className='mr-2 size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
            Add Content
          </Link>
        </Button>
      </div>

          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Title</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Created</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Updated</TableHead>
              <TableHead className='w-[70px]'>Actions</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {filteredContents.map((content) => (
              <TableRow key={content.id}>
                <TableCell>{content.title}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <Badge
                    variant={
                      content.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'default' : 'secondary'

                    {content.status}
                  </Badge>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{formatDate(content.createdAt, 'PPP')}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{formatDate(content.updatedAt, 'PPP')}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <DropdownMenu>
                    <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                      <Button variant='ghost' size='sm'>
                        <EllipsisVertical className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
                      </Button>
                    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                    <DropdownMenuContent align='end'>
                      {/* View */}
                      <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
                        <Link
                          href={`/account/organizations/${sourceSystem.organizationId}/content/${content.id}/view`}
                        >
                          <Eye className='mr-2 size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
                          View
                        </Link>

                        <React.Fragment>

                            <Pencil className='mr-2 size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />

                          <DropdownMenuItem
                            onClick={() => setDeletingContent(content)}
                          >
                            <Trash className='mr-2 size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
                            Delete
                          </DropdownMenuItem>
                        </React.Fragment>
                      )}
                    </DropdownMenuContent>
                  </DropdownMenu>
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>

      {isAdmin && (
        <EditContentDialog
          organizationId={sourceSystem.organizationId}
          content={editingContent}
          onClose={() => setEditingContent(null)}
          sourceSystem={sourceSystem}
          cookieStore={cookieStore}
        />
      )}

      {isAdmin && (
        <DeleteContentDialog
          organizationId={sourceSystem.organizationId}
          content={deletingContent}
          onClose={() => setDeletingContent(null)}
          sourceSystem={sourceSystem}
          cookieStore={cookieStore}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

        publishedTime: post.date
      },
      twitter: {
        card: 'summary_large_image',
        title: `${post.title} Blog Post | SignVault`,
        description: post.description,
        images: [post.image]
      }

    });

export async function generateStaticParams() {
  const logger = getServerLogger(getRandomUUID(), 'blog-page-ssg');

  try {
    logger.info('Generating static params for blogs');

    const response = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/blogs?bypassToken=${process.env.BYPASS_TOKEN}`
    );

    const blogPostsResponse: GetBlogsResponse = await response.json();

    if (!blogPostsResponse.blogs.database) {
      logger.error('Error fetching blog posts', {
        blogPostsResponse
      });
      return [];
    }

    const blogPosts = blogPostsResponse.blogs.database;

    logger.info('Generating static params for blogs', {
      blogPosts
    });
    return blogPosts.map((post: Blog) => ({
      slug: post.slug
    }));
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error generating static params for blogs', {
      error
    });
    return [];
  }
}

import Link from 'next/link';

import type { CalendarEvent } from './calendar-types';

type EventCardProps = {

  event: CalendarEvent;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  organizationId: string;
  teamId: string;
};

export function EventCard({
  event,
  organizationId,
  teamId,
  isAdmin,
  className
}: Readonly<EventCardProps>) {
  const isSingleDay =
    event.startDate.toDateString() === event.endDate.toDateString();

  const { setManageEventDialogOpen, setSelectedEvent } = useCalendarContext();

  let eventId = event.id;

  if (eventId.includes('_processed_')) {
    eventId = eventId.split('_processed_')[0];
  }

  return (
    <motion.div
      className={cn(
        'overflow-hidden rounded-lg border-l-2',
        `border-${event.color}-500`,
        className
      )}
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
      viewport={{ once: true }}
      whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
    >
      <Card className='flex h-full flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden'>
        <CardHeader className='space-y-2'>
          <div className='flex items-start justify-between'>
            <div>
              <h3 className='line-clamp-1 text-lg font-semibold'>
                {event.title}
              </h3>
              {event.description && (
                <p className='line-clamp-2 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm text-foreground/90'>
                  {event.description}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className='flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-foreground/90'>
            {isSingleDay ? (
              <div className='flex flex-col items-start gap-2'>
                <span className='inline-flex items-center gap-1'>
                  <CalendarDays className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
                  {format(event.startDate, 'PPP')}
                </span>
                <span className='inline-flex items-center gap-1'>
                  <Clock className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
                  {format(event.startDate, 'h:mm a')} -{' '}
                  {format(event.endDate, 'h:mm a')}
                </span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
                <CalendarDays className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
                {format(event.startDate, 'do MMMM')} -{' '}
                {format(event.endDate, 'do MMMM yyyy')}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          {event.location && (
            <div className='flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-foreground/90'>
              <MapPin className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
              {event.location}
            </div>

  try {
    const response = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/case-studies?bypassToken=${process.env.BYPASS_TOKEN}`,
      {
        next: {
          tags: ['case-studies']
        }
      }
    );
    const caseStudiesResponse: GetCaseStudiesResponse = await response.json();

    const caseStudies = caseStudiesResponse.caseStudies.database;

    if (!caseStudies) {
      logger.error('Error fetching case studies', {
        caseStudiesResponse
      });
      return [];
    }

    return caseStudies.map((study: CaseStudy) => ({
      slug: study.slug
    }));
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error generating static params for case studies', {
      error
    });
    return [];
  }
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/create-organization/components/invite-users-form/utils.ts ===

import type { FormState } from 'react-hook-form';

import { toTitleCase } from '@/lib/utils';

import type { InviteUser, InviteUsersFormValues } from '../../types';

import { FORM_STEPS } from './constants';

/**
 * Validates if all users in the form are complete and valid
 */
export function areAllUsersValid(
  users: InviteUser[],
  formState: FormState<InviteUsersFormValues>
): boolean {
  // If no users, return false
  if (!users.length) return false;

  // Check if any user has errors
  const hasErrors = users.some((_, index) => {
    return Object.keys(formState.errors?.users?.[index] || {}).length > 0;
  });

  // Check if all users have completed all required steps
  const allStepsCompleted = users.every(
    (_, index) =>
      isStepCompleted(index, 'basic-info', users, formState) &&
      isStepCompleted(index, 'function-clearance', users, formState) &&
      isStepCompleted(index, 'permissions', users, formState)
  );

  return !hasErrors && allStepsCompleted;
}

/**
 * Formats a permission name for display
 * Moves the last word to the front and formats as title case
 * e.g. COMPLIANCE_REPORT_GENERATE -> Generate Compliance Report
 */
export function formatPermissionName(permission: string): string {
  const parts = permission.split('_');
  const lastWord = parts.pop(); // Remove last word
  if (!lastWord) return ''; // Handle empty string case

  // Move last word to front and join rest of words
  const reorderedParts = [lastWord, ...parts];

  return toTitleCase(
    reorderedParts.map((part) => part.toLowerCase()).join(' ')
  );
}

/**
 * Formats a role description for display
 * e.g. "Regular User - L1_USER" -> Regular User
 */
export function formatRoleName(roleDescription: string): string {
  return toTitleCase(roleDescription.split('-')[0]);
}

/**
 * Gets the field error message
 */
export function getFieldError(
  userIndex: number,
  field: string,
  formState: FormState<InviteUsersFormValues>
): string | undefined {
  const error = formState.errors?.users?.[userIndex]?.[field];
  return error?.message as string | undefined;
}

/**
 * Checks if a step has validation errors
 */
export function hasStepErrors(
  userIndex: number,
  fields: string[],
  formState: FormState<InviteUsersFormValues>
): boolean {
  return fields.some((field) => {
    const error = formState.errors?.users?.[userIndex]?.[field];
    return error !== undefined;
  });
}

/**
 * Checks if a specific step is completed for a user
 */
export function isStepCompleted(
  currentUserIndex: number,
  step: (typeof FORM_STEPS)[keyof typeof FORM_STEPS],
  users: InviteUser[],
  formState: FormState<InviteUsersFormValues>
): boolean {
  const user = users[currentUserIndex];
  if (!user) return false;
  switch (step) {
    case FORM_STEPS.BASIC_INFO:
      return !!(
        user.firstName &&
        user.lastName &&
        user.email &&
        user.role &&
        user.team &&
        !hasStepErrors(
          currentUserIndex,
          ['firstName', 'lastName', 'email', 'role', 'team'],
          formState
        )
      );
    case FORM_STEPS.FUNCTION_CLEARANCE:
      return !!(
        user.attributes?.function?.primary &&
        user.attributes?.function?.specialization &&
        user.attributes?.clearance?.level &&
        user.attributes?.clearance?.scope &&
        user.attributes?.clearance?.scope.length > 0 &&
        user.attributes?.clearance?.scope.length <= 5 &&
        user.attributes?.temporalAccess?.timezone &&
        user.attributes?.temporalAccess?.schedule?.days &&
        user.attributes?.temporalAccess?.schedule?.days.length > 0 &&
        user.attributes?.temporalAccess?.schedule?.days.length <= 7 &&
        user.attributes?.temporalAccess?.schedule?.hours?.start &&
        user.attributes?.temporalAccess?.schedule?.hours?.end &&
        user.attributes?.temporalAccess?.schedule?.timeRange &&
        !hasStepErrors(
          currentUserIndex,
          [
            'attributes.function.primary',
            'attributes.function.specialization',
            'attributes.clearance.level',
            'attributes.clearance.scope',
            'attributes.temporalAccess.timezone',
            'attributes.temporalAccess.schedule',
            'attributes.temporalAccess.schedule.days',
            'attributes.temporalAccess.schedule.hours',
            'attributes.temporalAccess.schedule.timeRange'
          ],
          formState
        )
      );
    case FORM_STEPS.PERMISSIONS:
      // The permissions step is completed when function-clearance is completed
      // since permissions are auto-calculated
      return isStepCompleted(
        currentUserIndex,
        FORM_STEPS.FUNCTION_CLEARANCE,
        users,
        formState
      );
    case FORM_STEPS.REVIEW:
      return (
        isStepCompleted(
          currentUserIndex,
          FORM_STEPS.BASIC_INFO,
          users,
          formState
        ) &&
        isStepCompleted(
          currentUserIndex,
          FORM_STEPS.FUNCTION_CLEARANCE,
          users,
          formState
        )
      );
    default:
      return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Checks if a step should be locked
 */
export function isStepLocked(
  userIndex: number,
  step: string,
  users: InviteUser[],
  formState: FormState<InviteUsersFormValues>
): boolean {
  switch (step) {
    case 'basic-info':
      return false;
    case 'function-clearance':
      return !isStepCompleted(userIndex, 'basic-info', users, formState);
    case 'permissions':
      return !isStepCompleted(
        userIndex,
        'function-clearance',
        users,
        formState
      );
    case 'review':
      return !(
        isStepCompleted(userIndex, 'basic-info', users, formState) &&
        isStepCompleted(userIndex, 'function-clearance', users, formState)
      );
    default:
      return false;
  }
}

export default function OrganizationsPage({

  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [filteredOrganizations, setFilteredOrganizations] = useState<
    UserOrganization[]
  >([]);
  const [currentOrganizations, setCurrentOrganizations] = useState<
    UserOrganization[]
  >([]);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(0);

  const itemsPerPage = 4;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (userOrganizations.length > 0) {
      const filtered = userOrganizations.filter((org) =>
        org.organizationId.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())

import {
  getAllDocuments,
  getDocumentById,
  getDocumentVersionHistory
} from '@/actions/documents';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import DocumentViewClient from './document-view-client';
import type { Metadata, Viewport } from 'next';
import { getStorageLocation } from '@/lib/utils';
import { getAuditLogsForDocument } from '@/actions/audit-logs';
import { getAccessControlsForDocument } from '@/actions/document-access-controls';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { getDbUser } from '@/actions/auth';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import type { AccessLevelEnumPS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { ROLES } from '@signvault/logto';
import { AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS } from '@signvault/core-lib/index';

type DocumentPageProps = {
  params: {
    documentId: string;
  };
};

export async function generateStaticParams() {
  try {
    const allDocuments = await getAllDocuments();
    return allDocuments
      .filter((doc) => doc.status === 'ACTIVE')
      .map((doc) => ({
        documentId: doc.id.toString()
      })) as DocumentPageProps['params'][];
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      '[SSG] Error generating static params for document page',
      error
    );
    return [];
  }
}

export async function generateMetadata({
  params
}: DocumentPageProps): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { documentId } = await params;
  if (!documentId || !Number.isFinite(Number(documentId))) {
    return {
      title: 'Document Not Found',
      description: 'The requested document could not be found.'
    };
  }
  const documentIdBigInt = BigInt(documentId);
  const document = await getDocumentById(documentIdBigInt);

  if (!document) {
    return {
      title: 'Document Not Found',
      description: 'The requested document could not be found.'
    };
  }

  const documentTitle =
    document.title || document.filename?.split('.')[0] || 'View Document';
  const description =
    document.description || `View details and content of ${documentTitle}.`;

  return {
    title: documentTitle,
    description: description,
    creator: 'SignVault',
    keywords: [
      'SignVault',
      'Document',
      documentTitle,
      ...((document.metadata as { tags?: string[] })?.tags || [])
    ],
    authors: [{ name: 'SignVault', url: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL }],
    robots: 'index, follow',
    icons: {
      icon: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/favicon.ico`
    },
    openGraph: {
      title: documentTitle,
      description: description,
      url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/documents/${document.id}`,
      siteName: 'SignVault',
      locale: 'en-US',
      type: 'article', // More specific type for a document page
      images: [`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`]
    },
    twitter: {
      title: documentTitle,
      description: description,
      images: [`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`],
      creator: `@SignVault`,
      site: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL,
      card: 'summary_large_image'
    }
  };
}

export const viewport: Viewport = {
  width: 'device-width',
  initialScale: 1,
  themeColor: '#5e46ef'
};

export default async function DocumentPage({ params }: DocumentPageProps) {
  const { documentId } = await params;
  if (!documentId || !Number.isFinite(Number(documentId))) {
    notFound();
  }
  const documentIdBigInt = BigInt(documentId);
  const document = await getDocumentById(documentIdBigInt);

  if (!document) {
    notFound();
  }

  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  if (!dbUser) {
    notFound();
  }

  // Calculate access control permissions server-side
  const isSuperAdmin = AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS.includes(
    dbUser.id.toString() as (typeof AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS)[number]
  );
  const isOrgCreator =
    document.organizationId?.toString() === dbUser.id.toString();
  const isOrgAdmin = Boolean(
    dbUser.organizationRoleId &&
      dbUser.organizationId &&
      document.organizationId &&
      (String(dbUser.organizationRoleId) === ROLES.L5_USER.id.toString() ||
        String(dbUser.organizationRoleId) === ROLES.L6_USER.id.toString())
  );
  const isOwner = document.ownerId?.toString() === dbUser.id.toString();
  const canAdminister = isSuperAdmin || isOrgCreator || isOrgAdmin || isOwner;

  // Fetch audit logs, version history and access controls on the server
  const [auditLogsRes, versionHistory, accessControlsRes] = await Promise.all([
    getAuditLogsForDocument(documentIdBigInt),
    getDocumentVersionHistory(documentIdBigInt),
    getAccessControlsForDocument(documentIdBigInt)
  ]);

  return (
    <DocumentViewClient
      document={document}
      previewUrl={
        document.s3Key
          ? getStorageLocation(
              process.env.S3_BUCKET,
              process.env.S3_REGION,
              document.s3Key
            )
          : null
      }
      auditLogs={
        auditLogsRes.success
          ? auditLogsRes.data.map((l) => ({
              id: l.id.toString(),
              action: l.action,
              category: l.category,
              severity: l.severity,
              description: l.description,
              createdAt: new Date(l.createdAt).toISOString(),
              user: l.user
            }))
          : []
      }
      versionHistory={versionHistory}
      accessControls={
        accessControlsRes.success
          ? accessControlsRes.data.map((ac) => ({
              ...ac,
              accessLevel: ac.accessLevel as AccessLevelEnumPS
            }))
          : []
      }
      isSuperAdmin={isSuperAdmin}
      isOrgCreator={isOrgCreator}
      isOrgAdmin={isOrgAdmin}
      isOwner={isOwner}
      canAdminister={canAdminister}
    />
  );
}

'use client';

import type { DocumentCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import * as z from 'zod';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogClose
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/textarea';
import { updateDocumentMetadata } from '@/actions/documents';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { createAuditLogEntry } from '@/actions/audit-logs';
import {
  AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';

const editDocumentSchema = z.object({
  title: z.string().min(1, 'Title is required').max(255),
  description: z.string().max(1000).optional()
});

type EditDocumentFormValues = z.infer<typeof editDocumentSchema>;

export type EditDocumentDialogProps = {
  document: DocumentCS;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  onSuccess?: (updatedDocument: DocumentCS) => void;
};

export function EditDocumentDialog({
  document,
  isOpen,
  onOpenChange,
  onSuccess
}: EditDocumentDialogProps) {
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const form = useForm<EditDocumentFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(editDocumentSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      title: document.title || '',
      description: document.description || ''
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      form.reset({
        title: document.title || '',
        description: document.description || ''
      });
    }
  }, [isOpen, document, form]);

  const onSubmit = async (values: EditDocumentFormValues) => {
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const updatedDocument = await updateDocumentMetadata(document.id, {
        title: values.title,
        description: values.description || '' // Ensure empty string if undefined
      });
      toast.success('Document updated successfully!');
      await createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.DOCUMENT_UPDATED,
        category: AuditLogCategory.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT,
        entityId: document.id,
        entityType: 'document',
        entityName: values.title,
        description: `User updated document metadata for: "${values.title}"`,
        beforeState: {
          title: document.title,
          description: document.description
        },
        afterState: {
          title: values.title,
          description: values.description
        }
      }).catch(console.error);

      // Invalidate and refetch documents list
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['organizationDocuments']
      });
      // Optionally, update specific document query if one exists for document view page
      // await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['document', document.id.toString()] });

      onSuccess?.(updatedDocument as DocumentCS);
      onOpenChange(false); // Close dialog on success
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to update document:', error);
      toast.error(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to update document'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Edit Document</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Update the title and description for your document.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <Form {...form}>
          <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className='space-y-4'>
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='title'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Title</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Input placeholder='Enter document title' {...field} />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name='description'
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Description (Optional)</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Textarea
                      placeholder='Enter a brief description of the document'
                      {...field}
                      rows={3}
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            <DialogFooter className='pt-4'>
              <DialogClose asChild>
                <Button type='button' variant='outline'>
                  Cancel
                </Button>
              </DialogClose>
              <Button type='submit' disabled={isSubmitting}>
                {isSubmitting && (
                  <Loader2 className='mr-2 size-4 animate-spin' />
                )}
                Save Changes
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </form>
        </Form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

      }

  } catch (error) {

export const viewport: Viewport = {
  width: 'device-width',
  initialScale: 1,
  maximumScale: 1,
  minimumScale: 1,
  themeColor: '#5e46ef'
};

export default async function OrganizationPage() {
  // Since this is a server component, all data is loaded before render,
  // so isLoadingData should always be false.
  try {
    // Fetch Stripe plans
    const plans = await getPlans();

    // Fetch actual subscription and organization data
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

    if (!dbUser) {
      throw new Error('User not found');
    }

    const subscriptionResult = await getUserSubscriptionStatus(
      dbUser.id.toString()
    );

    if (!subscriptionResult.success) {
      console.error(
        'Failed to fetch subscription data:',
        subscriptionResult.error || 'Unknown error'
      );
      // Fallback to default data if subscription fetch fails
      const subscriptionData = {
        hasSubscription: false,
        hasOrganization: !!dbUser.organizationId,
        currentPlan: undefined,
        subscriptionStatus: undefined,
        isActive: false
      };

      return (
        <div className='flex flex-col gap-6 pb-24'>
          <SubscriptionStatus
            {...subscriptionData}
            plans={plans}
            organizationId={
              dbUser.organizationId
                ? dbUser.organizationId.toString()
                : undefined
            }
            hasStripeCustomer={false}
            isLoadingData={false}
          />
          <AccountSettingsForm page='organization' />
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className='flex flex-col gap-6 pb-24'>
        <SubscriptionStatus
          {...subscriptionResult.subscription}
          plans={plans}
          organizationId={
            dbUser.organizationId ? dbUser.organizationId.toString() : undefined
          }
          hasStripeCustomer={
            Boolean(subscriptionResult.subscription.hasOrganization) &&
            Boolean(subscriptionResult.subscription.hasSubscription)
          }
          isLoadingData={false}
        />
        <AccountSettingsForm page='organization' />
      </div>
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error in OrganizationPage:', error);
    // Fallback to default data if any error occurs
    const fallbackData = {
      hasSubscription: false,
      hasOrganization: false,
      currentPlan: undefined,
      subscriptionStatus: undefined,
      isActive: false
    };

    // Try to get plans even if other data fails
    let plans = [];
    try {
      plans = await getPlans();
    } catch (planError) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch plans:', planError);
    }

    return (
      <div className='flex flex-col gap-6 pb-24'>
        <SubscriptionStatus
          {...fallbackData}
          plans={plans}
          organizationId={undefined}
          hasStripeCustomer={false}
          isLoadingData={false}
        />
        <AccountSettingsForm page='organization' />
      </div>
    );
  }
}

export default async function DashboardPage() {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  if (!dbUser || !dbUser.organizationId) {
    // Or a more user-friendly component
    return <div>You are not part of an organization.</div>;
  }

  const organizationId = dbUser.organizationId;
  const userId = dbUser.id;

  const [
    documents,
    drafts,
    templates,
    provenanceEvents,
    provenanceQueries,
    roles,
    teamsResult,
    auditLogsResult
  ] = await Promise.all([
    getDocuments(organizationId),
    getOrganizationDrafts(organizationId, userId),
    getGlobalDocumentTemplates(),
    getProvenanceEventsByOrganizationId({
      organizationId: organizationId.toString()
    }),
    getProvenanceQueriesByOrganizationId({
      organizationId: organizationId.toString()
    }),
    getCustomRoles(organizationId),
    getActiveTeams(organizationId.toString()),
    getAuditLogs({
      page: 1,
      pageSize: 5,
      sort: { field: 'createdAt', direction: 'desc' }
    })
  ]);

  const teams = teamsResult.teams ?? [];
  const auditLogs = auditLogsResult.success
    ? (auditLogsResult.data?.data ?? [])
    : [];

  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<DashboardSkeleton />}>
      <DashboardPageClient
        user={dbUser}
        documents={documents.filter(
          (doc) =>
            doc.status === DocumentStatus.ACTIVE &&
            doc.s3Key !== null &&
            doc.s3Key !== undefined
        )}
        drafts={drafts}
        templates={templates}
        provenanceEvents={provenanceEvents}
        provenanceQueries={provenanceQueries}
        roles={roles}
        teams={teams}
        auditLogs={auditLogs}
      />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

function DashboardSkeleton() {

'use client';

import { useAuth } from '@/contexts/auth-context';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { Minimize2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { FaCode } from 'react-icons/fa6';
import {
  TbBoxAlignBottomLeft,
  TbBoxAlignBottomRight,
  TbBoxAlignTopLeft,
  TbBoxAlignTopRight
} from 'react-icons/tb';

type Position = 'bottom-right' | 'bottom-left' | 'top-right' | 'top-left';

export function NotificationTester() {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [isMinimized, setIsMinimized] = useState(true);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState<Position>('bottom-right');
  const { dbUser } = useAuth();

  const sendTestNotification = async (
    e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>
  ) => {
    try {
      e.preventDefault();
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/test-notification`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            title,
            message,
            userId: dbUser?.id,
            organizationId: dbUser?.organizationId
          })
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        console.error(`Failed to send test notification: Response:`, response);
        toast.error(`Failed to send test notification: ${response.statusText}`);
        throw new Error(
          `Failed to send test notification: ${response.statusText}`
        );
      }

      setMessage('');
      setTitle('');
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(
        `Error sending test notification: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`
      );
      clientLogger.error(
        'Error sending test notification:',
        {
          message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
          payload: {
            title,
            message
          }
        },
        'notification-tester'
      );
    }
  };

  const toggleMinimize = () => {
    setIsMinimized(!isMinimized);
  };

  const changePosition = (newPosition: Position) => {
    setPosition(newPosition);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`fixed ${getPosition(position)} ${isMinimized ? 'w-fit' : 'w-full max-w-lg'} z-50 ${isMinimized ? 'p-0' : 'p-4'} rounded-md ${isMinimized ? 'border-none' : 'border'} bg-background transition-all duration-300`}
    >
      {isMinimized ? (
        <Button onClick={toggleMinimize} size='icon' variant='outline'>
          <FaCode className='size-4' />
        </Button>
      ) : (
        <form className='flex w-full flex-col gap-2'>
          <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
            <div className='mb-2 flex justify-end gap-2'>
              <Button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  changePosition('bottom-right');
                }}
                size='icon'
                variant='outline'
              >
                <TbBoxAlignBottomRight className='size-4' />
              </Button>
              <Button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  changePosition('bottom-left');
                }}
                size='icon'
                variant='outline'
              >
                <TbBoxAlignBottomLeft className='size-4' />
              </Button>
              <Button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  changePosition('top-right');
                }}
                size='icon'
                variant='outline'
              >
                <TbBoxAlignTopRight className='size-4' />
              </Button>
              <Button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  changePosition('top-left');
                }}
                size='icon'
                variant='outline'
              >
                <TbBoxAlignTopLeft className='size-4' />
              </Button>
            </div>
            <Button onClick={toggleMinimize} size='icon' variant='outline'>
              <Minimize2 className='size-4' />
            </Button>
          </div>
          <Input
            className='w-full'
            onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
            placeholder='Enter test notification title'
            value={title}
          />
          <Input
            className='w-full'
            onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
            placeholder='Enter test notification message'
            value={message}
          />
          <Button
            className='w-full'
            disabled={!title || !message}
            onClick={sendTestNotification}
            type='submit'
          >
            Send Test Notification
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function getPosition(position: Position) {
  switch (position) {
    case 'bottom-left':
      return 'bottom-20 left-12';
    case 'bottom-right':
      return 'bottom-20 right-12';
    case 'top-left':
      return 'top-20 left-12';
    case 'top-right':
      return 'top-20 right-12';
  }
}

'use server';

import type { CreateRoleFormValues } from '@/app/(user)/account/organization/roles/create-role-form';
import type { RoleCS } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/types';

import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import { eq } from '@signvault/db/drizzle';
import { rolesCS, roleTemplates } from '@signvault/db/schema';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
import { api } from '@/lib/api';
import type { CreateRoleResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/v2/roles';
import { RoleActivationMethodPS, type RoleTemplate } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { execute } from '@signvault/gql-client/execute';
import { EnqueueRoleCreated } from '@signvault/gql-client/mutations/roles';
import { print, type ASTNode } from 'graphql';
import {
  AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';
import { createAuditLogEntry } from './audit-logs';

/**
 * Create a new role.
 * @param {role} role The role to create.
 * @returns {Promise<Role>} The created role.
 */
export async function createRole(
  role: CreateRoleFormValues,
  userId: string | bigint,
  organizationId: string | bigint
): Promise<RoleCS> {
  const newRole = await api.post<CreateRoleResponse>(
    'api/v2/roles',
    {
      ...role,
      attributes: {
        level: role.securityLevel,
        classification: role.classification,
        function: role.specialization,
        clearances: {
          main: {
            level: role.securityLevel,
            scope: role.accessScope
          }
        },
        temporalAccess: role.temporalAccess
      },
      createdBy: userId,
      organizationId,
      activationMethod: RoleActivationMethodPS.CUSTOM_CREATED_ROLE,
      baseRole:
        typeof role.baseRole === 'string'
          ? role.baseRole
          : String(role.baseRole),
      keyPermissions: role.permissions,
      permissions: [],
      name: role.name
    },
    '',
    organizationId.toString(),
    {
      headers: {
        'x-user-logto-id': String(userId),
        'x-middleware-bypass-token':
          process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
      }
    }
  );

  switch (newRole.code) {
    case 'role.created':
      break;
    case 'role.creation.failed':
      throw new Error('Failed to create role');
    case 'role.name.exists':
      throw new Error('Role name already exists');
    case 'team.not.found':
      throw new Error('Team not found');
    case 'organization.not.found':
      throw new Error('Organization not found');
    case 'user.not.found':
      throw new Error('User not found');
    case 'base.role.not.found':
      throw new Error('Base role not found');
    case 'internal.server.error':
      throw new Error('Internal server error');
  }

  // Provenance: enqueue role created event
  if (newRole.role) {
    await execute(print(EnqueueRoleCreated as ASTNode), {
      input: {
        actorUserId: String(userId),
        organizationId: String(organizationId),
        role: {
          id: String(newRole.role.id),
          name: newRole.role.name,
          description: newRole.role.description || '',
          isActive: true,
          createdBy: String(userId),
          activationMethod: RoleActivationMethodPS.CUSTOM_CREATED_ROLE,
          attributes: newRole.role.attributes || {},
          configuration: newRole.role.configuration || {},
          security: newRole.role.security || {},
          keyPermissions: role.permissions || [],
          permissions: role.permissions || [],
          baseRoleId: role.baseRole ? String(role.baseRole) : undefined,
          logtoId: newRole.role.logtoId || undefined
        }
      }
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log role created event');
    });

    // Create audit log entry
    await createAuditLogEntry({
      action: AuditLogAction.ROLE_CREATED,
      category: AuditLogCategory.ROLE_MANAGEMENT,
      metadata: {
        roleId: newRole.role.id.toString(),
        roleName: newRole.role.name,
        roleDescription: newRole.role.description || '',
        roleStatus: 'ACTIVE',
        roleCreatedBy: String(userId),
        roleCreatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
      },
      description: `Role ${newRole.role.name} created by ${userId}`,
      entityId: newRole.role.id.toString(),
      entityType: 'ROLE',
      entityName: newRole.role.name,
      targetUserId: String(userId),
      success: true
    }).catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      console.log('[AUDIT LOG] Failed to log role creation event');
    });
  }

  revalidatePath('/account/organization/roles');

  return newRole.role;
}

/**
 * Get all roles for an organization.
 * @param {string} organizationId The organization ID.
 * @returns {Promise<Role[]>} The roles.
 */
export async function getCustomRoles(
  organizationId: string | bigint
): Promise<RoleCS[]> {
  const customRoles = await db
    .select()
    .from(rolesCS)
    .where(
      eq(
        rolesCS.organizationId,
        typeof organizationId === 'string'
          ? BigInt(organizationId)
          : organizationId
      )
    );
  return customRoles;
}

/**
 * Get all default roles.
 * @returns {Promise<RoleTemplate[]>} The default roles.
 */
export async function getRoleTemplates(): Promise<RoleTemplate[]> {
  const roles = await db.select().from(roleTemplates);
  return roles;
}

'use client';

import { sendActiveTeamSetupNotification } from '@/actions/notifications';
import { useCreateActiveTeam } from '@/hooks/use-teams';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { TeamInheritanceType, type TeamTemplate } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/textarea';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { z } from 'zod';

const formSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(3, 'Name must be at least 3 characters long'),
  description: z
    .string()
    .min(10, 'Description must be at least 10 characters long')
    .optional()
});

export type AddTemplateFormValues = z.infer<typeof formSchema>;

type AddTemplateFormProps = {
  adminIds: (string | bigint)[];
  onCancel: () => void;
  onSuccess: () => void;
  organizationId: string | bigint;
  template: TeamTemplate;
  userId: string | bigint;
} & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLFormElement>;

export function AddTemplateForm({
  adminIds,
  template,
  userId,
  organizationId,
  onSuccess,
  onCancel,
  className
}: Readonly<AddTemplateFormProps>) {
  const form = useForm<AddTemplateFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(formSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      name: template.name,
      description: template.description || ''
    },
    mode: 'onBlur',
    reValidateMode: 'onBlur'
  });

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const createActiveTeam = useCreateActiveTeam();

  const onSubmit = async (values: AddTemplateFormValues) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const resultTeam = await createActiveTeam.mutateAsync({
        data: {
          organizationId:
            typeof organizationId === 'string'
              ? BigInt(organizationId)
              : organizationId,
          name: values.name,
          description: values.description,
          teamTemplateId: template.id,
          inheritedFrom: TeamInheritanceType.TEAM_TEMPLATE,
          customTeamId: null,
          isArchived: false
        },
        creatorId: userId.toString()
      });

      await sendActiveTeamSetupNotification({
        organizationId,
        teamId: resultTeam.id,
        teamName: values.name,
        adminIds,
        creatorId: userId
      });

      toast.success(
        `Team ${values.name} has been created from template ${template.name}.`
      );

      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['activeTeams'] });
      if (onSuccess) {
        onSuccess();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to create team', error);
      toast.error(
        `Failed to create team: ${
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
        }`
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form
        className={cn('space-y-4', className)}
        onBlur={() => form.trigger()}
        onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
      >
        <div className='space-y-4'>
          <FormField
            control={form.control}
            name='name'
            render={({ field }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>Team Name</FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Input placeholder='Enter team name' {...field} />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />

          <FormField
            control={form.control}
            name='description'
            render={({ field }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Textarea
                    className='resize-none'
                    placeholder='Enter team description'
                    rows={3}
                    {...field}
                  />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
        </div>

        <div className='flex items-center justify-end gap-2'>
          <Button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
              form.reset();
              onCancel();
            }}
            variant='outline'
          >
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
            disabled={
              loading || !form.formState.isValid || form.formState.isSubmitting
            }
            type='submit'
          >
            {(form.formState.isSubmitting || loading) && (
              <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin' />
            )}
            {form.formState.isSubmitting || loading
              ? 'Creating Team...'
              : 'Create Team'}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./components/form/date-time-picker.tsx ===

'use client';

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { Calendar } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/calendar';
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/popover';
import {
  ScrollArea,
  ScrollBar
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/scroll-area';
import { format } from 'date-fns';
import { CalendarIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import * as React from 'react';

type DateTimePickerProps = {
  field: {
    onChange: (value: string) => void;
    value: string;
  };
};

export function DateTimePicker({ field }: Readonly<DateTimePickerProps>) {
  const [date, setDate] = React.useState<Date>(
    field.value ? new Date(field.value) : new Date()
  );
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = React.useState(false);

  const hours = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => i + 1);

  const handleDateSelect = (selectedDate: Date | undefined) => {
    if (selectedDate) {
      const newDate = new Date(date);
      newDate.setFullYear(selectedDate.getFullYear());
      newDate.setMonth(selectedDate.getMonth());
      newDate.setDate(selectedDate.getDate());
      setDate(newDate);
      field.onChange(newDate.toISOString());
    }
  };

  const handleTimeChange = (
    type: 'hour' | 'minute' | 'ampm',
    value: string
  ) => {
    const newDate = new Date(date);
    if (type === 'hour') {
      newDate.setHours(
        (parseInt(value) % 12) + (newDate.getHours() >= 12 ? 12 : 0)
      );
    } else if (type === 'minute') {
      newDate.setMinutes(parseInt(value));
    } else if (type === 'ampm') {
      const currentHours = newDate.getHours();
      const isPM = value === 'PM';
      if (isPM && currentHours < 12) {
        newDate.setHours(currentHours + 12);
      } else if (!isPM && currentHours >= 12) {
        newDate.setHours(currentHours - 12);
      }
    }
    setDate(newDate);
    field.onChange(newDate.toISOString());
  };

  return (
    <Popover onOpenChange={setIsOpen} open={isOpen}>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          className={cn(
            'w-full justify-start text-left font-normal',
            !date && 'text-muted-foreground'
          )}
          variant='outline'
        >
          <CalendarIcon className='mr-2 size-4' />
          {date ? (
            format(date, 'MM/dd/yyyy hh:mm aa')
          ) : (
            <span>MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm aa</span>
          )}
        </Button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent className='w-auto p-0'>
        <div className='sm:flex'>
          <Calendar
            initialFocus
            mode='single'
            onSelect={handleDateSelect}
            selected={date}
          />
          <div className='flex flex-col divide-y sm:h-[300px] sm:flex-row sm:divide-x sm:divide-y-0'>
            <ScrollArea className='w-64 sm:w-auto'>
              <div className='flex p-2 sm:flex-col'>
                {hours.map((hour) => (
                  <Button
                    className='aspect-square shrink-0 sm:w-full'
                    key={hour}
                    onClick={() => handleTimeChange('hour', hour.toString())}
                    size='icon'
                    variant={
                      date && date.getHours() % 12 === hour % 12
                        ? 'default'
                        : 'ghost'
                    }
                  >
                    {hour}
                  </Button>
                ))}
              </div>
              <ScrollBar className='sm:hidden' orientation='horizontal' />
            </ScrollArea>
            <ScrollArea className='w-64 sm:w-auto'>
              <div className='flex p-2 sm:flex-col'>
                {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => i * 5).map((minute) => (
                  <Button
                    className='aspect-square shrink-0 sm:w-full'
                    key={minute}
                    onClick={() =>
                      handleTimeChange('minute', minute.toString())
                    }
                    size='icon'
                    variant={
                      date && date.getMinutes() === minute ? 'default' : 'ghost'
                    }
                  >
                    {minute.toString().padStart(2, '0')}
                  </Button>
                ))}
              </div>
              <ScrollBar className='sm:hidden' orientation='horizontal' />
            </ScrollArea>
            <ScrollArea>
              <div className='flex p-2 sm:flex-col'>
                {['AM', 'PM'].map((ampm) => (
                  <Button
                    className='aspect-square shrink-0 sm:w-full'
                    key={ampm}
                    onClick={() => handleTimeChange('ampm', ampm)}
                    size='icon'
                    variant={
                      date &&
                      ((ampm === 'AM' && date.getHours() < 12) ||
                        (ampm === 'PM' && date.getHours() >= 12))
                        ? 'default'
                        : 'ghost'
                    }
                  >
                    {ampm}
                  </Button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </ScrollArea>
          </div>
        </div>
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  );
}
