'use server';

import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import {
  eventsPS,
  provenanceEventMappingPS,
  provenanceRecordsPS
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/provenance/schema';
import { and, eq, inArray } from '@signvault/db/drizzle';
import type {
  ProvenanceRecords,
  Events,
  CustomProvenanceQueryCS
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { customProvenanceQueriesCS } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/schema';
import { toBigInt } from '@signvault/db/utils';

export const getProvenanceRecords = async ({
  userId
}: {
  userId: string;
}): Promise<ProvenanceRecords[]> => {
  const userIdBigInt = toBigInt(userId);
  return await db
    .select()
    .from(provenanceRecordsPS)
    .where(eq(provenanceRecordsPS.userId, userIdBigInt));
};

export const getProvenanceRecordsByOrganizationId = async ({
  organizationId
}: {
  organizationId: string;
}): Promise<ProvenanceRecords[]> => {
  return await db
    .select()
    .from(provenanceRecordsPS)
    .where(eq(provenanceRecordsPS.organizationId, toBigInt(organizationId)));
};

export const getProvenanceEventsByOrganizationId = async ({
  organizationId
}: {
  organizationId: string;
}): Promise<Events[]> => {
  if (!organizationId || organizationId === 'null') return [];
  return await db
    .select()
    .from(eventsPS)
    .where(eq(eventsPS.organizationId, toBigInt(organizationId)));
};

export const getProvenanceQueriesByOrganizationId = async ({
  organizationId
}: {
  organizationId: string;
}): Promise<CustomProvenanceQueryCS[]> => {
  return await db
    .select()
    .from(customProvenanceQueriesCS)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(customProvenanceQueriesCS.organizationId, toBigInt(organizationId)),
        eq(customProvenanceQueriesCS.isDeleted, false)
      )
    )
    .orderBy(customProvenanceQueriesCS.createdAt);
};

/**
 * Get events for a specific provenance record with organization security validation
 */
export const getEventsByRecordId = async ({
  recordId,
  organizationId
}: {
  recordId: string;
  organizationId: string;
}): Promise<Events[]> => {
  if (!recordId || !organizationId) return [];

  // First validate that the record belongs to the organization
  const record = await db.query.provenanceRecordsPS.findFirst({
    where: (provenanceRecordsPS, { eq, and }) =>
      and(
        eq(provenanceRecordsPS.id, toBigInt(recordId)),
        eq(provenanceRecordsPS.organizationId, toBigInt(organizationId))
      )
  });

  if (!record) {
    throw new Error('Record not found or access denied');
  }

  // Get event IDs associated with this provenance record from the mapping table
  const eventMappings = await db
    .select()
    .from(provenanceEventMappingPS)
    .where(eq(provenanceEventMappingPS.provenanceId, toBigInt(recordId)));

  if (!eventMappings.length) {
    return [];
  }

  // Extract event IDs from the mappings
  const eventIds = eventMappings.map((mapping) => mapping.eventId);

  // Get the actual events using the mapped event IDs
  const events = await db
    .select()
    .from(eventsPS)
    .where(inArray(eventsPS.id, eventIds));

  return events;
};

/**
 * Get all events for all records in an organization (for trail view)
 */
export const getAllEventsWithRecords = async ({
  organizationId
}: {
  organizationId: string;
}): Promise<{ events: Events[]; records: ProvenanceRecords[] }> => {
  if (!organizationId || organizationId === 'null') {
    return { events: [], records: [] };
  }

  // First, retrieve all provenance records for the organization
  const records = await db
    .select()
    .from(provenanceRecordsPS)
    .where(eq(provenanceRecordsPS.organizationId, toBigInt(organizationId)));

  if (records.length === 0) {
    return { events: [], records: [] };
  }

  // Extract provenance record IDs
  const recordIds = records.map((r) => r.id);

  // Get mapping rows that link the provenance records to events
  const mappings = await db
    .select()
    .from(provenanceEventMappingPS)
    .where(inArray(provenanceEventMappingPS.provenanceId, recordIds));

  if (mappings.length === 0) {
    return { events: [], records };
  }

  // Extract unique event IDs
  const eventIds = Array.from(new Set(mappings.map((m) => m.eventId)));

  // Fetch the actual events using the mapped IDs
  const events = await db
    .select()
    .from(eventsPS)
    .where(inArray(eventsPS.id, eventIds));

  return { events, records };
};

/**
 * Validate record access for a user and organization
 */
export const validateRecordAccess = async ({
  recordId,
  organizationId
}: {
  recordId: string;
  organizationId: string;
}): Promise<boolean> => {
  if (!recordId || !organizationId) return false;
  // console.log(
  //   '[validateRecordAccess] Validating record access for recordId:',
  //   recordId,
  //   'and organizationId:',
  //   organizationId
  // );
  const record = await db.query.provenanceRecordsPS.findFirst({
    where: (provenanceRecordsPS, { eq, and }) =>
      and(
        eq(provenanceRecordsPS.id, toBigInt(recordId)),
        eq(provenanceRecordsPS.organizationId, toBigInt(organizationId))
      )
  });

  // console.log(
  //   '[validateRecordAccess] Record access validation result:',
  //   record
  // );

  return !!record;
};

export const toMutableWorkflow = (workflow: typeof defaultWorkflow) => {
  const { tasks, settings, ...rest } = workflow;
  return {
    ...rest,
    tasks: tasks.map((task) => {
      const { deadline, dependencies, ...taskRest } = task;
      return {
        ...taskRest,
        deadline: {
          ...deadline
        },
        dependencies: [...dependencies]
      };
    }),
    settings: {
      ...settings,
      escalation: settings.escalation
        ? {
            ...settings.escalation,
            to: [...settings.escalation.to]
          }
        : undefined
    }
  };

/**
 * Get custom teams for an organization
 * @param organizationId - The ID of the organization
 * @returns The custom teams with members
 */
export async function getCustomTeams(
  organizationId: string
): Promise<GetCustomTeamsForOrganizationResponse> {
  const teams = await getCustomTeamsByOrganization(organizationId);
  return {
    teams,
    message: 'Custom teams retrieved successfully'
  };
}

/**
 * Create a new custom team
 * @param data - The custom team data
 * @returns The created custom team
 */
export async function createCustomTeam(
  data: Omit<CustomTeamCS, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt' | 'isArchived'>,
  creatorId: string
): Promise<CreateCustomTeamResponse> {
  const result = await createCustomTeamDb(data);

  // Create tracked team record
  await createTrackedTeam({
    organizationId: data.organizationId,
    inheritedFrom: TeamInheritanceType.CUSTOM_TEAM,
    teamId: result.customTeam.id,
    creatorId: BigInt(creatorId),
    status: 'ACTIVE',
    templateId: null
  });

  // --- Provenance Tracking ---
  await execute(print(CreateTeamDocument), {
    input: {
      teamId: result.customTeam?.id.toString() ?? '',
      teamName: result.customTeam?.name ?? '',
      description: result.customTeam?.description ?? '',
      createdFromTemplate: true,
      teamType: 'CUSTOM' as unknown as TeamTemplate
    },
    organizationId: data.organizationId.toString(),
    userId: creatorId
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log create custom team event');
  });

  // Provenance: create audit log entry

  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.TEAM_CREATED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.TEAM_MANAGEMENT,
    description: `Custom team ${result.customTeam?.name} created by ${creatorId}`,
    entityId: result.customTeam?.id.toString() ?? '',
    entityType: 'CUSTOM_TEAM',
    entityName: result.customTeam?.name ?? '',
    teamId: result.customTeam?.id.toString() ?? '',
    targetUserId: creatorId.toString(),
    success: true
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[AUDIT LOGS] Failed to log create custom team event');
  });

  return {
    message: 'Custom team created successfully',
    team: result.customTeam
  };
}

/**

 */
export async function updateCustomTeamData(
  id: string,
  data: Partial<CustomTeamWithMembersCS>,
  actorUserId: string | bigint
): Promise<UpdateCustomTeamResponse> {
  const result = await updateCustomTeam(id, data);

  await updateTrackedTeamFromSource(id, {
    status: data.status as EntityStatusPSType
  });

  await execute(print(EnqueueTeamEdited), {
    input: {
      actorUserId: actorUserId.toString(),
      changes: data,
      organizationId: data.organizationId.toString(),
      teamId: id,
      teamName: data.name
    }
  } as MutationRootEnqueueTeamEditedArgs).catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    console.log('[PROVENANCE] Failed to log update custom team event');
  });

  // Provenance: create audit log entry
  await createAuditLogEntry({
    action: AuditLogAction.TEAM_UPDATED,
    category: AuditLogCategory.TEAM_MANAGEMENT,
    description: `Custom team ${result.customTeam?.name} updated by ${actorUserId}`,

    teamId: result.customTeam?.id.toString() ?? '',

    beforeState: result.customTeam as NestedRecord,
    afterState: result.customTeam as NestedRecord,
    success: true
  }).catch((error) => {

function DesignerComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  return (
    <div className='flex w-full flex-col gap-2'>
      <Label>{element.label}</Label>
      <Input readOnly disabled placeholder={element.placeholder} />

function FormComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  return <div>{element.label}</div>;
}

const propertiesSchema = z.object({
  label: z.string().min(2).max(50),
  description: z.string().max(100),
  placeholder: z.string().max(50),
  required: z.boolean().default(false)
});

type PropertiesFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof propertiesSchema>;

function PropertiesComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  const { updateElement } = useFormBuilderStore();
  const form = useForm<PropertiesFormSchemaType>({
    resolver: zodResolver(propertiesSchema),
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      label: element.label,
      description: element.description,
      placeholder: element.placeholder,
      required: element.required
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    form.reset(element);
  }, [element, form]);

  const applyChanges = (values: PropertiesFormSchemaType) => {
    updateElement(element.id, { ...element, ...values });
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form
        onBlur={form.handleSubmit(applyChanges)}
        onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        className='space-y-1'
      >
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='label'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Label</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  {...field}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                      e.currentTarget.blur();
                    }
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='placeholder'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Placeholder</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  {...field}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                      e.currentTarget.blur();
                    }
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='description'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  {...field}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                      e.currentTarget.blur();
                    }
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>
                A short description to help the user.
              </FormDescription>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='required'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem className='shadow-xs flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border'>
              <div className='space-y-0.5'>
                <FormLabel>Required</FormLabel>
                <FormDescription>
                  Is this field required to be filled out?
                </FormDescription>
              </div>
              <FormControl>
                <Switch
                  checked={field.value}
                  onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                />
              </FormControl>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./components/calendar/body/week/calendar-body-week-full-day-events.tsx ===

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { differenceInDays, format, startOfWeek } from 'date-fns';
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';

import type { CalendarEvent } from '../../calendar-types';

import { useCalendarContext } from '../../calendar-context';

export default function CalendarBodyWeekFullDayEvents() {
  const { date, events, setTopOffset } = useCalendarContext();
  const weekStart = startOfWeek(date, { weekStartsOn: 1 });

  // Filter full-day and full-week events
  const fullDayEvents = events?.filter((event) => {
    const startDate = new Date(event.startDate);
    const endDate = new Date(event.endDate);

    // Check if dates are at start/end of their respective days
    const isStartOfDay =
      startDate.getHours() === 0 && startDate.getMinutes() === 0;
    const isEndOfDay = endDate.getHours() === 0 && endDate.getMinutes() === 0;

    // Calculate duration in days
    const diffInDays = differenceInDays(endDate, startDate) + 1;

    return (
      // Check if it's a full-day event (1-3 days) or a full-week event (7 days)
      ((diffInDays >= 1 && diffInDays <= 3) || diffInDays === 7) &&
      // And starts at beginning of day and ends at beginning of day
      isStartOfDay &&
      isEndOfDay
    );
  });

  // Sort events by start date first, then by duration
  const sortedEvents = [...(fullDayEvents || [])].sort((a, b) => {
    const startA = new Date(a.startDate);
    const startB = new Date(b.startDate);
    if (startA.getTime() !== startB.getTime()) {
      return startA.getTime() - startB.getTime();
    }
    return (
      differenceInDays(new Date(b.endDate), new Date(b.startDate)) -
      differenceInDays(new Date(a.endDate), new Date(a.startDate))
    );
  });

  // Assign rows to events based on overlap
  const eventRows = React.useMemo(() => {
    const rows: { event: CalendarEvent; row: number }[] = [];
    sortedEvents?.forEach((event) => {
      const eventStart = new Date(event.startDate);
      const eventEnd = new Date(event.endDate);

      // Find the first available row where this event doesn't overlap
      let row = 0;
      let foundRow = false;

      while (!foundRow) {
        const eventsInRow = rows.filter((e) => e.row === row);
        const hasOverlap = eventsInRow.some((e) => {
          const rowEventStart = new Date(e.event.startDate);
          const rowEventEnd = new Date(e.event.endDate);
          return !(eventEnd < rowEventStart || eventStart > rowEventEnd);
        });

        if (!hasOverlap) {
          foundRow = true;
        } else {
          row++;
        }
      }

      rows.push({ event, row });
    });
    return rows;
  }, [sortedEvents]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Calculate max row number + 1 for the offset
    const maxRow = Math.max(...(eventRows?.map((e) => e.row) || []), 0);
    setTopOffset((maxRow + 1) * 48);
  }, [eventRows, setTopOffset]);

  if (sortedEvents?.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className='flex flex-col'>
      {eventRows?.map(({ event, row }) => (
        <FullDayEventRow
          event={event}
          index={row}
          key={event.id}
          weekStart={weekStart}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function FullDayEventRow({
  event,
  weekStart,
  index
}: Readonly<{
  event: CalendarEvent;
  index: number;
  weekStart: Date;
}>) {
  const { setSelectedEvent, setManageEventDialogOpen } = useCalendarContext();
  const startDate = new Date(event.startDate);
  const endDate = new Date(event.endDate);
  const startDayOffset = differenceInDays(startDate, weekStart);

  // Calculate how many days of the event fall within this week
  const weekEnd = new Date(weekStart);
  weekEnd.setDate(weekEnd.getDate() + 6);
  const eventEndInWeek = endDate > weekEnd ? weekEnd : endDate;
  const eventStartInWeek = startDate < weekStart ? weekStart : startDate;
  const daysInWeek = differenceInDays(eventEndInWeek, eventStartInWeek) + 1;

  const width = `${(daysInWeek / 7) * 100}%`;
  const left = `${(startDayOffset / 7) * 100}%`;
  const top = `${index * 48}px`;

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        'absolute z-20 flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-start gap-0 rounded-md bg-white px-3 py-1.5 hover:opacity-90',
        `border border-${event.color}-500`
      )}
      onClick={() => {
        setSelectedEvent(event);
        setManageEventDialogOpen(true);
      }}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.stopPropagation();
          setSelectedEvent(event);
          setManageEventDialogOpen(true);
        }
      }}
      role='button'
      style={{ width, left, top }}
      tabIndex={0}
    >
      <p
        className={cn(
          'flex-1 truncate text-xs font-bold',
          `text-${event.color}-700`
        )}
      >
        {event.title}
      </p>
      <p
        className={cn(
          'whitespace-nowrap text-xs text-muted-foreground',
          `text-${event.color}-700`
        )}
      >
        {format(startDate, 'MMM d')} - {format(endDate, 'MMM d')}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./lib/api.ts ===

import ky, { type HTTPError } from 'ky';

import { clientLogger } from './client-logger';

// @ts-expect-error - This is a polyfill for BigInt
BigInt.prototype.toJSON = function () {
  return this.toString();
};

/**
 * Base API configuration for making requests to the backend
 */
const createKyInstance = (
  cookieString: string,
  organizationId?: string,
  options?: {
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
    searchParams?: Record<string, string> | URLSearchParams;
  }
) => {
  return ky.create({
    prefixUrl: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL,
    cache: 'no-store',
    timeout: 10000, // 10 seconds
    retry: {
      limit: 2,
      methods: ['get', 'put', 'post', 'delete'],
      statusCodes: [408, 413, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504]
    },
    headers: {
      ...options?.headers,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'cookie-string': cookieString,
      'cookie': cookieString
    },
    searchParams: organizationId
      ? new URLSearchParams({
          ...(options?.searchParams instanceof URLSearchParams
            ? Object.fromEntries(options.searchParams.entries())
            : options?.searchParams),
          organizationId: organizationId
        })
      : undefined,
    hooks: {
      beforeRequest: [
        (request) => {
          if (cookieString) {
            request.headers.set('cookie', cookieString);
            request.headers.set('cookie-string', cookieString);
          }
        }
      ],
      beforeError: [
        async (error: HTTPError) => {
          const { response, message, request } = error;
          const errorMessage = `API request failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`;
          try {
            const errorBody = await response.json();
            clientLogger.error(
              errorMessage,
              {
                message,
                requestUrl: request.url,
                requestMethod: request.method,
                requestHeaders: Object.fromEntries(request.headers.entries()),
                status: response.status,
                statusText: response.statusText,
                responseUrl: response.url,
                responseMethod: response.type,
                responseHeaders: Object.fromEntries(response.headers.entries()),
                responseBody: errorBody
              },
              'backend-api'
            );
          } catch {
            // If response body cannot be parsed as JSON
            clientLogger.error(
              errorMessage,
              {
                message,
                requestUrl: request.url,
                requestMethod: request.method,
                requestHeaders: Object.fromEntries(request.headers.entries()),
                status: response.status,
                statusText: response.statusText,
                responseUrl: response.url,
                responseMethod: response.type,
                responseHeaders: Object.fromEntries(response.headers.entries())
              },
              'backend-api'
            );
          }
          // Return the original error
          return error;
        }
      ]
    }
  });
};

export const api = {
  get: async <T>(
    url: string,
    cookieString: string,
    organizationId?: string,
    options?: {
      headers?: Record<string, string>;
      searchParams?: Record<string, string>;
    }
  ) => {
    const instance = createKyInstance(cookieString, organizationId, options);
    return instance.get(url).json<T>();
  },

  post: async <T>(
    url: string,
    data: Record<string, unknown>,
    cookieString: string,
    organizationId?: string,
    options?: {
      headers?: Record<string, string>;
      searchParams?: Record<string, string>;
    }
  ) => {
    const instance = createKyInstance(cookieString, organizationId, options);
    return instance
      .post(url, {
        json: data
      })
      .json<T>();
  },

  patch: async <T>(
    url: string,
    data: Record<string, unknown>,
    cookieString: string,
    organizationId?: string,
    options?: {
      headers?: Record<string, string>;
      searchParams?: Record<string, string>;
    }
  ) => {
    const instance = createKyInstance(cookieString, organizationId, options);
    return instance
      .patch(url, {
        json: data
      })
      .json<T>();
  },

  put: async <T>(
    url: string,
    data: Record<string, unknown>,
    cookieString: string,
    organizationId?: string,
    options?: {
      headers?: Record<string, string>;
      searchParams?: Record<string, string>;
    }
  ) => {
    const instance = createKyInstance(cookieString, organizationId, options);
    return instance
      .put(url, {
        json: data
      })
      .json<T>();
  },

  delete: async <T>(
    url: string,
    cookieString: string,
    organizationId?: string,
    options?: {
      headers?: Record<string, string>;
      searchParams?: Record<string, string>;
    }
  ) => {
    const instance = createKyInstance(cookieString, organizationId, options);
    return instance.delete(url).json<T>();
  }
};

'use client';

import { NotificationItem } from '@/components/notifications/notification-item';
import { useNotifications } from '@/contexts/notifications-context';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { ScrollArea } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/scroll-area';
import { ChevronDown, ListCheck, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';

export function NotificationList() {
  const { notifications, unreadCount, markAllAsRead } = useNotifications();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showPreviousNotifications, setShowPreviousNotifications] =
    useState(false);
  const [optimisticNotifications, setOptimisticNotifications] =
    useState(notifications);

  useEffect(() => {
    setOptimisticNotifications(notifications);
  }, [notifications]);

  const handleMarkAllAsRead = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      // Optimistically update the notifications
      setOptimisticNotifications((prev) =>
        prev.map((n) => ({ ...n, readAt: new Date() }))
      );
      await markAllAsRead();
      toast.success('All notifications marked as read.');
    } catch (error) {
      setOptimisticNotifications(notifications);
      toast.error(
        `Failed to mark all as read: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : (String(error) ?? 'Unknown error')}`
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const unreadNotifications = optimisticNotifications.filter((n) => !n.readAt);
  const readNotifications = optimisticNotifications.filter((n) => n.readAt);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className='flex h-32 items-center justify-center'>
        <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (unreadCount === 0) {
    return (
      <div className='flex flex-col'>
        <div className='flex flex-col items-center justify-center border-b p-8'>
          <Image alt='Tada' height={64} src='/tada.svg' width={64} />
          <h4 className='mt-2 text-lg font-medium'>You're all caught up!</h4>
          <p className='text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
            No new notifications to review
          </p>
        </div>
        {readNotifications.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <Button
              className='flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 p-4'
              onClick={() =>
                setShowPreviousNotifications(!showPreviousNotifications)
              }
              variant='ghost'
            >
              <span className='text-sm'>View previous notifications</span>
              <ChevronDown
                className={cn(
                  'h-4 w-4 transition-transform',
                  showPreviousNotifications && 'rotate-180 transform'
                )}
              />
            </Button>
            {showPreviousNotifications && (
              <div className='scrollbar-hide h-[calc(100vh-20rem)] overflow-y-auto sm:h-[350px]'>
                {readNotifications.map((notification) => (
                  <NotificationItem
                    key={notification.id.toString()}
                    notification={notification}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className='flex flex-col'>
      <div className='flex items-center justify-between border-b p-4'>
        <h4 className='text-sm font-medium'>Notifications</h4>
        {unreadCount > 0 && (
          <Button
            className='mr-2'
            onClick={handleMarkAllAsRead}
            size='sm'
            title='Mark all notifications as read'
            variant='ghost'
          >
            <ListCheck className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
      <ScrollArea className='h-[calc(100vh-10rem)] sm:h-[450px]'>
        <div className='flex flex-col'>
          {unreadNotifications.length > 0 && (
            <div className='flex flex-col'>
              {unreadNotifications.map((notification) => (
                <NotificationItem
                  key={notification.id.toString()}
                  notification={notification}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {readNotifications.length > 0 && (
            <div className='flex flex-col'>
              <div className='border-y bg-muted/50 p-2'>
                <span className='px-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground'>
                  Previous Notifications
                </span>
              </div>
              {readNotifications.map((notification) => (
                <NotificationItem
                  key={notification.id.toString()}
                  notification={notification}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </ScrollArea>
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./components/form-builder/fields/number-field.tsx ===

'use client';

import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { useFormBuilderStore } from '@signvault/frontend/components/form-builder/store-provider';
import type { FormElement, FormElementInstance } from '../types';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Switch } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/switch';
import { Hash } from 'lucide-react';
import { Label } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/label';

function DesignerComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  return (
    <div className='flex w-full flex-col gap-2'>
      <Label>
        {element.label}
        {element.required && <span className='text-red-500'>*</span>}
      </Label>
      <Input
        type='number'
        readOnly
        disabled
        placeholder={element.placeholder}
      />
      {element.description && (
        <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>{element.description}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function FormComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  // This will be the actual component rendered in the final form
  return <div>{element.label}</div>;
}

const propertiesSchema = z.object({
  label: z.string().min(2).max(50),
  description: z.string().max(100),
  placeholder: z.string().max(50),
  required: z.boolean().default(false)
});

type PropertiesFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof propertiesSchema>;

function PropertiesComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  const { updateElement } = useFormBuilderStore();
  const form = useForm<PropertiesFormSchemaType>({
    resolver: zodResolver(propertiesSchema),
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      label: element.label,
      description: element.description,
      placeholder: element.placeholder,
      required: element.required
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    form.reset(element);
  }, [element, form]);

  const applyChanges = (values: PropertiesFormSchemaType) => {
    updateElement(element.id, { ...element, ...values });
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form
        onBlur={form.handleSubmit(applyChanges)}
        onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        className='space-y-3'
      >
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='label'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Label</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  {...field}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur();
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='placeholder'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Placeholder</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  {...field}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur();
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='description'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  {...field}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur();
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>
                A short description to help the user.
              </FormDescription>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='required'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem className='shadow-xs flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-3'>
              <div className='space-y-0.5'>
                <FormLabel>Required</FormLabel>
              </div>
              <FormControl>
                <Switch
                  checked={field.value}
                  onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                />
              </FormControl>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
}

const NumberField: FormElement = {
  type: 'number',
  construct: () => ({
    type: 'number',
    label: '',
    required: false,
    placeholder: '0',
    description: ''
  }),
  designerButtonElement: {
    icon: Hash,
    label: 'Number'
  },
  designerComponent: DesignerComponent,
  propertiesComponent: PropertiesComponent,
  formComponent: FormComponent
};

export default NumberField;

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/create-organization/create-organization-form.tsx ===

'use client';

import type { State } from '@formity/react';
import type {
  UserCS,
  LinkedInData,
  NaicsCodePublic,
  TeamTemplate
} from '@signvault/db/types';

import { Formity } from '@formity/react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCallback } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';

import type {
  OrganizationCreationFormValues,
  OrganizationCreationFormValuesCallback
} from './types';

import { getSchema, type Values } from './schema';
import { verifyMemberConfiguration } from './utils';
import type { OrganizationCreationResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/v2/organization-creation';
import { getStatusRedirect } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function CreateOrganizationForm({
  cookieString,
  user,
  teamTemplates,
  naicsCodes
}: Readonly<{
  cookieString: string;
  naicsCodes: NaicsCodePublic[];
  teamTemplates: TeamTemplate[];
  user: UserCS;
}>) {
  const schema = getSchema(user, teamTemplates, naicsCodes);
  const router = useRouter();

  const onReturn = useCallback<OrganizationCreationFormValuesCallback>(
    async (formValues) => {
      // Verify member configuration before proceeding
      const result = await verifyMemberConfiguration(formValues.invites);

      if (!result.success) {
        toast.error('Please fix member configuration issues before proceeding');
        return;
      }

      // Proceed with organization creation
      const success = await createOrganization(formValues, user, cookieString);

      if (!success) {
        toast.error('Failed to create organization');
        return;
      }

      const teamsCount = formValues.teams.length;
      const usersCount = formValues.invites.length;

      const teamPlural = teamsCount === 1 ? 'team' : 'teams';
      const teamVerb = teamsCount === 1 ? 'has' : 'have';

      const userPlural = usersCount === 1 ? 'user' : 'users';
      const userVerb = usersCount === 1 ? 'has' : 'have';

      router.push(
        getStatusRedirect(
          `/account/dashboard`,
          'Organization created successfully',
          `Organization ${formValues.organization.name} has been created successfully. ` +
            `${teamsCount} ${teamPlural} ${teamVerb} been created and ` +
            `${usersCount} ${userPlural} ${userVerb} been invited`
        )
      );
    },
    [router, user]
  );

  return (
    <Formity<Values>
      initialState={getInitialState()}
      inputs={{
        user: {
          email: user.primaryEmail,
          fullName: user.name,
          username: user.username,
          phone: `+${user.primaryPhone}`,
          socialMedia: (
            (user.customData as Record<string, unknown>)
              ?.linkedin as LinkedInData
          )?.verified
            ? 'linkedin'
            : 'twitter'
        }
      }}
      onReturn={onReturn}
      schema={schema}
    />
  );
}

async function createOrganization(
  values: OrganizationCreationFormValues,
  user: UserCS,
  cookieString: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  // 1. Get the organization creation token and set the default headers for all further request
  const tokenResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/organization-creation/token`,
    {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  if (!tokenResponse.ok) {
    console.error('Failed to get creation token: ', tokenResponse);
    toast.error('Failed to get creation token');
    return false;
  }

  const { token } = await tokenResponse.json();

  // Add token to all organization creation requests
  const headers = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'x-organization-creation-token': token,
    'cookie': cookieString,
    'cookie-string': cookieString
  };

  // Call POST `/api/organization-creation` with the form values
  const organizationCreationResponse: OrganizationCreationResponse =
    await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/organization-creation`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...values,
          user: {
            ...values.user,
            id: user.id
          }
        })
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (
    organizationCreationResponse.message !== 'Organization created successfully'
  ) {
    console.error(
      'Failed to create organization: ',
      organizationCreationResponse
    );
    toast.error(
      `Failed to create organization: ${organizationCreationResponse.message}`
    );
    return false;
  }

  return true;
}

// Disabling local storage state saving for now
function getInitialState(): State | undefined {
  // if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window?.localStorage) return undefined;
  // const state = localStorage.getItem('create-organization-form-state');
  // if (state) return JSON.parse(state);
  return undefined;
}

import type { GetBlogsResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/blogs';
import type { Blog } from '@signvault/db/types';

import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import FilledCircle from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/filled-circle';
import { formatDate } from 'date-fns';
import { type Metadata } from 'next';
import Link from 'next/link';
import React from 'react';

export const revalidate = 60;

export default async function BlogsPage() {
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'blogs');

  try {
    logger.info('Fetching blog posts');
    const response = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/blogs`
    );
    const blogPostsResponse: GetBlogsResponse = await response.json();
    const blogs = blogPostsResponse.blogs;
    if (!blogs.database) {
      return (
        <div className='flex min-h-[400px] w-full items-center justify-center'>
          <div className='text-xl text-destructive'>
            Error loading blog posts
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }
    const blogPosts = blogs.database;

    return (
      <div className='w-full border-b border-line bg-transparent'>
        <div className='relative mx-4 max-w-5xl border-x border-line px-4 py-16 sm:px-6 md:mx-auto lg:px-8'>
          <FilledCircle className='absolute bottom-0 right-0 block translate-x-1/2 translate-y-1/2 xs:block sm:block md:hidden lg:hidden xl:block' />
          <FilledCircle className='absolute bottom-0 left-0 -translate-x-1/2 translate-y-1/2' />
          <h1 className='mb-1 mt-8 font-signvault text-3xl font-bold md:text-4xl'>
            SignVault Blog
          </h1>
          <p className='mb-24 text-base text-foreground/70 md:text-lg'>
            Stay up to date with the latest news and updates from SignVault.
          </p>
          <div className='grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3'>
            {blogPosts.map((post: Blog) => (
              <Link
                className='block'
                href={`/blogs/${post.slug}`}
                key={post.slug}
              >
                <div className='overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-line transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:border-primary hover:bg-white dark:hover:border-secondary dark:hover:bg-secondary'>
                  <img
                    alt={post.title}
                    className='h-48 w-full object-cover'
                    height={200}
                    src={post.image ?? '/icon.svg'}
                    width={400}
                  />
                  <div className='p-4'>
                    <h2 className='mb-2 text-xl font-semibold'>{post.title}</h2>
                    <p className='mb-4 line-clamp-3 text-foreground/70'>
                      {post.description}
                    </p>
                    <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
                      <div className='flex items-center'>
                        <img
                          alt={post.authorName}
                          className='mr-2 rounded-full'
                          height={32}
                          src={post.authorAvatar ?? '/icon.svg'}
                          width={32}
                        />
                        <span className='text-sm font-medium'>
                          {post.authorName}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <span className='text-sm text-foreground/50'>
                        {formatDate(new Date(post.date), 'PPP')}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error loading blog posts', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    });
    return (
      <div className='flex min-h-[400px] w-full items-center justify-center'>
        <div className='text-xl text-destructive'>Error loading blog posts</div>
      </div>
    );
  }
}

 * Gets the role key name from the general name.
 * @param name - The general name.
 * @returns The role key name.
 */
export function getRoleKeyNameFromGeneralName(
  name: 'AUTHOR' | 'EDITOR' | 'ADMINISTRATOR' | 'VERIFIED_USER' | 'REGULAR_USER'
): 'L5_USER' | 'L3_USER' | 'L4_USER' | 'L2_USER' | 'L1_USER' {
  switch (name) {
    case 'ADMINISTRATOR':
      return 'L5_USER';
    case 'AUTHOR':
      return 'L3_USER';
    case 'EDITOR':
      return 'L4_USER';
    case 'REGULAR_USER':
      return 'L1_USER';
    case 'VERIFIED_USER':
      return 'L2_USER';
  }
}

  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  if (!dbUser || !dbUser.organizationId) {
    // Or a more user-friendly component
    return <div>You are not part of an organization.</div>;
  }

  const organizationId = dbUser.organizationId;
  const userId = dbUser.id;

  const [
    documents,
    drafts,
    templates,
    provenanceEvents,
    provenanceQueries,
    roles,
    teamsResult
  ] = await Promise.all([
    getDocuments(organizationId),
    getOrganizationDrafts(organizationId, userId),
    getGlobalDocumentTemplates(),
    getProvenanceEventsByOrganizationId({
      organizationId: organizationId.toString()
    }),
    getProvenanceQueriesByOrganizationId({
      organizationId: organizationId.toString()
    }),
    getCustomRoles(organizationId),
    getActiveTeams(organizationId.toString())
  ]);

  const teams = teamsResult.teams ?? [];

  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<AnalyticsSkeleton />}>
      <AnalyticsPageClient
        user={dbUser}
        documents={documents}
        drafts={drafts}
        templates={templates}
        provenanceEvents={provenanceEvents}
        provenanceQueries={provenanceQueries}
        roles={roles}
        teams={teams}
      />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

'use client';

import type { DocumentCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import { cn } from '@signvault/ui-lib/lib/utils';
import {
  FileText,
  MoreVertical,
  Edit3,
  Trash2,
  Send,
  Eye,
  UserCircle
} from 'lucide-react';
import { formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns';
import { Badge } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/badge';
import { useUserData } from '@/contexts/user-data-context';
import { Skeleton } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/skeleton';

type UploadedDocumentCardProps = {
  draft: DocumentCS;
  onEdit: (draft: DocumentCS) => void;
  onDelete: (draftId: bigint) => void;
  onPublish: (draftId: bigint) => void;
  onView: (draft: DocumentCS) => void;
} & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>;

export function DraftCard({
  draft,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onPublish,
  onView,
  className,
  ...props
}: Readonly<UploadedDocumentCardProps>) {
  const { organizationMembers, organizationMembersLoading } = useUserData();
  const owner = organizationMembers?.find(
    (member) => member.id === draft.ownerId
  );

  const displayTitle =
    draft.title || draft.filename?.split('.')[0] || 'Untitled Document';

  const MAX_VISIBLE_TAGS = 3;
  const visibleTags = draft.tags ? draft.tags.slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE_TAGS) : [];
  const extraTagsCount = draft.tags
    ? Math.max(0, draft.tags.length - MAX_VISIBLE_TAGS)
    : 0;

  if (organizationMembersLoading) {
    return <Skeleton className='h-32 w-full rounded-xl' />;
  }

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        'group relative flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <div className='flex items-start justify-between gap-4 p-4'>
        <div className='flex min-w-0 items-start gap-4'>
          <div className='flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 p-2.5'>
            <FileText className='size-5 text-primary' strokeWidth={1.5} />
          </div>
          <div className='min-w-0 flex-1'>
            <h3 className='truncate font-britanica text-lg font-semibold'>
              {displayTitle}
            </h3>
            <p className='line-clamp-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
              {draft.description || 'No description.'}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <DropdownMenu modal={false}>
          <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
            <Button
              variant='ghost'
              size='icon'
              className='size-8 shrink-0 data-[state=open]:bg-muted'
              aria-label='Open menu'
            >
              <MoreVertical className='size-4' />
            </Button>
          </DropdownMenuTrigger>
          <DropdownMenuContent
            align='end'
            className='w-[180px] font-suisse-intl'
          >
            <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => onView(draft)}>
              <Eye className='mr-2 size-4' />
              View
            </DropdownMenuItem>
            <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => onEdit(draft)}>
              <Edit3 className='mr-2 size-4' />
              Edit
            </DropdownMenuItem>
            <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => onPublish(draft.id)}>
              <Send className='mr-2 size-4' />
              Publish
            </DropdownMenuItem>
            <DropdownMenuItem
              onSelect={() => onDelete(draft.id)}
              className='text-destructive focus:bg-destructive/10 focus:text-destructive'
            >
              <Trash2 className='mr-2 size-4' />
              Delete
            </DropdownMenuItem>
          </DropdownMenuContent>
        </DropdownMenu>
      </div>

      {draft.tags && draft.tags.length > 0 ? (
        <div className='p-4 pt-0'>
          <div className='flex flex-wrap gap-2'>
            {visibleTags.map((tag) => (
              <Badge key={tag} variant='light' className='font-normal'>
                {tag}
              </Badge>
            ))}
            {extraTagsCount > 0 && (
              <Badge variant='light' className='font-normal'>
                +{extraTagsCount} more
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className='h-10' />
      )}

      <div className='mt-auto flex items-center justify-between border-t bg-muted/30 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
        <div className='flex items-center gap-1'>
          <UserCircle className='size-3.5' />
          <span>{owner?.name || 'Unknown'}</span>
        </div>
        <span>
          {draft.updatedAt
            ? formatDistanceToNow(new Date(draft.updatedAt), {
                addSuffix: true
              })
            : 'recently'}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { PendingUserCS, UserCS } from '@signvault/db/types';

import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import {
  AccessScope,
  ClearanceSecurityLevel,
  Weekday
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer/enums';
import {
  FunctionPrimaryRole,
  FunctionSpecialization
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';

import { type EditUserFormValues, editUserSchema } from '../types';
import { getDefaultFormValues } from '../utils';

/**
 * Hook for managing pending user form state
 */
export function usePendingUserForm(selectedPendingUser: PendingUserCS | null) {
  const defaultValues = getDefaultFormValues();

  const form = useForm<EditUserFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(editUserSchema),
    defaultValues,
    mode: 'onBlur',
    reValidateMode: 'onBlur'
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedPendingUser) {
      form.reset(defaultValues);
      return;
    }

    const formValues: EditUserFormValues = {
      team: selectedPendingUser.activeTeamId.toString(),
      role: selectedPendingUser.organizationRoleId.toString(),
      attributes: {
        function: {
          primary:
            selectedPendingUser.attributes?.function?.primary ??
            FunctionPrimaryRole.SIGNER,
          specialization:
            selectedPendingUser.attributes?.function?.specialization ??
            FunctionSpecialization.SIGNATURE_CEREMONY
        },
        clearance: {
          level:
            selectedPendingUser.attributes?.clearance?.level ??
            ClearanceSecurityLevel.CONFIDENTIAL,
          scope: selectedPendingUser.attributes?.clearance?.scope ?? [
            AccessScope.VIEW
          ]
        },
        temporalAccess: {
          timezone:
            selectedPendingUser.attributes?.temporalAccess?.timezone ??
            Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone,
          schedule: {
            days: selectedPendingUser.attributes?.temporalAccess?.schedule
              ?.days ?? [
              Weekday.MONDAY,
              Weekday.TUESDAY,
              Weekday.WEDNESDAY,
              Weekday.THURSDAY,
              Weekday.FRIDAY
            ],
            hours: {
              start:
                selectedPendingUser.attributes?.temporalAccess?.schedule?.hours
                  ?.start ?? '09:00',
              end:
                selectedPendingUser.attributes?.temporalAccess?.schedule?.hours
                  ?.end ?? '17:00'
            },
            timeRange:
              selectedPendingUser.attributes?.temporalAccess?.schedule
                ?.timeRange ?? '09:00-17:00'
          }
        }
      }
    };

    form.reset(formValues);
  }, [selectedPendingUser, form, defaultValues]);

  return form;
}

  width: 'device-width',
  initialScale: 1,
  maximumScale: 1,
  minimumScale: 1,

};

export default async function AuditLogsPage({
  searchParams
}: {
  searchParams: { [key: string]: string | string[] | undefined };
}) {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

  const { logId } = await searchParams;

  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  if (!dbUser) {
    redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/',
        'Not Logged In',
        'You must be logged in to access that page.'
      )
    );
  }

  // only allow l7, l6 and l5 users to access audit logs
  const isL7 = AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS.includes(
    dbUser?.id.toString() as (typeof AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS)[number]
  );
  const isL6 = dbUser?.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L6_USER.id;
  const isL5 = dbUser?.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id;
  const hasAccess = isL7 || isL6 || isL5;

  if (!hasAccess) {
    redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/',
        'Insufficient Permissions',
        'You do not have permission to access that page.'
      )
    );
  }

  // Fetch specific log if logId is provided for deep-linking
  let specificLog = null;
  if (logId) {
    const logIdParam = Array.isArray(logId) ? logId[0] : logId;
    const specificLogResult = await getAuditLogById(logIdParam);
    if (specificLogResult.success) {
      specificLog = specificLogResult.data;
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        heading='Audit Logs'
        subheading='Monitor and track all activities within your organization for security and compliance.'
        rightElement={
          <Link href='/account/data-provenance/records'>
            <Button
              variant='default'
              className='flex flex-row items-center gap-2'
            >
              <Fingerprint className='size-4' />
              View Data Provenance
            </Button>
          </Link>
        }
      />

      <AuditLogsClient dbUser={dbUser} specificLog={specificLog} />
    </>
  );
}

                                : 'bg-red-100 text-red-700'
                            )}
                          >
                            {isAllowed ? (
                              <Check className='size-4' />
                            ) : (
                              <X className='size-4' />
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div className='flex flex-col'>
                            <span className='text-sm font-medium'>
                              {formatPermissionName(permission)}
                            </span>
                            <span className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                              {PERMISSION_DESCRIPTIONS[permission] ||
                                'No description available'}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          {/* Render the icon as a React element */}
                          {PERMISSION_ICONS[permission] && (
                            <div className='ml-auto'>
                              {React.createElement(
                                PERMISSION_ICONS[permission],
                                {
                                  className: 'h-4 w-4'
                                }
                              )}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </TooltipTrigger>
                      <TooltipContent>
                        {isAllowed
                          ? 'This permission is allowed based on the user attributes'
                          : reason ||
                            'This permission is not allowed based on the user attributes'}
                      </TooltipContent>
                    </Tooltip>
                  </TooltipProvider>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

'use server';

import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import {
  evidencePS,
  retentionPoliciesPS,
  versionHistoryPS,
  provenanceRecordsPS
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/provenance/schema';
import { and, eq } from '@signvault/db/drizzle';
import type {
  Evidence,
  RetentionPolicies,
  VersionHistory,
  ProvenanceRecords
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { toBigInt } from '@signvault/db/utils';

/**
 * Get evidence for a specific provenance record
 */
export const getEvidenceByRecordId = async ({
  recordId,
  organizationId
}: {
  recordId: string;
  organizationId: string;
}): Promise<Evidence[]> => {
  if (!recordId || !organizationId) return [];

  // First validate that the record belongs to the organization
  const record = await db
    .select()
    .from(provenanceRecordsPS)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(provenanceRecordsPS.id, toBigInt(recordId)),
        eq(provenanceRecordsPS.organizationId, toBigInt(organizationId))
      )
    )
    .limit(1);

  if (!record.length) {
    throw new Error('Record not found or access denied');
  }

  // Get evidence linked to this record
  return await db
    .select()
    .from(evidencePS)
    .where(eq(evidencePS.referenceId, toBigInt(recordId)));
};

/**
 * Get retention policies for a specific provenance record
 */
export const getRetentionPoliciesByRecordId = async ({
  recordId,
  organizationId
}: {
  recordId: string;
  organizationId: string;
}): Promise<RetentionPolicies[]> => {
  if (!recordId || !organizationId) return [];

  // First validate that the record belongs to the organization
  const record = await db
    .select()
    .from(provenanceRecordsPS)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(provenanceRecordsPS.id, toBigInt(recordId)),
        eq(provenanceRecordsPS.organizationId, toBigInt(organizationId))
      )
    )
    .limit(1);

  if (!record.length) {
    throw new Error('Record not found or access denied');
  }

  // Get retention policies linked to this record
  return await db
    .select()
    .from(retentionPoliciesPS)
    .where(eq(retentionPoliciesPS.provenanceId, toBigInt(recordId)));
};

/**
 * Get version history for a specific provenance record
 */
export const getVersionHistoryByRecordId = async ({
  recordId,
  organizationId
}: {
  recordId: string;
  organizationId: string;
}): Promise<VersionHistory[]> => {
  if (!recordId || !organizationId) return [];

  // First validate that the record belongs to the organization
  const record = await db
    .select()
    .from(provenanceRecordsPS)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(provenanceRecordsPS.id, toBigInt(recordId)),
        eq(provenanceRecordsPS.organizationId, toBigInt(organizationId))
      )
    )
    .limit(1);

  if (!record.length) {
    throw new Error('Record not found or access denied');
  }

  // Get version history linked to this record
  return await db
    .select()
    .from(versionHistoryPS)
    .where(eq(versionHistoryPS.provenanceId, toBigInt(recordId)))
    .orderBy(versionHistoryPS.timestamp);
};

/**
 * Get all details for a specific provenance record (comprehensive data)
 */
export const getRecordDetails = async ({
  recordId,
  organizationId
}: {
  recordId: string;
  organizationId: string;
}): Promise<{
  record: ProvenanceRecords | null;
  evidence: Evidence[];
  retentionPolicies: RetentionPolicies[];
  versionHistory: VersionHistory[];
}> => {
  if (!recordId || !organizationId) {
    return {
      record: null,
      evidence: [],
      retentionPolicies: [],
      versionHistory: []
    };
  }

  try {
    // First validate and get the record
    const records = await db
      .select()
      .from(provenanceRecordsPS)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(provenanceRecordsPS.id, toBigInt(recordId)),
          eq(provenanceRecordsPS.organizationId, toBigInt(organizationId))
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    if (!records.length) {
      throw new Error('Record not found or access denied');
    }

    const record = records[0];

    // Get all related data in parallel
    const [evidence, retentionPolicies, versionHistory] = await Promise.all([
      db
        .select()
        .from(evidencePS)
        .where(eq(evidencePS.referenceId, toBigInt(recordId))),
      db
        .select()
        .from(retentionPoliciesPS)
        .where(eq(retentionPoliciesPS.provenanceId, toBigInt(recordId))),
      db
        .select()
        .from(versionHistoryPS)
        .where(eq(versionHistoryPS.provenanceId, toBigInt(recordId)))
        .orderBy(versionHistoryPS.timestamp)
    ]);

    return {
      record,
      evidence,
      retentionPolicies,
      versionHistory
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching record details:', error);
    throw error;
  }
};

=== FILE: ./app/api/logto/management/[[...path]]/route.ts ===

import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const logtoEndpoint = process.env.LOGTO_MANAGEMENT_ENDPOINT;
const tokenEndpoint = `${logtoEndpoint}/oidc/token`;
const applicationId = process.env.LOGTO_M2M_APP_ID;
const applicationSecret = process.env.LOGTO_M2M_APP_SECRET;
const tenantId = process.env.LOGTO_TENANT_ID;

/**
 * Fetches the access token for the Logto Management API.
 * @param requestId - The request ID.
 * @param logger - The server logger.
 * @returns The access token.
 */
async function fetchAccessToken(
  requestId: string,
  logger: ReturnType<typeof getServerLogger>
) {
  try {
    // Fetch access token
    const response = await fetch(tokenEndpoint, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        'Authorization': `Basic ${Buffer.from(
          `${applicationId}:${applicationSecret}`
        ).toString('base64')}`
      },
      body: new URLSearchParams({
        grant_type: 'client_credentials',
        resource: `https://${tenantId}.logto.app/api`,
        scope: 'all'
      }).toString()
    });

    // Check if access token was fetched successfully
    if (!response.ok) {
      logger.error('Failed to fetch access token', {
        status: response.status
      });
      throw new Error('Failed to fetch access token');
    }

    // Log info
    logger.info('Access token fetched successfully');
    return response.json();
  } catch (error) {
    // Log error
    logger.error('Error fetching access token', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    });
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Handles the Logto Management API request.
 * @param request - The request object.
 * @returns A JSON response.
 */
async function handleRequest(request: NextRequest) {
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'logto-management');

  try {
    // Log info
    logger.info('Handling Logto Management API request', {
      method: request.method,
      url: request.url
    });

    // Fetch access token
    const { access_token } = await fetchAccessToken(requestId, logger);

    // Get path
    const path = request.nextUrl.pathname.replaceAll(
      '/api/logto/management',
      ''
    );
    const url = `${logtoEndpoint}${path}`;

    // Set headers
    const headers = new Headers(request.headers);
    headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${access_token}`);

    const response = await fetch(url, {
      method: request.method,
      headers,
      body: ['GET', 'HEAD'].includes(request.method) ? null : request.body,
      // @ts-expect-error - This is intended to be a half duplex stream
      duplex: 'half'
    });

    // Check if response is 204 No Content
    if (response.status === 204) {
      logger.info('Received 204 No Content response');
      return new NextResponse(null, { status: 204 });
    }

    // Check if response is not OK
    if (!response.ok) {
      const json = await response.json();
      logger.error('Error response from Logto Management API', {
        status: response.status,
        error: json.message
      });
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: json.message },
        { status: response.status }
      );
    }

    // Check if request method is not DELETE
    if (request.method !== 'DELETE') {
      const data = await response.json();
      logger.info('Logto Management API request handled successfully', {
        status: response.status
      });
      return NextResponse.json(data, {
        status: response.status
      });
    } else {
      logger.info('Logto Management API DELETE request handled successfully', {
        status: response.status
      });
      return new NextResponse(null, {
        status: response.status
      });
    }
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    // Check if error is an instance of Error
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      logger.error('Error handling Logto Management API request', {
        error: error.message
      });
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    } else {
      // Log error
      logger.error('Unknown error handling Logto Management API request');
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Internal Server Error' },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }
  }
}

// All methods are handled by the same function
export const GET = handleRequest;
export const POST = handleRequest;
export const PUT = handleRequest;
export const PATCH = handleRequest;
export const DELETE = handleRequest;
export const OPTIONS = handleRequest;
export const HEAD = handleRequest;

'use client';

import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import debounce from 'lodash/debounce';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export type MapboxFeature = {
  geometry: {
    coordinates: [number, number];
    type: string;
  };
  id: string;
  properties: {
    bbox: [number, number, number, number];
    context: {
      country: {
        country_code: string;
        country_code_alpha_3: string;
        mapbox_id: string;
        name: string;
        wikidata_id: string;
      };
      district: {
        mapbox_id: string;
        name: string;
        wikidata_id: string;
      };
      locality: {
        mapbox_id: string;
        name: string;
      };
      neighborhood: {
        mapbox_id: string;
        name: string;
      };
      place: {
        mapbox_id: string;
        name: string;
        wikidata_id: string;
      };
      postcode: {
        mapbox_id: string;
        name: string;
      };
      region: {
        mapbox_id: string;
        name: string;
        region_code: string;
        region_code_full: string;
        wikidata_id: string;
      };
    };
    coordinates: {
      latitude: number;
      longitude: number;
    };
    feature_type: string;
    full_address: string;
    mapbox_id: string;
    name: string;
    name_preferred: string;
    place_formatted: string;
  };
  type: string;
};

type MapboxSearchProps = {
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  onSelect?: (feature: MapboxFeature) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  value: string;
};

export default function AddressAutofill({
  value,
  onChange,
  onSelect,
  placeholder = 'Search for an address...'
}: Readonly<MapboxSearchProps>) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(value);
  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState<MapboxFeature[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [hasInteracted, setHasInteracted] = useState(false);
  const suggestionsRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  const fetchSuggestions = async (searchQuery: string) => {
    if (!searchQuery) {
      setSuggestions([]);
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `/api/geocoding?query=${encodeURIComponent(searchQuery)}`
      );
      const data = await response.json();
      const features = data.features || [];
      setSuggestions(features);
    } catch (error) {
      setSuggestions([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const debouncedFetch = debounce(fetchSuggestions, 300);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hasInteracted) {
      debouncedFetch(query);
    }
    return () => {
      debouncedFetch.cancel();
    };
  }, [query, hasInteracted]);

  const handleSelect = (feature: MapboxFeature) => {
    setQuery(feature.properties.full_address);
    onChange(feature.properties.full_address);
    setSuggestions([]);
    if (onSelect) {
      onSelect(feature);
    }
  };

  const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
    if (
      suggestionsRef.current &&
      !suggestionsRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)
    ) {
      setSuggestions([]);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className='relative'>
      <Input
        className='w-full'
        onChange={(e) => {
          setHasInteracted(true);
          setQuery(e.target.value);
          onChange(e.target.value);
        }}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        type='text'
        value={query}
      />
      {hasInteracted && (loading || suggestions.length > 0) && (
        <div
          className='shadow-xs absolute inset-x-0 top-full z-50 mt-1 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto rounded-md border bg-background'
          ref={suggestionsRef}
        >
          {loading && (
            <div className='flex items-center justify-center p-2'>
              <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin' />
            </div>
          )}
          {!loading &&
            suggestions.map((suggestion) => (
              <button
                className='w-full cursor-pointer px-4 py-2 text-left text-sm text-foreground transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:bg-primary/10'
                key={suggestion.id}
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handleSelect(suggestion);
                }}
              >
                {suggestion.properties.full_address}
              </button>
            ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore, getErrorRedirect } from '@/lib/utils';
import TeamDetails from './team-details';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import type {
  GetTeamMembersResponse,
  GetCustomTeamResponse
} from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/teams';
import type { GetTeamCalendarEventsResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/team-calendar-events';
import type { GetTeamDocumentsResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/team-documents';
import type { GetTeamMemberActivityLogsResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/team-member-activity-logs';

export default async function TeamDetailsPage(
  props: Readonly<{
    params: Readonly<{
      organizationId: string;
      teamId: string;
    }>;
  }>
) {
  const params = await props.params;
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const data = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookieStore.getAll());

  // Fetch team details
  const teamResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${params.teamId}?organizationId=${params.organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  if (!teamResponse.ok) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${params.organizationId}/teams`,
        'Team Error',
        'There was an error retrieving the team details.'
      )
    );
  }

  const { team }: GetCustomTeamResponse = await teamResponse.json();

  // Fetch team members
  const membersResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${params.teamId}/members?organizationId=${params.organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  if (!membersResponse.ok) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${params.organizationId}/teams`,
        'Team Members Error',
        'There was an error retrieving the team members.'
      )
    );
  }

  const { members }: GetTeamMembersResponse = await membersResponse.json();

  // Fetch team activity logs
  const activityLogsResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-member-activity-logs/team/${params.teamId}?organizationId=${params.organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  const activityLogs = activityLogsResponse.ok
    ? ((await activityLogsResponse.json()) as GetTeamMemberActivityLogsResponse)
    : { teamMemberActivityLogs: { database: [] } };

  // Fetch team documents
  const documentsResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-documents/${params.teamId}?organizationId=${params.organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  const documents = documentsResponse.ok
    ? ((await documentsResponse.json()) as GetTeamDocumentsResponse)
    : { documents: { database: [] } };

  // Fetch team calendar events
  const calendarResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-calendar-events/${params.teamId}?organizationId=${params.organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  const calendar = calendarResponse.ok
    ? ((await calendarResponse.json()) as GetTeamCalendarEventsResponse)
    : { events: { database: [] } };

  return (
    <TeamDetails
      organizationId={params.organizationId}
      teamId={params.teamId}
      team={{
        ...team,
        notifications: {
          beforeDeadline: team.notificationsPreferences.beforeDeadline,
          onComplete: team.notificationsPreferences.onComplete,
          onStart: team.notificationsPreferences.onStart
        },
        configuration: team.configuration as any
      }}
      members={members}
      users={members.map((member) => member.user)}
      activityLogs={activityLogs.teamMemberActivityLogs.database}
      documents={documents.documents.database}
      calendarEvents={calendar.events.database}
      cookieString={cookieString}
      user={data.claims}
    />
  );
}

'use client';

import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { useFormBuilderStore } from '@signvault/frontend/components/form-builder/store-provider';
import type { FormElement, FormElementInstance } from '../types';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Switch } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/switch';
import { CheckSquare } from 'lucide-react';
import { Label } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/label';
import { Checkbox } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/checkbox';

function DesignerComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  return (
    <div className='flex items-start space-x-2'>
      <Checkbox id={element.id} disabled />
      <div className='grid gap-1 leading-none'>
        <Label htmlFor={element.id}>
          {element.label}
          {element.required && <span className='text-red-500'>*</span>}
        </Label>
        {element.description && (
          <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>{element.description}</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function FormComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  // This will be the actual component rendered in the final form
  return <div>{element.label}</div>;
}

const propertiesSchema = z.object({
  label: z.string().min(2).max(50),
  description: z.string().max(100),
  required: z.boolean().default(false)
});

type PropertiesFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof propertiesSchema>;

function PropertiesComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  const { updateElement } = useFormBuilderStore();
  const form = useForm<PropertiesFormSchemaType>({
    resolver: zodResolver(propertiesSchema),
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      label: element.label,
      description: element.description,
      required: element.required
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    form.reset(element);
  }, [element, form]);

  const applyChanges = (values: PropertiesFormSchemaType) => {
    updateElement(element.id, { ...element, ...values });
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form
        onBlur={form.handleSubmit(applyChanges)}
        onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        className='space-y-3'
      >
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='label'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Label</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  {...field}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur();
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='description'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  {...field}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur();
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>
                A short description to help the user.
              </FormDescription>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='required'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem className='shadow-xs flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-3'>
              <div className='space-y-0.5'>
                <FormLabel>Required</FormLabel>
              </div>
              <FormControl>
                <Switch
                  checked={field.value}
                  onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                />
              </FormControl>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
}

const BooleanField: FormElement = {
  type: 'boolean',
  construct: () => ({
    type: 'boolean',
    label: '',
    required: false,
    description: ''
  }),
  designerButtonElement: {
    icon: CheckSquare,
    label: 'Checkbox'
  },
  designerComponent: DesignerComponent,
  propertiesComponent: PropertiesComponent,
  formComponent: FormComponent
};

export default BooleanField;
