'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { ROLES } from '@/lib/logto-roles-and-permissions';
import { CopyIcon, CheckIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import type { CreateInvitationResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organization-invitations';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';
import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore } from '@/lib/utils';

// TODO: Update this; Organization invitation link generation is not implemented yet

type MultiUserInviteProps = {
  organizationId: string;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}

export default function MultiUserInvite({
  organizationId,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<MultiUserInviteProps>) {
  const [inviteLink, setInviteLink] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isCopied, setIsCopied] = useState(false);
  clientLogger.info('Rendering multi-user invite component', {
    organizationId
  });
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  const generateInviteLink = async () => {
    clientLogger.info('Generating new multi-user invite link', {
      organizationId
    });
    setIsLoading(true);

    try {
      const expiresAt = new Date();
      expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 30);

      const invitationResponse: CreateInvitationResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-invitations?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            invitee: 'no-reply@signvault.io',
            organizationId,
            expiresAt: expiresAt.getTime(),
            organizationRoleIds: [ROLES.L1_USER.id],
            messagePayload: false,
            isMultiUse: true
          })
        }
      ).then((res) => res.json());

      if (
        invitationResponse.message !==
        'Organization invitation created successfully'
      ) {
        toast.error('Failed to generate invitation link');
        return;
      }

      const invite =
        invitationResponse.invitation.logto ??
        invitationResponse.invitation.database ??
        null;

      if (!invite) {
        toast.error('Failed to generate invitation link');
        return;
      }

      const link = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/join-organization/${organizationId}?code=${invite.id}`;
      setInviteLink(link);
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to generate invitation link');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const copyToClipboard = () => {
    clientLogger.info('Copying multi-user invite link to clipboard', {
      organizationId
    });
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(inviteLink);
    setIsCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setIsCopied(false), 2000);
    toast.success('Invitation link copied to clipboard');
  };

  return (
    <div className='space-y-4'>
      <h2 className='text-xl font-semibold'>Multi-User Invitation Link</h2>
      <p className='text-sm text-foreground/80'>
        Share this link with multiple users to invite them to your organization.
        They will be able to join with default user permissions.
      </p>
      <div className='flex items-center space-x-2'>
        <Input type='text' value={inviteLink} readOnly className='grow' />
        <Button onClick={copyToClipboard} disabled={isLoading || !inviteLink}>
          {isCopied ? (
            <CheckIcon className='h-4 w-4' />
          ) : (
            <CopyIcon className='h-4 w-4' />
          )}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <Button onClick={generateInviteLink} disabled={isLoading}>
        {isLoading ? 'Generating...' : 'Generate New Link'}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { TeamTemplate } from '@signvault/db/types';

} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';

import { AddTemplateForm } from './add-template-form';
import { TeamCard } from './team-card';

type AddTemplateDialogProps = {
  adminIds: (string | bigint)[];
  organizationId?: string | bigint;
  template?: TeamTemplate;
  teamTemplates: TeamTemplate[];
  triggerText?: string;
  userId?: string | bigint;
};

export function AddTemplateDialog({
  adminIds,
  template,
  userId,
  organizationId,
  teamTemplates,
  triggerText = 'Add Template to Active Teams'
}: Readonly<AddTemplateDialogProps>) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedTemplate, setSelectedTemplate] = useState<TeamTemplate | null>(
    template || null
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      setSelectedTemplate(null);
    }
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <Dialog onOpenChange={setOpen} open={open}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'
          size='sm'
          variant='default'
        >
          <Plus className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
          {triggerText}
        </Button>
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent className='max-h-[90vh] max-w-full overflow-y-auto font-suisse-intl xs:w-[480px] sm:w-[540px] md:w-[600px] lg:w-[660px] xl:w-[720px]'>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className='text-xl font-semibold'>
            Add {template ? template.name : 'a Template'} To Active Teams
          </DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        {userId && organizationId && (
          <>
            {template && (
              <TeamCard
                className='flex flex-col gap-2 bg-secondary'
                team={template}
              />
            )}

            {!template && (
              <div className='flex max-h-[452px] flex-col gap-4 overflow-y-auto'>
                <p className='text-balance text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                  Select a template to inherit and add to your active teams.
                  Scroll through the list below to view all the available
                  templates.
                </p>
                <div className='divide-y divide-line rounded-lg border border-line'>
                  {teamTemplates?.map((t, index) => {
                    return (
                      <div
                        className={cn(
                          'cursor-pointer overflow-hidden p-4 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out sm:p-6',
                          selectedTemplate?.id === t.id
                            ? 'bg-secondary'
                            : 'hover:bg-secondary/50',
                          index === 0 && 'rounded-t-lg',
                          index === teamTemplates.length - 1 && 'rounded-b-lg'
                        )}
                        key={t.id}
                        onClick={() => {
                          setSelectedTemplate(t);
                        }}
                        onKeyDown={(e) => {
                          if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                            setSelectedTemplate(t);
                          }
                        }}
                        role='button'
                        tabIndex={0}
                      >
                        <TeamCard
                          className='flex flex-col gap-2 p-0'
                          team={t}
                        />
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
            {(selectedTemplate || template) && (
              <AddTemplateForm
                adminIds={adminIds}
                key={(selectedTemplate || template)?.id || 'default'}
                onCancel={() => {
                  if (!template) setSelectedTemplate(null);
                  setOpen(false);
                }}
                onSuccess={() => setOpen(false)}
                organizationId={organizationId}
                template={selectedTemplate || template}
                userId={userId}
              />
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import type {
  GetAllOrganizationsResponse,
  GetOrganizationResponse
} from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organizations';
import type { GetOrganizationSourceSystemsByOrganizationIdResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organization-source-systems';
import SourceSystemsPage from './source-systems-page';
import { ChevronLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getRandomUUID,
  getErrorRedirect
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';

export const revalidate = 60;
export const dynamicParams = true;

export async function generateStaticParams() {
  const logger = getServerLogger(
    getRandomUUID(),
    'organization-source-systems-ssg'
  );
  try {
    logger.info('Generating static params for source systems');
    const organizationsRequest = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations?bypassToken=${process.env.BYPASS_TOKEN}`
    );
    const organizationsResponse: GetAllOrganizationsResponse =
      await organizationsRequest.json();

    if (
      !organizationsResponse.organizations ||
      organizationsResponse.message !== 'Organizations retrieved successfully'
    ) {
      logger.error('Error fetching organizations', {
        organizationsResponse
      });
      return [];
    }

    const organizations =
      organizationsResponse.organizations.logto ||
      organizationsResponse.organizations.database;

    return organizations.map((org: any) => ({
      organizationId: org.id
    }));
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error generating static params for source systems', {
      error
    });
    return [];
  }
}

export default async function SourceSystemsPageServer(
  props: Readonly<{
    params: Promise<{ organizationId: string }>;
  }>
) {
  const params = await props.params;
  const logger = getServerLogger(
    getRandomUUID(),
    'organization-source-systems-page'
  );
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );
  const { organizationId } = params;

  const organizationResponse: GetOrganizationResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());
  logger.info('Fetching organization', {
    organizationResponse
  });
  const organization =
    organizationResponse.organization.database ??
    organizationResponse.organization.logto ??
    null;

  const organizationSourceSystemsResponse: GetOrganizationSourceSystemsByOrganizationIdResponse =
    await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-source-systems/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString
        }
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (
    organizationSourceSystemsResponse.message !==
    'Organization source systems retrieved successfully'
  ) {
    logger.error('Organization source systems fetch failed', {
      organizationSourceSystemsResponse
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organizations',
        'Organization source systems not found',
        'The organization source systems you are trying to access do not exist.'
      )
    );
  }

  return (
    <SourceSystemsPage
      cookieStore={cookieStore}
      organizationId={organizationId}
      organizationSourceSystems={
        organizationSourceSystemsResponse.organizationSourceSystems.database
      }
    />
  );
}

'use client';

import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { useFormBuilderStore } from '@signvault/frontend/components/form-builder/store-provider';
import type { FormElement, FormElementInstance } from '../types';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Switch } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/switch';
import { PenSquare } from 'lucide-react';
import { Label } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/label';

function DesignerComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  return (
    <div className='flex w-full flex-col gap-2'>
      <Label>
        {element.label}
        {element.required && <span className='text-red-500'>*</span>}
      </Label>
      <div className='flex h-24 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-dashed'>
        <p className='text-muted-foreground'>Signature Area</p>
      </div>
      {element.description && (
        <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>{element.description}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function FormComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  return <div>{element.label}</div>;
}

const propertiesSchema = z.object({
  label: z.string().min(2).max(50),
  description: z.string().max(100),
  required: z.boolean().default(false)
});

type PropertiesFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof propertiesSchema>;

function PropertiesComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  const { updateElement } = useFormBuilderStore();
  const form = useForm<PropertiesFormSchemaType>({
    resolver: zodResolver(propertiesSchema),
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      label: element.label,
      description: element.description,
      required: element.required
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    form.reset(element);
  }, [element, form]);

  const applyChanges = (values: PropertiesFormSchemaType) => {
    updateElement(element.id, { ...element, ...values });
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form
        onBlur={form.handleSubmit(applyChanges)}
        onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        className='space-y-3'
      >
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='label'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Label</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  {...field}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur();
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='description'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  {...field}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur();
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>
                A short description to help the user.
              </FormDescription>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='required'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem className='shadow-xs flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-3'>
              <div className='space-y-0.5'>
                <FormLabel>Required</FormLabel>
              </div>
              <FormControl>
                <Switch
                  checked={field.value}
                  onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                />
              </FormControl>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
}

const SignatureField: FormElement = {
  type: 'signature',
  construct: () => ({
    type: 'signature',
    label: '',
    required: false,
    description: ''
  }),
  designerButtonElement: {
    icon: PenSquare,
    label: 'Signature'
  },
  designerComponent: DesignerComponent,
  propertiesComponent: PropertiesComponent,
  formComponent: FormComponent
};

export default SignatureField;

  TableHeader,
  TableRow
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/table';
import { getUserRoleNameFromRole } from '@/lib/utils';
import SearchInput from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/search-input';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import type {
  Organization as DbOrganization,
  User as DbUser
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import type {
  Organization as LogtoOrganization,
  User as LogtoUser
} from '@signvault/logto/types';
import { getUserOrganizationRoles } from '@/lib/organization-actions';

type OrganizationUsersPageProps = {
  organizationDetails: DbOrganization | LogtoOrganization;
  organizationUsers: (DbUser | LogtoUser)[];
}

type UserRolesProps = {
  userId: string;
  organizationId: string;
}

function UserRoles({ userId, organizationId }: Readonly<UserRolesProps>) {
  const [roles, setRoles] = useState<any[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchRoles = async () => {
      const fetchedRoles = await getUserOrganizationRoles(
        organizationId,
        userId,
        {
          page: 1,
          page_size: 100
        }
      );
      setRoles(fetchedRoles);
    };
    fetchRoles();
  }, [userId, organizationId]);

  return (
    <>
      {roles.map((role) => (
        <span
          key={role.id}
          className='mr-2 inline-block rounded-full bg-primary/10 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-primary'
        >
          {getUserRoleNameFromRole(role.name)}
        </span>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

export default function OrganizationUsersPage({
  organizationDetails,
  organizationUsers
}: Readonly<OrganizationUsersPageProps>) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  const filteredUsers = organizationUsers.filter((user) =>
    user.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  clientLogger.info('Rendering organization users page', {
    organizationDetails,
    organizationUsers
  });

  return (
    <>
      <div className='mb-6 flex items-center justify-between'>
        <div className='relative'>
          <SearchInput
            label='Search members...'
            placeholder='Search members...'
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(value) => setSearchTerm(value)}
            className='bg-transparent pl-10'
            showLabel={false}
          />
        </div>
        <Button className='inline-flex items-center gap-2'>
          <Plus className='h-4 w-4' />
          Invite new members
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div className='overflow-x-auto'>
        <Table className='min-w-full'>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Name</TableHead>
              <TableHead className='hidden md:table-cell'>Email</TableHead>
              <TableHead className='hidden lg:table-cell'>Roles</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Actions</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>

                <TableCell className='font-medium'>{user.name}</TableCell>
                <TableCell className='hidden md:table-cell'>
                  {user.primaryEmail}
                </TableCell>

=== FILE: ./lib/client-logger.ts ===

import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import ansis from 'ansis';

/**
 * Sends a log entry to Loki.
 * @param level - The log level.
 * @param message - The log message.
 * @param meta - The log metadata.
 * @param moduleName - The module name.
 */
const sendToLoki = async (
  level: 'info' | 'error' | 'warn',
  message: string,
  meta: Record<string, unknown> = {},
  moduleName: string = 'default'
) => {
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();
  const sanitizedMeta = Object.entries(meta).reduce(
    (acc, [key, value]) => {
      acc[key] = typeof value === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(value) : value;
      return acc;
    },
    {} as Record<string, unknown>
  );

  const logData = {
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    level,
    module: moduleName,
    requestId,
    message,
    ...sanitizedMeta
  };

  const border = '═'.repeat(40);

  // Color-coded level with emojis
  const levelColors: Record<string, (text: string) => string> = {
    debug: (text) => ansis.blue.bold(`🐛  ${text}`),
    info: (text) => ansis.green.bold(`ℹ️  ${text}`),
    warn: (text) => ansis.yellow.bold(`⚠️  ${text}`),
    error: (text) => ansis.red.bold(`❌  ${text}`)
  };

  // Ensure we have a valid color function
  const levelColor = levelColors[level] || ansis.white;

  const output = [
    ansis.gray(border),
    ansis.cyan.bold('[CLIENT] 📝 Log Entry:'),
    `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('🔍 Level:')}       ${level}`,
    `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('🕒 Timestamp:')}   ${ansis.white(logData.timestamp)}`,
    `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('📦 Module:')}      ${ansis.white(logData.module)}`,
    `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('🆔 Request ID:')}  ${ansis.white(logData.requestId)}`,
    `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('💬 Message:')}     ${ansis.white(logData.message)}`
  ];

  // Convert metadata to a structured, indented list
  const formatMetadata = (
    metadata: Record<string, unknown>,
    prefix = '  - ',
    connector = '├─'
  ) => {
    return Object.entries(metadata)
      .map(([key, value]) => {
        const valueString =
          typeof value === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(value) : value;
        return `${ansis.gray(prefix)}${ansis.gray(connector)} ${ansis.magenta.bold(key)}: ${valueString}`;
      })
      .join('\n');
  };

  const metadataTree = formatMetadata(sanitizedMeta, '   ', '└─');

  output.push(
    `${ansis.gray(border)}\n`,
    `${ansis.cyan.bold('[CLIENT] 📝 Log Entry:')}\n`,
    `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('🔍 Level:')}       ${level}`,
    `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('🕒 Timestamp:')}   ${ansis.white(logData.timestamp)}`,
    `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('📦 Module:')}      ${ansis.white(logData.module)}`,
    `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('🆔 Request ID:')}  ${ansis.white(logData.requestId)}`,
    `${ansis.gray('├─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('💬 Message:')}     ${ansis.white(logData.message)}`,
    `${ansis.gray('└─')} ${ansis.magenta.bold('📄 Metadata:')}\n${metadataTree}\n`,
    `${ansis.gray(border)}\n`,
    ''
  );

  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
    // output.forEach((line) => console.log(line));
  }

  // try {
  //   await fetch(`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/logging`, {
  //     method: 'POST',
  //     headers: {
  //       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  //       'X-Request-ID': requestId
  //     },
  //     body: JSON.stringify({
  //       level,
  //       message,
  //       requestId,
  //       module: moduleName,
  //       ...meta
  //     })
  //   });
  // } catch (error) {
  //   console.error('Failed to send log:', error);
  // }
};

/**
 * The client logger.
 */
export const clientLogger = {
  info: (
    message: string,
    meta: Record<string, unknown> = {},
    moduleName: string = 'default'
  ) => {
    sendToLoki('info', message, meta, moduleName);
  },
  error: (
    message: string,
    meta: Record<string, unknown> = {},
    moduleName: string = 'default'
  ) => {
    sendToLoki('error', message, meta, moduleName);
  },
  warn: (
    message: string,
    meta: Record<string, unknown> = {},
    moduleName: string = 'default'
  ) => {
    sendToLoki('warn', message, meta, moduleName);
  }

'use client';

import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { useFormBuilderStore } from '@signvault/frontend/components/form-builder/store-provider';
import type { FormElement, FormElementInstance } from '../types';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Switch } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/switch';
import { Calendar } from 'lucide-react';
import { Label } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/label';

function DesignerComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  return (
    <div className='flex w-full flex-col gap-2'>
      <Label>
        {element.label}
        {element.required && <span className='text-red-500'>*</span>}
      </Label>
      <Input type='date' readOnly disabled />
      {element.description && (
        <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>{element.description}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function FormComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  // This will be the actual component rendered in the final form
  return <div>{element.label}</div>;
}

const propertiesSchema = z.object({
  label: z.string().min(2).max(50),
  description: z.string().max(100),
  required: z.boolean().default(false)
});

type PropertiesFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof propertiesSchema>;

function PropertiesComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  const { updateElement } = useFormBuilderStore();
  const form = useForm<PropertiesFormSchemaType>({
    resolver: zodResolver(propertiesSchema),
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      label: element.label,
      description: element.description,
      required: element.required
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    form.reset(element);
  }, [element, form]);

  const applyChanges = (values: PropertiesFormSchemaType) => {
    updateElement(element.id, { ...element, ...values });
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form
        onBlur={form.handleSubmit(applyChanges)}
        onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        className='space-y-3'
      >
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='label'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Label</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  {...field}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur();
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='description'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Description</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  {...field}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur();
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>
                A short description to help the user.
              </FormDescription>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='required'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem className='shadow-xs flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-3'>
              <div className='space-y-0.5'>
                <FormLabel>Required</FormLabel>
              </div>
              <FormControl>
                <Switch
                  checked={field.value}
                  onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                />
              </FormControl>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
}

const DateField: FormElement = {
  type: 'date',
  construct: () => ({
    type: 'date',
    label: '',
    required: false,
    description: ''
  }),
  designerButtonElement: {
    icon: Calendar,
    label: 'Date'
  },
  designerComponent: DesignerComponent,
  propertiesComponent: PropertiesComponent,
  formComponent: FormComponent
};

export default DateField;

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/organizations/[organizationId]/teams/[teamId]/calendar/page.tsx ===

import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getErrorRedirect,
  getRandomUUID
} from '@/lib/utils';
import TeamCalendar from './team-calendar';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import type { GetTeamCalendarEventsResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/team-calendar-events';
import type {
  GetCustomTeamResponse,
  GetTeamMembersResponse
} from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/teams';
import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';

export default async function TeamCalendarPage(
  props: Readonly<{
    params: Readonly<{
      organizationId: string;
      teamId: string;
    }>;
  }>
) {
  const params = await props.params;
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const data = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookieStore.getAll());
  const logger = getServerLogger(getRandomUUID());
  const { organizationId, teamId } = await params;

  if (!data.claims.sub) {
    logger.error('No user ID found in Logto claims', {
      organizationId,
      teamId,
      claims: data.claims
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}`,
        'Authentication Error',
        'No user ID found. Please try logging in again.'
      )
    );
  }

  // Fetch team events
  const eventsResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-calendar-events/${teamId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  const { events, message: eventsMessage }: GetTeamCalendarEventsResponse =
    await eventsResponse.json();

  if (eventsMessage !== 'Team calendar events retrieved successfully') {
    logger.error('Error retrieving calendar events.', {
      organizationId,
      teamId,
      error: eventsMessage,
      payload: events
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}`,
        'Calendar Events Error',
        'There was an error retrieving the calendar events.'
      )
    );
  }

  // Fetch team details
  const teamResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${teamId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  const { team, message: teamMessage }: GetCustomTeamResponse =
    await teamResponse.json();

  if (teamMessage !== 'Custom team retrieved successfully') {
    logger.error('Error retrieving team details', {
      organizationId,
      teamId,
      error: teamMessage,
      payload: team
    });

    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}`,
        'Team Error',
        'There was an error retrieving the team details. Error details: ' +
          teamMessage
      )
    );
  }

  // Fetch team members for event attendees
  const membersResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${teamId}/members?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  const { members, message: teamMembersMessage }: GetTeamMembersResponse =
    await membersResponse.json();

  if (teamMembersMessage !== 'Team members retrieved successfully') {
    logger.error('Error retrieving team members', {
      organizationId,
      teamId,
      error: teamMembersMessage,
      payload: members
    });

    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}`,
        'Team Members Error',
        'There was an error retrieving the team members. Error details: ' +
          teamMembersMessage
      )
    );
  }
  return (
    <TeamCalendar
      organizationId={organizationId}
      teamId={teamId}
      team={team}
      events={events.database}
      members={members}
      cookieString={cookieString}
      user={{ ...data.claims, id: data.claims.sub }}
    />
  );
}

=== FILE: ./components/calendar/body/day/calendar-body-margin-day-margin.tsx ===

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { format, roundToNearestMinutes, startOfWeek } from 'date-fns';
import { useState } from 'react';

import { useCalendarContext } from '../../calendar-context';

export const hours = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => i);

export default function CalendarBodyMarginDayMargin({
  className
}: Readonly<{ className?: string }>) {
  const {
    mode,
    setSelectedDate,
    setNewEventDialogOpen,
    date,
    setEventFormMode,
    topOffset
  } = useCalendarContext();

  const [isHovering, setIsHovering] = useState(false);
  const [markerPosition, setMarkerPosition] = useState(0);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState<Date | null>(date);

  // Function to calculate time from Y position
  const getTimeFromPosition = (y: number) => {
    const containerHeight = 24 * 128; // 24 hours * 32px * 4 (15 min intervals)
    const pixelsPerMinute = containerHeight / (24 * 60);
    const minutes = Math.floor(y / pixelsPerMinute);
    const roundedMinutes = Math.round(minutes / 15) * 15;

    const hours = Math.floor(roundedMinutes / 60);
    const remainingMinutes = roundedMinutes % 60;

    const newDate = new Date(date);
    newDate.setHours(hours, remainingMinutes, 0, 0);
    return roundToNearestMinutes(newDate, {
      nearestTo: 15
    });
  };

  const handleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!isHovering || (mode !== 'day' && mode !== 'week')) return;

    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top + e.currentTarget.scrollTop;

    // Constrain the marker within the calendar bounds
    const constrainedY = Math.max(0, Math.min(y, 24 * 128));
    setMarkerPosition(constrainedY);

    const time = getTimeFromPosition(constrainedY);
    setCurrentTime(time);
  };

  const handleClick = () => {
    if (!currentTime || (mode !== 'day' && mode !== 'week')) return;

    if (window.screen.width < 768) return;

    let selectedTime = currentTime;

    // For week view, set the start date to the beginning of the week
    if (mode === 'week') {
      const weekStart = startOfWeek(date, {
        weekStartsOn: 1
      });
      selectedTime = new Date(weekStart);
      selectedTime.setHours(
        currentTime.getHours(),
        currentTime.getMinutes(),
        0,
        0
      );
      setEventFormMode('full-week');
    } else {
      setEventFormMode('daily');
    }

    setSelectedDate(selectedTime);
    setNewEventDialogOpen(true);
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn('sticky left-0 z-10 flex w-12 flex-col', className)}>
      <div
        className={cn('sticky left-0 z-10 flex w-12 flex-col')}
        onClick={handleClick}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
            handleClick();
          }
        }}
        onMouseEnter={() => setIsHovering(true)}
        onMouseLeave={() => {
          setIsHovering(false);
          setCurrentTime(null);
        }}
        onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
        role='button'
        style={{
          marginTop: topOffset ? `${topOffset}px` : '0'
        }}
        tabIndex={0}
      >
        {hours.map((hour) => (
          <div className='relative h-32 first:mt-0' key={hour}>
            {hour !== 0 && (
              <span className='absolute -top-2.5 left-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                {format(new Date().setHours(hour, 0, 0, 0), 'h a')}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}

        {/* Time Marker */}
        {isHovering && (mode === 'day' || mode === 'week') && currentTime && (
          <>
            {/* Time Label */}
            <div
              className='pointer-events-none absolute left-0 z-30 hidden -translate-y-2 md:block'
              style={{ top: markerPosition }}
            >
              <span className='whitespace-nowrap rounded-sm bg-primary px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-primary-foreground'>
                {format(currentTime, 'h:mm a')}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Horizontal Line */}
            <div
              className='pointer-events-none absolute left-0 right-[-2000px] hidden border-t-2 border-primary md:block'
              style={{ top: markerPosition }}
            />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use server';

import type { UserCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import nodemailer from 'nodemailer';
import type Mail from 'nodemailer/lib/mailer';

// Create a reusable transporter object using the SMTP transport
const transporter = nodemailer.createTransport({
  host: process.env.SMTP_SERVER,
  port: Number(process.env.SMTP_PORT),
  secure: process.env.SMTP_PORT === '465',
  auth: {
    user: process.env.SMTP_USERNAME,
    pass: process.env.SMTP_PASSWORD
  }
});

// Make sure this remains the same (no-reply@signvault.io)
const FROM_EMAIL = 'no-reply@signvault.io';

// Make sure to change this to the support email in future (support@signvault.io)
const REPLY_TO_EMAIL = 'harjot@signvault.io';

/**
 * A generic function to send an email using Nodemailer.
 * @param options The email options.
 * @param options.to Recipient's email address.
 * @param options.subject Email subject.
 * @param options.text Plain text body of the email.
 * @param options.html HTML body of the email (optional).
 * @returns A promise that resolves to an object indicating success or failure.
 */
export async function sendEmail({
  to,
  subject,
  text,
  html
}: {
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  text?: string;
  html?: string;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  const mailOptions: Mail.Options = {
    from: `"SignVault.io" <${FROM_EMAIL}>`,
    replyTo: REPLY_TO_EMAIL,
    to,
    subject,
    text,
    html
  };

  try {
    await transporter.sendMail(mailOptions);
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error sending email:', error);
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to send email.' };
  }
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/create-organization/components/form-controller.tsx ===

'use client';

import type { GetState, OnBack, OnNext, SetState } from '@formity/react';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { FormControllerContext } from './form-controller-context';

type FormControllerProps = {
  children: ReactNode;
  getState: GetState;
  isDialog?: boolean;
  onBack: OnBack;
  onNext: OnNext;
  progress: {
    current: number;
    total: number;
  };
  setState: SetState;
  step: string;
};

const steps = [
  { title: 'Basic Information' },
  { title: 'Organization Details' },
  { title: 'Billing Information' },
  { title: 'Configure Teams' },
  { title: 'Invite Users' }
];

export function FormController({
  step,
  onNext,
  onBack,
  getState,
  setState,
  progress,
  isDialog,
  children
}: Readonly<FormControllerProps>) {
  const [animate, setAnimate] = useState<'none' | 'next' | 'back'>('none');

  const handleNext = useCallback<OnNext>(
    (values) => {
      setAnimate('next');
      setTimeout(() => onNext(values), 0);
    },
    [onNext]
  );

  const handleBack = useCallback<OnBack>(
    (values) => {
      setAnimate('back');
      setTimeout(() => onBack(values), 0);
    },
    [onBack]
  );

  const values = useMemo(
    () => ({
      onNext: handleNext,
      onBack: handleBack,
      getState,
      setState
    }),
    [handleNext, handleBack, getState, setState]
  );

  return (
    <div
      className='relative flex flex-col gap-8 md:flex-row'
      id={isDialog ? 'invite-users-dialog' : 'create-organization-form'}
    >
      {!isDialog && (
        <div className='flex h-fit flex-col justify-start gap-0 md:sticky md:top-8'>
          {steps.map((s, index) => (
            <div
              className={cn(
                'flex flex-col items-start',
                index < progress.current - 1
                  ? 'text-muted-foreground'
                  : 'text-foreground',
                index === progress.current - 1 && 'text-primary'
              )}
              key={s.title + index}
            >
              <div className='flex flex-row items-center gap-2'>
                <div
                  className={`flex min-h-5 min-w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full font-sora text-xs ${
                    index < progress.current - 1
                      ? 'bg-green-600'
                      : 'border border-primary bg-background'
                  }`}
                >
                  {index < progress.current - 1 && (
                    <Check className='size-3 min-h-3 min-w-3 text-white' />
                  )}
                </div>
                <span className='text-sm font-medium'>{s.title}</span>
              </div>
              {index < steps.length - 1 && (
                <div className='ml-[9px] h-[24px] w-px bg-gray-300'>
                  <div
                    className={`h-full bg-gray-300`}
                    style={{
                      width: index < progress.current - 1 ? '100%' : '0%'
                    }}
                  ></div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div
        className={cn(
          'w-full max-w-lg md:mx-0 lg:mx-auto lg:max-w-xl',
          isDialog && 'lg:mx-0'
        )}
      >
        <AnimatePresence
          initial={false}
          mode='wait'
          onExitComplete={() => setAnimate('none')}
        >
          <motion.div
            animate={{
              opacity: 1,
              filter: 'blur(0px)',
              transition: { duration: 0.3 }
            }}
            exit={{
              filter: 'blur(3px)',
              opacity: 0,
              transition: { duration: 0.3 }
            }}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, filter: 'blur(3px)' }}
            key={step}
          >
            <FormControllerContext.Provider value={values}>
              {children}
            </FormControllerContext.Provider>
          </motion.div>
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./contexts/user-data-context.tsx ===

'use client';

import type {
  ActiveTeamCS,
  NotificationANS,
  OrganizationCS,
  CalendarEventCS,
  UserCS,
  TeamMemberCS
} from '@signvault/db/types';

import {
  getUserAndOrganizationDetails,
  getUserData,
  getOrganizationMembers
} from '@/actions/users';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { createContext, useContext, useMemo } from 'react';

import { useAuth } from './auth-context';
import { useNotifications } from './notifications-context';

export type UserDataContextType = UserDataContextOrganizationJoinedType &
  UserDataContextBaseType;

type UserDataContextBaseType = {
  error: Error | null;
  isLoading: boolean;
  notifications: NotificationANS[];
  organizationData:
    | Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getUserAndOrganizationDetails>>
    | undefined;
  organizationError: Error | null;
  organizationLoading: boolean;
  organizationMembers: UserCS[];
  organizationMembersError: Error | null;
  organizationMembersLoading: boolean;
};

type UserDataContextOrganizationJoinedType = {
  events: CalendarEventCS[];
  organization: OrganizationCS;
  organizationJoined: boolean;
  organizationUsers: UserCS[];
  teams: ActiveTeamCS[];
  teamUsers: TeamMemberCS[];
};

const UserDataContext = createContext<UserDataContextType | undefined>(
  undefined
);

export function UserDataProvider({
  children
}: Readonly<{
  children: React.ReactNode;
}>) {
  const { dbUser } = useAuth();
  const { notifications } = useNotifications();

  const {
    data: organizationData,
    isLoading: organizationLoading,
    error: organizationError
  } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['userOrganization'],
    queryFn: () =>
      dbUser?.id ? getUserAndOrganizationDetails(String(dbUser.id)) : null,
    enabled: !!dbUser?.id,
    select: (data) => {
      return {
        organizationJoined: data.organizationJoined,
        organization: data.organization,
        user: data.user
      };
    }
  });

  const organizationJoined = organizationData?.organizationJoined;

  const {
    data: userData,
    isLoading: userDataLoading,
    error: userDataError
  } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['userData'],
    queryFn: () => (dbUser?.id ? getUserData(String(dbUser.id)) : null),
    enabled: !!dbUser?.id && !!organizationJoined,
    select: (data) => data.data
  });

  const {
    data: organizationMembers,
    isLoading: organizationMembersLoading,
    error: organizationMembersError
  } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['organizationMembers'],
    enabled:
      !!dbUser?.id &&
      !!organizationJoined &&
      !!organizationData?.organization.id,
    queryFn: () =>
      organizationData?.organization.id
        ? getOrganizationMembers(String(organizationData.organization.id))
        : null,
    select: (data) => data.members
  });

  const value = useMemo(() => {
    return {
      organizationJoined: organizationJoined ?? false,
      organization: userData?.organization ?? null,
      teams: userData?.teams ?? [],
      events: userData?.events ?? [],
      organizationUsers: userData?.organizationUsers ?? [],
      teamUsers: userData?.teamUsers ?? [],
      notifications: notifications ?? [],
      isLoading:
        userDataLoading || organizationLoading || organizationMembersLoading,
      error: userDataError || organizationError || organizationMembersError,
      userData,
      userDataLoading,
      userDataError,
      organizationData,
      organizationLoading,
      organizationError,
      organizationMembers,
      organizationMembersLoading,
      organizationMembersError
    };
  }, [
    organizationJoined,
    notifications,
    userDataLoading,
    userDataError,
    organizationData,
    organizationLoading,
    organizationError,
    organizationMembers,
    organizationMembersLoading,
    organizationMembersError,
    userData
  ]);

  if (!dbUser) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <UserDataContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </UserDataContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useUserData() {
  const context = useContext(UserDataContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useUserData must be used within UserDataProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

'use client';

import { createAuditLogEntry } from '@/actions/audit-logs';
import { sendTeamConfigUpdatedNotification } from '@/actions/notifications';
import { useUpdateActiveTeam } from '@/hooks/use-teams';
import {
  AuditLogAction,
  AuditLogCategory
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/enums';
import type { NestedRecord } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/textarea';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';

type ActiveTeamFormProps = {
  adminIds: (string | bigint)[];
  defaultValues?: {
    description: string;
    name: string;
  };
  isEditing?: boolean;
  onCancel: () => void;
  onSuccess: () => void;
  organizationId: string | bigint;
  teamId?: string | bigint;
  userId: string | bigint;
};

export function ActiveTeamForm({
  userId,
  organizationId,
  onSuccess,
  onCancel,
  defaultValues,
  isEditing = false,
  teamId
}: Readonly<ActiveTeamFormProps>) {
  const [name, setName] = useState(defaultValues?.name || '');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState(
    defaultValues?.description || ''
  );
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const updateTeam = useUpdateActiveTeam();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!teamId) return;

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const team = await updateTeam.mutateAsync({
        teamId,
        data: {
          name,
          description
        },
        organizationId
      });

      await sendTeamConfigUpdatedNotification({
        organizationId,
        teamId,
        teamName: name,
        memberIds: team.members.map((m) => m.userId),
        adminId: userId,
        changes: {
          old: {
            name: defaultValues?.name,
            description: defaultValues?.description
          },
          new: {
            name,
            description
          }
        }
      });

      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['activeTeams']
      });

      toast.success('Team updated successfully');
      await createAuditLogEntry({
        action: AuditLogAction.TEAM_UPDATED,
        category: AuditLogCategory.TEAM_MANAGEMENT,
        entityId: team.id,
        entityType: 'team',
        entityName: team.name,
        description: `User updated team: "${team.name}"`,
        beforeState: {
          name: defaultValues?.name,
          description: defaultValues?.description
        },
        afterState: { name, description } as NestedRecord
      }).catch(console.error);
      onSuccess();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to update team:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to update team');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <form className='space-y-4' onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <div className='space-y-2'>
        <label className='text-sm font-medium' htmlFor='name'>
          Team Name
        </label>
        <Input
          id='name'
          onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
          placeholder='Enter team name'
          required
          value={name}
        />
      </div>

      <div className='space-y-2'>
        <label className='text-sm font-medium' htmlFor='description'>
          Description
        </label>
        <Textarea
          id='description'
          onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
          placeholder='Enter team description'
          rows={3}
          value={description}
        />
      </div>

      <div className='flex justify-end gap-2'>
        <Button onClick={onCancel} type='button' variant='outline'>
          Cancel
        </Button>
        <Button disabled={isSubmitting} type='submit'>
          {isSubmitting
            ? 'Saving...'
            : isEditing
              ? 'Update Team'
              : 'Create Team'}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/organizations/[organizationId]/source-systems/layout.tsx ===

import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore, getErrorRedirect } from '@/lib/utils';
import type { GetUserResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/users';
import type { GetOrganizationResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organizations';
import type { GetOrganizationRolesForAUserResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organization-roles';
import { ROLES } from '@signvault/logto';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';

export default async function SourceSystemsLayout(
  props: Readonly<{
    children: React.ReactNode;
    params: Promise<{ organizationId: string }>;
  }>
) {
  const params = await props.params;

  const { children } = props;

  const { organizationId } = await params;
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const cookiesStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookiesStore);

  if (!claims) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/',
        'Unauthorized',
        'You must be logged in to view this page.'
      )
    );
  }

  const userResponse: GetUserResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/users/${claims.sub}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (userResponse.message !== 'User retrieved successfully') {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/',
        'Unauthorized',
        'You must be logged in to view this page.'
      )
    );
  }

  const user = userResponse.user.database ?? userResponse.user.logto ?? null;

  if (!user) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect('/', 'User not found', 'The user does not exist.')
    );
  }

  const userRolesResponse: GetOrganizationRolesForAUserResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-roles/${organizationId}/users/${claims.sub}/roles?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (
    userRolesResponse.message !== 'Organization roles retrieved successfully' ||
    userRolesResponse.roles.length === 0
  ) {
    redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}`,
        'User Roles Not Found',
        'The user roles were not found in the database.'
      )
    );
  }

  const userHasL5OrSuperAdminRole = userRolesResponse.roles.some(
    (role) => role.id === ROLES.SUPER_ADMIN.id || role.id === ROLES.L5_USER.id
  );

  if (!userHasL5OrSuperAdminRole) {
    redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organizations',
        'Unauthorized',
        'You are not authorized to access this page.'
      )
    );
  }

  const organizationResponse: GetOrganizationResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (organizationResponse.message !== 'Organization retrieved successfully') {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organizations',
        'Organization not found',
        'The organization you are trying to access does not exist.'
      )
    );
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}

'use client';

import { cn } from '@signvault/ui-lib/lib/utils';
import { Upload, FileText, CloudUpload } from 'lucide-react';
import { useDropzone, type Accept } from 'react-dropzone';

type FileDropzoneStepProps = {
  onFilesSelected: (files: File[]) => void;
  accept?: Accept;
  multiple?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
};

export function FileDropzoneStep({
  onFilesSelected,
  accept = { 'application/pdf': ['.pdf'] },
  multiple = true,
  disabled = false
}: Readonly<FileDropzoneStepProps>) {
  const { getRootProps, getInputProps, isDragActive } = useDropzone({
    accept,
    multiple,
    disabled,
    onDrop: (acceptedFiles) => {
      if (acceptedFiles.length > 0) {
        onFilesSelected(acceptedFiles);
      }
    }
  });

  return (
    <div className='w-full'>
      <div
        {...getRootProps()}
        className={cn(
          'group relative cursor-pointer rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed transition-all duration-200 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2',
          isDragActive
            ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5 scale-[1.02]'
            : 'border-muted-foreground/25 hover:border-primary/50 hover:bg-muted/30',
          disabled && 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-50'
        )}
      >
        <input {...getInputProps()} />

        <div className='flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-6 py-12 sm:py-16 lg:py-20'>
          {/* Icon */}
          <div
            className={cn(
              'relative mb-6 rounded-full p-4 transition-all duration-200',
              isDragActive
                ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground scale-110'
                : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground group-hover:bg-primary/10 group-hover:text-primary'
            )}
          >
            {isDragActive ? (
              <CloudUpload className='size-8 sm:size-10' />
            ) : (
              <Upload className='size-8 sm:size-10' />
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Content */}
          <div className='space-y-3 text-center'>
            <h3
              className={cn(
                'text-lg sm:text-xl font-semibold transition-colors',
                isDragActive ? 'text-primary' : 'text-foreground'
              )}
            >
              {isDragActive ? 'Drop files here' : 'Upload Documents'}
            </h3>

            <div className='space-y-2'>
              <p
                className={cn(
                  'text-sm transition-colors',
                  isDragActive ? 'text-primary/80' : 'text-muted-foreground'
                )}
              >
                {isDragActive ? (
                  'Release to upload your files'
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <span className='font-medium'>Click to browse</span> or drag
                    and drop your files
                  </>
                )}
              </p>

              {!isDragActive && (
                <div className='flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                  <div className='flex items-center gap-1'>
                    <FileText className='size-3' />
                    <span>PDF files supported</span>
                  </div>
                  {multiple && (
                    <>
                      <span>•</span>
                      <span>Multiple files allowed</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Visual enhancement on hover/drag */}
          <div
            className={cn(
              'absolute inset-0 rounded-xl bg-linear-to-t from-transparent to-transparent transition-all duration-200',
              isDragActive && 'from-primary/5 to-primary/10'
            )}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Additional tips */}
      {!isDragActive && (
        <div className='mt-4 text-center'>
          <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
            Files will be uploaded securely and processed immediately
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import type { AccessLevelEnumPS } from '@signvault/db/types';

export const getAccessLevelColor = (level: AccessLevelEnumPS) => {
  switch (level) {
    case 'INTERNAL_USE_ONLY':
      return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-400 hover:bg-green-200 dark:hover:bg-green-800/30 zyflo-transition';
    case 'PUBLIC':
      return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-200 dark:hover:bg-blue-800/30 zyflo-transition';
    case 'RESTRICTED':
      return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 dark:bg-orange-900/30 dark:text-orange-400 hover:bg-orange-200 dark:hover:bg-orange-800/30 zyflo-transition';
    case 'CONFIDENTIAL':
      return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-200 dark:hover:bg-red-800/30 zyflo-transition';
    case 'TOP_SECRET':
      return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-900/30 dark:text-purple-400 hover:bg-purple-200 dark:hover:bg-purple-800/30 zyflo-transition';
    case 'NEED_TO_KNOW':
      return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900/30 dark:text-yellow-400 hover:bg-yellow-200 dark:hover:bg-yellow-800/30 zyflo-transition';
    case 'EXECUTIVE_LEVEL':
      return 'bg-pink-100 text-pink-800 dark:bg-pink-900/30 dark:text-pink-400 hover:bg-pink-200 dark:hover:bg-pink-800/30 zyflo-transition';
    case 'VENDOR_ACCESS':
      return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900/30 dark:text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-800/30 zyflo-transition';
    default:
      return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900/30 dark:text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-800/30 zyflo-transition';
  }
};

// Utility function to generate Tailwind class strings for a given color
const getTailwindColorClasses = (color: string) =>
  `bg-${color}-100 text-${color}-800 dark:bg-${color}-900/30 dark:text-${color}-400 hover:bg-${color}-200 dark:hover:bg-${color}-800/30 zyflo-transition`;

export const getAccessLevelColorTailwindClass = (level: AccessLevelEnumPS) => {
  switch (level) {
    case 'INTERNAL_USE_ONLY':
      return getTailwindColorClasses('green');
    case 'PUBLIC':
      return getTailwindColorClasses('blue');
    case 'RESTRICTED':
      return getTailwindColorClasses('orange');
    case 'CONFIDENTIAL':
      return getTailwindColorClasses('red');
    case 'TOP_SECRET':
      return getTailwindColorClasses('purple');
    case 'NEED_TO_KNOW':
      return getTailwindColorClasses('yellow');
    case 'EXECUTIVE_LEVEL':
      return getTailwindColorClasses('pink');
    case 'VENDOR_ACCESS':
      return getTailwindColorClasses('gray');
    default:
      return getTailwindColorClasses('gray');
  }
};

export type AccessControlItem = {
  id: bigint;
  userId: bigint | null;
  teamId: bigint | null;
  accessLevel: AccessLevelEnumPS;
  isActive: boolean;
  createdAt: Date;
};

// Shared helpers to remove duplication across components
export type TargetType = 'user' | 'team';

export const getAccessControlTargetType = (
  ac: AccessControlItem
): TargetType => (ac.userId ? 'user' : 'team');

export const getAccessControlTargetDisplayName = (
  ac: AccessControlItem,
  organizationMembers: UserCS[] | undefined,
  teams: ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS[]
): string => {
  if (ac.userId) {
    const user = organizationMembers?.find(
      (m) => String(m.id) === String(ac.userId)
    );
    return (
      user?.name ||
      user?.primaryEmail ||
      user?.username ||
      `User #${ac.userId.toString()}`
    );
  }
  if (ac.teamId) {
    const team = teams.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(ac.teamId));
    return team?.name || `Team #${ac.teamId.toString()}`;
  }
  return 'Unknown';
};

// Safe parser for MultipleSelector option values like "user-123" or "team-456"
export const parseSelectedOption = (
  value: string
): { type: TargetType; id: bigint } => {
  const [prefix, idStr] = value.split('-');
  const id = BigInt(idStr);
  return { type: prefix === 'user' ? 'user' : 'team', id };
};

=== FILE: ./hooks/use-toast.ts ===

'use client';

import type {
  ToastActionElement,
  ToastProps
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/toast';

// Inspired by react-hot-toast library
import * as React from 'react';

const TOAST_LIMIT = 1;
const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000;

type ToasterToast = {
  action?: ToastActionElement;
  description?: React.ReactNode;
  id: string;
  title?: React.ReactNode;
} & ToastProps;

const actionTypes = {
  ADD_TOAST: 'ADD_TOAST',
  UPDATE_TOAST: 'UPDATE_TOAST',
  DISMISS_TOAST: 'DISMISS_TOAST',
  REMOVE_TOAST: 'REMOVE_TOAST'
} as const;

let count = 0;

type Action =
  | {
      toast: ToasterToast;
      type: ActionType['ADD_TOAST'];
    }
  | {
      toast: Partial<ToasterToast>;
      type: ActionType['UPDATE_TOAST'];
    }
  | {
      toastId?: ToasterToast['id'];
      type: ActionType['DISMISS_TOAST'];
    }
  | {
      toastId?: ToasterToast['id'];
      type: ActionType['REMOVE_TOAST'];
    };

type ActionType = typeof actionTypes;

type State = {
  toasts: ToasterToast[];
};

function genId() {
  count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
  return count.toString();
}

const toastTimeouts = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();

const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) => {
  if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
    return;
  }

  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId);
    dispatch({
      type: 'REMOVE_TOAST',
      toastId: toastId
    });
  }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY);

  toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout);
};

export const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State => {
  switch (action.type) {
    case 'ADD_TOAST':
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT)
      };

    case 'DISMISS_TOAST': {
      const { toastId } = action;

      // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
      // but I'll keep it here for simplicity
      if (toastId) {
        addToRemoveQueue(toastId);
      } else {
        state.toasts.forEach((toast) => {
          addToRemoveQueue(toast.id);
        });
      }

      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
            ? {
                ...t,
                open: false
              }
            : t
        )
      };
    }

    case 'REMOVE_TOAST':
      if (action.toastId === undefined) {
        return {
          ...state,
          toasts: []
        };
      }
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== action.toastId)
      };
    case 'UPDATE_TOAST':
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t
        )
      };
  }
};

const listeners: Array<(state: State) => void> = [];

let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] };

type Toast = Omit<ToasterToast, 'id'>;

function dispatch(action: Action) {
  memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action);
  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    listener(memoryState);
  });
}

function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {
  const id = genId();

  const update = (props: ToasterToast) =>
    dispatch({
      type: 'UPDATE_TOAST',
      toast: { ...props, id }
    });
  const dismiss = () => dispatch({ type: 'DISMISS_TOAST', toastId: id });

  dispatch({
    type: 'ADD_TOAST',
    toast: {
      ...props,
      id,
      open: true,
      onOpenChange: (open) => {
        if (!open) dismiss();
      }
    }
  });

  return {
    id: id,
    dismiss,
    update
  };
}

function useToast() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<State>(memoryState);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    listeners.push(setState);
    return () => {
      const index = listeners.indexOf(setState);
      if (index > -1) {
        listeners.splice(index, 1);
      }
    };
  }, [state]);

  return {
    ...state,
    toast,
    dismiss: (toastId?: string) => dispatch({ type: 'DISMISS_TOAST', toastId })
  };
}

export { toast, useToast };

=== FILE: ./app/api/stripe/checkout/route.ts ===

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { headers } from 'next/headers';

import { stripe } from '@/lib/stripe';
import { getErrorRedirect, getStatusRedirect } from '@/lib/utils';

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const { priceId, planName, isYearly, source, organizationId } =
      await request.json();
    const headersList = await headers();
    const origin = headersList.get('origin');

    if (!priceId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Price ID is required' },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!planName) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Plan name is required' },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // organizationId is optional - users might not have an organization yet

    // Validate the price ID exists in Stripe
    try {
      const price = await stripe.prices.retrieve(priceId);
      if (!price.active) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: 'Invalid or inactive price ID' },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }
    } catch (stripeError) {
      console.error('Stripe price validation error:', stripeError);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid price ID' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Create Checkout Sessions from body params.
    const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
      line_items: [
        {
          price: priceId,
          quantity: 1
        }
      ],
      mode: 'subscription',
      success_url: getStatusRedirect(
        origin,
        'Success',
        'You have successfully subscribed to the plan.'
      ),
      cancel_url: getErrorRedirect(
        origin,
        'Cancelled',
        'You cancelled the checkout process.'
      ),
      allow_promotion_codes: true,
      subscription_data: {
        trial_period_days: 14,
        metadata: {
          plan_name: planName,
          billing_cycle: isYearly ? 'yearly' : 'monthly',
          source: source || 'unknown',
          organization_id: organizationId
        }
      },
      metadata: {
        plan_name: planName,
        billing_cycle: isYearly ? 'yearly' : 'monthly',
        source: source || 'unknown',
        organization_id: organizationId
      }
    });

    return NextResponse.redirect(session.url, 303);
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof Error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'An unknown error occurred' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const sessionId = searchParams.get('session_id');

    if (!sessionId) {
      return NextResponse.redirect(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/pricing`,
        303
      );
    }

    // Retrieve the session to verify it was successful
    const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.retrieve(sessionId);

    if (
      session.payment_status === 'paid' ||
      session.payment_status === 'unpaid'
    ) {
      // Success - redirect to organization page
      return NextResponse.redirect(
        getStatusRedirect(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/organization`,
          'Success',
          'You have successfully subscribed to the plan.'
        ),
        303
      );
    } else {
      // Payment failed or pending
      return NextResponse.redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/pricing`,
          'Payment Failed',
          'You cancelled the checkout process.'
        ),
        303
      );
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error processing checkout success:', err);
    return NextResponse.redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/pricing`,
        'Checkout Error',
        'An error occurred while processing your checkout.'
      ),
      303
    );
  }
}
