import type {
  GetUserResponse,
  UpdateUserCustomDataResponse
} from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/v2/users';

import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

/**
 * Handles the LinkedIn disconnect request.
 * @param req - The request object.
 * @returns A JSON response.
 */
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  // Setup logger
  const requestId = req.headers.get('x-request-id') ?? getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'linkedin-disconnect');

  try {
    // Log info
    logger.info('Processing LinkedIn disconnect request', {
      url: req.url
    });

    // Get Logto context
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

    // Check if claims are missing or invalid
    if (!claims || !claims.sub) {
      logger.warn('Unauthorized access attempt', {
        url: req.url
      });
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    // Log info
    logger.info('Fetching user data', {
      userId: claims.sub
    });

    // Get user data
    const userResponse: GetUserResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users/logto/${claims.sub}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'x-user-logto-id': claims.sub,
          'x-middleware-bypass-token':
            process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
        }
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());
    const userData =
      userResponse.user.logto ?? userResponse.user.database ?? null;

    const userCustomData =
      (userData?.customData as Record<string, unknown>) ?? null;
    // Update user custom data
    const newCustomData = {
      ...userCustomData,
      linkedin: {
        ...(userCustomData?.linkedin as Record<string, unknown>),
        ...((userCustomData?.linkedin as Record<string, unknown>)?.connected
          ? { connected: false }
          : {}),
        ...((userCustomData?.linkedin as Record<string, unknown>)?.profile_url
          ? {
              profile_url: (userCustomData?.linkedin as Record<string, unknown>)
                .profile_url
            }
          : {})
      }
    };

    // Log info
    logger.info('Updating user custom data', {
      userId: claims.sub
    });

    // Update user custom data
    const updateResponse: UpdateUserCustomDataResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users/${userResponse.user.database.id}/custom-data`,
      {
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          customData: newCustomData,
          linkedinVerified: false
        }),
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'x-user-logto-id': claims.sub,
          'x-middleware-bypass-token':
            process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
        }
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());

    // Check if user custom data is updated successfully
    if (updateResponse.code !== 'user.updated') {
      logger.error('Failed to update user custom data', {
        userId: claims.sub
      });
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Failed to disconnect LinkedIn account' },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    // Log success
    logger.info('Successfully disconnected LinkedIn account', {
      userId: claims.sub
    });

    // Return success response
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) {
    // Log error
    logger.error('Error disconnecting LinkedIn account', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
      url: req.url
    });

    // Return error response
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Failed to disconnect LinkedIn account' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/form-templates/file-attachment-field.tsx ===

import type { DocumentTemplateField } from '@signvault/db/types';
import {
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormControl,
  FormMessage,
  FormDescription
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { useDropzone } from 'react-dropzone';
import type { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { cn } from '@signvault/ui-lib/lib/utils';

import type { JSX } from 'react';

export default function FileAttachmentField({
  field,
  form,
  isImage,
  allowedFileTypes,
  innerContainer,
  className
}: {
  field: DocumentTemplateField;
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  form: ReturnType<typeof useForm<any>>;
  isImage: boolean;
  allowedFileTypes?: string[];
  innerContainer?: JSX.Element;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const onDrop = (acceptedFiles: File[]) => {
    form.setValue(field.name, acceptedFiles[0], { shouldValidate: true });
  };

  const accept = isImage
    ? { 'image/*': [] }
    : allowedFileTypes
      ? { [allowedFileTypes.join(',')]: [] }
      : undefined;

  const { getRootProps, getInputProps, isDragActive } = useDropzone({
    onDrop,
    accept,
    maxSize: 1 * 1024 * 1024, // 1MB
    multiple: false,
    onError: (error) => {
      // console.error('File upload error:', error);
      toast.error(error.message || 'File upload failed. Please try again.');
    }
  });

  const file = form.watch(field.name);

  return (
    <FormField
      control={form.control}
      name={field.name}
      render={() => (
        <FormItem className='space-y-0.5'>
          <FormLabel>
            {field.label}
            {field.required && <span className='text-destructive'>*</span>}
          </FormLabel>
          {field.description && (
            <FormDescription className='whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
              {field.description}
            </FormDescription>
          )}
          <FormControl className=''>
            <div
              {...getRootProps()}
              className={cn(
                'mt-2! cursor-pointer rounded-md border-2 border-dashed p-4 text-center',
                isDragActive ? 'border-primary' : '',
                className
              )}
            >
              {innerContainer && innerContainer}
              <input {...getInputProps()} />
              {file ? (
                <div>
                  <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                    {isImage && (
                      // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                      <img
                        src={URL.createObjectURL(file)}
                        alt='Preview'
                        className='mx-auto max-h-64 max-w-64 object-contain'
                      />
                    )}
                    {file.name}
                  </p>
                  <Button
                    variant='link'
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      form.setValue(field.name, null, {
                        shouldValidate: true
                      });
                    }}
                  >
                    Remove
                  </Button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p
                  className={cn(
                    'text-sm text-muted-foreground',
                    innerContainer && 'hidden'
                  )}
                >
                  {isDragActive
                    ? `Drop the ${isImage ? 'image' : 'file'} here ...`
                    : `Drag 'n' drop ${
                        isImage ? 'an image' : 'a file'
                      } here, or click to select ${isImage ? 'image' : 'file'}`}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </FormControl>
          <FormMessage />
        </FormItem>
      )}
    />
  );
}

export default function BlockNoteEditor({
  content,
  onChange,
  ...props
}: Readonly<BlockNoteEditorProps>) {
  const editor = useCreateBlockNote();
  const [html, setHtml] = useState(content);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function updateContent() {
      if (content) {
        const blocks = await editor.blocksToFullHTML(editor.document);
        setHtml(blocks);
      }
    }
    updateContent();
  }, [content, editor]);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadInitialHTML() {
      const blocks = await editor.tryParseHTMLToBlocks(content);
      editor.replaceBlocks(editor.document, blocks);
    }
    loadInitialHTML();
  }, [editor]);

  // Handle editor changes
  const handleChange = async () => {
    const html = await editor.blocksToHTMLLossy(editor.document);
    setHtml(html);
    onChange(html);
  };

  return (
    <BlockNoteView
      className='font-raleway! pt-2'
      editor={editor}
      formattingToolbar={false}
      onChange={handleChange}
      shadCNComponents={{
        Badge: {
          Badge: ({ className, variant, ...props }) => (
            <Badge className={className} variant={variant} {...props} />
          )
        },
        Button: {
          Button
        },
        Card: {
          Card,
          CardContent
        },

        },

'use client';

import { Suspense } from 'react';
import type { OrganizationSourceSystem } from '@signvault/db/types';
import SourceSystemsTable from './source-systems-table';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Loader2, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import type { GetOrganizationSourceSystemsByOrganizationIdResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organization-source-systems';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';
import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore } from '@/lib/utils';

async function fetchSourceSystems(
  organizationId: string,
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies
) {
  clientLogger.info('Fetching source systems', {
    organizationId
  });
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  const response = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organization-source-systems/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      },
      cache: 'no-store'
    }
  );
  if (!response.ok) {
    clientLogger.error('Failed to fetch source systems', {
      response,
      organizationId
    });
    throw new Error('Failed to fetch source systems');
  }
  const data: GetOrganizationSourceSystemsByOrganizationIdResponse =
    await response.json();
  if (data.message !== 'Organization source systems retrieved successfully') {
    clientLogger.error('Failed to fetch source systems', {
      response,
      organizationId
    });
    throw new Error('Failed to fetch source systems');
  }

  return data.organizationSourceSystems.database;
}

export default function SourceSystemsPage({
  organizationId,
  organizationSourceSystems,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<{
  organizationId: string;
  organizationSourceSystems: OrganizationSourceSystem[];
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}>) {
  clientLogger.info('Rendering source systems page', {
    organizationId,
    organizationSourceSystems
  });
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { data: sourceSystems = [], isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['sourceSystems', organizationId],
    queryFn: () => fetchSourceSystems(organizationId, cookieStore),
    initialData: organizationSourceSystems
  });

  const onUpdate = () => {
    clientLogger.info('Invalidating source systems query', {
      organizationId
    });
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({
      queryKey: ['sourceSystems', organizationId]
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className='-mt-2 space-y-6'>
      <div className='flex items-center justify-between'>
        <Link
          href={`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/source-systems/create`}
        >
          <Button>
            <Plus className='mr-2 h-4 w-4' />
            Create Source System
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </div>
      <Suspense
        fallback={
          <div className='flex h-40 items-center justify-center'>
            <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
          </div>
        }
      >
        <SourceSystemsTable
          cookieStore={cookieStore}
          organizationId={organizationId}
          sourceSystems={sourceSystems}
          onUpdate={onUpdate}
          isLoading={isLoading}
        />
      </Suspense>
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/organizations/[organizationId]/teams/create/page.tsx ===

import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getErrorRedirect,
  validateOrganizationAccess
} from '@/lib/utils';
import CreateTeamForm from './create-team-form';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { ROLES } from '@signvault/logto';
import type { GetOrganizationUsersResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/organizations';
import type { GetUserOrganizationsByOrganizationResponse } from '@signvault/backend/routes/user-organizations';

export default async function CreateTeamPage({
  params
}: Readonly<{
  params: Readonly<{ organizationId: string }>;
}>) {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const data = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookieStore.getAll());
  const organizationId = (await params).organizationId;

  // 0. check if the user is authenticated
  if (!data.isAuthenticated) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/`,
        'Not Logged In',
        'You are not logged in. Please log in to continue.'
      )
    );
  }

  // 1. Validate organization access and role
  const validationError = await validateOrganizationAccess(
    data.claims.sub,
    organizationId,
    ROLES.L5_USER.id,
    cookieString,
    `/account/organizations/${organizationId}`
  );

  if (validationError) {
    return validationError;
  }

  // 2. fetch all users in the organization
  const usersResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}/users?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  const users: GetOrganizationUsersResponse = await usersResponse.json();

  const allUsers = users.users;

  if (users.message !== 'Organization users retrieved successfully') {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}`,
        'Failed to fetch users',
        'Failed to fetch users. Please try again later.'
      )
    );
  }

  if (allUsers.database.length === 0 && allUsers.logto.length === 0) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}`,
        'No users found',
        'No users found in this organization. Please add users to the organization first.'
      )
    );
  }

  if (allUsers.database.length === 1 || allUsers.logto.length === 1) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}`,
        'Cannot create team',
        'You cannot create a team with only one user. Please add other users to the organization first.'
      )
    );
  }

  const userOrganizationsResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/user-organizations/organization/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  const userOrganizationsResult: GetUserOrganizationsByOrganizationResponse =
    await userOrganizationsResponse.json();

  const userOrganizations = userOrganizationsResult.userOrganizations;

  if (
    userOrganizationsResult.message !==
    'User organizations retrieved successfully'
  ) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}`,
        'Failed to fetch data',
        'Failed to fetch users and organization data. Please try again later.'
      )
    );
  }

  return (
    <CreateTeamForm
      organizationId={organizationId}
      users={allUsers}
      userOrganizations={userOrganizations}
      cookieString={cookieString}
      user={data.claims}
    />
  );
}

      setSelectedTab,
      viewType,
      setViewType,

      teamId,
      userId,
      processedEvents,
      setProcessedEvents
    ]
  );

  return (
    <CalendarContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
      <CalendarNewEventDialog />
      <CalendarManageEventDialog />
      <CalendarDayEventsDialog
        date={date}
        isAdmin={true}
        onOpenChange={setDayEventsDialogOpen}
        open={dayEventsDialogOpen}
        organizationId={organizationId}
        processedEvents={processedEvents}
        teamId={teamId}
      />
    </CalendarContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useCalendarContext() {
  const context = useContext(CalendarContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error(
      'useCalendarContext must be used within a CalendarProvider'
    );
  }
  return context;

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/organizations/[organizationId]/teams/[teamId]/events/[eventId]/attendees/page.tsx ===

import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getErrorRedirect,
  validateOrganizationAccess
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { ROLES } from '@signvault/logto';
import type { GetTeamCalendarEventResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/team-calendar-events';
import type { GetTeamMembersResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/teams';
import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
import { AttendeesList } from './attendees-list';

export default async function AttendeesPage({
  params
}: Readonly<{
  params: Readonly<{
    organizationId: string;
    teamId: string;
    eventId: string;
  }>;
}>) {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const data = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookieStore.getAll());
  const { organizationId, teamId, eventId } = params;

  // 0. check if the user is authenticated
  if (!data.isAuthenticated) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/`,
        'Not Logged In',
        'You are not logged in. Please log in to continue.'
      )
    );
  }

  // 1. Validate organization access
  const validationError = await validateOrganizationAccess(
    data.claims.sub,
    organizationId,
    ROLES.L1_USER.id,
    cookieString,
    `/account/organizations/${organizationId}`
  );

  if (validationError) {
    return validationError;
  }

  // 2. Fetch event details
  const eventResponse: GetTeamCalendarEventResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-calendar-events/event/${eventId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (eventResponse.message !== 'Team calendar event retrieved successfully') {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}/events`,
        'Event Not Found',
        'The requested event could not be found.'
      )
    );
  }

  // 3. Fetch team members for adding new attendees
  const membersResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${teamId}/members?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  const { members, message: teamMembersMessage }: GetTeamMembersResponse =
    await membersResponse.json();

  if (teamMembersMessage !== 'Team members retrieved successfully') {
    logger.error('Error retrieving team members', {
      organizationId,
      teamId,
      error: teamMembersMessage,
      payload: members
    });

    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}/events/${eventId}`,
        'Team Members Error',
        'There was an error retrieving the team members. Error details: ' +
          teamMembersMessage
      )
    );
  }

  // 4. Check if user has access to manage the event
  const isCreator = eventResponse.event.database.createdBy === data.claims.sub;
  const canManageEvent =
    isCreator ||
    (await validateOrganizationAccess(
      data.claims.sub,
      organizationId,
      ROLES.L5_USER.id,
      cookieString,
      `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}/events/${eventId}`
    )) === undefined;

  return (
    <AttendeesList
      event={eventResponse.event.database}
      teamMembers={members}
      organizationId={organizationId}
      teamId={teamId}
      canManageEvent={canManageEvent}
      cookieString={cookieString}
      user={{ ...data.claims, id: data.claims.sub }}
    />
  );
}

=== FILE: ./components/calendar/body/day/calendar-body-day-events.tsx ===

import { addDays, differenceInDays, isSameDay } from 'date-fns';
import { Calendar, CalendarDays } from 'lucide-react';

import { useCalendarContext } from '../../calendar-context';

export default function CalendarBodyDayEvents() {
  const { events, date, setManageEventDialogOpen, setSelectedEvent } =
    useCalendarContext();
  // exclude full day events
  const singleDayEvents = events.filter(
    (event) =>
      isSameDay(event.startDate, date) &&
      differenceInDays(event.endDate, event.startDate) === 0
  );

  const validMultiDayEvents = events.filter((event) => {
    const validDays: Date[] = [];
    for (
      let i = 0;
      i < differenceInDays(event.endDate, event.startDate) + 1;
      i++
    ) {
      validDays.push(addDays(event.startDate, i));
    }
    return validDays.some(
      (day) =>
        day.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0).toString() ===
        date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0).toString()
    );
  });

  if (!singleDayEvents.length && !validMultiDayEvents.length) {
    return (
      <div className='p-4 text-center text-muted-foreground'>
        No events scheduled for today...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className='flex flex-col gap-6 p-4'>
      {singleDayEvents.length > 0 && (
        <div className='space-y-3'>
          <div className='font-heading flex items-center gap-2 font-medium'>
            <Calendar className='size-5' />
            <h3>Single Day Events</h3>
          </div>
          <div className='flex flex-col gap-2 pl-7'>
            {singleDayEvents.map((event) => (
              <div
                className='flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-md p-2 transition-colors hover:bg-muted/50'
                key={event.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectedEvent(event);
                  setManageEventDialogOpen(true);
                }}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    setSelectedEvent(event);
                    setManageEventDialogOpen(true);
                  }
                }}
                role='button'
                tabIndex={0}
              >
                <div className={`bg- size-3 rounded-full${event.color}-500`} />
                <p className='text-sm font-medium'>{event.title}</p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {validMultiDayEvents.length > 0 && (
        <div className='space-y-3'>
          <div className='font-heading flex items-center gap-2 font-medium'>
            <CalendarDays className='size-5' />
            <h3>Multi-Day Events</h3>
          </div>
          <div className='flex flex-col gap-2 pl-7'>
            {Array.from(
              new Set(validMultiDayEvents).difference(new Set(singleDayEvents))
            ).map((event) => (
              <div
                className='flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-md p-2 transition-colors hover:bg-muted/50'
                key={event.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectedEvent(event);
                  setManageEventDialogOpen(true);
                }}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {

                    setSelectedEvent(event);

                tabIndex={0}
              >

                <p className='text-sm font-medium'>{event.title}</p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./components/event-data.tsx ===

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Badge } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/badge';

/**
 * Recursive component that renders arbitrary JSON (event data) in a vertically
 * flowing layout. Keys are rendered as outlined badges and values are rendered
 * below each key, indented for hierarchy, with connecting branches.
 */

// Helper for branch lines
function BranchLines({ isLast, depth }: { isLast: boolean; depth: number }) {
  // Only render for depth > 0
  if (depth === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: 'absolute',
        left: 0,
        top: 0,
        bottom: isLast ? '50%' : 0,
        width: 16,
        height: '100%',
        pointerEvents: 'none'
      }}
      aria-hidden
    >
      {/* Vertical line */}
      <div
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          left: 7,
          top: 0,
          bottom: isLast ? '50%' : 0,
          width: 1,
          height: '100%',
          background: 'var(--line)'
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function HorizontalBranch() {
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: 'absolute',
        left: 7,
        top: 12,
        width: 10,
        height: 1,
        background: 'var(--line)'
      }}
      aria-hidden
    />
  );
}

export function EventData({
  data,
  depth = 0,
  isLast = true
}: {
  data: unknown;
  depth?: number;
  isLast?: boolean;
}) {
  // Handle null / undefined early
  if (data === null || typeof data === 'undefined') {
    return <span className='text-muted-foreground'>N/A</span>;
  }

  // Primitive rendering -----------------------------------------------------
  if (typeof data === 'boolean') {
    return (
      <Badge variant={data ? 'default' : 'destructive'}>{String(data)}</Badge>
    );
  }

  if (typeof data === 'string' || typeof data === 'number') {
    return <span>{String(data)}</span>;
  }

  // Complex rendering -------------------------------------------------------
  // Arrays – render each item on its own line with indentation and branches
  if (Array.isArray(data)) {
    return (
      <div className='relative space-y-0' style={{ paddingLeft: depth * 8 }}>
        {data.map((item, idx) => (
          <div key={idx} className='relative'>
            <BranchLines isLast={idx === data.length - 1} depth={depth + 1} />
            <HorizontalBranch />
            <div style={{ marginLeft: 16 }}>
              <EventData
                data={item}
                depth={depth + 1}
                isLast={idx === data.length - 1}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Objects – iterate through keys & values recursively, with branches
  if (typeof data === 'object') {
    const entries = Object.entries(data);
    return (
      <div className='relative space-y-0' style={{ paddingLeft: depth * 8 }}>
        {entries.map(([key, value], idx) => (
          <div key={key} className='relative'>
            <BranchLines
              isLast={idx === entries.length - 1}
              depth={depth + 1}
            />
            <HorizontalBranch />
            <div style={{ marginLeft: 16 }}>
              <Badge
                variant='outline'
                className='my-1 border-primary/20 bg-primary/10 text-xs font-medium text-primary'
              >
                {key}
              </Badge>
              <div className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                <EventData
                  data={value}
                  depth={depth + 1}
                  isLast={idx === entries.length - 1}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Fallback (should not generally hit)
  return <span>{String(data)}</span>;
}

=== FILE: ./components/form/file-upload.tsx ===

'use client';

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import type { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { useDropzone } from 'react-dropzone';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  FormControl,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { UploadCloud, X } from 'lucide-react';

type FileUploadProps = {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  form: ReturnType<typeof useForm<any>>;
  accept?: Record<string, string[]>;
  existingFileName?: string | null;
};

export function FileUpload({
  name,
  label,
  form,
  accept,
  existingFileName: initialExistingFileName
}: FileUploadProps) {
  const [currentFile, setCurrentFile] = useState<File | null>(
    form.getValues(name)
  );
  const [existingFileName, setExistingFileName] = useState<string | null>(
    initialExistingFileName ?? null
  );

  const onDrop = useCallback(
    (acceptedFiles: File[]) => {
      if (acceptedFiles.length > 0) {
        const file = acceptedFiles[0];
        setCurrentFile(file);
        form.setValue(name, file, { shouldValidate: true });
        setExistingFileName(null);
      }
    },
    [form, name]
  );

  const { getRootProps, getInputProps, isDragActive } = useDropzone({
    onDrop,
    multiple: false,
    accept: accept ?? { 'application/pdf': ['.pdf'] }
  });

  const handleRemoveFile = () => {
    setCurrentFile(null);
    form.setValue(name, undefined, { shouldValidate: true });
    setExistingFileName(null);
  };

  const file = form.watch(name);
  const fieldState = form.getFieldState(name);

  return (
    <FormItem>
      <FormLabel>{label}</FormLabel>
      <FormControl>
        <div
          {...getRootProps()}
          className={`focus:outline-hidden flex h-32 w-full cursor-pointer appearance-none flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-md border-2 border-dashed bg-background px-4 transition hover:border-primary ${
            isDragActive ? 'border-primary' : 'border-input'
          }`}
        >
          <input {...getInputProps()} />
          {file ? (
            <div className='text-center'>
              <p className='truncate font-medium'>{file.name}</p>
              <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                Type: {file.type}, Size: {(file.size / 1024).toFixed(2)} KB
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : existingFileName ? (
            <div className='text-center'>
              <p className='truncate font-medium'>
                Current file: {existingFileName}
              </p>
              <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
                Drop a new file here to replace it.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : isDragActive ? (
            <p className='text-muted-foreground'>Drop the file here ...</p>
          ) : (
            <div className='flex flex-col items-center'>
              <UploadCloud className='size-8 text-muted-foreground' />
              <p className='mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
                <span className='font-semibold'>Click to upload</span> or drag
                and drop
              </p>
              <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>(PDF, max 1MB)</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </FormControl>
      {(file || existingFileName) && (
        <Button
          type='button'
          variant='outline'
          size='sm'
          className='mt-2'
          onClick={handleRemoveFile}
        >
          <X className='mr-2 size-4' />
          Remove file
        </Button>
      )}
      {fieldState.error && (
        <FormMessage>{fieldState.error.message}</FormMessage>
      )}
    </FormItem>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/api/auth/linkedin/connect/route.ts ===

import type {
  GetUserResponse,
  UpdateUserCustomDataResponse
} from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/v2/users';

import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';

/**
 * Handles the LinkedIn connect request.
 * @param req - The request object.
 * @returns A JSON response.
 */
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  // Setup logger
  const requestId = req.headers.get('x-request-id') ?? getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'linkedin-connect');

  try {
    // Log info
    logger.info('Processing LinkedIn connect request', {
      url: req.url
    });

    // Get Logto context
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

    // Check if claims are missing or invalid
    if (!claims || !claims.sub) {
      logger.warn('Unauthorized access attempt', {
        url: req.url
      });
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    // Get code from request
    const { code } = await req.json();
    logger.info('Received LinkedIn code', { code });

    // Get user data
    const userResponse: GetUserResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users/logto/${claims.sub}`,
      {
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'x-user-logto-id': claims.sub,
          'x-middleware-bypass-token':
            process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
        }
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());

    logger.info('Fetched user data', {
      userId: claims.sub
    });

    // Get user data
    const userData =
      userResponse.user.logto ?? userResponse.user.database ?? null;

    // Update user custom data
    const newCustomData = {
      ...(userData.customData as Record<string, unknown>),
      linkedin: {
        ...((userData.customData as Record<string, unknown>).linkedin as Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >),
        connected: true,
        connected_at: new Date().toISOString()
      }
    };

    // Update user custom data
    const updateResponse: UpdateUserCustomDataResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/users/${userResponse.user.database.id}/custom-data`,
      {
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          customData: newCustomData,
          linkedinVerified: true
        }),
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'x-user-logto-id': claims.sub,
          'x-middleware-bypass-token':
            process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
        }
      }
    ).then((res) => res.json());

    // Check if user custom data is updated successfully
    if (updateResponse.code !== 'user.updated') {
      logger.error('Failed to update user custom data', {
        userId: userResponse.user.database.id
      });
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Failed to connect LinkedIn account' },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    // Log success
    logger.info('LinkedIn account connected successfully', {
      userId: userResponse.user.database.id
    });

    // Return success response
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) {
    // Log error
    logger.error('Error connecting LinkedIn account', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
      url: req.url
    });

    // Return error response
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Failed to connect LinkedIn account' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/organizations/[organizationId]/content/delete-content-dialog.tsx ===

'use client';

import type { Content, Organization } from '@signvault/db/types';
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';
import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function DeleteContentDialog({
  content,
  onClose,
  organization,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<{
  content: Content | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  organization: Pick<Organization, 'id'>;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}>) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  if (!content) return null;

  clientLogger.info('Rendering delete content dialog', {
    contentId: content.id,
    organizationId: organization.id
  });

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    clientLogger.info('Deleting content', {
      contentId: content.id,
      organizationId: organization.id
    });
    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/content/${content.id}?organizationId=${organization.id}`,
        {
          method: 'DELETE',
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          }
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to delete content');

      toast.success('Content deleted successfully');
      router.refresh();
      router.push(`/account/organizations/${organization.id}/content`);
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error('Error deleting content', {
        contentId: content.id,
        organizationId: organization.id,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
      });
      toast.error('Failed to delete content');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      onClose();
    }
  };

  return (
    <AlertDialog open={!!content} onOpenChange={() => onClose()}>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>Are you absolutely sure?</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>
            This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete{' '}
            <span className='font-medium'>{content.title}</span> and remove it
            from our servers.
          </AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel disabled={isLoading}>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            onClick={handleDelete}
            disabled={isLoading}
            className='bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90'
          >
            {isLoading ? 'Deleting...' : 'Delete'}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts ===

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { headers } from 'next/headers';
import Stripe from 'stripe';
import {
  handleSubscriptionCreatedWebhook,
  handleSubscriptionUpdatedWebhook,
  handleSubscriptionDeletedWebhook
} from '@/actions/subscriptions';

const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY!, {
  apiVersion: '2025-08-27.basil'
});

const webhookSecret = process.env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET!;

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const body = await request.text();
  const headersList = await headers();
  const signature = headersList.get('stripe-signature')!;

  let event: Stripe.Event;

  try {
    event = stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(body, signature, webhookSecret);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Webhook signature verification failed:', err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Webhook signature verification failed' },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  try {
    switch (event.type) {
      case 'checkout.session.completed':
        const session = event.data.object as Stripe.Checkout.Session;
        console.log('Checkout session completed:', session.id);
        console.log('Session metadata:', session.metadata);
        console.log('Session customer:', session.customer);

        if (session.mode === 'subscription' && session.subscription) {
          // Handle subscription creation
          await handleSubscriptionCreatedWebhook(
            session.subscription as string,
            session.customer as string,
            session.metadata?.plan_name || 'Unknown',
            'active',
            session.metadata?.organization_id
          );
        }
        break;

      case 'customer.subscription.created':
        const newSubscription = event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription;
        console.log('Subscription created:', newSubscription.id);
        console.log('Subscription metadata:', newSubscription.metadata);
        console.log('Subscription customer:', newSubscription.customer);
        await handleSubscriptionCreatedWebhook(
          newSubscription.id,
          newSubscription.customer as string,
          newSubscription.metadata?.plan_name || 'Unknown',
          newSubscription.status,
          newSubscription.metadata?.organization_id
        );
        break;

      case 'customer.subscription.updated':
        const updatedSubscription = event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription;
        console.log('Subscription updated:', updatedSubscription.id);
        await handleSubscriptionUpdatedWebhook(
          updatedSubscription.id,
          updatedSubscription.status
        );
        break;

      case 'customer.subscription.deleted':
        const deletedSubscription = event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription;
        console.log('Subscription deleted:', deletedSubscription.id);
        await handleSubscriptionDeletedWebhook(deletedSubscription.id);
        break;

      case 'customer.subscription.resumed':
      case 'customer.subscription.paused':
        const modifiedSubscription = event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription;
        console.log(`Subscription ${event.type}:`, modifiedSubscription.id);
        await handleSubscriptionUpdatedWebhook(
          modifiedSubscription.id,
          modifiedSubscription.status
        );
        break;

      default:
        console.log(`Unhandled event type ${event.type}`);
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ received: true });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error processing webhook:', error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Webhook processing failed' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

'use client';

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import type { Content, Organization } from '@signvault/db/types';
import ContentList from './content-list';
import ContentStats from './content-stats';
import { Suspense } from 'react';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import type { GetContentByOrganizationResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/content';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';
import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore } from '@/lib/utils';

async function fetchContents(
  organizationId: string,
  logger: any,
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies
) {
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  try {
    logger.info('Fetching contents for organization', {
      organizationId
    });

    const response = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/contents/organization/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
      {
        next: {
          tags: ['content'],
          revalidate: 60 // Revalidate every minute
        },
        headers: {
          'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString,
          'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
            ? cookieStore.toString()
            : cookieString
        }
      }
    );

    const data: GetContentByOrganizationResponse = await response.json();

    if (data.message !== 'Content retrieved successfully') {
      throw new Error('Failed to fetch contents');
    }

    return data.contents.database;
  } catch (error) {
    clientLogger.error('Error fetching contents', {
      organizationId,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
      payload: {
        organizationId,
        cookieString
      }
    });
    throw error;
  }
}

export default function ContentPage({
  organizationId,
  contents: initialContents,
  organization,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<{
  organizationId: string;
  contents: Content[];
  organization: Organization;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}>) {
  const logger = clientLogger;

  const { data: contentsData, isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['contents', organizationId],
    queryFn: () => fetchContents(organizationId, logger, cookieStore),
    initialData: initialContents,
    throwOnError: (error, query) => {
      logger.error('Query error fetching contents', {
        organizationId,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
      });
      return true;
    }
  });

  logger.info('Rendering content page', {
    organizationId,
    contentsCount: contentsData?.length || 0,
    isLoading
  });

  const contents = contentsData || [];

  return (
    <div className='space-y-6'>
      <Suspense
        fallback={
          <div className='flex h-40 items-center justify-center'>
            <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
          </div>
        }
      >
        <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-3'>
          <ContentStats contents={contents} />
        </div>
        <ContentList
          contents={contents}
          isLoading={isLoading}
          organization={organization}
          cookieStore={cookieStore}
        />
      </Suspense>
    </div>
  );
}

export default async function OnboardingPage() {
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'onboarding');
  const socCodes = await getSocCodes();

  logger.info('Accessing onboarding page');

  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

  if (!claims) {
    logger.warn('No claims found, redirecting to sign-in');
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/',
        'Not Logged In',
        'You must be logged in to complete onboarding.'
      )
    );
  }

  const user = await getDbUser({ claims });

  if (!user) {
    logger.error('User not found in database', {
      userId: claims.sub
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect('/', 'User Not Found', 'User not found in database.')
    );
  }

  if (user.onboardingCompleted) {
    logger.info(
      'Onboarding already completed, redirecting to organization settings'
    );
    return redirect('/account/settings/organization');
  }

  return (
    <main className='mx-auto max-w-5xl rounded-lg bg-secondary p-6'>
      <h1 className='mb-4 text-2xl font-semibold'>
        Complete Your SignVault Profile
      </h1>
      <div className='mb-6 rounded-lg border border-line bg-background p-4'>
        <h2 className='mb-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-base'>
          <Info className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' strokeWidth={2} /> Next Steps
        </h2>
        <ul className='list-inside list-disc text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
          <li>
            Please fill out the form below to complete your SignVault profile.
          </li>
          <li>
            You will automatically get redirected to the account page after
            completing the form.
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <OnboardingForm socCodes={socCodes} user={user as UserCS} />
    </main>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/documents/document-thumbnail.tsx ===

'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Document, Page, pdfjs } from 'react-pdf';
import { Loader2, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import type { DocumentCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { getTemporaryDocumentUrl } from '@/actions/documents';
import { usePreviewCacheStore } from '@/app/(user)/account/documents/preview-cache-store-provider';
import { DocumentStatusHighlight } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/document-status-highlight';

pdfjs.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = `//unpkg.com/pdfjs-dist@${pdfjs.version}/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs`;

type DocumentThumbnailProps = {
  doc: DocumentCS;
};

export function DocumentThumbnail({ doc }: Readonly<DocumentThumbnailProps>) {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(Boolean(doc?.s3Key));
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);
  const [containerWidth, setContainerWidth] = useState<number | undefined>();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const previewCache = usePreviewCacheStore();

  // Observe visibility and measure container width
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ref.current) return;

    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        setInView(entry.isIntersecting);
      },
      { rootMargin: '200px' }
    );
    io.observe(ref.current);

    const measure = () => {
      if (ref.current) setContainerWidth(ref.current.clientWidth);
    };
    measure();
    window.addEventListener('resize', measure);

    return () => {
      io.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener('resize', measure);
    };
  }, []);

  // Fetch temporary URL only when visible, using cache
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!doc?.s3Key || !inView || url || error) return;
    const cached = previewCache.getUrl(doc.s3Key);
    if (cached) {
      setUrl(cached);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    getTemporaryDocumentUrl(doc.s3Key)
      .then((u) => {
        if (doc.s3Key) {
          previewCache.setUrl(doc.s3Key, u);
        }
        setUrl(u);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        setError('preview');
        if (doc.s3Key) {
          previewCache.deleteUrl(doc.s3Key);
        }
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [doc?.s3Key, inView, url, error, previewCache]);

  const isPdf = doc?.mimeType?.startsWith('application/pdf');

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className='relative flex aspect-video w-full items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-muted'
    >
      <DocumentStatusHighlight
        status={doc?.status}
        className='absolute left-2 top-2 z-[1] rounded-sm md:left-3 md:top-3 lg:left-3 lg:top-3'
      />
      {loading && <Loader2 className='size-5 animate-spin text-primary' />}
      {!loading && (!isPdf || !url || error) && (
        <FileText className='size-6 text-muted-foreground' />
      )}
      {!loading && isPdf && url && (
        <Document
          file={url}
          loading={null}
          error={null}
          className={'absolute top-0 scale-90 rounded-md'}
        >
          <Page
            pageNumber={1}
            width={containerWidth ? Math.min(containerWidth, 520) : undefined}
            renderAnnotationLayer={false}
            renderTextLayer={false}
            className='shadow-sm'
          />
        </Document>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default DocumentThumbnail;

export default async function OrganizationsPageWrapper() {
  const logger = getServerLogger(getRandomUUID(), 'organizations-page');
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const cookiesStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookiesStore);

  if (!claims) {
    return redirect('/');
  }

  const userOrganizationsResponse: GetUserOrganizationsResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/users/${claims.sub}/organizations`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookiesStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  const userOrganizations =
    userOrganizationsResponse.organizations.logto ??
    userOrganizationsResponse.organizations.database ??
    null;

  if (!userOrganizations || userOrganizations.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className='flex h-screen items-center justify-center'>
        <div className='text-center'>
          <h1 className='text-2xl font-bold'>No organizations found</h1>
          <p className='text-foreground/70'>
            You don't have any organizations yet. Create one to get started.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  logger.info('Rendering organizations page', {
    userId: claims?.sub,
    organizationsCount: userOrganizations.length
  });

  return (
    <OrganizationsPage
      userOrganizations={userOrganizations as UserOrganization[]}
    />
  );
}

'use server';

import Stripe from 'stripe';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { type OrganizationCS, type UserCS } from '@signvault/db/types';

export async function createCheckoutSession({
  organization,
  user,
  priceId
}: {
  organization: OrganizationCS | null;
  user: UserCS | null;
  priceId: string;
}) {
  const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY!, {
    apiVersion: '2025-08-27.basil'
  });

  if (!organization || !user) {
    redirect(`/sign-up?redirect=checkout&priceId=${priceId}`);
  }

  const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
    line_items: [
      {
        price: priceId,
        quantity: 1
      }
    ],
    mode: 'subscription',
    success_url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/stripe/checkout?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}`,
    cancel_url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/#pricing`,
    customer: organization.stripeCustomerId || undefined,
    client_reference_id: user.id.toString(),
    allow_promotion_codes: true,
    subscription_data: {
      trial_period_days: 14
    }
  });

  redirect(session.url!);
}

export async function createCustomerPortalSession(
  organization: OrganizationCS
) {
  const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY!, {
    apiVersion: '2025-08-27.basil'
  });

  if (!organization.stripeCustomerId || !organization.stripeProductId) {
    redirect('/#pricing');
  }

  let configuration: Stripe.BillingPortal.Configuration;
  const configurations = await stripe.billingPortal.configurations.list();

  if (configurations.data.length > 0) {
    configuration = configurations.data[0];
  } else {
    const product = await stripe.products.retrieve(
      organization.stripeProductId
    );
    if (!product.active) {
      throw new Error("Team's product is not active in Stripe");
    }

    const prices = await stripe.prices.list({
      product: product.id,
      active: true
    });
    if (prices.data.length === 0) {
      throw new Error("No active prices found for the team's product");
    }

    configuration = await stripe.billingPortal.configurations.create({
      business_profile: {
        headline: 'Manage your subscription'
      },
      features: {
        subscription_update: {
          enabled: true,
          default_allowed_updates: ['price', 'quantity', 'promotion_code'],
          proration_behavior: 'create_prorations',
          products: [
            {
              product: product.id,
              prices: prices.data.map((price) => price.id)
            }
          ]
        },
        subscription_cancel: {
          enabled: true,
          mode: 'at_period_end',
          cancellation_reason: {
            enabled: true,
            options: [
              'too_expensive',
              'missing_features',
              'switched_service',
              'unused',
              'other'
            ]
          }
        },
        payment_method_update: {
          enabled: true
        }
      }
    });
  }

  return stripe.billingPortal.sessions.create({
    customer: organization.stripeCustomerId,
    return_url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/organization`,
    configuration: configuration.id
  });
}

export async function getPlans() {
  const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY!, {
    apiVersion: '2025-08-27.basil'
  });

  const { data: plans } = await stripe.plans.list();

  return plans;
}

'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { Events, ProvenanceRecords } from '@signvault/db/types';
import debounce from 'lodash/debounce';
import { RecordsPageControls } from './records-page-controls';
import { RecordList } from './record-list';
import { TrailView } from './trail-view';
import {
  Tabs,
  TabsContent,
  TabsList,
  TabsTrigger
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/tabs';

export function RecordsPage({
  provenanceRecords,
  provenanceEvents
}: {
  provenanceRecords: ProvenanceRecords[];
  provenanceEvents: Events[];
}) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('list');
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<'date' | 'document' | 'type'>('date');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'grid' | 'list'>('list');
  const [selectedRecordId, setSelectedRecordId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const debouncedSearch = useMemo(
    () =>
      debounce((value: string) => {
        setSearch(value);
      }, 300),
    []
  );

  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = [...provenanceRecords];

    if (search) {
      const searchLower = search.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          item.entityType.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          String(item.id).includes(searchLower)
      );
    }

    filtered.sort((a, b) => {
      switch (sortBy) {
        case 'date':
          return (
            new Date(b.associationTimestamp).getTime() -
            new Date(a.associationTimestamp).getTime()
          );
        case 'document':
          return a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
        case 'type':
          return a.entityType.localeCompare(b.entityType);
        default:
          return 0;
      }
    });

    return filtered;
  }, [provenanceRecords, search, sortBy]);

  const handleRecordSelect = (recordId: string | null) => {
    setSelectedRecordId(recordId);
    if (recordId) {
      setActiveTab('trail');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className='space-y-6'>
      <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab}>
        <div className='mb-6 mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between'>
          <TabsList className='w-fit'>
            <TabsTrigger value='list'>Tabular View</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value='trail'>Trail View</TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>

          {activeTab === 'list' && (
            <RecordsPageControls
              onSearch={debouncedSearch}
              onSortChange={(value) =>
                setSortBy(value as 'date' | 'document' | 'type')
              }
              sortBy={sortBy}
              onViewModeChange={setViewMode}
              viewMode={viewMode}
            />
          )}
        </div>

        <TabsContent value='list'>
          <RecordList
            records={filteredData}
            viewMode={viewMode}
            onRecordSelect={handleRecordSelect}
          />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value='trail'>
          <TrailView
            records={provenanceRecords}
            selectedRecordId={selectedRecordId}
            onRecordSelect={handleRecordSelect}
          />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./actions/document-access-controls.ts ===

'use server';

import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import { usersCS, activeTeamsCS } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_';
import type { DocumentAccessControlCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  createDocumentAccessControl,
  updateDocumentAccessControl,
  deleteDocumentAccessControl,
  listDocumentAccessControls
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud/document-access-controls/operations';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getDbUser } from '@/actions/auth';

export async function getAccessControlsForDocument(
  documentId: bigint | string
) {
  const documentIdBig = BigInt(documentId);
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
  if (!dbUser) return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' } as const;
  const res = await listDocumentAccessControls(
    { page: 1, limit: 500, sortBy: 'createdAt', sortOrder: 'desc' },
    { documentId: documentIdBig }
  );

  const documentAccessControls = res.documentAccessControls || [];

  // Minimal hydration example: fetch first matching user/team for preview; full hydration can be added later
  const firstUserId = documentAccessControls.find((d) => d.userId)?.userId;
  const firstTeamId = documentAccessControls.find((d) => d.teamId)?.teamId;

  const [firstUser, firstTeam] = await Promise.all([
    firstUserId
      ? db
          .select()
          .from(usersCS)
          .where(eq(usersCS.id, BigInt(firstUserId)))
      : Promise.resolve([]),
    firstTeamId
      ? db
          .select()
          .from(activeTeamsCS)
          .where(eq(activeTeamsCS.id, BigInt(firstTeamId)))
      : Promise.resolve([])
  ]);

  return {
    success: true,
    data: documentAccessControls,
    users: firstUser,
    teams: firstTeam
  } as const;
}

export async function addAccessControl(
  data: Omit<DocumentAccessControlCS, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>
) {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
  if (!dbUser) return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' } as const;
  const res = await createDocumentAccessControl(data);
  return {
    success: res.code === 'document.access.control.created',
    code: res.code,
    data: res.documentAccessControl
  } as const;
}

export async function updateAccessControl(
  id: bigint | string,
  data: Partial<Omit<DocumentAccessControlCS, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>>
) {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
  if (!dbUser) return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' } as const;
  const res = await updateDocumentAccessControl(id, data);
  return {
    success: res.code === 'document.access.control.updated',
    code: res.code,
    data: res.documentAccessControl
  } as const;
}

export async function removeAccessControl(id: bigint | string) {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
  if (!dbUser) return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' } as const;
  const res = await deleteDocumentAccessControl(id);
  return {
    success: res.code === 'document.access.control.deleted',
    code: res.code
  } as const;
}

/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any */

import { ShortIdMapper } from '@signvault/core-lib';
import type { Task, Stage } from './types';

export const createNewTask = (
  order: number,
  type: Task['taskType'] = 'APPROVAL'
): Task => {
  const { shortId, uuid } = ShortIdMapper.generatePair();

  return {
    id: shortId,
    uuid,
    order,
    userId: '',
    taskType: type,
    description: '',
    deadline: {
      type: 'RELATIVE',
      value: 24
    },
    dependencies: []
  };
};

export const createNewStage = (order: number): Stage => {
  const { shortId, uuid } = ShortIdMapper.generatePair();
  return {
    id: shortId,
    uuid,
    name: '',
    order,
    type: 'SEQUENTIAL',
    tasks: [],
    settings: {}
  };
};

export const isStepValid = (step: number, values: any) => {
  switch (step) {
    case 0:
      return (
        values.name.length >= 3 &&
        values.description.length >= 10 &&
        values.type.length > 0 &&
        values.maxMembers >= 2
      );
    case 1:
      return values.members.length >= 2;
    case 2: {
      const workflow = values.workflows[0];
      const notificationsValid =
        values.notifications && values.notifications.beforeDeadline?.length > 0;
      if (workflow.type === 'HYBRID') {
        const hybridWorkflow = workflow;
        const hasStages =
          !!hybridWorkflow.stages && hybridWorkflow.stages.length > 0;
        const stagesValid = hasStages
          ? hybridWorkflow.stages.every((stage: Stage) => {
              return (
                stage.name &&
                stage.type &&
                !!stage.tasks?.length &&
                stage.tasks.every(
                  (task) =>
                    task.userId &&
                    task.taskType &&
                    task.description &&
                    task.deadline?.type &&
                    task.deadline?.value > 0
                ) &&
                (stage.type !== 'QUORUM' ||
                  (stage.settings?.quorumThreshold &&
                    stage.settings.quorumThreshold > 0))
              );
            })
          : false;
        return hasStages && stagesValid && notificationsValid;
      } else {
        const standardWorkflow = workflow;
        const hasValidTasks =
          standardWorkflow.tasks.length > 0 &&
          standardWorkflow.tasks.every(
            (task) =>
              task.userId &&
              task.taskType &&
              task.description &&
              task.deadline?.type &&
              task.deadline?.value > 0
          );
        return hasValidTasks && notificationsValid;
      }
    }
    default:
      return true;
  }
};

export const defaultWorkflowSettings = {
  timeoutBehavior: 'FAIL' as const,
  parallelExecution: false,
  quorumThreshold: undefined,
  escalation: {
    enabled: false,
    to: [],
    after: 24
  }
};

export const handleStepChangeScroll = () => {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const formElement = document.getElementById('create-team-form');
      if (formElement) {
        formElement.scrollIntoView({
          behavior: 'smooth',
          block: 'start'
        });
      } else {
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
      }
    }, 0);
  }
};

import {

  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,

} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/table';
import type {
  ColumnDef,
  ColumnFiltersState,
  RowSelectionState
} from '@tanstack/react-table';
import { flexRender, type useReactTable } from '@tanstack/react-table';
import React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@signvault/ui-lib/lib/utils';

type TnsUsersTableProps<TData, TValue> = {
  columns: ColumnDef<TData, TValue>[];
  data: TData[];
  rowSelection: RowSelectionState;
  setRowSelection: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<RowSelectionState>>;
  columnFilters: ColumnFiltersState;
  setColumnFilters: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<ColumnFiltersState>>;
  table: ReturnType<typeof useReactTable<TData>>;
};

// Helper function to get responsive classes for columns
const getColumnResponsiveClass = (columnId: string) => {
  switch (columnId) {
    case 'organizationRoleId':
    case 'role':
      return 'hidden lg:table-cell';
    case 'activeTeamId':
    case 'team':
      return 'hidden md:table-cell';
    default:
      return '';
  }
};

export function TnsUsersTable<TData, TValue>({
  columns,
  table
}: TnsUsersTableProps<TData, TValue>) {
  return (
    <div className='rounded-md border'>
      <Table>
        <TableHeader>
          {table.getHeaderGroups().map((headerGroup) => (
            <TableRow key={headerGroup.id}>
              {headerGroup.headers.map((header) => {
                const responsiveClass = getColumnResponsiveClass(
                  header.column.id
                );
                return (
                  <TableHead
                    key={header.id}
                    className={cn(responsiveClass, 'md:p-4 p-3')}
                  >
                    {header.isPlaceholder
                      ? null
                      : flexRender(
                          header.column.columnDef.header,
                          header.getContext()
                        )}
                  </TableHead>
                );
              })}
            </TableRow>
          ))}
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {table.getRowModel().rows?.length ? (
            table.getRowModel().rows.map((row) => (
              <TableRow
                key={row.id}
                data-state={row.getIsSelected() && 'selected'}
              >
                {row.getVisibleCells().map((cell) => {
                  const responsiveClass = getColumnResponsiveClass(
                    cell.column.id
                  );
                  return (
                    <TableCell
                      key={cell.id}
                      className={cn(responsiveClass, 'md:p-4 p-3')}
                    >
                      {flexRender(
                        cell.column.columnDef.cell,
                        cell.getContext()
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                  );
                })}
              </TableRow>
            ))
          ) : (
            <TableRow>
              <TableCell colSpan={columns.length} className='h-24 text-center'>
                No users found.
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          )}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/create-organization/utils.ts ===

import type { UseFormReturn } from 'react-hook-form';

import { userAlreadyExists } from '@/actions/users';
import { pendingUserExists } from '@/actions/pending-users';

import type { InviteUsersFormValues, MemberVerification } from './types';

export async function verifyMemberConfiguration(
  users: InviteUsersFormValues['users'],
  form?: UseFormReturn<InviteUsersFormValues>,
  organizationId?: string | bigint
): Promise<MemberVerification> {
  try {
    let violations: MemberVerification['results'] = [];
    let emails = new Set<string>();

    // First check for duplicates (this is synchronous)
    for (const [userIndex, user] of users.entries()) {
      if (emails.has(user.email.toLowerCase())) {
        violations.push({
          type: 'email.duplicate_user',
          message:
            'You have already added this email address for another user.',
          userIndex: userIndex
        });
        form?.setError(`users.${userIndex}.email`, {
          type: 'duplicate',
          message: 'Duplicate email address'
        });
        form?.setFocus(`users.${userIndex}.email`);
      }
      emails.add(user.email.toLowerCase());
    }

    // Then check for existing users (this is asynchronous)
    const existingUserChecks = await Promise.all(
      users.map(async (user, userIndex) => {
        const exists = await userAlreadyExists(user.email.toLowerCase());
        if (exists) {
          return {
            type: 'email.already_exists' as const,
            message: 'A user with this email address already exists.',
            userIndex
          };
        }
        return null;
      })
    );

    if (organizationId) {
      // Then check for pending users (this is asynchronous)
      const pendingUserChecks = await Promise.all(
        users.map(async (user, userIndex) => {
          const exists = await pendingUserExists(user.email.toLowerCase());
          if (exists) {
            return {
              type: 'user.already_invited' as const,
              message: 'A user with this email address is already invited.',
              userIndex
            };
          }
          return null;
        })
      );
      pendingUserChecks.forEach((result) => {
        if (result) {
          violations.push(result);
          form?.setError(`users.${result.userIndex}.email`, {
            type: 'exists',
            message: 'User has already been invited to an organization'
          });
          form?.setFocus(`users.${result.userIndex}.email`);
        }
      });
    }

    // Add existing user violations
    existingUserChecks.forEach((result) => {
      if (result) {
        violations.push(result);
        form?.setError(`users.${result.userIndex}.email`, {
          type: 'exists',
          message: 'User already exists'
        });
        form?.setFocus(`users.${result.userIndex}.email`);
      }
    });

    return {
      success: violations.length === 0,
      results: violations,
      loading: false,
      error: null,
      hasVerified: true
    };
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error : new Error('Unknown error'),
      loading: false,
      results: [],
      hasVerified: true
    };
  }
}
