'use client';

import type { GetBlogsResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/blogs';
import type { GetCaseStudiesResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/case-studies';
import type { Blog } from '@signvault/db/types';
import type { CaseStudy } from '@signvault/db/types';

import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/card';
import { formatDate } from 'date-fns';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function RecentActivity() {
  const [activities, setActivities] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchRecentActivity = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      const caseStudiesResponse: GetCaseStudiesResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/case-studies`
      ).then((res) => res.json());

      const blogsResponse: GetBlogsResponse = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/blogs`
      ).then((res) => res.json());

      if (
        !caseStudiesResponse.caseStudies.database ||
        !blogsResponse.blogs.database
      ) {
        setLoading(false);
        clientLogger.error('Failed to fetch case studies or blogs:', {
          caseStudiesResponse,
          blogsResponse
        });
        toast.error('Failed to fetch recent activity');
        return;
      }

      const caseStudies = caseStudiesResponse.caseStudies.database;
      const blogs = blogsResponse.blogs.database;

      const combinedActivities = [
        ...(caseStudies || []).map((cs: CaseStudy) => ({
          type: 'Case Study',
          title: cs.title,
          date: cs.createdAt
        })),
        ...(blogs || []).map((blog: Blog) => ({
          type: 'Blog',
          title: blog.title,
          date: blog.createdAt
        }))
      ]
        .sort(
          (a, b) =>
            new Date(b.date ?? '').getTime() - new Date(a.date ?? '').getTime()
        )
        .slice(0, 10);

      setActivities(combinedActivities);
      setLoading(false);
    };
    fetchRecentActivity();
  }, []);

  if (loading)
    return (
      <div className='flex items-center justify-center'>
        <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
      </div>
    );

  return (
    <Card id='recent-activity'>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Recent Activity</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <ul className='space-y-2'>
          {activities.map((activity, index) => (
            <li
              className='flex flex-row flex-wrap items-center justify-between'
              key={activity.title + index}
            >
              <span className='flex-1 text-sm md:text-base'>
                {activity.type}: {activity.title}
              </span>
              <span className='text-xs text-foreground/70 md:text-sm'>
                <span className='hidden md:inline-block'>Added on</span>{' '}
                {formatDate(new Date(activity.date), 'PPP')}
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/api/test-notification/route.ts ===

import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore, getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import {
  NotificationStatusPS,
  type NotificationANS
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const { title, message, userId: receiverId } = await request.json();
  const logger = getServerLogger(getRandomUUID());
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookieStore);

  logger.info('Received test notification request', {
    receiverId,
    title
  });

  if (!receiverId) {
    logger.error('User ID is missing in test notification request');
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'User ID is required' }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (!process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL) {
    logger.error('API URL is not configured');
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Internal server configuration error' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

  const notificationPayload: Partial<NotificationANS> = {
    notificationType: 'IN_APP',
    template: 'TEST_NOTIFICATION',
    status: NotificationStatusPS.SENT,
    title: title || 'Test Notification',
    message: message || 'This is a test notification message.',
    content: { details: 'Generated by Notification Tester' },
    metadata: { source: 'notification-tester' },
    senderId: receiverId,
    receiverId
  };

  try {
    logger.info('Sending test notification via V2 API', {
      receiverId,
      payload: notificationPayload
    });

    const backendResponse = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/notifications/${receiverId}`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'cookie': cookieString,
          'x-user-logto-id': claims.sub,
          'x-middleware-bypass-token':
            process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(notificationPayload)
      }
    );

    const responseBody = await backendResponse.json();

    if (!backendResponse.ok) {
      logger.error('Failed to send test notification via V2 API', {
        status: backendResponse.status,
        statusText: backendResponse.statusText,
        response: responseBody,
        receiverId
      });
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: 'Failed to create notification via backend API',
          details: responseBody
        },
        { status: backendResponse.status }
      );
    }

    logger.info('Test notification sent successfully via V2 API', {
      receiverId,
      response: responseBody
    });
    return NextResponse.json(responseBody, { status: 201 });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error calling V2 notification API', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      receiverId
    });
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Internal server error while sending notification' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';

/**
 * Revalidates the blogs page.

export async function revalidateBlogs() {

  try {
    logger.info('Revalidating blogs');

    revalidateTag('blogs');

    logger.info('Revalidating case studies');
    revalidatePath('/case-studies');
    revalidateTag('case-studies');
    logger.info('Case studies revalidated successfully');
    return { success: true };

  }

/**
 * Revalidates the content for a given organization.
 * @param organizationId - The ID of the organization.
 * @param contentId - The ID of the content to revalidate.
 * @returns A success status.
 */
export async function revalidateContent(
  organizationId: string,
  contentId?: string
) {
  const logger = getServerLogger(getRandomUUID(), 'revalidate-content');

  try {
    logger.info('Revalidating content', {
      organizationId,
      contentId
    });

    // Revalidate organization content list
    revalidatePath(`/account/organizations/${organizationId}/content`);

    // If specific content, revalidate that page too
    if (contentId) {
      revalidatePath(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/content/${contentId}`
      );
      revalidatePath(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/content/${contentId}/view`
      );
    }

    // Revalidate content tag
    revalidateTag('content');

    logger.info('Content revalidated successfully');
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to revalidate content', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
      organizationId,
      contentId
    });
    return { success: false };
  }
}

 * Revalidates the documents page.

=== FILE: ./app/api/stripe/customer-portal/route.ts ===

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import Stripe from 'stripe';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { getDbUser } from '@/actions/auth';
import { getOrganization } from '@/actions/organizations';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';

const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY!, {
  apiVersion: '2025-08-27.basil'
});

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    // Get user context
    const logtoContext = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    if (!logtoContext?.isAuthenticated) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const user = await getDbUser({ claims: logtoContext.claims });
    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'User not found' }, { status: 404 });
    }

    // Get user's organization
    if (!user.organizationId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'User does not belong to an organization' },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    const organization = await getOrganization(user.organizationId);
    if (!organization) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Organization not found' },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    // Check if organization has a Stripe customer ID
    if (!organization.stripeCustomerId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            'Organization not yet linked to Stripe. Please complete your subscription setup first.',
          code: 'NO_STRIPE_CUSTOMER'
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // Get the request body
    const { returnUrl } = await request.json();

    // Create customer portal session
    const session = await stripe.billingPortal.sessions.create({
      customer: organization.stripeCustomerId,
      return_url:
        returnUrl || `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/account/organization`
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ url: session.url });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error creating customer portal session:', error);

    // Handle specific Stripe errors
    if (error instanceof Stripe.errors.StripeError) {
      if (error.type === 'StripeInvalidRequestError') {
        if (error.message.includes('No configuration provided')) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            {
              error:
                'Stripe customer portal is not configured. Please contact support to configure the customer portal in your Stripe dashboard.',
              code: 'STRIPE_PORTAL_NOT_CONFIGURED',
              details:
                'The customer portal needs to be configured in the Stripe dashboard at https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/settings/billing/portal'
            },
            { status: 400 }
          );
        }
      }

      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: `Stripe error: ${error.message}`,
          code: 'STRIPE_ERROR',
          details: 'Please contact support if this issue persists'
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Failed to create customer portal session' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

'use client';

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import type { Content, OrganizationSourceSystem } from '@signvault/db/types';
import ContentList from './content-list';
import ContentStats from './content-stats';
import { Suspense } from 'react';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getSourceSystemConfig
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';

async function fetchContents(
  organizationId: string,
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies
) {
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );

  const response = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/content/organization/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
          ? cookieStore.toString()
          : cookieString
      }
    }
  );
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error('Failed to fetch contents');
  }
  return response.json();
}

export default function ContentPage({
  organizationId,
  sourceSystem,
  initialContents,
  isAdmin,
  cookieStore
}: Readonly<{
  organizationId: string;
  sourceSystem: OrganizationSourceSystem;
  initialContents: Content[];
  isAdmin: boolean;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
}>) {
  const { data: contentsData, isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['contents', organizationId],
    queryFn: () => fetchContents(organizationId, cookieStore),
    initialData: { contents: { database: initialContents } }
  });

  const contents = contentsData?.contents?.database || [];
  const config = getSourceSystemConfig(sourceSystem.configuration);

  clientLogger.info('Rendering content page', {
    contentsLength: contents.length,
    contents,
    config
  });

  return (
    <div className='space-y-6'>
      <div className='flex flex-col gap-4'>
        <h1 className='font-signvault text-3xl font-bold md:text-4xl'>
          {config.name} Content
        </h1>
        <p className='text-muted-foreground'>{config.description}</p>
      </div>

      <Suspense
        fallback={
          <div className='flex h-40 items-center justify-center'>
            <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
          </div>
        }
      >
        <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-2'>
          <ContentStats contents={contents} />
        </div>
        <ContentList
          cookieStore={cookieStore}
          contents={contents}
          isLoading={isLoading}
          sourceSystem={sourceSystem}
          isAdmin={isAdmin}
        />
      </Suspense>
    </div>
  );
}

  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';

type SaveQueryDialogProps = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSave: (data: { name: string; description?: string }) => Promise<void>;
};

export function SaveQueryDialog({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSave
}: SaveQueryDialogProps) {
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

    if (isOpen) {
      setName('');
      setDescription('');
      setIsSaving(false);
    }

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!name) return;
    setIsSaving(true);
    await onSave({ name, description });
    setIsSaving(false);
    // The parent component is responsible for closing the dialog on success
  };

    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onClose}>
      <DialogContent className='font-suisse-intl sm:max-w-[425px]'>

          <DialogTitle>Save Query</DialogTitle>

          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className='grid gap-4 py-4'>
          <div className='grid grid-cols-4 items-center gap-4'>
            <Label htmlFor='name' className='text-right'>
              Name
            </Label>
            <Input
              id='name'
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              className='col-span-3'
              placeholder='e.g., "Documents created last week"'
            />
          </div>
          <div className='grid grid-cols-4 items-center gap-4'>
            <Label htmlFor='description' className='text-right'>
              Description
            </Label>
            <Textarea
              id='description'
              value={description}
              onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
              className='col-span-3'
              placeholder='A brief description of what this query does.'
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant='outline' onClick={onClose} disabled={isSaving}>

import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@signvault/frontend/app/logto';
import { getPublishedTemplateDetails } from '@signvault/frontend/actions/document-templates';

import TemplateFillingForm from './template-filling-form';

import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';

type TemplateFillPageProps = {
  params: {
    shortId: string;
  };
};

function ErrorDisplay({ message }: { message: string }) {
  return (
    <div className='flex flex-col items-start justify-center'>
      <div className='rounded-lg border border-destructive bg-destructive/10 md:p-5 lg:p-6 xl:p-7'>
        <h1 className='font-britanica text-2xl font-bold text-destructive'>
          Access Denied
        </h1>
        <p className='text-destructive/80'>{message}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default async function TemplateFillPage({
  params
}: TemplateFillPageProps) {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const { shortId } = await params;
  if (!claims) {
    return <ErrorDisplay message='You must be logged in to view this page.' />;
  }

  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
  const templateDetails = await getPublishedTemplateDetails(shortId);

  if (!templateDetails) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/form-templates',
        'Template not found',
        'The template you are trying to access does not exist or might have expired.'
      )
    );
  }

  if ('error' in templateDetails) {
    if (templateDetails.error === 'EXPIRED_LINK') {
      return redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          '/account/form-templates',
          'Template expired',
          'The template you are trying to access has expired.'
        )
      );
    }
    if (templateDetails.error === 'INACTIVE_TEMPLATE') {
      return redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          '/account/form-templates',
          'Template inactive',
          'The template you are trying to access is inactive.'
        )
      );
    }
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/form-templates',
        'Template error',
        'An error occurred while accessing the template.'
      )
    );
  }

  if (
    // eslint-disable-next-line
    !(templateDetails?.link as any)?.isPublic &&
    String(dbUser?.organizationId) !==
      String(templateDetails.link.organizationId)
  ) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/form-templates',
        'Unauthorized',
        "You are not authorized to access this organization's template."
      )
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className='mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl md:max-w-2xl lg:max-w-3xl xl:max-w-3xl'>
      <TemplateFillingForm
        key={templateDetails?.link?.id}
        template={templateDetails.template}
        currentUserDbId={dbUser.id.toString()}
        currentOrganizationId={dbUser.organizationId.toString()}
        dbUser={dbUser}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./components/stripe-checkout-button.tsx ===

'use client';

import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import type Stripe from 'stripe';

type StripeCheckoutButtonProps = {
  priceId: string;
  planName: string;
  isYearly?: boolean;
  variant?:
    | 'default'
    | 'destructive'
    | 'outline'
    | 'secondary'
    | 'ghost'
    | 'link';
  size?: 'default' | 'sm' | 'lg' | 'icon';
  className?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  plans?: Stripe.Plan[];
  autoFindPriceId?: boolean; // If true, will try to find priceId from plans
  source?: string; // Track where the button was clicked from
  organizationId?: string;
};

export default function StripeCheckoutButton({
  priceId,
  planName,
  isYearly = false,
  variant = 'default',
  size = 'default',
  className = '',
  children,
  plans = [],
  autoFindPriceId = false,
  source = 'unknown',
  organizationId
}: StripeCheckoutButtonProps) {
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();

  // Auto-find price ID from plans if enabled
  const finalPriceId = useMemo(() => {
    if (!autoFindPriceId || plans.length === 0) {
      return priceId;
    }

    // Find plan based on planName and amount
    let targetAmount: number;
    switch (planName.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'business':
        targetAmount = 1999; // $19.99
        break;
      case 'enterprise':
        targetAmount = 7999; // $79.99
        break;
      default:
        return priceId;
    }

    const foundPlan = plans.find(
      (plan) =>
        plan.amount === targetAmount &&
        plan.currency === 'usd' &&
        plan.interval === 'month'
    );

    return foundPlan?.id || priceId;
  }, [autoFindPriceId, plans, planName, priceId]);

  const handleCheckout = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/stripe/create-checkout-session', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          priceId: finalPriceId,
          planName,
          isYearly,
          source,
          organizationId
        })
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const { url } = await response.json();
        router.push(url);
      } else {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        console.error('Failed to create checkout session:', errorData);
        toast.error(
          errorData.error ||
            'Failed to create checkout session. Please try again.'
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating checkout session:', error);
      toast.error('An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Button
      onClick={handleCheckout}
      disabled={isLoading}
      variant={variant}
      size={size}
      className={className}
    >
      {isLoading ? 'Loading...' : children}
    </Button>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/organizations/[organizationId]/teams/[teamId]/events/[eventId]/manage/page.tsx ===

import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getErrorRedirect,
  validateCalendarEventCreator
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import type { GetTeamCalendarEventResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/team-calendar-events';
import type { GetTeamMembersResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/teams';
import ManageEventPage from './manage-event-page';

export default async function EventManagePage({
  params
}: Readonly<{
  params: Readonly<{
    organizationId: string;
    teamId: string;
    eventId: string;
  }>;
}>) {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const data = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookieStore.getAll());
  const { organizationId, teamId, eventId } = params;

  // 0. check if the user is authenticated
  if (!data.isAuthenticated) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/`,
        'Not Logged In',
        'You are not logged in. Please log in to continue.'
      )
    );
  }

  // 1. Validate organization access and event creator status
  const validationError = await validateCalendarEventCreator(
    data.claims.sub,
    eventId,
    organizationId,
    teamId,
    cookieString
  );

  if (validationError) {
    return validationError;
  }

  const eventResponse: GetTeamCalendarEventResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-calendar-events/event/${eventId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (eventResponse.message !== 'Team calendar event retrieved successfully') {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}/events/${eventId}`,
        'Event Not Found',
        'The requested event could not be found.'
      )
    );
  }

  const event = eventResponse.event.database;

  // 3. Fetch team members for attendee selection
  const teamMembersResponse: GetTeamMembersResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/${teamId}/members?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (teamMembersResponse.message !== 'Team members retrieved successfully') {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${event.teamId}`,
        'Team Members Not Found',
        'Failed to retrieve team members.'
      )
    );
  }

  const teamMembers = teamMembersResponse.members;

  return (
    <ManageEventPage
      event={event}
      teamMembers={teamMembers}
      organizationId={organizationId}
      teamId={teamId}
      eventId={eventId}
    />
  );
}

'use server';

import type { IdTokenClaims, SignInOptions } from '@logto/node';

import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { signIn, signOut } from '@logto/next/server-actions';

export const signInAction = async () => {

  let postRedirectUri = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings`;

  } as SignInOptions);

export const signUpAction = async () => {
  let redirectUri = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/callback`;
  let postRedirectUri = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings`;
  await signIn(logtoConfig, {

    firstScreen: 'register'
  } as SignInOptions);

export const signInWithRedirect = async (
  organizationId: string,
  email: string
) => {
  // Store redirect info in a cookie
  await setCookie(
    'join-organization-redirect-info',
    JSON.stringify({ organizationId, email }),
    {
      cookies,
      path: '/',
      maxAge: 60 * 5, // 5 minutes
      secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
      sameSite: 'lax'
    }
  );

  const redirectUri = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/callback`;
  await signIn(logtoConfig, {
    redirectUri
  } as SignInOptions);
};

export const signInWithCustomRedirect = async (
  cookieName: string,
  cookieValue: Record<string, string>,
  cookieOptions?: { maxAge?: number },
  logtoSignInOptions?: Partial<SignInOptions>
): Promise<void> => {
  // Store redirect info in a cookie
  await setCookie(cookieName, JSON.stringify(cookieValue), {
    cookies,
    path: '/',
    maxAge: cookieOptions?.maxAge ?? 60 * 5, // Default to 5 minutes if not provided
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    sameSite: 'lax'
  });

  const defaultRedirectUri = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/callback`;
  await signIn(logtoConfig, {
    redirectUri: defaultRedirectUri,
    ...logtoSignInOptions
  } as SignInOptions);
};

export const signOutAction = async () => {
  await signOut(logtoConfig, `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/`);
};

/**
 * Get the database user context from the Logto claims
 * @param claims - The Logto claims
 * @returns The database user context
 */
export const getDbUser = async ({
  claims
}: {
  claims: IdTokenClaims | null;
}) => {
  if (!claims) {
    return null;
  }

  const dbUser = await api.get<GetUserResponse>(
    `api/v2/users/logto/${claims.sub}`,
    '',
    undefined,
    {
      headers: {
        'x-user-logto-id': claims.sub,
        'x-middleware-bypass-token':
          process.env.NEXTJS_MIDDLEWARE_BYPASS_TOKEN || ''
      }
    }
  );

  if (dbUser.code !== 'user.found') {
    return null;
  }

  return dbUser.user.database;
};

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/organization/users/hooks/use-filtered-users.ts ===

import type { PendingUserCS, UserCS } from '@signvault/db/types';

import { organizationRoleOptions } from '@/app/(user)/create-organization/components/invite-users-form/constants';
import { useMemo } from 'react';

/**
 * Hook for filtering and sorting pending users
 */
export function useFilteredPendingUsers(
  pendingUsers: PendingUserCS[] | undefined,
  search: string,
  sortBy: string,
  isLoading: boolean
) {
  return useMemo(() => {
    if (isLoading || !pendingUsers) {
      return [];
    }

    let filtered = pendingUsers.filter((user) => !user.joined);

    if (search) {
      const searchLower = search.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(
        (user) =>
          user.firstName?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          user.email?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)
      );
    }

    return filtered.sort((a, b) => {
      switch (sortBy) {
        case 'email':
          return (a.email || '').localeCompare(b.email || '');
        case 'name':
          return (a.firstName || '').localeCompare(b.firstName || '');
        case 'role':
          return (
            organizationRoleOptions.find(
              (role) => role.value === a.organizationRoleId
            )?.label || ''
          ).localeCompare(
            organizationRoleOptions.find(
              (role) => role.value === b.organizationRoleId
            )?.label || ''
          );
        case 'team':
          return a.activeTeamId
            .toString()
            .localeCompare(b.activeTeamId.toString());
        default:
          return 0;
      }
    });
  }, [pendingUsers, search, sortBy, isLoading]);
}

/**
 * Hook for filtering and sorting users
 */
export function useFilteredUsers(
  users: UserCS[] | undefined,
  search: string,
  sortBy: string,
  isLoading: boolean
) {
  return useMemo(() => {
    if (isLoading || !users) {
      return [];
    }

    let filtered = [...users];

    if (search) {
      const searchLower = search.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(
        (user) =>
          user.name?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          user.primaryEmail?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)
      );
    }

    return filtered.sort((a, b) => {
      switch (sortBy) {
        case 'email':
          return (a.primaryEmail || '').localeCompare(b.primaryEmail || '');
        case 'name':
          return (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || '');
        case 'role':
          return (
            organizationRoleOptions.find(
              (role) => role.value === a.organizationRoleId
            )?.label || ''
          ).localeCompare(
            organizationRoleOptions.find(
              (role) => role.value === b.organizationRoleId
            )?.label || ''
          );
        case 'team':
          return a.activeTeamId
            .toString()
            .localeCompare(b.activeTeamId.toString());
        default:
          return 0;
      }
    });
  }, [users, search, sortBy, isLoading]);
}

'use client';

import { useRef, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { TagInput, type Tag, type TagInputStyleClassesProps } from 'emblor';
import { v4 as getRandomUUID } from 'uuid';

const baseClasses = {
  inlineTagsContainer:
    'rounded-md border border-input shadow-xs bg-transparent focus-within:border-primary transition-[color,box-shadow] outline-hidden p-2 gap-1',
  input: 'w-full min-w-[80px] shadow-none px-2 h-7 bg-transparent',
  tag: {
    body: 'h-7 relative bg-secondary/50 border border-secondary/60 hover:bg-secondary/30 rounded-md font-medium text-xs ps-2 pe-7',
    closeButton:
      'absolute -inset-y-px -end-px p-0 rounded-e-md flex size-7 transition-[color,box-shadow] outline-hidden focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px] text-muted-foreground/80 hover:text-foreground'
  }
};

export const TagsInputField = ({
  value,
  onChange,
  placeholder,
  styleClasses
}: {
  value: string | undefined;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  styleClasses?: Partial<TagInputStyleClassesProps>;
}) => {
  const [tags, setTags] = useState<Tag[]>([]);
  const [activeTagIndex, setActiveTagIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const formValue = value || '';
    const componentValue = tags.map((t) => t.text).join(',');
    if (formValue !== componentValue) {
      setTags(
        formValue
          .split(',')
          .filter(Boolean)
          .map((text) => ({ id: getRandomUUID(), text }))
      );
    }
  }, [value, tags]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const newTagsValue = tags.map((t) => t.text).join(',');
    if (newTagsValue !== value) {
      onChange(newTagsValue);
    }
  }, [tags, value, onChange]);

  return (
    <TagInput
      tags={tags}
      setTags={setTags}
      activeTagIndex={activeTagIndex}
      setActiveTagIndex={setActiveTagIndex}
      inputRef={inputRef}
      placeholder={
        placeholder ?? 'Enter tags separated by commas or press Enter'
      }
      styleClasses={
        styleClasses
          ? {
              ...baseClasses,
              ...styleClasses
            }
          : {
              inlineTagsContainer:
                'rounded-md border border-input shadow-xs bg-transparent focus-within:border-primary transition-[color,box-shadow] outline-hidden p-2 gap-1',
              input: 'w-full min-w-[80px] shadow-none px-2 h-7 bg-transparent',
              tag: {
                body: 'h-7 relative bg-secondary/50 border border-secondary/60 hover:bg-secondary/30 rounded-md font-medium text-xs ps-2 pe-7',
                closeButton:
                  'absolute -inset-y-px -end-px p-0 rounded-e-md flex size-7 transition-[color,box-shadow] outline-hidden focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px] text-muted-foreground/80 hover:text-foreground'
              }
            }
      }
    />
  );
};

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/organizations/[organizationId]/source-systems/[organizationSourceSystemId]/content/delete-content-dialog.tsx ===

'use client';

import type { Content, OrganizationSourceSystem } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import type { ReadonlyRequestCookies } from 'next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/adapters/request-cookies';
import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function DeleteContentDialog({
  content,
  onClose,
  sourceSystem,
  cookieStore,
  organizationId
}: Readonly<{
  content: Content | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  sourceSystem: OrganizationSourceSystem;
  cookieStore: ReadonlyRequestCookies;
  organizationId: string;
}>) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(
    cookieStore instanceof Array || cookieStore instanceof Map
      ? cookieStore
      : cookieStore.getAll().map((cookie) => ({
          name: cookie.name,
          value: cookie.value
        }))
  );
  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!content) return;

    try {
      clientLogger.info('Deleting content', {
        contentId: content.id,
        sourceSystemId: sourceSystem.id
      });
      const response = await fetch(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/content/${content.id}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
        {
          method: 'DELETE',
          cache: 'no-store',
          headers: {
            'cookie': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString,
            'cookie-string': cookieString.includes('undefined')
              ? cookieStore.toString()
              : cookieString
          }
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to delete content');

      toast.success('Content deleted successfully');
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ['contents', sourceSystem.id]
      });
      onClose();
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to delete content');
    }
  };

  if (!content) return null;

  return (
    <Dialog open={!!content} onOpenChange={onClose}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Delete Content</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Are you sure you want to delete &quot;
            {content.title}&quot;? This action cannot be undone.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant='outline' onClick={onClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button variant='destructive' onClick={handleDelete}>
            Delete
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useFormBuilderStore } from '@signvault/frontend/components/form-builder/store-provider';
import type { FormElement, FormElementInstance } from '../types';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { ArrowUpFromLine } from 'lucide-react';
import { Slider } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/slider';

function DesignerComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  return (
    <div className='flex w-full flex-col items-center gap-2'>
      <ArrowUpFromLine className='size-8' />
      <p className='text-xs'>{element.height}px</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function FormComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  return <div style={{ height: `${element.height}px`, width: '100%' }} />;
}

const propertiesSchema = z.object({
  height: z.number().min(8).max(200)
});

type PropertiesFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof propertiesSchema>;

function PropertiesComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  const { updateElement } = useFormBuilderStore();
  const form = useForm<PropertiesFormSchemaType>({
    resolver: zodResolver(propertiesSchema),
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      height: element.height
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    form.reset({ height: element.height });
  }, [element, form]);

  const applyChanges = (values: PropertiesFormSchemaType) => {
    updateElement(element.id, { ...element, ...values });
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form
        onBlur={form.handleSubmit(applyChanges)}
        onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        className='space-y-3'
      >
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='height'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Height: {field.value}px</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Slider
                  defaultValue={[field.value]}
                  min={8}
                  max={200}
                  step={1}
                  onValueChange={(value) => {
                    field.onChange(value[0]);
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
}

const SpacerField: FormElement = {
  type: 'select', // change back to spacer when we implement "layout elements"
  construct: () => ({
    type: 'select', // change back to spacer when we implement "layout elements"
    label: '',
    height: 20
  }),
  designerButtonElement: {
    icon: ArrowUpFromLine,
    label: 'Spacer'
  },
  designerComponent: DesignerComponent,
  propertiesComponent: PropertiesComponent,
  formComponent: FormComponent
};

export default SpacerField;

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/organizations/[organizationId]/teams/page.tsx ===

import { TeamsContent } from './components/teams-content';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getErrorRedirect,
  getRandomUUID
} from '@/lib/utils';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import type { GetCustomTeamsResponse } from '@signvault/backend/routes/teams';
import type { GetOrganizationUsersResponse } from '@signvault/backend/routes/organizations';
import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import type { CustomTeamWithMembers } from '@signvault/db/crud/teams/types';

export default async function TeamsPage({
  params
}: Readonly<{
  params: { organizationId: string };
}>) {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookieStore);
  const data = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const logger = getServerLogger(getRandomUUID(), 'teams-page');

  const { organizationId } = await params;

  const teamsResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/teams/organizations/${organizationId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  const teams: GetCustomTeamsResponse = await teamsResponse.json();

  if (teams.message !== 'Custom teams retrieved successfully') {
    logger.error('Failed to fetch teams', {
      status: teamsResponse.status,
      statusText: teamsResponse.statusText
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams`,
        'Error',
        `Failed to fetch teams for organization. Please try again later. Error detail: ${teamsResponse.statusText}`
      )
    );
  }

  const usersResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${organizationId}/users`,
    {
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  const users: GetOrganizationUsersResponse = await usersResponse.json();

  if (users.message !== 'Organization users retrieved successfully') {
    logger.error('Failed to fetch organization users', {
      status: usersResponse.status,
      statusText: usersResponse.statusText,
      payload: users
    });
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams`,
        'Error',
        `Failed to fetch organization users for organization. Please try again later. Error detail: ${usersResponse.statusText}`
      )
    );
  }

  return (
    <TeamsContent
      teams={teams.teams as CustomTeamWithMembers[]}
      organizationId={organizationId}
      cookieString={cookieString}
      user={data.claims}
      allUsers={users.users}
    />
  );
}

=== FILE: ./components/form-builder/fields/paragraph-field.tsx ===

'use client';

import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import * as z from 'zod';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useFormBuilderStore } from '@signvault/frontend/components/form-builder/store-provider';
import type { FormElement, FormElementInstance } from '../types';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Textarea } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/textarea';
import { Pilcrow } from 'lucide-react';

function DesignerComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  return (
    <div className='flex w-full flex-col gap-2'>
      <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>{element.label}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function FormComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  return <p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>{element.label}</p>;
}

const propertiesSchema = z.object({
  label: z.string().min(2).max(500)
});

type PropertiesFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof propertiesSchema>;

function PropertiesComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  const { updateElement } = useFormBuilderStore();
  const form = useForm<PropertiesFormSchemaType>({
    resolver: zodResolver(propertiesSchema),
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      label: element.label
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    form.reset({ label: element.label });
  }, [element, form]);

  const applyChanges = (values: PropertiesFormSchemaType) => {
    updateElement(element.id, { ...element, ...values });
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form
        onBlur={form.handleSubmit(applyChanges)}
        onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        className='space-y-3'
      >
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='label'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Paragraph Text</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Textarea
                  rows={5}
                  {...field}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur();
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
}

const ParagraphField: FormElement = {
  type: 'select', // change back to paragraph when we implement "layout elements"
  construct: () => ({
    type: 'select', // change back to paragraph when we implement "layout elements"
    label: ''
  }),
  designerButtonElement: {
    icon: Pilcrow,
    label: 'Paragraph'
  },
  designerComponent: DesignerComponent,
  propertiesComponent: PropertiesComponent,
  formComponent: FormComponent
};

export default ParagraphField;

=== FILE: ./components/form/options-tag-input-field.tsx ===

'use client';

import { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { type Tag, TagInput, type TagInputStyleClassesProps } from 'emblor';
import { cn, getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';

const baseClasses = {
  inlineTagsContainer:
    'rounded-md border border-input shadow-xs bg-transparent focus-within:border-primary transition-[color,box-shadow] outline-hidden p-2 gap-1',
  input: 'w-full min-w-[80px] shadow-none px-2 h-7 bg-transparent',
  tag: {
    body: 'h-7 relative bg-secondary/50 border border-secondary/60 hover:bg-secondary/30 rounded-md font-medium text-xs ps-2 pe-7',
    closeButton:
      'absolute -inset-y-px -end-px p-0 rounded-e-md flex size-7 transition-[color,box-shadow] outline-hidden focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px] text-muted-foreground/80 hover:text-foreground'
  }
};

export const OptionsTagInputField = ({
  value,
  onChange,
  placeholder,
  styleClasses
}: {
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  styleClasses?: Partial<TagInputStyleClassesProps>;
}) => {
  const [tags, setTags] = useState<Tag[]>(() =>
    (value || '')
      .split(',')
      .filter(Boolean)
      .map((text) => ({ id: getRandomUUID(), text }))
  );
  const [activeTagIndex, setActiveTagIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const [inputFocused, setInputFocused] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    onChange(tags.map((t) => t.text).join(','));
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [tags]);

  return (
    <TagInput
      tags={tags}
      setTags={setTags}
      activeTagIndex={activeTagIndex}
      setActiveTagIndex={setActiveTagIndex}
      inputRef={inputRef}
      onInputFocus={() => setInputFocused(true)}
      onInputBlur={() => setInputFocused(false)}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Backspace') {
          if (tags.length === 0) {
            e.preventDefault();
          }
          if (activeTagIndex !== null) {
            setTags(tags.filter((_, index) => index !== activeTagIndex));
          } else if (inputFocused && tags.length > 0) {
            setTags(tags.slice(0, -1));
          }
        }
      }}
      placeholder={
        placeholder ??
        'Add options for the user to select from (e.g. "Option 1, Option 2, Option 3")'
      }
      styleClasses={{
        inlineTagsContainer: cn(
          baseClasses.inlineTagsContainer,
          styleClasses?.inlineTagsContainer
        ),
        input: cn(baseClasses.input, styleClasses?.input),
        tag: {
          body: cn(baseClasses.tag.body, styleClasses?.tag?.body),
          closeButton: cn(
            baseClasses.tag.closeButton,
            styleClasses?.tag?.closeButton
          )
        }
      }}
    />
  );
};

=== FILE: ./components/notifications/notification-item.tsx ===

'use client';

import type { NotificationANS } from '@signvault/db/schemas/notifications_/types';

import { useNotifications } from '@/contexts/notifications-context';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { NotificationStatusPS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns';
import {
  AlertCircle,
  Bell,
  CheckCheck,
  CheckCircle,
  FileText,
  Send
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';

type NotificationItemProps = {
  notification: NotificationANS;
};

export function NotificationItem({
  notification
}: Readonly<NotificationItemProps>) {
  const { markAsRead } = useNotifications();
  const [isUnread, setIsUnread] = useState(!notification.readAt);

  const getIcon = () => {
    switch (notification.status) {
      case NotificationStatusPS.DELIVERED:
        return <CheckCircle className='size-4 text-green-500' />;
      case NotificationStatusPS.FAILED:
        return <AlertCircle className='size-4 text-red-500' />;
      case NotificationStatusPS.QUEUED:
        return <FileText className='size-4 text-blue-500' />;
      case NotificationStatusPS.SENDING:
        return <Send className='size-4 text-orange-500' />;
      default:
        return <Bell className='size-4 text-gray-500' />;
    }
  };

  const handleMarkAsRead = async () => {
    try {
      setIsUnread(false); // Optimistically mark as read
      await markAsRead(notification.id);
      toast.success('Notification marked as read.');
    } catch (error) {
      setIsUnread(true); // Revert if there's an error
      toast.error(
        `Failed to mark as read: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}`
      );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        'flex items-start gap-4 border-b p-4 transition-colors',
        isUnread && 'bg-primary/5'
      )}
    >
      {getIcon()}
      <div className='flex-1 space-y-1'>
        <p className={cn('text-sm leading-none', isUnread && 'font-semibold')}>
          {notification.title}
        </p>
        <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
          {notification.message.length > 100
            ? `${notification.message.slice(0, 100)}...`
            : notification.message}
        </p>
        <p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'>
          {formatDistanceToNow(new Date(notification.createdAt), {
            addSuffix: true
          })}
        </p>
      </div>
      {isUnread && (
        <Button
          className='ml-auto'
          onClick={handleMarkAsRead}
          size='icon'
          title='Mark notification as read'
          variant='ghost'
        >
          <CheckCheck className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/api/logto/sign-in-callback/route.ts ===

import { logtoClientEdge } from '@/app/logto';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { handleUserCheck } from '@/lib/auth-utils';
import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

/**
 * Handles the Logto sign-in callback request.
 * @param request - The request object.
 * @returns A redirect response.
 */
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  // Get request ID
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();

  // Get server logger
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'logto-sign-in-callback');

  // Get cookies
  const cookiesStore = await cookies();

  try {
    // Log request details
    logger.info('Starting sign-in callback processing', {
      url: request.url,
      headers: Object.fromEntries(request.headers),
      siteUrl: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL
    });

    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

    // Log info
    logger.info('Got Logto context', {
      hasClaims: !!claims,
      userId: claims?.sub,
      claimsData: claims ? JSON.stringify(claims) : 'no claims'
    });

    // Handle user check
    const result: NextResponse<unknown> | null = await handleUserCheck(
      claims,
      request,
      true,
      cookiesStore
    );

    if (!result) {
      return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/', request.url));
    }

    // Log info
    logger.info('Handling sign-in callback with Logto', {
      userId: claims?.sub,
      redirectUrl: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/onboarding`
    });

    // Handle sign-in callback with Logto
    return logtoClientEdge.handleSignInCallback(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/onboarding`
    )(request);
  } catch (error) {
    // Log error
    logger.error('Error in sign-in-callback route', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
      stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : 'No stack trace',
      url: request.url,
      headers: Object.fromEntries(request.headers),
      env: {
        siteUrl: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL,
        nodeEnv: process.env.NODE_ENV
      }
    });

    // Return a more detailed error response
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
          stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : 'No stack trace'
        },
        {
          status: 500,
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
        }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/', request.url));
  }
}

import * as z from 'zod';
import { Visibility } from '@signvault/db/types';

const taskSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  order: z.number(),
  userId: z.string(),
  taskType: z.enum(['APPROVAL', 'SIGNATURE', 'REVIEW', 'ACTION']),
  description: z.string(),
  deadline: z.object({
    type: z.enum(['FIXED', 'RELATIVE']),
    value: z.number()
  }),
  dependencies: z.array(z.string()).optional()
});

const stageSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  uuid: z.string(),
  name: z.string(),
  order: z.number(),
  type: z.enum(['SEQUENTIAL', 'PARALLEL', 'QUORUM']),
  tasks: z.array(taskSchema),
  settings: z
    .object({
      quorumThreshold: z.number().optional()
    })
    .optional()
});

const workflowSettingsSchema = z.object({
  parallelExecution: z.boolean().optional(),
  quorumThreshold: z.number().optional(),
  timeoutBehavior: z.enum(['FAIL', 'CONTINUE', 'ESCALATE']),
  escalation: z
    .object({
      enabled: z.boolean(),
      to: z.array(z.string()),
      after: z.number()
    })
    .optional()
});

const baseWorkflowSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().optional(),
  settings: workflowSettingsSchema
});

const hybridWorkflowSchema = baseWorkflowSchema.extend({
  type: z.literal('HYBRID'),
  stages: z.array(stageSchema),
  tasks: z.never().optional()
});

const standardWorkflowSchema = baseWorkflowSchema.extend({
  type: z.enum(['SEQUENTIAL', 'PARALLEL', 'QUORUM']),
  tasks: z.array(taskSchema),
  stages: z.never().optional()
});

const workflowSchema = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [
  hybridWorkflowSchema,
  standardWorkflowSchema
]);

export const formSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(3, 'Name is required and must be at least 3 characters'),
  description: z.string().min(10, {
    message: 'Description is required and must be at least 10 characters long'
  }),
  type: z.string().min(1, 'Type is required'),
  members: z.array(z.string()).min(2, 'At least 2 members are required'),
  maxMembers: z.number().min(2, 'Maximum members must be at least 2'),
  visibility: z.nativeEnum(Visibility),
  notifications: z.object({
    beforeDeadline: z.array(z.string()),
    onComplete: z.boolean(),
    onStart: z.boolean()
  }),
  configuration: z.object({
    isActive: z.boolean(),
    autoJoin: z.object({
      enabled: z.boolean()
    }),
    security: z
      .object({
        mfaRequired: z.boolean().optional(),
        dataClassification: z.string().optional(),
        sessionTimeout: z.number().optional()
      })
      .optional()
  }),
  workflows: z.array(workflowSchema),
  security: z
    .object({
      accessControl: z
        .object({
          mfaRequired: z.boolean().optional(),
          sessionTimeout: z.number().optional()
        })

    })

'use client';

import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import * as z from 'zod';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useFormBuilderStore } from '@signvault/frontend/components/form-builder/store-provider';
import type { FormElement, FormElementInstance } from '../types';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Input } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/input';
import { Heading1 } from 'lucide-react';

function DesignerComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  return (
    <div className='flex w-full flex-col gap-2'>
      <p className='text-lg font-bold'>{element.label}</p>
    </div>
  );

function FormComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  return <p className='text-lg font-bold'>{element.label}</p>;
}

const propertiesSchema = z.object({
  label: z.string().min(2).max(50)
});

type PropertiesFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof propertiesSchema>;

function PropertiesComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  const { updateElement } = useFormBuilderStore();
  const form = useForm<PropertiesFormSchemaType>({
    resolver: zodResolver(propertiesSchema),
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      label: element.label
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    form.reset({ label: element.label });
  }, [element, form]);

  const applyChanges = (values: PropertiesFormSchemaType) => {
    updateElement(element.id, { ...element, ...values });
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form
        onBlur={form.handleSubmit(applyChanges)}
        onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        className='space-y-3'
      >
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='label'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Title</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input
                  {...field}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur();
                  }}
                />
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
}

const TitleField: FormElement = {
  type: 'select', // change back to title when we implement "layout elements"
  construct: () => ({
    type: 'select', // change back to title when we implement "layout elements"
    label: ''
  }),
  designerButtonElement: {
    icon: Heading1,
    label: 'Title'
  },
  designerComponent: DesignerComponent,
  propertiesComponent: PropertiesComponent,
  formComponent: FormComponent
};

export default TitleField;

=== FILE: ./hooks/use-subscription.ts ===

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '@/contexts/auth-context';

type SubscriptionData = {
  hasSubscription: boolean;
  hasOrganization: boolean;
  currentPlan?: string;
  subscriptionStatus?: string;
  isActive: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
};

export function useSubscription(): SubscriptionData {
  const { isAuthenticated, claims } = useAuth();
  const [subscriptionData, setSubscriptionData] = useState<SubscriptionData>({
    hasSubscription: false,
    hasOrganization: false,
    currentPlan: undefined,
    subscriptionStatus: undefined,
    isActive: false,
    isLoading: true
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      setSubscriptionData({
        hasSubscription: false,
        hasOrganization: false,
        currentPlan: undefined,
        subscriptionStatus: undefined,
        isActive: false,
        isLoading: false
      });
      return;
    }

    const fetchSubscriptionData = async () => {
      try {
        // Fetch subscription data from the API endpoint
        const response = await fetch('/api/subscription/status');

        if (response.ok) {
          const data = await response.json();
          setSubscriptionData({
            hasSubscription: data.hasSubscription,
            hasOrganization: data.hasOrganization,
            currentPlan: data.currentPlan,
            subscriptionStatus: data.subscriptionStatus,
            isActive: data.isActive,
            isLoading: false
          });
        } else {
          // Fallback to default state if API fails
          setSubscriptionData({
            hasSubscription: false,
            hasOrganization: false,
            currentPlan: undefined,
            subscriptionStatus: undefined,
            isActive: false,
            isLoading: false
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching subscription data:', error);
        setSubscriptionData({
          hasSubscription: false,
          hasOrganization: false,
          currentPlan: undefined,
          subscriptionStatus: undefined,
          isActive: false,
          isLoading: false
        });
      }
    };

    fetchSubscriptionData();
  }, [isAuthenticated, claims]);

  return subscriptionData;
}

// Helper function to determine if user should see upgrade prompts
export function shouldShowUpgradePrompt(
  subscriptionData: SubscriptionData
): boolean {
  return !subscriptionData.isLoading && !subscriptionData.hasSubscription;
}

// Helper function to determine if user has access to features
export function hasFeatureAccess(subscriptionData: SubscriptionData): boolean {
  return subscriptionData.isLoading || subscriptionData.hasSubscription;
}

export default function ContentStats({
  contents
}: Readonly<{
  contents: Content[];
}>) {

  const activeContent = contents.filter(
    (content) => content.status === 'ACTIVE'
  ).length;

        )
      : null;

  clientLogger.info('Rendering content stats', {
    totalContent,
    activeContent,
    inactiveContent,
    lastUpdated
  });

        <CardHeader className='flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2'>

          <FileText className='h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground' />
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className='text-2xl font-bold'>{totalContent}</div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader className='flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2'>
          <CardTitle className='text-sm font-medium'>Last Updated</CardTitle>
          <Clock className='h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground' />

import PaginationDemo from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/originui/pagination';
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import type { CalendarEvent } from '../calendar-types';

import { EventCard } from '../event-card';

type EventsViewProps = {
  events: CalendarEvent[];
  organizationId: string;
  teamId: string;
  userId: string;
};

const EVENTS_PER_PAGE = 6;

export function EventsView({
  events,
  organizationId,
  teamId,
  userId
}: Readonly<EventsViewProps>) {
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);

  const sortedEvents = [...events].sort(
    (a, b) => b.startDate.getTime() - a.startDate.getTime()
  );
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(sortedEvents.length / EVENTS_PER_PAGE);
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * EVENTS_PER_PAGE;
  const visibleEvents = sortedEvents.slice(
    startIndex,
    startIndex + EVENTS_PER_PAGE
  );

  // Reset to first page when events change
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentPage(1);
  }, [events]);

  // Handle page change from pagination component
  const handlePageChange = (page: number) => {
    setCurrentPage(page);
    // Scroll to top smoothly when page changes
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  return (
    <div className='space-y-6 p-4'>
      <AnimatePresence mode='wait'>
        <motion.div
          className='grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2'
          exit='exit'
          initial='initial'
          key={currentPage}
          transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
          variants={{
            initial: {
              opacity: 0,
              y: -20,
              filter: 'blur(3px)'
            },
            animate: {
              opacity: 1,
              y: 0,
              filter: 'blur(0px)'
            },
            exit: { opacity: 0, y: 20, filter: 'blur(3px)' }
          }}
          viewport={{ once: true }}
          whileInView='animate'
        >
          {visibleEvents.map((event) => (
            <EventCard
              className='h-full'
              event={event}
              isAdmin={event.createdBy === userId}
              key={event.id}
              organizationId={organizationId}
              teamId={teamId}
            />
          ))}
        </motion.div>
      </AnimatePresence>

      {totalPages > 1 && (
        <div className='mt-6 flex justify-center'>
          <PaginationDemo
            currentPage={currentPage}
            onPageChange={handlePageChange}
            paginationItemsToDisplay={5}
            totalPages={totalPages}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./components/form-builder/fields/separator-field.tsx ===

'use client';

import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import * as z from 'zod';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useFormBuilderStore } from '@signvault/frontend/components/form-builder/store-provider';
import type { FormElement, FormElementInstance } from '../types';
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { Minus } from 'lucide-react';

function DesignerComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  return (
    <div className='flex w-full flex-col gap-2'>
      <div
        className='w-full border-t-2'
        style={{ borderColor: element.label }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function FormComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  return (
    <div className='w-full border-t-2' style={{ borderColor: element.label }} />
  );
}

const propertiesSchema = z.object({
  label: z.string().min(2).max(20) // color
});

type PropertiesFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof propertiesSchema>;

function PropertiesComponent({ element }: { element: FormElementInstance }) {
  const { updateElement } = useFormBuilderStore();
  const form = useForm<PropertiesFormSchemaType>({
    resolver: zodResolver(propertiesSchema),
    mode: 'onBlur',
    defaultValues: {
      label: element.label // color
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    form.reset({ label: element.label });
  }, [element, form]);

  const applyChanges = (values: PropertiesFormSchemaType) => {
    updateElement(element.id, { ...element, ...values });
  };

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form
        onBlur={form.handleSubmit(applyChanges)}
        onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        className='space-y-3'
      >
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name='label'
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Color</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <input type='color' {...field} />
              </FormControl>
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
}

const SeparatorField: FormElement = {
  type: 'select', // change back to separator when we implement "layout elements"
  construct: () => ({
    type: 'select', // change back to separator when we implement "layout elements"
    label: '#000000' // color
  }),
  designerButtonElement: {
    icon: Minus,
    label: 'Separator'
  },
  designerComponent: DesignerComponent,
  propertiesComponent: PropertiesComponent,
  formComponent: FormComponent
};

export default SeparatorField;

=== FILE: ./contexts/auth-context.tsx ===

'use client';

import type { IdTokenClaims } from '@logto/node';

import { signInAction, signOutAction } from '@/actions/auth';
import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import { createContext, useContext, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { UserCS } from '@signvault/db/types';

type AuthContextType = {
  claims: IdTokenClaims | null;
  dbUser: UserCS | null;
  error: string | null;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  signIn: () => Promise<void>;
  signOut: () => Promise<void>;
};

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export function AuthProvider({
  children,
  initialIsAuthenticated = false,
  initialClaims = null,
  initialDbUser = null
}: Readonly<{
  children: React.ReactNode;
  initialClaims?: IdTokenClaims | null;
  initialIsAuthenticated?: boolean;
  initialDbUser?: UserCS | null;
}>) {
  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState(
    initialIsAuthenticated
  );
  const [claims, setClaims] = useState(initialClaims);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [dbUser, setDbUser] = useState(initialDbUser);

  const handleSignIn = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      await signInAction();
      setIsAuthenticated(true);
      clientLogger.info('User signed in successfully', {}, 'frontend-auth');
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error('Failed to sign in', { error }, 'frontend-auth');
      setError(error as string);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSignOut = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      await signOutAction();
      setIsAuthenticated(false);
      setClaims(null);
      setDbUser(null);
      clientLogger.info('User signed out successfully', {}, 'frontend-auth');
    } catch (error) {
      clientLogger.error('Failed to sign out', { error }, 'frontend-auth');
      setError(error as string);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const values = useMemo(() => {
    return {
      dbUser,
      isAuthenticated,
      claims,
      signIn: handleSignIn,
      signOut: handleSignOut,
      error,
      isLoading
    };
  }, [isAuthenticated, claims, error, isLoading, dbUser]);

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={values}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
}

export function useAuth() {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  try {
    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
    const organization = await getOrganization(dbUser?.organizationId);

    const title = 'Reports';
    const description =
      organization && organization?.name
        ? `Generate and view business reports and analytics for ${organization.name} on SignVault`
        : 'Generate and view your SignVault business reports and analytics';

    return {
      title,
      description,
      creator: 'SignVault',
      keywords: [

        'Reports',
        'Business Reports',
        'Analytics',
        'Business Intelligence'
      ],
      authors: [

          name: 'SignVault',
          url: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL
        }
      ],
      robots: 'index, follow',
      icons: {
        icon: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/favicon.ico`
      },
      openGraph: {
        title,
        description,
        url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/reports`,
        siteName: 'SignVault',
        locale: 'en-US',
        type: 'website',
        images: [`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`]
      },
      twitter: {
        title,
        description,
        images: [`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`],
        creator: '@signvault',
        site: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL,
        card: 'summary_large_image'
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    // Fallback metadata if user data fetch fails
    return {
      title: 'Reports',
      description:
        'Generate and view your SignVault business reports and analytics',
      creator: 'SignVault',
      keywords: ['SignVault', 'Reports', 'Business Reports'],
      robots: 'index, follow'
    };
  }
}
