'use client';

import { extractNameFromUser } from '@/lib/utils';
import type { DocumentCS, UserCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetDescription
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/sheet';
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/table';
import { format } from 'date-fns';

type UserDocumentsSheetProps = {
  user: UserCS | null;
  documents: DocumentCS[];
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
};

export function UserDocumentsSheet({
  user,
  documents,
  isOpen,
  onClose
}: UserDocumentsSheetProps) {
  if (!user) return null;

  const userDocuments = documents.filter((doc) => doc.ownerId === user.id);
  const name = extractNameFromUser(user);
  return (
    <Sheet open={isOpen} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && onClose()}>
      <SheetContent className='font-suisse-intl'>
        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle>{name}'s Documents</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription>
            Here are the documents owned by {name}.
          </SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>
        <div className='mt-4 max-h-[60dvh] overflow-y-auto'>
          <div className='overflow-x-auto rounded-md border'>
            <Table>
              <TableHeader className='sticky top-0 z-10 bg-background'>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead className='min-w-[150px]'>Title</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className='min-w-[120px]'>Created At</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {userDocuments.length > 0 ? (
                  userDocuments.map((doc) => (
                    <TableRow key={doc.id}>
                      <TableCell className='break-words font-medium'>
                        {doc.title ?? doc.filename ?? 'Untitled'}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className='whitespace-nowrap'>
                        {format(new Date(doc.createdAt), 'PP')}
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableCell colSpan={2} className='h-24 text-center'>
                      No documents found for this user.
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                )}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/organization/roles/custom-role-tab-content.tsx ===

'use client';

import type { RoleCS } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/types';

import { getCustomRoles } from '@/actions/roles';
import { cn } from '@signvault/ui-lib/lib/utils';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

import { CustomRoleCard } from './custom-role-card';

type CustomRoleTabContentProps = {
  onSelectRole: (role: RoleCS) => void;
  organizationId: string | bigint;
  search: string;
  sortBy: string; // "name" | "type" | "classification" | "createdAt"
  userId: string | bigint;
};

export function CustomRoleTabContent({
  organizationId,
  search,
  sortBy,
  onSelectRole
}: Readonly<CustomRoleTabContentProps>) {
  const { data: customRoles = [], isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['customRoles'],
    queryFn: () => getCustomRoles(organizationId)
  });

  const filteredRoles = customRoles
    .filter((role) => {
      const searchLower = search.toLowerCase();
      return (
        role.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
        role.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
        role.attributes.function.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
        role.attributes.level.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)
      );
    })
    .sort((a, b) => {
      switch (sortBy) {
        case 'classification':
          return a.attributes.function.localeCompare(b.attributes.function);
        case 'createdAt':
          return (
            new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime()
          );
        case 'name':
          return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
        case 'type':
          return a.activationMethod.localeCompare(b.activationMethod);
        default:
          return 0;
      }
    });

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className='flex h-24 items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground'>
        <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!filteredRoles.length) {
    return (
      <div className='flex h-24 items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground'>
        No custom roles found.
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className='flex flex-col gap-6'>
      {filteredRoles.map((role) => (
        <div
          className={cn('transition-colors duration-300 ease-in-out')}
          key={role.id}
        >
          <CustomRoleCard
            className='flex flex-col gap-3'
            onSelectRole={onSelectRole}
            role={role}
          />
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./actions/pending-users.ts ===

'use server';

import type { OrganizationRoleId } from '@signvault/logto';

import type { PendingUserCS } from '@signvault/db/types';

import type { EditUserFormValues } from '@/app/(user)/account/organization/users/users-page';
import {
  getPendingUserByEmail,
  listPendingUsers
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud/pending-users';
import { updatePendingUser as updatePendingUserDb } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer_/crud/pending-users';
import type { PermissionType } from '@signvault/db/types';
import type { PendingUserExistsResponse } from '@signvault/backend/routes/v2/pending-users';

/**
 * Server action that checks if a pending user already exists in the database
 * @param email - The email of the user to check
 * @returns True if the user already exists, false otherwise
 */
export async function pendingUserExists(email: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(
      `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/v2/pending-users/exists?email=${encodeURIComponent(
        email
      )}`,
      {
        method: 'GET',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        }
      }
    );

    const data: PendingUserExistsResponse = await response.json();
    return data.exists;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error checking pending user existence:', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
      email
    });
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Server action that updates a pending user
 * @param email - The email of the user to update
 * @param organizationId - The ID of the organization
 * @param data - The data to update the user with
 * @returns The updated user
 */
export async function updatePendingUser({
  email,
  data
}: {
  data: { permissions?: PermissionType[] } & EditUserFormValues;
  email: string;
}) {
  const { pendingUser } = await getPendingUserByEmail(email);

  if (!pendingUser) {
    throw new Error('Invited user not found');
  }

  return await updatePendingUserDb(pendingUser.id, {
    activeTeamId:
      typeof data.activeTeamId === 'string'
        ? BigInt(data.activeTeamId)
        : data.activeTeamId,
    attributes: data.attributes,
    permissions: data.permissions,
    organizationRoleId: data.role as OrganizationRoleId
  } as Partial<PendingUserCS>);
}

export async function getPendingUsersByOrganizationId({
  organizationId
}: {
  organizationId: string;
}) {
  return await listPendingUsers({}, { organizationId });
}

  keywords: [
    'SignVault',
    'Templates',
    'Document Templates',
    'Global Templates'
  ],

    {
      name: 'SignVault',
      url: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL
    }
  ],
  robots: 'index, follow',
  icons: {
    icon: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/favicon.ico`
  },
  openGraph: {
    title: 'Create Form Template',
    description: 'Create a new form template.',
    url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/form-templates/create`,
    siteName: 'SignVault',
    locale: 'en-US',
    type: 'website',
    images: [`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`]
  },
  twitter: {
    title: 'Create Form Template',
    description: 'Create a new form template.',
    images: [`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/og.jpg`],
    creator: '@signvault',
    site: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL,
    card: 'summary_large_image'
  }
};

export const viewport: Viewport = {
  width: 'device-width',
  initialScale: 1,
  maximumScale: 1,
  minimumScale: 1,
  themeColor: '#5e46ef'
};

export default async function CreateFormTemplatePage() {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  const isSuperAdmin = claims?.sub
    ? authorizedUsers.includes(claims.sub)
    : false;

  // Check if user has permission to create templates
  const isOrgAdmin =
    dbUser?.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L6_USER.id ||
    dbUser?.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id;

  const canCreateTemplates = isSuperAdmin || isOrgAdmin;

  if (!canCreateTemplates) {
    redirect('/account/form-templates');
  }

  return (
    <FormTemplateBuilder
      currentUserLogtoId={claims?.sub}
      currentUserDbId={dbUser?.id?.toString() || null}
      currentOrganizationId={dbUser?.organizationId?.toString() || null}
      isSuperAdmin={isSuperAdmin}
    />
  );
}

'use client';

import type { CaseStudy } from '@signvault/db/types';

import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/card';
import {
  type ChartConfig,
  ChartContainer,
  ChartLegend,
  ChartLegendContent,
  ChartTooltip,
  ChartTooltipContent
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/chart';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Bar, BarChart, CartesianGrid, XAxis } from 'recharts';

export default function CaseStudiesGraph({
  caseStudies,
  isLoading
}: Readonly<{
  caseStudies: CaseStudy[];
  isLoading: boolean;
}>) {
  const groupDataByDay = (data: CaseStudy[]) => {
    const grouped = data.reduce((acc, item) => {
      // Use ISO date string to ensure consistent parsing
      const date = new Date(item.createdAt).toISOString().split('T')[0];
      if (!date) return acc;
      acc[date] = (acc[date] || 0) + 1;
      return acc;
    }, {});

    return Object.entries(grouped).map(([date, count]) => ({
      date,
      count
    }));
  };

  const data = groupDataByDay(caseStudies);

  const chartConfig: ChartConfig = {
    count: {
      label: 'Case Studies',
      color: '#8884d8'
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className='flex h-full items-center justify-center'>
        <Loader2 className='size-4 animate-spin text-primary' />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Case Studies Added</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <ChartContainer className='h-[350px] w-full' config={chartConfig}>
          <BarChart data={data}>
            <CartesianGrid vertical={false} />
            <XAxis
              axisLine={false}
              dataKey='date'
              tickFormatter={(value) => {
                const date = new Date(value);
                return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
                  month: 'short',
                  day: 'numeric'
                });
              }}
              tickLine={false}
              tickMargin={10}
            />
            <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
            <ChartLegend content={<ChartLegendContent payload={data} />} />
            <Bar dataKey='count' fill='var(--primary)' radius={4} />
          </BarChart>
        </ChartContainer>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/data-provenance/queries/query-list.tsx ===

'use client';

import type {
  CustomProvenanceQueryCS,
  ProvenanceRecords
} from '@signvault/db/types';
import { SavedQueriesTable } from '../saved-queries-table';
import { ProvenanceQueryCard } from './provenance-query-card';

type QueryListProps = {
  queries: CustomProvenanceQueryCS[];
  viewMode: 'grid' | 'list';
  onQueryExecuted: (results: {
    data?: ProvenanceRecords[];
    executedQuery?: string;
    queryName?: string;
    totalCount?: number;
  }) => void;
  onRefresh: () => void;
  organizationId: string;
  loadingQueryId: string | null;
  deletingQueryId: string | null;
  handleExecuteQuery: (query: CustomProvenanceQueryCS) => void;
  handleDeleteQuery: (query: CustomProvenanceQueryCS) => void;
  setQueryToDelete: (query: CustomProvenanceQueryCS | null) => void;
  setQueryToPreview: (query: CustomProvenanceQueryCS | null) => void;
};

export function QueryList({
  queries,
  viewMode,
  onQueryExecuted,
  onRefresh,
  organizationId,
  loadingQueryId,
  deletingQueryId,
  handleExecuteQuery,
  handleDeleteQuery,
  setQueryToDelete,
  setQueryToPreview
}: QueryListProps) {
  if (queries.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className='flex h-40 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-dashed text-muted-foreground'>
        No saved queries found.
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (viewMode === 'grid') {
    return (
      <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3'>
        {queries.map((query) => (
          <ProvenanceQueryCard
            key={String(query.id)}
            query={query}
            onExecute={handleExecuteQuery}
            onDelete={() => setQueryToDelete(query)}
            onPreview={setQueryToPreview}
            isLoading={loadingQueryId === String(query.id)}
            isDeleting={deletingQueryId === String(query.id)}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SavedQueriesTable
      data={queries}
      onQueryExecuted={onQueryExecuted}
      onRefresh={onRefresh}
      organizationId={organizationId}
      loadingQueryId={loadingQueryId}
      deletingQueryId={deletingQueryId}
      handleExecuteQuery={handleExecuteQuery}
      handleDeleteQuery={handleDeleteQuery}
      setQueryToDelete={setQueryToDelete}
      setQueryToPreview={setQueryToPreview}
      queryToDelete={null}
    />
  );
}

=== FILE: ./lib/checkout.ts ===

'use server';

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { headers } from 'next/headers';
import { stripe } from '@/lib/stripe';
import { getErrorRedirect, getStatusRedirect } from '@/lib/utils';

export async function createCheckoutSession(
  priceId: string,
  planName?: string,
  isYearly?: boolean,
  source?: string
) {
  try {
    const headersList = await headers();
    const origin = headersList.get('origin');

    if (!priceId) {
      throw new Error('Price ID is required');
    }

    // Validate the price ID exists in Stripe
    try {
      const price = await stripe.prices.retrieve(priceId);
      if (!price.active) {
        throw new Error('Invalid or inactive price ID');
      }
    } catch (stripeError) {
      console.error('Stripe price validation error:', stripeError);
      throw new Error('Invalid price ID');
    }

    // Create Checkout Sessions from body params.
    const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
      line_items: [
        {
          price: priceId,
          quantity: 1
        }
      ],
      mode: 'subscription',
      success_url: getStatusRedirect(
        origin,
        'Success',
        'You have successfully subscribed to the plan.'
      ),
      cancel_url: getErrorRedirect(
        origin,
        'Cancelled',
        'You cancelled the checkout process.'
      ),
      allow_promotion_codes: true,
      subscription_data: {
        trial_period_days: 14,
        metadata: {
          plan_name: planName || 'Unknown',
          billing_cycle: isYearly ? 'yearly' : 'monthly',
          source: source || 'unknown'
        }
      },
      metadata: {
        plan_name: planName || 'Unknown',
        billing_cycle: isYearly ? 'yearly' : 'monthly',
        source: source || 'unknown'
      }
    });

    return NextResponse.redirect(session.url, 303);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Checkout session creation error:', err);
    if (err instanceof Error) {
      return NextResponse.redirect(
        getErrorRedirect(
          process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL!,
          'Checkout Error',
          err.message
        )
      );
    }
    return NextResponse.redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL!,
        'Error',
        'An unknown error occurred'
      )
    );
  }
}

import { TeamMemberActivityLogType } from '@signvault/db/types';
import {
  Activity,
  Archive,
  ArchiveRestore,
  BookUser,
  ListPlus,
  OctagonX,
  ShieldAlert,
  ShieldCheck,
  ShieldX,
  TriangleAlert,
  UserCheck,
  UserMinus,
  UserPlus,
  Users,
  type LucideProps
} from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export function ActivityLogIcon({
  type,
  className,
  ...props
}: Readonly<LucideProps & { type: TeamMemberActivityLogType }>) {
  const baseClassName = 'size-4 min-w-4 min-h-4';
  const combinedClassName = cn(baseClassName, className);

  switch (type) {
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_ADDED:
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_JOINED:
      return <UserPlus className={combinedClassName} {...props} />;
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_INVITED:
      return <UserCheck className={combinedClassName} {...props} />;
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_EXPIRED:
      return <ShieldAlert className={combinedClassName} {...props} />;
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_REMOVED:
      return <UserMinus className={combinedClassName} {...props} />;
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.MEMBER_ROLE_UPDATED:
      return <BookUser className={combinedClassName} {...props} />;
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_CREATED:
      return <Users className={combinedClassName} {...props} />;
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_UPDATED:
      return <ListPlus className={combinedClassName} {...props} />;
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_DELETED:
      return <OctagonX className={combinedClassName} {...props} />;
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_BLOCKED:
      return <ShieldX className={combinedClassName} {...props} />;
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_SUSPENDED:
      return <TriangleAlert className={combinedClassName} {...props} />;
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_REACTIVATED:
      return <ShieldCheck className={combinedClassName} {...props} />;
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_ARCHIVED:
      return <Archive className={combinedClassName} {...props} />;
    case TeamMemberActivityLogType.TEAM_UNARCHIVED:
      return <ArchiveRestore className={combinedClassName} {...props} />;
    default:
      return <Activity className={combinedClassName} {...props} />;
  }
}

=== FILE: ./app/api/stripe/create-checkout-session/route.ts ===

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { stripe } from '@/lib/stripe';

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const { priceId, planName, isYearly, source, organizationId } =
      await request.json();

    if (!priceId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Price ID is required' },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!planName) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Plan name is required' },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // organizationId is optional - users might not have an organization yet

    // Validate the price ID exists in Stripe
    try {
      const price = await stripe.prices.retrieve(priceId);
      if (!price.active) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: 'Invalid or inactive price ID' },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }
    } catch (stripeError) {
      console.error('Stripe price validation error:', stripeError);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid price ID' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Create Checkout Session
    const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
      line_items: [
        {
          price: priceId,
          quantity: 1
        }
      ],
      mode: 'subscription',
      success_url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/stripe/checkout?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}`,
      cancel_url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/pricing`,
      allow_promotion_codes: true,
      subscription_data: {
        trial_period_days: 14,
        metadata: {
          plan_name: planName,
          billing_cycle: isYearly ? 'yearly' : 'monthly',
          source: source || 'unknown', // Track where the checkout was initiated
          organization_id: organizationId
        }
      },
      metadata: {
        plan_name: planName,
        billing_cycle: isYearly ? 'yearly' : 'monthly',
        source: source || 'unknown',
        organization_id: organizationId
      }
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ url: session.url });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error creating checkout session:', error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Failed to create checkout session' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import {
  getCookieStringFromCookieStore,
  getErrorRedirect,
  validateOrganizationAccess
} from '@/lib/utils';
import TeamsDashboard from './teams-dashboard';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { ROLES } from '@signvault/logto';

export default async function TeamsDashboardPage(
  props: Readonly<{
    params: Readonly<{ organizationId: string }>;
  }>
) {
  const params = await props.params;
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const data = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookieStore.getAll());

  // 0. check if the user is authenticated
  if (!data.isAuthenticated) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/`,
        'Not Logged In',
        'You are not logged in. Please log in to continue.'
      )
    );
  }

  // 1. Validate organization access and role
  const validationError = await validateOrganizationAccess(
    data.claims.sub,
    params.organizationId,
    ROLES.L5_USER.id,
    cookieString,
    `/account/organizations/${params.organizationId}`
  );

  if (validationError) {
    return validationError;
  }

  // Fetch teams
  const teamsResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${params.organizationId}/teams?organizationId=${params.organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  const teams = await teamsResponse.json();

  // Fetch team statistics
  const statsResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/organizations/${params.organizationId}/teams/stats?organizationId=${params.organizationId}`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  );

  const stats = await statsResponse.json();

  return (
    <TeamsDashboard
      organizationId={params.organizationId}
      teams={teams}
      stats={stats}
      cookieStore={cookieStore}
      user={data.claims}
    />
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/api/logging/route.ts ===

import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

/**
 * Handles the logging request.
 * @param request - The request object.
 * @api {POST} /api/logging
 * @apiName Log
 * @apiGroup Logging
 * @apiDescription Logs a message to the server.
 * @apiParam {String} level - The log level.
 * @apiParam {String} message - The log message.
 * @apiParam {String} requestId - The request ID.
 * @apiParam {Object} meta - The metadata.
 * @apiSuccess {Boolean} success - Whether the log was sent successfully.
 * @returns A JSON response.
 */
export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    // Get body
    const body = await request.json();
    const { level, message, requestId: bodyRequestId, ...meta } = body;
    const requestId =
      request.headers.get('x-request-id') ?? bodyRequestId ?? getRandomUUID();
    const timestamp = Date.now() * 1000000;

    // Create log entry
    const logEntry = {
      streams: [
        {
          stream: {
            app: 'signvault-frontend',
            level
          },
          values: [
            [
              timestamp.toString(),
              JSON.stringify({
                requestId,
                message,
                ...meta,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
              })
            ]
          ]
        }
      ]
    };

    // Send log entry to Loki
    const response = await fetch(
      `${process.env.GRAFANA_URL}/loki/api/v1/push`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Authorization': `Basic ${Buffer.from(`${process.env.GRAFANA_USER}:${process.env.GRAFANA_TOKEN}`).toString('base64')}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(logEntry)
      }
    );

    // Check if log entry was sent successfully
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to send log to Loki: ${response.status}`);
    }

    // Return success response
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) {
    // Log error
    console.error('Logging error:', error);

    // Return error response
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/toast-handler.tsx ===

'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';

type ToastHandlerProps = {
  error?: string;
  success?: string;
};

export default function ToastHandler({ success, error }: ToastHandlerProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(
    success || null
  );
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(
    error || null
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (successMessage) {
      switch (successMessage) {
        case 'twitter_account_already_connected':
          toast.error('Twitter account already connected.');
          break;
        case 'twitter_connected':
          toast.success('Twitter account connected successfully.', {
            duration: 3000
          });
          break;
        case 'twitter_connection_failed':
          toast.error('Failed to connect Twitter account. Please try again.');
          break;
        case 'twitter_disconnected':
          toast.success('Twitter account disconnected successfully.');
          break;
        default:
          toast.error('Successfully connected social media account.');
      }
    } else if (errorMessage) {
      switch (errorMessage) {
        case 'invalid_request':
          toast.error('Invalid request. Please try again.');
          break;
        case 'twitter_account_already_connected':
          toast.error('Twitter account already connected.');
          break;
        case 'twitter_connection_failed':
          toast.error('Failed to connect Twitter account. Please try again.');
          break;
        default:
          toast.error('Failed to connect social media account.');
      }
    }

    // Delay the router.replace call
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      router.replace('/account/settings/organization', {
        scroll: false
      });
    }, 3000); // Increased to 3000ms to match toast duration

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      setSuccessMessage(null);
      setErrorMessage(null);
    };
  }, [successMessage, errorMessage, router]);

  return null;
}

=== FILE: ./components/pages/notifications/structured-metadata.tsx ===

/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any */

'use client';

import { camelCaseToTitleCase } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Badge } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/badge';
import React from 'react';

const renderValue = (value: any): React.ReactNode => {
  if (
    typeof value === 'string' &&
    (value.toLowerCase().endsWith('key') || value.toLowerCase().endsWith('id'))
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  if (value === null || typeof value === 'undefined') {
    return <span className='text-muted-foreground'>N/A</span>;
  }

  if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
    return (
      <Badge variant={value ? 'default' : 'destructive'}>{String(value)}</Badge>
    );
  }

  if (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number') {
    return <span>{value}</span>;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return (
      <div className='flex flex-wrap gap-1'>
        {value.map((item, index) => (
          <Badge variant='secondary' key={index}>
            {renderValue(item)}
          </Badge>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    return <StructuredMetadata data={value} />;
  }

  return <span>{String(value)}</span>;
};

export function StructuredMetadata({ data }: { data: any }) {
  if (typeof data !== 'object' || data === null) {
    return renderValue(data);
  }

  return (
    <div className='space-y-3'>
      {Object.entries(data)
        // ! IMPORTANT: do not display the objects that have a key that ends with key or id
        .filter(
          ([key]) =>
            !key.toLowerCase().endsWith('key') &&
            !key.toLowerCase().endsWith('id')
        )
        .map(([key, value]) => (
          <div
            key={key}
            className='flex flex-col items-start gap-2 md:flex-row md:items-center'
          >
            <Badge
              variant='outline'
              className='border-line bg-background/50 text-sm'
            >
              {camelCaseToTitleCase(key)}
            </Badge>
            <div className='text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
              {renderValue(value)}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/organization/users/utils.ts ===

import type {
  ActiveTeamInheritedFromTemplateCS,
  ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS
} from '@signvault/db/types';

import {
  AccessScope,
  ClearanceSecurityLevel,
  PermissionType,
  Weekday
} from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer/enums';
import {
  FunctionPrimaryRole,
  FunctionSpecialization
} from '@signvault/db/types';

import type { EditUserFormValues } from './types';

/**
 * Format permission categories for display
 */
export function formatPermissionCategories(
  permissionCategories: Record<string, PermissionType[]>
) {
  return Object.entries(permissionCategories).map(
    ([category, permissions]) => ({
      title: category,
      permissions
    })
  );
}

/**
 * Get default form values for user editing
 */
export function getDefaultFormValues(): EditUserFormValues {
  return {
    team: '',
    role: '',
    attributes: {
      function: {
        primary: FunctionPrimaryRole.SIGNER,
        specialization: FunctionSpecialization.SIGNATURE_CEREMONY
      },
      clearance: {
        level: ClearanceSecurityLevel.CONFIDENTIAL,
        scope: [AccessScope.VIEW]
      },
      temporalAccess: {
        timezone: Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone,
        schedule: {
          days: [
            Weekday.MONDAY,
            Weekday.TUESDAY,
            Weekday.WEDNESDAY,
            Weekday.THURSDAY,
            Weekday.FRIDAY
          ],
          hours: {
            start: '09:00',
            end: '17:00'
          },
          timeRange: '09:00-17:00'
        }
      }
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Get permission categories for filtering
 */
export function getPermissionCategories() {
  return Object.entries(PermissionType).reduce<
    Record<string, PermissionType[]>
  >((acc, [key, value]) => {
    const category = key.split('_')[0];
    if (!acc[category]) {
      acc[category] = [];
    }
    acc[category].push(value);
    return acc;
  }, {});
}

/**
 * Check if a team is inherited from a template
 */
export function isTemplateTeam(
  team: ActiveTeamWithDetailsCS | undefined
): team is ActiveTeamInheritedFromTemplateCS {
  return !!team?.teamTemplateId;
}

=== FILE: ./app/api/logto/rbac-protected-resource/route.ts ===

import { logtoClientEdge } from '@/app/logto';
import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import { type NextRequest } from 'next/server';

/**
 * Handles the RBAC protected resource request.
 * @param request - The request object.
 * @returns A JSON response.
 */
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  // Get request ID
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();

  // Get server logger
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'rbac-protected-resource');

  try {
    // Log info
    logger.info('Processing RBAC protected resource request', {
      url: request.url
    });

    // Get Logto context
    const { isAuthenticated, scopes } = await logtoClientEdge.getLogtoContext(
      request,
      {
        getAccessToken: true,
        resource: 'https://auth.signvault.io/app'
      }
    );

    // Check if user is authenticated
    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      logger.warn('Unauthorized access attempt', {
        url: request.url
      });
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ message: 'Unauthorized' }), {
        status: 401
      });
    }

    // Check if user has the required scope
    if (!scopes?.includes('read:users')) {
      logger.warn('Access denied due to insufficient scope', {
        url: request.url,
        requiredScope: 'read:users'
      });
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({
          message: 'Access denied, requires read:user scope.'
        }),
        {
          status: 403
        }
      );
    }

    // Log info
    logger.info('Access granted to RBAC protected resource', {
      url: request.url
    });

    // Return response
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        data: 'this_is_resource_protected_by_rbac_scope'
      })
    );
  } catch (error) {
    // Log error
    logger.error('Error in RBAC protected resource route', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
      url: request.url
    });
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ message: 'Internal Server Error' }), {
      status: 500
    });
  }
}

type CalendarDayEventsDialogProps = {
  date: Date;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  open: boolean;
  organizationId: string;
  processedEvents: ProcessedEvent[];
  teamId: string;
};

export function CalendarDayEventsDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  date,
  processedEvents,
  organizationId,
  teamId,
  isAdmin
}: Readonly<CalendarDayEventsDialogProps>) {
  return (
    <Dialog onOpenChange={onOpenChange} open={open}>
      <DialogContent className='max-h-[80vh] max-w-5xl overflow-y-auto'>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Events for {format(date, 'do MMMM, yyyy')}</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2'>
          {/* filter out duplicate events with same id */}
          {processedEvents
            .filter(
              (obj, index, self) =>
                index ===
                self.findIndex(
                  (o) =>
                    o.startDate === obj.startDate &&
                    o.endDate === obj.endDate &&
                    o.title === obj.title &&
                    o.location === obj.location
                )
            )
            .map((event) => (
              <EventCard
                event={event as unknown as CalendarEvent}
                isAdmin={isAdmin}
                key={
                  event.id.includes('_processed_')
                    ? event.id.split('_processed_')[0]
                    : event.id
                }
                organizationId={organizationId}
                teamId={teamId}
              />
            ))}
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

'use client';

import { FormElements } from './form-elements';
import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { useDraggable } from '@dnd-kit/core';
import { cn } from '@signvault/ui-lib/lib/utils';

export function ToolboxElementOverlay({
  formElement,
  isButton = true
}: {
  formElement: (typeof FormElements)[keyof typeof FormElements];
  isButton?: boolean;
}) {
  const { label, icon: Icon } = formElement.designerButtonElement;

  return (
    <Button
      variant='light'
      className={cn(
        'flex cursor-grab  w-full h-auto text-foreground flex-row gap-3 items-center justify-start',
        isButton && ''
      )}
    >
      <Icon className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 text-primary' />
      <p className='text-sm'>{label}</p>
    </Button>
  );
}

function ToolboxElement({
  formElement
}: {
  formElement: (typeof FormElements)[keyof typeof FormElements];
}) {
  const { label, icon: Icon } = formElement.designerButtonElement;
  const draggable = useDraggable({
    id: formElement.type,
    data: {
      type: formElement.type,
      isToolboxElement: true
    }
  });

  return (
    <Button
      ref={draggable.setNodeRef}
      variant='default'
      className={cn(
        'flex cursor-grab bg-white dark:bg-card dark:border-solid dark:border-border dark:border-1 text-foreground flex-row gap-3 items-center justify-start hover:bg-white/90',
        draggable.isDragging && 'ring-1 ring-primary bg-primary/10'
      )}
      {...draggable.listeners}
      {...draggable.attributes}
    >
      <Icon className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 text-primary' />
      <p className='text-md font-medium'>{label}</p>
    </Button>
  );
}

export function Toolbox() {
  return (
    <div>
      <div className={cn('flex md:flex-col flex-row flex-wrap gap-2')}>
        {Object.values(FormElements).map((element) => (
          <ToolboxElement key={element.type} formElement={element} />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

              <Calendar className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 text-primary' />
              <span className='text-sm'>Timeline View</span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
              <LayoutList className='size-5 min-h-5 min-w-5 text-primary' />
              <span className='text-sm'>Events List View</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </motion.div>
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Create Organization',
  description: 'Create a new organization in SignVault.'
};

export default async function CreateOrganization2Page() {
  const { claims, isAuthenticated } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

  const cookiesStore = await cookies();
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookiesStore);
  const teamTemplates = await getTeamTemplates();
  const naicsCodes = await getNaicsCodes();

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/settings/basic',
        'Unauthorized',
        'You are not authorized to access this page.'
      )
    );
  }

  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  if (!dbUser) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/settings/basic',
        'Unauthorized',
        'You are not authorized to access this page.'
      )
    );
  }

  // Check if user is already a member of an organization
  if (dbUser.organizationJoined) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/settings/organization',
        'Already in Organization',
        'You are already a member of an organization.'
      )
    );
  }

  return (
    <CreateOrganizationForm
      cookieString={cookieString}
      naicsCodes={naicsCodes}
      teamTemplates={teamTemplates}
      user={dbUser}
    />
  );

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/data-provenance/events/events-page.tsx ===

'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { Events } from '@signvault/db/types';
import debounce from 'lodash/debounce';
import { EventsPageControls } from './events-page-controls';
import { EventList } from './event-list';

export function EventsPage({
  provenanceEvents
}: {
  provenanceEvents: Events[];
}) {
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<'date' | 'document' | 'type'>('date');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'grid' | 'list'>('list');

  const debouncedSearch = useMemo(
    () =>
      debounce((value: string) => {
        setSearch(value);
      }, 300),
    []
  );

  const filteredEventsData = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = [...provenanceEvents];

    if (search) {
      const searchLower = search.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.type.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          item.ontologyType.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
          String(item.id).includes(searchLower)
      );
    }

    filtered.sort((a, b) => {
      switch (sortBy) {
        case 'date':
          return (
            new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime()
          );
        case 'document':
          return a.type.localeCompare(b.type);
        case 'type':
          return a.ontologyType.localeCompare(b.ontologyType);
        default:
          return 0;
      }
    });

    return filtered;
  }, [provenanceEvents, search, sortBy]);

  return (
    <div className='space-y-6'>
      <EventsPageControls
        onSearch={debouncedSearch}
        onSortChange={(value) =>
          setSortBy(value as 'date' | 'document' | 'type')
        }
        sortBy={sortBy}
        onViewModeChange={setViewMode}
        viewMode={viewMode}
      />
      <EventList events={filteredEventsData} viewMode={viewMode} />
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/organization/join-requests/page.tsx ===

import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import JoinRequestsPageClient from './join-requests-page';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getDbUser } from '@/actions/auth';
import {
  getOrganizationJoinRequests,
  getOrganizationJoinRequestsForUser
} from '@/actions/organization-join-requests';
import { getErrorRedirect } from '@/lib/utils';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { ROLES } from '@signvault/logto';
import { AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS } from '@signvault/core-lib/index';

export default async function JoinRequestsPage() {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const user = await getDbUser({ claims });

  if (!user) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organization/information',
        'Not logged in or user not found in database.'
      )
    );
  }

  const isAdmin =
    user.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L6_USER.id ||
    user.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
    user.isCreator ||
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS.includes(String(user.id) as any);

  let result;

  if (!user.organizationId && !user.organizationJoined) {
    result = await getOrganizationJoinRequestsForUser(user.id);
  } else if (isAdmin) {
    result = await getOrganizationJoinRequests(user.organizationId);
  } else {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organization/information',
        'Unauthorized access.'
      )
    );
  }

  const { requests = [], success = false, error = '' } = result || {};

  if (!success) {
    console.error(error);
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/organization/information',
        'Failed to fetch organization join requests. Please try again later.'
      )
    );
  }

  return <JoinRequestsPageClient requests={requests} user={user} />;
}

import type { NotificationStatusEnum } from '@signvault/db/types';

import { useNotifications } from '@/contexts/notifications-context';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardHeader
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/card';
import React, { useCallback, useState } from 'react';

import { NotificationFilters } from './notification-filters';
import { NotificationList } from './notification-list';
import { NotificationStats } from './notification-stats';

export function NotificationDashboard() {
  const { notifications = [] } = useNotifications();
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<
    NotificationStatusEnum | 'ALL'
  >('ALL');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

  const filteredNotifications = useCallback(() => {
    let filtered = Array.isArray(notifications) ? notifications : [];

    // Apply status filter
    if (statusFilter !== 'ALL') {
      filtered = filtered.filter((n) => n.status === statusFilter);
    }

    // Apply search filter
    if (searchQuery) {
      const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(
        (n) =>
          n.title?.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
          n.message.toLowerCase().includes(query)
      );
    }

    return filtered;
  }, [notifications, statusFilter, searchQuery]);

  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <div className='-mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-2'>
        <NotificationStats />
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <NotificationFilters
            onSearchChange={setSearchQuery}
            onStatusChange={setStatusFilter}
            searchQuery={searchQuery}
            statusFilter={statusFilter}
          />
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <NotificationList notifications={filteredNotifications()} />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </React.Fragment>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/api/geocoding/route.ts ===

import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

/**
 * Handles the geocoding request.
 * @param request - The request object.
 * @returns A JSON response.
 */
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  // Setup logger
  const requestId = request.headers.get('x-request-id') ?? getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'geocoding');

  // Log info
  logger.info('Processing geocoding request', {
    url: request.url
  });

  const searchParams = request.nextUrl.searchParams;
  const query = searchParams.get('query');

  // Check if query parameter is missing
  if (!query) {
    logger.warn('Query parameter is missing', {
      url: request.url
    });
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Query parameter is required' },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  try {
    // Fetch geocoding data from Mapbox
    const url = new URL(
      `https://api.mapbox.com/search/geocode/v6/forward?q=${encodeURIComponent(
        query
      )}&access_token=${process.env.MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN}&limit=20&types=address,district,place,locality,neighborhood,street,secondary_address`
    );

    const response = await fetch(url.toString(), {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      }
    });

    const data = await response.json();

    // Log info
    logger.info('Geocoding request handled successfully', {
      url: request.url
    });
    return NextResponse.json(data);
  } catch (error) {
    // Log error
    logger.error('Error fetching address suggestions', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
      url: request.url
    });

    // Return error response
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Failed to fetch address suggestions' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export function NotificationBell() {

  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

    <Popover onOpenChange={handleOpenChange} open={isOpen}>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          aria-label='Open notifications'
          className='relative'
          size='icon'
          variant='outline'
        >
          <BellIcon className='size-4 min-h-4 min-w-4' />
          {unreadCount > 0 && (
            <span className='text-[11px]! absolute right-0 top-0 flex size-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-destructive text-xs text-destructive-foreground'>
              {unreadCount > 99 ? '99+' : unreadCount}
            </span>
          )}
        </Button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent
        align='end'
        className='w-80 p-0 md:w-[400px] lg:w-[500px] xl:w-[600px] 2xl:w-[700px]'

=== FILE: ./app/api/logto/sign-in/route.ts ===

import { logtoClientEdge } from '@/app/logto';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { handleUserCheck } from '@/lib/auth-utils';
import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

/**
 * Handles the Logto sign-in request.
 * @param request - The request object.
 * @returns A redirect response.
 */
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  // Get request ID
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();

  // Get server logger
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'logto-sign-in');

  // Get cookies
  const cookiesStore = await cookies();

  try {
    // Log info
    logger.info('Processing sign-in request', {
      url: request.url
    });

    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

    // Log info
    logger.info('Got Logto context', {
      hasClaims: !!claims,
      userId: claims?.sub
    });

    const userCheckResult = await handleUserCheck(
      claims,
      request,
      false,
      cookiesStore
    );

    // Check if user check resulted in redirect
    if (userCheckResult) {
      // Log info
      logger.info('User check resulted in redirect', {
        userId: claims?.sub
      });
      return userCheckResult;
    }

    // Log info
    logger.info('Handling sign-in with Logto', {
      userId: claims?.sub
    });

    // Handle sign-in with Logto
    return logtoClientEdge.handleSignIn()(request);
  } catch (error) {
    // Log error
    logger.error('Error in sign-in route', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
      url: request.url
    });
    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/', request.url));
  }
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/organizations/[organizationId]/teams/[teamId]/events/page.tsx ===

import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getCookieStringFromCookieStore, getErrorRedirect } from '@/lib/utils';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { AllTeamEventsPage } from './all-team-events-page';
import type { GetTeamCalendarEventsResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/team-calendar-events';

export default async function EventsPage({
  params
}: Readonly<{
  params: Readonly<{
    organizationId: string;
    teamId: string;
  }>;
}>) {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const data = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const cookieString = getCookieStringFromCookieStore(cookieStore.getAll());
  const { organizationId, teamId } = await params;

  // 0. check if the user is authenticated
  if (!data.isAuthenticated) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/`,
        'Not Logged In',
        'You are not logged in. Please log in to continue.'
      )
    );
  }

  // 1. Fetch all events
  const eventsResponse: GetTeamCalendarEventsResponse = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/team-calendar-events/${teamId}?organizationId=${organizationId}`,
    {
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString
      }
    }
  ).then((res) => res.json());

  if (
    eventsResponse.message !== 'Team calendar events retrieved successfully'
  ) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `/account/organizations/${organizationId}/teams/${teamId}`,
        'Events Not Found',
        'Failed to retrieve events.'
      )
    );
  }

  return (
    <AllTeamEventsPage
      events={eventsResponse.events.database}
      organizationId={organizationId}
      teamId={teamId}
    />
  );
}

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { addDays, startOfWeek } from 'date-fns';

import { useCalendarContext } from '../../calendar-context';
import CalendarBodyDayContent from '../day/calendar-body-day-content';
import CalendarBodyMarginDayMargin from '../day/calendar-body-margin-day-margin';
import CalendarBodyWeekFullDayEvents from './calendar-body-week-full-day-events';

export default function CalendarBodyWeek() {
  const { date, topOffset } = useCalendarContext();

  const weekStart = startOfWeek(date, { weekStartsOn: 1 });
  const weekDays = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => addDays(weekStart, i));

  return (
    <div className='flex grow divide-x overflow-hidden'>
      <div className='flex grow flex-col divide-y overflow-hidden'>

          <div className='relative flex flex-1 flex-col md:flex-row'>

            <div className='relative flex flex-1 flex-col'>
              <div className='flex flex-1 divide-x'>
                <CalendarBodyWeekFullDayEvents />
                {weekDays.map((day) => (
                  <div
                    className={cn(`flex flex-1 divide-x md:divide-x-0`)}
                    key={day.toISOString()}
                    style={{
                      marginTop: topOffset ? `${topOffset}px` : '0'
                    }}
                  >
                    <CalendarBodyMarginDayMargin className='block md:hidden' />
                    <CalendarBodyDayContent date={day} type='week' />
                  </div>
                ))}

          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

=== FILE: ./components/form-builder/store-provider.tsx ===

'use client';

import { type ReactNode, createContext, useRef } from 'react';
import { create } from 'zustand';

import { immer } from 'zustand/middleware/immer';

import type { FormElementInstance } from './types';

export type FormBuilderStore = {
  elements: FormElementInstance[];
  addElement: (element: FormElementInstance) => void;
  removeElement: (id: string) => void;
  updateElement: (id: string, element: FormElementInstance) => void;
  setElements: (elements: FormElementInstance[]) => void;
};

export const FormBuilderStoreContext = createContext<
  FormBuilderStore | undefined
>(undefined);

export type FormBuilderStoreProviderProps = {
  children: ReactNode;
};

export const FormBuilderStoreProvider = ({
  children
}: FormBuilderStoreProviderProps) => {
  const storeRef = useRef<FormBuilderStore | null>(null);
  if (storeRef.current === null) {
    storeRef.current = useFormBuilderStore.getState();
  }

  return (
    <FormBuilderStoreContext.Provider value={storeRef.current}>
      {children}
    </FormBuilderStoreContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useFormBuilderStore = create<FormBuilderStore>()(
  immer((set) => ({
    elements: [],
    addElement: (element) =>
      set((state) => {
        state.elements.push(element);
      }),
    removeElement: (id) =>
      set((state) => {
        state.elements = state.elements.filter((element) => element.id !== id);
      }),
    updateElement: (id, element) =>
      set((state) => {
        const index = state.elements.findIndex((el) => el.id === id);
        if (index !== -1) {
          state.elements[index] = element;
        }
      }),
    setElements: (elements) =>
      set((state) => {
        state.elements = elements;
      })
  }))
);

=== FILE: ./lib/checkout-sources.ts ===

/**
 * Standardized source identifiers for checkout tracking
 * This helps track where users are initiating checkout from
 */
export const CHECKOUT_SOURCES = {
  // Landing page sources
  HERO_SECTION: 'hero-section',
  PRICING_SECTION: 'pricing-section',

  // Dashboard sources
  DASHBOARD_UPGRADE_BANNER: 'dashboard-upgrade-banner',
  DASHBOARD_UPGRADE_CARD: 'dashboard-upgrade-card',

  // Account page sources
  SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS: 'subscription-status',
  ORGANIZATION_PAGE: 'organization-page',

  // Component sources
  STRIPE_CHECKOUT_BUTTON: 'stripe-checkout-button',

  // Fallback
  UNKNOWN: 'unknown'
} as const;

export type CheckoutSource =
  (typeof CHECKOUT_SOURCES)[keyof typeof CHECKOUT_SOURCES];

/**
 * Get a human-readable description for a checkout source
 */
export function getCheckoutSourceDescription(source: CheckoutSource): string {
  const descriptions: Record<CheckoutSource, string> = {
    [CHECKOUT_SOURCES.HERO_SECTION]: 'Landing Page Hero Section',
    [CHECKOUT_SOURCES.PRICING_SECTION]: 'Pricing Section',
    [CHECKOUT_SOURCES.DASHBOARD_UPGRADE_BANNER]: 'Dashboard Upgrade Banner',
    [CHECKOUT_SOURCES.DASHBOARD_UPGRADE_CARD]: 'Dashboard Upgrade Card',
    [CHECKOUT_SOURCES.SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS]: 'Subscription Status Component',
    [CHECKOUT_SOURCES.ORGANIZATION_PAGE]: 'Organization Page',
    [CHECKOUT_SOURCES.STRIPE_CHECKOUT_BUTTON]: 'Stripe Checkout Button',
    [CHECKOUT_SOURCES.UNKNOWN]: 'Unknown Source'
  };

  return descriptions[source];
}

/**
 * Validate if a source is a valid checkout source
 */
export function isValidCheckoutSource(
  source: string
): source is CheckoutSource {
  return Object.values(CHECKOUT_SOURCES).includes(source as CheckoutSource);
}

  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger

type RoleActionsProps = {
  onSelectRole: (role: RoleCS) => void;
  role: RoleCS | RoleTemplate;
};

export function RoleActions({
  role,
  onSelectRole
}: Readonly<RoleActionsProps>) {
  const { organizationData } = useUserData();

  const isAdmin =
    organizationData?.user?.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id ||
    organizationData?.user?.isCreator;

  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
        <Button className='size-8 p-0' variant='ghost'>
          <span className='sr-only'>Open menu</span>
          <MoreHorizontal className='size-4' />
        </Button>
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent align='end' className='font-suisse-intl'>
        <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => onSelectRole(role as RoleCS)}>
          <Eye className='mr-2 size-4' />
          View Details
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        {isAdmin && 'type' in role && role.type === RoleType.CUSTOM && (

=== FILE: ./app/callback/route.ts ===

import { handleSignIn } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { deleteCookie, getCookie } from 'cookies-next/server';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { logtoConfig } from '../logto';

/**
 * Handles the Logto sign-in callback.
 * @param request - The request object.
 * @returns A redirect response.
 */
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  // Get search parameters
  const searchParams = request.nextUrl.searchParams;

  const headers = request.headers;

  console.log(
    'headers received on callback route:',
    JSON.stringify(headers, null, 2)
  );
  console.log(
    'searchParams received on callback route:',
    JSON.stringify(searchParams, null, 2)
  );

  // Handle sign-in
  await handleSignIn(logtoConfig, searchParams);

  // Check for redirect info in cookie
  const redirectInfo = await getCookie('join-organization-redirect-info', {
    cookies
  });

  if (redirectInfo) {
    try {
      const { organizationId, email } = JSON.parse(redirectInfo);

      // Create response with redirect
      const response = NextResponse.redirect(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/join-organization/${organizationId}?email=${email}`
      );

      // Delete the cookie
      await deleteCookie('join-organization-redirect-info', {
        cookies,
        path: '/'
      });

      return response;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error parsing redirect info cookie:', error);
    }
  }

  // Default flow - redirect to the account settings page
  return NextResponse.redirect(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/dashboard`
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/organization/users/hooks/use-permissions.ts ===

import { PERMISSION_CATEGORIES } from '@/app/(user)/create-organization/components/invite-users-form/constants';
import { PermissionType } from '@signvault/db/schemas/customer/enums';
import { useMemo } from 'react';

/**
 * Hook for evaluating permissions based on user attributes
 */
export function usePermissionEvaluation() {
  // Get all permission categories
  const permissionCategories = useMemo(() => {
    return Object.entries(PermissionType).reduce<
      Record<string, PermissionType[]>
    >((acc, [key, value]) => {
      const category = key.split('_')[0];
      if (!acc[category]) {
        acc[category] = [];
      }
      acc[category].push(value);
      return acc;
    }, {});
  }, []);

  // Format permission categories for display
  const filteredCategories = useMemo(() => {
    return Object.entries(permissionCategories).map(
      ([category, permissions]) => ({
        title: category,
        permissions
      })
    );
  }, [permissionCategories]);

  // Create a permission results map
  const permissionResults = useMemo(() => {
    const results = new Map<
      PermissionType,
      { allowed: boolean; reason?: string }
    >();

    // Flatten all permissions
    const allPermissions = Object.values(PERMISSION_CATEGORIES).flatMap(
      (category) => category.permissions
    );

    // For now, we'll just set all permissions as allowed
    for (const permission of allPermissions) {
      results.set(permission, { allowed: true });
    }

    return results;
  }, []);

  return {
    permissionCategories,
    filteredCategories,
    permissionResults
  };
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/join-organization/[organizationId]/actions.ts ===

'use server';

import { and, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import type { InviteCS, PendingUserCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { invitesCS, pendingUsersCS } from '@signvault/db/schema';

/**
 * Check if an invitation exists for a user in an organization
 * @param organizationId - The organization ID
 * @param email - The email of the user
 * @returns The invitation if it exists, otherwise null
 */
export async function validateInvitation(
  organizationId: bigint | string,
  email: string
): Promise<InviteCS | null> {
  const invitation = await db
    .select()
    .from(invitesCS)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(invitesCS.inviteeEmail, email),
        eq(
          invitesCS.organizationId,
          typeof organizationId === 'string'
            ? BigInt(organizationId)
            : organizationId
        )
      )
    );

  return invitation[0] ?? null;
}

/**
 * Check if a pending user exists in an organization
 * @param organizationId - The organization ID
 * @param email - The email of the user
 * @returns The pending user if it exists, otherwise null
 */
export async function validatePendingUser(
  organizationId: bigint | string,
  email: string
): Promise<PendingUserCS | null> {
  const pendingUser = await db
    .select()
    .from(pendingUsersCS)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(
          pendingUsersCS.organizationId,
          typeof organizationId === 'string'
            ? BigInt(organizationId)
            : organizationId
        ),
        eq(pendingUsersCS.email, email)
      )
    );

  return pendingUser[0] ?? null;
}

=== FILE: ./lib/notification-sound.ts ===

import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';

/**
 * The notification sound service.
 */
class NotificationSound {
  private audio: HTMLAudioElement | null = null;
  private enabled: boolean = true;

  /**
   * The constructor for the notification sound service.
   */
  constructor() {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      this.audio = new Audio('/sounds/notification.mp3');
      this.loadPreferences();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Loads the notification preferences.
   */
  private loadPreferences(): void {
    const preferences = localStorage.getItem('notificationPreferences');
    if (preferences) {
      const { soundEnabled } = JSON.parse(preferences);
      this.enabled = soundEnabled;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Sets the notification sound enabled state.
   * @param enabled - Whether the notification sound is enabled.
   */
  public setEnabled(enabled: boolean): void {
    this.enabled = enabled;
    localStorage.setItem(
      'notificationPreferences',
      JSON.stringify({ soundEnabled: enabled })
    );
  }

  /**
   * Plays the notification sound.
   */
  public async play(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.enabled || !this.audio) return;

    try {
      this.audio.currentTime = 0;
      await this.audio.play();
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        clientLogger.error('Failed to play notification sound:', {
          message: error.message
        });
      } else {
        clientLogger.error('Failed to play notification sound:', { error });
      }
    }
  }
}

export const notificationSound = new NotificationSound();

=== FILE: ./hooks/use-pagination.ts ===

type UsePaginationProps = {
  currentPage: number;
  paginationItemsToDisplay: number;
  totalPages: number;
};

type UsePaginationReturn = {
  pages: number[];
  showLeftEllipsis: boolean;
  showRightEllipsis: boolean;
};

export function usePagination({
  currentPage,
  totalPages,
  paginationItemsToDisplay
}: UsePaginationProps): UsePaginationReturn {
  const showLeftEllipsis = currentPage - 1 > paginationItemsToDisplay / 2;
  const showRightEllipsis =
    totalPages - currentPage + 1 > paginationItemsToDisplay / 2;

  function calculatePaginationRange(): number[] {
    if (totalPages <= paginationItemsToDisplay) {
      return Array.from({ length: totalPages }, (_, i) => i + 1);
    }

    const halfDisplay = Math.floor(paginationItemsToDisplay / 2);
    const initialRange = {
      start: currentPage - halfDisplay,
      end: currentPage + halfDisplay
    };

    const adjustedRange = {
      start: Math.max(1, initialRange.start),
      end: Math.min(totalPages, initialRange.end)
    };

    if (adjustedRange.start === 1) {
      adjustedRange.end = paginationItemsToDisplay;
    }
    if (adjustedRange.end === totalPages) {
      adjustedRange.start = totalPages - paginationItemsToDisplay + 1;
    }

    if (showLeftEllipsis) adjustedRange.start++;
    if (showRightEllipsis) adjustedRange.end--;

    return Array.from(
      {
        length: adjustedRange.end - adjustedRange.start + 1
      },
      (_, i) => adjustedRange.start + i
    );
  }

  const pages = calculatePaginationRange();

  return {
    pages,
    showLeftEllipsis,
    showRightEllipsis
  };
}

import { logtoClientEdge } from '@/app/logto';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { handleUserCheck } from '@/lib/auth-utils';
import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

/**
 * Handles the Logto sign-out request.
 * @param request - The request object.
 * @returns A redirect response.
 */
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  // Get request ID
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();

  // Get server logger
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'logto-sign-out');

  // Get cookies
  const cookiesStore = await cookies();

  try {
    // Log info
    logger.info('Processing sign-out request', {
      url: request.url
    });

    const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

    // Log info
    logger.info('Got Logto context', {
      hasClaims: !!claims,
      userId: claims?.sub
    });

    // Handle user check
    await handleUserCheck(claims, request, false, cookiesStore);

    // Log info
    logger.info('Handling sign-out with Logto', {
      userId: claims?.sub
    });

    // Handle sign-out with Logto
    return logtoClientEdge.handleSignOut()(request);
  } catch (error) {
    // Log error
    logger.error('Error in sign-out route', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
      url: request.url
    });
    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/', request.url));
  }
}

=== FILE: ./lib/auth/session.ts ===

import type { UserCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { compare, hash } from 'bcryptjs';
import { SignJWT, jwtVerify } from 'jose';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';

const key = new TextEncoder().encode(process.env.AUTH_SECRET);
const SALT_ROUNDS = 10;

export async function hashPassword(password: string) {
  return hash(password, SALT_ROUNDS);
}

export async function comparePasswords(
  plainTextPassword: string,
  hashedPassword: string
) {
  return compare(plainTextPassword, hashedPassword);
}

type SessionData = {
  user: { id: number };
  expires: string;
};

export async function signToken(payload: SessionData) {
  return await new SignJWT(payload)
    .setProtectedHeader({ alg: 'HS256' })
    .setIssuedAt()
    .setExpirationTime('1 day from now')
    .sign(key);
}

export async function verifyToken(input: string) {
  const { payload } = await jwtVerify(input, key, {
    algorithms: ['HS256']
  });
  return payload as SessionData;
}

export async function getSession() {
  const session = (await cookies()).get('session')?.value;
  if (!session) return null;
  return await verifyToken(session);
}

export async function setSession(user: UserCS) {
  const expiresInOneDay = new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  const session: SessionData = {
    user: { id: Number(user.id) },
    expires: expiresInOneDay.toISOString()
  };
  const encryptedSession = await signToken(session);
  (await cookies()).set('session', encryptedSession, {
    expires: expiresInOneDay,
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: true,
    sameSite: 'lax'
  });
}

=== FILE: ./app/api/s3/upload/route.ts ===

import { createPresignedPost } from '@aws-sdk/s3-presigned-post';
import { S3Client } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const { filename, contentType, organizationId } = await request.json();

  if (!filename || !contentType || !organizationId) {
    return Response.json(
      { error: 'Missing filename or contentType' },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  try {
    const client = new S3Client({
      region: process.env.S3_REGION,
      credentials: {
        accessKeyId: process.env.S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID,
        secretAccessKey: process.env.S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
      }
    });
    // Include organizationId in the key for multi-tenant separation
    const key = `org_${organizationId}/uploads/${uuidv4()}_${filename}`;

    const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10485760; // 10 MB
    const EXPIRATION_TIME = 600; // 10 minutes

    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment
    // @ts-ignore - type mismatch
    const { url, fields } = await createPresignedPost(client, {
      Bucket: process.env.S3_BUCKET,
      Key: key,
      Conditions: [
        ['content-length-range', 0, MAX_FILE_SIZE],
        ['starts-with', '$Content-Type', contentType]
      ],
      Fields: {
        'acl': 'private',
        'Content-Type': contentType
      },
      Expires: EXPIRATION_TIME
    });

    return Response.json({ url, fields, key });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    return Response.json({ error: (error as Error).message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

=== FILE: ./middleware/request-logger.ts ===

import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server';

import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import { type NextResponse } from 'next/server';

/**
 * Logs the request and response.
 * @param handler - The handler.
 * @returns The handler.
 */
export function requestLogger(
  handler: (req: NextRequest) => Promise<NextResponse>
) {
  return async (request: NextRequest) => {
    const requestId = request.headers.get('x-request-id') ?? getRandomUUID();
    const logger = await getServerLogger(requestId);
    const startTime = Date.now();
    const method = request.method;
    const url = request.url;

    logger.info(`Incoming request`, {
      requestId,
      method,
      url,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    });

    try {
      const response = await handler(request);
      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;

      logger.info(`Request completed`, {
        requestId,
        method,
        url,
        status: response.status,
        duration: `${duration}ms`,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      });

      return response;
    } catch (error) {
      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;

      logger.error(`Request failed`, {
        requestId,
        method,
        url,
        duration: `${duration}ms`,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
        stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : undefined,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      });

      throw error;
    }
  };
}

import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getServerLogger } from '@/lib/server-logger';
import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { type Metadata } from 'next';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import React from 'react';

import DashboardContent from './dashboard-content';

export const revalidate = 60;

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Admin Dashboard',
  description: 'SignVault Admin Dashboard'
};

async function DashboardPage() {
  const requestId = getRandomUUID();
  const logger = getServerLogger(requestId, 'dashboard');
  const cookieStore = await cookies();

  try {
    logger.info('Accessing admin dashboard page');

    const logtoResponse = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);

    logger.info('Logto context received', {
      hasLogtoResponse: !!logtoResponse,
      hasClaims: !!logtoResponse?.claims
    });

    const { claims } = logtoResponse;

    if (!claims) {
      logger.warn('No claims found, redirecting to sign-in');
      return redirect('/');
    }

    return (
      <DashboardContent
        cookieStore={cookieStore}
        data={logtoResponse}
        organizationId={claims.organizations[0] ?? 'zb184szj6nmm`'}
      />
    );
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Dashboard page error', {
      requestId,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    });
    return redirect('/');
  }
}

export default DashboardPage;

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/data-provenance/provenance-context.tsx ===

'use client';

import { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { ProvenanceRecords } from '@signvault/db/types';

type QueryExecutionResults = {
  data?: ProvenanceRecords[];
  executedQuery?: string;
  queryName?: string;
  totalCount?: number;
};

type ProvenanceContextType = {
  queryResults: QueryExecutionResults | null;
  isQueryResultsOpen: boolean;
  showQueryResults: (results: QueryExecutionResults) => void;
  hideQueryResults: () => void;
};

const ProvenanceContext = createContext<ProvenanceContextType | undefined>(
  undefined
);

export function ProvenanceProvider({
  children
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const [queryResults, setQueryResults] =
    useState<QueryExecutionResults | null>(null);
  const [isQueryResultsOpen, setIsQueryResultsOpen] = useState(false);

  const showQueryResults = useCallback((results: QueryExecutionResults) => {
    setQueryResults(results);
    setIsQueryResultsOpen(true);
  }, []);

  const hideQueryResults = useCallback(() => {
    setIsQueryResultsOpen(false);
  }, []);

  return (
    <ProvenanceContext.Provider
      value={{
        queryResults,
        isQueryResultsOpen,
        showQueryResults,
        hideQueryResults
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </ProvenanceContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useProvenance() {
  const context = useContext(ProvenanceContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error('useProvenance must be used within a ProvenanceProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

=== FILE: ./components/calendar/header/date/calendar-header-date-chevrons.tsx ===

import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import {
  addDays,
  addMonths,
  addWeeks,
  format,
  subDays,
  subMonths,
  subWeeks
} from 'date-fns';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';

import { useCalendarContext } from '../../calendar-context';

export default function CalendarHeaderDateChevrons() {
  const { mode, date, setDate } = useCalendarContext();

  function handleDateBackward() {
    switch (mode) {
      case 'day':
        setDate(subDays(date, 1));
        break;
      case 'month':
        setDate(subMonths(date, 1));
        break;
      case 'week':
        setDate(subWeeks(date, 1));
        break;
    }
  }

  function handleDateForward() {
    switch (mode) {
      case 'day':
        setDate(addDays(date, 1));
        break;
      case 'month':
        setDate(addMonths(date, 1));
        break;
      case 'week':
        setDate(addWeeks(date, 1));
        break;
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className='flex items-center gap-2'>
      <Button
        className='size-7 p-1'
        onClick={handleDateBackward}
        variant='outline'
      >
        <ChevronLeft className='min-h-5 min-w-5' />
      </Button>

      <span className='min-w-[140px] text-center font-medium'>
        {format(date, 'MMMM d, yyyy')}
      </span>

      <Button
        className='size-7 p-1'
        onClick={handleDateForward}
        variant='outline'
      >
        <ChevronRight className='min-h-5 min-w-5' />
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

import { type DocumentCS } from '@signvault/db/types';

  id: string; // unique id for the file in the list (e.g., using crypto.randomUUID())
  file: File;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  tags: string[]; // Store as an array of strings
  status:
    | 'pending' // Waiting for details or to be uploaded
    | 'uploading-s3' // Uploading to S3
    | 'creating-record' // Creating database record
    | 'completed' // Successfully uploaded and record created
    | 'error'; // An error occurred
  progress: number; // 0-100, overall progress for this file
  s3Key?: string;
  storageLocation?: string;
  dbRecord?: DocumentCS;
  fileSize?: bigint; // Size of the file in bytes
  mimeType?: string; // MIME type of the file (e.g., 'application/pdf)
  draftId?: bigint; // The ID of the draft record in the database
  error?: string; // Error message if status is 'error'
};

export type UploadStep =
  | 'selectFiles' // Step 1: User selects files
  | 'editDetails' // Step 2: User edits details for selected files
  | 'uploading' // Step 3: Files are being uploaded
  | 'summary'; // Step 4: Show summary of upload (success/failures)

// This can replace or augment the existing DocumentUploadState for the wizard
export type DocumentUploadWizardState = {
  step: UploadStep;
  files: UploadableFileDetail[];
  overallProgress: number; // Can be an average or based on completed files
  globalError?: string | null; // For errors not specific to a single file
};
