=== FILE: ./components/scroll-to-top-button.tsx ===

'use client';

import { Button } from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/button';
import { ChevronUp } from 'lucide-react';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

const ScrollToTopButton = () => {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const toggleVisibility = () => {
      window.scrollY > 500 ? setIsVisible(true) : setIsVisible(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', toggleVisibility);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', toggleVisibility);
    };
  }, []);

  const scrollToTop = () => {
    isVisible &&
      window.scrollTo({
        top: 0,
        behavior: 'auto'
      });
  };

  return pathname.startsWith('/blogs/') ||
    pathname.startsWith('/case-studies/') ? null : (
    <Button
      className={`ease-in-out-sine z-100 group fixed bottom-4 right-4 size-12 rounded-2xl border-2 border-primary/50 bg-background/95 p-0 backdrop-blur-[1px] transition-all duration-300 hover:border-primary/60 hover:bg-background/70 xs:right-4 sm:right-4 md:right-4 lg:right-12 xl:right-4 ${
        isVisible ? 'opacity-100' : 'cursor-default opacity-0'
      }`}
      onClick={scrollToTop}
      variant={'outline'}
    >
      <ChevronUp className='ease-in-out-sine size-6 transition-all duration-300 group-hover:mb-1' />
      <span className='sr-only'>Scroll to top</span>
    </Button>
  );
};

export default ScrollToTopButton;

=== FILE: ./hooks/use-tags.ts ===

import { useState } from 'react';

type Tag = {
  color?: string;
  id: string;
  label: string;
};

type UseTagsProps = {
  defaultColors?: string[];
  defaultTags?: Tag[];
  maxTags?: number;
  onChange?: (tags: Tag[]) => void;
};

export function useTags({
  onChange,
  defaultTags = [],
  maxTags = 10,
  defaultColors = [
    'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-300',
    'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-900/30 dark:text-purple-300',
    'bg-green-100 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-300',
    'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 dark:bg-yellow-900/30 dark:text-yellow-300',
    'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-300'
  ]
}: UseTagsProps = {}) {
  const [tags, setTags] = useState<Tag[]>(defaultTags);

  function addTag(tag: Tag) {
    if (tags.length >= maxTags) return;

    const newTags = [
      ...tags,
      {
        ...tag,
        color: tag.color || defaultColors[tags.length % defaultColors.length]
      }
    ];
    setTags(newTags);
    onChange?.(newTags);
    return newTags;
  }

  function removeTag(tagId: string) {
    const newTags = tags.filter((t) => t.id !== tagId);
    setTags(newTags);
    onChange?.(newTags);
    return newTags;
  }

  function removeLastTag() {
    if (tags.length === 0) return;
    return removeTag(tags[tags.length - 1].id);
  }

  return {
    tags,
    setTags,
    addTag,
    removeTag,
    removeLastTag,
    hasReachedMax: tags.length >= maxTags
  };
}

=== FILE: ./utils/id-mappings.ts ===

import type { CreateIdMappingResponse } from '@signvault/backend/src/routes/id-mappings';
import type { IdMappingMetadata } from '@signvault/core-lib';

import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';

/**
 * Creates an ID mapping.
 * @param shortId - The short ID.
 * @param uuid - The UUID.
 * @param metadata - The metadata.
 * @param cookieString - The cookie string.
 * @returns The ID mapping.
 */
export const createIdMapping = async (
  shortId: string,
  uuid: string,
  metadata: IdMappingMetadata,
  cookieString: string
): Promise<
  { message: 'Failed to create ID mapping' } | CreateIdMappingResponse
> => {
  clientLogger.info(`Creating ID mapping`, {
    shortId,
    uuid,
    metadata,
    cookieString
  });
  const response = await fetch(
    `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}/api/id-mappings`,
    {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'cookie-string': cookieString,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ shortId, uuid, metadata })
    }
  );
  if (!response.ok) {
    clientLogger.error(`Failed to create ID mapping`, {
      response
    });
    return {
      message: 'Failed to create ID mapping'
    };
  }
  const json = (await response.json()) as unknown as CreateIdMappingResponse;

  clientLogger.info(`ID mapping created successfully`, {
    response: json,
    message: json.message,
    shortId,
    uuid,
    metadata,
    cookieString
  });

  return json;
};

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/documents/preview-cache-store-provider.tsx ===

'use client';

import { type ReactNode, createContext, useRef } from 'react';
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { immer } from 'zustand/middleware/immer';

export type PreviewCacheStore = {
  cache: Record<string, string>;
  getUrl: (s3Key: string) => string | undefined;
  setUrl: (s3Key: string, url: string) => void;
  deleteUrl: (s3Key: string) => void;
  clear: () => void;
};

export const PreviewCacheStoreContext = createContext<
  PreviewCacheStore | undefined
>(undefined);

export type PreviewCacheStoreProviderProps = {
  children: ReactNode;
};

export const usePreviewCacheStore = create<PreviewCacheStore>()(
  immer((set, get) => ({
    cache: {},
    getUrl: (s3Key) => get().cache[s3Key],
    setUrl: (s3Key, url) =>
      set((state) => {
        state.cache[s3Key] = url;
      }),
    deleteUrl: (s3Key) =>
      set((state) => {
        delete state.cache[s3Key];
      }),
    clear: () =>
      set((state) => {
        state.cache = {};
      })
  }))
);

export const PreviewCacheStoreProvider = ({
  children
}: PreviewCacheStoreProviderProps) => {
  // Keep per-request/store instance safe
  const storeRef = useRef<PreviewCacheStore | null>(null);
  if (storeRef.current === null) {
    storeRef.current = usePreviewCacheStore.getState();
  }

  return (
    <PreviewCacheStoreContext.Provider value={storeRef.current}>
      {children}
    </PreviewCacheStoreContext.Provider>
  );
};

export default PreviewCacheStoreProvider;

=== FILE: ./middleware/api-logger.ts ===

import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server';

import { getRandomUUID } from '@/lib/utils';
import { type NextResponse } from 'next/server';

import { logger } from '../lib/logger';

/**
 * Logs the API request and response.
 * @param handler - The handler.
 * @returns The handler.
 */
export function apiLogger(
  handler: (req: NextRequest) => Promise<NextResponse>
) {
  return async (req: NextRequest) => {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    const requestId = req.headers.get('x-request-id') ?? getRandomUUID();

    try {
      logger.info('API Request', {
        requestId,
        method: req.method,
        path: req.nextUrl.pathname,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      });

      const response = await handler(req);

      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;

      logger.info('API Response', {
        requestId,
        status: response.status,
        duration: `${duration}ms`,
        path: req.nextUrl.pathname,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      });

      return response;
    } catch (error) {
      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;

      logger.error('API Error', {
        requestId,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
        stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : undefined,
        duration: `${duration}ms`,
        path: req.nextUrl.pathname,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      });

      throw error;
    }
  };
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/documents/[documentId]/esign/page.tsx ===

import {
  canAccessDocument,
  getDocumentById
} from '@signvault/frontend/actions/documents';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import ESignClient from './esign-client';
import { getErrorRedirect } from '@signvault/frontend/lib/utils';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getDbUser } from '@/actions/auth';

export default async function ESignPage({
  params
}: {
  params: { documentId: string };
}) {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });

  const { documentId } = await params;

  if (!documentId) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/documents',
        'Invalid document',
        'The document you are trying to access does not exist.'
      )
    );
  }

  const document = await getDocumentById(BigInt(documentId));

  if (!document) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/documents',
        'Invalid document',
        'The document you are trying to access does not exist.'
      )
    );
  }

  if (!canAccessDocument(documentId, dbUser.id, dbUser.organizationId)) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/documents',
        'Access denied',
        'You do not have access to this document.'
      )
    );
  }

  return <ESignClient document={document} user={dbUser} />;
}

'use client';

import type { State } from '@formity/react';
import type { UseFormProps } from 'react-hook-form';

import { type ReactElement, useEffect } from 'react';
import { FormProvider, useForm } from 'react-hook-form';

import { useFormController } from './form-controller-context';

type FormViewProps = {
  children: ReactElement<any>; // eslint-disable-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  defaultValues: UseFormProps['defaultValues'];
  itemName: string;
  resolver: UseFormProps['resolver'];
};

export function FormView({
  defaultValues,
  resolver,
  children,
  itemName
}: Readonly<FormViewProps>) {
  const form = useForm({
    defaultValues,
    resolver,
    mode: 'onBlur',
    reValidateMode: 'onBlur'
  });
  const { onNext, getState } = useFormController();

  useEffect(() => {
    const { unsubscribe } = form.watch((values) => {
      const state = getState(values);
      saveState(state, itemName);
    });
    const state = getState(form.getValues());
    saveState(state, itemName);
    return () => unsubscribe();
  }, [form, getState]);

  return (
    <form className='space-y-8' onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onNext)}>
      <FormProvider {...form}>{children}</FormProvider>
    </form>
  );
}

// Disabling local storage state saving for now
function saveState(state: State, itemName: string) {
  return;
  // localStorage.setItem(itemName, JSON.stringify(state));
}

=== FILE: ./app/api/subscription/status/route.ts ===

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { getDbUser } from '@/actions/auth';
import { getUserSubscriptionStatus } from '@/actions/subscriptions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    // Get user context
    const logtoContext = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
    if (!logtoContext?.isAuthenticated) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const user = await getDbUser({ claims: logtoContext.claims });
    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'User not found' }, { status: 404 });
    }

    // Fetch actual organization and subscription data from database
    const subscriptionResult = await getUserSubscriptionStatus(
      user.id.toString()
    );

    if (!subscriptionResult.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: subscriptionResult.error || 'Failed to fetch subscription data'
        },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json(subscriptionResult.subscription);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching subscription status:', error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Internal server error' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: ./providers/termly-provider.tsx ===

'use client';

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { usePathname, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';

const SCRIPT_SRC_BASE = 'https://app.termly.io';

export default function TermlyProvider({
  autoBlock,
  masterConsentsOrigin,
  websiteUUID = '4b6097a7-5c7c-45a9-b7a4-0653912114c7'
}) {
  const scriptSrc = useMemo(() => {
    const src = new URL(SCRIPT_SRC_BASE);
    src.pathname = `/resource-blocker/${websiteUUID}`;
    if (autoBlock) {
      src.searchParams.set('autoBlock', 'on');
    }
    if (masterConsentsOrigin) {
      src.searchParams.set('masterConsentsOrigin', masterConsentsOrigin);
    }
    return src.toString();
  }, [autoBlock, masterConsentsOrigin, websiteUUID]);

  const isScriptAdded = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isScriptAdded.current) return;
    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = scriptSrc;
    document.head.appendChild(script);
    isScriptAdded.current = true;
  }, [scriptSrc]);

  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      //   eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
      (window as any)?.Termly?.initialize();
    }
  }, [pathname, searchParams]);

  return null;
}

'use client';

import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { ControllerRenderProps, FieldValues, Path } from 'react-hook-form';

import {
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/form';
import { useFormContext } from 'react-hook-form';

type FormFieldWrapperProps<T extends FieldValues> = {
  children:
    | ReactNode
    | ((field: ControllerRenderProps<T, Path<T>>) => ReactNode);
  description?: string;
  label: string;
  name: Path<T>;
};

export function FormFieldWrapper<T extends FieldValues>({
  name,
  label,
  description,
  children
}: Readonly<FormFieldWrapperProps<T>>) {
  const form = useFormContext<T>();

  return (
    <FormField
      control={form.control}
      name={name}
      render={({ field }) => (
        <FormItem className='w-full'>
          <FormLabel className='font-medium'>{label}</FormLabel>
          <FormControl>
            {typeof children === 'function' ? children(field) : children}
          </FormControl>
          {description && (
            <FormDescription className='text-xs'>{description}</FormDescription>
          )}
          <FormMessage className='text-xs' />
        </FormItem>
      )}
    />
  );
}

=== FILE: ./lib/short-id-mapping.ts ===

import { nanoid } from 'nanoid';
import { v4 as uuidv4, validate as validateUUID } from 'uuid';

/**
 * type definitions for mapping objects
 */
export type IdMapping = {
  createdAt: Date;
  shortId: string; // Now 12 chars
  uuid: string;
};

/**
 * IdMapping database schema type
 */
export type IdMappingSchema = {
  created_at: Date;
  short_id: string; // PK, indexed, 12 chars
  uuid: string; // UK, indexed
};

/**
 * The short ID mapper.
 */
export class ShortIdMapper {
  private static readonly SHORT_ID_LENGTH = 12; // 12 characters

  /**
   * Generates a short ID and UUID pair
   * @returns Object containing both identifiers
   */
  static generatePair() {
    return {
      shortId: nanoid(this.SHORT_ID_LENGTH), // Generate 12-char nanoid
      uuid: uuidv4()
    };
  }

  /**
   * Validates a short ID format
   * @param shortId The ID to validate
   */
  static isValidShortId(shortId: string): boolean {
    return (
      Boolean(shortId) &&
      shortId.length === this.SHORT_ID_LENGTH && // Check for 12 chars
      /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/u.test(shortId)
    );
  }

  /**
   * Validates a UUID format
   * @param uuid The UUID to validate
   */
  static isValidUUID(uuid: string): boolean {
    return validateUUID(uuid);
  }
}

import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { getDbUser } from '@/actions/auth';
import { ROLES } from '@signvault/logto';
import { AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS } from '@signvault/core-lib/index';
import { getErrorRedirect } from '@/lib/utils';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';

export default async function DashboardLayout({
  children
}: Readonly<{
  children: React.ReactNode;
}>) {
  const { claims } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const dbUser = await getDbUser({ claims });
  const isL7 = AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS.includes(
    dbUser?.id.toString() as (typeof AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_IDS)[number]
  );
  const isL6 = dbUser?.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L6_USER.id;
  const isL5 = dbUser?.organizationRoleId === ROLES.L5_USER.id;
  const hasAccess = isL7 || isL6 || isL5;

  if (!hasAccess) {
    redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/account/settings/organization',
        'Insufficient Permissions',
        'You do not have permission to access that page.'
      )
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className='flex flex-col gap-2'>
      {/* <h1 className='font-britanica text-3xl md:text-4xl'>Dashboard</h1> */}
      {children}
    </main>
  );
}

'use client';

import {
  ExpandableTabs,
  type TabItem
} from '@signvault/ui-lib/components/ui/expandable-tabs';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

import { useCalendarContext } from '../../calendar-context';
import { calendarModeIconMap } from '../../calendar-mode-icon-map';
import { calendarModes } from '../../calendar-types';

export default function CalendarHeaderActionsMode() {
  const { mode, setMode, viewType } = useCalendarContext();
  const tabs = calendarModes.map((modeValue) => ({
    title: modeValue.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + modeValue.slice(1),
    icon: calendarModeIconMap[modeValue]
  }));

  if (viewType === 'events') {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <motion.div
      exit='exit'
      initial='initial'
      transition={{ duration: 0.25 }}
      variants={{
        initial: { opacity: 0 },
        animate: { opacity: 1 },
        exit: { opacity: 0 }
      }}
      viewport={{ once: true }}
      whileInView='animate'
    >
      <ExpandableTabs
        onChange={(index) => {
          if (index !== null) {
            setMode(calendarModes[index]);
          }
        }}
        selected={calendarModes.indexOf(mode)}
        tabs={tabs as TabItem[]}
      />
    </motion.div>
  );
}

export type TaskType = 'APPROVAL' | 'SIGNATURE' | 'REVIEW' | 'ACTION';

export type TaskDeadline = {
  type: 'FIXED' | 'RELATIVE';
  value: number;
}

export type Task = {
  id: string;
  uuid: string;
  order: number;
  userId: string;
  taskType: TaskType;
  description: string;
  deadline: TaskDeadline;
  dependencies: string[];
}

export type Stage = {
  id: string;
  uuid: string;
  name: string;
  order: number;
  type: 'SEQUENTIAL' | 'PARALLEL' | 'QUORUM';
  tasks: Task[];
  settings: {
    quorumThreshold?: number;
  };
}

export type WorkflowType = 'SEQUENTIAL' | 'PARALLEL' | 'QUORUM' | 'HYBRID';

export type WorkflowSettings = {
  timeoutBehavior: 'FAIL' | 'CONTINUE' | 'ESCALATE';
  parallelExecution?: boolean;
  quorumThreshold?: number;
  escalation?: {
    enabled: boolean;
    to: string[];
    after: number;
  };
}

export type BaseWorkflow = {
  name?: string;
  settings: WorkflowSettings;
}

export type HybridWorkflow = {
  type: 'HYBRID';
  stages: Stage[];
  tasks?: never;
} & BaseWorkflow

export type StandardWorkflow = {
  type: 'SEQUENTIAL' | 'PARALLEL' | 'QUORUM';
  tasks: Task[];
  stages?: never;
} & BaseWorkflow

export type Workflow = HybridWorkflow | StandardWorkflow;

'use client';

import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import type { TeamMemberCS } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { createTeamMember, deleteTeamMember } from '@/actions/team-members';

export function useAddTeamMember() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (
      data: Omit<TeamMemberCS, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>
    ) => {
      const { teamMember } = await createTeamMember(data);
      return teamMember;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['customTeams'] });
    }
  });
}

export function useRemoveTeamMember() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      memberId
    }: {
      memberId: bigint | string;
      organizationId: bigint | string;
    }) => {
      const { message } = await deleteTeamMember(
        typeof memberId === 'string' ? memberId : memberId.toString()
      );
      return message === 'Team member removed successfully';
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['customTeams'] });
    }
  });
}

=== FILE: ./hooks/use-copy-to-clipboard.ts ===

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';

type CopyFn = (text: string) => Promise<boolean>;

export function useCopyToClipboard(messages?: {
  success?: string;
  error?: string;
}): {
  isCopied: boolean;
  copy: CopyFn;
  messages: {
    success: string;
    error: string;
  };
} {
  const [isCopied, setIsCopied] = useState(false);

  const copy: CopyFn = async (text) => {
    if (!navigator?.clipboard) {
      toast.error('Clipboard not supported');
      return false;
    }

    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      setIsCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setIsCopied(false), 2000); // Reset after 2 seconds
      toast.success(messages?.success || 'Copied to clipboard!');
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('Copy failed', error);
      toast.error(messages?.error || 'Failed to copy to clipboard');
      setIsCopied(false);
      return false;
    }
  };

  return {
    isCopied,
    copy,
    messages: {
      success: messages?.success || 'Copied to clipboard!',
      error: messages?.error || 'Failed to copy to clipboard'
    }
  };
}

=== FILE: ./app/api/logto/join-organization/route.ts ===

import { logtoClientEdge } from '@/app/logto';
import { getErrorRedirect } from '@/lib/utils';
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

/**
 * Handles the Logto sign-in for the organization join flow.
 * @param request - The request object.
 * @returns A redirect response.
 */
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const searchParams = request.nextUrl.searchParams;
  const organizationId = searchParams.get('organizationId');
  const email = searchParams.get('email');

  if (!organizationId || !email) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/account/settings/organization`,
        'Invalid Request',
        'Ran into an error while joining organization. Please try again.'
      )
    );
  }

  return logtoClientEdge.handleSignIn({
    redirectUri: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/api/logto/join-organization/callback`,
    extraParams: {
      organizationId,
      email
    },
    postRedirectUri: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}/join-organization/${organizationId}?email=${email}`
  })(request);
}

import { differenceInDays, isSameDay } from 'date-fns';

import { useCalendarContext } from '../../calendar-context';
import CalendarEvent from '../../calendar-event';
import CalendarBodyHeader from '../calendar-body-header';
import { hours } from './calendar-body-margin-day-margin';

export default function CalendarBodyDayContent({
  date,
  type = 'day'
}: Readonly<{
  date: Date;
  type?: 'day' | 'week' | 'month';
}>) {
  const { events } = useCalendarContext();

  // Filter out full-day events from the main calendar grid
  const dayEvents = events.filter(
    (event) =>
      isSameDay(event.startDate, date) &&
      differenceInDays(event.endDate, event.startDate) === 0
  );

  return (
    <div className='flex grow flex-col'>
      <CalendarBodyHeader date={date} />

      <div className='relative flex-1'>
        {hours.map((hour) => (
          <div className='group h-32 border-b border-border/50' key={hour} />
        ))}

        {dayEvents.map((event) => (
          <CalendarEvent event={event} key={event.id} type={type} />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./actions/template-files.ts ===

'use server';

import { S3Client, PutObjectCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import crypto from 'crypto';

const s3Client = new S3Client({
  region: process.env.S3_REGION,
  credentials: {
    accessKeyId: process.env.S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID,
    secretAccessKey: process.env.S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  }
});

const BUCKET_NAME =
  process.env.S3_BUCKET_ORG_DATA ||
  process.env.S3_BUCKET ||
  'your-default-org-bucket';

export async function uploadFileToS3(
  file: File,
  organizationId: string
): Promise<{ url: string; s3Key: string }> {
  const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
  const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buffer).digest('hex');
  const s3Key = `org_${organizationId}/template_uploads/${Date.now()}_${hash.substring(0, 12)}_${file.name}`;

  const command = new PutObjectCommand({
    Bucket: BUCKET_NAME,
    Key: s3Key,
    Body: buffer,
    ContentType: file.type,
    ACL: 'public-read'
  });

  await s3Client.send(command);

  const url = `https://${BUCKET_NAME}.s3.${process.env.S3_REGION}.amazonaws.com/${s3Key}`;

  return { url, s3Key };
}

=== FILE: ./utils/notifications.ts ===

import type { Notification } from '@signvault/db/types';

import { format, isThisWeek, isThisYear, isToday, isYesterday } from 'date-fns';

/**
 * Groups notifications by date.
 * @param notifications - The notifications.
 * @returns The grouped notifications.
 */
export function groupNotificationsByDate(
  notifications: Notification[]
): Record<string, Notification[]> {
  return notifications.reduce(
    (groups, notification) => {
      const date = new Date(notification.createdAt);
      let dateString: string;

      if (isToday(date)) {
        dateString = 'Today';
      } else if (isYesterday(date)) {
        dateString = 'Yesterday';
      } else if (isThisWeek(date)) {
        dateString = format(date, 'EEEE');
      } else if (isThisYear(date)) {
        dateString = format(date, 'MMMM d');
      } else {
        dateString = format(date, 'MMMM d, yyyy');
      }

      if (!groups[dateString]) {
        groups[dateString] = [];
      }
      groups[dateString].push(notification);
      return groups;
    },
    {} as Record<string, Notification[]>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/documents/utils/draft-storage.ts ===

import type { UploadableFileDetail } from '../upload-types';

const DRAFT_STORAGE_KEY = 'document_upload_drafts';

export type DocumentDraftState = {
  files: UploadableFileDetail[];
  lastModified: number;
  organizationId: string;
  userId: string;
};

export function saveDraftToStorage(draft: DocumentDraftState): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(DRAFT_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(draft));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to save draft to localStorage:', error);
  }
}

export function getDraftFromStorage(): DocumentDraftState | null {
  try {
    const draft = localStorage.getItem(DRAFT_STORAGE_KEY);
    return draft ? JSON.parse(draft) : null;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to get draft from localStorage:', error);
    return null;
  }
}

export function clearDraftFromStorage(): void {
  try {
    localStorage.removeItem(DRAFT_STORAGE_KEY);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to clear draft from localStorage:', error);
  }
}

export function hasDraft(): boolean {
  return !!localStorage.getItem(DRAFT_STORAGE_KEY);
}

            onSelect={onRecordSelect}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return <DataProvenanceTable data={records} onRecordSelect={onRecordSelect} />;
}

=== FILE: ./contexts/cookie-context.tsx ===

'use client';

import { createContext, useContext, useMemo } from 'react';

type CookieContextType = {
  cookieString: string;
};

// Create cookie context
const CookieContext = createContext<CookieContextType | undefined>(undefined);

/**
 * Provider component for the cookie context.
 * @param children - The child elements.
 * @param cookieString - The cookie string.
 * @returns The cookie provider component.
 */
export function CookieProvider({
  children,
  cookieString
}: Readonly<{
  children: React.ReactNode;
  cookieString: string;
}>) {
  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      cookieString
    }),
    [cookieString]
  );

  return (
    <CookieContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</CookieContext.Provider>
  );
}

/**
 * Custom hook to use cookies.
 * @returns The cookie context.
 */
export function useCookies() {
  const context = useContext(CookieContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useCookies must be used within a CookieProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

import { logtoConfig } from '@/app/logto';
import { AccountProvider } from '@/components/pages/account/account-provider';
import { getErrorRedirect } from '@/lib/utils';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { NuqsAdapter } from 'nuqs/adapters/next/app';
import React from 'react';

export default async function MainAccountLayout({
  children
}: Readonly<{
  children: React.ReactNode;
}>) {
  const cookieData = await cookies();
  const { isAuthenticated } = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  const defaultOpen = cookieData.get('dashboard-sidebar-state')?.value;

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return redirect(
      getErrorRedirect('/', 'Not Logged In', 'You are not logged in.')
    );
  }

  return (
    <AccountProvider defaultOpen={defaultOpen === 'true' || true}>
      <NuqsAdapter>{children}</NuqsAdapter>
    </AccountProvider>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./lib/logging/log-util.ts ===

import pino from 'pino';

const logLevel = {
  '*': 'info',
  'account': 'debug',
  'api': 'debug',
  'auth': 'info',
  'organizations': 'debug',
  'server-logger': 'debug',
  'middleware': 'debug',
  'blogs': 'debug',
  'case-studies': 'debug',
  'content': 'debug',
  'onboarding': 'debug',
  'root': 'info'
};

const levels = new Map(Object.entries(logLevel));

export function getLogger(moduleName: string) {
  return pino({
    name: moduleName,
    level: getLogLevel(moduleName),
    enabled: true,
    timestamp: () => `,"time":"${new Date(Date.now()).toISOString()}"`,
    formatters: {
      level: (label) => ({ level: label })
    },
    transport:
      process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development'
        ? {
            target: 'pino/file',
            options: { destination: 1 } // stdout
          }
        : undefined
  });
}

export function getLogLevel(moduleName: string): string {
  return levels.get(moduleName) || levels.get('*') || 'silent';
}

=== FILE: ./lib/document-drafts.ts ===

import type { CreateDraftInput } from '@/actions/document-drafts';
import type { MimeTypePSType } from '@signvault/db/types';

/**
 * Converts an UploadableFileDetail to CreateDraftInput for document creation.
 * @param file The UploadableFileDetail to convert
 * @param organizationId The organization ID
 * @param ownerId The owner user ID
 * @returns CreateDraftInput object
 */
export function fileDetailToDraftInput(
  file: {
    title: string;
    description: string;
    tags: string[];
    file: File;
  },
  organizationId: bigint,
  ownerId: bigint
): CreateDraftInput {
  return {
    title: file.title,
    description: file.description,
    tags: file.tags,
    organizationId,
    ownerId,
    mimeType: (file.file.type as MimeTypePSType) || 'application/pdf',
    fileSize: BigInt(file.file.size),
    metadata: {
      originalFileName: file.file.name,
      uploadedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      isUploaded: true
    }
  };
}

=== FILE: ./lib/logger.ts ===

type LogLevel = 'info' | 'error' | 'warn';

async function log(
  level: LogLevel,
  message: string,
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>
) {
  // In development, log to console
  // if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
  //   console[level](message, meta);
  //   return;
  // }

  try {
    await fetch('/api/logging', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        level,
        message,
        ...meta,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      })
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to send log:', error);
  }
}

export const logger = {
  info: (message: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>) =>
    log('info', message, meta),
  error: (message: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>) =>
    log('error', message, meta),
  warn: (message: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>) =>
    log('warn', message, meta)
};

=== FILE: ./components/termly-script-wrapper.tsx ===

'use client';

import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { createElement, type FC, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

const TermlyScriptWrapper: FC<{
  className?: string;
  dataId: string;
}> = ({ dataId, className }) => {
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = 'https://app.termly.io/embed-policy.min.js';
    script.async = true;
    script.onload = () => setLoaded(true);
    document.body.appendChild(script);
  }, []);

  if (!dataId) {
    return null;
  }

  if (!loaded) {
    return (
      <div className='flex min-h-screen w-full items-center justify-center'>
        <Loader2 className='size-6 animate-spin text-primary' />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return createElement('div', {
    'name': 'termly-embed',
    'data-id': dataId,
    'data-type': 'iframe',
    className
  });
};

export default TermlyScriptWrapper;

=== FILE: ./components/notifications/notification-error-boundary.tsx ===

'use client';

import { clientLogger } from '@/lib/client-logger';
import { Component, type ReactNode } from 'react';

type Props = {
  children: ReactNode;
};

type State = {
  hasError: boolean;
};

export class NotificationErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  public override state: State = {
    hasError: false
  };

  public static getDerivedStateFromError(): State {
    return { hasError: true };
  }

  public override componentDidCatch(error: Error) {
    clientLogger.error(
      'Notification component error:',
      {
        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
      },
      'notification-error-boundary'
    );
  }

  public override render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div className='p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
          Unable to load notifications
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

=== FILE: ./actions/admins.ts ===

'use server';

import type { UserCS } from '@signvault/db/types';

import { db } from '@signvault/db';
import { and, eq, inArray } from '@signvault/db/drizzle';
import { usersCS } from '@signvault/db/schema';
import { ROLES } from '@signvault/logto';

/**
 * Get all admins for an organization.
 * @param organizationId The ID of the organization to get admins for.
 * @returns An array of admin users.
 */
export async function getAdmins(
  organizationId: bigint | string
): Promise<UserCS[]> {
  const admins = await db
    .select()
    .from(usersCS)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(
          usersCS.organizationId,
          typeof organizationId === 'string'
            ? BigInt(organizationId)
            : organizationId
        ),
        inArray(usersCS.organizationRoleId, [
          ROLES.L5_USER.id,
          ROLES.L6_USER.id
        ])
      )
    );
  return admins;
}

=== FILE: ./app/api/stripe/create-customer/route.ts ===

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import Stripe from 'stripe';

const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY!, {
  apiVersion: '2025-08-27.basil'
});

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const { email, name, metadata } = await request.json();

    if (!email || !name) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Email and name are required' },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // Create Stripe customer
    const customer = await stripe.customers.create({
      email,
      name,
      metadata
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      customerId: customer.id,
      success: true
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error creating Stripe customer:', error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Failed to create Stripe customer' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

'use client';

import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { ReactQueryDevtools } from '@tanstack/react-query-devtools';
import { useState } from 'react';

export function ReactQueryProvider({
  children
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const [queryClient] = useState(
    () =>
      new QueryClient({
        defaultOptions: {
          queries: {
            staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes
            refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
            refetchOnReconnect: true,
            retry: 3
          },
          mutations: {
            retry: 1
          }
        }
      })
  );

  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      {children}
      {process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && (
        <ReactQueryDevtools initialIsOpen={false} />
      )}
    </QueryClientProvider>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./utils/uuid.tsx ===

'use client';

export function generateUUID(): string {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    // Server-side: use Node.js crypto
    const { randomUUID } = require('crypto');
    return randomUUID();
  } else if (window.crypto && window.crypto.randomUUID) {
    // Modern browsers: use window.crypto.randomUUID
    return window.crypto.randomUUID();
  } else {
    // Fallback: generate RFC4122 v4 UUID manually
    // https://stackoverflow.com/a/2117523/2715716
    return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(
      /[xy]/gu,
      function (c) {
        const r =
          window.crypto && window.crypto.getRandomValues
            ? window.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(1))[0] & 15
            : (Math.random() * 16) | 0;
        const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3) | 0x8;
        return v.toString(16);
      }
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: ./actions/helpers.ts ===

import {
  type CustomDocumentTemplateCS,
  type DocumentTemplate
} from '@signvault/db/types';

export function getTemplateId(
  template: DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS
) {
  // Here, if templateId is in template, then it is a custom template (i.e, CustomDocumentTemplateCS)
  return 'templateId' in template ? template.templateId : template.id;
}

export function isCustomDocumentTemplate(
  template: DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS
) {
  // Here, if templateId is in template, then it is a custom template (i.e, CustomDocumentTemplateCS)
  return 'templateId' in template;
}

export function isGlobalDocumentTemplate(
  template: DocumentTemplate | CustomDocumentTemplateCS
) {
  // Here, if templateId is not in template, then it is a global template (i.e, DocumentTemplate)
  return !('templateId' in template);
}

'use client';

import type { Events } from '@signvault/db/types';
import { ProvenanceEventCard } from './provenance-event-card';
import { DataEventsTable } from '../data-events-table';

type EventListProps = {
  events: Events[];
  viewMode: 'grid' | 'list';
};

export function EventList({ events, viewMode }: EventListProps) {
  if (events.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className='flex h-40 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-dashed text-muted-foreground'>
        No events found.
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (viewMode === 'grid') {
    return (
      <div className='grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3'>
        {events.map((event) => (
          <ProvenanceEventCard key={String(event.id)} event={event} />
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return <DataEventsTable data={events} />;
}

=== FILE: ./app/api/logto/rbac-protected-resource/get-rbac-protected-resource.ts ===

import { cookies } from 'next/headers';

/**
 * Fetches the RBAC protected resource.
 * @returns The RBAC protected resource.
 */
export async function getRbacProtectedResource() {
  // Fetch RBAC protected resource
  const response = await fetch(
    `${process.env.LOGTO_BASE_URL}/api/logto/rbac-protected-resource`,
    {
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: {
        cookie: (await cookies()).toString()
      }
    }
  );

  // Check if response is not OK
  if (!response.ok) {
    // Check if access is denied
    if (response.status === 403) {
      return 'Access denied, requires read:user scope.';
    }

    // Throw error
    throw new Error('Something went wrong!');
  }

  // Parse response body

  const body = (await response.json()) as { data: string };

  return body.data;
}

=== FILE: ./posthog-page-view.tsx ===

'use client';

import { usePathname, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { usePostHog } from 'posthog-js/react';
import { Suspense, useEffect } from 'react';

export default function SuspendedPostHogPageView() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <PostHogPageView />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

function PostHogPageView(): null {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const posthog = usePostHog();

  // Track pageviews
  useEffect(() => {
    if (pathname && posthog) {
      let url = window.origin + pathname;
      if (searchParams.toString()) {
        url = url + `?${searchParams.toString()}`;
      }

      posthog.capture('$pageview', { $current_url: url });
    }
  }, [pathname, searchParams, posthog]);

  return null;
}

=== FILE: ./hooks/use-query-params.ts ===

import { usePathname, useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';

export function useQueryParams<T>() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const urlSearchParams = new URLSearchParams(searchParams?.toString());

  function setQueryParams(params: Partial<T>) {
    Object.entries(params).forEach(([key, value]) => {
      if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') {
        urlSearchParams.delete(key);
      } else {
        urlSearchParams.set(key, String(value));
      }
    });

    const search = urlSearchParams.toString();
    const query = search ? `?${search}` : '';

    router.push(`${pathname}${query}`);
  }

  return { queryParams: searchParams, setQueryParams };
}

=== FILE: ./app/(user)/account/(debugging)/layout.tsx ===

import { getErrorRedirect } from '@signvault/frontend/lib/utils';

import { authorizedUsers } from '@signvault/core-lib';

import { logtoConfig } from '@signvault/frontend/app/logto';
import { getLogtoContext } from '@logto/next/server-actions';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';

export default async function DebuggingLayout({
  children
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const logtoContext = await getLogtoContext(logtoConfig);
  if (
    !logtoContext?.claims?.sub ||
    !authorizedUsers.includes(logtoContext.claims.sub)
  ) {
    redirect(
      getErrorRedirect(
        '/',
        'Unauthorized',
        'You are not authorized to access this page'
      )
    );
  }
  return children;
}

=== FILE: ./components/spot-blur.tsx ===

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import React from 'react';

export default function SpotBlur({
  intensity,
  color,
  size,
  className,
  stack = 1
}: {
  className?: string;
  color: string;
  intensity: number;
  size: number;
  stack?: number;
}) {
  const Element = (
    <div
      className={cn(`size-[${size}px] absolute`, className)}
      style={{
        backgroundColor: color,
        width: size,
        height: size,
        filter: `blur(${intensity}px)`,
        background: color
      }}
    ></div>
  );
  return (
    <>
      {Array.from({ length: stack }).map((_, index) => (
        <React.Fragment key={index}>{Element}</React.Fragment>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./hooks/use-waitlist.ts ===

'use client';

import { getTotalUsersOnWaitlist } from '@/actions/waitlist';
import { create } from 'zustand';

type WaitlistState = {
  totalUsers: number;
  fetchTotalUsers: () => Promise<void>;
  isLoading: boolean;
};

export const useWaitlist = create<WaitlistState>((set) => ({
  totalUsers: 0,
  isLoading: true,
  fetchTotalUsers: async () => {
    set({ isLoading: true });
    try {
      const count = await getTotalUsersOnWaitlist();
      set({ totalUsers: count + 120, isLoading: false });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch total users on waitlist:', error);
      set({ totalUsers: 999 + 120, isLoading: false }); // Fallback
    }
  }
}));

  getState: GetState;
  onBack: OnBack;
  onNext: OnNext;
  setState: SetState;
};

export const FormControllerContext =
  createContext<FormControllerContextType | null>(null);

export function useFormController() {
  const context = useContext(FormControllerContext);
  if (!context) {

=== FILE: ./hooks/use-mobile.tsx ===

import * as React from 'react';

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 1024;

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(
    undefined
  );

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`);
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);
    };
    mql.addEventListener('change', onChange);
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);
    return () => mql.removeEventListener('change', onChange);
  }, []);

  return !!isMobile;
}

=== FILE: ./app/api/logto/user/get-user.ts ===

import { type LogtoContext } from '@logto/next';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';

export async function getUser() {
  // Fetch user
  const response = await fetch(`${process.env.LOGTO_BASE_URL}/api/logto/user`, {
    cache: 'no-store',
    headers: {
      cookie: (await cookies()).toString()
    }
  });

  // Check if response is not OK
  if (!response.ok) {
    console.error(response);
    throw new Error('Something went wrong! ' + response.statusText);
  }

  // Parse response body
  // Return user
  return (await response.json()) as LogtoContext;
}

=== FILE: ./hooks/use-click-outside.ts ===

import { type RefObject, useEffect } from 'react';

export function useClickOutside(
  ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>,
  handler: () => void
) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        handler();
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, [ref, handler]);
}

let env;

export function getCorrectProjectDir() {
  const projectDir = __dirname;
  const parts = projectDir.split(/[\/\\]/u);

  return correctProjectDir;
}

import { isSameMonth } from 'date-fns';

export default function CalendarHeaderDateBadge() {

      {monthEvents?.length} events
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: ./hooks/use-media-query.tsx ===

import * as React from 'react';

export function useMediaQuery(query: string) {
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    function onChange(event: MediaQueryListEvent) {
      setValue(event.matches);
    }

    const result = matchMedia(query);
    result.addEventListener('change', onChange);
    setValue(result.matches);

    return () => result.removeEventListener('change', onChange);
  }, [query]);

  return value;
}

=== FILE: ./hooks/use-debounce.ts ===

'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export function useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay: number): T {
  const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState<T>(value);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedValue(value);
    }, delay);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [value, delay]);

  return debouncedValue;
}
